sanskrit: ।। ॐ स्वस्ति ।। श्रीनाथपादुकाभ्यां नमः । श्रीगणेशाय नमः । मन्थानभैरवतन्त्रे कुमारिकाखण्डे प्रथमानन्दः 'संवतीमण्डलान्ते' क्रमपदनिहितानन्दशक्तिः सुभीमा सृष्टिन्यायें चतुष्क त्वकुलकुलग पञ्चक चान्यषट्कम् । चत्वारः' पञ्चकोऽन्यः पुनरपि चतुरः षोडशाज्ञाभिषेक दिव्याष्टौ मूर्तिमध्ये हसखफरकला बिन्दुपुष्पा खमुद्रा ॥ १ ॥ बाल कौमारवृद्ध ँ परमशिवकला वक्रदेवी क्रमाणा २२ श्रीनाथ चन्द्रपुर्यांीं” नवनवकलितं युग्मभेदं तु सारम् । त्रीणि” सिद्धावतार प्रथमकलियुगे कोङ्कणे चाधिकार तेषां वै पुत्रशिष्या नवपुरुषक्रमे तेषु मध्याद्” द्विरष्टौ ॥ २ ॥ •३३ सन्तान” गोत्रपिण्ड” क्रमपदसकल षोडशान्तं क्रमान्तं ३९ शेषा वै मण्डलानि परिभ्रमविमल पूज्यसद्भाववृन्दम् । आदावष्टादशान्तं कुलक्रमसकल मण्डलोत्थानपूर्वं ? संस्कार” त्रिक्रमेण” पशुमलक्षयकृत् पिण्डशुद्धिः शिवाग्नौ ॥। ३ ।। ४७ ५० मध्ये विश्रामभूमिः ँ प्रसरमनुभव प्रत्ययं स्वाधिकारम् संसृष्टं येन तस्मै नमत गुरुवरं भैरव श्रीकुलीशम् ॥ ४ ॥
english: CHAPTER ONE Śrīnātha's Inquiry The SaˆvartāmaSÆalasūtra 1Within (the centre) of SaˆvartāmaSÆala2 is the power of bliss (ānandaśakti). Present in (every) part (pada) of the Transmission (kramapadanihitā),3 she is pleasingly horrific (subhīmā). The quaternary is present in (both) Akula and Kula4 (as is) the pentad and another, the hexad, (again) the four, another pentad and again four in the pattern of emanation.5 There is the Sixteenfold Consecration of the Command,6 the eight divine beings7 and, in the middle of (Kubjikā's) form (mūrti), the energy (kalā - E) of (the consonants) Ha Sa Kha Pha Ra and the (goddess who is the) flower which is the Point (bindupunpā)8 and the Gesture of Space (khamudrā).9 (1) (There is the Transmission of the) Child, the Youth and the Aged. She is the goddess Vakrā (the Crooked One), the energy of Supreme Śiva of (all) the Transmissions (krama). (Along with her) Śrīnātha10 (resides in) the City of the Moon11 manifested (kalita) (along with) the eighteen (Nāthas).12 Indeed, the category of the Couple is the essence (of the Divine Current).13 The three (constitute) the descent of the Siddhas in the beginning of the Age of Strife (prathamakaliyuga)14 and the (spiritual) authority (that was thereby established in the land of) Ko‰kaSa.15 These (three) had disciples (who were their spiritual) sons in the Lineage of the Nine Persons (navapurunakrama). Sixteen (disciples) (dviran˜au)16 (arose) from amongst them. (2) The lineage (santāna), the body (formed from the) clans (gotrapiSÆa),17 all the parts (pada) of the Transmission (kramapadasakala), the End of the Sixteen (noÆaśānta)18 that is the culmination of the Transmission (kramānta),19 the remaining maSÆalas,20 the pure rotation (of KuSÆalinī) (paribhrama)21- (this) is the collection of the (teachings concerning) the essential nature (of the deity who is the) object of worship (pūjyasadbhāvavrndam).22 In the beginning23 the entire Kulakrama is within the (group of) eighteen (Nāthas) prior to the emergence of the maSÆala.24 The purification (saˆskāra)25 that destroys the impurity of the fettered26 by means of the Triple Transmission (trikrama)27 is the purification of the body (piSÆa) in the fire of Śiva.28 (3) In the centre is the Plane of Repose,29 it is the spread (of emanation) (prasara) and the experience (of ultimate reality),30 realisation (pratyaya)31 and one's own authority.32 (You all) bow (namatha) to him by whom (all this) has been emitted,33 the best of teachers, Bhairava, the venerable Kulīśa!34 (4)

sanskrit: 4 कुमारिकाखण्डः वृत्ताध्युष्ट क्रमार्थ रचितमनुभवं खञ्जिनीमूर्तिपूर्व दिव्योऽय देवसंज्ञ पुनरपि अपर मानवं त्रिक्रमौघम् । भेदानेकैर्विभिन्न” सकलपदक्रमं मण्डलं षट्प्रकार ६८ संकेत कादिपूर्व सकलगुणयुतं मण्डलं भैरव तम् ।। ५ ।। श्रीनाथ उवाच मण्डलान्ते तु कः कती मण्डलं तु कथं भवेत् । कथमानन्दशक्तिस्तु ँ सा शक्तिर्भीषण कथम् ।। ६ ॥ ७२ ७१ तस्यावरणमादाय कीदृक् ” चैव पदक्रमम्” । ७४ सृष्टिन्याये चतुष्कं तु अकुल तु कथं भवेत् ॥ ७ ॥ •७७ ७८ कुल चैव कथं प्रोक्त” कुलाचार च कीदृशम् । पञ्चकं किं समासेन षट्कं चत्वार एव च ॥ ८ ॥ ८२ पञ्चक:” कश्चतुर्भूयः¨ षोडशाज्ञा कथं भवेत् । ८६ आदौ कुत्राभिषेक तु“ देवताष्टौ ँ वदस्व मे ॥ ९ ॥ मूर्तिमध्ये कथं तच्च मुद्रा तत्रैव कीदृशी । बालक्रमं च कौमारं तथा वृद्धक्रमं कथम् ।। १० ।। का कला परमा शार्वी क्रमाणां क्रमदेवता । ३ चन्द्रपुर्यं कथं प्रोक्तं श्रीनाथ किं स्वरूपिणम् ॥ ११ ॥ ९६ षोडशात्मकशिष्यौघ अवसानं कथं भवेत् । । सन्तान” गोत्रपिण्डं तु सकलं तु पदक्रमम् ॥ १२ ॥
english: CHAPTER ONE 5 The purport of the Transmission (kramārtha) is set in (these) three and a half (verses) (vrttādhyun˜a).35 It is the experience (of deity) that has been composed (racita in verse) in accord with (pūrva) Khañjinī's form (mūrti). This is the Divine Current (divyaugha) called that of the gods (devasaˆjña). There is also the other (apara) (immanent) one namely, the Current of the Triple Transmission (trikrama), which is human (mānava). (Thus) the maSÆala consisting of six parts (prakāra) is the entire Krama with all its parts (sakalapadakrama)36 divided into many types (bheda).37 The teaching (saˆketa) commences with (the sacred seat whose name) begins with `Kā'38 and, endowed with all the qualities, is Bhairava's maSÆala. (5) Śrīnātha's questions concerning the SaˆvartāmaSÆalasūtra Śrīnātha said:39 (1) Who acts within the maSÆala? (2) How is the maSÆala? (3) How is the power of bliss? (4) How is it that that energy is horrific? (6) (5) Once taken up its enclosure (āvaraSa), how is the sequence of parts (padakrama) (within the maSÆala)? (6) (What is) the tetrad in the pattern of emanation? (7) How is Akula? (7) Again, (8) what is Kula said to be? (9) How is the activity of Kula (kulācāra)? (10) What, in brief, is the pentad, the group of six and (the second) four? (8) (11) What is the (second) pentad and, again, the (third group of) four? (12) How is the sixteenfold Command? (13) Where (does) the consecration (take place) in the beginning? (14) Pray tell me (about) the eight deities. (9) (15) And how is that (group of eight) within the icon (of the deity) (mūrti)?40 (16) How is the Gesture (mudrā) there? (17) How is the Transmission (krama) of the Child and that of the Youth and the Aged? (10) (18) What is the energy (kalā), the supreme Śārvī41 who is the Krama Deity (devatā) of (all) the Transmissions (krama)? (19) What is the City of the Moon (candrapurya)42 said to be? (20) What is the (true) nature of Śrīnātha? (11) (21) How is the conclusion (avasāna) (of the transmission)43 namely, the sixteenfold current of disciples? (22) What is the family (santāna), the body (formed from the) clans (gotrapiSÆa) and the entire sequence of parts (padakrama)? (12)

sanskrit: 6 कुमारिकाखण्डः षोडशान्त क्रमान्त किं २ शेषा वै मण्डलानि १०६ १०४ ४ । परिभ्रमं न में ज्ञात विमलं तु विशेषतः ।। १३ ।। एतत् सर्वं समासेन पूज्यसद्भावनिर्णयम्” । तस्याष्टादशभेदानि” कथं ज्ञास्यन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥ १४ ॥ युग्मभेदं कथं सारं सिद्धास्त्रितयशासनें । १११ दक्षिणे कोऽधिकारी स्यान्नवकं किं स्वरूपिणम् ।। १५ ।। ११७ तथाष्टादशभेदानि आश्रम पूर्वमण्डलम् । कथं विज्ञायते”“ देवि संस्कार” त्रिक्रमेण तु ।। १६ ।। पशुः कोऽत्र समासेन मण्डलं तु कथं भवेत् २ । क्षय २३ केन स्वरूपेण मलस्यैव २४ तु विद्यते ।। १७ ।। १२६ आदौ पिण्ड २५ तु किं प्रोक्तं देहे देहे व्यवस्थितम् । शिव ७ नाम कथं ह्यग्निमध्ये विश्रामभूमिका १२९ ॥ १८ ॥ १३४ का स्वरूपा च कि देवि प्रत्यय स्वाधिकारकम्' । सृष्ट ३५ येन स वै ३६ कोऽत्र भैरवश्च कथं भवेत् ॥ १९ ॥ कौलीश नाम किं प्रोक्तं सर्वमेवानुपद्धति: १३९ । कथयस्व प्रसादेन ं यदि तुष्टासि वक्रिके ॥ २० ॥ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते ४२ लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे ३ विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे’४५ आज्ञापारमेश्वरे ६ स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्र- संहिताया अव्वाक्रमभाषिते श्रीनाथप्रश्नाधिकारो १४९ नामानन्दः प्रथमः ।। १ ।
english: CHAPTER ONE 7 (23) What is the End of the Sixteen which is the culmination (anta) of the Transmission (kramānta)?44 (24) What are the remaining maSÆalas? (25) I have not known the rotation (paribhrama) (of KuSÆalinī), particularly the pure one. (13) All this, in brief, is the teaching concerning the essential nature of the object(s) of worship.45 (26) How will the (spiritual) sons know its eighteen divisions? (14) (27) How is the Division of the Couple the essence? (28) (Who are the) Siddhas in the teaching of the three (lineages) (tritayaśāsana)? (29) Who has authority in the South? (30) What is the group of nine? (15) (31) Moreover, (what are) the eighteen divisions? (32) And (what is) the Hermitage (aśrama) which is the first maSÆala? (33) O goddess, how can one know the purification (saˆskāra) (that takes place) by means of the Triple Transmission? (16) (34) Who is the fettered soul here? (35) (Pray tell me) in brief how the maSÆala is and (36) by means of what essential nature does the destruction of impurity take place? (17) (37) What is said to be the body (piSÆa) that is located in the beginning within each single body (deha)? (38) How is Śiva? (39) What is the nature of the Plane of Repose in the middle of (his) fire? (18) O goddess, (40) what is the realisation that is one's own authority? (41) Who is the one here who has emanated (this)? And (42) how is Bhairava? (19) (43) Who is said to be Kaulīśa? O Vakrikā, if you are satisfied tell me everything in due order, by (your) grace. (20) This is the first chapter called Concerning Śrīnātha's Enquiry. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for a hundred and twenty-five thousand (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six (Thousand Verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses - caturviˆśatsahasrasaˆhitā) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: श्रीवक्रा उवाच' द्वितीयानन्दः शृणु नाथ महाप्राज्ञ कुलकौलस्य' भाजन । येन विज्ञातमात्रेण' संवित्तिर्भवते स्फुटा' ॥ १ ॥ तदहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि वक्रिकां परमेश्वरीम् । यः शावरादिरित्याहुरेकधा बहुधा गतः ।। २ ।। मण्डलान्ते स्थितो´ नित्यं सृष्टिसंहारकारकः' । O अतसीपुष्पसंकाश ं नित्योदितमखण्डितम् ।। ३ ॥ सर्वगं सर्वदा शान्तं मण्डलं कुलक्रमे । खरण्डदण्डमध्यस्था'' अणुचित्कलयापिनीं ॥ ४॥ प्राणापानान्तरे लीना आनन्दशक्तिरुच्यते । १७ कालवेलाविचित्राङ्गी ँ तन्वी तत्त्वप्रबोधकी ॥ ५ ॥ निरानन्दपदे लीना भीषणी परमाव्यया । पदषोडशप्रस्तारे” देव्या मूर्तिस्त्रिधा गता ।। ६ ॥ अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गवक्त्रैस्तु पदभेदैव्यवस्थिता ।
english: CHAPTER TWO The Response to the Inquiry The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O Lord! Greatly wise one! Repository of Kula and Kaula! Listen. I will explain that, namely, (the true nature of) the Supreme Goddess (parameśvarī) Vakrikā, by just knowing which the realisation (of attainment) (saˆvitti)1 is clearly evident (sphu˜ā). (1-2ab) The one who acts within the MaSÆala and the MaSÆala He2 whom (the wise) call Śāvara3 and the like is one and has assumed many forms. He resides permanently within the maSÆala and (is the one there who) engenders emanation and withdrawal. (2cd-3ab) 4The maSÆala in the Kula transmission (kulakrama) is always peaceful, pervasive, unbroken and perpetually manifest (nityodita). It is (dark blue) like the flower of the hemp plant (atasī).5 (3cd-4ab) The Power of Bliss 6Merged between the exhaled (prāSa) and inhaled breath (apāna), (she is) said to be the power of bliss. Located in the middle of the Stick of the Cavity of Space (i.e. SunumSā),7 she pervades the energy of the consciousness of the individual soul.8 Slender, her limbs beautifully variegated by time and moment, she awakens to (ultimate) reality. Merged in the plane of the Bliss of Stillness (nirānanda),9 she is supreme, imperishable and horrific.10 (4cd-6ab) The Goddess in the MaSÆala 11The form (mūrti) of the goddess has become threefold12 within the layout (prastāra) of the sixteen parts (pada of her Vidyā)13 and is established (within the maSÆala) according to the division of the parts (of her Vidyā, which are her), faces and limbs, major and minor.14 (6cd-7ab)

sanskrit: 10 कुमारिकाखण्डः भर्गपूर्वक्रम यच्च” विलोमांशे¨ व्यवस्थितम्” । क्रमं तु नवधा भिन्नं वृद्धं कौमारबालकम् ।। ७ ।। २८ ३४ •३१ इच्छा ज्ञानी क्रियाख्या प्रकटितविभवा बुद्धिरेतच्चतुष्कं तन्मात्रा:” पञ्च शब्दप्रभृतय इति ये पञ्चकं ज्ञानपूर्वम् । त्वक्चक्षुघ्रीणजिह्वाश्रवण इति मनांसीति षट्कं क्रियाख्यम् जाग्रत् सुप्तं सुषुप्तं” पदमपि अपरं तुर्यगं तच्चतुष्कं ॥ ८ ॥ आपस्तेजोऽथ पृथ्वीपवनगगनकं पञ्चकं रत्नपूर्वम् सत्त्वं रजस्तमांसि” त्रिगुणगुणयुतं संस्थितं वृक्षनाथम् । ३८ ४५ श्रीकुब्जी षट्प्रकारा” हसखफरकला व्यापयन्ती भगाख्या तस्यान्ते क्षोभितायां परमसुखनिधौ रुद्रशक्तौ प्रविश्य ।। ९ ।। संलीना मूलनार्थे पुनरपि च तदाच्छादकाः षट्प्रकाराः ४८ पीठाद्यैः षट्प्रकारैस्तदुपरिमथन दिव्यलिङ्गं विभिन्नम् । ° तत्राज्ञानन्दरूपा सुखरतिविमला विश्वकर्त्री च हन्त्री चिद्रूपा वक्रिकाख्या परमपदगता भुक्तिदा मुक्तिदा च'३ ॥१० ॥ ५६ ५७ ललनार्थ खमादाय घण्टिकायाः परामृतम् । आत्मानं प्लाव्य तेनैव अभिषेकमिदं” भवेत् ॥ ११ ॥ मालिनी शब्दराशिश्च गोत्रं व्याप्य व्यवस्थितौ । तद्” गोत्र े सृष्टिकर्ताीर शिवशक्त्यावृतं जगत् ।। १२ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWO 11 The Transmission 15The Transmission (krama) that begins with Bharga is established in the reverse aspect.16 Again, the transmission is divided nine times. It is that of the Aged, the Youth and the Child. (7cd-7ef) The Groups of Four, Five, Six, Four, Five and Four 17The intellect, will, knowledge and (the energy) called action whose power has been made manifest: this is the tetrad. The subtle elements namely, the five - sound and the rest: this is the pentad of knowledge. The skin, eye, nose, tongue and hearing, along with the mind (manas): this is the hexad called action. Waking, sleep, deep sleep and the other state established in the Fourth: that is the tetrad. Water, fire, earth, wind and sky are the group of Five Jewels.18 Vrknanātha19 abides (there) endowed with the qualities of the three qualities namely, sattva, rajas and tamas.20 (8-9ab) The Six Modalities of the Goddess and Mūlanātha, the Root Lord 21The venerable (goddess) Kubjī has six modalities (na˜prakārā).22 She is the energy (E) of Ha Sa Kha Pha Ra and, pervading (all things), is called the Yoni (bhaga). When she who is Rudra's power, the treasure of Supreme Bliss, is aroused and has entered within him (i.e. Vrknanātha), then the six modalities (prakāra) that are (her) enclosures (āchādaka) are again merged into the Root Lord (Mūlanātha).23 By churning from above, the Divine Li‰ga is divided into six modalities (prakāra) namely, the sacred seats (pī˜ha) and the rest. The (goddess) called Vakrikā (resides) there. She is the bliss of the Command (ājñā), pure with blissful intercourse (sukharati). She creates all things and destroys (them). She is consciousness and, abiding in the supreme state, she bestows both (worldly) enjoyment and liberation. (9cd-10) The Consecration 24This consecration (abhineka) takes place once the Self has been flooded with the supreme nectar (that flows from the psychic centre) of the uvula (after) having laid hold (ādāya) of the Void (kha)25 in order to play (lalanārtha). (11) The Clan 26Mālinī and Śabdarāśi having pervaded the clan (gotra) are (well) established. That clan is the agent of emanation and the universe enveloped by Śiva and Śakti. 27 (12)

sanskrit: 12 कुमारिकाखण्डः गृहवर्गसमोपेत कुलाष्टकसमन्वितम् । ६७ चक्राष्टकसमायुक्त ं ब्रह्माणीदेवताष्टकम् ।। १३ ॥ मुद्राशक्तिः समाख्याता ययेद मुद्रितं जगत् । ७१ ७२ ७३ चतुर्विधा” तु सा सृष्टिर्भूतग्रामे चतुर्विधे ॥ १४ ॥ •७४ •७५ बालक्रमं च कौमारं तथा वृद्ध क्रम क्रमात् । विषुवस्थानमार्गेण त्रिमार्गे संव्यवस्थिता ।। १५ ॥ खकला” पूर्णिमास्यन्ते” अमान्ते ं संव्यवस्थिता । सा कला खकला” ज्ञेया सा च पूर्ण हृदि स्थिता ॥ १६ ॥ अन्वयं श्रीमताख्यं च देवी त्रैलोक्यचारिणी । चतुःषष्टिक्रमेणोक्ता क्रमदेवी च वक्रिका ॥ १७ ॥ विसर्गयोगमध्ये“ तु चन्द्रपूर्यौ ं व्यवस्थितम् । सूष्मणामण्डलाधार कल्लोलामृतवाहिनः ।। १८ ॥ विश्वरूपं परं तत्त्वं उन्मनान्ते” व्यवस्थितम् । ९३ श्रीनाथं तं कुलालम्बी कुजी सिद्धनायकम् ॥ १९ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWO 13 The Eight Deities 28The group of eight deities (beginning with) BrahmāSī29 is associated with eight wheels,30 the Octad of Kula, the classes (of phonemes) and the houses (grha). (13) The Gesture 31The energy of Gesture (mudrāśakti) is said to be that by which the universe is made manifest (mudrita lit. ‘stamped’). It is the fourfold emanation that takes place in the fourfold aggregate of elements (bhūtagrāma). 32 (14) The Three Transmissions and the Deity of the Transmission The Transmission (krama) of the Child, that of Youth and the Transmission of the Aged, in due order.33 34Established (saˆvyavasthitā)35 on the triple path, by means of the Path of the Stations of the Equinox (vinuvasthāna),36 the energy of the Void (khakalā) is established within the New Moon at the end of the Full Moon37 (pūrSamāsī).38 That energy should be known to be the energy of the Void and, full (pūrSā), it abides within the Heart.39 (15-16) The Tradition (anvaya) is called the Śrīmata and the goddess is she who moves (throughout) the Three Worlds by means of the Sequence of Sixty-four (energies).40 She is said to be Vakrikā, the goddess of the transmissions (kramadevī). (17) The City of the Moon 41The City of the Moon is located in the centre of the Union of Emission (visargayoga). It is the foundation of the MaSÆala of SūnmaSā42 and transports the waves of nectar.43 (18) Śrīnātha The supreme, omniform (viśvarūpa) reality (tattva) is located within the Transmental (unmanānte). That is Śrīnātha (otherwise know as) Kujīśa who sustains the Kula (kulālambin)44 and is the leader of those who have achieved perfection (siddhanāyaka).45 (19)

sanskrit: 14 कुमारिकाखण्डः दिव्याष्टादशभेदानि कथयामि सुरेश्वर । अष्टादशक्रमाम्नायं उन्मनाज्ञाविनिर्गतम् ।। २० ।। चतुःप्रकारसंयुक्तं पञ्च षट् च त्रिधात्मकम् । १०३ प्रथममुन्मनाम्नाय द्वितीयं च मनोन्मनम् ॥ २१ ॥ े ।। ।। १०४ तृतीयं समनाव्याप्तिः व्यापिन्यायाश्चतुर्थकम् ' १०५ । अव्यक्तं पञ्चमं शम्भो नन्दिन्या षष्ठ उच्यते ।। २२ ।। २०७ ११० ।। २३ ।। मन्थानं सप्तमं वक्रे अष्टमं फेरुक भवेत् । नवमं समयाख्य च जम्भलं दशमं स्मृतम् दशैक कालसंकर्ष २ द्वादशं चण्डनिर्णयम् त्रयोदशमघोरीश४ त्रैलोक्यं च चतुर्दशम् ॥ २४ ॥ ११७ ।। । विनयं पञ्चदशं प्रोक्त कमल षोडश भवेत् । ११९ । दशसप्त चर्चिका देवी श्रीनाथोऽष्टादश १ भवेत् ।। २५ ।। १२३ इत्यष्टादशभेदानि पारम्पर्यक्रमागताः । आगत’२४ ओघभेदेन'१५ दिव्याम्नायमनुक्रमात् ।। २६ ।। १२६ •१२७ १२८ शिवशक्तिसमायोग सामरस्य विदुस्तथा । १२९ १३१ उभे पक्षे तु मेलाप युग्मभेदमिदं स्मृतम् ।। २७ ।। चन्द्रार्काग्निस्त्रयः१३२ सिद्धा मि-ष- ओ ३३ वै त्रिके मता: अधिकारपदस्थाश्च सिद्धास्त्रिभुवनाधिपाः ।। २८ ।। १३६ सोमाकीनलमध्यस्था चित्कला अमृतोपमा ७ । १३८ षडध्वशुद्धतत्त्वात्मावृक्षनाथ तु दक्षिणे ॥ २९ ॥ नवात्मानन्ददेवेशं नवशक्तिसमन्वितम् । १३४ ।
english: CHAPTER TWO 15 The Divine Current: the Transmission of the Eighteen 46O Lord of the gods, I will now explain the eighteen divine divisions namely, the tradition (āmnāya) of the Transmission of the Eighteen that has emerged as the Command of the Transmental. Endowed with four aspects, (there are) five and six (divisions) and it is threefold.47 (20-21ab) (1) The first (division) is the tradition (āmnāya) of Unmana (the Transmental), the second Manonmana (Mind Beyond Mind), the third is the pervasion of Samanā (the Equal One) and the fourth (division) is that of Vyāpinyā (the Pervasive). (2) O Śambhu, Avyakta (Unmanifest) is the fifth while (the division of) Nandinii is said to be the sixth. O Vakrā, the seventh is Manthāna, the eighth is Pheruka48 and the ninth is called Samaya. (3) Jambhala is said to be the tenth. The eleventh is Kālasaˆkārna. The twelfth (division) is the teaching (nirSaya) (concerning) CaSÆa. The thirteenth is Aghorīśa and the fourteenth Trailokya. The fifteenth is said to be Vinaya. (4) The sixteenth is Kamala. The seventeenth is the goddess Carcikā and the eighteenth is Śrīnātha. (21cd-25) These are the eighteen divisions that have come (into the world) through the uninterrupted succession of the transmission (of the teaching) (pāramparyakrama). It is the Divine Tradition (divyāmnāya) that has come as (one of) the currents (oghabheda) (of the teachings transmitted) in due order.49 (26) The Couple 50(The wise) know the union of Śiva and Śakti to be oneness (sāmarasya). This, the Division of the Couple (yugmabheda), is said to be the union (melāpa) that takes place in both polarities.51 (27) The Three Siddhas The three Siddhas,52 MI (Mitranātha),53 ±a (±an˜hanātha) and O (OÆÆīśanātha)54 are the Moon, Sun and Fire, honoured in the three (lineages) (trika).55 They occupy the post of authority and, Siddhas, they are the lords of the Three Worlds. (28) Vrknanātha, the Nine and Sixteen Siddhas The energy of consciousness (citkalā), similar to nectar, is in the middle of the Moon, Sun and Fire. Vrknanātha,56 who is the pure principle of the Sixfold Path,57 is in the Deccan.58 He, the lord of the gods, is the bliss of Navātman59 endowed with nine powers. (29-30ab)

sanskrit: 16 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १४० नवधागतिरागत्य” गकारादिव्यवस्थितम् ।। ३० ॥ १४२ भर्गस्थानादयश्चैव षोडशाधारमण्डलाः । १४४ शिष्यौघामोघसंभूतं महाभ्युदयकारकम् ।। ३१ ।। पिण्डं कुण्डलिनी प्रोक्तं नवात्मानन्दसंयुतम् । १४७ क्रमणे क्रमभेदेन पिण्डरूपा तु पीठगां अवतारक्रमेणैव द्वादशान्ते व्यवस्थिता । १५१ १४९ ।। ३२ ।। अपरपरभेदेन अवतीर्णी ५०७ च वक्रिका ।। ३३ ।। १५३ सन्ततिप्रसरौघ स्यान्निरानन्दा च सा कला । १५६ संसारे ५४ वर्तते तस्मात् तरङ्गिण्या परा कला ।। ३४ ।। गोत्रपञ्चाशद्भिर्भिन्ना पिण्डरूपा शिवा कला । १५८ शिव तु निर्विकारं वै संसारोत्तीर्णभेषजम् ।। ३५ ।। उदासीनमनाम च शिवमित्युच्यते ततः १६४ १६३ । इडापिङ्गलयोर्मध्ये ं वक्रा विश्रामभूमिका ।। ३६ ।। कारणोत्था सदा तिष्ठेच्छिवमार्गीनुयायिनी' । १६८ १६७ अतसीपुष्पसंकाशा षड्वक्त्रा परमा कला ।। ३७ ।। चैतन्यसहिता तिष्ठेद् विद्यारूपा परा कला । १७१ प्रत्यय बहुधा तस्याः विज्ञानाज्ञानुगा परा ।। ३८ ।। भुवनाधिपति:¨२ सा वै वक्रिका कुलरूपिणीं १७३ । अधिकारे प्रसिद्धा सा पञ्चतत्त्वैरधिष्ठिता ।। ३९ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWO 17 (Vrknanātha), the one who possesses nine modalities (gati),60 having come (into the world) the (Nine Nāthas) starting with the one (whose name begins with the) letter Ga are established (here).61 While the maSÆalas of the sixteen supports are those beginning with Bharga’s place (bhargasthāna).62 (In this way) the unfailing current of disciples (śinyogha), that brings great prosperity, has come into being. (30cd-31) The Body (piSÆa) and the Fifty Clans of the Wave of Sonic Energy 63The Body (piSÆa), endowed with the bliss of Navātman, is said to be KuSÆalinī. Her nature the Body (of letters) (piSÆarūpā), in (her onward) advance (kramaSa) in association with the transmission (kramabheda), she resides in (all) the sacred seats (pī˜ha). By the sequence of (her) descent (avatārakrama) she is established in the End of the Twelve and (so) Vakrikā has descended as (both) supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent) so that the current (ogha) of the extension of (her spiritual) family may exist.64 And that energy (kalā) is the Bliss of Stillness (nirānandā).65 (32-34ab) She resides within the world of transmigration (saˆsāra) and so she, the supreme energy (kalā), is (called) Tara‰giSī (the Wave (of power that flows through manifestation).66 Divided into the fifty clans (gotra),67 she is the energy (called) Śivā and her nature the Body (of letters) (piSÆarūpā).68 (34cd-35ab) Śiva (It is) auspicious (śiva), the (divine medicinal) herb beyond the sphere of transmigration and free of change, then (that reality which is) aloof (from the world) and has no name (anāma) is said to be `Śiva'.69 (35cd-36ab) The Plane of Repose Vakrā resides between the (two psychic nerves) IÆā and Pi‰galā70 and is the Plane of Repose.71 Arisen from (the god who is the primal) cause (of all things), she is always (well) established and follows Śiva's Path.72 (Blue) like the flower of the hemp plant (atasī),73 she has six faces74 and is the supreme energy. (36cd-37) Realisation, Authority and the Goddess of the Transmission 75The supreme energy (kalā), whose form is (the goddess's) Vidyā (vidyārūpā), abides endowed with consciousness. Supreme and in accord with the Command of realised consciousness (vijñānājñā), her sign of attainment (pratyaya) is manifold.76 Indeed, she, Vakrikā, is the lord of the worlds (bhuvanādhipati)77 and is Kula (the aggregate of energies). She is well known in the post of authority (adhikāra) and is sustained by the five Principles.78 (38-39)

sanskrit: 18 कुमारिकाखण्डः १७७ १७९ क्रमनायकिविख्याता”“ साधिकारे तु शाम्भवें । पञ्चाशद्भुवनव्याप्ति:७८ कालाग्न्यादिशिवान्तिका' ।। ४० ।। तत्र मध्ये मया सृष्ट चराचर चतुर्विधम् । त्रिगुणा८२ सा८३ त्रिमात्रा च सृष्टिरूपा व्यवस्थिता ॥ ४१॥ भैरव १८६ भरिताकारं अनादिनिधनं महत् । भरत्यमृतरूपेण व्योमगात्र निरञ्जनम् ।। ४२ ॥ रवति“ ज्ञानसद्भाव“” तेनासौ भैरवः प्रभुः । अक्षयः क्षयहीनश्च भैरवः परिकीर्तितः ।। ४३ ॥ कुलकौलान्तमध्यस्थ” ईशं नाम व्यवस्थितम् । ईश्वरं सर्वदेवानां कौलीशं परिकीर्तितम् ।। ४४ ॥ चतुष्कं चतुरो३ भेदैः सा शक्तिश्च चतुर्विधा । मि-ष-च-ओ९४ प्रसिद्धाश्च पद्धतिस्तैर्निदर्शिता ।। ४५ ।। इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे ९७ लक्षपादाधिके“ आद्यपीठावतारिते ” विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे° स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्र- २०२ संहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते २३ प्रश्नोत्तराधिकारवर्णने २०४ २०७ क्रमोदयो २०५ नामानन्दो २६ द्वितीयः ॥ २ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWO 19 79She is known as the Mistress of the Transmission (kramanāyakī) within Śiva's (śāmbhava) sphere of authority. She is the pervasion of the fifty worlds that ranges from the Fire of Time (kālāgni) up to Śiva in the end.80 There, in the centre, I have emanated the moving and immobile (universe) of four kinds.81 She has three qualities,82 three measures (trimātrā)83 and abides in the form of emanation. (40-41) Bhairava and Kaulīśa 84Bhairava is (the god) whose form is full (bharita) (of all things). Devoid of origin and end, he is great. Stainless (nirñjana), he fills (bharati) with nectar (his) body which is the Void (vyomagātra). He emits (vamati) the essence of knowledge and so he is Bhairava, the lord. Imperishable and devoid of decay, he is known as Bhairava.85 The lord (īśa) abides in the centre between Kula and Kaula.86 He is the lord of all the gods and is known as Kaulīśa. (42-44) The Four Siddhas The group of four (catunka) (is formed) by means of the four divisions and that energy is also fourfold. Again, MI (Mitranātha), ±a (±an˜hanātha), Ca (Caryānātha) and O (OÆÆīśanātha) are famous. They have shown the path (paddhati).87(45) This is the second chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description Concerning the Response to the Inquiry. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for a hundred and twenty-five thousand (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six (Thousand Verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Transmission of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: श्रीवक्रा उवाच' तृतीयानन्दः कैलासस्यापरे' मूर्ती मेरुमन्दिरमूर्धनि । महारामे च रम्ये च तूष्णीनाथगुहाश्रमम्' ।। १ ।। त्रिरस्रं सप्तस्कन्धाभ ँ कुलाष्टकसमावृतम् । तन्मध्ये च त्रिरत्र' तु शतयोजनविस्तरम् ॥ २ ॥ सा शिला चन्द्रकान्तिस्तु तप्तहेमसमप्रभा । मणिमुक्ताप्रवालैस्तु” चित्रिता सुमनोरमा ।। ३ ।। सुस्पष्टा च महादीप्ता चन्द्रकोटिसमप्रभा । सप्तस्कन्धसमायुक्ता पञ्चासनसमन्विता ॥ ४॥ तन्मध्ये वर्तुलाकार षडशीतिस्तु योजना: । विस्तार च अधश्चैव शुद्धस्फटिकनिर्मलम् ॥ ५ ॥ तोरणद्वयसंयुक्त प्राकाराष्टकभूषितम् । २१ देवताष्टकसंयुक्तं विकरालं च भीषणम् ॥ ६ ॥ अखण्डमण्डलावास” सिंहनादमलंकृतम्” । महासान्निध्यकरण” आदिकादिसमायुतम् ॥ ७ ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE Dakna's Curse and Grace The Goddess's Li‰ga: The Triangle in the Centre The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: The cave hermitage (āśrama) of TūnSīnātha (the Silent Lord) is located in a large and beautiful grove situated on the peak of the temple of Meru, which is another form of (mount) Kailāsa.1 (1) It is triangular and appears to have seven sections (skandha).2 It is surrounded by the Octad of Kula.3 The triangle that is in the middle of that (Octad of Kula) extends for one hundred leagues (yojana).4 (2) That is the Stone (śilā), beautiful as the moon, the light of which is like heated gold. It is decorated with jewels, pearls and corals and is most delightful. (3) It is clearly visible (suspan˜ā),5 greatly illumined, like the light of ten million moons. It possesses seven sections (skandha) and is endowed with five seats (āsana).6 (4) There is a circular form in the centre of that which is eighty-six leagues7 in diameter (vistāra). And below (the foundation) is as clean as pure crystal. (5) It possesses two arches8 and is adorned with eight ramparts. Endowed with the group of eight deities,9 it is very terrible and horrific. (6) Its abode is the unbroken circle (akhaSÆamaSÆalāvāsa)10 and is adorned with the Lion's Sound (siˆhanāda).11 Endowed with (the vowels) `A' and the rest (as well as the consonants) `Ka' and so forth,12 it is the great means (to draw the deity) near (mahāsānnidhyakaraSa). (7)

sanskrit: 22 कुमारिकाखण्डः .२६ २७ तन्मध्ये त ँ त्रिकोणं तु योजनानां शतार्धकम् । मेखलात्रयसंयुक्त” भूगृह” देवतालयम् ॥ ८ ॥ आरक्तं राजतं” सुभ्रं शतार्कवपुतेजसम्” । ३४ ३६ योजनाः” पञ्चविंशैव तन्मध्येऽखण्डमण्डलम् ॥। ९ ॥ ३८ निशाकरार्धजठर” तन्मध्ये कुलकालिका । ०३९ शतार्धं” योजनानां तु आत्मानं रविमण्डलम् ॥ १० ॥ तन्मध्ये क्रममुद्रा च आज्ञा उलित्रये गुरुः ४६ •४८ ४२ । ज्येष्ठमध्यमबाल४३ च सदिव्य खेचरक्रमम् ॥ ११ ॥ एतद् वै पश्चिमं वेश्म चन्द्रपुर्येति” नामतः । मण्डलं प्रथमेद तु अधिकार तु मन्त्रिणाम् ।। १२ ।। ५३ एकपाद त्रिशक्ति तु विद्यात्रितयभेदितम् । तन्मध्ये चाधिकारिण्या सुखोपायेन कौलिनी ॥ १३ ॥ संस्थिता लिङ्गरूपेण सिंहरूपा अधोमुखी । पृच्छते भगवान् रुद्रो” श्रीकण्ठोऽसौ उमापतिः ॥ १४ ॥ श्रीकण्ठ उवाच अस्मिन् गुरुगृहे शाक्ते मध्यलिङ्गे भगोदिते । कस्याधिकारमायात ैः तिष्ठते को गुरुर्नृणाम् ॥ १५ ॥ श्रीकौलिन्युवाच सद्योजातक्रमस्यैव पश्चिमस्य गृहस्य च । अधिकार ममेहैव दत्तं वै गुरुणा पुरा ।। १६ ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE 23 That is the triangle in the centre of that which is one hundred and fifty leagues (in diameter śatārdha).13 (This), the house of the earth and the abode of the gods, possesses three girdles (mekhalā).14 (8) Light red (ārakta) (in colour)15 and shining (like) silver, its form is as brilliant as a hundred suns. (The sides of the triangle extend for) five times twenty (pañcaviˆśa) leagues. In the middle of that is the unbroken circle. (9) In the centre of that is Kulakālikā, the semi-circle of the Moon.16 The Circle of the Sun (ravimaSÆala), which is the self (ātman) (of the maSÆala),17 is one hundred and fifty leagues (śatārdha) (in diameter).18 (10) In centre of that is the Gesture of the Transmission (kramamudrā).19 It is the Command, which is the teacher in the Three Traditions (uli). (The lineages of) the Eldest, the Middling and the Child along with the divine one (divya), the Transmission of the Skyfarers (khecarakrama).20 (All) that, indeed, is the Western House (veśman) called the City of the Moon. This is the first maSÆala21 and the (the source of) authority for (initiates) who recite mantras. (11-12) (This maSÆala) has one foot22 and consists of the triple energy conjoined with the Triple Vidyā.23 And in the middle of that is Kaulinī,24 she who, by means of the practice of bliss (sukhopāya), possesses authority. She whose form is a lion, resides (there) facing downwards in the shape of a Li‰ga.25 (13-14ab) ŚrīkaS˜ha speaks with the Goddess The lord (bhagavān) Rudra, he who is ŚrīkaS˜ha, husband of Umā, enquired (of the goddess). (14cd) ŚrīkaS˜ha said: 26Who has acquired authority in this, the Teacher's House free of ties, the Li‰ga in the centre, arisen as the Yoni (bhaga)? Who resides (here as) the teacher of men?27 (15) The venerable (goddess) Kaulinī said: It is I myself who here possess the authority of the Western House (grha) which is the Transmission of Sadyojāta.28 Previously, it was given (to me by my) teacher. (16)

sanskrit: 24 कुमारिकाखण्डः ६८ या सा शक्तिर्भगाख्या च जगन्माता त्रिरक्षरी । .७२ सा चाज्ञा कौलिनी व नपुंसकपदे स्थिता ।। १७ ।। श्रीकण्ठ उवाच •७४ ७५ ७६ त्व ं योनिः परमाकाशं दिव्यलिङ्गं नपुंसकम् । •७७ अन्तःपुरवरं गर्भं भगाह्लादेन” भैरवी ॥। १८ ॥ संस्थिताज्ञा” त्रिभिर्भेदैस्त्रिमूर्तिरिति ” कौलिनी । बहुरूपक्रमेणैव एका त्वं कुलदेवता¨ ॥ १९ ॥ ८७ त्वं माता जगतां“ देवि विश्वयोनिः पितामहे ँ । त्वया मया च देवेशि“ ओतप्रोत ” जगत्त्रयम् ।। २० ।। नाहं शिष्यस्तव” प्रायः किन्तु मित्रत्वमागतः । पूर्वप्रीतिवशाद् देवि पूजाज्ञानं तवान्तिकम् ।। २१ ।। ९८ ९२ आयातो” ज्ञानकाङ्क्षी ँ च समाचक्ष्व ततो उमे” । अनेकशो मया ख्यातं तव ज्ञानमनुत्तमम् ।। २२ ।। त्वयापि मम” पूर्वं हि तदाख्यातमशेषतः ' १०२ । तस्मान्न भग्नशिष्यत्व आवयोर्विद्यते परे ॥ २३ ॥ केवल सौहृद भद्रे तस्मान्निःसंशय वद । यस्माद्”” ज्ञानं तु वांच्छामि कौलिकं प्रत्ययात्मकम् ।। २४ ।। श्रीकौलिनी उवाच ११२ ११४ मानवेन तु रूपेण कि ३ त्वं श्रीकण्ठ उच्यसे । ११५ देवप्रकृतिरायातः निश्चयं त्वमुमापतिः ।। २५ ।। ११७ ११८ मायावेशधरो धीमान् स्नेहेन मम लुब्धकः । स्वगिरा लक्षितः शम्भो मायाजालेन मोहितः ।। २६ ।। तमोविध्वंसनार्थाय आगतो ज्ञानलुब्धकः १२६ १२१ । मया ज्ञातं महाशम्भो” तत् किमर्थ े महेश्वर ।। २७ ।। आत्मान २४ गूहसे नून २५ कस्य हेतो:' समाश्रयात् । यथावृत्तं प्रवक्ष्यामि अतीव मम वल्लभ' १२८ ।। २८ ।।
english: CHAPTER THREE 25 That energy called the Yoni (bhaga) who is the mother of the universe and consists of three letters,29 is the Command, Kaulinī who abides on the plane of the Neuter One (napuˆsakapada).30 (17) ŚrīkaS˜ha said: You are the Yoni, the Supreme Space (paramākāśa), the Divine Li‰ga,31 the Neuter (absolute).32 (You are) the Womb (garbha), the best of inner sanctums and, by virtue of the bliss of the Yoni, (you are) Bhairavī.33 (18) (You are) Kaulinī, the well established Command and (you have) three forms, by virtue of the three divisions (of the Tradition). Due to the transmission in many forms (bahurūpakrameSa) you are the one deity of the Kula (kuladevatā).34 (19) You, O goddess, are the mother of the worlds, O grandmother,35 (you are) the source (yoni) of the universe. By you and by me, O mistress of the gods, the triple world is woven warp and woof. (20) I am not, as it were, your disciple but (rather) have come in friendship.36 (Indeed) O goddess, the knowledge of ritual is close to you because of (our) previous affection.37 (21) And (I) have come (as one who) craves knowledge, thus, O Umā, tell me. I have imparted (this) most excellent knowledge to you many times and you also have explained it to me completely in the past. Therefore, O Supreme One (Parā), our condition as disciples (of one another) is uncompromised.38 All (there is between us is) affection, O auspicious one, and so speak without (harbouring any) doubt for I desire Kaulika knowledge which is the experience (of ultimate reality) (pratyayātmaka). (22-24) The venerable (goddess) Kaulinī said: O ŚrīkaS˜ha, what are you saying! The truth is that you are Umā's lord who has come (into this world) in the form of a man (but) with the nature of a god.39 (You who are) wise, wear the garment of Māyā and, out of love, are greedy for me, O Śambhu, it is apparent by your voice that (it is you) deluded by the net of Māyā. You have came (here), greedy for knowledge, to destroy the darkness (of ignorance). I have understood (this is so) why, O great Śambhu, do you conceal yourself?40 O Great Lord, what is the reason (for this)? O my dearly beloved, I will explain (things) truly (as they are) (yathāvrtta).41 (25-28)

sanskrit: 26 कुमारिकाखण्डः १३० तथा शृणुष्व भो नाथ योगकारणमुत्तमम् । -१३३ विस्तरेणाभिधास्यामि पूर्वं यत् सूचितं मया ।। २९ ।। कैलासस्यापरे ३५ बिम्बे मेरुमन्दिरमूर्धनि १३८ । महारामे ३७ च रम्ये च तुष्णीनाथगुहाश्रमम् ॥ ३० ॥ १४० त्रिरस्रं सप्तस्कन्धाभ” कुलाष्टकसमावृतम् । योजनानां शतास्त्रीणि श्लोकद्वादशवेष्टितम् ।। ३१ ।। पञ्चाशत्¨” सिद्धयोगिन्यः संजाताः ४५ श्रीकुलेच्छया । आदिकादिथकारादित्रिप्रकारमया शिला ॥ ३२ ॥ १४९ । जननी कुलमात्रीणा सिद्धानां मोक्षदायिका' विनिष्क्रान्ता“ गुहावासान्मन्त्रमुद्रा त्रयोलिषु ॥ ३३ ॥ रजोभावेन ५३ रूप४ स्यात् पुष्पवत् परिगीयते । सा शिला“ ँ चन्द्रकान्तिस्तु तप्तहेमसमप्रभा ।। ३४ ॥ १६० सुस्पष्टा हक्षमध्यस्था अमया मध्यभेदिता १६१ । शक्तिस्था शक्तिमध्यस्था हक्षद्वयविसर्पिणी ६२ ।। ३५ ।। त्रिकोणभुवनाधारे आग्नेये योनिमण्डले ६५ । १७० १३४ रविमण्डल६६ तद्बाह्ये७ आरक्त तत् सुतेजसम् ।। ३६ ।। योजनानां शत९ सार्धं समन्तात् तन्मनोरमम् । अखण्डमण्डलाकारं भुवनं सर्वयोगिनाम् ।। ३७ ।। तन्मध्यात्७३ तु विनिष्क्रान्तमन्वय सप्तकोटिकम् । तथा च भैरव ५ घोरं द्वात्रिंशत्सिंहसंज्ञकम् ॥ ३८ ॥ १७६ बीजस्थं पञ्चधावस्थ शक्तिस्थ पञ्चधास्थितम् । तस्योत्सङ्गे च सा विद्या सूष्मणामृतवर्षिणी ।। ३९ ।।
english: CHAPTER THREE 27 More concerning the Triangle in the centre And so listen, O lord, to the most excellent cause of Yoga. I will (now) explain in detail what I previously (merely) indicated to you. (29) The cave hermitage (āśrama) of TūnSīnātha (the Silent Lord) is located in a large and beautiful grove situated on the peak of the temple of Meru, which is another form of (mount) Kailāsa. (30) It is triangular and appears to have seven sections (skandha). It is surrounded by the Octad of Kula.42 (The three sides together measure) three times a hundred leagues (long)43 and it is surrounded by the Twelve Verses.44 (Within it reside) the fifty Siddhas and Yoginīs born of the will of the Śrīkula.45 The Stone is made of three parts. (One) begins with (the letter) `A', (another) begins with (the letter) `Ka' and (the third) begins with (the letter) `Tha'.46 (31-32) She is the Mother of the (eight) mothers of Kula47 who bestows liberation to the accomplished (siddha). She who is mantra and gesture (mudrā) in the Three Lineages (trayoli) has emerged from the Cave Dwelling as menstruation (rajobhāva) (and such) is (her) form which is lauded as menstruated (punpavat).48 That is the Stone (śilā), beautiful as the moon, the light of which is like heated gold. (33-34) Clearly visible, (the Command) is located between (the letters) Ha and K±a and is conjoined in the centre with Amā (the New Moon).49 Residing within energy and located in the middle of energy, (the Command) flows out from (between) the two, Ha and K±a into the igneous maSÆala of the Yoni, that is, into the Triangle which is the foundation of the world.50 (35-36ab) The Circle of the Sun is outside that. It is light red and very brilliant. Delightful, that is one hundred and fifty leagues all around.51 Its form that of an unbroken circle, it is the world of all yogis. (36cd-37) Bhairava and Bhairavī in the Centre The tradition (taught in) seventy million (verses) has emerged from the (triangle in the) middle of that.52 And so has the formidable (ghora) Bhairava called the lion of the thirty-two (syllable Vidyā).53 (38) He resides within the seed-syllable,54 possesses five states and, residing in (his divine) energy (śakti), is established fivefold.55 Seated next to him56 is the Vidyā who rains down the nectar of SūnmaSā.57 (39)

sanskrit: 28 कुमारिकाखण्डः भैरवी कालिकानन्दा त्रैलोक्ये क्षोभकारिणी । निशाकरार्धजठर आपीत कालिकासनम् ॥। ४० ।। सुतप्तहेमसंकाश चतुराशीतियोजनम् । उत्तानं तदधस्थ“ तु तन्मध्ये तु नपुंसकम् ।। ४१ ॥ शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं वर्तुल रविमण्डलम् । १८९ तच्चात्मा“ तस्य चक्रस्य चन्द्राकीनलभेदितम् ॥ ४२ ॥ तन्मध्ये तु अमा देवी पक्षापक्षनिरोधिनी । तदा सिंहक्रमे जाता वक्रदेवी त्रिवर्गसु ॥ ४३ ॥ मयूखचन्द्रिकाकारा” पञ्चस्था पञ्चभूषिता । पञ्चपञ्चक्रमेणापि संपूर्ण नग्नवाससा ' १९४ ।। ४४ ।। कुमारी ब्रह्मचर्येण श्रीमान्देवी भगोदरा । २०० अधिकार त्रिधाभूत द्वीपान्ते कुरुतेच्छया ।। ४५ ।। न स्त्री न पुरुषाकार आनन्द २ तं३ नपुंसकम् । २०४ । साधिकारं लिङ्गरूपं निरधिकरण तथा ॥। ४६ ॥ खस्थ॰ निवर्तिताकारं अव्यक्तं भैरवात्मकम् । एवमानन्दशक्तिस्तु दिव्यलिङ्गा क्रमोदिता ँ ।। ४७ ।। २०७ उभयोर्बाह्यगं क्षेत्रं मुद्रात्रितयभेदितम् । कूटस्थ वर्णराशिस्तु” त्रिकोण? गुहवासकम् २१३ २१४ गृह चन्द्रपुरं नाम पश्चिमस्थमधोमुखम् । एकपादं त्रिहस्तं तु त्रिशक्तितरुमण्डितम् २१५ २१२ ॥ ४८ ॥ ॥ ४९ ॥ तन्मध्ये चाधिकार”६ तु मन्थानस्य महत्पुरे । मन्थानभैरवी शक्तिर्भेदानां कुलकौलिनी ॥ ५० ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE 29 (She is) Bhairavī, the bliss of Kālikā who arouses the Three Worlds. Light yellow, Kālikā's seat is the Half-moon. (Brilliant) like well heated gold, (it is) eighty-four leagues (wide). In the middle of that is the Neuter (absolute - napuˆsaka)58 (while the Half-moon) lies supine (uttāna)59 below it. (40-41) The Circle of the Sun is round and (clear) as pure crystal. And that (centre), conjoined (bhedita) with the Moon, Sun and Fire, is the Self of that Wheel (cakra i.e. maSÆala).60 (42) Vakrā, the Goddess Moon, the Li‰ga, the City of the Moon and the Transmissions In the centre of that is the goddess of the New Moon (Amā) who checks the two polarities (paknāpakna) (of the breaths).61 Then the goddess Vakrā arose (jātā) in the Transmission of the Lion within the three categories (trivarga).62 Her form rays of moonlight,63 she resides in the five (primal causes) and is decorated with the five. Naked (nagnavāsasā),64 she is completely full also by means of the sequence (that proceeds) five by five.65 (43-44) By virtue of (her) continence (brahmacaryā), she is a virgin, the venerable goddess who is within the Yoni (bhagodarā). She exercises (her) threefold authority within the Island (of the Moon) according to (her own) will.66 (45) That bliss is the Neuter (absolute). It is neither female nor is (its) form (ākāra) male.67 Its nature (rūpa) is the Li‰ga that possesses authority and is not subject to (any other) authority (niradhikaraSa). Located in the Void (khastha), unmanifest and form annulled (nivartitākāra), it is Bhairava. In the same way (evam), the power of bliss is the divine (female) Li‰ga (divyaliSgā) that has emerged within the Transmission (kramoditā).68 (46-47) Outside both of them (i.e. Bhairava and the power of bliss) is the field (knetra).69 It is conjoined (bhedita) with the triad of Gestures (mudrā)70 and, located on the peak (kū˜astha),71 it is the aggregate of letters (varSarāśi),72 the Triangle which is the Cave Dwelling. (48) The House (grha) is the City of the Moon.73 It is located in the west (paścimastha)74 and faces downwards. It has one foot (ekapāda), three hands and is adorned with the Tree of the triple energy.75 (49) And in its centre, in the great abode (mahatpura) of the Churning (Bhairava), is authority. (There) the energy of the divisions is the Churning Bhairavī who is Kulakaulinī.76 (50)

sanskrit: 30 .२२० कुमारिकाखण्डः २२१ संस्थिता”” लिङ्गरूपेण वक्रदेवी ह्यधोमुखी । आत्मान२२२ .२२३ । च हृदिस्थं तु श्वेतं पिङ्गलनायकम् ।। ५१ ।। वर्तुलं चातिशोभाढ्यं “ ॐकारमिति गीयते । तत्रस्थं ज्योतिमध्यस्थ आद्यपीठं स्वरूपधृक् २२८ ॥ ५२ ॥ २३० लिङ्गरत्नमयाकारं” अत्यारक्त सुतेजसम् । सद्यावेशकर घोरं अघोरस्योपरिस्थितम् ।। ५३ ॥ २३२ तस्याज्ञा स्वमुखे नित्यं भेदैश्च सप्तविंशतिः । २३३ २३४ षट्प्रकारक्रमेणैव आम्नायेन मुखागमम् ॥ ५४ ॥ २३६ बालं कौमारवृद्ध१५ च त्रिविधं क्रम संस्थितम् । ज्येष्ठं मध्यं कनिष्ठं च ओलित्रितयभूषितम् २३७ एतद् वै पश्चिमं वेश्मं चन्द्रपुर्येति” नामतः । २४० २४१ २४२ । ।। ५५ ।। क्रममण्डल ओलीनां त्रिधातत्त्वपरिग्रहम् ।। ५६ ।। क्रममुद्राधिकार तु मुद्रापीठकृताङ्कितम् । अर्धचन्द्रस्य४५ मध्यस्थं पुरं प्रणवयोजितम् ।। ५७ ।। विलोमेन चकारादौ मणिपूर्णे ततः २४७ पुनः । श्रीमद् वै रुद्र पादाब्ज पश्चिमं इच्छसे क्रमम् ।। ५८ ।। श्रीकण्ठ उवाच ५० २५१ गृहे चन्द्रपुरे शाक्ते १ मध्यलिङ्गे ५२ भगोदिते । । तिष्ठते ५३ को गुरुर्मन्त्री पश्चिमस्य क्रमस्य च ।। ५९ ।।
english: CHAPTER THREE 31 She is the goddess Vakrā who, facing downwards,77 is well established in the form of a Li‰ga.78 And the Self resides in (the centre), the heart (of the maSÆala) and is the lord (nāyaka) Pi‰gala who is white.79 (51) Round and very beautiful, it is said to be the syllable O¤.80 Located there, in the centre of the Light, is the first seat (ādyapī˜ha), the holder of the essential nature (svarūpa) (of the deity and the maSÆala). (52) Its form is that of a jewelled Li‰ga.81 A very subtle pink (atyārakta), it is pleasingly brilliant. Formidable (ghora), it brings about immediate penetrating possession (āveśa)82 and is located above Aghora.83 (53) Its Command, with (its) twenty-seven divisions (bheda),84 is ever on my lips (svamukha). As the tradition (āmnāya) consisting of the transmission in six parts (na˜prakārakrama),85 it is the oral tradition (mukhāgama). (54) The transmission (krama) is threefold as that of the Child, the Youth and the Aged and, adorned with the three lineages (oli), it is the oldest, the middle one and the youngest. (55) That indeed is the Western House (veśman) called the City of the Moon. It is the MaSÆala of the Transmission (krama) of the lineages (oli) and its form is the threefold enclosure of the (three) principles (tridhātattvaparigraha).86 (56) (The maSÆala possesses) the authority of (the goddess who is) the Gesture of the Transmission (kramamudrā) and is marked with (the energy) created by the Seat of Gesture (mudrāpī˜ha). It is located in the middle of the Half-moon and is the City conjoined with O¤ (praSava).87 (57) Then again, in MaSipūrSa (within the Vidyā that), in the reverse order, begins with the letter `Ca'.88 O Rudra! Venerable one! You whose feet are lotuses! desire the Western Transmission which is the lotus of (your) feat. (58) The Goddess, the teacher in the City of the Moon, instructs ŚrīkaS˜ha ŚrīkaS˜ha said: Who is the teacher of the Western Transmission, the one who recites mantra in the empowered (śākta)89 House, the City of the Moon, that is, in the Li‰ga in the centre arisen within the Yoni (bhagodita)?90 (59)

sanskrit: 32 कुमारिकाखण्डः श्रीवक्रा उवाच -२५५ चन्द्रपुर्यस्य २५६ वेश्मस्य २५७ अघोरस्य महेश्वर । अहं गुरुरहं५८ मन्त्री नपुंसकपदे स्थिता ।। ६० ।। २६० व्याप्तिव्यापकभेदेन ५९ सर्वज्ञा उन्मना परा । २६२ सिद्धवासाद् विनिष्क्रान्ता शाम्भवाज्ञास्वरूपतः ।। ६१ ।। पश्चिमं३३ शाम्भवं तस्मात् सर्वेषामुपरिस्थितम् । सविशेषमिदं नित्यं बहुरूपस्य साम्प्रतम् ।। ६२ ।। २६४ २६८ २६६ । या सा शक्तिर्भगाख्याता शम्भोरुत्सङ्गगामिनी कौलिनी २६७ ब्रह्मचर्येण श्रीमान्देवी नपुंसका ॥ ६३ ॥ निर्वाणभूमिका प्राप्ता सिद्धाज्ञा च नभेऽक्षया ¨° । श्रीकण्ठ उवाच २७१ २७० । वद मे कौलसद्भाव २७२ यदुक्त७३ पश्चिमे गृहे ॥ ६४ ॥ मायावृतस्य अम्बे२७५ मे सद्योनिर्वाणतां २७६ वद । २७४ श्रीवक्रा उवाच २७७ २७८ २७९ न च मायावृतस्त्वं हि साक्षाद् देवो निरञ्जन: ॥ ६५ ॥ २८० ईश्वर: ° पञ्चवक्त्रस्त्वं ज्ञानार्थी रुद्रसंज्ञकः । २८५ त्रैलोक्ये २८२ त्वं गुरुः २८३ कर्ता २४ हती त्वं च पुनः पुनः सृष्टिसंहारकर्तृत्वे एकस्त्वं पार्थिवे कुले । २८७ २८६ तत् किमर्थं९ जगन्नाथ शाम्भवाज्ञां त्वमिच्छसि ।। ६७ ।। प्रायशस्त्व हि कामार्थी आज्ञार्थी न कथञ्चन २९३ २९४ २९२ । अस्माकं तपनाशाय रुद्रस्त्वमिह आगतः ।। ६८ ।। ।। ६६ ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE 33 The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O Great Lord, I am the teacher of the City of the Moon,91 the House of Aghora.92 (I am) the one who recites mantra established on the plane of the Neuter.93 (60) (I am) Parā (the Supreme), the omniscient Transmental, the Śāmbhava Command (śāmbhavājñā) by nature, who has emerged by means of the distinction (bheda) between pervasion and the one who pervades94 from the (Triangle that is the) Abode of the Siddhas. (61) The Western (Transmission paścima) is Śāmbhava and so is above all others.95 It is eternal with (all its) details and is now that of (Svacchandabhairava otherwise known as) Bahurūpa (the Pluriform). (62) The energy called the Yoni (bhaga) who (sits in union) on Śambhu’s lap (utsa‰gagaminī)96 is, by virtue of (her) practice of continence (brahmacarya),97 Kaulinī, the venerable goddess Neuter (napuˆsakā)98 who is the plane of NirvāSa attained and, imperishable, is the Command that has been accomplished (siddhājñā) in the Void (nabhas) (of the supreme principle). (63-64ab) ŚrīkaS˜ha said: Tell me the essence of the Kaula (teachings) as expounded in the Western House. O mother,99 tell me (who am) enveloped in Māyā, (the teaching that leads to the) state which is the immediate attainment of NirvāSa. (64cd-65ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: You are indeed god (himself) directly apparent (sāknāt), the stainless one (nirañjana)100 and are not covered by Māyā. You are the lord with five faces called Rudra101 who (now) desires knowledge. (65cd-66ab) In the Three Worlds you are the teacher102 and you are, again and again, the creator and destroyer. You alone are the one who emanates and withdraws (all things) in (this) earthly Kula.103 (66cd-67ab) O lord of the universe, why is that? (Why) do you desire the Śāmbhava Command (śāmbhavājñā)?104 You are generally desirous of sexual pleasure (kāma from me),105 you are not at all one who desires the Command. You are Rudra who has come here to ruin our austerities.106 (67cd-68)

sanskrit: 34 २९५ कुमारिकाखण्डः स्त्रीत्वं पूर्वं मया त्यक्त पौरुषं च तथैव च -२९९ भूमिकाज्ञाप्रभावेन प्रकटाह युगे युगे अहं शून्यस्वरूपेण” परा दिव्यतनुर्हयहम् 00 ३०२ २९७ । ॥ ६९ ॥ । ३०७ ३०८ अहं सा मालिनी देवी अहं सा सिद्धयोगिनी ॥ ७० ॥ अहं सा०४ कालिका ५ काचित् कुलयागेश्वरी ं ह्यहम् अहं सा चर्चिका देवी” कुब्जिकाहं च षड्वि ं ॥ ७१ ॥ ३१३ ३१० एवं २ सा कलिकाले तु मुमुक्षूणां विमुक्तये । संसारभयभीतानां अवतारं प्रकुर्वते ।। ७२ ।। दक्षस्य दुहिता पूर्वमास्म्यहं भद्रकालिका । अतिरूपा विशालाक्षी शम्भुना च विवाहिता ॥ ७३ ॥ ३१४ ३१७ दक्षेण तु प्रदत्ताहं सृष्टिहेतोर्न भान्तरे । ३१९ ३२० प्रविष्टा ऋतुकाले तु देवी देवस्य विस्तरे ।। ७४ ॥ लीनाह२१ परमानन्दा११ आनन्दतनुतां गता । ३२७ । । यज्ञं करोति२४ विमल २५ अथ २६ दक्षः प्रजापतिः ।। ७५ ।। ३२९ मायापुर्या८ तटे गङ्गा धर्मकामार्थसाधनम् । । देवासुरगणाः सर्वे वासुदेवादि सर्वशः ।। ७६ ।। आमन्त्रितास्तु दक्षेण” त्रैलोक्ये” ये व्यवस्थिताः नाहं तेन पुरा तत्र ईश्वरं पञ्च - आननम् ३३७ ३३८ ३३५ ३३३ ।। ७७ ।। यज्ञक्षोभभयाद् देव ऋषिणां च तु शंकया । । सभायां न३४९ निमन्त्रितौ ४२ ।। ७८ ।। भयभीतेन दक्षेण सभायां न •३४४ ईश्वरेण तदारब्ध४३ महत् कोपं सुदारुणम् । यज्ञविध्वंसनार्थाय५ दक्षे शापः प्रवर्तितः ।। ७९ ।। ३४८ ३४६ ३५० ३४७ त्रैलोक्ये विजयायुक्तो वीरभद्रो ४९ गणैः ५° सह ३५३ ३५१ प्रहितश्च महावीरो गणवृन्दसमावृतः ।। ८० ।। आरब्ध यज्ञविध्वंसं कोटिसम्भारसंवृतम् ३५६ । । ३११
english: CHAPTER THREE 35 Formerly, I abandoned femininity and so too masculinity.107 By the (empowering) Command of the plane (of ultimate reality) (bhūmikājñā), I am clearly manifest (praka˜ā) in each age (yuga).108 (69) By virtue of (my) Void nature (śūnyasvarūpa) I am Parā (the Supreme and my) body is divine. I am that goddess Mālinī. I am that Siddhayoginī. I am that certain (inscrutable - kācit — goddess) Kālikā. I am indeed Kulayāgeśvarī (the Mistress of the Kula Sacrifice).109 I am that goddess Carcikā110 and I am Kubjikā who is sixfold.111 (70-71) The Goddess's Previous Life and the Destruction of Dakna's sacrifice And (I am) she who, during the Age of Strife (kaliyuga), descends (into this world) to liberate those who, frightened by the fear of the world of transmigration, desire liberation. I am Bhadrakālikā, formerly Dakna's daughter. My eyes (were) large, (I was) beautiful and married to Śambhu. (72-73) Given by Dakna (to lord Śiva) in order to bring about the emanation (of the universe) (srn˜i) I, the goddess, entered, during (my) fertile period (rtukāla), into the Void which is the god’s couch (vistara).112 I who am supreme bliss merged (into the expanse of the foundation) and assumed a body of bliss.113 (74-75ab) Now, Dakna Prajāpati (set about) performing a pure sacrifice, serving as a means (to the attainment of) Dharma, sexual fulfilment and wealth, in the City of Māyā114 on the banks of the Ganges. Dakna invited the entire host of gods and celestial beings, including VinSu and the rest, who reside in the Three Worlds. I was not (invited) there by him, (nor was Śiva) the Five-Faced Lord.115 O god, due to the fear that the sacrifice would be disturbed and the misgiving of the sages, (we two) were not invited into the assembly by the frightened Dakna. Then the Lord gave vent to (his) great and very fearsome anger and, in order to destroy the sacrifice, he cursed Dakna. (75cd-79) (Śiva in the wrathful form of) Vīrabhadra, intent on the conquest of the Three Worlds, along with (his) host (gaSa), he the Great Hero, surrounded by the assembly of (his) attendants (gaSa) and urged on (by his rage), began to destroy the sacrifice with (its) countless trappings. It was entirely destroyed, uprooted

sanskrit: 36 कुमारिकाखण्डः विध्वंसितमशेष५७ तु आद्यन्तोच्चाटन कृतम् ॥। ८१ ॥ ३५९ ३६० त्रस्ताश्च ९ देवताः सर्वे पलायन्ते दिशो ३६१ दश ३६२ । ३६४ ३६५ शरण्या:६३ केचिद् वै तत्र े४ प्राणत्राणपरायणाः ।। ८२ ॥ ३६८ केचित् पातालविवरे केचित् गह्वरमागताः । ३६९ ३७० ३७१ ३७२ केचिन्नष्टा ९ नभोयाने केचित् स्वर्ग समागताः ॥ ८३ ॥ •३७४ केचित् प्रविष्टा:३७३ पाताल दक्षो विह्वलतां गतः । ३७५ ३७६ ३७७ आराधयत् स हृष्टात्मा राजीवासनसंस्थितम् ॥ ८४ ॥ दक्ष उवाच ३७९ भगवन् देवदेवेश लोकानुग्रहकारक । ३८० ३८२ अव्यक्तभगवन् शम्भो लिङ्गरूपि सदाशिव ॥ ८५ ॥ महावनस्य३ मध्ये तु मयास्मिन् नन्दने वने ८५ । ३८८ ३८४ ९० जप्तं८६ यष्टं७ हुतं भक्त्या ईदृगाह अनेकधा ।। ८६ ।। प्रसीद भगवन् शम्भो यागसंपूर्णतां कुरु ।९२ ३९४ दक्ष:”५ ३९६ एवं विज्ञाप्य स दक्षः कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः ।। ८७ ।। स्तुनोति स्तवराजेन महाशक्तिसमन्वितः । दक्ष उवाच ३९९ नमस्ते कुलनाथाय कौलसिद्धिप्रदायक ज्ञानविज्ञानरूपाय श्रीश्रीनाथ नमोऽस्तु ते । ।। ८८ ।। हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्यस्थं तरुणादित्यमण्डले ।। ८९ ।। नित्योदितप्रकाशाय” वन्दे विद्यामहाव्रतम् । शतार्धचक्रसंघातं यस्योत्पन्नं शिवेच्छया ।। ९० ।। सिद्धौघ॰३ देवताम्नायं वन्दे ज्ञानमहार्णवम् । मन्त्रतत्त्वार्थसंबोध॰ षट्चक्रकुलपर्वते ।। ९१ । यस्येच्छानिर्गतं सर्वं वन्दे विज्ञानभास्करम् ४०८
english: CHAPTER THREE 37 from start to finish. All the gods were terrified and ran away in the ten directions. Some, intent on saving their lives, took refuge (in lord Śiva) there (itself). Some (hid) in the cavity of the lower worlds, some came to the abyss, some were destroyed, some (travelling) on the celestial way reached heaven and some entered the netherworld. Dakna became distraught. (Even so) that blissful soul praised (lord Śiva), the one seated on a lotus throne.116 (80-84) Dakna said: "O Blessed one (bhagavat), lord of the gods, you who grace the world, Śambhu, the unmanifest God, Sadāśiva whose form is the Li‰ga! I have, in the middle of the great forest, in this Nandana grove, repeated mantras, offered sacrifices and made oblations with devotion". He said such things many times. (85-86) "O Blessed one, be gracious, O Śambhu, make the sacrifice complete". Having declared thus, Dakna stood with (his) his hands folded together (in prayer) and, possessing mighty energy, he praised (Śiva) with the King of Hymns (stavarāja). (87-88ab) Dakna's Stavarāja Dakna said: 117Salutation to you the Lord of Kula, you who bestow Kaulasiddhi! O venerable Śrīnātha, salutation to you who are knowledge and consciousness. (88cd-89ab) (I offer praise) to the ever manifest (nityodita) Light. I praise the great aggregate of the Vidyā (vidyāmahāvrata)118 established in the middle of the lotus of the Heart within the circle of the young (rising) sun. (89cd-90ab) I praise the great of Ocean of Knowledge, the aggregate of fifty wheels, of which the Tradition of the Deity (devatāmnāya), the Current of the Siddhas (siddhaugha) has arisen by Śiva's will.119 (90cd-91ab) I praise the awakened consciousness of the reality that is the principle of mantra (mantratattvārtha), the Sun of Consciousness on the Mountain of Kula (consisting of) the Six Wheels, by whose will everything has emerged (into being).120 (91cd-92ab)

sanskrit: 38 कुमारिकाखण्डः नादबिन्दुकलाज्योतिरानन्दक्रमपञ्चकम् ।। ९२ ।। पञ्चावस्थां गतो यस्तं वन्दे ज्ञेयं परापरम् । ४१३ मनोबुद्धिरहंकार त्यक्त्वा १२ अज्ञानगह्वरम् दृश्यते” मन्त्रसद्भावं वन्दे १५ विज्ञानसागरम् । ॥ ९३ ॥ सप्तसागरपर्यन्तं संसारार्णवगोचरम् ।। ९४ ।। निष्प्रपञ्च७ निराधारं वन्दे व्योम्नि ” ” परापरम् । -४२० ४१८ -४२१ ४१९ त्रिकूट””” पञ्चतत्त्वस्थं ” पञ्चावस्थगतं विभुम् ॥ ९५ ॥ ४२५ अकुलकुलसद्भावं त्रिकभेद परापरम् । ४२७ मन्त्रचक्रकलाधार२६ वन्दे कुलमनामयम् ।। ९६ ।। अधोब्रह्मबिल२८ चक्रं चतुर्दलसमन्वितम् । रक्तवर्णं महादीप्तं वन्दे आधारमण्डलम् ।। ९७ ॥ ४२९ ४३१ तस्योध्वे नाभिमूले तु चक्रं पञ्चदलान्वितम् । •४३३ ४३४ पद्मरागनिभ वज्रं वन्दे पूर्णमणीपुरम् ।। ९८ ॥ पञ्चारे ४३५ हृत्पुरे चक्रं नीलजीमूतवाहनम् । प्रज्वलन्तं महादीप्तं ३७ वन्दे देवमनाहतम् ।। ९९ ॥ एवं पञ्चदलोपेतं विशुद्ध” कण्ठमाश्रितम् ४४० । तप्तहेमनिभप्रख्यं वन्दे ह्यमृतगोचरम् ।। १०० ।। ४४३ •४४४ तुर्यस्थाने पञ्चाकार बिन्दुस्थं कोपमूर्धनि । -४४५ शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं वन्दे आज्ञापरापरम् ॥ १०१ ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE 39 I praise the fivefold sequence of Sound (nāda), the Point (bindu), Energy (kalā), Light (jyotin) and bliss and the one who has assumed (these) fives states121 who, both supreme and inferior, is (all that) should be known. (92cd-93ab) I praise the Ocean of Consciousness (vijñānasāgara), the essence of mantra122 which is perceived once abandoned the abyss of ignorance namely, the mind, intellect and ego. (93cd-94ab) 123I praise (the absolute that is) both supreme (transcendence) and inferior (immanence) which, in the Sky (of pure consciousness), is free of (any extrinsic) foundation (nirādhāra) and thought constructs (ninprapañca) and (whose) field is the ocean of transmigratory existence right up to the end of the seven seas.124 (94cd-95ab) I praise the flawless Kula, the all-pervasive lord (vibhu) who abides in the Five States and the Five Principles,125 (he who is) the Triple Peak,126 the essence of Kula and Akula,127 the Triad (trikabheda),128 supreme and inferior, and is the foundation of the energy of the circle (cakra) of mantras. (95cd-96) The Six Wheels 1) I praise the Circle of the Foundation (ādhāramaSÆala), that is, the lower Cavity of Brahmā,129 the wheel possessing four petals,130 red in colour and very bright (mahādīpta). (97) 2) 131I praise the City Full of Gems which is the Wheel above it at the root of the navel, possessing five petals, it is the Thunderbolt (vajra),132 (red) as a ruby.133 (98) 3) I praise the god Unstruck Sound (anāhata) whose vehicle is a blue lightning flash and, burning fiercely and very bright, is in the wheel of five spokes within the City of the Heart. (99) 4) In the same way, I praise the Pure (Wheel) located in the throat that, brilliant as heated gold, has five petals and is the sphere of nectar. (100) 5) I praise (the Wheel of the) Command which is both supreme and inferior, in the abode of the Fourth (state).134 Located in the Point between the eyebrows (kopamūrdhan),135 its form is fivefold (pañcākāra) and it (shines) like pure crystal. (101)

sanskrit: 40 कुमारिकाखण्डः तालुमध्ये महानादं षोडशारं निरञ्जनम् ४६ । •४४८ । ४४९ ज्योतिरूपं महाचक्र वन्दे दिव्यमनामयम् ॥ १०२ ॥ यकारादिसमायुक्तं ब्रह्ममन्त्रपरिग्रहम् । हिमकुन्देन्दुधवल५९ सद्यो ५२ वन्दे यथा शिवम् ॥ १०३ ॥ ततस्तादिविभेदेन भेदितं तु जनार्दनम् । -४५५ ।। पद्मरागसमप्रख्य॰॰॰ वन्दे रक्तविभूषणम् ॥ १०४ ॥ टादिपञ्चसमोपेतं रुद्रं तृतीयं पूजितम् ४५८ ४५७ । । भिन्नाञ्जनमहादीप्तं वन्दे घोरमनामयम् ।। १०५ ॥ ४५९ यच्च“” चादिस्वरूपेण॰ ईश्वर पञ्चभेदितम् । अलातपुष्पसंकाशं१२ वन्दे तं लिङ्गभास्वरम् तस्योध्वे ४६४ कादिभेदेन शक्तिपञ्चकयोजितम् । ।। १०६ ।। शुद्धस्फटिकरूपेण वन्दे ईशानभैरवम् ।। १०७ ।। अकारादिविसर्गीन्तषोडशैस्तु सदाशिवम् । ।। ज्योतिरूपं४६७ सदा वन्दे कौलिकाज्ञाप्रबोधकम् ।। १०८ ।। तत्राधारगतां ९ मध्ये मन्त्रमुद्राविभेदकम् । ४७२ चक्रनायकिविख्यातां वन्देऽहं कुलडामरीम् ॥ १०९ ॥ मणिपूर्णगतां देवीं परतत्त्वप्रकाशकीम् ४७४ । ४७८ चक्रनायकिविख्यातां ँ वन्दे उड्डामरीं पुरे ।। ११० ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE 41 6) I praise the great, divine and flawless wheel whose form is light that, in the centre of the palate,136 has sixteen spokes and, stainless (nirañjana), is the Great Sound (mahānāda). (102) The Gods, Colours and Letters of the Six Wheels137 1) I praise Sadyojāta (sadyo)138 as (I would) Śiva (in the Wheel of the Foundation). It is conjoined to `Ya' and the rest (of the semi-vowels)139 and, white like snow, jasmine and the moon, has the form of Brahmā's mantra.140 (103) 2) I praise then (the City of Gems), a red ornament, brilliant as ruby, VinSu (janārdana), conjoined with the class of the (letters) `Ta' and the other (dentals). (104) 3) I praise Rudra, the third worshipped (in the Wheel of Unstruck Sound) endowed with the five (cerebrals) `µa' and the rest. Very brilliant (like) a slice of (black) collyrium, he is formidable (ghora and yet) devoid of imperfection. (105) 4) I praise that shining Li‰ga (the Pure Wheel) which, in the form of the (five palatals) `Ca' and the rest, is Īśvara conjoined with (these) five and is (brilliant) like the flower (made by a whirling) firebrand.141 (106) 5) Above him, I praise Īśānabhairava in the form of pure crystal who, as the class (of the five gutturals) `Ka' and the rest, is conjoined with the group of five energies.142 (107) 6) I praise Sadāśiva constantly along with the sixteen (letters) beginning with `A' and ending with Emission (visarga)143 - he whose form is Light and awakens to the Kaulika Command. (108) The Yoginīs in the Six Wheels 1) I praise KulaÆāmarī, known as the mistress of the wheel (cakranāyakī) who is present there in the (Wheel of the) Foundation and, in the centre, pierces through (vibhedakī) mantra and Gesture. (109) 2) I praise UÆÆāmarī, known as the mistress of the wheel in the abode (pura) (of the body) who is present in the (Wheel) Full of Gems (maSipūrSa) and illumines the Supreme Principle. (110)

sanskrit: 42 कुमारिकाखण्डः •४७९ हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्यस्थ सिद्धचक्रप्रबोधकीम् । । चक्रनायकिविख्यातां वन्दे तां ज्वालिनीं पुरे ॥ १११ ॥ ४८५ विशुद्धचक्रमध्यस्था शवरीज्ञानभेदकीम् । चक्रनायकिविख्यातां¨“ वन्दे दूतीं च शाकिनीम् ॥ ११२ ॥ आज्ञामूर्धनि” चक्रस्था” सिद्धतत्त्वसमायुताम् ४९२ ४९४ । ।। ।। चक्रनायकिविख्यातां वन्देऽहं व्योमरूपिणीम् ।। ११३ ।। अनामचक्रमध्यस्थां”“ सिद्धतत्त्वसमन्विताम् । चक्रनायकिविख्यातां९६ वन्देऽहं खेचरीं४९७ पुरे ४९८ ।। ११४ ।। कदम्बगोलकाकारां” षोडशान्ते व्यवस्थिताम् ५०० । शुक्लपक्षे त्वहं वन्दे पूर्णाख्यामृतरूपिणीम् ॥ ११५ ॥ तन्मध्ये कालिकाबिम्ब' उत्सङ्गामृतकेसरीम् ३ । देवीं४ अमामहं वन्दे चन्द्रिकाकाररूपिणीम् ।। ११६ ।। ५०५ ५०७ वामामृतपुरोत्कृष्टां उत्कृष्टां चरुनन्दिताम् ' । ०५०८ ०५०९ वामा सृष्टिकरां वन्दे देवीं ता कुलमालिनीम् ॥ ११७ ॥ परां° तेजसमावस्था” तत्त्वात्मासुपरिग्रहाम् ५१२ । तेजोदृप्ता ३ च दक्षिणे वन्दे सिद्धदिवाकराम्।। ११८ ।। ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE 43 3) I praise that Jvālinī, known as the mistress of the wheel in the abode (of the body) who resides in the centre of the lotus of the Heart and awakens the congregation (cakra) of Siddhas. (111) 4) And I praise Śākinī,144 the consort (dūtī) (of the god) known as the mistress of the wheel who resides in the centre of the Pure Wheel (viśuddhacakra) and pierces (bhedakī) (through it) with the Knowledge of Śavarī.145 (112) 5) I praise her whose form is the Void (vyoman) known as the mistress of the wheel who resides, endowed with reality attained (siddhatattva), in the wheel on the apex (mūrdhani) of the Command.146 (113) 6) I praise Khecarī in the body (pura) who, known as the mistress of the wheel, resides in the centre of the Wheel of the Nameless (anāmacakra) endowed with reality attained.147 (114) The Play of the Full and the New Moon: The Full Moon in the New Moon I praise (the goddess) in the bright lunar fortnight who is called the Full (Moon) (pūrSā) and is nectar. Her form (spherical like) the bud of a Kadamba tree, she is present at the end of the sixteen (lunar digits).148 (115) The New Moon in the Full Moon I praise the goddess New Moon (amā) whose form is moonlight (candrikākāra)149 in the midst of that (Full Moon), she who is the lioness of the nectar of union (utsa‰gāmrtakesarī)150 and the original form (bimba) of (the goddess) Kālikā.151 (116) The Full Moon I praise the goddess Vāmā, that is, Kulamālinī152 who engenders emanation. Exalted (utkrn˜ā), she is delighted with the sacrificial pap (caru) and is most excellent (utkrn˜ā) in the Abode of the Nectar of Wine (vāmāmrta).153 (117) The New Moon And I praise (the goddess) Parā who, well established in radiant energy, possesses the beautiful form of the essential nature of (all) the principles (tattvātmāparigrahā)154 and, haughty with radiant energy (tejas) is, on the right, the sun (of knowledge for) the accomplished (siddha).155 (118)

sanskrit: 44 शक्तित्रितयमध्ये तु अंकुराकारदेवता ५१८ कुमारिकाखण्डः ५१७ । पिण्डं तस्या भगाकार ९९ वन्दे त्रिष्कोणपीठगाम् ॥ ११९ ॥ नादस्थाने महारत्नं जाठराग्निसमुज्ज्वलम् । परमार्थदशाधारं वन्देऽहं नाभिमण्डलम् ।। १२० ।। तस्यावरण—१ सिद्धाङ्गा'२२ कुण्डली नाम देवता । •५२५ ५२६ त्रिस्था २३ त्रिवलयाकारां २४ वन्देऽह २५ सिद्धकुण्डलीम् ।। १२१ ।। अनन्तं यस्य मन्त्रस्य तेजोरूपं नवात्मकम् । कूटस्थं परमव्योम्नि ँ वन्दे कूटं यथा गुरुम् ।। १२२ ॥ ५३० अनामा २८ परधाम्निस्था शक्तित्रितयभाविनीम् । एकतत्त्वस्थितां १ यत्र' वन्दे विज्ञानघट्टिनीम् ।। १२३ ।। •५३४ इच्छाज्ञानक्रियाभेदैर्भेदितां चन्द्रमूर्धनि । गमागमक्रमेणैव वन्दे शक्त्यन्तगोचरे ।। १२४ ॥ ५३६ व्योमपञ्चकलाधार३५ विपरीतेन मायया । ५३९ निशाचारेण ३७ संवेद्य ३८ घटं वन्दे यथागमम् ।। १२५ ।। तुर्यस्थममृत शुक्लं परमार्थमुखोद्गतम् । द्रवते? ज्ञानमाश्रित्य वन्दे बिन्दु मनोरथम् ।। १२६ ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE 45 The Full Moon In the midst of the three energies is the deity whose form is a sprout and her body the shape of a Yoni (bhagākāra). I praise (the goddess) present in the sacred seat of the Triangle (trinkoSapī˜ha).156 (119) 157I praise the Circle of the Navel, aflame with the fire of the stomach, it is the Great Jewel in the locus of Sound (nāda) and the foundation of the plane of ultimate reality (paramārtha). Its enclosure (āvaraSa) is the deity called KuSÆalinī whose limbs are the Siddhas (siddhā‰gā) (who govern the letters). I praise her, the KuSÆalinī of the accomplished (siddhakuSÆalinī) who, established in the three (energies), is in the form of three coils.158 (120-121) The New Moon I praise, as I do the teacher, the Peak (syllable) (kū˜a) on the summit (kū˜a) (of existence) within the Supreme Void (paravyoman) that, endless, has as its mantra Navātmaka whose form is radiant energy (tejas).159 (122) I praise (the goddess) Anāmā (the Nameless) who resides in the Supreme Abode and contemplates the three energies. She is established in the one reality (ekatattva) where she coalesces (all things with) consciousness (vijñāna- gha˜˜inī).160 (123) The Full Moon I praise (the goddess) who, in the field at the extremity of the energy at the summit of the Moon is, by the process of going and coming (gamāgamakrama), divided by the divisions of will, knowledge and action.161 (124) The New Moon I praise the body (gha˜a) in accord with the tradition (yathāgama), as the foundation of the energies of the Five Voids (vyomapañcakalā)162 that can be known (saˆvedya) by the Conduct of the Night (niśācāra), that is, by means of Māyā reversed (from its normal deluding course).163 (125) The Full Moon I praise the Point (bindu) that is desire (manoratha), the white nectar in the Fourth state that has emerged from the mouth of ultimate reality (paramārtha)164 and, having recourse (āśritya) to knowledge, melts and flows (dravate).165 (126)

sanskrit: 46 कुमारिकाखण्ड: -५४४ तस्योध्वे ४३ ज्योतिमात्रं तु कलाशेषस्य ४५ धारिणी । दृश्यते बिन्दुवेधेन वन्दे कोटरमव्ययम् ।। १२७ ।। जीवाधारमहारत्नं पशुपाशमलापहम् । निर्मलं मण्डलाकारं वन्दे चाखण्डमण्डलम् ।। १२८ ।। सर्वाङ्गव्यापकं देवं मुद्रामन्त्रविभूषितम् । ५४७ चित्स्वरूपप्रकाशस्थ वन्दे शिव महामृतम् ॥ १२९ ॥ लयातीतं तु मन्त्राणां षोडशान्ते विपर्ययम् ५४८ । -५५० द्वादशान्ते परावस्थ४९ वन्दे नादान्तमाश्रितम् ।। १३० ।। -५५१ परतत्त्वप्रकाशाय“ आत्मतत्त्वगरीयसीम् -५५२ ५५५ अन्तर्गता^५३ महालक्ष्मीं वन्देऽहं कालिका पराम् ।। १३१ ।। विद्यातत्त्वनिनादेन नादेनाक्रम्य देवताम् । मूर्तिमध्ये बहिर्लक्षे वन्दे शुष्काभयप्रदाम् ५५८ ।। १३२ ।। ५६० ५६१ शिवपक्षे ५९ परे व्योम्नि गता विद्या परापरा । तुर्यचक्ररथारूढा``२ वन्दे शिवमयीं कलाम् ।। १३३ ॥
english: CHAPTER THREE 47 The New Moon Above that is the pure Light (jyotimātra) which is the energy that sustains everything. Perceived by piercing through the (the Wheels) with the Point (binduvedha), I praise the imperishable Cavity (of the Void).166 (127) The Full Moon I praise the Unbroken Circle (akhaSÆamaSÆala) that, round and pure, removes the impurity of the fetters (that bind) the fettered, the Great Jewel which is the foundation of (every) living being (jīva).167 (128) The New Moon I praise the blue168 Great Nectar, the god who, adorned with mantra and Gesture, resides in the Light which is consciousness and pervades all the limbs (of the body) (sarvā‰gavyāpaka). (129) The Full and the New Moon I praise (that reality which is) the Supreme State at the End of the Twelve established at the End of Sound. The reversal of mantras (into silence) at the End of the Sixteen, it transcends the dissolving away (of manifestation) (layātīta).169 (130) (I offer salutations) to the Light of the Supreme Principle. I praise the supreme (goddess) Kālikā who is Mahālaknmī170 present within and is greater than the Principle of the Self (ātmatattva). (131) The New Moon I praise (the goddess) Śunkā (the Emaciated One) who bestows fearlessness. She who, having entered into (ākramya) the deity through the Sound (nāda) that is the resonance of the principle of the Vidyā (vidyātattva), is in the middle of the (goddess's) outwardly visible (bahirlakna) icon (mūrti).171 (132) The Voids of the Wheels The Void of the Wheel of the Command 1) I praise the energy (kalā) who is Śiva (śivamayī). (She who), mounted on the carriage of the Wheel of the Fourth State, is the Vidyā who is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent) (parāparā) present in the supreme Void (vyoman) within Śiva's (transcendental) polarity (pakna) (of being).172 (133)

sanskrit: 48 कुमारिकाखण्डः शक्तिमध्ये ६४ मन कृत्वा चिन्तयेद् व्योम्नि चिद्घनम् । सर्वद्वन्द्वविनिर्मुक्तं वन्दे शान्तं निरञ्जनम् ।। १३४ ।। •५६७ ५६८ नाभिदेशे ६६ महाघोर व्योमराजखमाश्रितम् । चिन्तयन्” मूलसंगृह्यं वन्दे व्योममनादिकम् ५७० । ।। १३५ ।। ५७२ हृत्पुरे खमनं कृत्वा व्योमगर्भं च मारुतम् । ५७३ ५७४ संस्मरन् पूर्वकारणं वन्दे ज्योतिमहेश्वरम् ।। १३६ ।। ५७८ कण्ठमध्ये ६ समाश्रित्य वेला इव महोदधेः । ५७९ परव्योमस्वरूपेण वन्दे व्योमकलार्णवम् ।। १३७ ।। ०५८१ तालुमध्यगतं व्योमं“” उत्तानं तडिताहताम्८३ । ब्रह्मघोषरथारूढां वन्दे व्योम्न्याश्रितां पराम् ।। १३८ ।। कुलविज्ञानपञ्चाशच्छब्दराशिक्रमेण तु । ०५८७ ५८५ स्तवराज“ महागुह्यं महाविज्ञानभैरवम् ।। १३९ ॥ स्तुतं दक्षेण मनसा' अन्तर्याीगेन ९ धारणा ९° । ५८९ ५९०
english: CHAPTER THREE 49 The Void of the Wheel of the Foundation 2) Once fixed the mind in the middle of the power (śakti) (of the deity), contemplate the dense mass of (uninterrupted) consciousness (cidghana) within the Void (vyoman). I praise the peaceful Stainless (One) (nirañjana) (there) that is free of all duality.173 (134) The Void of the Wheel of the Navel 3) I praise the beginningless Void (in the act of) contemplating (Bhairava in the Wheel Full of Gems) in the navel, the Greatly Formidable One (Mahāghora) who resides within the Void of (Bhairava) and is the King of the Void (vyomarājan) who should be grasped as the root (of all existence). (135) The Void of the Wheel of the Heart 4) Once fixed the void mind (khamanas) in the Abode of the Heart, recalling (saˆsmaran) the Void that is the womb of the vital breath (maruta), I praise the preceeding cause (pūrvakāraSa) (of all things), the Great God of Light. (136) The Void of the Wheel of the Throat 5) Entering the centre of (the Wheel of Purity in) the throat (I, on the brink of the Void) like the shore of the ocean,174 praise the ocean of the energy of the Void as the essential nature of the Supreme Void. (137) The Void of the Wheel of the Palate 6) The Void in the centre of the palate, struck with the lightning flash (of KuSÆalinī's power) lies supine (uttāna). I praise Parā (the Supreme) who resides in the Void mounted on the carriage (ratha) of the Sound of the Brahman (brahmaghona).175 (138) (This is) the King of Hymns (Stavarāja), the great secret, the great Bhairava of consciousness (vijñāna). Dakna offered it mentally as praise by means of the meditation which is the inner sacrifice. (He did this) by means of the sequence of the aggregate of the fifty sounds (śabdarāśi) which is the consciousness (vijñāna) of Kula.176 (139-140ab)

sanskrit: 50 कुमारिकाखण्डः •५९२ ।। १४१ ।। संस्मरेद्” यः क्रमस्याग्रे त्रिष्काल ९२ स्मरतेऽथवा ।। १४० ।। सततं भक्तिपूर्वेण भैरवसमता ९३ व्रजेत् । ९४ जराव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तो”“ भोगजालविवर्जितः दुःखदारिद्र्यनिर्मुक्तो ँ विचरेत यथासुखम् । तिष्ठते” सुचिरं कालं जीवन्मुक्तिधरः पुमान् ।। १४२ ।। अपमृत्युर्न° बाध्येत विघ्नजालविवर्जित: । ६०३ ६०२ । स्तवराजप्रभावेन भवते नात्र संशयः ।। १४३ ॥ गोपयेत् परशिष्याणां न देयं यस्य कस्यचित् । ६०५ ६०७ पुत्रस्यापि न दातव्यं “ भक्तिहीने कदाचन ॥ १४४ ॥ ६०९ कुलाचारविलुप्ते च न दध्याद् वै कदाचन ११ । तान्त्रिकानां १२ न दातव्यं रक्षणीयं शरीरवत् ।। १४५ ।। मोक्षसद्भावविज्ञानं आत्मज्ञानप्रकाशकम् । ६१४ ६१३ यः पुनः प्रातरुत्थाय संस्मरेद् १५ देहनिर्णयम् ।। १४६ ।। आत्मज्ञानमसौ वेत्ति १६ स्तवबोधस्वरूपिणम्' ६२० ६२१ ६१७ विधिनानेन१८ संपूर्ण १९ कृत्वा दक्षः २९ क्षमापयेत् ॥ १४७ ॥ प्रसन्नः१२२ परमेशानः स्तवराजेन तोषितः । ६२३ ६२४ ऊचुरेव परः शान्तः ब्रूहि मे परमार्थतः ।। १४८ ॥ स्तवराजेन महता १२५ किमर्थं स्तवितस्त्वया ६२६ । दक्ष उवाच ६२७ ६२९ प्रारब्धं यन्मया देव यज्ञ १ २८ गङ्गातटे शुभम् ॥ १४९ ॥ धर्मकामार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं न सिद्धं मन्दबुद्धिना । •६३२ मया नामन्त्रितो देवो यज्ञ विध्वंसितं ततः ।। १५० ।। युष्मत्कोपाच्च संजातं शापभ्रष्टमहं पुनः । • ६३४ `६ मखस्थयाजकाना१३५ च तेषामुद्वेगबन्धनम् ।। १५१ ॥ ६३७ •६३८ देवस्य कोपात् संजातं तत् क्षमध्व महाप्रभो । ये गता ये प्रणष्टाश्च ३९ ये च बद्धा महोदरे ६४० ।। १५२ ।।
english: CHAPTER THREE 51 The Benefits (phalaśruti)177 He who recalls it in front of the Transmission (krama)178 or remembers it at the three times (of day) and always with devotion becomes equal to Bhairava.179 (140cd-141ab) Free of old age and disease, free of the net of worldly experience (bhoga), free of suffering and poverty, he may move about (in the world) as he pleases. (141cd-142ab) (This) man is liberated in this life and abides (in this world) for a long time. He is not troubled by untimely death and, by the power of the King of Hymns, he is free of the net of impediments. There can be no doubt about it. (142cd-143) It should be hidden from the disciples of others. It should never be given to (just) anybody, not even to (one's own) son if (he is) devoid of devotion. Nor should it ever be given to one fallen from the practice of Kula (kulācāra). (This), the knowledge of the essence of liberation that illumines the knowledge of the Self (ātmajñāna), should not be given to Tāntrikas,180 (but) should be protected (as one does one's own) body. (144-146ab) Again, he who after getting up in the morning recalls the teaching concerning the body (dehanirSaya),181 knows the knowledge of the Self which is the awakened understanding of (this) hymn. (146cd-147ab) Dakna's Repentance and Forgiveness Once Dakna had completed (his sacrifice) by this means (vidhi),182 (he pleaded): "forgive (me)". The Supreme Lord was pleased, satisfied by the King of Hymns and, supremely peaceful, spoke thus: "tell me in truth, why have you praised (me) with the great King of Hymns?" (146-149ab) Dakna said: "O god, the auspicious sacrifice I started on the banks of the Ganges in order to gain merit (dharma), sexual fulfilment and wealth was not completed due to (my) stupidity. I did not invite (the foremost) god and so the sacrifice has been destroyed. This has happened because of your anger. Moreover, I have fallen (from Dharma) due to (your) curse and the sacrificers present at the sacrifice are afflicted with anxiety (udvega) brought about by the god's anger. Forgive (us) that (fault). O great lord! Be gracious to those who have fled (from the sacrifice), those who have been destroyed, those who are bound in the Great Pit (mahodara), so that they may no longer be born (again)." Once (Dakna) had said this - (149cd-153c)

sanskrit: 52 ६४१ कुमारिकाखण्डः तेषां कुरु प्रसादं तु येन ते संभवं नहि४२ । श्रीनाथ उवाच ६४३ इत्युक्त सप्रसादं तु उत्तिष्ठ ऋषिपुत्रक ।। १५३ ॥ नष्टानां च प्रणष्टानां बन्धने ये च संस्थिताः । ६४४ तेषां कृता मया मुक्तिः सत्येद ४५ च शुचिव्रत ४६ ।। १५४ ।। यज्ञारम्भं कुरु प्राज्ञ मत्प्रसादेन सिद्धिदम् । • ६४७ ६४८ ·६५० ६५१ भवते नात्र संदेह:४९ शापस्यायं महद् वरम् ६५३ ज्ञात्वा चेदं तदा देवी इदं ५२ वृत्तान्तमागतम् । ६५७ ।। १५५ ॥ मत्संबन्धाच्च दक्षस्य अहं सा पापकारिणी ॥ १५६ ॥ पितुर्यज्ञ मया ध्वस्त आत्मानं शोधयाम्यहम् । ज्वलज्वालोर्मिसंकाशमुद्दीप्य परमानलम् ।। १५७ ।।६५८ ज्वलन्तं चिन्तयित्वा तु मुद्रामण्डलमध्यतः । वज्रासनं ततो बध्वा स्मृताघोरेश्वरीकला ।। १५८ ।। कालाग्निना स्वयं दग्धा निर्धूमाङ्गारतां गता । ६६० मृता भस्मगता६१ साध्वी १२ उत्तीणी मत्यलोकतः ।। १५९ ।। पुनरेव त्वहं जाता हिमवन्तस्य १६४ मन्दिरे । ६६५ अष्टमे तु महाजन्मे जाताहं भद्रकालिका ६६८ ६७० ६६७ ।। १६० ।। ज्ञात्वा च मे पुरा वाणीं हिमवन्तस्य ईश्वरः । ६७१ ईप्सते पाणिग्रहण ७२ कालीं७३ मां दर्द ६७६ ६७४ काली दत्ता परिचर्ये हिमवन्तेन सुन्दरी ६७९ ६८० ६७५ सुव्रत ।। १६१ ।। ६७८ कैलासे तु महाशैले देवदेवस्य मन्दिरे ।। १६२ ।। महादेशं समुत्पन्नं सांप्रतं किञ्चिदन्वये । ६८२ । गुहावासस्य मध्ये तु विद्यते शाम्भवं पदम् ॥ १६३ ॥ गत्वा त्वनुग्रह“३ तत्र भविष्ये तव सांप्रतम् । ६८४ ज्ञात्वा चेदं पुरा देवी संजाता पश्चिमे गृहे ।। १६४ ॥ कुलदेवी च कौलेशी अधिकारे व्यवस्थिता ।
english: CHAPTER THREE 53 Śrīnātha said: "O son of a sage! Arise (and be) with grace! I have liberated those who have been discomfited and killed and those who are in bondage: this is the truth, O one whose vow is pure! Start the sacrifice (again),183 O wise one, by my grace it will, without a doubt, bestow success. This is the great boon of (my) curse." (153d-155) The Goddess's Self-immolation, re-birth, marriage and the god's enlightenment And then184 when the goddess came to known what had occurred, (she said): "My father Dakna's sacrifice has been destroyed by me because (its destruction was) due to me. I am the sinner (and so) will purify myself!" (156-157ab) Once stoked the supreme fire, brilliant with waves of raging flames and, having contemplated it burning fiercely in the middle of the MaSÆala of Gesture (mudrā), she then sat on the adamantine seat (vajrāsana)185 and recalled to mind the energy of Aghoreśvarī. She burnt herself with the Fire of Time and became (like) a smokeless, burning coal.186 (This) wise woman, dead and reduced to ashes left the mortal world.187 (157cd-159) (The goddess continued): I was reborn in the temple of the Himalayas. In the eighth great rebirth, I was born (as) Bhadrakālikā. Having first recognised (jñātvā) my voice,188 the Lord wished to get married (to me and so said) to Himavat: ‘O observer of good vows, give me Kālī"." (160-161) 189Himavat gave the beautiful Kālī in devout attendance (to him in marriage) (paricarya)190 in the temple of the God of the gods, that is, on the great mount Kailāsa. (Then) a great instruction (mahādeśa) arose: “Now there is something that is part of the tradition, namely, the Śāmbhava plane, that is in the middle of the Cave Dwelling. Having gone there now, I will be your grace.”191 (162-164ab) And once (the god) came to know this, the goddess first arose (saˆjātā) in the Western House. She who is the goddess of the Kula (kuladevī) and the mistress of Kaula (kauleśī),192 was established in authority.193 (164cd-165ab)

sanskrit: 54 कुमारिकाखण्डः आगतो देवदेवेशोऽनुग्रहार्थी महाप्रभुः ।। १६५ ।। पारम्पर्यक्रमेणैव८६ तया तस्य त्वनुग्रहम् ६८७ ६८९ ।। कृतं तच्छक्तिपातेन संपूर्ण शुद्धवासना ॥ १६६ ॥ संजाता चर्चिका देवी आज्ञा या मालिनीकुले । ६९१ क्रामिता परमा दिव्या शाम्भवाज्ञामखण्डिता ।। १६७ ।। देवी आज्ञाप्रभावेन१९२ विद्युत्पुञ्जशताकुलाः । तेजोभाभिः सुसंदीप्ता दिव्यलिङ्गत्वमागता ।। १६८ ॥ एवं सा लिङ्गरूपेण कलिकाले तु चर्चिका । गृहे चन्द्रपुरे दिव्ये अधिकारे ९४ व्यवस्थिता ६९५ इत्यागम९६ मया प्राप्त१९७ चतुर्थे तु महायुगे । ७०० ।। १६९ ।। पारम्पर्यमुखाम्नाय शाम्भव९ कौलिकान्वये ।। १७० ।। ७०२ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते M लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्र- संहिताया' अव्वाक्रमभाषिते दक्षशापानुग्रहा - धिकारो नामानन्दः ।। ३ ।। ७०६ ७०१
