english: CHAPTER THREE 55 (Then) the God of gods, the Great Lord, came desiring grace and she graced him in accord with the transmission of the tradition (pāraˆparyakrama).194 Once that had been done completely by means of (her) grace (śaktipāta),195 she whose past impressions are pure196 became the goddess Carcikā who is the Command (that operates) in the Mālinīkula.197 Supreme and divine, the Śāmbhava Command (śāmbhavājñā) was transmitted (krāmitā) unbroken.198 (165cd-167) By the power of the Command, the goddess, filled with hundreds of nets of lightning flashes and beautifully illumined by the lights of effulgent power (tejas), assumed the form of the Divine Li‰ga.199 In this way, during the Age of Strife, she is Carcikā in the form of a Li‰ga and is established in authority in the divine House of the City of the Moon.200 (168-169) I201 have received this tradition (āgama) in the fourth great Age. It is Śambhu's (śāmbhava) oral tradition (transmitted through the) series (of teachers) (pāraˆparyamukhāgama) within the Kaulika tradition (kaulikānvaya). (170) This is the (third) chapter called Concerning Dakna’s Curse and Grace. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for hundred and twenty-five thousand quarter. It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six (Thousand Verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (caturviˆśatsaˆhitā) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's Command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: श्रीकण्ठ उवाच' चतुर्थानन्दः एवं प्राप्तं' स्वरूपेण त्वयाज्ञाशाम्भवं पदम् । सर्वद्वन्द्वपरित्यागात् शान्तातीतं परापरम् ॥ १ ॥ ६ तेन त्वं गुरुर्मे माता युक्त्यायुक्त क्षमस्व माम् । मातॄणां सिद्धरुद्राणां त्वमेका' हृदि देवता ।। २ ॥ त्वं शक्तिर्मम° रुद्रस्य मातरी पश्चिमे गृहे । कामार्थिनों ह्यहं नेह आज्ञार्थी क्रमलुब्धकः ॥ ३ ॥ दिव्यादिव्यक्रमौघस्य” सन्तानस्य महोदयम् । १७ तव शिष्यो ह्यहं सम्यक् उपसन्नः प्रसन्नधीः ॥ ४ ॥ कथयस्व कुलाम्नायं पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् । प्रत्ययाष्टौ च देवेशि कादिभेदं मतं मम ॥ ५ ॥ दद मे परमे अम्बे” यत् ख्यातं सप्तकोटिके । २३ एवं वायुपुराणादौ लिखिताक्षरमालिकां¨ ।। ६ ।। आज्ञाप्रत्ययहीनस्य देवदेवस्य निश्चयम्' । २६a वैकल्प्य २० भवते तस्मादाज्ञां याचामि पश्चिमे ॥ ७ ॥
english: CHAPTER FOUR Concerning the Mālinīstavarāja ŚrīkaS˜ha declares his Devotion to the Goddess and implores her for the Teachings ŚrīkaS˜ha said: In this way you have attained, in accord with (its) own (true) nature, the plane of the Śāmbhava Command (śāmbhavājñāpada), beyond the tranquil (state of deep sleep) (śāntātīta)1 which is (both) supreme (transcendence) and inferior (immanence), by abandoning all duality.2 (1) Thus, you, mother,3 are my teacher. By virtue of (your) wisdom (yukti), forgive me (whatever I may have done) wrong (ayukta).4 You are the sole deity in the heart of the mothers, Siddhas and Rudras. You are my energy, Rudra's mother5 in the Western House. I do not desire sexual pleasure (kāma) here (from you).6 I desire the Command and am greedy for the Transmission (krama).7 (2-3) I am your proper (samyak) disciple, attentive and of lucid intellect. Tell me the Kula tradition (kulāmnāya) that has come down through the transmission of the series (of teachers) (pāramparyakrama)), the great arising of the lineage (santāna) which is the current (ogha) of the transmission, divine and human.8 (4-5ab) O mistress of the gods, (tell) me of the eight signs (of attainment) (pratyaya)9 and the school (mata) of the division beginning with Kā (kādibheda).10 Give me, O supreme mother, what is called (the knowledge of) the seventy million (verses).11 (5cd-6ab) In the same way (impart the teaching transmitted through) the little garland of letters (aknaramālikā) written in the VāyupurāSa and other (such scriptures). (Give me), the God of the gods, who is devoid of the signs of attainment (pratyaya) and (your empowering) Command, the final purport (niścaya) (of the teachings). A state of uncertainty prevails (vaikalpyaˆ bhavate) (within me) and so I beg (for the empowering) Command (transmitted) in the Western (tradition).12 (6cd-7)

sanskrit: 58 कुमारिकाखण्डः श्रीकाराज्ञा पुनस्तस्य गुर्वाम्नाये प्रवर्तते । तत्र सा शाम्भवी आज्ञा श्रीनाथो लभते कलौ ” ॥ ८ ॥ मोक्षार्थं सर्वजन्तूना” अवतारं करिष्यति । पुराणार्थमिद” सत्यं त्वद्भक्तिसेवनादपि ं ।। ९ ।। श्रीमतं पश्चिमाम्नायं मूलान्वयक्रमागतम् । रजमण्डलनिर्मुक्त जातिप्रणववर्जितम् ।। १० ।। सस्फुरं कौलिकाम्नायं” गुवाम्नायं” क्रमं वद । ऊचुरेव महावाणीं” तेजलिङ्गान्तवासिनी” ॥ ११ ॥ तीव्राज्ञाधिष्ठिता देवी श्रुत्वा देवगिरां शुभाम् । श्रीवक्रा उवाच ४४ ४६ यदेतत् पश्चिमं मार्ग श्रीक्रम गुणवत्तमम् ॥ १२ ॥ आलयं सर्वसिद्धानां सविशेषं तु शाम्भवम् । आवेशकारकं शम्भो” स्मरणादपि सिंहकम् ।। १३ दशसप्तक्रमा ज्येष्ठा गुरुशिष्यक्रमेण तु । ५२ ५३ तेषामाज्ञाप्रसादेन अस्माक च समागता ।। १४ ।। त्वं हि तेषां कथं देव शिष्यत्वे संभविष्यसि । ज्येष्ठाज्ञोल्लङ्घनाद् देव आज्ञायास्तमन भवेत् ।। १५ । आज्ञाहीनः शोचनीयो गोत्रबाह्यो विधीयते । ६० त्वं प्रभुः सर्वदेवानां न दृष्टं मे तवाधिकम् ।। १६ ।। गुरुत्वेऽह कथं तस्माद् भवामि तव विग्रहे । श्रीकण्ठ उवाच ६४ पारम्पर्यक्रमेणापि आज्ञा स्फुरति कौलिनी ॥ १७ ॥ यदि दृष्ट पदार्थ तु को दोषो विद्यते कुले ६८ •७० ६७ ७१ । सारमेकं कुले कौले तेषां शिष्यमहं पुनः ॥ १८ ॥
english: CHAPTER FOUR 59 (Thus) the Command (the god) possesses of the venerable (goddess) (śrīkārā) operates again in the Tradition of the Masters (gurvāmnāya). The goddess's (śāmbhavī) Command is there (and) Śrīnātha obtains (it) in the Age of Strife. In order to liberate everybody, he will come down into the world. This truth is the ancient purport (of the scripture) also (realised) by practising devotion to you. It is the Śrīmata, that is, the Western Tradition (paścimāmnāya) that has come through the transmission of the root lineage (mūlānvaya).13 (8-10ab) Tell (me this) Transmission (krama), the Tradition of the Masters, the Kaulika Tradition endowed with vibrant energy (sasphura)14 that is free of the sphere of rajas and devoid of (the six) types (jāti) and praSava.15 (10cd-11ab) Having heard the auspicious discourse of the god, the goddess who resides in the Li‰ga of Fire (tejoli‰ga),16 inhabited by an intense Command (tīvrājñā),17 uttered thus a mighty speech (mahāvāSī). (11cd-12ab) The venerable Vakrā said: That which is this Western path is the Śrīkrama, the most excellent; it is the abode of all the Siddhas and, in a special way (saviśena), a Śāmbhava (tradition). O Śambhu, it is a (Tradition of the) Lion (siˆhaka)18 and brings about possession (āveśa)19 by just recalling (it). (12cd-13) (The goddess) Jyen˜hā, who is the sequence of seventeen (lunar energies) has come (here) by means of the sequence (krama) of masters and disciples by the grace of their Command and ours.20 O god, how will you become their disciple? O god, by transgressing Jyen˜hā's Command, the Command declines. One who is devoid of the Command is lamentable and considered to be outside the clan (gotra).21 You are the lord of all the gods, I have seen none greater than you. (Moreover) I am within your (very) form,22 so how can I be (your) teacher? (14-17ab) ŚrīkaS˜ha said: Kaulinī’s 23 Command pulses radiantly also by virtue of the transmission through the series (of teachers) (pāramparyakrama) (just as it does when it is first transmitted). If (that ultimate) reality (padārtha) has been realised (drnta lit. 'perceived'), than what defect can there be in the Kula?24 There is (only) one essence in (both) Kula and Kaula25 and (so) I am, once again, their disciple. (17cd-18)

sanskrit: 60 ७३ कुमारिकाखण्ड: या स्थिता उघमार्गेऽस्मिन् ज्येष्ठानुक्रमयोगतः । ७४ नाहं ज्येष्ठाकुले देवि एवं कुरुष्व नुग्रहम् ॥ १९ ॥ त्वं त्राता गुरु श्रीमान् पूज्यामि त्वां त्रिमध्यतः । अत्र दोष न पश्यामि गुरोराज्ञा स्वयंप्रभा ।। २० ।। मन्त्रो” विद्या परामुद्रा योगिनी कुलदेवता । आज्ञा” पञ्चविधा शक्ति: लिङ्गयोन्या व्यवस्थिता ।। २१ ।। तत्रोदरे जगत् सर्वं क्रमं चापि महाक्रमम् । ८७ तत् ँ प्रविश्य“ महादेवि आज्ञार्थी इह जन्मनि ।। २२ ।। .९२ दद मे परमे अम्बे” भक्त्या ज्ञानं महाक्रमम् । शिष्ये भक्तिर्गुरोराज्ञा संप्राप्तिरुभयोर्यदा ।। २३ । तदासौ कौलिकी आज्ञा अवतारं प्रकुर्वति । तस्याश्रममिदं लिङ्गं त्वच्छक्तिकुलविग्रहम् ।। २४ ॥ ९९ ९७ पारम्पर्यक्रमाम्नाये अधिकार क्रमागतम् । आज्ञालिङ्गं महासिद्धं विकल्पमोहवर्जितम् ।। २५ ।। तस्य शास्त्र च तन्त्र च लक्षपादाधिकं त्विदं । ०३ १०४ उपसन्नो महादेवि देह्यनुज्ञा मा प्रति ।। २६ ।। १०६ ११० १०७ १११ १०९ अह ं निवेदितो ँ देवि मत्तुल्यो नास्ति कश्चन' । निवेदितं त्वया भद्रे शरणागतवत्सले ।। २७ ।। गृहावतारसकल मेरोरुपरि मूर्धनि ।
english: CHAPTER FOUR 61 O goddess, the one who is the eldest (jyen˜hā)26 in due order (anukrama) on this, the Path of the Current (of the teaching) (ughamārga) in the Kula of the Eldest One (jyen˜hākula) (is you) not me. Grace (me)! (19) You are the saviour, my venerable teacher, I worship you in the midst of the three (transmissions). I see no defect here. The Command of the teacher is its own light.27 (20) The Command is the five-fold energy located in the womb (yoni) of the Li‰ga (li‰gayoni). (These five aspects are) mantra, Vidyā, the supreme gesture (parāmudrā), the Yoginī and the deity of the Kula (kuladevatā). (21) Here within it (atrodare)28 is the entire universe, the Transmission (krama) as well as the Great Transmission (mahākrama). O great goddess, (I am the one who) desires the Command here in (this) life. O supreme mother! having entered that (Li‰ga),29 give me, for the sake of (my) devotion, the knowledge which is the Great Transmission.30 (22-23ab) Devotion in the disciple and the teacher's Command - if both have been attained then this Kaulikī Command descends (into the world).31 Its sacred abode (āśrama) is this Li‰ga whose form is your aggregate of energies (śaktikula). (23cd-24) The authority in the tradition of the transmission through the series (of teachers) (pāramparyakramāmnāya) that has come through the Transmission is the Li‰ga of the Command (ājñāli‰ga), greatly accomplished (mahāsiddha), it is free of delusion and thought constructs. Its scripture (śāstra) and Tantra is this one (consisting) of a hundred and twenty-five thousand (verses).32 (25-26ab) O great goddess, (I have) approached (you with devotion) permit me to play (with you). O goddess, I have been told (by you) that no one is my equal. O fair one! the darling of (this devotee) who has come to take refuge! You have proclaimed the entire descent of the (Western) House onto the top of (mount) Meru on the head. (26cd-28ab)

sanskrit: 62 कुमारिकाखण्डः कलौ मत्यावतार४ तु स्वशिष्याय निवेदयेत् ॥ २८ ॥ यागकाले १५ सिद्धिद१६a स्यात् पूजितं वरदं भवेत् । ११६b ११८ । तर्पितं दीक्षित सर्वं अवतार प्रकुर्वति ॥ २९ ॥ अन्यायोपार्जित”” चापि निष्फलं तु भविष्यति । आज्ञाभङ्गकरं तस्य उद्वेग तु दिने दिने ।। ३० ॥ १२२ गृहयाग पुरा कृत्वा पश्चात् संग्राह्य श्रीकण्ठ उवाच १२६ तद् गृहम् । तत: २७ स्तवेन दिव्येन देवेनानन्दभृद्गिरा ।। ३१ ॥ दिव्यं स्तोत्रं समारब्ध अशेषार्थप्रबोधकम् । । मथित्वा तु परं तत्त्वं तेनेद ” मालिनीस्तवम् ॥ ३२ ॥ ।। सबीजं दण्डक१३२ भक्त्या ३३ रचित ३४ तत्र पश्चिमे । १३६ तस्य सा देवतावाणी आदेशेन महौघवान् ।। ३३ ॥ तया सार्धं भवत्येवं मालिनीकुलविग्रहम् । युक्तं द्वादशभिर्भेदैर्मूर्तिराज्ञावलोकितम् ।। ३४ ।। १३८ १४० तत: स्तवेन महता ३९ नाथ आज्ञा लभिष्यति' उपसन्नस्तदा योगी श्रीकण्ठाज्ञामनुग्रहे ।। ३५ ।। ईदृगनुप्रदानेन वाक्पुष्पैः स्तुतिपूर्वकैः ५ । प्राणायामादिभिर्यज्ञैर्दिव्यवर्षशतं तपः ।। ३६ ।। एकानुष्ठानमनसा ं प्रस्तुतस्तुतिपूर्वकैः । १४७ १४६ १४२ । स्तुनोति”” विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्देवो भुवनमालिनीम् ।। ३७ ।। -१५५ जय'५३ त्वं मालिनीदेवि १५४ निर्मले मलनाशिनि' । ज्ञानशक्ति:५६ प्रभुर्देवि“ बुद्धिस्त्वं तेजवर्धनी ॥ ३८ ॥ जननी सर्वभूतानां संसारेऽस्मिन् व्यवस्थिता । । माता वीरावली देवी° कारुण्यं कुरु वत्सले ॥ ३९ ॥
english: CHAPTER FOUR 63 One should tell (only) one's own disciple of the mortal incarnation (martyāvatāra) (of the deity in the world) during the Age of Strife. During the sacrifice he (will) bestow accomplishment and, worshipped, grant boons. Once all have received libation and have been initiated, (the deity) will descend (into the world). (Whatever) one earns illegally will be fruitless and bring about the transgression of the Command. (Thus he will be) worried every day.33 (So) once performed a (purifying) sacrifice in (one's own) home (grhayāga), that tradition (grha) should be embraced (saˆgrāhya) again.34 (28cd-31ab) ŚrīkaS˜ha said: Then the god, having deeply pondered (mathitvā lit. `churned') the Supreme Principle,35 began (to intone) with divine praise and blissful voice, a divine hymn that enlightens as to the entire meaning (of the scripture). Thus there, in the Western (tradition) he composed with devotion a composition in prose (daSÆaka) with seed-syllables (called) the Mālinīstava. (31cd-33ab) His is this speech of the deity (devatāvāSī) which, by virtue (of the goddess's) Command (ādeśa), is endowed with the great current (of the teaching). In this way, the form of the Mālinīkula36 is accompanied by that (Speech). Possessing twelve divisions,37 it is viewed (with grace) by the Command of (the goddess's divine) Form (mūrti).38 (33cd-34) Thus, by (this) great hymn the lord will get the Command. Then ŚrīkaS˜ha, the yogi, approached (the goddess with devotion) in order (to receive) the grace of (her) Command. By means of this kind of offering, with the flowers of speech heralded by hymns of praise and with sacrifices of breath control and the like, (he performed) austerities for a period of a hundred divine years. (Then), with (his) mind solely intent on worship, the god praised (the goddess) Bhuvanamālinī ('She who wears the worlds as her garland')39 with many kinds of hymns. (35-37) The Hymn to Mālinī - the Mālinīstava40 Be victorious,41 O goddess Mālinī,42 you who are pure!43 The destroyer of impurity! english: CHAPTER FOUR 79 PHE¤ PHE¤ PHE¤! O goddess! O Mahālaknmī! sanskrit: 80 60 ७४६६ कुमारिकाखण्डः ४६७ ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं ख्फ्रें हनुआँ दिव्यलिङ्गासनं मण्डलोत्कृष्टनिर्वाणयोगावलीशक्तिभि: हक्ष॰॰८ शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशाकाशपरमनिर्वाणमहाबाणपञ्चकोपेताज्ञाधिकारपरमविश्राम— भूमिकासकलकलाभूतोन्मादमदनसंक्रम ९ सागम योगिनीसिद्धं वन्दितं सतता- भिनन्दित¨¨? विद्याम्नायौघगद्यपद्यैश्चतुष्पादाभिध्यातसर्वार्थसंवित्संबोध संबुध्यसे सर्ववीराम्बिके ४७४ । (१२५) ४७३ .४८० ४८३ भँ भँ भँ४७५ भैरवि ४७६ भैरवस्ते शरणागतोऽहं भैरवस्ते शरणागतोऽह आज्ञार्थिनोऽह आज्ञार्थिनोऽह' लिङ्गाकाशभैरवि क्षमस्वापराधं” शिवे उमे जगन्माते कालिके कुलकमलगुहागहनवासिनि मालिनीस्तवनात् तुभ्यं समयनन्दिनोऽहं” “ चरणवन्दिनोऽहं कारुण्यादनुकम्पस्व मामिति (१२६) ४८८ ४८७ मालिनीस्तवराजं तु आदिनाथावतारितम् ४९० । प्रेर्यमाणा महावाणी आज्ञयानन्दप्रेरिता ४९२ ।। ४० ।। ४९३ ४९४ आज्ञामनुग्रहाथीय अधिकारार्थहेतुना । ।। बालक्रमस्य समये४९५ क्रमाग्रे पठते तु यः ॥ ४१ ॥ क्रमात् सिद्धिस्तदा” ँ तस्य अणिमादिगुणाष्टकम् । आनन्दपदसंस्पर्शो “ उच्चारादेव” जायते ।। ४२ ।। ५०० त्रिष्कालमेककाल वा एकचित्तः समाहितः । ५०२ बीजसंख्याधिकारेण दिव्यावेशः २ प्रवर्तते ॥ ४३ ॥ आज्ञामनुग्रह३ धन्यं वाचासिद्धिर्न ४ संशयः ५०५ ।
english: CHAPTER FOUR 81 AI¤ HRĪ¤ ŚRĪ¤ KHPHRE¤ HSRŪAU¤! the seat (of the goddess), the Divine Li‰ga145 is praised and always lauded by the energies of the series (of states that accompany) the excellent Yoga of NirvāSa within the maSÆala - HK±AU¤ - (it is praised) along with the scripture (āgama), secured (siddha) by the Yoginīs (as is) the transmission of the passionate ecstasy (unmādamadana) which, as the entire (aggregate of) energies (sakalakalā), is the supreme plane of repose of the authority of the Command endowed with the five great arrows of the Supreme NirvāSa of Space, (translucent and brilliant) like pure crystal. O Mother of all the Heroes! You awaken (that) realisation (saˆbodha) of the insight (saˆvit) into the entire reality (artha) contemplated by the four parts (of the scripture) by means of the verses and prose of the current (of the teaching of this) the Tradition of Knowledge (vidyāmnāya).146 (125) BHAI¤! BHAI¤! BHAI¤! O Bhairavi! I am Bhairava who has come to take refuge in you. I desire the Command. O Bhairavī who are the Li‰ga of Space!147 Forgive (me my) sin!148 O Śivā!149 O Umā! O mother of the universe! O Kālikā! You who live in the abyss of the cave of the Lotus of Kula!150 By extolling (stavana) (the glories of) Mālinī to you I praise (your) feet and laud (your) Rule. Out of compassion be gracious towards me! (126) Benefits of the Hymn and Admonition to Secrecy The Mālinīstavarāja was brought down (to earth) by Ādinātha.151 It is the great voice (mahāvāSī)152 (inwardly) impelled by the Command and impelled by bliss in order to graciously confer the Command153 so that (one may acquire) authority. (40-41ab) He who reads it in front of the Transmission (krama), in the Rule (samaya) of the Transmission of the Child,154 will (first achieve) accomplishment (siddhi) from the Transmission155 and then the eight yogic powers (guSa), including the capacity to become small at will (aSimā) and the rest, are his.156 By just uttering it (he makes) contact with the plane of bliss. (41cd-42) (If) one is one-pointedly attentive (to the recitation of this hymn), (at all) three times (of the day) or (just) one time (a day), a divine penetration (of energy) (divyāveśa) takes place by the authority (adhikāra) of the contemplation (saˆkhyā) of the seed - syllables (uttered during the recitation of this hymn).157 (And one obtains) the wealth which is the grace of the Command and the Accomplishment of Speech (vācāsiddhi).158 There can be no doubt about it! (43ab-44ab)

sanskrit: 82 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ५०६ ५०७ एवं क्रमेण वै तस्य मन्त्राम्नायमनेकधा ।। ४४ ।। ५०९ अदृष्टविग्रहे शान्ते परतत्त्वे गतिं लभेत् ” । एकधा स्मरणात् सर्वं मन्त्रविद्याक्रमं लभेत् ।। ४५ ।। ५११ द्विधा एव परिज्ञानं त्रिधा चाम्बापदं लभेत् । गोपयेत् परशिष्याणां पारम्पर्यविवर्जिताम् ॥ ४६ ॥ अहंकारेऽधिरूढाना १४ दम्भिकाना न दापयेत् । एवं स्तुता महादेवी भैरवेन महात्मना ।। ४७ ।। ततो लिङ्गं विनिर्भिद्य निर्गता परमेश्वरी ५१९ -५१७ । वदते“ सिद्धनाथस्य लिङ्गस्था लिङ्गरूपिणी ॥ ४८ ॥ पूर्वप्रीतिवशाच्छम्भो मैत्रीभावेन भावनात् । भावग्राह्यं कुलं कौलं ददामि तव निश्चयम् ॥ ४९ ॥ मनसा वचसा स्नेहात् महाकौलिकमादिशेत् । ५२० ५२१ आमन्त्रितो यदा देव्या तदा मित्रत्वमागतः ॥ ५० ॥ तेनायं सिद्धनाथोऽत्र विख्यातो मित्रसंज्ञकः । आद्यारभ्यात्र २३ मद्भागे स्वामित्वं तव कौलिके ॥ ५१ ॥ ५२४ भवनाज्ञाधरो मन्त्री कौलीशश्चाधिकारिणः । ५२७ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे २५ अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलभेदोत्तरषट्कनिर्णयें कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनिमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्र- संहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते मालिनीस्तवराजाधिकारो नामानन्दः ।। ४ ।।५३०
english: CHAPTER FOUR 83 Thus one progressively (krameSa) obtains the manifold teaching concerning mantra and (thus) achieves the condition (gati) within the Supreme (transcendental) Principle that is tranquil and invisible. (44cd-45ab) By recalling it once one attains the entire transmission (krama) of mantras and Vidyās, just twice, complete knowledge and thrice, the plane of the Mother.159 (45cd-46ab) It should be kept hidden from the disciples of others, devoid of the lineage (pāramparya). It should not be given to the deceitful and the proud. (46cd-47ab) The Goddess Bursts out of the Li‰ga and graces the God Then after the great soul, Bhairava had praised the Great Goddess in this way, the Supreme Goddess broke open the Li‰ga and emerged (from it).160 And she who resides in the Li‰ga and whose form is the Li‰ga161 spoke to Siddhanātha.162 (47cd-48ab) "O Śambhu! Out of (our) prior affection and due to (your steadfast) attitude (bhavana) and friendship, I am giving you the certain knowledge (niścaya), namely, Kula and Kaula that can (only be) grasped by means of Being (bhāvagrāhya)." (Thus) by mind and by speech, out of love, she taught (the teachings concerning) the great Kaula reality (mahākaulika). (48cd-50ab) When he was invited (in this way) by the goddess, he came in friendship (mitratvamāgata) and so this Siddhanātha is known here by the name Mitra (Friend).163 (50cd-51ab) (The god said:) "O (goddess) Kaulikā, you who are a part of me! Here from today onwards it is you who are the master (svāmitvaˆ tava)." And Kaulīśa (also), who recites mantras and is the bearer of the Command of contemplation (bhavanājñā), was endowed with authority. (51cd-52ab) (This is the fourth) chapter called Concerning the Mālinīstavarāja. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) consisting of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru which (extends) for a hundred and twenty-five thousand (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) which is the ultimate purport of the Subsequent Six (Thousand Verses) of the Pure Division (vimalabhedottara-na˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata which is the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Transmission of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: पञ्चमानन्दः श्रीवक्रा उवाच' यदेतत् कौलिकं ज्ञानं क्रममण्डलधीपुरम् । दातुं न विहितं देव भक्तिस्ते रतिकामतः ॥ १ ॥ ९ पूर्वस्नेहवशात्' प्रीतिस्तेन ं शिष्यः कथं मम । गुरुशिष्यविपर्यास अयुक्तं शूलपाणि ॥ २ ॥ कृतेनापि च देवेश उपहासः प्रवर्तते । अनुलोमस्य मार्गस्य विलोमाच्च महद् भयम् ॥ ३ ॥ बुद्धिहानिर्मनोग्लानिरयुक्ताचरणाद् भवेत् । यावन्न गुरुशिष्यत्वं क्लेश यावन्न दासवत् ॥ ४॥ तावत् कुलक्रमे सिद्धिः कुतो भवति मन्त्रिणः । न शिष्य त्वा प्रवक्ष्यामि न भवामि अहं गुरुः ।। ५ ।। २१ इतः” सूत्रक्रमं शम्भो दीयते” तत् कुलक्रमम्” । भवान् ज्ञानी महाविद्वान् शिष्यत्वे नैव सा सुधीः ।। ६ ।। शिष्ये भक्तिर्गुरोज्ञान” संवित्तिरुभयोर्यदा” । तदा सा जायते दीक्षा अन्यथा च” विडम्बिका ।। ७ ।। श्रीनाथ उवाच' ३० ३८ ३७ यत् पुरासीश्च” त्वं भायी अस्म्यहं पूर्वमन्मथः५ । उभौप्रीतिवशानन्दे कामस्यान्ते यथा पुनः ॥ ८ ॥ तथा त्वमन्यदेही स्यात् अहं मत्यशरीरिणः” । आवयोः परिवर्तेन” संसारस्तच्च कामिकम् ॥ ९ ॥ तथा क्रमेण शिष्योऽहं त्वं मातामिति कल्पिता ४२ ४३ नैव दोषक्रिया चात्र मन्त्रसंकेतकं तपः ।। १० ॥ ४६ भवतामिति संप्राप्ते त्वं च सिद्धः कुलक्रमे ।
english: CHAPTER FIVE Śrīnātha's Consecration with the Command (ājñābhineka) The God Seeks to Persuade the Goddess to Accept Him as Her Disciple The venerable (goddess) Kubjikā said: 1O god, your devotion is due to a passionate desire for sex (ratikāmataƒ)2 (and so) it is not proper (for me) to give (you) this Kaulika knowledge namely, the KramamaSÆala which is the abode of the (enlightened) intellect (dhī).3 (1) (I also feel) affection (for you) because of (our) previous love and so how can (you be) my disciple? It is not right, O bearer of the trident, to reverse the (roles of) the teacher and the taught.4 And even if it is done, O lord of the gods, (it gives rise to) derision. There is great fear in reversing (the normal) forward (anuloma) path.5 By behaving improperly the intellect is damaged and the mind withers (glāni).6 Obstructing affliction (kleśa) (persists) as long as there is no (relationship) between master and disciple. As long as (the disciple does) not (behave) like a servant how can he who recites mantras achieve success (siddhi) in the Kula transmission (kulakrama)? I will not (ever) say that you are (my) disciple. I am not the teacher. O Śambhu, (it is) from hence7 that the scripture (sūtrakrama),8 namely, the Kulakrama is given (to others). You sir are wise (jñānin) and a great scholar, that intelligence is certainly not (found) in the condition of a student. If the disciple possesses devotion and the teacher knowledge9 and both possess (an illumined) consciousness, then (a true) initiation takes place. Otherwise its is a deceitful one.10 (2-7) Śrīnātha said: And just as you were previously (my) wife, I was previously your lover.11 Just as, in the bliss at the conclusion of passion, swayed by our love (we make love) again, similarly may you again became another embodied being and I (became) a mortal embodied being. It is because of our transformation that the world of transmigratory existence (has come into being) and is (thus full of) passion. In the same way, I am by turns (krameSa) the disciple12 and you are conceived to be the mother (of the universe).13 And there is no bad action (donakriyā)14 here (in this, in fact) it is (a form of) austerity that accords with the teaching of mantra.15 And when it becomes yours it is you who are attained in the Kulakrama.16 (8-11ab)

sanskrit: 86 कुमारिकाखण्डः ५० एवं क्रमेण शिष्योऽहं स्थितः पूर्वसमुच्चये ॥ ११ ॥ क्रमस्याग्रे मण्डलस्याग्रे” युष्मदग्रे प्रसन्नधीः । परिवत्य स्वरूपेण तुभ्यं मह्यं यथार्थतः ।। १२ ॥ ५२ ५४ तथा में प्रीतिपूर्वेण कुरु ज्ञानप्रकाशनम् । -५५ शिष्योऽहं तव कल्याणि त्वं माता मे प्रतीकुरु ॥ १३ ॥ एवं तु आवयोः प्राप्तं उत्तीर्ण पूर्वसंग्रहम् । तस्मादनुग्रहार्थाय स्नेहेन पश्यसे मम ॥ १४ ॥ .६३ ६१ ५९ नास्ति सिद्धि:° कलौ तन्त्रे चतुर्थे तु महायुगे । सिद्ध्यन्ति निश्चयं चात्र श्रीमच्चन्द्रपुरे गृहे ॥ १५ ॥ मण्डले सावधानोऽहं भवे जन्मनि जन्मनि । एवमाज्ञाक्रमं ब्रूहि संहितार्थसमुच्चयम्¨ ।। १६ ।। येन विज्ञानमात्रेण कम्पते देहपञ्जरम् । कौलिकं तु पर ज्ञानं उपदेशं वदस्व मे ॥ १७ ॥ ६७ त्वमेकाकाशलिङ्गं तु आसनं पृथिवी त्वियम् । चराचरं त्वयि लीन तेन त्वं लिङ्गरूपिणी ॥ १८ ॥ त्वं मन्त्रस्त्वं परा विद्या त्वमाज्ञा त्वं परापरा । 06 त्वं सिद्धिस्त्वं च शक्तिस्त्व शरणागतवत्सले ॥ १९ ॥ ७२ त्वच्छक्त्या” प्रेरितोऽहं च भवे जन्मनि जन्मनि । ७४ अहं धन्यतनुर्मर्त्यो” यस्त्वयाराधने क्षमः ।। २० ।। विशेषक्रमविज्ञानं भवेत् सिद्धिप्रदं मतम् । सिद्धिरूपाश्रमैकत्व विनयेनोपगम्यते ।। २१ ।।
english: CHAPTER FIVE 87 In this way, in due order (krameSa) I am the disciple in the initial aggregation (samuccaya) (of the teaching). So, reveal (this) knowledge to me with affection. Just as in front of the Krama, the maSÆala and you, (the adept) whose intellect is content, (makes offerings) to you and I, as is proper, alternating (between us) according to (our) nature. O auspicious one, I am your disciple and you my mother.17 Help me! The previous collection (of teaching's) (pūrvasaˆgraha)18 was acquired from us in this way and fully learnt (uttīrSa). Therefore, look upon me with love in order to grace (me). (11cd-14) There is no accomplishment (siddhi) (to achieve) in Tantra19 during the Age of Strife, the fourth great aeon.20 (But initiates) achieve realisation (niścaya) here in the House of the venerable City of the Moon.21 In the maSÆala, I am attentive in (this world of transmigratory) existence life after life. And so expound the transmission of the Command (ājñākrama), namely, the aggregate of the meaning of (this) scripture (saˆhitā), merely by knowing which the cage of the body trembles.22 Impart the teaching, which is supreme Kaulika knowledge, to me. (15-17) The God Praises the Goddess in the Li‰ga 23You are the one Li‰ga of the Sky (ākāśali‰ga) and the seat, which is this earth.24 The moving and immobile (universe) is merged (līna) in you and so you (O goddess) are the Li‰ga.25 (18) O beloved of those who come to take refuge (in you)! You are mantra. You are the Supreme Vidyā. You are the Command. You are (both) inferior (immanence) and supreme (transcendence). You are yogic accomplishment (siddhi) and you are power (śakti).26(19) By your power I am impelled into phenomenal existence life after life. I am that mortal who possesses a blessed body and due to you is capable of worshipping (you).27 (20) The special knowledge of the Transmission (krama) is considered to be that which bestows accomplishment (siddhi). By virtuous conduct (vinaya) one comes to understand the oneness which is the hermitage (āśrama) whose nature is accomplishment.28 (21)

sanskrit: 88 कुमारिकाखण्डः ७७ तदेव तपयुक्तस्य ँ लिङ्गस्य खेचरस्य च । व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्य शुद्धस्य नादिफान्ते स्थितस्य च ।। २२ ।। सिंहसंकेतदेहस्य” मालिनीक्रममध्यतः । मया निवेदितात्मान ं साष्टाङ्गगतिपूर्वकम् ॥ २३ ॥ ८२ एतद् भक्त्याश्रमं चात्र देवि तुभ्यं निवेदितम् । शिष्यत्वेन न संदेहो न त्वत्परतरं धनम् ।। २४ ।। -८५ ८९ सिद्ध्यसे नात्र संदेहो भक्तश्चाज्ञा लभेत् स्फुटम् । शिष्ये भक्तिर्गुरोज्ञान आज्ञालब्ध कुलागमम् ॥ २५ ॥ मुद्रा ज्ञानशलाका या भक्तियुक्ते प्रवर्तते । ९२ प्रसन्ना भव देवेशि दर्शनं देहि साम्प्रतम् ।। २६ ।। ९४ शरीरं न मया दृष्टं लिङ्ग दृश्यति केवलम् । शुद्धहेममयं दिव्यं भ्रमते अग्निदीपवत् ।। २७ ।। तेन मे विभ्रमं चित्ते आत्मानं प्रकटं कुरु । लिङ्गस्य स्फोटनं कृत्वा प्रत्यक्षा भव मे प्रभो ।। २८ ।। श्रीवक्रा उवाच' ०३ लिङ्गस्फोट कृत शम्भो निष्क्रान्ताहं सुवर्चसा । कुटिलाकृतिरूपेण त्रिष्कोणाननभीषणा ।। २९ । श्यामा रक्ता त्रिनेत्राहं कालानलसमप्रभा । सिंहावलोकसंपन्ना तेन सिंहावलोकिनी ॥ ३० ॥ दृष्ट्वा त्वां भैरवानन्द“ लज्जासंकुचिता अहम्” । संजाता वक्रिका तेन अष्टाङ्गकरभूषिता ॥ ३१ ॥ ।। ।
english: CHAPTER FIVE 89 I have made known with profound obeisance (an˜ā‰gagatipūrva)29 that same (oneness), the essential nature (ātman) of the Li‰ga endowed with austerity (tapas)30 that moves in the expanse (of transcendent reality) (khecara). Pure and both manifest and unmanifest, it is established in the Mālinī order of the alphabet (nādiphānta) and its body is the Lion's Convention (siˆhasaˆketa) in the middle of the Mālinīkrama.31 (22-23) That (maSÆala), O goddess, is the hermitage of devotion, and it was here that it was made known to you because (you then assumed the state of) a disciple.32 (But) there can be no doubt that there is no greater wealth than you. (24) You attain success, there is no doubt about it, and the devotee clearly attains the Command. Devotion is in the disciple and knowledge in the teacher and the Kula scripture (āgama) is (then) attained by the Command.33 (25) The Gesture (mudrā), which is the Scalpel of Knowledge,34 operates within one endowed with devotion. Be pleased, O mistress of the gods, give (me) now a vision (darśana) (of yourself). (26) I have not seen (your) body; only the Li‰ga is visible. Made of pure gold and divine, it moves like a flame of fire. (27) And so there is delusion in my mind. Make yourself clearly manifest! O lord (prabhu),35 having burst apart the Li‰ga become visible to me! (28) The Emergence of the Goddess from the Li‰ga and the God's Empowerment The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O Śambhu, the Li‰ga has been burst apart36 and I of beautiful lustre have emerged (from it) in a crooked form, horrific and (my) face the Triangle.37(29) I am dark blue and red.38 I have three eyes and (my) light is like the Fire of Time.39 The gaze I possess (is like that of a) lion and so (I am called) `she who has the lion's gaze' (siˆhāvalokinī).40 (30) When I saw you, who are Bhairava's bliss, I became bent over with bashfulness (lajjāsaˆkucitā)41 thus I became Vakrikā (the Little Crooked One) adorned with the rays of (my) eight limbs.42 (31)

sanskrit: 90 06 कुमारिकाखण्डः अहं जाता तदा वक्रा दिव्यदेहा” ” महाबला । दृष्टमात्रेण”” विद्धस्त्वं इदं तथ्यं मया कृतम् ।। ३२ ।। श्रीनाथ उवाच ११५ अहं विद्धस्त्वया शक्त्या विह्वलो ह्यवलोकनात् । न ते दृष्टं मया कार्यं निद्राघूर्मिवशं गतः ११७ ११६ न शृणोमि न पश्यामि परचेतापहारित: । ॥ ३३ ॥ तदाहं च त्वया देवि वेधितश्चावलोकनात् ॥ ३४ ॥ १२९ एतत्प्रत्ययसंप्राप्ते वेधदीक्षा कुलक्रमे ९ । श्रुतिर्मतिर्मनोदृष्टिश्चेतो धृतिः १ क्षमेति च ॥ ३५ ॥ अन्यचित्तगतो विद्ध: १२३ शक्त्यावेशेन २४ विग्रहः । प्रत्ययाज्ञा स्वरूपेण प्राप्ता ज्ञानशलाकया ।। ३६ ।। १२५ १२८ ११४ सिद्धानामाद्यसिद्धोऽस्मि २६ मित्राख्यो नामनामतः । तव भक्तो ह्यहं दासो गतिस्त्वं शरण” परम् ।। ३७ ।। १३१ साष्टाङ्गप्रणिपातोऽय ै” कृत१३२ दण्ड ३३ कृत दण्ड त्रिधा पुन: १३६ आज्ञाधरमह३५ शिष्यस्त्वमेका व्यापिनी गुरु: जातः शिष्यो ह्यहमेको ७ गोत्राचारेण ३८ धीमतः १३७ क्षमस्व देवदेवेशि संक्रान्ताज्ञामनुग्रहात् १३९ १३४ ।। ३८ ।। ।। ३९ ॥ वक्रिके त्वं प्रभुमीता देवी विश्रामभूमिका । १४२ । त्वं गतिस्त्वं च मे स्वामी तवाहं शरणं गतः ।। ४० । स्वर्गापवर्गयोर्देवि त्वमेका योनि ४५ मातरः १४६ । १४३
english: CHAPTER FIVE 91 I then became Vakrā (the Crooked One), (endowed with) a divine body and very strong. You were pierced merely by being seen (by me). It is I who have brought about this reality (tathya). (32) Śrīnātha said: I have been pierced by you who are power (śakti). I am in distress because of (your) gaze. Deprived of consciousness by sleep and inebriation (ghūrmi),43 I have not seen your body. Stolen away by another mind, I neither see nor hear (anything).44 Then, O goddess, I was pierced by you with (your) gaze. (33-34) The initiation by piercing into the Kulakrama takes place when these signs (pratyaya) obtain45 namely, (divine) hearing, intuition (mati), mental perception (manodrn˜i), intelligence (cetas), strength of character (dhrti) and forbearance (knamā). (Thus) the form (of the disciple) present in the mind of another (i.e. the teacher) is pierced by the penetration of energy (śaktyāveśa) and the (initiation), which is the Command of Insight (pratyayājñā), is attained according to its essential nature by means of the scalpel of knowledge.46 (35-36) (Bhairava said): “Amongst accomplished yogis (siddha), I am the first to have attained the goal (ādyasiddha) and according to (the worldly way of) naming, I am called Mitra.47 I am your devotee. (I am your) servant. You are the means of success (gati), the supreme cause. (37) (I have) prostrated with all eight of (my) limbs having (extended my body on the ground like a) stick, three times again.48 I am the disciple, the bearer of (your divine) Command, and you are the one, all-pervading teacher. As (I am) wise (dhīmat) I have become (your) sole disciple by practicing according (to the teachings of our spiritual) clan (gotrācāra).49 (38-39ab) O mistress of the god of gods, pardon (me and vouchsafe) by (your) grace the Command that has been transmitted (to you) (saˆkrāntājñā). O Vakrikā, you are the lord (prabhu),50 the mother, the goddess and the plane of rest. You are the way (gati) and you are my master (svāmin), I have taken refuge in you. O goddess, you are the mother (of the universe) and sole source (yoni) of (both) heaven and liberation. (40-41ab)

sanskrit: 92 कुमारिकाखण्डः अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः ।। ४१ ।। अद्य मे विभव प्राप्तं आज्ञा संक्रमिताद्य ४८ मे । अद्य योगीश्वरोऽहं च त्वत्प्रसादाच्च भैरवि ४९ ।। ४२ ।। उपदेशं क्रिया शिक्षा साम्प्रतं कथयस्व मे । सिद्धवाक्यमिदं श्रुत्वा देवी वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ ४३ ॥ १५२ श्रीवक्रा उवाच मया च तव मित्रत्वं पूर्वस्नेहान्निवेदितम् । मित्रदेव'५३ महासिद्ध४ आज्ञानाम प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ ४४ ॥ पुष्पा:५६ सप्तदशाराध्या आत्माष्टादशकम् तथा । १६० १६२ दशसप्तक्रमे ज्येष्ठा आराध्या मम सुव्रत ।। ४५ ।। तवैते पूजनीयास्तु शाम्भवाः सिद्धनायकाः । उन्मनादिक्रमेणैव'`३ यावत् श्रीनाथचिञ्चिणी ॥ ४६ ॥ पुष्पसंकेतकं शम्भो अज्ञात्वा नैव मुक्तिभाक् । १६७ ।। बालक्रमं तथा देव पीठा: १६६ पीठेषु देवता:' ।। ४७ ।। बाह्ये तु देवताश्चाष्टौ नादिफान्ता तु कौलिकी । १७१ १७२ उत्तिष्ठ स्फुरते चाज्ञा क्रमयुक्ते महेश्वर ।। ४८ ।। त्वमेक७४ चान्वये गोत्रे मयाद्य प्रकटीकृतम् । १७७ रक्षणीयमिदं ज्ञान पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् ।। ४९ ॥ योगिनीमुखनिष्क्रान्तं मेरुमार्गविनिर्गतम्” । कुमारीयोगिनीभक्ति:° समयद्रोहनिग्रहम् ।। ५० ।। कर्तव्य २ च मदीयाज्ञा यथेच्छा विचरेत् सुखम् ।
english: CHAPTER FIVE 93 Today my birth has born fruit. Today my austerity is fruitful. Today I have attained glorious power (vibhava). Today the Command has been transmitted to me. And today, O Bhairavī, by your grace, I am the Lord of Yogis.51 Now, pray tell me the teaching, the ritual and the instruction.” When she had heard this, the speech of an accomplished being, the goddess uttered (the following) words. (41cd-43) The Goddess's Teaching The venerable Vakrā said: “Out of (our) previous affection I have proclaimed your friendship.52 O Mitradeva! Mahāsiddha! The name of the Command has been lauded. (44) The Flowers that are the object of worship are seventeen and the Self is the eighteenth. O observer of fine vows, my (energy called) Jyen˜hā should be worshipped (jyen˜hā ārādhyā mama)53 in the Sequence of Seventeen (parts). These are your Śāmbhava leaders (nāyaka) of the Siddhas and should indeed be worshipped. O Śambhu, without having known the Convention of the Flower (punpasaˆketaka) that extends in due order from the Transmental (unmanā) up to Śrīnātha and CiñciSī, one is not liberated. (45-47ab) O god, such also is the case54 with the Transmission of the Child (bālakrama),55 the sacred seats (pī˜ha), the deities in the sacred seats56 and, externally, the eight deities and (the goddess) Kaulikī who is Mālinī (nādiphāntā).57 (47cd-48ab) Maheśvara arise! The Command pulses effulgent within one who is conjoined to the transmission (kramayukta). Today I have made you manifest as the one (reality to be realised) in the tradition (anvaya), that is, (in my spiritual) clan (gotra). (48cd-49ab) This knowledge has come forth from the mouth of the Yoginī.58 It has emerged from the Path of Meru and come down through the line (of teachers). It should be (carefully) guarded. (49cd-50ab) (One should have) devotion for the Virgins (Kumārīs) and Yoginīs,59 suppress (nigraha) attacks60 on the Rule (samaya) and execute my Command. (One who does this) may wander about joyfully. (50cd-51ab)

sanskrit: 94 कुमारिकाखण्डः १८४ लोका भक्तिरता यत्र तत्र ज्ञानं प्रकाशय ।। ५१ ।। गुटिका पादलक्षा तु पातनीयावलोकनात् । चन्द्रार्थोऽनुग्रहेत्“ सर्वान् संसाध्य इति ज्ञानप्रभावोऽयं तवोक्त २ हि तु १९३ आज्ञया खग ।। ५२ ।। भैरव । १९६ निग्रहानुग्रहे शक्तिर्भवते तव निश्चयम् ॥ ५३ ॥ मत्यलोके व्रजित्वा तु कुरु क्रीडा यथेच्छया । १९७ जरामरणनिर्मुक्त:“ खगतिस्तव नित्यशः” ।। ५४ ॥ विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यस्त्वं हि काञ्चनवद्” यथा । ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि ये कुर्वन्ति दिने दिने ॥ ५५ ॥ तव स्मरणमात्रेण नश्यन्ते नात्र संशयः । २०२ २०४ २०५ ये२०३ ध्यायन्ति सदा तुभ्यं त्रिष्कालस्मरणादपिं ॥ ५६ ॥ ते सिद्धा नात्र संदेहो विमुक्ताः पाशबन्धनैः २०६ । ये निन्दन्ति तु त्वां मित्र दूषयन्त्यथवा यदि ।। ५७ ।। म्रियन्ते” कुगतिं यान्ति मोक्षहास्ते” न संशयः । रौरवं नरक?? यान्ति मुक्तिस्तेषां कुतो भवेत् ॥ ५८ ॥ एवमुक्त्वा तु सिद्धस्य योगावस्था तु सुन्दरी । श्रीनाथ उवाच २१२ वदते३ परया भक्त्या देव्यग्रे ४ प्रणतः स्थितः ॥ ५९ ॥ देशिकस्त्वं५ महादेवि अभिषेकं ददस्व मे । २१६ २१७ दद विभवसामथ्यं दीक्षाव्याख्याद्यनुग्रहम् ॥ ६० ॥ ततो भ्रमामि' आचार्यो योगेशीनां तु मध्यतः । २१९
english: CHAPTER FIVE 95 Reveal (this) knowledge wherever people are intent on devotion. The pill (gu˜ikā)61 indeed consists of 125,000 (verses) (pādalaknā)62 and should be administered (pātanīyā) by (the energy of your) gaze.63 O Wanderer in the Sky (of the transcendent), once attained by means of the Command, (the reality which is the ultimate) purport (of the Tradition of the) Moon (candrārtha),64 you should grace all. Thus, O Bhairava, I have explained this, the power of knowledge to you. (51cd-53ab) Yours, certainly, is the power (both) to grace (anugraha) and to chastise (nigraha). Once gone to the mortal world, play as you will. (53cd-54ab) (You are) free of old age and death and you move perpetually in the Sky (of ultimate reality). You are free of all sins, like gold (purified of all dross). (54cd-55ab) (Even the most dreadful) sins, including brahminicide, that (people) commit every day, are destroyed merely by remembering you. There is no doubt about it. (55cd-56ab) Those who meditate on you constantly are accomplished yogis (siddha) and also (become so) by remembering (you) the three times (of day).65 They are free from the fetters of the bonds (that imprison the soul). There is no doubt about it. (56cd-57ab) O friend (mitra), those who censor you or find fault in you (dūnayanti) die and end up on the wrong path (kugati). They are, without a doubt, destroyers of (true) freedom (mukti). (57cd-58ab) They go to the Raurava hell.66 Where can there be liberation for them?" Once the beautiful (goddess, who is) the yogic state of the accomplished yogi had spoken thus (Śrīnātha responded). (58cd-9ab) The God's Consecration Śrīnātha said: Bowing before the goddess, he said with supreme devotion: "O great goddess, you are the teacher (deśika),67 give me the consecration (abhineka). Give me the power of dominion (vibhavasāmarthya), the grace of initiation, the explanation (of the scriptures)68 and the rest. Then I, a teacher, will wander in the midst of the Mistresses of Yoga (yogeśī)."69 (59cd-61ab)

sanskrit: 96 कुमारिकाखण्डः सिद्धवाक्यमिदं श्रुत्वा तुष्टासौ योगमातरम् ।। ६१ ।। वदते२२२ सिद्धनाथस्य २२३ हे २२४ मित्र जगतः प्रभो । इदं तदभिषेक २५ तु षोडशान्तावलोकनात् ।। ६२ ।। कलाषोडशसंपूर्णी पूर्णी देवी समुच्चरेत् । २२९ अमृतौघं प्रवर्षन्ती” अमा सप्तादशी कला ।। ६३ ।। अभिषेक३० तु नाथस्य दत्तं देव्यावलोकनात् । २३१ खेचरत्वं१३३ ददाम्यद्य लिङ्गं गृह्य” यथार्थतः •२३६ २३७ २३५ ॥ ६४ ॥ .२३८ दीक्षाव्याख्याससामथ्यं इत्याज्ञा मुक्तिदा तव । २४० इदं तदभिषेक तु मया दत्तं तव प्रिय ॥ ६५ ॥ वज्रं विदारयेल्लिङ्ग” संजीव्यः २४२ २४३ ।। परमः शशि : २४४ । २४७ पूजनीयं ४५ सदा हीद४६ लिङ्गमेक कुलागमे ।। ६६ ॥ २४८ यत्र यत्रापि देशे४९ तु मन्त्रजं सहजं हि ५० वा २५१ । २५२ कृत्रिमं भवते वाथ पूजनीयं विशेषतः ।। ६७ ॥ नमस्कारेच्छुचिर्भक्त्या श्रीलिङ्ग पश्चिमामुखम् २५३ - २५५ । तदभिषेकमाचार्ये५६ लिङ्गपूजा दिने दिने लिङ्गपूजा दिने २७ दिने २५८ ॥ ६८ ॥ कुलाचार्याभिषिक्ता ये लिङ्गाराधनवर्जिताः । २६० २६१ न तेषां२६२ साधनी सिद्धि : २६३ अन्यथा ४ पतनं भवेत् ।। ६९ ।। एवमुक्त्वा तु सिद्धस्य अदृष्टकुलविग्रहा २६६ । संजाता देवदेवेशी चक्रे सिंहावलोकिनी ।। ७० ।। २७० २७१ तत: २६८ सिद्धो९ महातुष्टः सिंहरूपो गत: स्वयम् । साष्टाङ्गैस्तु७२ नमस्कारै:२७३ सिद्धः ४ क्षाम्यति भैरवीम् ।। ७१ ।। श्लोकद्वादशकैर्दिव्यैः ७७ स्तुवते २७८ दिव्यशासनम् । २७९
english: CHAPTER FIVE 97 Upon hearing this, the speech of an accomplished being, she the Mother of Yoga, was satisfied and said to Siddhanātha: "O friend (mitra), lord of the universe, this is that consecration (that takes place) by the gaze of (the goddess who is) at the End of the Sixteen (noÆaśāntavalokanāt)."70 (61cd-62) The goddess Full Moon (PūrSā), replete with the sixteen energies (of the Moon) is the seventeenth energy (that as) the New Moon (Amā) ascended (samuccaret) as she rained down a stream of nectar. (Thus) the consecration was imparted to the Lord by the gaze of the goddess. (63-64ab) Today I will give (you the liberated) state of flight (khecaratva); grasp the Li‰ga as it is in reality! 71 Initiation, the explanation (of the teachings) (vyākhyā) and the capacity (to apply them) (sāmarthya): this is the Command that bestows upon you liberation.72 (64cd-65ab) This, O dear one, is the consecration I have given you. The thunderbolt (vajra) must split apart the Li‰ga and the supreme Moon should be vitalised.73 (65cd-66ab) This, the sole Li‰ga in the Kula scripture (kulāgama), should be worshipped constantly. Wherever it is, whether it be born spontaneously (sahaja), generated from mantra (mantraja) or even if an artefact (krtrima), it should be worshipped in particular.74 The pure man should salute the Śrīli‰ga that faces west (paścimāmukha)75 with devotion. (66cd-68ab) This is the consecration (abhineka) that takes place within the teacher (ācārya) namely, the daily worship of the Li‰ga.76 Those consecrated as Kula teachers (kulācārya) who do not worship the Li‰ga cannot achieve accomplishment (siddhi) and (doing) otherwise, (they) fall." (68cd-69) Having spoken thus to the Accomplished One (Siddha), her form the unseen Kula she, the mistress of the god of the gods, whose gaze is like a lion (siˆhāvalokinī) 77 arose within the Wheel. Then the Accomplished One, greatly satisfied, whose form was (as powerful as a) lion (siˆharūpa) spontaneously went (to her). (70-71ab) The Accomplished One propitiated Bhairavī with salutations accompanied by full prostrations and praised the divine teaching with twelve divine verses. (71cd-72ab)

sanskrit: 96 98 कुमारिकाखण्डः ऐंकारासनमारूढां° वज्रपद्मोपरिस्थिताम् ।। ७२ । सिद्धि२८१ मां ददते नित्यं श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (१) २८५ ज्ञानशक्तिं महामायां दिव्यज्ञानप्रकाशकीम् ।। ७३ । अन्तधीनगतां८६ देवीं श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (२) । चतु:पीठकमध्यस्थां“ दिव्यशक्तिप्रभावत:२८९ ।। ७४ ।। षट्प्रकारसमोपेता” श्रीकुजाख्यां” नमाम्यहम् (३) । २९३ । २८३ मेनाख्यदुहिता देवी तुर्यस्थाने व्यवस्थिता ।। ७५ । लिङ्गान्ते”४ वसते नित्यं श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (४) । २९५ २९८ बालक्रमसमोपेतां भगाह्लादेन चिञ्चिणीम् ।। ७६ ।। नादिफान्तास्वराघोरां श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (५) । • २९९ ३०० चन्द्रद्वीपे शिला शुद्धा पूजिता च मया पुरा ।। ७७ ।। सप्तजन्मविनिष्क्रान्तां श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् ( ६ ) । •३०१ ३०२ ' घोरां घोरतराघोराघोरज्ञानावलम्बिनीम् ।। ७८ ।। नित्ययुक्तां स्वचक्रस्थ श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (७) । जन्मत्रिकोणमध्यस्थां •३०५ •३०४ ३०६ तरुणादित्यवर्चसाम् ।। ७९ ।। दिव्यामाज्ञास्वरूपेण श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (८) । ३०७ ३०८ रुद्रशक्तिः सदा पूज्या पीठानां कीर्तनादपि ।। ८० ।। •३०९ सिद्धि स्फुटां ३१२ •३१० प्रदातारीं श्रीकुजाख्यां नामाम्यहम् (९) । देवतैः पूजितां नित्यं ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणैः ।। ८१ ।। सिद्धयोगेश्वरीख्यातां४ श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (१०) । ।
english: CHAPTER FIVE 99 The Hymn of Twelve Verses78 (1) I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā who, established above the thunderbolt-lotus (vajrapadma) and mounted on the letter AI¤ (as her) seat constantly gives me (every) accomplishment (siddhi).79 (72cd-73ab) (2) I salute the venerable goddess called Kujā who has become invisible; (she who is) the power of knowledge, Mahāmāyā who illumines divine knowledge.80 (73cd-74ab) (3) I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā endowed with six parts (prakāra) who, by the power of (her) divine energy, resides in the middle of the four sacred seats.81 (74cd-75ab) (4) I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā who always resides within the Li‰ga. She, the daughter of (the one) called Menā,82 is the goddess established in the abode of the fourth state.83 (75cd-76ab) (5) I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā who, benign (aghorā),84 is Mālinī (nādiphāntā), the silent (sound of consciousness) (asvarā).85 As the bliss of the Yoni (bhagāhlāda)86 she is CiñciSī who possesses the Transmission of the Child.87 (76cd-77ab) (6) There is a pure Stone on the Island of the Moon88 worshipped by me before. I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā who, after seven births,89 has come out (of it). (77cd-78ab) (7) I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā who, residing in (her) own Wheel,90 is perpetually conjoined (with the Supreme Principle) - she who is Ghorā, Ghoratarā and Aghorā91 and is sustained by the knowledge of Aghora.92 (78cd-79ab) (8) I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā who, as the Command, is divine and, brilliant as the youthful sun (at dawn), resides in the centre of the Triangle of Birth.93 (79cd-80ab) (9) I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā who bestows evident accomplishment. (She who is) Rudra's energy94 should always be worshipped (as such) and also by praising the sacred seats. (80cd-81ab) (10) I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kujā who is known as Siddhayogeśvarī and is worshipped constantly by (all) the deities and those intent on celibacy. (81cd-82ab)

sanskrit: 100 कुमारिकाखण्डः ३१५ सिद्धविद्याधरैर्यक्षैर्योगिनीगणवृन्दकैः ।। ८२ ।। वाद्यनृत्यरतां देवीं६ श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (११) । ३१८ भरितां भैरवीमुग्रा अमान्तपदगामिनीम् ॥ ८३ ॥ ३१९ मित्रमातः प्रभुं देवीं श्रीकुजाख्यां नमाम्यहम् (१२) । ३२१ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके विद्यापीठमार्गे २२ विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे २३ आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां ३२४ अव्वाक्रमभाषिते ४ श्रीनाथाज्ञाभिषेका— धिकारो नामानन्दः ॥ ५ ॥
english: CHAPTER FIVE 101 (11) Along with accomplished yogis, the celestial sages (vidyādhara), the spirits of vegetation (yakna) and troupes of Yoginīs, I salute the venerable goddess called Kujā who is devoted to instrumental music and dance. (82cd-83ab) (12) O mother of Mitra!95 I salute the venerable goddess called Kujā, the lord who, full (of energy) (bharitā), is the ferocious (ugrā) Bhairavī who travels to the plane at the extremity of (the energy of the) New Moon (amā). (83cd-84ab) This is the (fifth) chapter called Concerning Śrīnātha's Consecration with the Command (ājñābhineka). It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for one hundred and twenty-five thousand (verses). It is on the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) and within the ultimate purport of the Pure Six (Thousand Verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command uttered within the Transmission of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: श्रीनाथ उवाच षष्ठानन्दः पीठावतारमन्य' तु यथा भवति भैरवि । तदेव ब्रूहि मां देवि येन क्षुभ्यन्ति जन्तवः ॥ १ ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच या सा शक्तिर्भगाख्याता पुरा सिद्धा तु भाषिता क्वचिन्मुद्राश्रमे स्थाने प्रविष्टा' देवतैः सह ॥ २ ॥ ९ तूष्णीं भूत्वा गुहामध्ये आरूढा तपभावना ं । उन्मत्तब्रह्मचर्येण कृष्णरूपावधूतया ।। ३ ।। उड्डीकारयते” नित्यं निशाचारेण ब्रह्मवित् । ततः शब्दो महान् जात: त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ॥ ४ ॥ दिव्यज्ञानप्रभावेन सिद्धरूपा बलोत्कटा । आगता ब्रह्मचर्येण क्रीडयित्वा नभान्तरे ।। ५ ॥ उभौ उडिप्रवेशेन पीठोद्यान विधीयते । खगेशस्तत्र” संसिद्धस्त्रैलोक्याकर्षणक्षमः” ॥ ६ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIX The Pervasion of Śrīnātha's Sacred Seat of the Command (ājñāpī˜ha) The Goddess's Contemplation in the Cave of the Li‰ga and Her Emergence from It Śrīnātha said: O Bhairavī, pray tell me of the other descent of the sacred seats (into the world)1 by which, O goddess, people are (spiritually) aroused (knubhyanti). (1) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: That energy called the Yoni (bhaga), formerly said to be (fully) accomplished (siddhā),2 has entered (pravin˜ā),3 along with the deities, somewhere into the place (sthāna)4 which is the Hermitage of Gesture (mudrāśrama).5 (2) Silent in the middle of the Cave, she is intent (ārūÆhā) on contemplating (the power of) austerity (tapas), by the practice of ecstatic celibacy (unmattabrahmacarya) and laying aside (her) dark (krnSarūpāvadhūtayā) form.6 (There), O knower of the Brahman, she constantly induces (mystical) flight (within herself and others) by the Conduct of the Night (niśācāra).7 (3-4ab) Then a great sound (śabda) arose in the triple world, within (the universe of all that) moves and is immobile.8 And, after having played within the Void (nabhas) (of the Li‰ga),9 she whose nature is accomplished came (into the world) grand with (her) might by the power of divine knowledge10 and the practice of continence (brahmacarya).11 (4cd-5) The five sacred seats, their inhabitants and Bhairava's consecration in each one. OÆÆiyāna Bhairava meets the Goddess 12As both (the god and goddess) entered (the land of) UÆi,13 (the worship of) Udyāna is enjoined as a sacred seat. There, Khageśa (the Lord of the Skyfarers) is fully accomplished and capable of attracting (to himself the entire) triple world. (6)

sanskrit: 104 कुमारिकाखण्डः प्राप्ते देव्याश्रमे भक्त्या आराधयति पादुकाम् । यथेच्छा पूजिता देवी क्रमाज्ञा पारमेश्वरी ।। ७ ।। अष्टाङ्गप्रणिपातेन“ अश्रुपूर्णः क्षमापयेत्” । कुलजा सिद्धनाथस्य” दिव्याज्ञा संभविष्यति ॥ ८ ॥ ततो नमस्कृतं” पश्चादोडीशः” सिद्धनायकः । गतो” वृक्षान्तरे” सिद्धो निशाचारेण कौलवित् ।। ९ ।। कदम्बवद् भ्रमेद् वृक्षं वृक्ष तेन कदम्बकम् । सिंहरूपं गतो यस्मात्” तस्मात्” संकेतसिंहकम् ॥१० ॥ सिंहज्ञानमिदं तेन भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् । ४३ अथ पञ्चाशद् रुद्रास्तु” तूष्णीं भूत्वा समागताः ।। ११ ।। पूजिता कुब्जिका देवी स्तुता सर्वैः सुरादिभिः । ४७ वरं ददाति सा तुष्टा विचरध्वं यथासुखम् ॥ १२ ॥ एवं श्रुत्वा च ते तुष्टा देव्यामाराधयन्ति” हि । पञ्चोपचारपूजायां तदोक्ताः परिचारकाः ॥ १३ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIX 105 When he reached the goddess's hermitage, he worshipped (her) sandals with devotion. He worshipped the goddess who is the Command of the Transmission (kramājñā) of the Supreme Goddess, (freely) as much as he desired. (7) Prostrating (fully before her), (his eyes) full of tears, (he exclaimed): "Be gracious." (And she replied): "(Rest assured), the divine Command, born of Kula, will come into Siddhanātha's possession!" (8) The Sacred Tree Then after saluting, OÆīśa,14 the leader of accomplished yogis, (himself) an accomplished yogi and knower of Kaula, entered into the Tree by the Conduct of the Night.15 (9) The Tree rotates like the ecliptic (kadamba) and so the Tree is a Kadamba.16 He assumed the form of a lion17 and so the teaching (saˆketa) is that of the Lion. Thus (this is) the Lion Knowledge (siˆhajñāna)18 that bestows the fruits of worldly benefits (bhukti) and liberation. (10-11ab) The Fifty Rudras Now, the fifty Rudras19 became silent and came (to that place). The goddess Kubjikā was worshipped and praised by all the gods and the others. She was satisfied and gave them a boon (saying): "Wander freely as you please!" (11cd-12) When they heard this, they were satisfied and worshipped the goddess in the Rite of the Five Offerings (pañcopacārapūjā) and (so were) then said to be (the goddess's) attendants (paricāraka). (13)

sanskrit: 106 कुमारिकाखण्डः -५५ ५३ श्रीकण्ठश्च” अनन्तश्च सूक्ष्मीशं च त्रिमूर्तिकम् । अमरीशं तथार्घीश भारभूत्यतिथीश्वरम् ॥ १४ ॥ स्थाणुनाम हरश्चैव झण्टीश भौतिक तथा । सद्योजातोऽनुग्रहीश अंकुरीशमतः परम् ।। १५ । महासेनश्च क्रोधीश चण्डीशं च प्रचण्डराट् । क्रूराख्यमेकरुद्रश्च कूर्म चैवैकनेत्रकम् ॥ १६ ॥ चतुर्मुखो अजेशश्च श्येनः सोमेश्वरस्तथा । ६७ लांगुली दारुकेशश्च अर्धनारीश्वरस्तथा ।। १७ ॥ उमाकान्तस्तथाषाडी डिण्डिनं धातृरुद्रकम् । मीनं चैव तथा मेषं लोहितं च तथैव च ॥ १८ ॥ शिखिवाही तथा चान्य छगलण्ड तथैव च । •७० •७१ द्विरण्डं च महाकाल ँ बालीश च भुजङ्गमम् ।। १९ ।। पिनाकीशं च खड्गाख्य” बकानन्द च श्वेतकम् । लकुली भृगुदेवेश संवर्तकमतः परम् ।। २० ।। एवं पञ्चाशद् रुद्रास्तु प्रतिचर्यीरताः सदा । ७७ तथान्ये देवताः सप्त सुमूलप्रतिचारकाः ।। २१ ।। आज्ञाविधेयाः सर्वे ते देव्यापादार्चने रताः । ७८ तथा वृक्षाः” स्मृतास्त्रीणि वेल्लकत्रितयं तथा ।। २२ ।। खररा गररा चैव ररा च परिचारिकाः २ । ८३ कुबेरं खगमश्चैव कर्बुरं प्रतिचारकम् ।। २३ । ८४ आज्ञाविधेयाः सर्वे ते अपरा भैरवाः स्वयम् । अन्येषा ँ प्रतिचारीणां“ देवगन्धर्वयोषिताम् ॥ २४ ॥ योगियोगिनिवीराणां परिसंख्या न विद्यते । एवं क्रमेण संयोगात् पीठोद्यानमुदाहृतम् ।। २५ ॥ करवीरं श्मशानं तु करपुष्पैरधिष्ठितम् । तत्र चक्रं तु रुद्राणां नाम्ना कङ्कालभैरवम् ।। २६ ।। •९७ रौद्रं रौद्रतरं तीव्रं व्यालव्यग्रोग्रभीषणम् ।
english: CHAPTER SIX 107 (These attendants are as follows): 20ŚrīkaS˜ha (A) and Ananta (Ā) along with Sūknmīśa (I) and Trimūrtika (Ī), Amarīśa (U) and Ārghīśa (Ū), Bhārabhūti (¬), Atithīśvara (­), the one called SthāSu (ŀ) as well as Hara (Ŀ), JhaS˜īśa (E) and Bhautika (Ai), Sadyojāta (O), Anugrahīśa (Au), followed by A‰kurīśa (¤),21 Mahāsena (Ö) and Krodhīśa (Ka), CaSÆīśa (Kha) and PracaSÆarā˜ (Ga), the one called Krūra (Gha)22 and Ekarudra (¥a), Kūrma (Ca) as well as Ekanetraka (Cha), Caturmukha (Ja) and Ajeśa (Jha),23 Śyena (na)24 along with Someśvara (µa), LāSgulin (µha) and Dārukeśa (Õa)25 together with Ardhanārīśvara (Õha), Umākānta (¦a) and ĀnāÆin (Ta),26 ÕiSÆina (Tha), Dhātrrudraka (Da), and Mīna (Dha) as well as Mena (Na) and Lohita (Pa), Śikhivāhin (Pha) along with ChagalaSÆa (Ba) as another, DviraSÆa (Bha), Mahākāla (Ma), Bālīśa (Ya) and BhujaSgama (Ra), Pinākīśa (La) and the one called KhaÆga (Va), Bakānanda (Śa)27 and Śvetaka (±a), Lakulin (Sa), Bhrgu (Ha) the lord of the gods and then Saˆvartaka (K±a). (14-20) Such are the fifty Rudras who are ever intent on attending (on the goddess). Similarly, there are another seven deities who are (her) good main (sumūla) attendants (praticāraka).28 All of them are subject to (the goddess's) Command and are intent on worshipping the goddess's feet. (21-22ab) The Three Trees, Vellakas and Attendants Again, there are said to be three trees and the triad of Vellakas.29 (22cd) The female servants are Khararā, Gararā and Rarā. (The male ones are) Kubera, Khagama and the attendant Karbura. All of them are subject to the (the goddess's) Command and are themselves other Bhairavas. (While), the other attendants namely, gods, celestial musicians, (heavenly) women, yogis, Yoginīs and heroes are innumerable. (23-25ab) Karavīra - the Cremation Ground Due to the conjunction (of all these beings) in this way in due order the sacred seat is called Udyāna.30 While the cremation ground is Karavīra (so called because many) Kara flowers grow (there) (karapunpairadhin˜hita).31 The circle of Rudras there is called (the congregation of) Ka‰kālabhairava.32 (25cd-26) It is terrible (raudra), most terrible. (Full of) vicious and ferocious animals, it is intensely frightening. It always protects the devotees, (but) kills the fettered in a moment. (27)

sanskrit: 108 कुमारिकाखण्डः भक्तानां रक्षते“ नित्यं पशूनां मारयेत् क्षणात् ।। २७ ।। १०० श्मशानपालकस्तत्र” नाम्ना योगेश्वर : कुले । एवं पीठमिदं प्रोक्तं त्रिप्रकारान्तरस्थितम् ।। २८ ।। १०२ निरालम्बा स्थिता ं मुद्रा बन्ध यस्या न विद्यते । सा मुद्रा मोक्षदातारी पीठमध्ये प्रकल्पिता ।। २९ ।। प्रकटा सा चन्द्राकारे पीठाम्बा सह संयुता । पीठेशी भवते तस्मिन् खेचरी नामनामतः ।। ३० ।। देवी तत्र खगेशी च कुब्जिकानामविश्रुता । ११० तथा चोडीशसिद्धस्तु” शेषान्ये प्रतिचारकाः ।। ३१ ।। एवं सिद्धिकर” प्रोक्तं ओडियान” विनिर्गतम् । दिव्यवर्षशतास्त्रीणि १३ देवी तत्र व्यवस्थिता ॥ ३२ ॥ ।। भरिता भैरवानन्दा शिवमार्गे? च खेगता' । ११८ ११६ ऋषयो” विंशतिस्तत्र त्वरिताश्च समागताः ।। ३३ ।। आज्ञामुपार्जनार्थीय सद्भक्ताश्च विचक्षणाः । १२० १२१ द्वादशाब्दैरतीतैस्तु” सिद्धनाथेन” दीक्षिताः ।। ३४ ॥ कश्यपश्चैव २४ मार्कण्डो वशिष्ठो गोतमस्तथा' । १२६ १२७ १२५ माण्डव: शम्भुः संवर्त आपस्तम्बः' पराशरः ।। ३५ ।। याज्ञवल्क्यस्तथा व्यासो दुर्वास आसुरी तथा । १३० हारीतो नीलकण्ठश्च विश्वामित्रो धनुर्धरः ॥ ३६ ॥ १३१ ।। ऋषिशृङ्गः” शक्तिपुत्रो दक्ष ३ च ४ विंशम ३५ विदुः । दक्ष । १३७ १३८ ज्येष्ठपीठावतारोऽय३६ ॐकार प्रथम स्मृतम् ।। ३७ ।। अथ द्वितीयकं वक्ष्ये भगदक्षिणतः” स्थितम् । तत्रैवोत्तरमार्गस्थं वीरक्षेत्रं तु नामतः ।। ३८ ।
english: CHAPTER SIX 109 The guardian of the cremation ground there who belongs to the Kula is called Yogeśvara. In this way, this sacred seat is said to be located within (the triangular section of the maSÆala) consisting of three parts (triprakāra).33 (28) Khecarī - the Gesture The Gesture that is not made (with the hands) (bandha) and abides (perpetually self-established) without support (nirālambā) bestows liberation. Conceived (prakalpitā) in the centre of the sacred seat, she is clearly manifest (praka˜ā) in the Moon's form and is linked with the mother of the sacred seat. Within that (seat) resides the mistress of the sacred seat called Khecarī.34 (29-30) The Goddess and God of the Sacred Seat There the goddess is Khageśī, well known by the name of Kubjikā. Similarly, the Siddha UÆīśa35 (resides there)36 and all the others (who) are (their) attendants. In this way, (the sacred seat of) OÆiyāna, which is said to bring about accomplishment, has emerged. The goddess resided there for three hundred divine years. Full (bharitā) (of energy), she is Bhairava's bliss and has taken flight (khegatā) on Śiva's Path.37 (31-33ab) The Twenty Sages There are twenty sages (rni) there, true devotees and wise. They came in haste to earn the Command and after twelve years were initiated by Siddhanātha.38 (These sages are) 1) Kaśyapa and 2) MārkaSÆa, 3) Vaśin˜ha as well as 4) Gotama, 5) MāSÆava, 6) Śambhu, 7) Saˆvarta, 8) Āpastamba, 9) Parāśara, 10) Yājñavalkya and 11) Vyāsa, 12) Durvāsa and 13) Āsurī, 14) Hārīta and 15) NīlakaS˜ha, 16) Viśvāmitra, 17) Dhanurdhara, 18) ¬niśrSga, 19) Śaktiputra and (the wise) know that Dakna is the twentieth.39 (33cd-37ab) This is the descent of the eldest (jyen˜ha) sacred seat. It is the first and is said to be Oˆkāra. (37cd) Jālandhara Now I will tell (you about) the second (sacred seat), located on the right of the Yoni (bhagadakniSataƒ).40 There, on the path to the north (of that is the place) called the Heroes' Field (vīraknetra). (38)

sanskrit: 110 कुमारिकाखण्डः ॐ कारे या स्मृता देवी खगेशी नाम वत्सला । सा एवान्यस्वरूपेण प्रविशेत् तत्र योगवित् ।। ३९ ॥ चामुण्डा रक्तरूपेण च्छायायां बिल्ववृक्षके । योगारूढा स्थिता तस्मिन् कुमारीसप्तभिर्वृता ॥ ४० ॥ एवं कौमाररूपेण चर्यावस्थागत : १४२ प्रिय ४३ । १४४ १४७ प्रविष्टो भैरव : १४५ सिद्धों देव्यापादाग्रतो भुवि ॥ ४१ ॥ •९४८ कृतं मण्डलकं दिव्यं यदुक्तं पश्चिमान्वये । १५० पूजिता: ४ पीठदेव्यस्तु स्वशरीरं निवेदितम् ।। ४२ ।। कृत्वा दण्डनमस्कार“ अश्रुपूर्णः १५२ क्षमापयेत् ३ । तस्य तुष्टा तु सा देवी सिद्धसंज्ञा ४ ददेच्छुभाम् ॥ ४३ ॥ चर्यादेवेश उत्तिष्ठ तवाज्ञा स्फुरते स्वयं । १५७ १५८ चर्याीयुक्तमभूत् तत्र श्रद्धवान् तु शुचिव्रतः ।। ४४ ।। य ५९ स्थान ६० पश्यते १ सौम्यं क्रीडते तत्र नित्यशः । १६२ १६३ एवं ते‍ वीराः पञ्चाशत् सन्त्रस्तास्तत्र चागताः ।। ४५ ।। वीरमार्गे ६६ यदारूढास्तेन वीराः स्मृता भुवि । गतास्ते सर्वऽवैकल्य देव्यापादार्चने रताः ।। ४६ ।। १७० १७१ पूजिता तै: समस्तैश्च पञ्चाशैर्वीरनायकैः । १७३ स्तुवन्ति २ संमताः सर्वे वीरक्षेत्रे पृथक् पृथक् ।। ४७ ।। वरं ददाति सा तुष्टा सर्वेषां वीरनायिका' १७६ १७५ । जरामरणनिर्मुक्ता विचरध्व यथासुखम् ॥ ४८ ॥ प्रतिचर्याीरता: सर्वे आज्ञाश्रवणतत्पराः ।
english: CHAPTER SIX 111 Bhairava worships the Goddess in the Shade of the Bilva Tree The goddess said to (reside) in the (sacred seat of the) syllable O¤ is the beloved called Khageśī. It is she, O knower of Yoga, who enters therein (assuming a) different nature.41 (39) Established in Yoga she resides therein, red in colour,42 as CāmuSÆā43 in the shade of a bilva tree surrounded by seven virgins.44 (40) In the same way Bhairava, the accomplished one (siddha), absorbed in the state of Kaula practice (caryāvasthā) entered (there), O beloved, into the world before the goddess's feet in the form of a youth (kumāra).45 (41) Once fashioned the divine maSÆala46 as explained in the Western Tradition, worshipped the goddesses of the sacred seats and offered his own body, he made a full prostration and, his (eyes) full of tears (pleaded): "Be gracious." Pleased with him, the goddess bestowed upon him the auspicious title of 'Siddha'. (42-43) "Rise Caryādeveśa," (the goddess said) "your Command shines radiantly (spontaneously) by itself!" (Upon hearing these words) he who possessed faith and (observed) the vow of purity, applied (himself) to Kaula practice (caryā) there (and then)47 and played (care free) at all times there in whatever beautiful (saumya) place he saw. (44-45ab) The Fifty Heroes Thus, those fifty heroes arrived there in fear. They are called `heroes' (here in this) world because they are on the Heroes' Path (vīramārga).48 (45cd-46ab) Dedicated to the worship of the goddess's feet, they all attained (a state) free of imperfection. (She was) worshipped by all those fifty leaders of heroes and all being of the same view praised (her) individually in the Heroes' Field.49 (46cd-47) The mistress of the heroes was satisfied and gave them all a boon (saying): "Wander (wherever you like) as you please, free of old age and death."50 All of them are devoted to (her) service and intent on hearing the (divine) Command. (48-49ab)

sanskrit: 112 कुमारिकाखण्डः •९७८ ८० कमण्डलु नट धूर्त सोम टङ्कटशूलिनम् ॥ ४९ ॥ १८३ मुण्डधारी स्फुलिङ्गं च त्राणं वीर्यं सुरार्चितम् । दर्पणममर८५ लोड जीवं सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरम् ॥ ५० ॥ शिवोत्तमं महारावं नन्दिवीर कपर्दिनम् । सोमेश्वरं तथा शम्भु एकनेत्रं वृषध्वजम् ॥ ५१ ॥ मातङ्गं चन्द्रनाग° च मोहनं कमलेश्वरम् । १९४ डम्बर ३ लोहितं धूम्रं कामदं घोरदंष्ट्रिणम् ॥ ५२ ॥ •१९६ संवरं शर्वर चन्द्रं अट्टहास कपीश्वरम् १९७ । दीर्घतनु महाराव भृङ्गिरावं वृकोदरम् ॥ ५३ ॥ मर्कटं लम्बकर्णं च जीमूतं मेघनिस्वनम् २०० दामोदरं करालं च महोदधिस्तथानेकम् ॥ ५४ ॥ वीरसिद्धिप्रभावेण वीराः पञ्चाशत् सिद्धिदाः २०२ २०३ वेश्या मुण्डिनि कैवर्ती त्रयेते प्रतिचारिका: । २०६ ॥ ५५ ॥ लोलादेवी विचित्रा च भाभूती च तृतीयका । वेश्यादित्रिकसंज्ञा ८ च ९ परिकर्मे व्यवस्थिताः ।। ५६ ।। २०८ २१३ परिचारास्त्रयः ११ पुंसाः १२ स्वनामेन पृथक् पृथक् । •२१४ । कल्लोलं कृकरं चैव कामेश्वर तृतीयकम् ।। ५७ ।। २१७ तथान्यं १५ सिद्धनाथ १६ च सर्वेषां प्रभुरीश्वरम् । २१८ शेषाश्चैव समाख्याता” ” द्वारे तिष्ठन्ति किङ्कराः ॥ ५८ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIX 113 (These heroes are as follows): KamaSÆalu (Ascetic's Pot) (A), Na˜a (Shore) (Ā), Dhūrta (Wicked One) (I), Soma (Moon) (Ī), µa‰ka˜a (Axe) (U), Śūlin (Spear Bearer) (Ū), MuSÆadhārin (Wearing a Garland of Heads) (¬) and Sphuli‰ga (Spark) (­), TrāSa (Salvation) (ŀ), Vīrya (Bravery) (Ŀ), Surārcita (Worshiped by the gods) (E), DarpaSa (Mirror) (Ai), Amara (Immortal) (O), LoÆa (Mad) (Au), Jīva (Living Being) (¤), SarvāSgasundara (Beautiful in all Limbs) (Ö), Śivottama (Excellent Śiva) (Ka), Mahārāva (Great Sound) (Kha), Nandivīra (Bull Hero) (Ga), Kapardin (Dredlock) (Gha), Someśvara (Lord of the Moon) (¥a) and Śambhu (Ca), Ekanetra (One-eyed) (Cha), Vrnadhvaja (Bull-bannered) (Ja), MātaSga (Elephant) (Jha) and Candranāga (Moon Snake) (na), Mohana (Charming) (µa), Kamaleśvara (Lord of the Lotus) (µha), Õambara (Clatter) (Õa), Lohita (Red) (Õha), Dhūmra (Smoke) (¦a), Kāmada (Bestower of Desires) (Ta), Ghoradaˆn˜rin (Terrible Fanged) (Tha), Saˆvara (Pledge) (Da), Śarvara (Dha), Candra (Moon) (Na), A˜˜ahāsa (Loud Laugh) (Pa), Kapīśvara (Lord of the Monkeys) (Pha), Dīrghatanu (Long Bodied) (Ba), Mahārāva (Great Sound) (Bha), BhrSgirāva (Bee-sound) (Ma), Vrkodara (Wolf Belly) (Ya), Marka˜a (Ape) (Ra), LambakarSa (Long Ear) (La), Jīmūta (Lightening) (Va), Meghanisvana (Cloud Sound) (Śa), Dāmodara (±a) and Karāla (Big Teeth) (Sa), Mahodadhi (Ocean) (Ha) and Aneka (Many) (K±a). (These) are the fifty heroes who, by the power of the hero's accomplishment (vīrasiddhi), bestow accomplishment. (49cd-55ab) The Six Female Attendants These three namely, Veśyā (the Prostitute), MuSÆinī (Skull-bearer) and Kaivartī (Fisherwoman) are the female attendants (praticārikā).51 (55cd) The goddess Lolā (Lustful), Vicitrā (Peculiar) and Bhābhūtī (Wealth of Light), the third, along with the triad beginning with Veśyā (the Prostitute) are engaged in service.52 (56) The Three Male Servants The servants are three men each with (his own) separate name: Kallola (Wave), Krkara (Crane) and Kāmeśvara (Lord of Passion), the third.53 (57) In the same way Siddhanātha is another one. He is the lord and master of them all. The rest have been named. They are the servants that stand at the door. (58)

sanskrit: 114 कुमारिकाखण्ड: एवं दक्षिणपीठं तु ओड्डियाणाद् विनिर्गतम् । • २२१ २२३ २२४ श्मशानं तत्र चोद्यान लकुट नाम भीषणम् ॥ ५९ ॥ योगिचक्रं स्थितं तत्र दिव्ययोगिनिसंयुतम् । २२५ श्मशानपालकस्तत्र च्छिन्नमुण्डकपालधृक् ।। ६० ।। क्षुरधारैव२६ तत् तीव्रं विषमं कौलगोचरम् । २२७ २२८ । मारयेत् क्षणमात्रेण मूढानां नामधारकम् ।। ६१ ।। २३१ विश्वास२२९ नैव२३॰ हन्तव्यं पीठे जालन्धरे शुभे २ । २३३ । दर्पं तत्र न कर्तव्यं यदि साक्षात् सदाशिवः ।। ६२ ।। २३६ ईदृग् जालन्धर२३४ पीठ ३५ जालाव्वा तत्र विश्रुता । २३७ । कराला संस्थिता मुद्रा पीठच्छाया च रक्तजा ।। ६३ ।। रक्तश्चापि े“ पुनः सिद्धः वीरैः सुरवरार्चितः । -२३९ पुष्पसंज्ञ भवेत् पीठं कुमारो नामनामतः ।। ६४ ॥ २४० २४१ २४२ २४३ २४४ शावरेण तु रूपेण तत्र सा शवरी स्मृता । सिद्धयोगिनिनामा २४५ च चर्यासिद्धं महाबलम् शेषान्ये२४७ परिचाराश्च क्रियामार्गेष्वनुक्रमात् २४६ २४८ । ॥ ६५ ॥ दिव्यवर्षशतार्थे च संस्थिता परमेश्वरी ।। ६६ ॥ बहुरूपधरात्युग्रा उत्पतेत् गगनान्तरे १५१ । २५१ ।
english: CHAPTER SIX 115 The Southern Seat (DakniSapī˜ha)54 has emerged from OÆÆiyāSa in this way.55 (59ab) Laku˜a - The Cremation Ground There is a garden there and a frightening cremation ground called Laku˜a (Cudgel). A circle of yogis resides there along with divine Yoginīs. The guardian of the cremation ground there carries the skull of a severed head. (59cd-60) That (cremation ground) is the domain of Kaula (kaulagocara), dangerous and sharp as a razor's edge, it kills fools and the hypocrite in a moment. (61) One should never betray (someone's) trust in (this) sacred seat, that is, in auspicious Jālandhara. If one is (indeed) Sadāśiva directly apparent there, then one should not be proud (in that sacred place).56 (62) The Three Gestures Such is Jālandhara, the sacred seat, the mother (avvā) Jālā is famous there. The gesture present (there) is (called) Karālā (and along with her are the goddesses) Pī˜hacchāyā (Shade of the Sacred Seat) and Raktajā (Born from Blood). (63) The Yogi and the Yoginī Again, the accomplished yogi (siddha) (who resides there) along with the heroes is red and is worshipped by the best of the gods. The sacred seat is called `the Flower'. 57 Śavarī is said (to reside) there along with (the god) whose form is that of a (tribal) Śāvara and named Kumāra (the Youth).58 (Her) name is Siddhayoginī and Caryāsiddha,59 immensely powerful (resides there along with her). (64-65) The remaining (residents) are attendants who are, in due order, on the paths of (ritual) action. The Supreme Goddess (resided) there for one hundred and fifty divine years.60 (Then) extremely fierce and possessing many forms, she flew up into the Sky.61 (66-67ab)

sanskrit: 116 कुमारिकाखण्डः २५५ ।। ६७ ।। ऋषयो २५३ द्वादशस्तत्र ५४ आज्ञार्थिन उपागताः पूर्वाब्दैरतीतैश्च सिद्धनाथेन दीक्षिताः । प्राणत्यागेन सद्भक्ता अन्वये सिद्धिभाजनाः ।। ६८ ।। २५८ २५९ .२६० कपिलश्चैव २५७ वाल्मीक: वाल्मीकः भृगुः श्रीवत्सभृङ्गिराट् ' २६२ २६३ ऋषभस्तिमिरश्चैव” गालवः सूर्यरश्मयः ॥ ६९ ॥ कुमारश्चन्द्रमा ज्योति: २४ शक्रश्चैव तु द्वादशः । २६५ २६६ एवं त्रेतायुगे प्रोक्तं दक्षपीठावतारकम् ।। ७० ।। ओडियाणाद्” विनिष्क्रान्तं द्वितीयं पीठनायकम् २६८ २७० अथ तृतीयकं वक्ष्ये यथा भवति तच्छृणु क्वचिद् देश१७२ तथा रम्यं देशानामुत्तमो २७४ २७५ दिशां दक्षिणदिग्भागे दक्षिणापथमण्डले २७६ २६९ ।। ७१ ।। निधिः । । ।। ७२ ।। तत्रैव चोत्तमा लोका भक्तिवन्तो दृढव्रताः । एतद्देशे २७ महादेशे २७८ अस्ति वै भैरवाश्रमम् ॥ ७३ ॥ भैरवामृतसंपूर्ण गिरौ मध्ये विराजते । २८० पूर्वैव संस्थितो देवो विमलार्थप्रबोधकः ॥ ७४ ॥ पञ्चाशद् भैरवास्तत्र क्रीडयन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः । आगता भक्तितत्पराः ।। ७५ ।। क्रीडयन्ति महायाने २२ अमृतेन तु पूरिताः २८४ २८३ । पूर्णचन्द्रावलोकेन शवरी ५ दिव्यरूपिणी ।। ७६ ।। समत्वात् सर्वभूतानां समरी तेन चोच्यते २८८ २८९ २९० २८७ । कला पूर्णोदिता भूत्वा पातालाच्च” समुत्थिता ।। ७७ ।। पीतवणी सुशोभाढ्या दिव्यमालास्वलंकृता २९२–२९३
english: CHAPTER SIX 117 The Twelve Sages There are twelve sages there who have come desirous of (the goddess's divine) Command. Initiated by Siddhanātha in the previous years (they became) true devotees by abandoning their lives and, within the tradition (anvaya), they are accomplished (siddhibhājana). (67cd-68) Kapila and Vālmīka, Bhrgu, Śrīvatsa, BhrSgirā˜, ¬nabha, Timira and Gālava - (these are like) the rays of the sun (along with) Kumāra, Candramas, Jyoti and Śukra, the twelfth. (69-70ab) Such is said to be the one who has brought down the sacred seat (into this world) which is on the right (dakna)62 during the Tretā Age. He, the second leader of a sacred seat, came forth from OÆiyāSa.63 (70cd-71ab) PūrSagiri Now I will explain the third. Listen to how it is. There is a country somewhere that is so beautiful that it is the most excellent treasure of (all) countries. The direction (in which it lies) is in the southern quarter, in the region of the Deccan (dakniSāpathamaSÆala).64 (71cd-72) The best of people, devout and of firm vows, (live) there. Located in that country, in that great country, is Bhairava's hermitage. (73) Completely full (saˆpūrSa) of Bhairava's nectar, it radiates (beautifully) in the midst of the mountain (giri).65 And the deity (deva) who awakens to the pure reality resides (there) in front of it. (74) Fifty Bhairavas play there repeatedly. * * * * They came (here) intent on devotion and filled with the nectar (of bliss) play on the great path (mahāyāna) (of manifestation).66 (75-76ab) Samarikā - the Goddess of the Sacred Seat Śavarī (who resides there) is divine by virtue of (her) gaze (which is) the Full Moon. (She is the essential) equality (samatva) of all beings (within which she is equally present) and so she is said to be Samarī, the energy which, fully active (pūrSoditā), has arisen out of the netherworld (pātāla).67 Yellow68 and very beautiful, she is adorned with a divine garland. (76cd-78ab)

sanskrit: 118 कुमारिकाखण्डः २९४ २९५ -२९६ २९७ तत्राश्रमे स्थिरं चित्तं कृतं निश्चलभावना' ।। ७८ ।। तेन निश्चलमाख्यातं भैरवस्याक्षचिञ्चिणी । २९८ एवं समरिका नाम स्थिता परमवासना ।। ७९ ।। कुलजासप्तभिर्युक्ता”” अष्टमी तु शिवात्मिका । ३०० ३०३ ३०१ एवं ज्ञात्वा तु सिद्धोऽसौ प्रविष्टः पीतविग्रहः ।। ८० ।। अदृष्टविग्रहो जातो २ गत े ३ पादाग्रभूतले । मण्डलोत्थापित॰॰ भक्त्या यथोक्तं कुलशासने ॥ ८१ ॥ कृता पूजा यथा चोक्ता पश्चिमे योगिनीगृहे । ३०६ ३०७ स्तुवते तु नमस्कारैर्विविधै रतिविग्रहः ।। ८२ ।। शक्त्युच्छालस्वरूपेण प्लवते च मुहुर्मुहुः । कृतं दण्डनमस्कार“ तोषिता तेन भैरवी ॥ ८३ ॥ संतुष्टा ददते आज्ञा वीरचक्रे व्रज स्वयम् । आहरस्व” महाफल्गु वीरचक्रात् सुरेश्वर ” ” ॥ ८४ ॥ •३१३ ३१२ ।। एव श्रुत्वा गतः सिद्धस्तत्रैवान्तरतं क्वचित्” । ३१५ ३१६ प्रविष्टो वीरचक्रे तु भूचरीणां तु मध्यतः ॥ ८५ ॥ आमिषार्थी”” स्थितस्तस्मिन् अहोरात्रञ्च पञ्चकम् । ततोऽभ्यन्तरसंस्थैश्च”” विज्ञप्तमामिषार्थिनम् तच्चक्रं क्षोभितं” तस्य महाक्षोभमजायत ३२० ३२२ चक्रस्थैर्वहितः २३ सिद्धो २४ मथित्वा १२५ घटके । ।। ८६ ।। मथित्वा१५ घटके“ कृतः ।। ८७ ।। विक्षेप७ मध्यतः क्षिप्तं व्योममुद्रासुमुद्रितम्' ३३० ३२८ । पञ्चरात्रस्थितं यावत् तिष्ठते” घटकान्तरे ।। ८८ ।
english: CHAPTER SIX 119 By means of (her) unmoving (niścala) contemplation, (she) has made the mind firm there in (that) hermitage and so it is called unmoving (niścala).69 (78cd-79a) In this way, Bhairava's (consort, the goddess) AknaciñciSī (CiñciSī of the Letters), called Samarikā abides in the supreme abode (paramavāsanā)70 and is associated with the seven (energies) born from Kula71 while the eighth is (herself who is) Śivā by nature.72 (79bcd-80ab) Bhairava’s Initiation Once known (all things) thus, he (Bhairava) the accomplished one (siddha), whose form is yellow,73 entered (therein). He became invisible and went to a piece of ground in front of (the goddess’s) feet (where he) generated (utthāpita) the maSÆala74 with devotion as taught in the Kula teachings. (80cd-81) Once the rite of adoration (pūjā) had been performed as taught in the western Yoginī’s House,75 he whose form is sexual pleasure (rati)76 praised (the goddess) with many kinds of salutation and, by means of the outpouring of the energy (of KuSÆalinī) (śaktyucchāla), flew up repeatedly (into the expanse of the transcendent).77 Having prostrated fully, (the goddess) Bhairavī was satisfied by that.78 (82-83) Pleased, (the goddess) gave (him the following) Command (ājñā):79 "Go by yourself (svayam) to the Assembly of the Heroes (vīracakra)80 and take the Great Meat (mahāphalgu),81 O lord of the gods, from (that) Assembly of Heroes." (84) Having heard this, the accomplished one, disappeared somewhere there itself. He entered the Assembly of the Heroes and abided in the midst of the Bhūcarī (Earth Wandering Yoginīs) for five days and nights desirous of meat. (85-86ab) Then, he who desired meat was reported (vijñapta) by those within (the Assembly) and that Assembly was aroused (knubhita) and he became greatly aroused.82 (86cd-87ab) The accomplished one was massaged (vahita)83 by the members of the Assembly (cakrastha) and having churned (his genitals) he was placed in a small jar. The ejaculated (sperm) (viknepa) was emitted (knipta) in the middle (of the Assembly)84 and, well sealed by the Gesture of Space (vyomamudrā), stood in (that) small jar for five nights.85 (87cd-88)

sanskrit: 120 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३३२ देव्यायाज्ञाप्रभावेन घटं स्फोटय विनिर्गतः |३३३ क्षणार्धं तिष्ठते तत्र गृह्णते आमिषं ततः ३३९ ३३६ ।। ८९ ।।३३७ ३४० तच्चक्रं त्रसितं३८ तस्य छल” कृत्वा गतः स्वयम् । प्राप्ते४१ देव्याश्रमस्थाने पादाब्जं च नमस्करेत् ।। ९० ।। दृष्ट्वा तं भैरवानन्दं हृष्टा वदति भैरवी । द्वितीयद्रव्यमानीत४३ योगिचक्रात् सुरेश्वर ।। ९९ त्रितत्त्वयोगयुक्तानां' प्रत्ययं५ ते कृतं महत् । ।। । श्रुत्वा हृष्टमनो भूत्वा विज्ञपेद् योगिमण्डलम् ।। ९२ ।। गतोऽहं युष्मदाज्ञातः४९ खेचरीचक्रमेलके । ३५० ३५१ तस्मिन् चक्रे प्रविष्टोऽहं विज्ञप्तमामिषार्थिनम् ।। ९३ ।। श्रुत्वैवं चक्रसंस्थैस्तु क्षोभाविष्टैर्महाबलैः । ३५३ ३५२ मथित्वा तु अहं क्षिप्तो मद्यकुम्भान्तरे ततः ।। ९४ ।। विक्षेप कुम्भमध्ये तु पञ्चरात्रावधिस्थितम् ३५८ ३५६ । ततो ५७ आज्ञाबलेनैव देव्यापादाग्रस्मरणात् ॥ ९५ ॥ तं५९ घटं स्फोटयित्वा तु निर्गतोऽहं च्छलेन तु । •३६१ ३६० । एवं श्रुत्वा तदा तुष्टा पुनराज्ञा ददेच्छुभाम् ।। ९६ ।। नाम दत्तं ६२ महारत्नं षष्ठदेवं महागुरुम् ३६३ । प्रतिचारा: ३६४ स्थितास्तत्र योगचिन्तासमन्विताः ।। ९७ ।। भैरवास्तत्र पञ्चाशत् पूर्णगिय समागताः । •३६५ तेन ६६ तद् भैरव क्षेत्रं भैरवीसिद्धिदायकम् ।। ९८ ॥ आगतास्तत्र ते सर्वे देव्यापादार्चने ३६८ रताः ।
english: CHAPTER SIX 121 (Then) by the power of the goddess’s Command, (the god) burst apart the jar and emerged out of it. (The accomplished one) stood there (barely) half a moment and then took the meat. The Assembly was overcome with fear (while Bhairava), having played his trick (chala),86 left of his own accord (svayam). (89ab-90ab) When he reached the place where the goddess's hermitage is located, he saluted (her) lotus feet. When Bhairavī saw him, (the embodiment of) Bhairava's bliss,87 overjoyed, said: "O lord of the gods, you have brought (meat) the second (sacrificial) substance from the Assembly of Yogis. In this way (you have) engendered a great sign of attainment (pratyaya) for those engaged in the Yoga of the Three Principles (tritattvayoga)".88 (90cd-92ab) Upon hearing (these words) (the god) was delighted and told (the goddess about) the Assembly (maSÆala) of Yogis: "Commanded by you, I went (there) to the meeting of the Assembly of Skyfarers (khecarīcakramelaka). (92cd-93ab) I entered that Assembly (cakra) and I was reported to be one who desired (the sacrificial) meat. Having heard this, those powerful beings present in the Assembly, penetrated by (a state of) arousal, churned (me) and having done so I was then cast (knipta) into a wine jar. (93cd-94) The ejaculated (seed) (viknepa) stood within the jar for five complete nights. Then, by the power of (the divine) Command (evoked) by the recollection of the fore part of the goddess's feet, I burst apart the jar and got out by means of (this) trick (chala)."89 (95-96ab) Then, when (the goddess) had heard this, she was satisfied and gave the great teacher another auspicious Command that is, she told (him his initiatory) name, (which is) ±an˜hadeva, the great jewel. (96cd-97ab) The Fifty Bhairavas There, in that place, are attendants endowed with the contemplation of Yoga (yogacintā). Fifty Bhairavas have come there to PūrSagiryā. (97cd-98ab) Therefore, that is Bhairava's field which bestows Bhairavī's accomplishment. All of those who have come there are devoted to the worship of the goddess's feet. (98cd-99ab)

sanskrit: 122 पञ्चोपचारपूजायां अलिफल्गुसमायुतैः कुमारिकाखण्डः ।। ९९ ।। । पूजिता पीठदेव्या २ च स्तुतिस्तोत्रैरनेकधा ३७४ असिताङ्गः सिताङ्गश्च कापाली भृकुटी कृतः •३७६ क्रोधं चैव तथोन्मत्तं करालं भीषणं विदुः । ३७७ ३७५ ।। १०० ।। महेश्वरं महाकायं अट्टहासं च तुम्बुरुम् ।। १०१ ।। महाकायं नृसिंहश्च' विजयं पशुपतिस्तथा । ३८० खट्वाङ्गी डामर” टङ्कं चण्डीशं च प्रचण्डवान् ॥ १०२ ॥ • ३८१ -३८२ मुण्डधारी शिवं शम्भु उड्डा डामरं तथा । अर्धनारी वृद्ध ३ शुक्रं कालं चण्डं कुलेश्वरम् ॥ १०३ ॥ लम्बोष्ठं घर्घरं घोरं कालदंष्ट्रोग्ररूपिणम् । भीमनासं३८५ वज्रकायं कौलीशं गोवृषध्वजम् ॥। १०४ ।। रक्ताम्बरधरं शूली व्यग्रोग्रं पिङ्गलं भृगुः । त्रैलोक्यभासुरं चैव एवं पञ्चाशद् भैरवाः ।। १०५ ॥ ३८८ कथिताश्चानुपूर्वेण सिद्धिदाः स्मरिताः“ सदा । ३९० । ।। श्रीपूर्वीन् भाषयेत् सर्वान् पूजितव्या: ” प्रयत्नतः ।। १०६ ।। सर्वे आज्ञाविधेयाश्च देव्याः पदाब्जपूजकाः ३९१ । प्रतिचारास्ते विज्ञेयाः९२ पूर्णगियीं महायशाः ।। १०७ ।। ३९५ ३९६ कुलदेव्यस्तथा शम्भो खट्टिक्याद्या: १५ स्मृतास्त्रयः । ४०० त्रयेते ९७ परिचयाया“ त्रिकसंज्ञा” तथा भवेत् ॥ १०८ ॥ विजया दमना चैव महिमा च तृतीयका । त्रयेते” खट्टिक्याद्यास्तु चेल्लकास्त्रयमेव हि ।। १०९ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIX 123 The goddess of the sacred seat was worshipped many times in the rite of adoration with five offerings (pañcopacārapūjā)90 with hymns and lauds, along with meat and wine.
