(34cd-36ab) Now follows the arising of the (consonant) letters: Mahat (hanumānta) (Great — Ka), Vrnabha (Bull — Kha)22, * ? (Mahākaliyuga) (Ga), Siˆha (Lion Gha), Mātr (Mother — ¥a),23 Ha˜˜akeśvara24 (Ca), Jihmaka (k: Divyaja; g: Jihvāja) (Deceitful — Cha), Śūlarāja (King of the Spear, the god of Death — Ja), Unmatta (Ecstatic -Jha), Vīrabāhuka (Heros Arms — na), Kapāla (Skull — µa), Ja˜āhāra (Ja˜ādhārin) (Dreadlock — µha), Vāsuki (Õa), ±oÆha (±oÆaśānta) (Õha), Tadgraha (¦a), NīlakaS˜ha (Blue Throat — Ta), Parāvarta (Change — Tha), Kuvera (Ku˜hāraka) (Da), Girijātmaja (Son of the Daughter of the Mountain and Daughter of the Mountain Dha), Tāra (Saviour — Na), Dvijapati (Lord of the Twice-born — Pa), Rāva (Sound — Pha), Śakti (Ba),25 Purandara (Destroyer of the City Bha),26 Ekavīra (Ekākinīvīra) (Solitary Hero — Ma), Haya (Horse — Ya), Agnidhāman (Abode of Fire — Ra), Pārthiva (Earthen — La), Padmayoni (Womb of the Lotus Va), Mahāśa‰kha (Great Conch — Śa), Dhūmradhvaja (Smoke Flag — ±a), Srn˜ibīja (Seed of Creation — Sa), Ana‰ga (Mrgāˆgaja) (Cupid — Ha) and then Cchāyāchatra (Umbrella — K±a).27 (36cd-40ab)

sanskrit: 10 कुमारिकाखण्ड: एतद् वै मेरुप्रस्तार पूजयेत् खटिकायुतम् ॥ ४० ॥ न चात्र विस्मरेत् किञ्चिद् विद्यामार्गं समुद्धरेत् । सिंहावलोकने ४९ शम्भो संहारेण स्वरूपतः ।। ४१ ।। पीठनायक्यहं देव्या कुब्जिका नाम योगिनी । •९५२ कृषभेदेन चैवात्र अजामावासिक क्रमम् ॥ ४२ ॥ सांप्रतं हि'५३ प्रवक्ष्यामि विद्योद्धारविनिर्णयम् । आद्यं शक्तिपुरस्यैव५४ रावस्यैव तु मस्तकम् ।। ४३ ॥ द्विधाभूतैकपादश्च आद्यं वै अक्षरं शुभम् । १५५ शंखपार्थिवयोर्मध्ये पद्मयोनिः शिवालयम् ।। ४४ ।। मायायुक्तं महादेव द्वितीयमक्षरं भवेत् । आसनं चाग्निधामस्य५ कपालोध्वेन भेदितम् ।। ४५ ।। तृतीयमक्षर प्रोक्त चतुर्थं कथयामि ते । ६० अनन्तहनुमन्मध्ये देव वर्णोदय २ शुभम् ॥ ४६ ॥ आन्त३ मायासमायुक्तं उद्धरेत सुरोत्तम । षोढाद्य ४ टोध्वभिन्न तु अक्षरं पञ्चमं भवेत् ।। ४७ ।। आसनं द्विजपतेश्च कपालशिरभूषितम् । षष्ठमक्षरमाख्यातं सप्तमं चाधुना शृणु ॥ ४८ ॥
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 11 That indeed is the Meruprastāra and one should worship it along with the foundation (kha˜ikā).28 One should not forget anything here. O Śambhu, one should extract the Path (mārga) of the Vidyā in the reverse order29 as one (looks upon the prastāra with) the Gaze of a Lion.30 (40cd-41) The Extraction of Kubjikā's Thirty-two Syllable Vidyā31 I am the mistress of the sacred seat, the Yoginī called the goddess Kubjikā. (42ab) Here, according to the division of the dark (fortnight) (krnabheda), the sequence is that of the unborn New Moon.32 (42cd) Now I will explain the teaching concerning the extraction of the Vidyā. (The letter) that precedes the City of Energy (Śaktipura, Ba i.e Ca) — the head of Sound (Rāva, Pha i.e. Ca) which is (thereby) doubled and (conjoined) to the One- footed (Ekapāda, E) — is the first auspicious syllable (CCE). (43-44ab) The Womb of the Lotus (Padmayoni, Va), which is the abode of Śiva between the Conch (Śa‰kha Śa) and Earthen (La), conjoined with Māyā (I) is, O great god, the second syllable (VI). (44cd-45ab) The third syllable (¦I) is said to be the seat (āsana) of the Abode of Fire (Ra i.e. ¦a) conjoined with (the letter) above the Skull (µa i.e I). (Now) I will tell you the fourth one (KI). (45cd-46ab) (This), O god, is the auspicious arising of the letter (Ka that occurs) between the Endless (Ö) and Hanumān (Kha). O best of the gods, one should extract the end (of it) conjoined with Māyā (I). (46cd-47ab) The fifth syllable (¦I) (consists of the letter) preceded by ±oÆha (Õha i.e ¦a) and is conjoined with (the letter) above µa (i.e. I). (47cd) The seat of the Lord of Brahmins (Dvijapati, Pa i.e. Ka) is adorned with the head of the Skull (µa i.e I). I have told you the sixth syllable (KI). Now hear the seventh. (48)

sanskrit: 12 •१६७ कुमारिकाखण्ड: हराद्यं हि६ तथा पात्य ँ हयान्तेनोध्वमण्डितम् । १७० वासुकेरन्तमध्यस्थ चन्द्रोऽयं परमाक्षरम् ।। ४९ ॥ शूलहाटकयोर्मध्ये उन्मत्तान्तविभेदितम् । एकवीरकृतं शम्भो सौरमष्टाक्षरोद्धृतम् २ ।। ५० ।। द्वावेतौ चन्द्रसूर्योभौ कपालेनोध्वमण्डितौ । आज्ञा मूर्ध्नि कृताभासौ विद्याप्राकारतोरणौ ।। ५१ ॥ १७६ १७७ सिंहौघहनुमान् नाथ मायया वेष्टितं पुरम् । नवमं सर्वकामिन्या अक्षरोऽयं निपातितम् ॥ ५२ ॥ शिरो बीजमनङ्गस्य जटाहारान्तभेदितम् । अक्षरेद” तु दशमं आख्यात तव भैरव ।। ५३ ।। जटापार्थिवयोर्मध्ये अग्निधाम निपातयेत् । ऐभानुसंगत भेद्य' अक्षरैकादश भवेत् ॥ ५४ ॥ हनुमान्शिरसिंहश्च च्छायाछत्रोध्वमण्डितम् । द्वादशं वर्णमाख्यातं उन्मत्तोव त्रयोदशम् ।। ५५ ।। तस्यासनमेकवीर तद्ग्रहासनभेदितम् ' चतुर्दश समाख्यातं अक्षरं त्रिदशेश्वर' १९२ १८८ १९० । ॥ ५६ ॥ द्विजपतेः शिवस्यान्त” तारकाक्षर ” ” केवलम् । १९३ पञ्चदश ैः समाख्यातं देवदेव्या प्रकाशितम् ।। ५७ ।।
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 13 (The letter that) precedes Hara (Bha i.e Cha) should be placed in the same way, decorated by the (letter) that precedes the one that is followed by the Horse (Haya Ö i.e ¤). (The letter) in the middle is the one that is followed by Vāsuki (µa i.e. Ī). This, the Moon (Candra),33 is the supreme syllable (CHĪ¤). (49) (The first letter is) between the Spear (Śūla — Ja) and Hā˜aka (Ca i.e. Cha) and is conjoined with the (letter) followed by the Ecstatic (Unmattā Jha i.e Ā) and is completed by the Solitary Hero (Ma). O Śambhu, the eighth syllable (CHĀ¤),34 which is that of the Sun, has been extracted. (50) Both of them, namely, (the syllables of) the Sun and Moon, are decorated with (the letter) which is above with the Skull (Kapāla µa i.e. Ra). Those two archways of the ramparts of the Vidyā bear the Command (¤) on (their) head (CHRĀ¤ CHRĪ¤). (51) O lord, the city (pura)35 of Hanumān (Kha) belonging to the Current of the Lion, enveloped by Māyā (I) — this, the ninth syllable (KHI), is formed by (the goddess) who loves all (sarvakāminī).36 (52) The seed that is the head of the god of love (AnaSga Ha i.e Ma), conjoined with (the letter) that ends with the Dreadlock (Ja˜āhāra — µha i.e U). O Bhairava, I have told you this, the tenth syllable (MU). (53) One should place the Abode of Fire (Ra) between the Dreadlock (Ja˜ā µha) and the Earthen (La). It should be conjoined with the Sun (Aibha Ā), which follows after. This is the eleventh syllable (RĀ). (54) The Lion (Gha) who is on Hanumān’s head is adorned (with the letter) above the Umbrella (K±a i.e O). (This) is said to be the twelfth syllable (GHO). The thirteenth (letter) is above the Ecstatic (Unmatta Jha i.e A). (55) Its seat the Solitary Hero (Ha i.e Ma), it is conjoined with the seat of Tadgraha (¦a i.e E). (Thus), O lord of the gods, (this) is said to be the fourteenth syllable (ME). (56) The fifteenth (NA) (letter) revealed by the goddess of the gods is said to be simply the letter of the Saviour (Tāraka Na), at the end of which is Śiva, the Lord of the Twice-born (Dvijapati Pa). (57)

sanskrit: 14 ९४ कुमारिकाखण्डः । नीलकण्ठस्य षोढस्य मध्यपुरे तु तद्ग्रहम् । केवलं षोडश १९७ ख्यातं हयशीर्षं च केवलम् ॥ ५८ ॥ सप्तादश“ समाख्यातं फकाराद्य ९९ दशाष्टमम् २०० । २०४ ॥ ५९ ॥ ऐहिकाभुवि २०७ । अनुनासिकचत्वारः” सिद्धा मन्त्रस्य व्यापका : ते युगानि तु चत्वार: ०५ ते पीठा ते पीठा २०८ २०३ ततो बीजत्रयं ज्ञेय विद्याजिह्वा सुरोत्तम ।। ६० ।। हयसृष्टिगतानङ्गं पार्थिवान्तेन भेदितम् .२११ । रावणाद्येन संभिन्नं अनङ्गशिरसाहतम् ।। ६१ ।। २१२ २१३ एतद् बीजं तु रुद्रस्य एकोनविंश संख्यया । २१६ । हरपार्थिवमध्यस्थ१४ जटान्तेन १५ विभेदितम् ।। ६२ ।। कपालान्तयुतं गौयी हरानुजविभेदितम् । •२१९ २१८ एतन्मायात्मकं पिण्डं विष्णुमूर्ध्नि च विंशमम् ।। ६३ ।। शंखवीरान्तगानङ्गं जटाहाराद्यभेदितम् । २२१ अ—इमध्यगतं कूटं हरान्तेन शिराहतम् ॥ ६४ ॥ •२२२ एतद् ब्रह्माक्षरं पिण्ड११२ एकविंश२३ प्रकीर्तितम् । ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च ते २४ सिद्धाः क्रमान्विताः २२६ २२५ । २२७ ॥ ६५ ॥ एषां मूर्ध्नि स्थिता शक्तिर्माया कासनसंस्थिता । अक्षमध्यमवणीनां उदयं च समायुतम् ।। ६६ ॥ एतद् वर्णं च द्वाविंशं त्रयोविंशमकं भवेत् । २२८ सृष्टिशक्तिपुराद्य च हशिरेण समायुतम् ॥ ६७ ॥ कपालशिरसाक्रन्तं एषा चक्रतनुर्हयहम् । २३१
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 15 The single (letter) Tadgraha (¦a), which is in the compartment (pura) between Blue Throat (NīlakaS˜ha Ta) and ±oÆha (Õha), is said to be the sixteenth (¦A). The Head the Horse (Haya Ya — i.e na) alone is said to be the seventeenth (nA). The one preceded by the letter Pha (i.e ¥a) is the eighteenth (¥A). (58-59ab) The nasals (anunāsika) are the four Siddhas who pervade the mantra.37 They are the four Ages and sacred seats present here in the world.38 (59cd-60ab) Then, O best of the gods, one should know the three seed-syllables (that constitute) the Tongue of Wisdom (vidyājihvā). (60cd) Passion (Ana‰ga Ha), which is between the Horse (Ya) and Emanation (Srn˜i — Sa), is conjoined with (the letter) followed by the Earthen (La i.e Ra), (then) conjoined with (the letter) preceded by RāvaSa (O i.e. AU) and united with the head of Passion (Ha i.e. Ma). That is the seed of Rudra which, in numerical order, is the nineteenth (HRAU¤).39 (61-62ab) (The letter) between the Hara (Bha) and the Earthen (La i.e. Ha) conjoined with the (letter) that comes after the Dreadlock (µha i.e Ra), united with the (letter) followed by the Skull (µa), that is, Gaurī (Ī), conjoined with (the letter) preceding (anuja lit. younger brother) Hara (Bha i.e Ma) — this is the syllable (piSÆa) of Māyā (HRĪ¤). It is the twentieth and is on VinSu's head.40 (62cd-63) The god of love (Ha), who is between the Conch (Śa) and the Hero (na), conjoined with (the letter) preceded by the Dreadlock (µha i.e. Ra), the letter (kū˜a) between A and I (i.e. Ā), the head of which is conjoined to (the letter) followed by Hara (Bha i.e Ma). This is the syllable (aknara) of Brahmā (HRĀ¤), said to be the twenty-first syllable (piSÆa). (64-65ab) Brahmā, VinSu and Rudra — these are (all) Siddhas endowed with the transmission (krama).41 (65cd) Above them is Power (E), that is, Māyā, who is on the seat of Ka. That is the twenty-second letter (KE) conjoined with the arising of (all) the letters between A and K±a.42 (66-67a) The twenty-third is (as follows). It is (the letter) that is preceded by the compartment of the energy of emanation (Sa i.e Ba) conjoined with the (letter) above Bha and united (with the letter) above the Skull (µa i.e I). My body being made of the Wheels (cakratanu), I am this (BJI).43 (67bcd-68ab)

sanskrit: 16 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २३२ पुद्गलस्य तु पूर्वाद्यं वासुकिशिरसि स्थितम् ।। ६८ ।। चतुर्विंशमकं वर्ण मुद्रानामाभिधानकम् । आख्यातं तव सिद्ध्यर्थं श्रीनाथेन समायुतम् ।। ६९ ।। पञ्चविंशतिकं वर्णं शर - ईकारसंज्ञया २३८ । एकपदगतानङ्ग१३९ पुरं२४ शक्त्यन्तभेदितम् ।। ७० ।। २४१ त्रिषु वर्णान्तहनुमान् ” तेन युक्तमध:कृतम् । धूम्रमातरमध्यस्थ४२ युक्तं टासनमेव च ।। ७१ ।। शिरोभूषणरत्नाढ्यं तेनाक्रान्तं च पिण्डकम् । २४५ आज्ञादीप्तं कृतं कूटं षड्विंश कुलनायकम् ॥ ७२ ॥ २५० २४९ अनेन स्मरते २४६ देव २४७ भवेत् ४८ कौलस्य भाजनः आज्ञा प्रवर्तते शिष्ये आज्ञयाभ्यासनेन तु ॥ ७३ ॥ खगतिश्च न संदेहो अचिरादपि सुन्दर । २५३ एतच्चैतन्यकूटं तु षड्विधं ५२ परमेश्वर ।। ७४ ।। षड्भिः पीठैः समायुक्तं खेचरं आद्यपीठकम् । तद् यदालोकयेन्मन्त्री“४ पतते२५५ इति निश्चयम् सप्ताविंशतिलक्षैस्तु५८ जपितैश्चापि २५९ खेगति: .२६१ २५६ २६० । ।। ७५ ।।२५७ । क्रममण्डलमध्यस्थं ज्वलन्तं दीपरूपकम् ।। ७६ ।। २६२ २६३ तल्लिङ्गं तं च`२ वृक्षं च विधिना क्रमनायकम् । तस्योद्यानं ६५ सपूर्वं६६ च अग्निजलन्धरोदितः २६७ ।। ७७ ।। खाणीन्त पूर्णगिर्यं ९ च हसान्तमिति कोंकणम् । एकपादं च तिस्राख्यं सिद्ध पीठक्रमेण तु ॥ ७८ ॥ २७२ एतद् वै षड्विधं पिण्डं आश्रमं पारमेश्वरम् वै २७३ ।
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 17 The first one before the Individual Soul (pudgala), seated on Vāsuki’s (µa) head. (is) the twenty-fourth letter that denotes the Gestures (mudrā). I have told you this so (you may achieve) success along with Śrīnātha (KU). (68cd-69) The twenty-fifth letter, according to (the standard) nomenclature, (consists of) Śa, Ra and Ī (ŚRĪ). (70ab) Passion (Ha) is linked with the One-footed (E) and conjoined first at the end with Power (Sa). The last letter out of the three is Hanumān (Kha). Conjoined with that (i.e. the previous two consonants), it is placed below.44 (70cd-71ab) The (letter) between Smoke (±a) and Mother (¥a i.e Pha) is conjoined (to that) as is the seat of µa (Ra). (Finally), the seed-syllable (piSÆaka) is covered with (the letter) called the jewel that adorns the head (¤). (This) is the twenty- sixth Peak syllable — the leader of the Kula energized by the Command. (71cd-72) He who remembers the god with this (syllable) possesses Kaula (the union of Śiva and Śakti). The Command operates in the disciple and by practicing with the Command (on the body), O handsome one, certainly one quickly (achieves) flight. (73-74ab) O Supreme Lord, that is the Peak of Consciousness (caitanyakū˜a) which is sixfold. It is the Skyfarer (Khecara), the first sacred seat, conjoined with the six sacred seats.45 (74cd-75ab) Whatever the reciter of (this) mantra gazes at, that (object) falls to the ground and, having recited (this syllable) two million seven hundred thousand times, (one achieves mystic) flight. (75cd-76ab) The (reality) in the centre of the KramamaSÆala burns in the form of (the flame of) a lamp. That is the Li‰ga,46 the Tree47 and, according to the rule, the master of the Krama. (76cd-77ab) (The sacred seat) Udyāna that belongs to that (seed-syllable) is (the letter) that precedes Sa (i.e Ha). Fire (Ra) has emerged from Jālandhara. (The letter) after Kha (i.e. Pha) is PūrSagiri (Pha). Ko‰kaSa (which is Kha) comes at the end of Ha and Sa. (The sacred seat) called Tisra is the One-footed (E) and is (thus) accomplished (siddha) in accord with the sequence of the sacred seats.48 That, indeed, is the sixfold seed-syllable (piSÆa), the hermitage of the Supreme Lord. (77cd-79ab)

sanskrit: 18 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २७४ एषा सा खेचरीमुद्रा ग्रस्तं त्रैलोक्यमद्भुतम् ।। ७९ ॥ ओलित्रितयमध्ये तु एषाज्ञा कुब्जिकाक्रमे । २७५ २७७ तस्या मूर्तिरघोरा च उद्धार तु विलोमतः ।। ८० ।। जटाहाराद्यमनल तद्ग्रहाधः समन्वितम् । तद्ग्रहाधःसमन्वितम् । २७८ सप्ताविंशमक७९ वर्णं° अष्टाविंशमकं भवेत् ॥ ८१ ॥ हनुमान्शिरसिंहस्य परावतीधयोजितम्” । । गजेन्द्रस्य शिरं पात्यं नीलकण्ठेति” नामतः ।। ८२ ।। मायायुक्तमूनत्रिंशं कथितं तव सुन्दर । -२८३ त्रिंशमं कथयिष्यामि परावर्तशिरं पुनः ॥ ८३ ॥ केवलं हनुमाद्यं च एकत्रिंशं प्रकीर्तितम् । शूलस्यैवासन देव द्वात्रिंश समुदाहृतम् २८७ २८६ ।। ८४ ।। एकवीरादि–आरभ्य ँ भगान्तं यावद् भैरव । २९० आख्यातं परमं देहं बिम्बा २९ देवी नभस्थिता ॥ ८५ ॥ २९१ २९२ उद्धृता तु विलोमेन पीठान् कुर्यान्नुलोमतः १२ । एतत्”” सिंहावलोकेन सिंहवत् सिंहसंज्ञया ॥ ८६ ॥ आदिपीठेश्वरी ख्याता मुद्रात्रितयभेदिता श्रीनाथ उवाच । यदेतत् पुरवर”१५ देवि ज्वलन्तं भीमरूपिणम् २९७ ।। ८७ ।। २९८ भयावहं तु शिष्याणां अमृतीकरणं वद ।
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 19 This is the Gesture of the Skyfaring (Goddess) (khecarīmudrā) (by which) the astonishing triple world is consumed. This is the Command in the midst of the triple lineage (oli) within Kubjikā's transmission (krama). (79cd-80ab) The form (mūrti) of that (Command) is AGHORĀ and extraction (of this name is) in the reverse order. Fire (Ra), which is (the letter) preceded by the Dreadlock (Ja˜āhāra µha) is endowed with (the letter) below Tadgraha (¦a i.e. E). (This is) the twenty-seventh letter (RE). (80cd-81c) The twenty-eighth (GHO) belongs to the Lion (Gha) who is above Hanumān (Kha)49 conjoined (with the letter) below Change (Tha i.e. O). (81d-82ab) One should extract (pātya)50 the (letter) on top of the Lord of Elephants (Gajendra, Ai i.e Ta) called Blue Throat (Ta), conjoined with Māyā (I). (Thus I) have told you the twenty-ninth (TI) (syllable), O handsome one. (82cd-83ab) I will (now) tell (you) the thirtieth (VA). (It is the letter) on top of Change (Tha i.e Va). The thirty-first (GA) is said to be only (the letter) that is preceded by Hanumān (Kha i.e Ga). (83cd-84ab) The seat (āsana) of the Spear (Ja i.e Bha), O god, is said to be the thirty- second (Bha). (84cd) O Bhairava, (the letters) starting from the Solitary Hero (Bha) up to the Yoni (E) are said to be the supreme body, the goddess Bimbā who resides in the Sky (of the transcendent). (Her Vidyā) has been extracted in reverse, while the sacred seats should be fashioned in the forward order.51 (85-86ab) (Generated) by the Lion's Gaze, that (Vidyā is) like a lion; (and so, she who is) the mistress of the first sacred seat (ādipī˜ha) and is associated (bheditā) with the three gestures52 is called the Lion. (86cd-87ab) The Five PraSavas: the Kaulikī Vidyās Śrīnātha said: O goddess, this is (your) most excellent abode. Burning and terrible, it inspires fear in (your) disciples. (Now) explain the process whereby it is transformed into nectar (amrtīkaraSa).53 (87cd-88ab)

sanskrit: 20 कुमारिकाखण्ड: येन सर्वत्र शिष्याणां संपूर्णसिद्धिदा भवेत् ॥ ८८ ॥ ३०० एतत् प्रयोगमिच्छामि चान्द्रेयं करणं शुभम् । ३०१ श्रीवक्रा उवाच ३०२ अतोव संप्रदायं तु पूर्वस्यैव तु उत्तरम् ॥ ८९ ॥ श्रीनाथ त्वां प्रवक्ष्यामि अमृतीकरणं शुभम् । कृत्वादौ प्रणवाः पञ्च अन्ते तेऽपि विलोमतः ।। ९० ॥ तयोर्मध्यगता विद्या पूर्णिमा नात्र संशयः । ३०३ न चात्र विस्तरं किञ्चित् विद्यापञ्चार्णमुद्धरेत् ।। ९१ ।। ययोच्चारितमात्रया महेश्वर्यं प्रवर्तते । •३०८ ३०९ वायुवणीच्चतुर्थं तु अधस्थ यत् पुरार्चितम् ” ॥ ९२ ॥ शिखाशेखरमाक्रान्त आज्ञावर्तिसमुज्ज्वलम् । एषा कौलेश्वरी विद्या ओकारान्तविभेदिता ।। ९३ ।। एषा भगवती देवी नाम्ना सा वह्निवासिनी ३१३ । आरक्तां चिन्तयेद् देव आधारमणिमध्यतः ।। ९४ ॥ लक्षैकजपनात् सिद्धिर्महावेधः प्रवर्तते । अमृतादिचतुर्थं तु इकाराधस्तृतीयकम् ।। ९५ ।। ३१५ यान्तान्तं”४ बिन्दुनादस्थं अशिरेण शिराहतम् । । महामाया स्मृता ह्येषा त्रैलोक्यक्षोभकारिणी ।। ९६ ॥
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 21 I desire (to know) that method (prayoga), the lunar (process) by which (the Vidyā) bestows on (her) disciples complete accomplishment everywhere. (88cd-89ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: What follows is the tradition that answers (your) previous (question). Śrīnātha, I will tell you the auspicious process of transformation into nectar. (89cd-90ab) Once (one has) fashioned the Five PraSavas at the beginning and, those same (five) at the end in reverse, the Vidyā in between these two (groups) is the Full Moon. Here (about this), there is no doubt.54 (90cd-91ab) There is no (further) extension here (of this mantra) of any sort. One should (simply) extract the five syllables of the Vidyā.55 Great lordship manifests (within one's self) by the mere utterance (of the Vidyā). (91cd-92ab) Kuleśvarī Vidyā (AI¤) 56The Vidyā of Kuleśvarī (consists) of the fourth (letter) (Ai below) the letter of the Wind (Ya). It is worshipped in the City (i.e. the maSÆala) conjoined with the tip of the flame (śikhāśekhara) (¤) and burns intensely with the Wick of the Command. This is Kauleśvarī Vidyā, conjoined with the letter followed by O (Ai). This is the goddess Bhagavatī whose name is Vahnivāsinī (Dweller in the Fire).57 (92cd-94ab) O god, one should think that she is light red (and located) between the Foundation (ādhāra) and the (City of) Jewels. By reciting (this Vidyā) 100,000 times (one achieves) success (siddhi) and the Great Piercing (mahāvedha) takes place.58 (94cd-95ab) Mahāmāyā Vidyā (HRĪ¤) (It is composed of) the fourth (letter down) beginning from Nectar (A i.e. Ha)59 (combined) with the third (letter) below the letter I (Ra) and (the letter) that is followed (by the letter) followed by Ya (yāntānta) (Ī). Established in the Point and Sound, the head of (the syllable) is conjoined with that which is the head of A (¤).60 This is said to be Mahāmāyā who disturbs the triple world. (95cd-96)

sanskrit: 22 •३१७ •३१८ कुमारिकाखण्ड: वह्निं” कपिलसंकाशं चिन्तयेन्मणिपूरके ३२० ३१९ । वशीकरणमावेशं लक्षैकजपनाच्छ्रियः ॥ ९७ ॥ षवान्तं३२१ टासनारूढं२२ उशिरेण विभेदितम् । •३२४ ३२५ कलाबिन्द्वङ्कितं नाद” आज्ञामूर्ध्नि कृतान्तकम् ।। ९८ ।। एषा सा शाङ्करी देवी सर्वदुःखक्षयंकरी । हिमकुन्देन्दुसंकाशां ध्यायेद् २६ देव अनाहते ।। ९९ ॥ सकृज्जप्तेन लक्षेण कौलज्ञानं लभेन्नरः । ३३० •३३१ ऐहिकान्२८ प्राप्नुयाद्” भोगान् सौभाग्यं यशसः श्रियम् ।। १०० ।। •३३२ पानुज खरमध्यस्थं एलीनरविभेदितम् ३३६ ३३३ । इन्दुबिन्दुकलाक्रन्तं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् ।। १०१ ॥ एषा सा खेचरी विद्या श्यामा रक्ता विशुद्धगा । लक्षैकजपनात् सिद्धिमीतृलब्धवरो भवेत् ।। १०२ ।। ३३८ लघुत्वं कर्मविच्छेदं निर्गमं जालकान्तरे । ३३९ धारास्तम्भं न संदेहः”” करोत्यावेशमुत्तमम् ॥ १०३ ॥ •३४० ३४१ ३४२ यशमध्यगताकाश हबान्तं च १ लठान्तरम् । ऋशिरं ओशिरैकत्व३ बिन्दुनादखगाङ्कितम् ।। १०४ ।। एषा सा भैरवी विद्या श्वेतरक्तां विचिन्तयेत् ।
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 23 One should think of the (element) Fire, brown in colour, within the City of Jewels (maSipūraka). By reciting (this Vidyā) 100,000 times one (achieves) control (over others vaśīkaraSa), possession (āveśa)61 and (other) powers (śrī). (97-98ab) Śaˆkarī Vidyā (ŚRĪ¤) (The letter) between ±a and Va (i.e. Śa) mounted on the seat of µa (Ra), conjoined with the head of µha (Ī), (along with) Sound marked with Energy (kalā) and the Point (bindu) placed on the top of the Command at the end62 — this is the goddess Śāˆkarī who destroys all suffering. (98cd-99ab) O god, one should visualize (her) (dhyāyet), (white as) snow, the jasmine flower or the moon, in (the Wheel of) Unstruck Sound (anāhata). By reciting this 100,000 times, a man attains Kaula knowledge. He gains the benefits (bhoga) of this world, good fortune, fame and prosperity. (99cd-100) Khecarī Vidyā (KHPHRE¤) (The letter) following Pa (Pha), which is located between Kha and Ra, conjoined with the Sun that is merged in the (letter) E and pervaded by the energy of the lunar drop: hard to acquire even by the gods, this is the Vidyā of (the goddess) Khecarī. Dark blue and red, she resides in the Pure (Wheel) (viśuddha). By reciting it 100,000 times (one achieves) success (siddhi) and attains the boon of the Mothers. (101-102) It (bestows) the power to make oneself small at will (laghutva) and Karma is destroyed. (Trapped, the adept can) get out of a net or a deep ravine. (He can) check the (flow of a strong) current. Without a doubt, it induces the most excellent form of possession. (103) Bhairavī Vidyā (HSRAU-U¤) Space, which is a between Ya and Sa (Ha), (the letter) between Ha and Ba (Sa), the one between La and µha (Ra), the head of ¬ (U), at one with (the letter) after O (Au) and marked with the Point, Sound and the Skyfarer — this is the Bhairavī Vidyā.63 One should think of her as white and red. (104-105ab)

sanskrit: 24 कुमारिकाखण्ड: आज्ञास्थानशलाकाया५ लक्षैकजपनाच्छ्रियः ३४६ कृत्वा क्रोधं क्षयं याति शक्रसैन्यं न संशयः । ॥ १०५ ॥ निग्रहं चैव दुष्टानां शत्रूणां चैव ताडनम् ।। १०६ ॥ भवते नात्र संदेहो ययाराधनमात्रतः ३४८ धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ १०७ ॥ यस्त्विदं विन्दते योगी विद्यापञ्चककौलिकम् ३४९ । सोऽपि याति परे तत्त्वे ३५० यत्र गत्वा न शोचते १५१ ।। १०८ ।। वाग्भवं प्रथमं बीजं मायाबीजं द्वितीयकम् । तृतीयं च श्रियो बीजं चतुर्थं चैव खेचरम् ॥ १०९ ॥ पञ्चमं भैरवं नाम विज्ञेयाः कुलभूषणाः । ३५३ ३५४ प्रणवाः पञ्च आख्याता दीपकानि ५५ कुलक्रमे ।। ११० ।। पुनरेव हि विद्याया आदिपीठाः ५९ प्रकीर्तिताः । ३५८ ३६० प्रथमं कामरूपं तु जालपीठं द्वितीयकम् ॥ १११ ॥ पूर्णगिर्यं तृतीयं तु ओडियानं १२ चतुर्थकम्३ । •३६४ ३६५ पञ्चमं तिस्रपीठाख्यं सिद्धास्ते पुनः पञ्चभिः ।। ११२ ।। मैत्रीशं चर्यदेवं च ३६६ षष्ठीशो ३६७ ओडमेव ३६८ च । ३७० तूष्णीश” देवदेवेश सिद्धाः पञ्च क्रमेण तु ।। ११३ ।। आद्यपीठात् समारभ्य कुर्यादेव क्रमार्चनम् ३७२ ३७१ । पञ्चप्रणवसंयुक्त सिद्ध्यते नात्र संशयः ।। ११४ ।। विद्यापञ्चार्णरहितं७३ यस्तु पूजयते क्रमम् । ३७५ अक्रमस्थः स विज्ञेयो न मोक्षाय विधीयते ।। ११५ ॥
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 25 By reciting (this Vidyā) which, (sharp as) a scalpel, is (located on) the plane of the Command64 100,000 times, (one attains many) powers (śrī). (If one who recites it) is angered (he can), without a doubt, destroy (even) the army of Śakra (the king of the gods). (105cd-106ab) Merely by worshipping with this (Vidyā) the wicked are punished and enemies are struck down. There is no doubt about it. (Through it) a man attains the fruit of (the four goals of human life, namely) Dharma, prosperity (artha), conjugal love (kāma) and liberation. (106cd-107) The Five Lettered Kaulika Vidyā The yogi who acquires this fivefold Kaulikī65 Vidyā reaches the Supreme Principle where, once gone, he no (longer) grieves. (108) Vāgbhava (AI¤) is the first seed-syllable. The seed of Māyā (HRĪ¤) is the second. The third is the seed of Śrī (ŚRĪ¤). The fourth is Khecara (KHPHRE¤) and the fifth is (that of) Bhairava (HSRŪAU¤). These should be known to be the ornaments of Kula. (109-110ab) The Five PraSavas and the Five Sacred Seats The Five PraSavas, the energizers (dīpaka) in the Kula transmission (kulakrama), have been explained. Again, they are said to be the first sacred seats of the Vidyā. (110cd-111ab) The first (of these) is Kāmarūpa. The second is Jālapī˜ha (i.e. Jālandhara). The third is PūrSagiri. OÆiyāna is the fourth and the fifth is called Tisrapī˜ha. Again, they have five Siddhas (one for each seat). O lord of the gods, the five Siddhas are, in due order, Maitrīśa, Caryadeva, ±an˜hīśa, OÆa and TūnSīśa.66 (111cd-113) One should worship the Transmission (kramārcana) thus starting from the first seat in conjunction with the Five PraSavas. (In this way) one is certainly successful. One should know that he who worships the Transmission (krama) that is devoid of the five-lettered Vidyā is not established in the Transmission (and that his worship) does not make for liberation. (114-115)

sanskrit: 26 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३७७ क्रमं पञ्चाक्षरं योग क्रमविद्यार्णपञ्चकम् । •३७८ पञ्चधातुगृहं चक्रं तथात्मानं च पञ्चधा ३७९ पञ्चाक्षरमिदं न्यासं कृत्वा क्षोभोऽभिजायते । ३८० ३८१ ।। ११६ ।। ये योगिनीकुले जाता ते च विन्दन्ति पञ्चकम् ।। ११७ ।। गत्वा वै कामरूपे तु तथा जालन्धरे तु च । अपरं पूर्णगियायां गत्वा पीठे चतुर्थके तिस्राख्ये च पुनर्गत्वा ३ विद्यापञ्चकमभ्यसेत् । पूर्वक्रमेण सिद्ध्यन्ति नान्यथा वीरवन्दित ३८८ ३८६ ३८४ ।। ११८ ॥ ॥ ११९ ॥ आदौ ते पञ्च लक्षाणि ३८५ जप्तव्याः ६ साधकेन तु । संयोगाल्लक्षमेकं तु जपेद् विद्याद्यपीठके ॥ १२० ॥ साधकः सिद्धिभागी स्यात् खेगतिनात्र संशयः । ३९० ३९४ मेलाप९२ खेचरीसार्धं ९३ तत्र पीठे लभेन्नर: ।। १२१ ।। वीरसिद्धिर्महाव्याप्तिः९५ पुरक्षोभ तु इच्छया । । अणिमा९७ महिमा चैव लघिमा प्राप्तिरेव च ।। १२२ ।। प्राकाम्य चैव ईशित्वं वशीकरणमेव च । ४०० यत्र कामगतीच्छया” सिद्ध्यष्टाविह जन्मनि ।। १२३ ।। लभेदमरपदं ? योगी स्वयं रुद्रो भविष्यति । एषा पञ्चाक्षरी विद्या मुद्रापञ्चकभूषिता ।। १२४ ।। प्रथमा कुलकौले तु ज्ञातव्या क्षोभचिन्तकैः ४०४ । योनिमुद्रा तु शङ्खिन्या पद्ममुद्रा तथैव च ।। १२५ ।। कपालमुद्रा देवेश तथा वै घटसंज्ञया । ४०६ मुद्रापञ्चकनिर्मुक्तो विद्यापञ्चकवर्जितः ।। १२६ ।। नासौ अन्वयिको मन्त्री न भवेत् सिद्धिभाजनः । ४०९ जिह्वोपस्थनिमित्यर्थं“ कौलिकान् तान् ” ब्रूवन्ति ४१२ न तेषां कुलकौलोऽस्ति ? अन्यथा ? पतनं भवेत् । ये ।। १२७ ।।
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 27 The Transmission consists of the union (yoga) of the Five Syllables. The Vidyā of the Transmission is the group of five syllables. The Wheel is the House of the Five Bodily Substances (dhātu). Similarly, the Self is fivefold. Once one has executed this, the deposition (nyāsa) of the five syllables, (KuSÆalinī) is aroused (knobha).67 (116-117ab) (Only) those born into the Yoginīkula obtain the Group of Five. Once one has gone to (the five sacred seats, namely) Kāmarūpa, Jālandhara, to the other in PūrSagiri, the fourth sacred seat (i.e. OÆÆiyāna) and again to the one called Tisra, one should practice therein the Group of Five. O you who are praised by the Heroes, they achieve success by means of (this), the previous Transmission and not otherwise. (117cd-119) The adept must first repeat them 500,000 times. (Then) he should repeat them 100,000 times conjoined together in the original seat, which is the Vidyā. (In this way) the adept has siddhi and (achieves mystical) flight. Here, (concerning this), there is no doubt.68 (120-121ab) There, in (that) sacred seat, man attains union (melāpa) with (the goddess) Khecarī. At will, (he experiences) the arousal of (the energy in) the body, the Accomplishment of the Heroes, and the Great Pervasion (mahāvyāpti).69 (121cd-122ab) Here, in (this very) life, wherever (his) desire may wander, (he attains) at will the eight accomplishments.70 These are the power of atomicity (aSimā), the power of greatness (mahimā), the power of lightness (laghimā), the power of attainment (prāpti), the power of wilfulness (prākāmya), lordship (īśitva) and subjugation (of others) (vaśīkaraSa). The yogi attains the immortal abode and will be Rudra himself.71 (122cd-124ab) This is the Five-lettered (pañcāknarī) Vidyā, adorned with the five gestures. The first (of these gestures taught) in the Kulakaula that should be known by those who contemplate the arousal (of KuSÆalinī) (knobhacintaka) is the Gesture of the Yoni (yonimudrā). (The others are the Gestures of the) Conch (śa‰khinī), the Lotus (padmamudrā), Skull (kapālamudrā) along with the one called the Jar,72 O lord of the gods. (124cd-126ab) The reciter of mantra devoid of the five gestures and the fivefold Vidyā does not belong to the tradition and has no attainments (siddhi). (126cd-127ab) Those who, for (the pleasures) of the tongue and genitals, say that (people such as) these are Kaulikas do not possess the Kulakaula. On the contrary, they fall (instead to lower levels). (127cd-128ab)

sanskrit: 28 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४१३ विद्या ध्यानानि पीठानि सिद्धा मुद्राश्च पञ्चकम् ॥ १२८ ॥ एतद् वै तत्त्वतो ज्ञेयं तथा पञ्चार्णपञ्चकम् । ।। सूचितं तव सिद्धस्य गोपनीयं शरीरवत् ।। १२९ ॥ •४१४ इदं रहस्यं परमं नाख्येयं यस्य कस्यचित् । इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे १६ स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्र- संहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते मेरुप्रस्थारनिर्णये विद्या - उद्धारो नामानन्दः ।। ८ ।।
english: CHAPTER EIGHT 29 The pentad (consists of) the Vidyā, the visualizations (dhyāna), the sacred seats, the Siddhas and the gestures. This should be known as it really is and so too, the pentad of the five syllables. (128cd-129ab) What I have indicated to you, O Accomplished One, should be kept hidden, as one does the body. This supreme secret should not be told to (just) anybody. (129cd-130ab) This is the (eighth) chapter called the Extraction of the Vidyā according to the Teaching concerning the Meruprastāra. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's Command, as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: नवमानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच श्रुतं च देवदेवेशि विद्या - उद्धारमुत्तमम्' । देव्याः कूटं न मे ज्ञातं विस्तरेण मया प्रभो ॥ १ ॥ अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि इदानीं तद् वद प्रभो । श्रीवक्रा उवाच कूटमेकं गुरोर्वक्त्रात् ' ज्ञातव्यं तत् महेश्वर ।। २ ॥ न तेन रहिता सिद्धिस्तदाकर्णय सुन्दर । प्रथमं जालपीठं तु पूर्णगिर्यं द्वितीयकम् ॥ ३ ॥ o तृतीयं कोंकण प्रोक्तं कामरूपं चतुर्थकम् । पञ्चमं पीठमोंकारं षष्ठ' त्रिस्रोतनायकम् ॥ ४ ॥ १७ सालम्बास्ते” स्मृता: षड्भिः शरीरे तु विनिर्दिशेत् । निरालम्बान् तदूध्वं तु षड्भिर्वक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतम् ॥ ५ ॥ २४ इन्दुबिन्दुः” स्वयंनाथः” शक्तिरूध्वे” च” व्यापिनी । तदूवे समना ज्ञेया उन्मना वै तथोपरि ।।६॥ उभयोरपि संयोगात्” द्वादशानि” भवन्ति ते । पदार्थाीनि समूहेन अथ वक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतम् ॥ ७ ॥ ३२ ३१ ३३ तेजोरूपं तु जालाख्यं हृदये तु” हुताशनम् । ३४ दाडिमीपुष्पसंकाश कूपस्थ पूर्णगिर्यकम् ॥ ८ ॥
english: CHAPTER NINE The Consciousness of the Vidyā according to its Divisions as Full and the Rest. The Peak Syllable of the Goddess Śrīnātha said: O mistress of the god of gods, I have heard the most excellent extraction of the Vidyā (but), O lord, I have not know the Peak syllable (kū˜a) of the goddess in detail. I now wish to hear (about) it. O Lord,1 tell me that. (1-2ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O Maheśvara, the single Peak syllable should be known from the teacher's mouth.2 (There is no) accomplishment (siddhi) without it. Hear me, O handsome one! (2cd-3ab) The first is the sacred seat of Jāla (Ra).3 The second is PūrSagiri (Pha). The third is said to be Ko‰kaSa (Kha). Kāmarūpa (Sa) is the fourth. The fifth is the sacred seat of the letter O¤ (Ha) and the sixth is the Leader of the Three Currents (i.e. Tisrapī˜ha — E). (3cd-4) These six are said to be ‘with support’ (sālamba) and should be indicated within the body. Now I will now tell about the ones ‘without support’ (nirālamba) that are six. (5) (First come) the Moon and the Drop (indubindu), (followed by) the Lord Himself (svayaˆnātha);4 above is Energy (śakti) and the Pervasive One (vyāpinī). One should know that above (all) that is the Equal One (samanā) while the Transmental (unmanā) is, similarly above that. (6) 5 By conjoining the two (groups) they make twelve. Now I will tell (you what these) things (padārtha) are as a group. (7) The Six With Support 1) The (sacred seat) called Jāla is brilliant energy (tejas). (It is) the fire (that burns) in the Heart. 2) PūrSagiri, (red) like the flower of the pomegranate, is located in the pit of the throat. (8)

sanskrit: 32 कुमारिकाखण्ड: कोङ्कणं घण्टिकायां तु शरद्गगनसन्निभम् । कामाख्य तालुमध्ये तु हिमकुन्देन्दुनिर्मलम् ।। ९ ।। ३८ •४० तस्य ऊर्ध्वं तु विज्ञेयं ॐ का दर्पणप्रभम् । ब्रह्मरन्ध्रे” त्रिकोणाख्य” ऊध्ववक्त्र विचिन्तयेत् ॥ १० ॥ तप्तहेमनिभं ध्यायेत्” तिस्राख्यं पीठनायकम् । ४७ तदूव व्योमचक्रं तु आलातकसमप्रभम् ॥ ११ ॥ बिन्दुरूपं समाभ्यस्य अर्धेन्दुस्तस्य चोपरि । ज्योतिरूप” समाख्यात आदिनाथ तु मूर्धनि ॥ १२ ॥ ५४ शिवतत्त्व“ विजानीयादव्यक्तं चक्रवत् स्मरेत् । ५६ ५७ ५८ हृदयात् तु ं समारभ्य ँ यावदूध्वं हि मस्तकम् ॥ १३ ॥ तावत् कूटं समाख्यातं नवधा संव्यवस्थितम् । सुषुम्नानाडिभेदेन शनैः शनैस्तु” भेदयेत् ॥ १४ ॥ ६० तदूध्वे ओलिभेदानि ं त्रिभिर्वक्ष्यामि“ साम्प्रतम् । चतुरंगुलमुत्सृज्य ऋजुशक्तिर्विधीयते ॥ १५ ॥ अतसीपुष्पसंकाशां व्योमव्यापीं विचिन्तयेत् । ६३ ६४ तदूध्वे व्यापिनी प्रोक्ता चत्वार्यगुलमूध्वतः ॥ १६ ॥ समना सा स्वरूपेण चन्द्रकोटिसमप्रभा । ६६ ६७ शिवतत्त्वस्य ऊध्वे तु ओलिदेव्यस्त्रयः स्मृताः ॥ १७ ॥
english: CHAPTER NINE 33 3) Ko‰kaSa, which is like the autumn sky, (is located) in the uvula. 4) Kāmākhya, pure as snow, the jasmine or the moon, is in the middle of the palate. (9) 5) One should know that above that is (OÆÆiyāna the sacred seat of) the letter O¤, (Ha) as brilliant as a mirror.6 (10ab) 6) One should think of the Upper Face (ūrdhvavaktra), called the Triangle, in the Cavity of Brahmā.7 One should meditate on the leader of the sacred seats called Tisra as similar to heated gold. Above that is the Wheel of Space (vyomacakra)8 brilliant as a whirling firebrand.9 (10cd-11) The Six Without Support10 1) Once one has practiced (meditation) on the form of the Drop (bindurūpa), (one should concentrate on) the 2) Half-moon above it. 3) The Primordial Lord (ādinātha), who is said to be light (jyotirūpa), is on top (mūrdhani). (12) Know that to be the Śiva Principle (śivatattva). Unmanifest, one should recollect it (as having a form and motion) like a wheel.11 (13ab) The Peak (kū˜a), established ninefold, is said to extend from the Heart upward onto the head. By splitting apart the channel of SunumSā one should slowly (and gradually) split apart (the Peak).12 (13cd-14) Above that the divisions of the lineages (oli) are (associated) with (the following) three. I will now tell (you what they are). (15ab) 4) Abandoning (a distance of) four fingers (breadth upwards), (one comes to) the Straight Energy (rjuśakti). One must think (of her to) be like the hemp flower (in colour) and pervading the Sky (of the Supreme Principle).13 (15cd-16ab) 5) It is said that the Pervasive One (vyāpinī) is above that. (Again), four fingers further above is 6) the Equal One (samanā) who is, by her very nature, as brilliant as countless millions of moons.14 (These) are said to be the three goddesses of the Lineages (oli) that are above the Śiva principle. (16cd-17)

sanskrit: 34 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तस्योध्वे उन्मनावस्था शब्दावस्थ हि शाम्भवम् । शून्यमेकं समाभ्यस्य यत्र सर्व निवर्तते ॥ १८ ॥ ७४ ७२ शून्यान्ते तून्मने प्राप्ते को न मुच्येत बन्धनात् । अथान्य ँ संप्रवक्ष्यामि कारणं गूढमुत्तमम् ॥ १९ ॥ ७८ प्रथमं कामरूपाख्यं शृङ्गाटाकृतिशेखरम् । ७९ मायाबीजं द्वितीयं तु गुहा मुद्रा च तूष्णिका ॥ २० ॥ तृतीयं रुद्रबीजं तु दिव्यं सुरवरार्चितम् । चतुर्थं खेचर पीठ खफरेमिति विग्रहम् ।। २१ ।। ८४ पञ्चमं भैरवं नाम हसरौ – उपदाङ्कितम् । पीठपञ्चकमाख्यातं गुप्तसंज्ञं कुलागमे ।। २२ ॥ ८७ तेषां संकेतकाः पञ्च शास्त्रेऽस्मिन् स्ववतारिताः । ईकारश्च आकारश्च इ उ ओ स्वरपञ्चकम् ॥ २३ ॥ एते तत्त्वक्रमाच्छम्भो संजातानि कुलेच्छया । आद्यं पीठ भवेद् दीर्घं चतुर्थं स्वरनायकम् ॥ २४ ॥ स्वरोदय द्वितीय च तृतीये च तृतीयकम् । ९७ चतुर्थकं चतुर्थे तु पञ्चमे तु त्रयोदशम् ।। २५ ।। एते पीठा: स्मृता रत्ना ओजापूका: सतिस्रका: २ एतेषां नायिकाह ३ च विद्या च महान्तारिका' साकारा च निराकारा अद्वैताकारभूषिता । १०४ । ।। २६ ।। सा स्थूला सा च वै सूक्ष्मा चिच्छक्त्यन्तरचारिणी ।। २७ ।।
english: CHAPTER NINE 35 Above that is the state Beyond Mind (unmanāvasthā) and that is the Śāmbhava state of the Word (śabdāvastha). (One attains it) once one has practiced (immersion in) the one Void where everything comes to an end. And once the Transmental at the end of the Void has been reached, who is it that would not be freed from bondage?15 (18-19ab) The Five PraSavas16 Now I will explain something else, the most excellent secret concerning the (five) causes.17 (19cd) The first is called the 'form of passion' (kāmarūpākhya), which is the peak in the shape of (the triangular) water chestnut (AI¤). The second is the seed of Māyā (HRĪ¤). (It is) the silent (goddess) (tūnSikā), the Gesture (mudrā) and the Cave.18 (20) The third is Rudra's divine seed (ŚRĪ¤), which is worshipped by the best of the gods. The fourth is Khecara's sacred seat whose form is KHAPHARE¤.19 (21) The fifth is called Bhairava marked with (the seed-syllable) HASARAU- U¤.20 (This is) said to be the secret name of the group of the five sacred seats in the Kula scripture (kulāgama). (22) Their five conventions have been well brought down (into the world) in this scripture. (They are) the five vowels, namely, the letter Ī and the letters Ā, I, U and O.21 (23) These, O Śambhu, have arisen in accord with the sequence of the principles (tattvakrama) by the will of Kula. The first sacred seat is the long fourth (vowel) which is the leader of the vowels (Ī). The second is the arising of the vowels (Ā), while the third (sacred seat) is in the third (vowel) (I). The fourth (sacred seat) is in the fourth (vowel) (U), while the thirteenth (vowel) (O) is in the fifth (seat). These sacred seats are said to be (five) jewels. (They are) O (OÆÆiyāna), JĀ (Jālandhara), PŪ (PūrSagiri), KĀ (Kāmarūpa) and with them is (the sacred seat called) Tisraka.22 (24-26ab) I am their mistress; I am the Mahāntārikā Vidyā (the Incantation of the Great Saviouress). (26cd) Decorated with a nondual form she (both) has form and is formless. She is gross. She is subtle. She is the inwardly moving energy of consciousness. (27)

sanskrit: 36 कुमारिकाखण्ड: बोधरूपा महामाया अलेख्या लेख्यरूपिणी । गुह्ये च हृदये वक्त्रे विलसेत् परमेश्वरी ।। २८ ॥ मुद्राकूटसमायुक्ता तेन सा मुद्रिता भवेत् । यावन्न विन्दते कूटं तावद् विद्या न सिद्ध्यति ।। २९ ।। पश्चात् संपूर्ण करण कादिभेदेन कौलिकम् । गूढार्थेन प्रवक्ष्यामि विद्या द्वात्रिंशदक्षरा ।। ३० ।। संकेतेन यथा प्रोक्ता सिद्धिदा चैव योगिनाम् । ११३ ११५ प्रथमं पीठसंकेत भगवतीत्यतः परम् ।। ३१ ।। ११७ तृतीयं मूर्तिसंकेत चैतन्यं च अतः परम् ँ । चतुर्थं तु समाख्यतं अलङ्कार च पञ्चमम् ।। ३२ ॥ अभिधानं ततः षष्ठं ब्रह्माख्यं बीजसप्तमम् । अष्टमं विष्णुबीज ” तु नवमं रुद्रमुच्यते ॥ ३३ ॥ द्विपञ्चक१२३ करालाख्यं अमृतैकादशोच्यते । महाभैरवरूपं तु द्वादशं समुपस्थितम् ।। ३४ । त्रयोदशं भवेद् व्याप्तिः१५ संस्थितिश्च चतुर्दशम् । सिद्धिः पञ्चदशे ८ स्थाने आज्ञा षोडशमे ” पदे ।। ३५ ।। १३१ षोडशात्मकसंकेत उपदेशकृते कृतम् ' । त्रिधा देवी क्रमाणां हि ओलीनां तदनन्तरम् ॥ ३६ ॥ यथा कर्णोपदेश तु तत् प्रवक्ष्याम्यनन्तरम् ।
english: CHAPTER NINE 37 (She is) Mahāmāyā who is consciousness (bodharūpā). 23 She cannot be written about and (yet she) is (all that can be) written about. May the Supreme Goddess play in the genitals (guhya), the heart and the mouth (vaktra).24 (28) She is conjoined with the Peak syllable and with Gesture and so she is stamped (mudritā) (onto the body).25 (This) Vidyā is not successful until one obtains the Peak (syllabic mantra).26 (29) The Vidyā of Thirty-two Syllables in Sixteen Parts Next I will explain the complete Kaulika means (to realisation) according to the division beginning with Kā (kādibheda) with its profound meaning. (This), the Vidyā of Thirty-two Syllables explained according to the convention, bestows accomplishment (siddhi)27 upon yogis. (30-31ab) The first (part of this Vidyā consists of) the Convention of the Sacred Seats.28 After that comes (the word) 'BHAGAVATI'. (31cd) The third is the Convention of Form (mūrti)29 (GHORE)30 and after that comes Consciousness (HSKHPHRE¤),31 which is said to be the fourth. The Ornament (ŚRĪ)32 is the fifth. (32) Then comes the Designation (KUBJIKE), which is the sixth. Brahmā is the name of the seventh seed-syllable (HRĀ¤). The eighth is the seed of VinSu (HRĪ¤) and the ninth is said to be Rudra (HRAŪ¤).33 (33) The tenth is called Karāla (¥AnA¦ANAME) and Nectar (A) is said to be the eleventh. The twelfth is present in the form of the great Bhairava (GHORA). (34) The thirteenth is Pervasion (MUKHI), while Stability is the fourteenth (CHĀ¤ CHĪ¤). Accomplishment (KI¦I KI¦I) is in the fifteenth place and the Command (VICCE) is in the sixteenth part. (35) For the purpose of instruction, the convention has been made sixteenfold. The goddess of the Transmissions (krama) and, after that, that of the Lineages (oli), are threefold. (36) An Explanation of the Thirty-two Syllable Vidyā, Application and Modifications I will (now) explain the oral teaching (karSopadeśa). (37ab)

sanskrit: 38 कुमारिकाखण्डः १३५ मूर्तिभेद' त्रिधा प्रोक्तं व्युत्क्रमेण क्रमत्रये ॥। ३७ ।। विपरीतेन रेघो वै द्वौ सिद्धौ अ गणाधिपः । १३७ यावन्न ज्ञायते चार ओलिशुद्धिः कुतः क्रमे ॥ ३८ ॥ आदौ विकृतिकारण” सौम्यं च तदनन्तरम् । महावृक्ष पुनश्चात्र त्रिविध करणेन तु ॥ ३९ ॥ •१४० मूर्तिशुद्धि पुरा ज्ञात्वा आज्ञातत्त्वमनुस्मरेत् । चैतन्येन विनिर्मुक्तं प्रमादादपि वर्तते ।। ४० ।। तत्र शून्यं क्रम तस्य अधिकारं विना गुरोः । १४६ शक्तिना ४५ व्यतिरिक्तं तु रुद्रबीजं त्रिकन्दकम् ॥ ४१ ॥ ४७ मलानां दहनं कस्माच्छक्तिना परिभाव्यते । १५० ।। शक्तियुक्त पुरा ज्ञात्वा तदादिष्ट मलक्षयम् ।। ४२ ।। अमृतं योगिनीरिक्तं विसर्गरहित५२ यदा । अपवर्ग ३ कुतस्तस्माद्४ नापि स्वर्ग प्रवर्तते भैरवान्तं यदा दीर्घ भिन्नं कस्मात् कलेवरम् । १५९ १५७ ।। ४३ ।। कुतः स्याद् भैरवीशक्तिः कुतः स्यात् सिद्धिमण्डले ।। ४४ ।। अव्ययेन यदा रिक्तं व्याप्तं मण्डलपञ्जरम् । संसारमण्डलात्” तस्मान्न मुक्तिरिह र गीयते ॥ ४५ ॥ १६३ सर्वेषां पूर्वतो देव्या नमो‍ आमन्त्रणे पदे । १६४ १६५ कुलभ्रंशविनाशाय मतिभ्रंश: सदात्मनि ।। ४६ ।। १६७ मलानां भवते वृद्धिस्तद्वद् वृद्धिः कुतो भवेत् । तदा संसारचक्रेऽस्मिन् उदयते दिने दिने ॥ ४७ ॥
english: CHAPTER NINE 39 The Division of Form (mūrtibheda) is said to be threefold and is present, out of order, in the three Transmissions (kramatraya). 'RE’ and ‘GHO' in reverse order (i.e. GHO RE) are the two accomplished ones (siddha) (and along with them) is A, the Lord of Hosts (gaSādhipa).34 As long as one does not know the dynamics (cāra) (of this Vidyā), how can the lineages (oli) be purified in the Transmission (krama)? (37cd-38) (The Vidyā starts) in the beginning with the Cause of Change (vikrtikāraSa) (AI¤) and is followed by the Profound (saumya) (HRĪ¤). Again here the Great Tree is threefold (AI¤ HRĪ¤ ŚRĪ¤) in accord with the instrument (that applies its mantras). (39) Initially, having known the purification of Form, one should recall the Principle of the Command (AI¤). If, due to negligence, (this Vidyā is uttered by someone) without consciousness (HSKHPHRE¤), the Transmission (krama) of such a one, devoid of the authority of the teacher, is empty.35 (40-41ab) If the seed of Rudra, which is in three parts (HRĀ¤ HRĪ¤ HRAU¤), is devoid of Energy (RA) how can impurities (mala) be burnt away? (For it is) due to Energy that (this) takes place. It is taught that having initially known it to be conjoined with Energy, (only) then is impurity destroyed.36 (41cd-42) If Nectar (A) is devoid of the Yoginī37 and Emission (visarga) how can there be liberation? (Indeed, not even) heaven is (attained). (43) If there is a long (vowel) at the end of Bhairava (i.e. HSRAU-U¤) how can the body be split apart? Where would Bhairavīśakti be? Where (would it be in) the Circle of Accomplishments? (44) If the cage of the maSÆala is pervaded (by the Vidyā) devoid of the Imperishable (avyaya),38 it is said that there is no liberation from the sphere (maSÆala) of transmigratory existence. (45) Preceding all (the parts of the Vidyā) comes the salutation of the goddess (namaƒ) in the section (pada) (of the Vidyā) concerned with invocation.39 (This is done) in order to destroy lapses from (the teachings of the) Kula. (Moreover, if one fails to do this) the intellect within oneself constantly lapses. In this way impurities increase, so how can there be (any spiritual) growth? (Indeed one) then enters (further) into this wheel of transmigratory existence day by day. (46-47)

sanskrit: 40 कुमारिकाखण्ड: पीठरिक्ता अमावास्या नेह सिद्धिफलप्रदा । भाग्यक्षयं च कुरुते ९ अन्ते आज्ञाविवर्जिता ।। ४८ ॥ दुर्भगा जायते विद्या दुर्भगत्वं न संशयः १७१ । अथ संपुटयोग”” वा आद्यन्तेऽवकृतं यदि ।। ४९ ॥ तदा रेफप्रभावेण७३ जज्वलद् भैरवानलम् । -१७५ तेन सा भीषणीमूर्ति: ४ साक्षात् ५ क्लिन्ना भविष्यति' १७८ तत्रास्ति करणं किञ्चित् हसमध्ये प्रवर्तते । १८० १७६ ।। ५० ।। रवेर्लोप” पुरा कृत्वा तत्र सा वारुणी कला ॥ ५१ ॥ करणं चन्द्रचारेण तदा पूर्णतरङ्गिणी १८४ । चन्द्रांशुः क्षरते यस्मात् तस्मात् पूर्णा निगद्यते ॥ ५२ ॥ उभौपञ्चकहीना च जपिता विधिना यदि । १८७ तथापि हि न सिद्ध्यन्ति इत्याज्ञा पारमेश्वरी ।। ५३ ।। उभौपञ्चकनिर्मुक्ता नमो आमन्त्रणे युता । तेन विद्यां अमावास्या जप्त्वा कोटिशतैरपि ॥ ५४ ॥ विमुखा जायते विद्या मत्यलोके कलौ युगे । यद्यपि दक्षिणे प्रोक्ता मन्त्रसिंहासने हर ॥ ५५ ॥ निग्रहानुग्रहे शक्तिः वृक्षस्फोटादिप्रत्यया” । तदिदं ३ क्षेत्रमाहात्म्य तत् तु विद्याप्रभावतः ।। ५६ ।। वटुकस्य प्रभावेण संस्थिता बाह्यप्रत्ययाः' १९७ स्वप्रत्यया भवेद् विद्या यथा ओघक्रमेण तु ॥ ५७ ॥ ओघहीना न मुच्यन्ति” पतनं तेन खेचर ।
english: CHAPTER NINE 41 The New Moon that is devoid of the sacred seats does not bestow the fruits of accomplishment here (in this world). Devoid of the Command (AI¤)40 at the end, it destroys (all of one's) good fortune.41 The Vidyā becomes unlucky (and so one is) undoubtedly (afflicted) by misfortune. (48-49ab) Now, if the union of encapsulation (saˆpu˜ayoga) (of the Vidyā with the PraSavas)42 at the beginning and the end is omitted then, by the power of the letter Ra, the fire of Bhairava burns intensely. Thus (to extinguish this fire) the (goddess) of fearsome form becomes visibly (sāknāt) wet (klinnā) (by the power of the encompassing syllables). (49cd-50) There is some (mantric) instrument (karaSa) there that operates in the middle between Ha and Sa. The energy (called) VāruSī is present there once the Sun has been removed.43 (51) Then, by the movement of the Moon, the (mantric) instrument (i.e. the Vidyā) becomes the Full TaraSgiSī. (Then) the ray of the Moon oozes (nectar) and so (that energy) is called the Full (pūrSā).44 (52) The Command of the Supreme Goddess (ordains that) (even) if (the Vidyā) is repeated according to the rule (but) without the two pentads (of PraSavas at the beginning and end), then also (those who recite it) are not successful. (53) If one recites (this), the Vidyā of the New Moon, along with the salutation (namaƒ) during the invocation (but) without the two pentads even a hundred million times, the Vidyā becomes averse (to its reciter) in the mortal world during the Age of Strife. (This is so), O Hara, even though she is said to be on the right (propitious) (dakniSa) side of the Lion Throne of mantra. (54-55) (This Vidyā is) the power to (both) grace and restrain, which (has as its) sign of attainment (pratyaya) such (powers as the capacity to) burst trees apart and the like.45 This, the glory of the sacred field (i.e. the maSÆala), is due to the power of the Vidyā. (56) The external signs of attainment are established by Va˜uka's power,46 (while) the Vidyā (itself) is its own sign of attainment in accord with the transmission of the current (of the lineages) (oghakrama). O Skyfarer, those who are devoid of the current (of the transmission) (ogha) are not freed (but, on the contrary,) fall because of this. (57-58ab)

sanskrit: 42 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २०३ २०४ अनुलोमेन पाठ्यादौ विलोमान्ते च पञ्चकम् ॥ ५८ ॥ कृत्वा गमागम देव मध्ये विद्या सुरेश्वर । २०७ । भादिसृष्टिक्रमेणैव तदा सा पूर्णिमा भवेत् ।। ५९ ॥ सकृदुच्चारिता”“ विद्या” कम्पते देहपञ्जरम् । २११ रुद्रांशको” भवेन्मन्त्री विद्या देवी च पूर्णिमा ।। ६० ।। २१३ अन्यथा न भवेद्”? देव शास्त्रेऽस्मिनवतारिता । २१५ एतद्वै संपुटं योग विद्याया तनुपूर्वकम् ।। ६१ ।। पञ्चार्णमिति”६ विख्यातं यो विन्दति स सिद्ध्यति । २१७ विद्या संपुटिता शुद्धा संपुटेन विवर्जिता ।। ६२ ।। अशुद्धा नात्र संदेहो विघ्नदात्री ८ पदे पदे । विघ्नविदारणार्थाीय”” तदाख्यातं च संपुटम् ॥ ६३ ॥ २२० २२१ २२२ अमावास्या भवेत् पूर्णा कृष्णा स्थूला भविष्यति' रौद्रा सा भवते सौम्या आक्रान्ता करणेन तु ॥ ६४ ॥ ये२३ ते पञ्च क्रमात्४ पीठाः २५ पूर्वोक्ता हि २६ सुरोत्तम । ते च कुर्याद् भकारादौ वाग्भवाद्यनुलोमतः ॥ ६५ ॥ २२७ । पुनस्तेऽपि विलोमाच्च चकारान्ते २९ नियोजयेत् । आदौ ते प्रणवाः पञ्च अन्ते तेऽपि विसर्पिताः ।। ६६ ।। २३० विद्यामध्ये” गताहं च त्वमूर्तिरिति कौलिनी । २३२ द्वात्रिंशाक्षरिका या तु अनेन करणेन तु ॥ ६७ ॥ •२३४ द्विचत्वारिंशती सा तु स्वमन्त्रं पश्चिमान्वये । २३७ तच्चास्य१३५ प्रणव३६ देयं दीपनं वैदिक प्रिय ।। ६८ ।। २३८ तेन सा च विनिर्मुक्ता षड्जातिभ्यो विवर्जिता । •२३९ २४० २४१ ॐकार च नमः पूर्वं नमः स्वाहा स्वधा वषट् ।। ६९ ।। वौषट् ४२ चैव तु स्वाहान्तं रक्षफट्कारवर्जिता । २४४ २४५ २४३ एभिर्मन्त्रपदैस्तत्र उत्तीणी सिद्ध्यते परा ।। ७० ।।

sanskrit: CHAPTER NINE 43 Once recited in the beginning in the forward order, the group of five (praṇavas should be recited) in the end in reverse. (58cd) O god, having gone and come, 47 the Vidyā, O lord of the gods, is in the middle. Then, in accord with the sequence of emanation starting with the (letter) Bha, it is the Full Moon (pūrṇimā).48 (59) (If this) Vidyā is recited (just) once, the cage of the body shakes. The reciter of mantra (becames) an incarnation (aṁśa) of Rudra and the goddess of the Vidyā is the Full Moon. (60) Otherwise, O god, she would not have descended down into this scripture. This indeed is the union of encapsulation (sampuțaṁ yogam) 49 with the Vidyā preceded by (the formation of its) the body. It called the Five-lettered (Vidyā).50 He who receives it is successful. (61-62ab) The encapsulated Vidyā is pure (but) without the encapsulation it is impure and, undoubtedly, creates obstacles at each step. Then (the method of) encapsulation has been explained in order to remove (these) obstacles. (62cd-63) (In this way) the New Moon becomes the Full Moon. The dark (Moon) is gross and fierce (raudrā) (but), conjoined with the instrument (of mantra i.e. the Praṇavas), it becomes tranquil (saumyā).5 (64) 51 O best of the gods, these five (praṇavas), that are the aforementioned sacred seats in due order, 52 should be placed before the letter Bha (in the beginning of the Vidyā) in the forward order beginning with Vägbhava (AIM). (65) Then again, the same (praṇavas) should be placed at the end of the syllable CCE (which is at the end of the Vidyā) in the reverse order. (Thus) the same Five Praṇavas that are at the beginning have emerged also at the end. (66) I am the Vidyā in the middle, (the goddess) Kaulinī without form (amūrti). (I am) that thirty-two syllable (Vidyā) who, by means of this (mantric) instrument, is the forty-two syllable (Vidyā), which is my own mantra in the western tradition. And that, O beloved, is the Pranava, the Vedic energizer (dīpana), that should be given to it. (67-68) 53 Thus, (the Vidyā) is free and devoid of the six types. 54 (It is devoid of) OM preceded by NAMAḤ, SVĀHĀ, SVADHĀ, VAṢAṬ, VAUṢAṬ and SVĀHĀ at the end. It is devoid of PHAṬ that serves for protection. There (in that case), the supreme (Vidyā), free of these mantric syllables, is successful. (70)

44 कुमारिकाखण्ड: प्रधानास्तेऽपि तन्त्रेषु इज्यार्थे होमकर्मसु । तैस्तु कृत्वा कुलाम्नाये योगभ्रंशो २४७ हि २४८ जायते स्वभावे दीपिता विद्या संस्थिता वह्निमण्डले । २४९ ।। ७१ ।। तदा सा तन्त्रमन्त्रैस्तु उत्तीणी चापि सिद्ध्यति ।। ७२ ।। २५१ न चास्याः सदृशा विद्या त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते । विद्यते कुलशास्त्रेऽस्मिन् पीठानां पीठदेवता ।। ७३ ।। अस्या विद्या परा नास्ति आज्ञाशास्त्रात् परं नहि । .२५२ पीठक्रमात् परं नास्ति गुरुवक्त्रात् परं नहि ॥ ७४ ॥ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे २५३ स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्र- संहितायां¨¨ अव्वाक्रमभाषिते विद्यापूर्णादिभेदचैतन्या- धिकारवर्णने २५५ क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। ९ ।।
english: CHAPTER NINE 45 Even though, according to the Tantras, these are also the main (syllables used) in rites in which offerings are made in the fire (homakarma) for the gods and ancestors (ijya); if (this) is done with these in the Kula tradition, there is a fall from Yoga. (71) The Vidyā is energized (dīpitā) in its own essential nature and abides in the Circle of Fire. Then, even though it is free (uttīrSā) of (supplimentary) rites (tantra) and mantras, it is successful. (72) There is no Vidyā like it in the Three Worlds. The deity of the sacred seats, it is present in this Kula teaching (śāstra). There is no Vidyā superior to this one. There is nothing superior to the scripture of the Command (ājñāśāstra). There is nothing superior to the transmission of the sacred seats (pī˜hakrama) nor anything superior to the teacher's mouth. (73-74) This is the (ninth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the (seed-syllable of) Consciousness and the types of the Vidyā, namely, Full and the rest. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: दशमानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच किमेतत् पूर्णकरण विद्यायाः कथितं त्वया । भैरवस्य तु पिण्डस्य यत्' तेजो औसमध्यतः' ॥ १ ॥ आदावन्ते स्थितस्यैव द्वौ रेफ सन्निरोधत: । वक्रीकरणमेतद् वै न पूर्णं करणं क्वचित् ॥ २ ॥ एतच्छल्यं च विद्यायास्तदा सा कीलिता भवेत् । उत्कीलनं वद” तस्या” येन सा पूर्णिमा भवेत् ॥ ३ ॥ १४ श्रीवक्रा उवाच एतत् प्रश्नवर गुह्यं देवदेवावतारितम् । १६ त्वदृते बुद्धिमान् नास्ति उत्तरं तस्य तच्छृणु ॥ ४ ॥ भैरवस्य तु पिण्डस्य आदावन्ते स्थितस्य च । औसमध्यगत शल्यं मध्याह्नार्कसमप्रभम् ॥ ५ ॥ लोपन तस्य तत् कृत्वा तत्र सा वारुणी कला । कृत्वा चामृतमाद्यन्ते ततो विद्या च सिद्ध्यति ।। ६ ।। उपदेशं समाख्यातं लक्षजापेन खेगतिः । साधकस्य भवेद् देव नात्र कार्याी विचारणा ॥ ७ ॥
english: CHAPTER TEN A Description of the Glory of the Vidyā. The Fixing and Release of the Vidyā Śrīnātha said: What is that complete instrument (karaSa) of the Vidyā you have explained (previously), namely, the radiant energy (tejas) of Bhairava's syllable (piSÆa) (that emerges) from between Au and Sa?1 (1) There are two Ras. (One is in the seed-syllable) located at beginning (of the Vidyā) and (the other is in the seed-syllable at) the end, (placed there) in order to block (it). That is the way to make (the Vidyā) crooked (vakrīkaraSa). (In that condition) the instrument (of mantra) is nowhere complete.2 (2) That is the Lance (śalya) of the Vidyā. (The Vidyā) is then fixed (kīlitā). (Now) tell me of its release (utkīlana) by virtue of which it becomes (the Vidyā of) the Full Moon. (3) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: This is the best of questions; (it concerns) the secret brought down (into this world) by the god of the gods. None is wise apart from you (and so) listen to its answer. (4) The Lance (Ra), located between AU and Sa of Bhairava's syllable (HSRAU-U¤) at the beginning and end (of the Vidyā), is as brilliant as the midday sun. (5) The energy VāruSī is (located) there when that (i.e. the letter Ra) has been eliminated. Then, when nectar has (thus) been placed at the beginning and end, the Vidyā is successful.3 (6) (This) is said to be the teaching. By repeating (this Vidyā) 100,000 times, O god, the adept possesses (the power of mystical) flight (khegati).4 (This is a fact), one need not ponder here (about this. It will certainly take place). (7)

sanskrit: 48 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तस्य तत्क्रमयुक्तस्य विद्याजापरतस्य च । २४ अन्तिमे” च युगे सिद्धिः प्रत्ययानि” बहून्यपि ॥ ८ ॥ नष्टप्रत्यन्तविज्ञान विद्यानाभ्यसनाद्” भवेत् । २७ २९ एतत् तस्यापि” संतानं प्रस्तार पूर्वभाषितम् ।। ९ ।। मेरूत्था ं रुद्रशक्तिस्तु ज्ञात्वा विद्यार्थिनो” भवेत् । ३० इदानीं पदभेदेन विद्या पूर्णा निगद्यते ॥ १० ॥ च्चेविणिकिपदं पूर्वं णिकिच्छींच्छा द्वितीयकम् । तृतीयं खिमुराघो अमेनण चतुर्थकम् ॥ ११ ॥ ८३८ पञ्चमं च ञ ङ स्हौँ” स्ह्रीँ षष्ठ स्हाँ केब्जिकु भवेत् । श्रीँ हस्ख्फ्रें रेघो सप्तमं स्यात् तिवगभपदाष्ठमम् ।। १२ ।। ६ विद्या चाष्टपदैरुक्ता अघोरैषा महातनुः । ४७ पञ्चप्रणवपूर्वा च अन्ते पञ्च विलोमगाः ।। १३ । पूर्णकरणयोगोऽय“ कथितं तव भैरव । अस्या” वक्त्रषडङ्गानि” करन्यासे विशोधयेत् ॥ १४ ॥ ५३ भेदद्वादशसंयुक्तान् पूर्व चैव तु विन्यसेत् । वक्त्रन्यासमतः” पूर्वं सृष्टिन्यायेन कारयेत् ।। १५ । ५७ ऊध्ववक्त्रात् समारभ्य ँ यावत्” पश्चिममाननम्” । सौम्यं सृष्टिक्रमेणैव रौद्रमन्यक्रमेण तु ।। १६ ॥
english: CHAPTER TEN 49 He who is intent on that transmission (tatkramayukta) and is devoted to the repetition of the Vidyā (attains) accomplishment (siddhi) and many signs of attainment (pratyaya) in the last Age. (8) Failure to practice the Vidyā leads to the complete loss of understanding (vijñāna) and of one's lineage and the grid (prastāra) explained previously. (But) once one knows Rudra's energy that has arisen from Meru,5 he becomes a (true) disciple (vidyārthin).6 (9-10ab) The Vidyā of Thirty-two Syllables in Eight Parts Now the Vidyā in its full form (pūrSā) will be explained in accord with the division of its parts (padabheda).7 (10cd) First comes the part CCEVI ¦IKI. The second one is ¦IKI CCHI¤ CCHĀ¤. The third is KHIMURĀGHO. The fourth is AMENA¦A. The fifth is nA¥A SHRAU¤ SHRĪ¤. The sixth is SHRĀ¤ KEBJIKU. The seventh is ŚRĪ¤ HSKHPHRE¤ REGHO. The eighth part is TIVAGABHA.8 (11-12) This Vidyā with eight parts, Aghorā whose body is great, has been explained. It is preceded by the Five PraSavas and (has the same) five at the end in the reverse order. (13) The Division and Deposition of the Limbs and Faces of the Vidyā9 O Bhairava, (I) have told you this, the conjunction (yoga) of the full (form of the) instrument (of mantra). One must purify (the Vidyā’s) faces and six limbs when the deposition onto the hands (karanyāsa) (has been completed).10 (14) (These limbs and faces) with (their) twelve divisions (bheda)11 should be deposited (onto the body) first. Thus, initially, one should perform the Deposition of the Faces (vaktranyāsa) according to the pattern of emanation (srn˜inyāya).12 (15) The tranquil (saumya) (aspect is worshipped) according to the sequence of emanation, beginning with the upper face up to the western one. The fierce (raudra aspect is worshipped) through the other (reverse) sequence. (16)

sanskrit: 50 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ६३ पश्चिमानन” कृत्वादौ यावद् ऊध्वं क्रमाननम् । तावत् संहारमेवोक्त ं॰ सिद्धाङ्गपञ्चक भवेत् ।। १७ ॥ सृष्टिक्रमेण सकल संहारेण तु निष्कलम् । सृष्टिसंहारयोज्ञात्वा दिव्यवक्त्रं प्रवेशयेत् ।। १८ ॥ भकारादि च रेफान्तं ऊध्ववक्त्रं च विन्यसेत् । देव्याकूटादि नामान्त” मूर्धवक्त्रं तु विन्यसेत् ॥ १९ ॥ 4 बीजत्रयं समारोप्य विन्यसेत् पूर्वमाननम् । ७६ ङकारादि च शून्यान्तं विज्ञेयं दक्षमाननम् ॥ २० ॥ सूर्यादिसोमपर्यन्तं विन्यसेच्चोत्तराननम् । क्यादि” चानुक्रमाभ्यासाद् वक्त्रेदं° पश्चिमं न्यसेत् ।। २१ ।। देव्यः” षट्कगतास्तेषां यथा चैव क्रमेण तु परा देवी च मालिन्या सिद्धयोगेश्वरी तथा ।। २२ ।। कालिकाख्या तथा देवी त्रिपुरामूर्ति पञ्चमी । पश्चिमे तु पुनस्तस्य उमाखेचरि पूर्विका ।। २३ ॥ ८७ पश्चिमाननमारभ्य“ वाग्भवाद्यन्तयोजिताः ँ । ८८ पीठन्यासानुन्यासैस्तु कृत्वाङ्गानि षडि: “ पुनः ।। २४ ।।
english: CHAPTER TEN 51 (In that case) one must start first with the western face (and continue) up to the upper face of the Krama (kramānana).13 Such is said to be (the process) of withdrawal (saˆhāra) and the group of five accomplished limbs (siddhā‰ga).14 (17) The differentiated (sakala) (form of the deity is worshipped) in accord with the sequence of emanation, the undifferentiated (ninkala) (form) by (the process of) withdrawal. Once one has know (the sequences of) emanation and withdrawal, one should enter the Divine Face.15 (18) One should deposit the letters from Bha to the letter Ra (BHAGAVATI GHORE) onto the uppermost face. (The section) from the goddess's Peak up to the end of the name (HSKHPHRE¤ ŚRĪ¤ KUBJIKE) should be deposited (directly) onto the head (above the four) (mūrdhavaktra).16 (19) Having placed the three seed-syllables (SHRĀ¤ SHRĪ¤ SHRAU¤), deposit (them on) the eastern face. One should know that the southern face (consists of the letters) starting with ¥a and ending with the Void (¥AnA¦ANAME AGHORĀMUKHI). (20) Deposit the Sun (CCHĀ¤) at the beginning and the Moon (CCHĪ¤) at the end onto the northern face. (The section) beginning with KI (KI¦I KI¦I VICCE) — by practicing (the recitation) in due order — deposit this onto the western face.17 (21) The goddesses associated with the six (faces) and of those (parts of the Vidyā) are, in due order, (as follows): the goddess Parā, Mālinī, Siddhayogeśvarī,18 the one called Kālikā, the goddess whose form is Tripurā as the fifth and to the west of that, Umākhecarī, who is the one in front19 (pūrvikā). (22-23) Beginning with the western face, they are (all) conjoined at the beginning and end with Vāgbhava (AI¤) and the rest (of the Five PraSavas). The six limbs are again formed by means of the deposition of the sacred and seats and the subsiduary depositions. (24)

sanskrit: 52 कुमारिकाखण्ड: पुनरेव भकारादौ रेफान्तं हृदयं न्यसेत्” । आत्मकूटादि नामान्तं॰ उद्धृतं तु शिरं न्यसेत् ।। २५ ।। शिखायां त्रीणि बीजानि ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । ङादि चैव तु शून्यान्तं वर्मदेव्यामनुक्रमात् ।। २६ ।। च्छाँ च्छीं चैव तु चन्द्रार्कौ द्वावेतौ नेत्रयोन्यसेत् विच्चे किणिकिणिपूर्वं अस्त्रराजं तु विन्यसेत् ।। २७ ।। ९९ एवं चाङ्गानि” सुभग” कौलिकाद्यन्तयोजिता: । पुटिताञ्च न्यसेद् देव सर्वरक्षकरा: पराः ।। २८ ।। तैरङ्गैर्देवताषट्क ै ३ हृदयादिक्रमेण तु । ०७ १०२ देवी हृत्कमलाम्बाख्या कुलदीपा तथैव च ।। २९ ।। बर्बरा बहुरूपाख्या महन्तारी च कोङ्कणा । एवं ते देवताषट्कं अङ्गाना परिकीर्तितम् ॥ ३० ॥ एतैर्द्वादशभिर्भेदैर्विन्यसेत्” कुलदेवताम् । तन्त्रादेशविनिर्मुक्ताः सिद्धाङ्गानि षडङ्गयोः ।। ३१ ।। ॐ नमश्चैव स्वाहान्तं वौषट् च स्वस्थिरार्णवम् । वषट् फट् क्रमेणैव उत्तीर्णाङ्गानि विन्यसेत् ।। ३२ ॥ ११७ योगपीठक्रमाच्छम्भो आद्यन्ते विनियोजिता: । पश्चादारभ्यते न्यास यथाख्यातं कुलागमे ॥ ३३ ॥ ।।
english: CHAPTER TEN 53 Once this has been done, one should again deposit (the letters) beginning with Bha and ending with Ra (BHAGAVATI GHORE) as the Heart. (The part of the Vidyā) that has been extracted beginning with the Peak of the Self (HSKHPHRE¤) and ending with the name (KUBJIKE) should be deposited as the head. (25) The three seed-syllables, namely those of Brahmā (SHRĀ¤), VinSu (SHRĪ¤) and Maheśvara (SHRAU¤), (should be deposited) onto the topknot. (The part) beginning with ¥a and ending with the Void (Kha — ¥AnA¦ANAME AGHORĀMUKHI — should be deposited), in due order, onto the goddess of the armour. (26) These two, CCHĀ¤ and CCHĪ¤, which correspond to the Sun and Moon (respectively), should be deposited onto the eyes. VICCE preceded by KI¦I KI¦I should be deposited onto the king of weapons.20 (27) In this way the limbs, O handsome one, are conjoined at the beginning and end with the Kaulikā (Vidyā). O god, deposit them (thus) encapsulated, supreme and protectors of all.21 (28) (There is a) group of six deities along with these limbs. (These are), in due order, commencing with the heart, the goddess called Hrtkamalāmbā along with Kuladīpā, Barbarā, the one called Bahurūpā, Mahantārī and Ko‰kaSā. This is said to be your group of six deities belonging to the limbs.22 (29-30) (Kubjikā) the deity of Kula should be deposited with these twelve divisions. The accomplished (siddha) limbs of the two groups of six limbs are free of the teachings of the Tantra.23 (31) The extensions of the limbs (uttīrSāSga) should be deposited in the following order: O¤ and NAMAÖ, the ending SVĀHĀ (then) VAU±Aµ, HŪ¤ (svasthirārSava), VA±AT and PHAµ.24 (32) O Śambhu, (the syllables) are added at the beginning and end according to the transmission of the sacred seat of Yoga.25 The deposition is performed after this as explained in the Kula scripture. (33)

sanskrit: 54 कुमारिकाखण्ड: वक्रमुख भवेत्” षट्कं आख्यातं पूर्वनिर्णये । अङ्गषट्के २२ षडिमुद्रा मुद्रा द्वादशधाक्रमे ४ ॥ ३४ ॥ योनिमुद्रा २५ तथा सिंहा दूतीमुद्रा च ७ चिञ्चिणी' । १२८ शूलमुद्रा च वक्रिण्या मुद्राषट्कं क्रमेण तु ।। ३५ ।। एतैस्तु” भेदिता विद्या तदा सिद्ध्यारुहो भवेत् । मुद्रिता 33 योनिमुद्रायां तदा विद्या समभ्यसेत् ॥ ३६ ॥ ध्यानद्वादशकं वक्ष्ये वक्त्राङ्गेषु पृथक् पृथक् । ४० १४१ श्वेतं ३८ रक्तानन” मूर्ध पाण्डुर पूर्वमाननम् ॥। ३७ ।। दक्षिणानन४२ कृष्णं तु पीतं चैवोत्तराननम् । पश्चिमं श्यामरक्तं तु वक्त्रं त्रिदशपूजितम् ॥ ३८ ॥ शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं देव्या हृदि विशिष्यते । तप्तहेमप्रतीकाशं शिरो देव्याः प्रकीर्तितम् ।। ३९ ॥ ज्वालामालाकुला रौद्रां विद्युज्जिह्वा ५ शिखां स्मरेत् । १४७ किञ्चिच्छाम च रक्तं च बहुवर्णं कवचं न्यसेत्” ॥ ४० ॥ नेत्रौ चन्द्रार्कतुल्याभौ वर्तुलौं हिमशीतलौ । वह्निवत् सदृश“” चास्त्रं सर्वविघ्नविनाशकम् २ ।। ४१ ॥
english: CHAPTER TEN 55 The group of six explained in the previous teaching is the (sixfold) face of (the goddess) Vakrā. The Gesture in the twelvefold sequence26 is the sixfold Gesture within the group of six limbs. (34) The six Gestures, in due order, are: Yonimudrā (the Gesture of the Yoni — the Heart), Siˆhā (the Gesture of the Lioness — the Head), Dūtīmudrā (the Gesture of the Tantric Consort — the Topknot), CiñciSī (the Gesture of the Tamarind Tree — the Armour), Śūlamudrā (the Gesture of the Lance — the Eye) and VakriSyā (the Gesture of the Crooked One — the Weapon).27 (35) When the Vidyā is conjoined with these (limbs, faces and gestures), (the adept) is successful (siddhyāruha). He should practice the Vidyā when it has been sealed within the Gesture of the Yoni (yonimudrā).28 (36) The Visualization of the Goddess’s Faces and Limbs (Now) I will explain the twelvefold visualization (dhyāna) (that should be performed) individually (in association with) the faces and limbs. (37ab) (The uppermost face is) white (śveta). The upper (one below that) is a red face. The eastern face is yellow (pāSÆura).29 The southern face is dark blue (krnSa). The northern face is yellow while the western face, worshipped by the gods, is blue and red.30 (37cd-38) (The limb) that is radiant like pure crystal is most excellent and is within the Heart of the goddess, (while) the Head of the goddess is said to be as brilliant as heated gold. (39) One should recollect the Topknot to be (like) a terrible (raudra) tongue of lightning filled with garlands of flames. One should deposit (on one's body) the Armour (kavaca) that, multi-coloured, is light blue and red31. (40) Round and cool as snow, the Eyes shine like the Sun and Moon,32 while the Weapon, like fire, is the destroyer of all obstacles.33 (41)

sanskrit: 56 कुमारिकाखण्ड: एतत् क्रमागतं योग५३ न्यासद्वादशक १५४ प्रति । सदा न्यस्तैस्तु देवेश साधकः सिद्धिभाग् भवेत् ॥ ४२ ॥ यानि१५७ चेच्छति कामानि १५८ तानि५९ लभति नान्यथा । एक एव महादोषो विद्ययाभ्यसनाद् २ भवेत् ॥ ४३ ॥ यमेव लोकयेज्जन्तु कोपाविष्टस्तु साधकः । पातयेन्नात्र संदेहो यदि शक्रसमो भवेत् ॥ ४४ ॥ १६७ पीठन्यासानुन्यासैस्तु कृत्वा वै वज्रपञ्जरम् ' १७० । मुद्रास्फोटा: प्रवर्तन्ते चालनं चावलोकनम् ।। ४५ ।। १७५ दिव्यदेह न संदेहो वपुस्तेजश्चिरायुषम् । सौभाग्य ७६ कान्तिलक्ष्मी च विद्याक्षोभः समन्ततः कामेश्वर्य बल ११ शौर्य ८२ सर्वसिद्धिः प्रवर्तते२८३ । १८५ १७९ ।। ४६ ।। इत्यागमविशुद्धस्य विद्या शुद्धक्रमस्य च ॥ ४७ ॥ ।। १८७ प्रभावमेतदाख्यात“ सिद्धप्रत्ययलक्षणम् ँ । सतताभ्यासयोगेन द्वादशाब्दैस्तु सिद्ध्यति ।। ४८ ।। स्वयमाकाशगामी च पातालतल” भुञ्जति” । ९९३ यथा चाहं यथा त्व' १३ च तथासौ साधकोत्तमः १९४ देवमाता जगन्माता ९५ विश्वमाता प्रतिष्ठिता ९६ । सर्वेषामालयं देव देवदेवी महातनुः ।। ५० ।। १९७ । ।। ४९ ॥
english: CHAPTER TEN 57 The Glory of the Vidyā This is the Yoga34 that has come through the transmission (kramāgata), namely, the deposition (nyāsa) in relation to the group of twelve (limbs and faces). O lord of the gods, the adept (sādhaka) is successful (siddhibhāk) with (these) constantly deposited (on his body).35 (42) He obtains whatever he desires (in this and in) no other way. There is only one great defect brought about by practicing with the Vidyā. If the adept (has practiced enough to have become) the equal of Śakra (the king of the gods), then whoever he looks at when angry, he certainly causes to drop (down senseless).36 (43-44) Once (he) has fashioned the (protective) cage of lightning flashes (vajrapañjara) by the deposition of the sacred seats and the subsidiary depositions (that accompany it), bursts of energy emanate from (his) gestures (mudrāspho˜a), (and he receives the magical power to) move (objects at will) (cālana) and (the power of yogic) sight (avalokana). (45) Without a doubt (the adept acquires a) divine body, corporeal radiance (vapustejas)37 and a long life. (He attains) good fortune, the wealth of beauty, the arousal (knobha) of the (power of) the Vidyā38 in every direction, the mastery of passion, strength, valour and complete accomplishment. (46-47ab) This is the Vidyā of one who has been purified by the scriptures and of the pure transmission (krama). This, the power (prabhāva) (of the Vidyā), whose mark is accomplished realisation (siddhapratyaya), has been explained. (The adept) achieves success after twelve years through the constant practice of this Yoga. (47cd-48) He (acquires the power of) flight spontaneously and enjoys (the pleasures of) the lower world. Just as you and I are, such is (he), the best of adepts (sādhaka). (49) Mother of the gods, mother of the universe, mother of all things, well- established, abode of all, (she) is the goddess of the gods and her body is great, O god. (50)

sanskrit: 58 कुमारिकाखण्ड: सद्यावेशकरी घोरा अघोराघोररूपिणी । महाविद्येश्वरी”” माया भैरवी देवता परा ।। ५१ ।। अस्योच्चारणमात्रेण सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् । २०२ २०३ ब्रह्महत्या असंख्यानि स्त्रीणां १३ गौबालहन्तका: भूमिहन्ता सुवर्णं च परदारहराश्च ये । २०५ २०७ २०४ ।। ५२ ॥ गुरुद्रोही दुरात्मा च मित्रद्रोही“ विशेषतः ।। ५३ ॥ अग्निद्रोहकरा ये १० च तथा विश्वासघातकाः रथ्याचौरकरा”? ये च पितृमातृ - उपेक्षक : २१३ २१६ २११ । ॥ ५४ ॥ । बहून्यपि”४ कृतान्यायात्१५ मेरुराशिप्रमाणतः विद्योच्चारणन्यासैस्तु भस्मसात्” यान्ति” तत्क्षणात् ।। ५५ ।। सकृदुच्चरणाद्”” देव सर्वतीर्थफलं लभेत् । २२२ स्मरणान्निर्मलो योगी भवते नीरुजः सदा ।। ५६ ।। अश्वमेधसहस्राणां १३ गोकन्यादानकोटीनाम .२२६ २२४ । स्मरणात् तारणं१२५ पुण्यं गोगृहे शरणागते ।। ५७ ।। २२७ २२८ संग्रामे सन्मुखो युद्धे गोग्रहे प्राणदायकः । २३० अनशने २९ च भृगोः पाते तथा चैव महापथे २३१ २३२ २३४ ॥ ५८ ॥ । ग्रहणे सोमसूर्ययोः” राहुग्रस्ते तु यत् फलम्` तत् फलं प्राप्नुयाद् वीरो विद्यायाः २३५ स्मरणादपि ।। ५९ ।। योगिन्यो ३६ वरदास्तस्य पीठजा : २३७ क्षेत्रजाश्च २३८ वा । २३९ २४० सहजा:”” कलजाश्चैव पूजयन्ति पदे पदे ।। ६० ।।
english: CHAPTER TEN 59 She brings about immediate possession and, (both) horrific (ghorā) and benign (aghorā),39 her nature is (basically) not fierce (aghorarūpiSī).40 (She is) the mistress of the great Vidyā, Māyā, Bhairavī, and the deity Parā (the Supreme). (51) Merely by reciting (the Vidyā) all sins are destroyed, (even) countless brahminicides. Those who have killed women, children and cows, one who has spoilt the land, (stolen) gold and those who have kidnapped other (men's) women. The wicked one who has done violence to (his) teacher, particularly one who has done violence to a friend. Those who have violated the (sacred) fire, those who have betrayed (another person's) trust, highway robbers and those who disregard (their) mother and father. Even if (one's sins are all those that such people commit) and one commits many more, a heap as great as (mount) Meru, they are reduced to ashes in a moment by the recitation of the Vidyā and the depositions.41 (52-55) O god, by reciting it (just) once one gets the fruit of (pilgrimage to all) the sacred places (tīrtha). By recalling it, the yogi is always pure and free of the wrinkles (of old age). (56) By recalling (this Vidyā) one (gets) the fruit, succur (tāraSa) and merit (of performing) a thousand horse sacrifices and making countless millions of donations of cows and virgins. Even by just recalling the Vidyā, the Hero gets the fruit (acquired by practicing meditation) in a cow stall, by taking refuge (in the deity) (or that of) one who stands firm (sanmukha) in battle, (or he who) gives his life in a war, or (in attempting to prevent) the stealing of a cow. (He gets the fruits) of fasting, (or those acquired by one who committes ritual suicide by) throwing himself down from a precipice (bhrgupāta), or (by undertaking) the Great Journey (mahāpatha),42 (or that one acquires) during a lunar or solar eclipse when (the sun or moon) are devoured by Rāhu. (57-59) The Yoginīs grant him boons, and those (Yoginīs who are) born out of the sacred seats (pī˜hajā) from the field (knetrajā), spontaneously (sahajā) or out of the energies (kalājā), worship him at (his) every step. (60)

sanskrit: 60 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २४१ दुर्भगः सुभगो याति जनसौभाग्यवत्सलः । संग्रामे तु जयप्राप्तिः २४२ राजद्वारे यशो लभेत् ॥ ६१ ॥ अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रान् आयुरारोग्यसंपदः ४३ । २४४ मृतवत्सा तु या नारी सुतजीवन्तिका भवेत् ।। ६२ ।। २४५ २४६ कृतकृत्य: स देवेश यस्य विद्या मुखे स्थिता । २४९ एकया जिह्वया देव नाहं वर्णयितुं क्षमा ॥ ६३ ॥ २५१ यान् यान् वांच्छयते” कामान् तांस्तान् सर्वानवाप्नुयात् ५२ । कलौ युगे प्रभावोऽयं मत्यानां गोचरं गतः २५५ साधिता देवदेवेश ब्रह्मविष्ण्वेंद्रनायकैः । २५४ ।। ६४ ।। अस्या विद्याप्रभावेण २५६ नरा देवत्वमागताः ॥ ६५ ॥ ये स्मरन्ति इमां नित्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदाम् । तस्य २५७ हस्ततले मोक्षं इत्याज्ञा पारमेश्वरी ।। ६६ ।। ब्रह्मणा 258 पूजिता चैषा शक्रेण च महेश्वर । २६० विष्णुना भैरवेणापि ५९ सिद्धगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः ।। ६७ ।। मारुतेन कुवेरेण लोकपालैर्दशो दिशैः २६४ २६१ २६२ । २६५ सर्वै: २६३ संपूजिता विद्या वन्दिता त्रिदशैरपि ।। ६८ ।। २६६ २६७ नान्या सा गीयते विद्या द्रव्यहीना न चोच्चरेत् । २७० कृतं तेन महाशापं योगिन्यश्चक्रनायिकाः ।। ६९ ।। रक्षणीया प्रयत्नेन इत्याज्ञा पारमेश्वरी । ।
english: CHAPTER TEN 61 An unfortunate man becomes lucky, loved by (all) people and by good fortune. (He attains) victory in battle and gets fame at the door of the king. (61) The sonless man gets sons, the wealth of long life and health. The woman whose child has died becomes one who has given birth (to a child who) lives. (62) O lord of the gods, he who has the Vidyā on his lips is one who has accomplished all that needs to be done. O god, I cannot describe (its power) with (just) one tongue. (63) He gets all the things he desires. This (is) the power (that), in the Age of Strife, has come into the domain of mortal men.43 (64) O lord of the god of the gods, (this Vidyā) was acquired by the leaders (of the gods, namely) Brahmā, VinSu and Indra. By the power of this (Vidyā), men have become gods. (65) It bestows (both worldly) benefits and liberation to those who always recall it. It is the Command of the Supreme Goddess that liberation be in the palm of their hands. (66) O Great God, this (Vidyā) is worshipped by Brahmā, Śakra (the king of the gods), VinSu, Bhairava, the Siddhas, celestial eunuchs (kinnara) and the divine musicians (gandharva). (This) Vidyā is worshipped by all, by Rudra (māruta), Kuvera, the guardians, the ten directions as well as by the gods. (67-68) The Vidyā extolled here is like none other. (But remember,) it should not be uttered (if it is) devoid of offerings (dravyahīnā). By doing this (one incurs) a great curse. It is the Supreme Goddess's Command that the Yoginīs, who are the leaders of the circles (of Siddhas and Yoginīs), should be protected with (every possible) effort. (69-70ab)

sanskrit: 62 कुमारिकाखण्डः इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे २७२ अन्वये १७३ सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे २७४ मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते २७६ लक्षपादाधिके७५ आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे २८ स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते विद्यामाहात्म्यवर्णने ' क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। १० ।। २७९
english: CHAPTER TEN 63 This is the (tenth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to a description of the Glory of the Vidyā. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with Kā in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: श्रीवक्रा उवाच' एकादशानन्दः वर्णदेव्याः क्रमं शम्भो वदाम्यहं यथा भवेत् । तथा कूटस्य विन्यास जपसंख्यार्घमण्डलम् ।। १॥ सृष्टिक्रमेण ऊध्वादि देव्यो' द्वात्रिंशसंयुताः । वाग्भवाद्यं ततः कृत्वा विद्यान्यासं च कौलिकम् ॥ २ ॥ मस्तके प्रथमं देयं द्वितीयं तुर्यमण्डले । तृतीयं च चतुर्थं च द्वावेतौ” नेत्रयोन्यसेत् ॥ ३॥ १३ पञ्चमं च तथा षष्ठ द्वावेतौ च भ्रुवोन्यसेत् । आज्ञास्थाने सप्तम च नासिकाग्रे तथाष्टमम् ॥ ४ ॥ o १९ २३ नवमार्णं त्रिभिर्मध्ये” वक्त्रे चैव दशाक्षरम् । २४ बीजं द्वादशमं कर्णे तथा वामे त्रयोदशम् ॥ ५ ॥ २५ कण्ठस्थाने विजानीयाद् वर्ण देव्याश्चतुर्दशम् । दक्षे पञ्चदशं स्कन्धे उत्तरे षोडश भवेत् ॥ ६ ॥ सप्तादर्श” बाहुदण्डे दक्षिणेऽष्टादशोत्तरे । एकोनविंश हृदये” विंशमं नाभिमण्डले ॥ ७ ॥
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN The Way to Offer Libation (argha) and Repeat the Vidyā. The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: 1O Śambhu, I will explain the sequence of the goddesses of the letters as it is. (Then) in the same way, (I will tell you about) the deposition of the Peak syllable, the number of repetitions of mantra (required) and the maSÆala of the argha offering.2 (1) The Sequence of the Goddesses of the Letters and their Deposition (The syllables of the Vidyā) along with the thirty-two goddesses (should be deposited) in the sequence of emission, beginning from the top.3 Then, once one has formed (the group of Five PraSavas) that begins with Vāgbhava (AI¤), (one should perform) the Kaulika deposition of the Vidyā. (2) The first (syllable) (BHA) should be placed on the head and the second (GA) in the Circle of the Fourth State (turyamaSÆala).4 The third (VA) and the fourth (TI) — these two should be deposited onto the two eyes. (3) The fifth (GHO) and sixth (RE) — these two should be deposited onto the two eyebrows. The seventh (HSKHPHRE¤) onto the location of the Command5 and the eighth (ŚRĪ¤) onto the tip of the nose. (4) The ninth syllable (KU) is between the three while the tenth (BJI) is in the mouth.6 The twelfth seed-syllable (HRĀ¤) is on the (right) ear and the thirteenth on the left (HRĪ¤). (5) Know that the fourteenth letter (HRAU¤) of the goddess is on the throat. The fifteenth (¥A) is on the right shoulder, the sixteenth (nA) on the left. (6) The seventeenth is on the right arm (¦A), the eighteenth (NA), on the left. The nineteenth (ME) is in the heart and the twentieth (A) is in the circle of the navel. (7)
