sanskrit: 66 कुमारिकाखण्ड: एकविंशं ऊरुभ्यां च द्वाविंश योनिमण्डले । •३६ ३७ त्रयोविंशारमध्ये च चतुर्विंशं तु नाडिगम् ॥ ८ ॥ सूष्मनाया महादेव स्फिजे” च पञ्चविंशमम् । दक्षिणे तु भगीशाख्य षड्विंशं” चोत्तरे स्फिजे ॥ ९ ॥ सप्ताविंशं३ चाष्टाविंशं द्वावेतौ जानुनी न्यसेत् । एकोनत्रिंश ७ त्रिंश च जङ्घयोरुभयोन्यसेत् ॥ १० ॥ एकत्रिंश च द्वात्रिंश पादे दक्षे तथोत्तरे ५३ वर्णानां देवतेदानीं द्वात्रिंशच्छुभ भैरव ॥। ११ ॥ स्वनामाक्षरभेदेन पदमन्त्रैर्विसर्पिताः । ५५ भीमा गगनवेगा च वीरदेवी चतुर्थका ॥ १२ ॥ घोरा चैव तु रक्ताक्षी कूटमुद्रा श्रेयस्तथा । कुवेर्याी कुब्जिकादेव्या कैवर्ती हरदेवता ॥ १३ ॥ हरी चैव हरानन्दा ङणनञमटेश्वरी । नागाख्या मीनदेवी च तथा चैव तु अम्बिका ॥ १४ ॥ घोरमुखी च रावा च मुसलायुधखेचरी । च्छांकारी” चैव३ छिंच्छा च किङ्किणी कुलदेवता ।। १५ ।। करङ्किणी नारायणी विमला वर्चिका तथा । ६८ ज्ञेया द्वात्रिंशतिर्देव्य : “ स्थाने स्थानेऽधिकारिण्यः ।। १६ ।। एतासु पूजितास्वेव न भूयो जन्मबन्धनम् । एतदेव” पुराख्यातं तस्योच्चार तु कौलिकम् ।। १७ ।। ७३ सा च एकाक्षरं कूटं सप्तधाज्ञा च खेचरम् । करणं षड्विध ं तस्य तत्र सिंहक्रमं भवेत् ॥ १८ ॥
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 67 The twenty-first (GHO) is on the thighs and the twenty-second (RĀ) in the circle of the Yoni. The twenty-third (MU) is in the centre of the spokes (of the wheel of the Yoni (?)). The twenty-fourth (KHI) is in the conduit (nāÆī) within SunumSā (sūnmanā) while the twenty-fifth (CHRĀ¤), called Bhagīśa, O great god, is on the right buttock, while the twenty-sixth (CHRĪ¤) is on the left buttock. (8-9) The twenty-seventh (KI) and the twenty-eighth (¦I) should be deposited on the knees. The twenty-ninth (KI) and the thirtieth (¦I) should be deposited on the two shanks. The thirty-first (VI) and the thirty-second (CCE) on the right and left foot (respectively). (10) Now, O auspicious Bhairava, (here are) the thirty-two deities of the letters that have emerged along with the parts (pada) and mantras according to the division of their own names and syllables. (11-12ab) 1) Bhīmā (Terrible) (BHA), 2) Gaganā (Sky) (GA) 3) Vegā (Force) (VA) with 4) Vīradevī (the Goddess of the Heroes) (TI) as the fourth. 5) Ghorā (Horrific) (GHO), 6) Raktāknī (Red-eyed) (RE), 7) Kū˜amudrā (Peak Gesture) (HSKHPHRE¤), 8) Śreyas (Welfare) (ŚRĪ¤), 9) Kuveryā (KU), the goddess 10) Kubjikā (BJI), 11) Kaivartā (Fisherwoman) (KE), 12) Haradevatā (Śiva's Deity) (HRĀ¤), 13) Harī (HRĪ¤), 14) Harānandā (Śiva's Bliss) (HRAU¤), 15) ¥a, 16) na, 17) ¦a, 18) Na, 19) Ma˜eśvarī, the one called Nāgā (ME), 20) Mīnadevī (the Fish Goddess) (who is) Ambikā (A), 21) Ghoramukhī (GHO), 22) Rāvā (Sound) (RĀ), 23) Musalāyudhā (She whose Weapon is a Mortar) (MU), 24) Khecarī (Skyfarer) (KHI), 25) Cchāˆkārī (She who makes the Sound Cchām) (CHRĀ¤), 26) Chiˆcchā (Tamarind) (CHRĪ¤), 27) Ki‰kiSī (Tinkle) (KI), 28) Kuladevatā (¦I) 29) Kara‰kiSī (KI) 29) NārāyaSī (¦I), 31) Vimalā (Pure) (VI), and 32) Varcikā (Radiant) (CCE).7 (12cd-16ab) One should know the thirty-two goddesses to have authority (each) in (their own) particular place.8 When they are worshipped, the bondage of birth does not occur again. (16cd-17ab) The Deposition of the Peak syllable (HSKHPHRE¤) This, as explained before, is the Kaulika (method of) the utterance (of the Vidyā).9 And that is (also) the Peak of one syllable, the sevenfold Command10 and (is called) the Skyfarer (khecara).11 The instrument (of mantra) there (in that case) pertaining to it is the sixfold Transmission of the Lion (siˆhakrama).12 (17cd-18)

sanskrit: 68 कुमारिकाखण्डः ओडियाण भ्रुवोर्मध्ये कामाख्यं शक्तिजन्मनि । शून्यं षट्कोणमध्ये तु रावपूर्णेन पूर्णकम् ॥ १९ ॥ ० तेजो जालन्धरं नाभौ तिस्राख्यं च विशुद्धिषु । तालुमध्ये तु चन्द्राख्य ं तन्मध्ये बिन्दुमण्डलम् ।। २० ।। षोडशान्ते” स्मृता आज्ञा एतत् खेचर्यनुक्रमात् । ८३ ८४ .८६ पदान्वेषणशीला“ ये जीवन्मुक्तिरताश्च ये ।। २१ ।। न तेषां पतनं देव गतास्ते पश्चिमे पदे । ९० कृत्वा त्रितयसंयोगं“ क्षिप्ता आज्ञान्तमण्डले ॥ २२ ॥ रश्मिज्वालाकदम्बं” च चिन्तयेच्च अधोमुखम् । नवलक्षकृते देव त्रैलोक्यमपि साधयेत् ।। २३ ।। ९३ कुलाचारे यथा प्रोक्तं अर्घमण्डलकं शृणु । ९४ एकान्ते विजने रम्ये एकारे पश्चिमादिशि ।। २४ ।। पशुदृष्टिविनिर्मुक्ते एकहस्तप्रमाणतः ँ । । ९९ गोमयेन प्रकर्तव्यं मण्डलं चतुरस्रकम् ॥। २५ ।। ०० १०१ । तन्मध्ये सूर्यबिम्बं तु मण्डलं वर्तुलं कुरु अलिचन्दनकाश्मीरैः” पञ्चप्रणवमन्त्रितम्' ।। २६ ।। १०४ १०३ क्षिप्त्वा पञ्चार्णविद्यां ता४ दक्षहस्ततलारुहेत्' १०५ । संयोगेन तु उत्थाप्य वामावर्तपरिभ्रमात् ।। २७ ।। मुष्टि मध्ये ततो बध्वा अखण्डमिति मण्डलम् ।
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 69 OÆiyāSa is in between the eyebrows and Kāmākhya is in the Birth of Energy (śaktijanman). PūrSaka, (i.e. PūrSagiri, so called) because it is full of Sound (rāvapūrSa), is the Void in the centre of the hexagon (na˜koSa). (19) Jālandhara is the radiant energy (tejas) in the navel, while the (sacred seat) called Tisra is in (the Wheel of) Purity (viśuddhi) (in the throat). The (seat) called Candra is in the centre of the palate and in the middle of that is the Circle of the Drop (bindumaSÆala). The Command is said to be in the End of the Sixteenth. This is in due order, (the goddess) Khecarī.13 (20-21ab) O god, those who are intent on seeking (the supreme) level (of existence) and those devoted (to the attainment of) liberation in this life (jīvanmukti), do not fall once (they) have attained the Western Plane (paścimapada).14 (21cd-22ab) Having formed the conjunction of the three,15 once the Command has been placed (kniptā) in the maSÆala at the end,16 one should think (of it) as the Kadamba (tree)17 aflame with its rays facing downwards. O god, when (the Vidyā has been recited) 900,000 times, he shall even gain control of the triple world. (22cd-23) The Fashioning of the MaSÆala and the Offering of Libation (argha)18 (Now) listen to what is said to be the MaSÆala of the Libation (argha)19 according to the practice of Kula (kulācāra).20 (24ab) (Having fashioned) the letter E in the western direction in a beautiful secluded place where there are no people, out of sight of the uninitiated (paśu), one should (then) fashion a square (caturasraka) maSÆala the size of one handspan with cow dung (and water).21 (24cd-25) In the centre of that make a round maSÆala (representing) the solar disc made of liquor, sandalwood and saffron (kāśmīra) and consecrated (mantrita) with the Five PraSavas. Having cast that Five-lettered Vidyā22 (into the square) then place the palm of the right hand (there). Having raised it in conjunction (with the Five PraSavas) by rotating (the hand) anticlockwise (around the maSÆala), and clenching it into a fist in the middle (of the maSÆala), it is (known as) the Unbroken (akhaSÆa) MaSÆala.23 (26-28ab)

sanskrit: 70 कुमारिकाखण्ड: पञ्चप्रणव' कृत्वादौ प्राकाराष्टक विन्यसेत् ॥ २८ ॥ ऐन्द्रादारभ्य देवेश दिग्दिशाष्टौ क्रमेण तु । त्रिबीजैरारुहेत् तेषां ततो हस्तं समुद्धरेत् ।। २९ ॥ दर्पणं शोधयेत् तत्र षोडशांगुलमानतः । त्रिगुण चांगुलैक तु भस्मना च विशोधयेत् ।। ३० ।। स्थापयेद्”” देव्यशस्त्रेण कवचेनावगुण्ठयेत्। त्रिकोणान्ते लिखेच्छक्तिं कौलेशीं च अधोमुखीम् ।। ३१ ।। तद्बाह्ये कारयेत् षट्कं मेखलात्रयभूषितम् । वीरपात्रमथारोप्य अनेन करणेन तु ।। ३२ ॥ तस्या”” वक्त्रषडङ्गानि सबाह्याभ्यन्तरे न्यसेत् । क्षेत्रेशवटुकाभ्यां च योगिनीनां बलित्रयम् ।। ३३ ॥ कृत्वादौ प्रारभेत् पूजां निर्विघ्ना सिद्धिरिष्यते । आनियाद्३ हेमकलश४ तदभावेन १२५ रौप्यजम् ।। ३४ ।। १२७ १२८ ताम्रजं मृन्मयं वापि निर्व्रणं सुसमं शुभम् । कम्बुग्रीवोच्छ्रितं स्वर्ण बालबालुकवर्जितम् ।। ३५ ।। उदके” पूर्वतः क्षाल्य अस्त्रराजेन शोधयेत् । अवगुण्ठ्य च वर्मेण” अलिद्रव्येण पूरयेत् ॥ ३६ ॥ १३७ स्थापयेत् कोङ्कणास्त्रेण मण्डलाग्रे महेश्वर८ । कवचेनावगुण्ठेन मूत्यावेशस्तथात्मना” ।। ३७ ।। विद्यान्यासं ततः कुर्याद् भादि चानुक्रमेण तु । क्रमार्चनमतः कुर्यात् पृथक्वर्णक्रमेण तु ।। ३८ ॥ त्रिकोणान्ते तु विन्यस्य विद्या पुष्पाञ्जलिं क्षिपेत् । संयोगेन तु विद्यायाः पीठषट्कं तु बाह्यतः ॥ ३९ ॥
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 71 Having formed the Five PraSavas at the beginning, O Lord of gods, one should deposit the eight ramparts (prākārān˜aka) in due order into the eight directions beginning with Indra’s (quarter i.e. the east). One should place (them) with three (repetitions) of their seed-syllables. Then one should raise one's hand.24 (28cd-29) Then there, one should purify the mirror,25 which measures sixteen fingers (in diameter) and is one finger (thick). (The circle is) three times (that). One should purify it with ash. Install it with the (goddess's) divine Weapon26 and envelop it within the Armour.27(30-31ab) Draw the energy Kauleśī, facing downwards, into the triangle.28 Outside that, one should cause to fashion the group of six (na˜ka) adorned with three girdles (mekhala).29 (31cd-32ab) Once the Hero's Vessel (vīrapātra) has been placed (in the maSÆala)30 with this instrument (of mantra), one should deposit the faces and six limbs of (the goddess) internally and externally. (32cd-33ab) After one has first made three meat offerings (bali) to the Lord of the Field, to Va˜uka31 and to the Yoginīs, one should start the rite of adoration (pūjā) if one wishes unobstructed success.32 (33cd-34ab) One should fetch a golden jar. If that is unavailable, (fetch) a silver one or one of copper, or even of clay (but it should be) without cracks, beautifully even and auspicious. It (should have a thick) neck like a conch and be tall, golden and free of (polluting) hair and sand. (34cd-35) Having first washed it in water, it should be purified it with the King of Weapons (astrarāja) and once it has been wrapped within the Armour, it should be filled with liquor (alidravya). (36) O great lord, place it in front of the maSÆala with the Weapon of Ko‰kaSa and, by enveloping (it with) the Armour and by means of the Self, the image (of the deity) penetrates (into it) (mūrtyāveśa).33 (37) Then deposit the Vidyā in due order beginning with Bha. Then one should perform the worship of the Krama (kramārcana) according to the order of the individual letters (of the Vidyā). Having deposited the Vidyā into the triangle, throw a handful of flowers (into the maSÆala). Outside the Vidyā and in conjunction (with it), (deposit) the six sacred seats.34 (38-39)

sanskrit: 72 कुमारिकाखण्ड: पञ्चप्रणवसंयुक्ता ॐकारे पश्चिमे दले । आग्नेया ४२ जालपीठं तु नैर्ऋत्यां ४३ पौर्णगिर्यकम् ॥ ४० ॥ पूर्वकोणे तु कामाख्यं वायुकोणे तु तिस्रकम् । ।। ईशाने कोङ्कण नाम उलिसिद्धाश्रय पुनः ।। ४१ त्रिष्कोणे तु भगीशाख्यः पूजितव्य : क्रमेण तु । १४८ सिद्धाङ्गपञ्चक“” मध्ये षडङ्गं तु षडस्रके ॥ ४२ ॥ हृदयं कामरूपे तु शिर: १५२ पूर्णगिरिः स्मृतम्' १५४ १५३ । १५० शिखा जालन्धरे पीठे कवचं तिस्रसंज्ञके ॥ ४३ ॥ नेत्रमोंकारपीठे तु अस्त्र चैव तु कोंकणे । १५८ । १६२ तद्द्बाह्ये मेखलायां तु श्लोकानि द्वादशार्चयेत् ॥ ४४ ॥ अकारादिविसर्गीन्ता५७ स्वरचक्रेशिमेखला ' कादिभान्तक्रमे सिद्धिर्द्वितीया बाह्यमेखला ।। ४५ ।। मादिसान्ता तृतीया च एतद् वै वर्णराशिकम् । मलयाधिवासितैः पुष्पैः श्वेतैः कुंकुमचर्चितैः ॥ ४६ ॥ दर्पणे च पुरा शुद्धैस्तथा सर्वोषधीषु च । सुगन्धेन तु धूपेन गोधूमादिकदीपकैः ५ ।। ४७ । त्रिविधेन तु मद्येन क्षीरोदनगुडौदनैः । मांसौदनैस्त्रिभिर्देव६९ आममांसेन कर्दमैः ।। ४८ ॥ कुब्जिकाक्रममेतद्धि पूजयित्वा निवेदयेत् । -१७१ १७२ कलश पूजयेत् पश्चात् विद्यापुष्पांजलित्रिभिः १७३ ।। ४९ ।। चन्दनं कुंकुमादीनि आत्मानं च निवेदयेत् । १७५ ततोऽप्यर्घं च पुष्पानि ७४ द्वात्रिंशाक्षरसंख्यया' ॥ ५० ॥ १७७ जानुनी उभयौं भूमौ क्षिप्त्वा चार्घं तु विद्यया' । विनिवेद्य महाचक्रे जपसंख्यामुदीरयेत् ।। ५१ । अम्बे सिद्धे तथाघोरे देहि मां परमेश्वरि । ममेप्सितां महासिद्धिं सर्वकामफलोदयाम् ।। ५२ ॥
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 73 (The Vidyā), conjoined with the Five PraSavas, (should be) deposited onto the western petal which is that of (the sacred seat of) O¤ (i.e. OÆÆiyāna). The sacred seat Jāla is in the south-east. (The seat of) PūrSagiryaka is in the south- west. Kāmākhya is in the eastern corner. Tisraka is in the north-west corner and Ko‰koSa is in the north-east. Again, the abode of the Siddhas of the (three) lineages (uli) (should be deposited) into the triangle. (Then), in due order, one should worship (the god) called Bhagīśa.35 (40-42ab) The group of five limbs of the Siddhas (i.e. the Five PraSavas) is in the centre, while the six-limbed is in the six spokes. The Heart is in Kāmarūpa, while the Head is said to be PūrSagiri. The Topknot is in the sacred seat of Jālandhara, the Armour in (the seat) called Tisra. The Eye is in the sacred seat of the syllable O¤ and the Weapon is in KoˆkaSa.36 (42cd-44ab) Outside that one should worship the Twelve Verses in the enclosure (mekhalā). (The first) girdle, that of the mistress of the Wheel of the Vowels, begins with the letter A and ends with Emission (visarga). The second outer girdle consists of the accomplishment (attainable) in the sequence (of letters) beginning with Ka and ending with Bha. The third (enclosure) consists of (the letters) from Ma to Sa. This indeed is the aggregate of letters (varSarāśika).37 (44cd-46ab) (The maSÆala should then be worshipped) with pure, white flowers, perfumed with sandal (malaya) and smeared with vermilion. (They are offered) first to the mirror with all the herbs, sweet-smelling incense, lamps (made of) wheat (pastry) (godhūma) and the rest, three kinds of wine, the three kinds of cooked rice, namely, those made with milk, raw sugar and meat, along with raw meat and (varieties of) rice (kardama). After it has been worshipped, one should make food offerings (nivedayet) to this, the Kubjikā Krama.38 (46cd-49ab) After that, one should worship the jar with three handfuls of flowers and the Vidyā. One should make offerings of sandalwood, vermilion and the rest and one's self (ātman) as well as water (argha) and flowers numbering thirty-two (an amount equal to) the syllables (of the Vidyā). (49cd-50) Placing both knees on the ground and having offered water (argha) along with the Vidyā to the Great Wheel, one should say (the following as many) number of times as one repeats the Vidyā (japasaˆkhyā). (51) “O mother! Siddhā! Aghorā! O Supreme Goddess, give me the Great Accomplishment that I desire, which is the arising of the fruit of all desires!”39 (52)

sanskrit: 74 कुमारिकाखण्ड: कुमार्यष्टौ ” ततः पूज्याः षट्क च त्रयमेका वा' १८४ १८२ । ततः सिद्धि ३ लभेन्मन्त्री आदिपर्वे न संशयः ।। ५३ ।। ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतं कुर्यात् कामक्रोधादि घातयेत् । तत:“ सिद्धिर्न संदेहो सेवनाद् गतिरिष्यते ।। ५४ ॥ १८७ सहस्रादि च लक्षान्तं जपसंख्याविधिं शृणु । वामपाण्यक्षमाला या स्फाटिकैरथ पुत्रकैः ॥ ५५ ॥ पद्माक्षैवी प्रकर्तव्या यथालाभेन कारयेत् । अक्षसूत्रमलाभेन पाणिना जप्यमारभेत् ।। ५६ ।। १९१ आगमार्थविधानेन वामावर्तपरिभ्रमात् । तर्जनीवाममूलात् ” तु पूर्वारभ्य महेश्वर ।। ५७ ।। । उपदेशं गुरोर्वक्त्राज्जपसिद्धि४ लभेत्”“ क्रमात् । स्थूलं वाप्यथ सूक्षमं वा न मेरुं लङ्घयेत् करे ।। ५८ ।। । वर्जयित्वा तु तज्ज्येष्ठ” कुर्यात् प्रान्त चतुष्टयम् । पर्वसंख्याकृत” जप्यं मध्यमोभौ तु वर्जयेत् ।। ५९ । २०० एवं क्रमविधानेन वामावर्तपरिभ्रमात् । २०१ २०२ •२०३ • २०४ २०५ गमागमेन मनसा हृद्गतं गमनं कुरु ।। ६० ।। पूरकेन स्वकीयेन मन कुम्भे प्रकल्पयेत्” । रेचयित्वा ततः सिद्धिरिहलोके परत्र च ।। ६१ ।। २१२ यावदक्षरसंख्या च”” तावत् कुर्याच्च कुम्भकम् । वायुना सह वेगेन करोत्यावेशमुत्तमम् ।। ६२ ।
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 75 Then one should worship eight virgins (kumārī), six, three or one. Thus the one who recites mantra will undoubtedly achieve success (siddhi) at the first auspicious time (ādiparvan). One should observe a vow of chastity and destroy lust, anger and the rest. Then without any doubt (one attains) success and, by practice (sevana), the (supreme) state (gati).40 (53-54) The Repetition of the Vidyā with the aid of the Left Hand41 (Now) listen to the prescription concerning the enumeration of the repetition of the Vidyā commencing with one thousand up to one hundred thousand (repetitions).42 (55ab) The rosary for the left hand should be made of crystals, Putraka43 or lotus seeds. One should have it made according to the (material one has managed to) obtain (and afford). If one cannot get a rosary then one should practice the required repetition (of the Vidyā) (japya) with (the aid of one's) hand. O Great Lord, in accord with the method (laid down) by the teaching of the scripture, (this is done) by moving (the thumb) in an anticlockwise direction (vāmāvartaparibhrama), starting initially from the root of the left index finger.44 (55cd-57) One should get the teaching from the teacher's mouth and success in the repetition of the Vidyā progressively. Whether (the repetition) is gross or subtle45 one should not cross over Meru on the hand.46 (58) Omitting the middle finger (jyen˜ha) (count the repetitions up to the end) of the group of four (phalanges) at the end (of the little finger). Both (fingers) in the middle (of the hand) should be omitted (in the returning movement). The repetition is done according to the number of phalanges (parvan) (traversed).47 (59) In this way, by moving in an anticlockwise direction in accord with the prescribed sequence, by the going and coming48 mentally fix the movement in the Heart. (60) By means of one’s own inhaled breath (pūraka), mentally station (prakalpayet) the mind (manas) in the (inwardly) retained breath (kumbhaka). Having exhaled, (one obtains) success (siddhi) in this world and the next. (61) One should practice retention of the breath (for a period of time) according to the number of letters (of the Vidyā).49 (In this way) by means of the force (vega) (of intent) along with the breath (vāyu), (the yogi) brings about the most excellent (form of) penetration (āveśa).50 (62)

sanskrit: 76 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २१३ अनेनैव विधानेन न द्रुतं न विलम्बितम् । २१५ मध्यचारगतिं ज्ञात्वा जपं कुर्यात् त्रयोलिषु ॥ ६३ ॥ ५ एवं पाणिकृतं जप्यं उत्तमं परिकीर्तितम् । २१६ अक्षसूत्रेण वा देव माहात्म्यमथवा शृणु ।। ६४ ॥ २१७ २१८ सहस्रेण तु जप्तेन प्राप्तः शत्रुः परामुखः । २२० द्विभिः ९ प्रवर्तते तेजस्त्रिभिरैश्वर्यसंपदः ॥ ६५ ॥ २२२ चतुर्भिर्जनसौभाग्य आयुरारोग्यं पञ्चभिः । ज्ञानप्राप्तिर्भवेत्”” षड्भिरवस्था सप्तभिर्भवेत् ।। ६६ ।। अष्टाभिः २२४ पश्यते२५ किञ्चिद् दिव्यरूपं कुलात्मकम् नवभिर्लभते योगं७ निर्वाणं खेचरक्रमम् ।। ६७ ।। २३१ दशभिर्वर्तते वेध” मुद्रास्फोट तु विंशभि: । २३२ २३३ २२६ मारणं त्रिंशभिश्चैव चत्वारिंशभिः स्तम्भनम् ।। ६८ ।। रणे राजकुले द्यूते विवादे शत्रुमध्यतः । २३५ ॥ ६९ ॥ शिलानां भेदनं स्तोभ २४ वृक्षाणां पातनं तथा ' पञ्चाशद्भि:३६ सहस्रैस्तु जपितैर्नात्र संशयः । षष्टिभिश्च३७ सहस्रैस्तु ३८ देवकन्या ९ तिलोत्तमा वशं याति न” संदेहो मानुषेषु ४२ च का कथा ' २४४ २४० २४३ २४६ राजानः मण्डलीकास्तु अन्तःपुरनिवासिनः ये चान्ये २४७ मानवा लोके आज्ञाश्रवणतत्पराः ' २४८ । ।। ७० ।। ।। ७१ ।।
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 77 Knowing the manner of the modality of the medium movement, (the practice of which) according to this method (vidhāna) is neither (too) fast nor (too) slow, one should practice the repetition of Vidyā in the three Lineages (trayoli).51 The recitation of Vidyā done with the (aid of) the hand in this way is said to be the best.52 (63-64ab) The Benefits of Reciting the Vidyā O god, alternatively, listen to the glory (of the recitation of Vidyā done) with (the aid of a) rosary.53 (64cd) By reciting (the Vidyā) a thousand times, the enemy one encounters (becomes) averse (to fight). (Recited) two (thousand times), brilliant energy (tejas) is generated.54 (Recited) three (thousand times), (one attains) the wealth of sovreignty. (Recited) four (thousand times), the well-being of the people.55 (Recited) five (thousand times), long life and good health. (Recited) six (thousand times), one obtains knowledge. (Recited) seven (thousand times, it generates) a higher state. (Recited) eight (thousand times), he sees something divine of the nature of Kula.56 (Recited) nine (thousand times), he achieves Yoga, NirvāSa and the Transmission of the Skyfarer (khecarakrama). (65-67) (Recited) ten (thousand times), the perforation (of the psychic centres) (vedha) (takes place). (Recited) twenty (thousand times), (the power to bring about) explosions by a gesture (mudrāspho˜a)57 (is attained). (Recited) thirty (thousand times, it brings about) the death (of an enemy). (Recited) forty (thousand times, it brings about) the paralysis (of the enemy)58 in battle, in the king's family (and that of an adversary) when gambling, (during) a dispute or in the midst of (one's) enemies. (68-69ab) By reciting the Vidyā fifty thousand times, without a doubt, stones burst apart, (enemies) are paralysed (stobha) and trees fall.59 By sixty thousand (repetitions), undoubtedly (even) Tilottamā, the celestial maiden (devakanyā), comes under one's control, so what to say of (the women) among men?60 Kings, (their) vassals, those who dwell in (their palaces') inner chamber and all the other people in the world who are intent on listening to (their) command (are all brought under one’s control). (69cd-71ab) O god, by (reciting the Vidyā) seventy thousand times, one controls (demonic beings called) Vetālas and the demon Mahināsura as well as the (world of) moving and immobile (beings). (71cd-72ab)

sanskrit: 78 कुमारिकाखण्डः सप्ततिभि:४९ सहस्रैश्च वेतालान्यभिसाधयेत् ।। ७२ ।। तथा चराचरं देव५९ महिषासुरदानवम् । २५२ -२५५ ब्रह्मा सम्पद्यते मूर्ती स्वयंरूपेण ५४ देहिना ॥ ७३ ॥ पाताले भुञ्जते भोगान् कन्याभिः सह क्रीडते । २५७ २५८ अशीतिभिः सहस्रैस्तु”° जपितैनात्र संशयः २६१ .२६३ २५९ ।। ७४ ।। । २६७ नवतिभिर्भवेद्`” विष्णुः स्वयं मत्यतनुः प्रियं पृथिव्याधिपतिर्भूत्वा एकच्छत्रेण भुञ्जते ।। ७५ ।। लक्षैकेन २६४ स्वयं रुद्रो २६५ भवे २६ तिष्ठति मानवः विमानं तस्य चायाति पञ्चचामरभूषितम् ।। ७६ ।। देव्यष्टकसमोपेतं चतुःषष्टिभिरावृतम् । २६८ २६९ । वेष्टितं बहुभिः सिद्धैस्तारानक्षत्रमण्डलैः ।। ७७ ।। भवेत् कलौ महासिद्धः साधको विद्यया युतः । व्रजते २७° च खमार्गेण यत्रस्था भैरवी स्वयम् ।। ७८ ॥ वसते२७९ तत्र मध्ये तु भवते अजरामरः । यथाहं देवदेवेश तथासौ साधकोत्तमः ।। ७९ ॥ इच्छारूपधरः श्रीमान् लक्षजापेन खेचरः । २७३ त्रैलोक्ये २७२ क्रीडतेऽसौ वै कामरूपी महाबलः ।। ८० ।। क्षणाच्च शाङ्करं रूपं क्षणाद् रूपं च वैष्णवम् । क्षणाद् ब्राह्मं च ऐन्द्रं च सौरं चान्द्रं क्षणेन तु ॥ ८१ ॥ क्षणान्नारायणं रूपं क्षणाद् वै मारुतं भवेत् । क्षणाच्चापि ज्वलद्रूपं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं क्षणात् क्षणात् ।। ८२ ।। २७४ क्षणात् पक्षिणमाकाशे क्षणात् सिंह २७५ महावने । २७७ मार्जार ७६ च शृगालं च श्वानमुष्ट्र च गर्दभम् ।। ८३ ।। वृषं चैव तु मेषं च उलूकं च तथैव च । व्याघ्रं चैव तु ऋक्षं च मृगं वाथ महाद्विपम् ॥ ८४ ॥ २७८ क्षणाच्च मानुषे लोके नानारूपधरो भवेत् ।
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 79 By reciting (the Vidyā) eighty thousand times, the embodied being attains Brahmā in (his embodied) form as his own form and, without a doubt, he enjoys the pleasures in the lower world and sports (there) with young women. (72cd-74) (By reciting the Vidyā) ninety thousand times, O dear one, the embodied mortal becomes VinSu himself,61 and having become the king of the earth enjoys it (all, keeping it under the protection of his royal) parasol alone. (75) (By reciting the Vidyā) one hundred thousand times, a man abides as Rudra himself in (this) world (of bondage) (bhava).62 His vehicle comes (to fetch him) decorated with five chowries,63 accompanied by the eight (mother) goddesses, surrounded by the sixty-four (Yoginīs) and many Siddhas along with the circles of stars and constellations. (76-77) The adept who is yoked to the Vidyā is (indeed) a great Siddha in the Age of Strife. He moves by the path of the sky and lives there, free from old age and death, in the midst (of these beings) where Bhairavī herself resides. (78-79ab) O God of the gods, this, the best of adepts, is as I am. By reciting the Vidyā one hundred thousand times he possesses royal power (śrī),64 flies (khecara) and assumes whatever form he pleases. (79cd-80ab) Indeed, this mighty one, whose form is as he pleases (kāmarūpin), plays in the triple world. In an instant (he can assume) Śa‰kara's form, in an instant VinSu's, in a moment Brahmā's, in a moment that of Indra, the Sun and the Moon, in a moment NarāyaSa's, in an instant it is that of the wind. (80cd-82ab) And in an instant (he can assume) a burning form. In an instant he is gross, one moment later, subtle. In a moment (he is) a bird in the sky, in an instant a lion in a great forest, a cat, a jackel, dog, camel, donkey, bull, ram, owl, tiger, bear, deer or a great elephant. In an instant he assumes many forms in the world of men.65 (82cd-85ab)

sanskrit: 60 80 कुमारिकाखण्ड: एवं संजायते सिद्धिर्भवते अजरामरः ।। ८५ ॥ निश्चयात्° लक्षजापेन साधकस्य तु खेगतिः । यत्र यत्र मनो याति तत्र तत्र महाश्रियः ॥ ८६ ॥ २८१ •२८२ यद् यद् कामयते कामं तत् तत् क्षणात् प्रवर्तते २८३ न तस्य दुर्गमं स्थानं भ्रमतेऽसौ पतङ्गवत् ।। ८७ ।। मत्तमातङ्गयूथानां हनत्येकोऽपि २५ केशरी । तथासौ भवदेवानां हनति साधकोत्तमः ॥ ८८ ॥ २८७ त्वत्तुल्यः साधकेन्द्रस्तु विद्ययाभ्यसनाद् भवेत् । २९० एकवृक्षे श्मशाने च गत्वा चैव चतुष्पथे ।। ८९ ॥ अटव्यां निर्जने स्थाने शून्ये देवगृहे तु च । एषु स्थानेषु कर्तव्यं विद्याजापमनन्तकम् ॥ ९० ॥ पूजाकाले तु सुभग ९३ निशाचारेण कौलवित् । २९२ २९४ २९१ परिभ्राजितचित्तस्य संसारे विरतात्मनः ॥ ९१ ॥ तस्यैषा सिद्धिराख्याता विद्याराधनकर्मणि । न च मायावृतस्यैव गृहस्थस्य तु भैरव ।। ९२ ॥ गृहे सिद्धिस्तथा नैव भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् । २९६ २९५ । इहैव जीवलोकेऽस्मिन् जीवन्मुक्ता न संशयः ।। ९३ ।। विद्यापूजारता ये तु तन्मनास्तत्परायणाः । गत्वा वै आदिपीठे तु अथवा पूर्णगिर्यके ।। ९४ ।। जालाख्ये त्वथवा देव तथा श्रीकामरूपके । २९७ २९८ सिद्ध्यन्ते च न संदेहो न तेषां परिवेदना ।। ९५ ॥
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 81 In this way (he gets) success (siddhi) and he is free from old age and death. By one hundred thousand repetitions of the Vidyā, the adept certainly (achieves) flight.66 (85cd-86ab) (He acquires) great royal powers wherever his mind goes and whatever he desires occurs that very moment. (86cd-87ab) He wonders (free) as a bird and there is no place hard for him to reach. Even a single lion (can) kill herds of mad elephants; just so, he, the most excellent of adepts, kills the (false) gods of conditioned existence (bhavadeva). By practicing with the Vidyā, the king of adepts becomes equal to you.67 (87cd-89ab) O handsome knower of Kaula, one should practice the repetition of the Vidyā which has no end (in conjunction) with the nocturnal practice (niśācāra) when the rite of adoration is performed.68 (This should be done) once one has gone to (any of the) following places: (a desert where there is only a) solitary tree, a cremation ground, a crossroad, a forest, a place without people or empty (abandoned) temples.69 (89cd-91ab) This, the aforesaid accomplishment (siddhi) (attained) through the act of worshipping the Vidyā, belongs to one who is detached (from the things) in the world of transmigration and whose mind is well illumined. (91cd-92ab) O Bhairava, the householder shrouded by Māyā70 does not possess accomplishment in the home and he does not attain worldly benefits (bhukti) or liberation (there). (92cd-93ab) (But) those who are devoted to the worship of the Vidyā, intent on that, their mind (given solely to) that, are without a doubt liberated while living (jīvanmukta) in this world of living beings. Once they have gone, O god, to either the First Seat,71 PūrSagiryaka, the place called Jāla or the venerable Kāmarūpaka, they certainly achieve the goal (there) and they have no troubles. (93cd-95)

sanskrit: 82 कुमारिकाखण्ड: यस्य एषा महाविद्या मुखे तिष्ठति नित्यशः । स सर्वविघ्ननिर्मुक्तो जयं सर्वत्र आप्नुयात् ।। ९६ ।। २९९ रणे राजकुले द्यूते शत्रुमध्ये जलाग्निषु । अटव्यां विषमे दुर्गे तथा चौरपथेषु च ।। ९७ ।। वृश्चिके विषसर्पेषु गजोन्मत्तवृषेषु च । उल्कापाते च दिग्दाघे योगिनीगणमध्यतः ॥ ९८ ॥ निशाचारैकवृक्षे' वा वज्रपाते चतुष्पथे । संग्रामे समये चक्रे पीठे क्षेत्रे त्वेवादिषु ।। ९९ ॥ ३०५ शुभं च प्रप्नुयाद् योगी ४ अस्य विद्याप्रभावतः । ३०६ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान्भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते विद्याजप्यार्घ- विधानो नामानन्दः ॥। ११ ॥
english: CHAPTER ELEVEN 83 He who has this great Vidyā always on his lips is free of all obstacles and is victorious everywhere, whether in battle, the king's family, gambling or in the midst of enemies. (96) By the power of his Vidyā, the yogi attains what is auspicious, (even) in fire or water, in a dangerous forest, in a fort, on roads plied by robbers, in the presence of a scorpion, poisonous snakes, elephants and mad bulls, when a meteor falls, when (there is a huge fire that) burns in all directions, in the midst of a troup of Yoginīs, while wandering about at night, in (a desert where there is only) a solitary tree, when lightning falls, at a crossroad, during a battle, in the assembly of initiates (cakra), in a sacred seat, in a sacred area (knetra) and so too in other such (places).72 (97-100ab) This is the (eleventh) chapter called the Prescribed Way to Offer Libation (argha) and Repeat the Vidyā. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: द्वादशानन्दः श्रीवक्रा उवाच' जय' भवति देवेश यस्य विद्या हृदि स्थिता । सुखमारोग्यकल्याण चिरायुः शौर्यवृत्तिश्च ॥ १ ॥ प्रभा दीप्तिश्च कान्तिश्च विद्ययाभ्यसनाद्' भवेत् । भविष्यति न संदेहो का चिन्ता मरणे रणे ॥ २ ॥ ७ यस्य विद्या' भवेत् सिद्धा दुर्लभा महतारिका १२ तस्य सिद्धि ?” करे बद्धा स सिद्धो नात्र संशयः ।। ३ ।। गोहत्यानां सहस्रैकं लक्षैक'' ब्रह्महत्यानाम्” । १६ तथान्ये मायजाः पापा: नश्यन्ते नात्र संशयः ॥ ४ ॥ .२० विद्या स्मरितमात्रा या अशुभं च विनश्यति । मिष्टान्नभोजनं पानं दिव्यभोग” रसायनम् ॥ ५ ॥ शयनं चोत्तमं यानं वस्त्राभरणभूषणम् सकृत्स्मरणमात्रेण” विद्यावेशात् प्रवर्तते ॥ ६ ॥ पदार्थमर्थविज्ञान” सर्वस्वं पुत्रपौत्रकम् २१ २२ । २५ परमार्थ' परं ज्ञानं विद्यावेशात् प्रवर्तते ॥ ७ ॥ परं तत्त्वं परावस्था परं योगमरूपकम् । परं सौभाग्यमतुल” विद्यावेशात् प्रवर्तते ।। ८ ।। पराज्ञा परमानन्दं परं वाग्भवशासनम् । सकृत्स्मरणमात्रेण” विद्यावेशात् प्रवर्तते ।। ९ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWELVE The Glory of the Vidyā. The Benefits of Reciting the Vidyā The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O lord of the gods, he in whose heart the Vidyā abides is victorious. By practicing with the Vidyā (he attains) happiness, health and good fortune; he has a long life and is couragious. (By practicing the Vidyā he gains) light, brilliance and beauty. He will certainly (continue to exist forever, and so) what worry (can he have) when dying (or) in battle? (1-2) He whose Vidyā, Mahantārikā, difficult to acquire, has been accomplished, holds success (siddhi) firmly in (his) hand and is, without a doubt, an accomplished yogi (siddha).1 (3) A thousand bovinicides, a hundred thousand brahminicides and (all) the other sins born of Māyā are certainly destroyed. (4) That is the (true) Vidyā which, merely by recalling it, destroys (all that is) inauspicious. Merely by recalling it once, by the penetration of the Vidyā (the adept obtains) delicious food to eat as well as, drink, divine enjoyment, life-giving medicine (rasāyana),2 a bed, an excellent vehicle, ornaments and clothes. (5-6) Penetration (āveśa) by the Vidyā brings about (the acquisition all that is) substantial (padārtha), knowledge of reality, wealth, sons, grandsons, the supreme goal (of life) (paramārtha), supreme knowledge, the supreme principle, the supreme state, the supreme formless Yoga and supreme, unequalled good fortune. (7-8) Merely by recalling it once, the penetration (āveśa) of the Vidyā brings about (the realisation of) the supreme Command, supreme bliss and the teaching (śāsana) concerning Vāgbhava, which is supreme.3 (9)

sanskrit: 86 कुमारिकाखण्ड: शाम्भवं शक्तिविज्ञानं वैष्णवं सौरसंहिता । ३४a ३४b बौद्धादि आरहन्ताश्च ॥ चान्द्रायणपरायणम्' ॥ १० ॥ क्षुभ्यन्ति च षडङ्गानि विद्यावेशान्न चान्यथा । ३८ शैवसिद्धादिसिद्धान्ता ँ लाकुलास्तुम्बुरादयः ॥ ११ ॥ नित्यातन्त्रादिका ये” च विद्यावेशात् प्रवर्तते । ४२ ४० वैदिकं गारुडं तन्त्र” सुतन्त्रशब्दलक्षणम् ॥ १२ ॥ योगं” परमनिर्वाणं विद्यावेशात्” प्रवर्तते । यत् सर्वसात्विक ज्ञानं मत्यलोके व्यवस्थितम् ॥ १३ ॥ सकृत्स्मरणमात्रेण विद्यावेशात् प्रवर्तते । ४८ ये“ केचिच्छास्त्रसंघाता” नित्यातन्त्रादि सर्वशः ॥ १४ ॥ क्षुभ्यन्ति देवदेवेश विद्यया परमेश्वर । ५५ तावत्” गर्जन्ति ं तन्त्राणि स्वच्छन्दादीन्यनेकशः ।। १५ ।। द्वात्रिंशाक्षरविद्याया: कला नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् । ६१ यथा दन्तिसहस्राणि° सिंहस्यैव परामुखाः ॥ १६ ॥ ६२ ६३ तथा विद्याश्च मन्त्राश्च विमुखाः प्राप्तविद्यया । निशायां च शशिर्यद्वत्” आप्यायेत् सचराचरम् ॥ १७ ॥ तथैषा पूर्णभेदेन आप्यायनकरी भवेत् । ६८ यथा दीप: प्रदीप्तस्तु अन्धकार विनाशयेत् ॥ १८ ॥ तेषां च पटलं घोरं छेदयेन्नात्र संशयः । ७४ तथा श्रीश्रीकुजाविद्या षट्प्रकारा वरानन दहते नात्र संदेहो देहस्थ पापसंचय । ॥ १९ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWELVE 87 (One realises) Śiva's (state) (śāmbhava), the knowledge of (his) energy, VinSu's (state), (the teachings of) the scripture of the Sun (saurasaˆhitā), (the ideal of) the Buddhists etc. and the Jains (ārahanta) and (one goes) beyond the path of the Moon. By the penetration of the Vidyā, and in no other way, the six limbs (of the body) are aroused. (10-11ab) Penetration by the Vidyā gives rise to the Siddhānta (schools) of the Śaivas, the Siddhas and the rest, the Lākula (Paśupata schools) and the Tumburu (Tantras), as well as the Nityā Tantras4 and the like.5 (11cd-12ab) Penetration by the Vidyā gives rise to the (knowledge of) the Veda, the GāruÆa Tantra, the (reality which is) the sign of the good words of the Tantra, Yoga and the supreme NirvāSa.6 (12cd-13ab) Merely by recalling it once, penetration by the Vidyā brings about (the knowledge) of all that every creature in the mortal world knows. (13cd-14ab) O Lord of the gods, whatever be the class of scriptures (śāstrasaˆghāta), whether it be the Nityātantra or the like, (they are all) aroused (and made potent) in every way, O Supreme Lord, by (this) Vidyā. (14cd-15ab) The Svacchanda and other Tantras repeatedly proclaim that they are not worth (even) a sixteenth part of the Thirty-Two Lettered Vidyā. (15cd-16ab) Just as (even) a thousand elephants turn away from (just one) lion, so (all other) Vidyās and mantras avert themselves once (this) Vidyā has been obtained. (16cd-17ab) This (Vidyā) in its full form (pūrSabheda) nourishes just as the moon at night nourishes (itself) along with the moving and immobile (universe). (17cd-18ab) (This Vidyā) certainly pierces through the terrible covering of those (shrouded in ignorance), just as a well lit lamp destroys darkness. (18cd-19ab) In the same way, O fair-faced one, the venerable sixfold (na˜prakārā)7 Vidyā of the venerable (goddess) Kujā certainly burns away the sin accumulated in the body. (19cd-20ab)

sanskrit: 88 कुमारिकाखण्ड: शुभाशुभं च यत् कर्म सप्तजन्मान्तरार्जितम् ।। २० ॥ तत् सर्वं विलयं याति” विद्याभ्यासान्न संशयः । ८२ ये केचित्” शास्त्रसंघाता मन्त्रा विद्याद्यनेकशः ।। २१ ।। तस्य विद्याप्रभावस्य कला नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् । श्रीनाथ उवाच ९० युक्तमुक्त ँ प्रभावोऽयं“ विद्याभ्यासेन नान्यथा ।। २२ । परं जप्यरतानां तु किं न सिद्ध्यन्ति साधकाः ' तत् किमर्थं” महादेवि” संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि ।। २३ ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच ९५ । मानवा दुर्भगा देव विद्याहंकारगर्विताः । जातिशीलविनिर्मुक्ता ँ अगम्यगमनोद्यताः “ ।। २४ । 00 अभक्ष्यभक्षणरताः” कलहन्ति यतस्ततः । प्राणिभङ्गं प्रकुर्वन्ति बहुलोभसमन्विताः ।। २५ ।। बहुकामप्रसक्ताश्च' ं” बहुशास्त्रार्थचिन्तकाः ३ । २ ०५ उद्ग्राहयन्ति तर्कीर्थं विवदन्ति परस्परम् ।। २६ ।। १०७ महामायाविमोहेन अर्थसंग्रहणादिषु । कुकर्माणि“ प्रकुर्वन्ति निन्दा” राग चरन्ति च ।। २७ ।। समयानि”” न मन्यन्ते गुर्वाज्ञालोपकारकाः । गुरुद्रोहं प्रकुर्वन्ति समयद्रोह१२ वरानन३ ।। २८ ।। ११५ तेन े ते सिद्धिनिर्मुक्ताः विद्ययाभ्यासनादपि' । तपोभ्रष्टा नरा ये च तेषां संख्या न विद्यते ।। २९ ।। ११७ तृप्ता मद्येन मांसेन परस्त्रीरमणोत्सुकाः । १२० अगम्यगमनाद्” देव भुक्तिमुक्तिर्न विद्यते ।। ३० ।।
english: CHAPTER TWELVE 89 All Karma, whether auspicious or inauspicious, generated in the course of seven lives certainly dissolves away, by practicing the Vidyā.8 (20cd-21ab) Whatever the scriptures, mantras and Vidyās of many types, they are not equal to (even) a sixteenth part of the power of his Vidyā. (21cd-22ab) Reasons for the Failure of the Vidyā Śrīnātha said: It has been rightly said that this power (comes) by the practice of the Vidyā and not otherwise. But, why is it that adepts who are devoted to the Vidyā (japya) do not attain the supreme? O great goddess, why is that? Please remove (my) doubt. (22cd-23) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: 9O god, men are unfortunate, they are proud because of (their) knowledge and ego. They do not behave correctly in accord with their caste status (jātiśilā) and are intent on going where they should not go.10 (24) They are devoted to eating what should not be eaten and quarrel (amongst themselves) and so commit murders. They are full of greed and are attached to many pleasures. They think of the meaning of many scriptures (but to no avail) and they (attempt) to fathom (the depths) of logic and quarrel with one another. (25-26) Deluded by the great Māyā (of the world), they behave badly in order to accumulate wealth and the like. They censor (others) and cultivate attachment. They do not respect the rules of religion (samaya) and they disobey the teacher's commands. O fair-faced one, they do violence to (their) teacher and the rules of religion. (27-28) So, even though they practice with the Vidyā, they have no success (siddhi). (Such) men who have fallen from (their practice of) austerity are innumerable. (29) They are satisfied with meat and wine and keen to enjoy (sexual pleasure) with other (mens') women. By going to where one ought not go, (one obtains) neither worldly enjoyment (bhukti) nor liberation. (30)

sanskrit: 90 90 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १२४ श्वपचास्ते२१ समाख्याताः२२ प्राकृताः१२३ श्वानकुक्कुटाः । पिबन्ति स्वेच्छया मद्यं मांसं खादन्ति स्वेच्छया ।। ३१ ।। १२७ अगम्यगमनं यान्ति अज्ञानपटलावृताः । न तेषां मुक्तिरस्तीह संयमान्मुक्तिरिष्यते ।। ३२ ॥ १२८ बहुपानात् कुतो मुक्तिरिच्छाभोगे” तथैव च । १३१ अगम्यगमनाचाराद्” अभक्षस्य च भक्षणात् ।। ३३ ।। विकर्मणा कुतो मुक्तिरर्थलोभात् कुतो भवेत् । १३३ १३४ पापिष्ठा” दर्पदुष्टानां दूषका तन्त्रवादिनाम् ॥ ३४ ॥ कुमार्गेषु प्रसक्ताना न सिद्धिर्विद्यते क्वचित् । १३८ आगमार्थविनिर्मुक्ता: समयाचारलोपकाः ।। ३५ ।। न तेषां साधने” सिद्धिर्न च ते मोक्षभाजनाः । १४० १४१ एवंभूतगुणाः शिष्याः साधकाचार्यपुत्रकाः ।। ३६ ।। २ विद्याराधनशीला हि१४३ भवन्ते सिद्धिभाजना: १४५ गुरुभक्ता विनीताश्च समयाचारपालकाः ।। ३७ ।। द्वैताचारपदारूढा मकारत्रयवर्जिताः । १४६ १४७ निर्लोभा: सदयाः शान्ता:४८ नित्यानन्दरताः सदा ॥ ३८ ॥ १५० आगमार्थरता धीराः तर्कशास्त्रमुपेक्षकाः १५३ १५१ । अनुरक्ताश्च २ भक्ताश्च सर्वजीवदयापरा: ।। ३९ ।। एवंगुणविशिष्टा ये सिद्ध्यन्ते ह्यविचारत: १५४ १५८ एतेषां सिद्ध्यते विद्या ५६ अन्येषां न कदाचन' ।। ४० ।। १६० पारम्पर्यागता विद्या अर्धसंस्कारमण्डले । १६२ संस्फुटा यावन्न ज्ञात्वा तावत् सिद्धि कुतो लभेत् ।। ४१ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWELVE 91 They are said to be outcastes (svapaca)11 and their nature is that of dogs. They drink wine as they will and (freely) eat meat according to their desire.12 (31) Wrapped in the shroud of ignorance, they go (to visit prostitutes) where they should not go. They have no worldly enjoyment (or) liberation here (in this world). Liberation comes by self-control. (32) How can (one achieve) liberation by much drinking or enjoying (oneself) according to (one's own) desires, or by visiting (prostitutes) to whom one should not go, or by bad behaviour, or by eating what should not be eaten? (33) How can (one achieve) liberation by sinful action (or) by greed for wealth? The men who are most sinful and proud, those who cause harm (and profess) false views (tantravādin), and those attached to bad paths (kumārga) do not have success (siddhi) anywhere. (34-35ab) Those who have no (understanding) of the sense of the meaning of scripture and break the rules of right conduct have no success in (their) spiritual discipline (sādhana) nor liberation. None of the many disciples, adepts, teachers and spiritual sons who are such are liberated. (35cd-36) But those whose habit is to worship the Vidyā are successful (if they are) devoted to the teacher, well behaved, maintain the rules of right conduct and are well established on the level of conduct (based on) duality (that is, a sound sense of difference between right and wrong). (They are successful) if they do not (make use of) the three `Ms',13 are free of greed, compassionate, tranquil, ever devoted to eternal bliss, devoted to the teachings of the scripture, grave, indifferent to treatises on logic, affectionate, devoted and concerned for the well- being of all living creatures. Those who have such qualities are successful without (even having to) think (about how to be so). The Vidyā of such (people) is successful, never (that) of anyone else. (37-40) As long as one has not learned the Vidyā, transmitted through the (spiritual) lineage and clearly manifest within the maSÆala used to purify the libation, where can one attain success (siddhi)?14 (41)

sanskrit: 92 कुमारिकाखण्ड: अन्यग्रन्थाद् विनिष्क्रान्ता जातिभेदेन संयुता । ७० सिद्धिदा सा न९ विज्ञेया अन्वये पश्चिमे गृहे ।। ४२ ।। तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन गुरुवक्त्रात् समभ्यसेत्” । •१७४ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहिताया अव्वाक्रमभषिते विद्यामाहात्म्यवर्णनाधिकारे क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। १२ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWELVE 93 One should know that (a Vidyā) that has come from another (sacred) book and is conjoined to various types (of Vedic seed-syllables) (jāti) does not grant success in the tradition of the Western House. Therefore, (having received it) from the teacher's mouth, practice it with all effort. (42-43ab) This is the (twelfth) chapter called the Description of the Glory of the Vidyā. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru that contains more than a hundred thousand quarters (of a metre) and has been brought (down to earth) into the primordial sacred seat on the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's Command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: श्रीनाथ उवाच त्रयोदशानन्दः शिवेति' कथित' नाम स कथं गम्यते जगत् । वैकल्पेन अपूर्णत्वात् कथं कर्तृत्वमाप्नुयात् ॥ १ ॥ कथं वा भुञ्जते भोगान् संसारति तमाश्रितः । मृत्युरस्ति कथं तस्य सत्यमाख्याहि निर्णयम् ।। २ ।। o श्रीवक्रा उवाच सर्वश्रेष्ठ पर शान्तं अवर्णतत्त्वमाश्रितम्” । १६ ज्योतिरूप निराभासं अनन्तं सततोदितम् ॥ ३ ॥ अप्रतर्कयमिदं ज्ञेयं स्वयं मुक्तं च संस्थितम् । २२ .१७ अच्छेद्यं च अभेद्यं च अलेप्यं च परापरम् ।। ४ ।। ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्राद्यः” अमृतं जीवमाश्रितम् । परानन्दस्वरूपेण नित्यानन्दपरायणम्” ॥ ५ ॥ निरानन्दमयं शान्तं कारणाष्टकवर्जितम् । गुणतत्त्वविनिर्मुक्तं हेयोपादेयवर्जितम् ।। ६ ।। न तस्य गर्भसंभूति: सर्वावस्थगतो विभुः । २७ २८ स कती न ै परः कश्चिदशरीरः शिवः प्रभुः ।। ७ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN Concerning the Destruction of Impurity. Supreme Śiva Śrīnātha said: How can (he who is) called Śiva enter the world? (He would be subject to) thought constructs, and so would be imperfect (apūrSa), and so, how (could he) acquire the power to act (kartrtva) (in the world)?1 (1) Or, again, how does he enjoy worldly experiences (bhoga) and, immersed in darkness, transmigrate? How is it that he dies? Tell (me) the true teaching (nirSaya) (concerning this matter). (2) The venerable (goddess) Kubjikā said: One should know that this (reality) beyond reason (apratarkya), the best of all, supreme and tranquil, established in the principle of unmanifest Speech (avarSatattva),2 (in the) form of light, unmanifest, endless and everywhere active, abides liberated of itself.3 (3-4ab) (Both) supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent), it cannot be cut, divided or stained. (The supreme principle is) Brahmā, VinSu, Rudra and the rest (of the gods). It is the immortal (amrta) established in (every) living being (jīva). It is supreme bliss by nature, and so is the eternal bliss which is the ultimate goal (of all existence). (It is) the Bliss of Stillness (nirānanda), tranquil and free of the eight causes (that constitute the subtle body). It is free of the qualities (guSa) and principles (tattva), and devoid of both that which is to be taken up and that which is to be abandoned.4 (4cd-6) (Not) born from any womb, (this transcendent reality) is the All-pervasive Lord (prabhu) who is present in every state (of being). He is the (universal) agent (kartr), (that) undefinable (kaścit) and supreme disembodied (reality), Śiva, the Lord.5 (7)

sanskrit: 96 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २९ तस्येच्छा निर्गता शक्तिर्नादरूपा चिदात्मिका । ३२ तयासौ” नीयते तत्त्वे” अधोमूर्तेस्तु धारणात् ॥ ८ ॥ तत्त्वैर्युक्ता” यदा भाति तदा तन्मयतां¨ गतः । मूर्तभूतोऽप्यमूर्तस्तु स्वभावादपि निर्मलः ॥ ९ ॥ ३७ महामायाश्रितो यस्मात् तस्मात् कती स ँ कर्मणि । जायते व्रजते देहे” तत्त्वैर्युक्तममलकः ॥ १० ॥ मायातत्त्वेन लिपस्तु” तदा भोगांश्च भुञ्जति । ४४ भोग्यक्षये भवेत् ” दुःखं रमते पूर्वधिष्ठितः ॥ ११ ॥ मायाज ५ कर्मजं चैव ऐहिकं तत्त्वमाश्रितम् । त्रिविधस्तु मल: प्रोक्तः सत्त्वरजस्तमेरितः ।। १२ ॥ मायाज सत्त्वमारूढं स्वाभाविकं शिवेच्छया । -५२ शक्त्यावेशेन संप्राप्ते समले तु यदात्मनि ॥ १३ ॥ तदा कर्मजसंप्राप्ति:' भावसंस्थितिचित्पुरे” । तदा संभवते भूय ऐहिकस्तु महामलः ॥ १४ ॥ ५७ तस्यैव दहनं कुर्यात् शक्तिपातेन ं मन्त्रवित् । परानन्दस्वरूपेण शक्तिनाक्रम्य पूर्ववत् ॥ १५ ॥ ५८
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 97 The power, as his will of the nature of consciousness and in the form of Sound (nāda), has emerged (from within him). He is lead by that (energy) to the principle (of phenomenal existence) by (his) contemplation (dhāraSa of his) lower form (adhomūrti).6 (8) Bondage and the Nature of Impurity (mala) If (Śiva) manifests conjoined to the principles (of conditioned existence), he then assumes their nature. But even though he (then) has a form (mūrtabhūta), he is by his very nature without form (amūrta) and pure (nirmala). (9) It is because he has entered (āśrita) (the sphere of) Mahāmāyā that he is the agent in the midst of Karma. (In this way) he who is free of impurity comes to be (jāyate) within the body and he enters (it), conjoined to the principles (of conditioned existence). (10) Stained by the principle of Māyā, he then enjoys worldly pleasures (bhoga). When the object of enjoyment ceases to exist, there is suffering (and then, after the suffering), governed by (his) previous (action), he enjoys (himself once again).7 (11) Impurity (mala) is said to be of three kinds, namely that born of Māyā, that born of Karma and that of the world (aihika) which is based on the principle (of Nature).8 The threefold impurity is said to be impelled (īrita) by (the qualities) of sattva, rajas and tamas, (respectively).9 (12) (The impurity) born of Māyā is established in sattva. In accord with Śiva's will, it belongs to one's own (phenomenal) nature (svābhāvika). Then, once the Self has become impure (samala), due to (Śiva's) energy, the (impurity) born of Karma obtains within the abode of consciousness pertaining to (phenomenal) being (bhāvasaˆsthiti). Then the great impurity of (this world) here (aihika) arises once again.10 (13-14) The Burning Away of Impurity, Merger of the Principles of Existence and Liberation The knower of mantra should burn that away by the descent of power (śaktipāta) which is supreme bliss, once he has invaded (the Self) (ākramya) with energy as before.11 (15)

sanskrit: 98 कुमारिकाखण्ड: आक्रान्तं पूर्वकारणं” अधोव ं च विघट्टितम्” । शक्तिर्दीपशिखाकारा आनन्दत्व समुद्धरेत् ॥ १६ ॥ ६४ महामाया मलस्तत्र शोध्याध्वनि च६ लीलया६७ । नीयते तेन सा ऊवे ऊर्णातन्तुनिनादवत् ।। १७ ॥ ब्रह्मघोषेण बलवान्” प्राक्तन” यन्मल ँ” दहेत् । तस्योध्वे परमा शक्ति: शिवेन सह संस्थिता ।। १८ ।। लीयते परमे व्योम्नि परे धाम्नि विनिक्षिपेत् । ऐहिकं शोधयेत् तत्र मलस्त्यजति काञ्चनम् ।। १९ ॥ त्रिविधस्तु समासेन शिवेन परमात्मना । ७७ ७८ ७९ शक्तिसंगमकाले तु प्राप्तमेतन्मलत्रयम् ।। २० ॥ आत्मान्तरे कृतं शून्य रुद्रशक्तिप्रभावतः । मलशुद्धिस्तदा तस्य निर्मलत्वं प्रपद्यते ।। २१ ।। ३ प्रकृतिस्थो यदा मुञ्चेज्जन्मसंसारबन्धनात् । ८७ आत्मनात्मा पुरा शोध्य : शक्तिपातेन प्रत्ययात् ।। २२ ।। तदा मलक्षय” तस्य देह तिष्ठति केवलम् । तत्त्वैर्युक्तो यदा युक्तः” पुण्यपापक्षये” सति ।। २३ ॥ कर्मक्षयेऽपि संप्राप्ते मुक्तिरस्ति न संशयः । विशुद्धं काञ्चनं” यद्वन्नागसंगाद्¨ विनश्यति ।। २४ ॥ एवं विशुद्धशान्तात्मा मायासंगाद् विनश्यति । ९८ दीक्षामात्रेण शिष्यस्य संभवेद् गतिरुत्तमा ।। २५ ।। शक्तिपातेन संशुद्धिर्मलस्त्यजति काञ्चनम् । त्रिविधस्तु समासेन शिवेन परमात्मना ।। २६ ।। त्यज्यते वेधपाकेन मन्त्राभ्यासेन लीलया ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 99 When the previous cause (of impurity is thus) filled (ākrānta) (with energy) and split apart (vigha˜˜ita) above and below, (then) the energy, in the shape of the flame of a lamp, should generate12 the state of bliss. (16) Impurity is there and Mahāmāyā,13 which like an echoing resonance (nināda) along a spider's thread, is playfully transported upward along with that (impurity) by the path of what is to be purified.14 (17) The powerful (adept) should burn whatever past impurity there is with the Sound of the Brahman (brahmaghona). Above that is the Supreme Energy who, along with Śiva, is well established.15 (18) (Impurity) dissolves away16 in the Supreme Sky (of ultimate reality). It should be cast into the Supreme Abode. Purify the impurity of the world (aihika) there. (In this way) Śiva, the Supreme Self (induces) the threefold impurity as a whole (samāsena) to quit (the individual soul just as) dross does gold.17 (19-20ab) This triple impurity is acquired (by the Self) when uniting with the power (of Mahāmāyā). When the Void has been formed within the Self by the power of Rudra's energy, it is purified from impurity and attains a state of purity. (20cd-21) If he who resides within (the confines of) Nature (prakrti) (seeks to) be free from the bondage of transmigratory existence, the Self must first purify the Self by grace (śaktipāta) and realisation (pratyaya).18 (22) Then his impurity is destroyed and all that persists is the body. When the one who is conjoined with the principles (of phenomenal existence) is separated (from them), and when both merit and sin are destroyed and Karma has also been destroyed, (he) certainly (attains) liberation.19 (23-24ab) Just as pure gold is destroyed by fusion with lead (nāga), in the same way, the pure, tranquil Self is destroyed by fusion with Māyā.20 (24cd-25ab) The disciple's (liberation which is his) most excellent state (gati) is possible only by means of initiation. Purification (can only take place) by the grace (śaktipāta) (received during initiation). (In this way) Śiva, the Supreme Self, (induces) the threefold impurity as a whole (samāsena) to quit (the individual soul just as) dross does gold.21 (Impurity) is (thus) playfully abandoned by means of the maturation (of Karma) brought about by the piercing (of the psychic centres) (vedhapāka) through the practice of mantra.22 (25cd-27ab)

sanskrit: 100 -१९०१ कुमारिकाखण्डः मलपाकमिदं प्रोक्तं त्रिविधं त्रिस्वरूप्तः ।। २७ ।। स्थूल सूक्ष्मं पर” चैव भित्त्वा शुद्धतनुर्भवेत् । सतताभ्यासयोगेन विद्रवेत मलत्रयम् ॥ २८ ॥ १०४ ।। मायामलविनिर्मुक्तः स भवेत् ज्ञानचक्षुषा । जीवन्मुक्तस्तु योगीशोऽय यदा चरते शिवः ।। २९ ।। तेन तस्य न लेपोऽस्ति पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसि । बिन्दुमध्यगतस्यैव तत्त्वैर्युक्तस्य चेच्छया ” ॥ ३० ॥ शिवस्यैव न लेपोऽस्ति योगाभ्यासाच्च तत्त्ववित् । प्रत्ययाज्ञास्वरूपेण१३ विद्धस्यैव मलक्षयम् ॥ ३१ ॥ ।। ११७ संसारावधि संप्राप्य तत्त्वं यास्यति व्युत्क्रमात् २१ ११८ । पृथिवी पार्थिवे”” याति आपो वरुणमण्डले ॥ ३२ ॥ तेजो’२२ ह्यग्नौ लय२३ याति २४ मारुतो २५ वायुमण्डले । १२७ १२९ आकाश २६ व्योम्नि मध्ये तु व्रजते तत्त्वपञ्चकम् ।। ३३ ।। १३२ शब्द लीयते” चाकाशे स्पर्श वै वायुमूर्धनि ' १३३ १३७ । रस३४ वै जलमध्ये तु रूपं तेजोमुखे हुतम् ॥ ३४ ॥ पार्थिवे लीयते गन्ध तन्मात्रमिति” पञ्चकम् । १४० वाचा वागीश्वरे तत्त्वे ४१ पाणिः१४२ करणपञ्चके' १४५ १४३ १४६ पादौ लीयति पाताले पायुर्वै वायुमण्डले । ४७ १४८ ॥ ३५ ॥ उपस्थ व्योम्नि मध्ये तु इत्येतत् कर्मपञ्चकम् ।। ३६ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 101 This, the maturation of impurity (malapāka), is said to be of three kinds because of its triple nature. (One) possess a pure body having been penetrated through (and having consumed the three impurities,) gross, subtle and supreme. By the Yoga of constant practice, one should melt away the three impurities.23 (27cd-28) He is free of the impurity of Māyā by means of the eye of knowledge.24 If it is Śiva who acts, this lord of yogis is one who is liberated in this life (jīvanmukta). (29) Thus, he is not stained, like a lotus leaf in water (that remains dry). (In the same way), Śiva is not stained (although he) resides within the Point (bindu),25 conjoined by (his own) will with the principles (of phenomenal existence) and, by practicing Yoga, (he is the sage who) knows reality. The impurity of one who has been pierced (by Śiva's energy) is destroyed in this way by the essential nature of the Command (that brings about) realisation (pratyayājñā). (30-31) The Merger of the Twenty-four Principles into one another Once (the adept) reaches the (highest) limit of transmigratory existence, he goes on to reach the (supreme) principle (by ascending) by the reverse (process with respect to emanation). Earth enters into the (principle of) Earth and Water, the sphere (maSÆala) of VaruSa. Fiery energy (tejas) merges into Fire, and Wind into the sphere of the Wind, while Space enters the centre of the Sky. (This is) the group of five principles (of the gross elements).26 (32-33) Sound merges into Space and Touch into the head of the Wind, Taste (rasa) into the centre of Water, while Form is offered as an oblation into the mouth of Fire and the subtle element of Smell merges into the Earth. This is the group of five (subtle elements). (34-35ab) Speech (merges) into the principle of Vāgīśvara (the Lord of Speech) and the hand into the group of five instruments.27 The feet dissolve into the lower world (pātāla), the genital organ into the sphere of the Wind and the anus into the centre of the Sky. This is the group of five (organs of) action. (35cd-36)

sanskrit: 102 •९५२ कुमारिकाखण्ड: १५३ १५६ बुद्धीन्द्रियेषु संपर्कीत् तल्लय च तथा भवेत् । श्रोत्रं लीयति शब्देऽस्मिन् त्वचं च पिशिते तथा ' चक्षुर्लीयति चन्द्रार्के' जिह्वा वै राहुमण्डले । तु६२ १५९ ।। ३७ ।। नासिका गन्धतत्त्वे तु ६२ अत ऊध्वं चतुष्टयम् ।। ३८ ।। १६४ १६६ मनो लीयति३ बिन्दौ ४ च विद्यातत्त्वे धियः पुनः अहंकार:“ शिवस्यान्ते प्रकृतेः सर्वतो लयः १७० १७३ १७४ धर्मकामार्थवश २ चतुर्विंशात्मक कुलम् । १७५ १७१ लयं याति इडापात्रे मोक्षवर्गे चतुर्थके ॥ ४० ॥ १७८ शक्तिपातेन संपातात् शिष्यस्य विनिवर्तते' । १७९ १७६ १६७ । ।। ३९ ॥ व्रजते मायया रिक्तो कैलास सर्वमूर्धनि ॥ ४१ ॥ तेन मृत्युरिय“२ चात्र८३ चतुर्विंशात्मकस्य च । न मृत्युः शिवतत्त्वस्य अपवर्गगतस्य च ।। ४२ ॥ १८७ मायाकरणवैकल्ये शक्तिपातेन प्रत्ययात् । १८९ १९० विद्यते तच्छिवो ह्येको दर्पणे च यथा मुखम् ॥ ४३ ॥ अभीत्वा प्रविशेत् तत्र कुलस्यान्तर्गतः प्रभुः । जरामरणनिर्मुक्तो मोक्षं च अन्तजन्मनि ॥ ४४ ॥ १९७ १९९ यथा एकमनेकञ्च योगाभ्यासेन तत्त्ववित्' । प्रत्ययाज्ञास्वभावस्य विद्धस्यैव च प्रत्ययः ।। ४५ ।। २०० २०१ .२०३ २०४ मलपाते वशं १ प्राप्ते मुक्तीह कुलदर्शने । न मुक्तिर्हेतुवादेभ्यो अविद्धस्य न तिष्ठति ।। ४६ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 103 Similarly, the same merger takes place within the senses (buddhīndriya) by (their) contact (with their equivalent principles). The Ear28 dissolves into this Sound and, in the same way, Skin into Flesh, the Eye into the Sun and Moon, the Tongue into Rāhu's sphere and the nose into the principle of smell.29 (37-38c) Above, after (this), comes the group of four. The mind (manas) dissolves into the Point, then the perceptions of the intellect (dhiyaƒ) into the Principle of Knowledge (vidyātattva), the Ego into the extremity of Śiva and Nature30 dissolves away everywhere.31 (38d-39) The aggregate (kula) consisting of (these) twenty-four (principles) is under the sway of Dharma, passion (kāma) and worldly gain (artha).32 It dissolves into the fourth goal of life (varga), that is, liberation, the sacrificial vessel (iÆāpātra).33 (40) The disciple's (impurity) comes to an end by (a powerful) descent of power. Free from Māyā, he goes to (mount) Kailāsa at the top of all.34 (41) Thus, this is the death of what consists of the (aggregate of) twenty-four (principles). (But this does not entail) the death of the Śiva principle, which is established in liberation. (42) When Māyā, the instrument (of bondage), comes to an end through grace (śaktipāta) and realisation (pratyaya), the one Śiva is present (before the yogi) as is (his own) face in a mirror. (43) 35One should enter there without fear. The Lord is within the body (kula).36 He is free from old age and death and is (himself) the liberation (that occurs in the last and most) beautiful life. (44) Just as the knower of reality (knows both) the one and the many by the practice of Yoga, (such also) is the realisation (pratyaya) of a person who has been pierced (by Śiva's energy) and whose nature is the Command (that brings about a true) experience (of ultimate reality) (pratyayājñā). (45) When impurity falls away and mastery is achieved, liberation (is attained) here in the Kula doctrine (kuladarśana). Liberation is not (attained) through the philosophies of logic. One who is not pierced (by grace) is not (liberated). (46)

sanskrit: 104 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २०७ दीक्षामन्त्रविहीनस्य विना च मलशोधनम् । २१० तस्य पूर्ववशात् कर्म प्रसज्यते मुहुर्मुहुः ।। ४७ ।। मल११ त्रिविधमाधत्ते स्वयमात्मावशोत्तरे । अविदित्वा१२ परं१३ तत्त्वं तत्र बद्धो न मुच्यते ॥ ४८ ॥ २१६ नोपवासादितीर्थेभ्यो न १५ व्रतशोधितात्मनि ' २१७ २१८ २१९ अनशने ” सोमसूर्यराहुग्रस्ते रणेऽपि वा ।। ४९ ।। शरणागतसंबन्धे गोग्रहे ९ वा जलाग्निषु । देवायतनमूलेषु° वाराणस्यां जलेश्वरे ।। ५० ।। केदारादिषु सर्वत्र कुरुक्षेत्रे रणेऽपि वा । न मुक्तिरस्ति”” भूतानां वृथाः २३ क्लिश्यन्ति४ ते जनाः किन्तु स्वर्गमवाप्यन्ते६ अष्टधागुणो २७ वर्तते । ऋणशेष: २२८ प्रवर्तते मत्ये ९ भुवनमण्डले ॥ ५२ ॥ २२९ २३० शुभाशुभे च संप्राप्ते भुञ्जते सुखदुःखयो: । कर्मक्षयं २३१ विना २२ तेषां कथं मुक्तिर्विधीयते ॥ ५३ ॥ २३३ दीक्षामात्रादनभ्यासात् शक्तिपातेन निश्चयात् ४ । मलशुद्धिमवाप्नोति’५ कम्पस्तोभादिप्रत्ययान् २२५ ।। ५१ ।। ।। ५४ ।। भुक्तीह सर्वसामान्या प्रकृति : २३८ पुरुषेच्छया । प्रकृतिः४° पुरुषाधारा स्वकर्मणा ४२ इहोच्यते ४३ ।। ५५ ।। शून्ये शून्यमनाश्रित्य ४५ निराशीति४६ परिग्रहः । .२४७ नास्तिभावपदारुह्य भावसिद्धिस्तदा भवेत् ।। ५६ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 105 One who has neither initiation nor mantra and is devoid of the purification of impurity is subject repeatedly to Karma because of his previous (Karma). (47) He himself takes (onto himself) the three kinds of impurity when he is beyond self-control. Without having known the Supreme Principle, he is bound there and is not freed. (48) Beings do not attain liberation from (visiting) sacred places (tīrtha), fasting and the like, nor when they are purified by observing a vow. (They do not find liberation simply) in not eating (impure food) or when the sun or moon are eclipsed, or in battle, or in the relationship (that is formed) by taking refuge (śaraSāgata). (They are not liberated) by taking a cow (and tending it), or (by performing austerities) amidst fire or water, or (by living) in the recesses of the foundations of temples (devāyatanamūla). (None find it just by going to) VārāSasī, or in (the sacred abode of) Jaleśvara, or in Kuruknetra or anywhere (in sacred places) such as Kedāra37 or even in battle. (Those who seek liberation in these places and these ways simply) suffer troubles uselessly. However, they do attain heaven and (possess) the eight yogic powers (an˜adhāguSa).38 (But), a debt remains (to be paid) in the world of mortals. (49-52) In the wake of auspicious and inauspicious (actions), one experiences pleasure and pain. How can (people) be liberated without the destruction of Karma (karmaknaya)? (53) By initiation alone, (even) without practice, by grace (śaktipāta) and the certainty (of insight it gives), one attains the purification of impurity and the signs of realisation (pratyaya) such as the shaking and paralysis (of the body).39 (54) Experience here (in this world) (bhukti) is Nature (prakrti) that is universally equal for all40 (and it takes place) by the will of the Person (puruna). Nature's support is the Person. It is said to be here because of one's own action. (55) The accomplishment of Being (bhāvasiddhi) comes about when, having assumed a void (state of mind) within the Void and having laid hold of a condition free of longing,41 one ascends to the plane of the state of Non-being (nāstibhāva).42 (56)

sanskrit: 106 कुमारिकाखण्ड: प्रत्यक्षे“ बहिकर्माणि” स्वयं भूतानि यानि वै । २५० २५१ तान्येव विधिपूर्वेण शोध्यान्यनेन मन्त्रवित् ।। ५७ ।। श्रीनाथ उवाच एवं मायाश्रितोऽनन्तमायाकर्मसमुच्चयः ५२ । । मायाबीज २५३ कथं५४ तस्मात् वेधनं भुवनत्रये ॥ ५८ ॥ तेन संस्मृतमात्रेण किं फलं भवते नृणाम् । २५७ शरीरस्य यथातथ्यं सप्तधातुविमिश्रणम् ॥ ५९ ॥ •२५८ २५९ एवं तत्त्वप्रमाणं तु अस्थिनाडिपरिग्रहम् २६० । कथं व्यक्तपुरे १ चात्र देहे देहे तथोदितम् ।। ६० ।। तथाविधरूपेण ब्रूहि सर्वं तु मे उमे । श्रीवक्रा उवाच -२६५ २६६ २६४ आदौ तन्वी परा देवी दण्डिनी चारुनन्दिता २६९ २६७ ॥ ६१ ॥ स्वरहीना महामाया प्रज्वलन्ती २८ शिवासने । २७० ऋजुः स्पष्टा महौघेन स्मरेत् तां योनिमुद्रिताम् ।। ६२ ।। खेचरीमूलमाश्रित्य २७३ शिवेन सह जल्पते २७४ । २७५ नीयते हृद्रुहान्ते च कदम्बकुसुमत्विषा ।। ६३ ॥ २७७ संस्मरेद् ज्ञानचन्द्रेण बिन्दुचक्रे च मूर्धनि । नीयते परमे व्योम्नि हिमकुन्देन्दुनिर्मला ।। ६४ ।। २७८ •२८१ क्षीयमाणां स्मरेद् वक्रां९ नासिकाग्रे लयं कुरु । सदानन्दमहौघं तु वर्तते गिरिजात्मजे ।। ६५ ॥ तु
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 107 O knower of mantra, whatever external, directly apparent Karmas there may be or physical elements, they should (all) thereby be purified in accord with the prescribed method. (57) The Rise of KuSÆalinī and the Destruction of Māyā Śrīnātha said: In this way, the seed of Māyā resides in Māyā (i.e. Mahāmāyā) and is the aggregate of endless Mayā and Karma. So how is the piercing (of the psychic centres possible) in the three worlds? What fruit do men get just by remembering that? (58-59ab) O Umā, tell me truly about how the seven constituents (dhātu) of the body are combined together, the measure (pramāSa) of the principles and the configuration of the bones and channels. How is it that (all this) has arisen thus here in the manifest abode (of Śiva), that is, in each body? (59cd-61ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: 43First of all, one should recall the Supreme Goddess (Parā). Beautiful and blissful (cārunanditā), she is thin and (straight like) a stick (daSÆinī).44 She is Mahāmāyā, the silent (sound of consciousness) (svarahīnā),45 who burns in Śiva's seat. She is straight and clear. Recollect her, she who is stamped (with the triangular form of) the Yoni, along with the great current (of bliss) (mahaugha).46 (61cd-62) Taking up her residence in the root of (the energy which) wanders in the Sky (of ultimate reality) (khecarī), she converses with Śiva. She, who is the radiance of the Kadamba Flower,47 is led into the cave of the Heart. (63) Recollect (her) as the moon of knowledge, in the Wheel of the Point (binducakra) (on the top of) the head. Pure as the moon, snow and the kunda flower, she is led into the Supreme Sky.48 (64) Think of (her, the goddess) Vakrā, as waning away. Dissolve (her) away at the tip of the nose.49 (In this way) the great current of perpetual bliss abides within (Śiva) who is Pārvatī’s son (girijātmaja).50 (65)

sanskrit: 108 कुमारिकाखण्डः मायाविध्वंसनं ३ सम्यक् योगावेशन धारणात् २८४ योगावेशनधारणात् । २८६ लयोत्पत्तिविपत्तिञ्च ५ कृत्वा आचारवान् भवेत् ॥ ६६ ॥ २८७ विध्वस्तमायाचैतन्या ँ शुद्धस्फटिकनिर्मला । करणेन सदाभ्यासाद्“ योगनिद्रा ततो भवेत् ।। ६७ ।। मायाकरणसंबन्ध९९ कथितं सिद्धिहेतवे । २९२ २९५ मुमुक्षूणां विमुक्त्यर्थं शक्तिभेदं परापरम् ।। ६८ ।। श्रीनाथ उवाच २९७ उदयास्तमनं चाद्यं तच्च क्रमात् कथं विदुः निग्रहानुग्रहे” शाक्ते आणवे शाम्भवे क्रमे १ ३०० २९८ ॥ ६९ ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच ३०२ निग्रहस्य च संशुद्धिरन्तयीगे विशोधयेत् । ३०४ या सा शिवमयी पूर्वं उद्धृता भैरवागमे ।। ७० ।। तया कर्मक्षयः स्वान्तदेहे पूर्व क्रमार्चनात् श्रीनाथ उवाच ३०८ ३०९ कथं वद । आदौ कर्म कथं प्रोक्तं क्षये तस्य किमोषधि: कथं शुद्धिर्मनुष्याणां मोक्षमार्ग । ३१० श्रीवक्रा उवाच कर्मसंशुद्धि”४ न विन्दन्ति”५ यथात्मनः तान्त्रिका: ३ कर्मसंशुद्धिं ३१७ तेन तेषां न मुक्तीह“ अस्तीति कुलशासने । ।। ७१ ।। ३१६ ।। ७२ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 109 The destruction of Māyā (takes place) by properly maintaining the possessed state brought about by Yoga (yogāveśanadhāraSā). (By doing this) and bringing creation and destruction to an end, (the adept is one who practices) right conduct (ācāravat).51 (66) Thus, by the constant practice of the means (karaSa) (i.e. mantra), (the adept experiences) Yogic sleep (yoganidrā) which, stainless as pure crystal, is consciousness in which Māyā has been destroyed.52 (67) The relationship between Māyā and the means (karaSa) has been explained. (I have also explained) the categories of power, supreme and inferior, in order that (the adept may achieve) accomplishments (siddhi) and those who desire liberation may be liberated.53 (68) The Nature of Karma, its Destruction and Entry into NirvāSa Śrīnātha said: How do (the wise) know the (true nature of the) arising and falling away (of impurity) and the primary (form of impurity) in due order, both in grace and obstruction (nigraha), in the Śāmbhava, Śākta and ĀSava sequences?54 (69) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: (The binding) restraint (nigraha) (should be) purified.55 One should purify it during the inner sacrifice. That (Vidyā), the nature of which is Śiva, was previously extracted (uddhrtā) in the Bhairava Āgama.56 It destroys Karma within one’s own body prior to the worship of the transmission (kramārcana).57 (70-71ab) Śrīnātha said: Firstly, what is Karma said to be? And what is the remedy for it by which it is destroyed? How are men purified? Tell (me), how is the path to liberation? (71cd-72ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: As Tāntrikas do not manage to purify the Self from Karma, thus there is no liberation for them here (in this world) as there is in the Kula teaching.58 (72cd-73ab)

sanskrit: 110 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३२० प्रभुत्वे च शिवः कर्ता भूतग्रामे ” चतुर्विधे । ७३ ।। परमात्मा निराकाश: सावकाशात् समुद्भवः । स्वयंभू कारण लोके शून्यभूतमचेतनम् ।। ७४ ।। अस्वतन्त्रं यदा जीव े चाराचारविवर्जितम् ३२४ शून्यभूतात्मकं लोके योगाभ्यासात् प्रवर्तते ।। ७५ ।। तस्यापि चोध्वचैतन्य निमित्तं ज्ञानभास्करम् । उदयास्तमनैकत्वे ६ राजते बोधरूपकम् ।। ७६ ।। ३२७ कामस्य विषतत्त्वस्य निरञ्जनान्तर्गस्य च । चन्द्रार्कप्रतिबिम्बं च निष्कलं तरितात्मजम् ।। ७७ ।। ताप्यमानं” स्वयं तिष्ठेद् भारूपं तिमिरापहम् । पुरुष: सर्वसामान्यो भरणादपि भैरव : ।। ७८ ।। ३३१ ३३० निर्मलः सकलो व्यापी क्षीरमध्ये यथा घृतम् ३३२ प्रच्छन्नं परमानन्दं शिवतत्त्वं निरञ्जनम् ।। ७९ ॥ अभेद्यमव्ययं शान्तं सर्वोक्तं सर्वतोमुखम् । । तस्येच्छा निर्गता शक्तिर्ऋजुरेखा ह्यधोमुखी ॥ ८० ॥ विसर्गमध्यगा भीमा अग्निज्वाला सुवर्चसा । व्यापिका सृष्टिमार्गस्य धर्माधर्मात्मके पदे ॥ ८१ ॥ ।। ३३८ स्वाभाविकी कला माया सृष्टिहेतोः समुद्भवा । गुणत्रयधरात्युग्रा” नादरूपा मनोन्मनी ।। ८२ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 111 (As the one who possess) mastery (over action), Śiva is the agent within the fourfold aggregate of living beings (bhūtagrāma).59 The Supreme Self is spaceless (nirākāśa). Creation (samudbhava) proceeds from that which is spatial (sāvakāśa). That is the self-born (universal) cause (that operates) in the world. The insentient (acetana) is emptiness (śūnyabhūta). (73cd-74) If the living being (jīva) is not free and is devoid of (i.e does not care about) right and wrong conduct (cārācāra), it is (insentient) emptiness (śūnyabhūta). (However), the higher consciousness (ūrdhvacaitanya), which is the sun of knowledge and the instrumental cause (of liberation), also works for him by (his) practice of Yoga in the world. (75-76ab) When the arising and falling away (of the breath become) one, the conscious nature (bodharūpaka) of Passion (kāma), the Principle of Poison (vina) and of that within the Stainless (nirañjana), shines.60 (76cd-77ab) (The conscious nature) is the reflection of the Sun and Moon, undifferentiated (ninkala), born of the liberated Self (taritātmaja) that burns by itself, abiding as light that removes darkness.61 It is the Person (puruna) who is universally identical for all.62 He is ‘Bhairava’ (for this reason) and also because (he) fills (all things) (bharaSa).63 (77cd-78) Free of impurity (nirmala), endowed with (universal) power (sakala),64 pervasive like clarified butter within milk,65 it is the Śiva principle which is stainless (nirañjana), hidden, supreme bliss, indivisible, imperishable, tranquil, present everywhere and is all that is spoken. (79-80ab) His will has emerged (as his universal) energy (from within him in the form of) a straight line facing downwards.66 Horrific (bhimā), she is in the centre of emission (visarga). A tongue of flame of beautiful lustre, she pervades the path of emanation on the plane (pada) consisting of Dharma and Adharma. (80cd-81) She is Māyā, the energy inherent in one's own nature (svābhāvikī) that has come forth in order to emanate (the world). Sustaining the three qualities, she is extremely fierce. Her nature Sound (nāda), she is Mind Beyond Mind (manonmanī).67 (82)

sanskrit: 112 कुमारिकाखण्ड: दण्डाकारा निराकारा साकारा शिवदेवता । ३४२ ३४३ मायामलमिदं कर्म निष्कलस्य समुद्भवम् ।। ८३ ॥ ३४४ तेनासौ सकलो योगी मायातत्त्वोपरिस्थितः । •३४६ ३४७ एवं मायामल५ पूर्वं बन्धनं तस्य नामतः ।। ८४ ॥ सृष्टेः स्थितेश्च संहारे कर्तृत्वे कर्मपाशकम् । पञ्चभौतिकब्रह्माद्याः५” संसृष्टेरवतारकाः ३५२ कृत्रिमं सहजं नैव भौतमाभोगवेष्टितम् ३५० ।। ८५ । ३५७ । मायामोहेन संतप्त५५ बिन्दुरात्मा जगोत्तरे ॥ ८६ ॥ ३५८ सा चैव प्रकृतिव्यापी कर्मबन्धात्मिकी भवेत् । ३६१ ३६२ स६० पशुः पाशबन्धेन आक्रान्तः च गुणत्रये ।। ८७ ।। ३६४ सत्त्वेन कुरुते कर्म कामश्च रजवर्तिनः । तमाविष्ट:३१५ स्मरेत् पापान् सुखदुःखवशंगतः ॥ ८८ ॥ भुञ्जते स्वर्गनरकं अविदित्वा न मुच्यते” । ३७० सुकृतं दुष्कृतं भुंक्ते इष्टानिष्टं मनेप्सितम् एवं ३७२ मानापमानौ च वेदितव्यौ मलस्य च । । ।। ८९ ॥ ब्राह्मे च वैष्णवे लोके ऐन्द्रे चैव शशिप्रभे ॥ ९० ॥ यक्षलोके च गान्धर्वे रक्षपैशाचिके कुले । स्वर्गे चाष्टविधे कर्मभोगान् भुञ्जति भैरव ।। ९१ ।। ३७६ अशुभे च कृते पापे नरकं गच्छते ३७८ ३७९ क्षणात् । मत्यलोके महाघोरे पशुयोनौ मृगे तथा ।। ९२ ॥ पतति नरके” घोरे८२ शरीषु३ स्थावरेष्वपि । ३८० ३८६ ३८४ व्यापित ८५ कर्मपाशेन स विन्दति शुभाशुभम् ।। ९३ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 113 Śiva's deity, (this energy is the goddess) in the form of a stick.68 She is both formless and with form. This (binding) Karma is (essentially) the impurity of Māyā, which is the product (samudbhava) of (the aspect) ‘without power’ (ninkala).69 (83) Thus the Yogi above the principle of Māyā possesses power (sakala). In this way, his first bond is called the the impurity of Māyā, (whereas) the bond of Karma is present in the agency of emanation and persistence and in withdrawal.70 (84-85ab) Brahmā and the rest (of the gods who govern) the five (gross) elements bring about phenomenal existence (saˆsrn˜i). The (gross) elemental nature (bhauta) is created (krtrima lit. ‘artificial’), it is not innately existent (sahaja lit. ‘natural’). It is material (bhauta), wrapped in worldly experience and troubled by the delusion of Māyā, (whereas) the Point is the Self beyond the universe.71 (85cd-86) And, pervasive, (Mahāmāyā) is Nature (prakrti) which becomes the fetter of Karma. (While) this is the fettered soul (paśu), attacked by the bondage of the fetters (who resides) in the three qualities (guSa).72 (87) (Impelled) by sattva, he acts (lit. `makes Karma'). Passionate desire (kāma) resides in rajas. Penetrated by tamas, he reflects on (many kinds of) sins, (due to which he is) under the sway of pleasure and pain. (88) He experiences heaven and hell and, not having known (ultimate reality), is not freed. He experiences (the consequences of) good and bad deeds and what is not desired whether it is something he likes or dislikes. In the same way, know that (both) respect and contempt are also (products) of impurity. (89-90ab) O Bhairava, he undergoes the experiences that are the consequences of (his) actions in the eight kinds of heaven (svarga). (These are) those of Brahmā and VinSu, the world of Indra, that of the lunar light, the world of Yaknas, that of the Gandharvas and the (worlds) of the families (kula) of Raknasas and Piśācas. (90cd-91) When (some) inauspicious sin has been committed, he goes to hell in an instant. In this way, he falls into the ghastly world of mortal (men, or) into the womb of a deer (or any other) animal, (or) into a terrible hell, (or) even into Śarīs and (other) plants. Pervaded by the fetter of Karma, (at times) he gets what is auspicious (and at other times) what is inauspicious. (92-93)

sanskrit: 114 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तेन कर्मवशाद् योगी विश्वरूपो मणिर्यथा । ३८७ ३८८ कर्मच्छेदेन चाभ्यासात् तदा निर्वाणमाविशेत् ।। ९४ ।। ३९० भुवनान्तर्गत: तिष्ठेद् व्योमव्यापी स भैरवः' । मायाविध्वस्तजीवाख्यो अपरे पश्चिमे पुरे ।। ९५ ।। जायते रत्नतुङ्गे तु तेन मोक्षो विधीयते । इति ज्ञात्वा यथा तस्य” मलपातं तु कारयेत् ।। ९६ ।। श्रीनाथ उवाच ·३९४ एवं स्वाभाविकं तस्य कमीयत्तं मलत्रयम् । प्राकृतं मानसं चैव मायामोहाद् ५ भवार्णवम् ।। ९७ ।। •३९६ क्षयं तेषां कथं उग्रे क्रमेऽस्मिन् संप्रगीयते । श्रीवक्रा उवाच ३९७ निरोधकरणं कृत्वा पञ्चोत्थं मण्डलक्रमम् ४०० ३९८ ।। ९८ ।। ४०१ योनिमुद्रा” समाश्रित्य भैरवीं मायया युताम् । कुम्भककरणाधिष्ठाय ं‍ येनोध्व॰३ व्रजेन्मणिः ४०८ •४०३ ४०४ ।। ९९ ।। शनै: ४०५ शनैरुपरमेद् यावद् रौद्री च मूर्धनि । तदावेशेन जगतो.९ मलविध्वंसनं भवेत् ।। १०० ॥ मायास्तमनमेतद् वै” निर्मलं काञ्चनं भवेत्” । ४१० धुननावेशन २ कम्पं निद्रा घूर्मि: १४ पिपीलिका ४१६ एकाङ्गनर्तना भाषा अश्रुपातं कुरङ्गवत् । ४१५ ।। १०१ ।। प्लुतिभेदं सिंहशब्द इत्येकादश प्रत्ययाः ।। १०२ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 115 Thus, due to the effect of Karma, the yogi, like a jewel, (assumes each and) every form. By the cessation of Karma and through practice, he enters NirvāSa.73 (94) He, Bhairava who pervades the Sky, abides within the world. (There he is) in the lower (apara) City of the West and is called the living being (jīva) in whom Māyā has been destroyed.74 (95) He arises victorious (jāyate) on the Mountain of Jewels and so liberation is attained. (Having learned this), do what is necessary to remove his impurity.75 (96) The Destruction of the Threefold Impurity and Maturation of Karma by means of the Rise of KuSÆalinī and the Transmission (krama) Śrīnātha said: Such is his threefold impurity which is (both) innate (svābhāvika) and dependent on Karma in this way; while the ocean of transmigratory existence, material (prākrta) and mental (mānasa), is due to the delusion brought about by Māyā. O terrific one! How is their destruction said to take place in this transmission (krama)? (97-98ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Having fashioned the means to check (impurity), namely, the sequence of the maSÆalas generated from the five (pañcottha),76 one should make the Gesture of the Yoni,77 which is that of Bhairavī,78 conjoined with (the seed-syllable of) Māyā (HRĪ¤) while retaining the breath in such a way that (KuSÆalinī) the jewel (maSi) 79 may travel upwards.80 (98cd-99) He should gradually bring (all action to) rest until (he reaches) Raudrī (at the top of) the head.81 Then by the penetration (āveśa) (that takes place, all) the impurity of the universe is destroyed. This is indeed the cessation of Māyā (whereby the soul, free of Māyā) becomes like pure gold.82 (100-101ab) 83The eleven signs of attainment (pratyaya) (that manifest then) are (as follows).84 1) trembling (dhunana), 2) possession (āveśana), 3) shaking (kampa), 4) sleep (nidrā), 5) rolling (of the eyes as if inebriated) (ghūrmi), 6) (the sensation of) ants (crawling on the body),85 7) dancing on one limb, 8) (speaking in the Kaula) language (bhānā),86 9) tears, 10) jumping like a deer and 11) roaring (like) a lion. (101cd-102)

sanskrit: 116 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४१९ रुद्रभागे पदे प्राप्ते तुर्योध्वे लयतां गते । नश्यन्ति २० सर्वकर्माणि ४९ तस्मिन् दृष्टे परापरे ।। १०३ ॥ परानन्दस्वरूपेण भवेदानन्दविग्रहः । दहनाप्यायभेदोऽयं४२ ज्ञात्वा कर्मक्षयो भवेत् ॥। १०४ ।। ४२३ मुक्तं ज्ञानाश्रितं देहं कृत्वा क्रमात् क्रमार्चनम् । ४२४ पशुपाशविनिर्मुक्तः पतते २५ ज्ञानमण्डले ।। १०५ ॥ आज्ञाप्रत्ययमावेश२६ रोमाञ्च च मुहुर्मुहुः ४२८ ४२९ अन्वयं पूजयेन्नित्यं अन्वयं पूर्वसंग्रहम् ॥ १०६ ॥ मुहुर्मुहुः क्रमाभ्यासाल्लक्षजापेन खेगतिः । ४३४ ४३२ पञ्चमूर्तिधरेन्द्रस्य३ शिवस्य दक्षिणापथे ।। १०७ ।। यदा कलियुगे घोरे तदा तं पूजयेत् क्रमात् । इत्याज्ञा मलपातेन निष्कला सकलागमे ॥ १०८ ॥ गुर्वाम्नायेन इत्युक्ता न चोक्ता अन्यदर्शने । •४३७ मयावतारितं तुभ्यं आश्रमं क्रमपञ्चकम् ॥ १०९ ॥ श्रीभैरव उवाच •४३८ महत् कर्मविपाकं तु ज्ञातमद्य मया स्फुटम् । दहनं च कथं तस्य ओलीनां क्रममण्डले ॥ ११० ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTEEN 117 Once the plane which is Rudra's part87 has been attained and (individual consciousness) has dissolved away in (the state) Beyond the Fourth, all Karmas are destroyed upon perceiving (ultimate reality which is both) supreme (transcendence) and lower (immanence). (103) (The yogi's) nature is (then) supreme bliss and so (his very) form is bliss. Once one has known this division (bheda) (of the teaching, namely) the burning away (of impurity) ( dahana) and nourishment (apyāya), Karma is destroyed.88 (104) Once (the adept) has worshipped the Krama in due order, the body, established in knowledge, is liberated. Free of the fetters (pāśa) of a fettered soul (paśu), he enter into (patate)89 the MaSÆala of Knowledge.90 (Then he experiences) possession (āveśa), the signs (of accomplishment), the Command and (his) hair stands on end, again and again.91 (105-106ab) One should always worship the Tradition (anvaya). The Tradition is (the teaching) that has been gathered together from the past. By practicing (this) progression (krama) repeatedly and by 100,000 repetitions of the Vidyā, (the adept attains) flight (khegati). (106cd-107ab) During the terrible Age of Strife one should worship, in due order in the Deccan (dakniSāpatha) (the Li‰ga) of Śiva, the Lord who bears a fivefold form.92 (107cd-108ab) This is the Command, which after the removal of impurity is formless (ninkalā) (and present) in all the scripture. (The Command) is uttered by the tradition of the masters (gurvāmnāya). It is not discussed in (any) other system (darśana). I have brought the fivefold transmission (kramapañcaka) of the Hermitage (maSÆala) down (to earth) for you. (108cd-109) 93The Consecration of the Command: The Devyākramasūtra The Ascent and Descent of KuSÆalinī The venerable (god) Bhairava said: Today I have clearly understood the great maturation of Karma. (Now please tell me), how are the Lineages (oli) in the Circle of the Transmission (kramamaSÆala) burnt away? (110)

sanskrit: 118 कुमारिकाखण्ड: श्रीवक्रा उवाच ४४० पुनरन्यक्रमेणैव” अन्तर्यागस्य निर्णयम्४२ । ४४३ । क्रमेऽस्मिन् वृद्धकौमारे सिद्धगुह्ये कुलकन्दरे ॥ १११ ॥ ४४६ ४४८ क्रमस्य पूरको ४५ मन्त्री वज्राविष्टेन साधकः स्वमुद्रायोगिनीपाणौ कृत्वा चित्तमधोन्मुखम् मुद्रामडलकं वृत्तं” आश्रमं पारमेश्वरम् । -४५० । ४४७ । ।। ११२ ।। तप्तहेममयं शुद्धं तस्य मध्ये च वर्तुलम् ॥ ११३ ।। आरक्तं रविबिम्बं तु दक्षावर्तपरिभ्रमात् । तस्य मध्येऽखण्डचक्रं आरक्तं ज्योतिसन्निभम् तस्य५२ मध्ये परं द्वीपं गोक्षीर५३ शान्तवारुणम् ४५५ ४५६ -४५१ ४५४ ।। ११४ ।। । भ्रमन्तं संस्मरेत् तत्र ओलित्रितयशासने ।। ११५ ।। जन्मचक्रे जगन्नाथ तन्मध्ये बिन्दुमण्डलम् । अलातपुष्पसंकाशं“ वामावर्तपरिभ्रमात् ।। ११६ ॥ तदन्तरगता विद्या या परा परमेश्वरी । सा शक्तिर्भीमरूपेण४५८ ज्योतिरूपा ४५९ मनोन्मनी ॥ ११७ ॥ दीपवर्तिशिखा घोरा ज्वालिनी धूम्रवर्जिता । रुद्रकोटिसहस्राभा रुद्रशक्ति: ६२ परापरा ।। ११८ ।। रुद्रकोटिधरो बिन्दुः शक्तिराभूमिसंप्लवः । ४६४ ४६३ तस्य तेज: परा शक्ति : रुद्रशक्तिर्महेश्वरी वक्ररूपा शिवेन्द्रेण भाविताज्ञास्वभावतः ४६५ ।। ११९ ॥ ४६६ । चित्स्वरूपा¨६७ विकासा तु श्रीदेवी कुलकुब्जिका ॥ १२० ॥
