english: CHAPTER TWENTY-ONE The Five Principles The Formation of the Aghoryan˜aka Vidyā The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Now I will tell (You) something else, namely, the most excellent Aghorān˜aka.1 One should form it in conjunction with the going and coming encapsulated by Śiva. 2 (1) O Śambhu, I will now tell (you) the sequence of (its) various parts (padabhedakrama). The first part is AGHORE. AGHORYĀ-Ī3 is the second. This is the first Aghorā. (Now listen to) how the second one is (formed). (2-3ab) It (begins with) the word PARAMAGHORE. It is followed by PARAMAGHORYĀ-Ī GHORARŪPE,4 (the letter) Ha with Emission (Ö) (HAÖ) and GHORARŪPĀ with Ī at the end. (Thus) the third Aghorikā has been explained. Now listen to the fourth. (3cd-4) (It is thus): GHORAMUKHI and GHORAMUKHĀ conjoined with the vowel ‘Ī’. There is the part BHĪMABHĪ±A¦I. Another is BHĪMABHĪ±A¦Ā. (5) (This is) the fourth Gauryā. O Maheśvara, the fifth Gauryā is VAMA PIVA HA and VAMA PIVA along with HĀYĪ. (6) This, the sixth Aghorā, has been explained. The next one is the seventh: the word RURU and RARA, the word RURU (and then) again RARA. (7) These letter ‘Ras’, located in the letter A, are inflamed by Gaurī's letter (Ī).5 This is the seventh Aghoryā. Now the eighth follows: PHETKĀRĪ along with PHETKĀRYĀ, conjoined with (Ī), the fourth vowel. (8-9ab) This is the Aghoryan˜aka (Vidyā), which is divided into sixteen parts. The Ghorikān˜aka has been explained according to the conjunction of the sequence of two parts (at a time). (9cd-10ab)

sanskrit: 74 कुमारिकाखण्ड: दीपनैस्तु ँ विनिर्मुक्तं अघोर्यद्यष्टकोद्धृतम् ॥ १० ॥ न तु सिद्धिप्रद देव बीजहीनं न साधयेत् । तस्मात् सबीजकरण ं इदानीं शृणु भैरव ॥। ११ ॥ मातृकाक्रमलिङ्गस्य पूर्णिमानलभेदितम् । गौयायामलमाक्रान्तं” आज्ञावर्तिसमुज्ज्वलम् ॥ १२ ॥ एतद् बीजं महेन्द्रस्य तथा प्रसादभैरवम् । तस्यान्ते मध्यगं पात्यं महेन्द्रशिरभेदितम् ।। १३ ॥ शक्तितोमरमाविष्टं अधिकारार्णभेदितम् । तत्पदस्थ३ विसर्गस्थं व्योमबीजं महेश्वर ॥ १४ ॥ बविलोमाच्चतुर्थं तु तोरणशिरभेदितम् । •३८ । ३९ तस्याधःस्थस्तथा” चोव चन्द्रासनं सुसंस्थितम् ॥ १५ ॥ तस्योवे तु पुनः” क्षोभ संयोगाद् रावबीजकम् । वकारस्य मकारस्य अन्तस्थं च समुद्धरेत् ॥ १६ ॥ कुबेरासनमाविष्ट बिन्दुभिन्नगुरूपरि । ४८ एषैव कौलिनीबीजं सुरसिद्धनमस्कृतम् ॥ १७ ॥ प्रथमादि चतुर्थं तु अग्निवेधकभेदितम् । ४९ शशाङ्कांकितबिन्दूध्वे षट्त्यागात् ” सप्तमे हितम् ॥ १८ ॥ एष कालाग्निरुद्रस्तु प्रोक्तः” सर्वजनप्रियः” ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-ONE 75 The Aghoryādyan˜aka has been explained without the seed-syllables that serve as its energizers. (However, without them, it) does not give success (siddhi). Devoid of the seed-syllables, it cannot achieve its goal. Therefore, O Bhairava, listen now to how the seed-syllables are added (sabījakaraSa). (10cd-11) The Eight Seed-syllables of the Vidyā Mahendra The Li‰ga (Ha) of the sequence of letters conjoined with the Fire (Ra) and the Full Moon covered by the Gaurī couple (Ī) and burning with the Wick of the Command (¤):6 this is the seed-syllable of Mahendra (HRĪ¤). (12-13a) Prasādabhairava and the Void Next (comes) Prasādabhairava.7 Place the (letter) in the middle (Ha) at its end conjoined with the head of Mahendra (Ū) penetrated by the Hammer of Energy (Ra) and conjoined with the letter of Authority (¤) (HRŪ¤). O Maheśvara, the seed-syllable of the Void (vyomabīja) established in Emission resides in that part (pada) (KHAÖ). (13bcd-14) Sound The fourth (syllable begins with the letter that comes in the) reverse order from Ba (Pha) conjoined with the head of the Arch (toraSa) and (with the letter that is) below. Above it, the seat of the Moon is well established. Again above that is Arousal (¤). (This is) the seed-syllable of Sound (rāvabīja) (formed) by the conjuction (of these letters).8 (15-16ab) Kaulinī Extract (the letter) between the letters Va and Ma (Ha), (that which) rests on the seat of Kubera (AU), (and the letter) above the Guru conjoined with the Point: this indeed is the seed-syllable of Kaulinī saluted by the gods and Siddhas. (16cd-17) Kālāgni (The letter) preceded by the first, the fourth conjoined with Fire (Ra) and the Piercer (U), above the Point, (is) marked with the Moon and, omitting six, the beneficial (hita) is (attained) in the seventh;9 this is said to be (the seed-syllable of) Kālāgnirudra, beloved of everybody. (18-19ab)

sanskrit: 76 कुमारिकाखण्ड: भलमध्यमक३ नाथ४ बाद्येनाहत औशिरम् ॥। १९ ।। बिन्दुनादकलाक्रान्तं महारुद्रपुरोद्धृतम् । अन्य ँ धूम्रध्वजस्याद्यं तोरणासनभेदितम् ।। २० ।। तोरण शिरचन्द्रार्धं” आनन्दं च अखण्डितम् । योगिनीबीजराजान रावावस्थोत्तमोत्तमम् ।। २१ । ६४ एतद् बीजाष्टकं कुर्याद् घोयीया अष्टकस्य तु । पदानां षोडशानां तु बीजान्यष्टौ द्विधा कुरु ।। २२ ।। अवसाने पदानां तु ते बीजा: षोडश स्मृताः । भविष्यन्ति च देवेश आद्यन्तशिवयोजिताः ।। २३ ।। प्रसादस्य तु जीवस्य शिरं कृत्वा चतुर्दशम् । भवते शिवराजान ँ कृत्वा न्यासं समारभेत् ।। २४ ॥ पदाभ्यां“ जानुजङ्घाभ्यां आधारे हृदि मण्डले । कुक्षिभ्यां पृष्ठवंशे च तथा बाहुद्वये पुनः ।। २५ ।। वक्त्रमण्डलमेवं तु अष्टस्थानेषु विन्यसेत् । •७३ संहार पूर्वतः कृत्वा ततः सृष्टिक्रमं पुनः ।। २६ ।। अघोर्याद्यात्मक” न्यासं त्रिकण्टावरणोद्धृतम्” । कथितं तव देवेश पुर्यष्टकसमायुतम् ।। २७ । ७७ •७८ शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धश्च पञ्चमः । मनो बुद्धिरहंकार पुर्यष्टकमिति स्मृतम् ॥ २८ ॥ b ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-ONE 77 The City of Mahārudra O Lord (nātha), (it is formed with the letter) between Bha and La (Ha), along with (the one beginning with) Ba (Sa) and the head of AU covered by the energy of the Point and Sound (HSAU¤). The city of Mahārudra has (thus) been extracted. (19cd-20ab) Yoginī Another (seed-syllable is as follows): (the letter) following Smoky Flag (Sa) conjoined with the seat of the Arch. The Arch is the Half Moon of the head and is unbroken bliss. (This,) the king of seed-syllables, is that of the Yoginī. It is the state of Sound (rāvāvasthā), the best of the most excellent. (20cd-21) Fashion this group of eight seed-syllables of the eightfold (Vidyā of the goddess) Ghoryā. (22ab) The Deposition of the Vidyā on the Body Double the eight seed-syllables for the sixteen parts (pada) (of the mantra).10 At the end of the parts, these seed-syllables are said to be sixteen. O Lord of the gods, they shall be joined to (the word) ‘Śiva’ at the beginning and at the end.11 (22cd-23) (The seed-syllable called) Śivarāja is (formed) once the head, which is the fourteenth (AU), has been fashioned of Prasāda and of the individual Soul (jīva). Once this is done, begin the deposition. (24) (It is done) on 1) the two feet, 2) the two thighs and knees, 3) in the foundation, 4) in the circle of the heart, 5) on the two armpits, 6) on the back, 7) on the two arms and 8) on the circle of the face. In this way, deposit (the seed- syllables) in (these) eight places. (25-26ab) Once one has, first of all, performed (this deposition according to the sequence of) withdrawal, (one should) then (do it again, this time) according to the sequence of emanation. (26cd) O Lord of the gods, the deposition beginning with Aghoryā extracted from the Triangle12 has been explained to you conjoined with the City of Eight. (27) Sound, touch, form, taste and smell (as the) the fifth, (along with) mind, intellect and ego are said to (constitute) the City of Eight.13 (28)

sanskrit: 78 कुमारिकाखण्डः ब्रह्माण्यादेवताद्यष्टौ चतुःषष्टिस्तु संख्यया । एवं व्याप्तिक्रमेणैव अघोर्यष्टक विन्यसेत् ॥ २९ ॥ अथ विद्याक्रमं न्यासं सिद्धगाङ्गसमायुतम् । करन्यासक्रमेणैव पूर्वं यत् ख्यापितं मया ।। ३० ॥ साम्प्रतं बीजविन्यास तथा वै पीठपञ्चकम् । विसर्गाद्यं महावर्णं पञ्चधा कारयेत् स्वरम् ।। ३१ ।। महद्भूतमतः कृत्वा दीर्घपङ्कजभेदितम् । ८७ कलाबिन्द्वङ्कितं देव एतद् वै बीजपञ्चकम् ।। ३२ ।। विन्यस्तव्यं हि देव्यायास्तत्त्वपञ्चकसंयुतम्” । पृथिवी शक्तिबीजं तु आपो वै सोमबीजकम् ॥ ३३ ॥ तेजो वै सूर्यबीजं तु वायुर्व बिन्दुबीजकम् । आकाशं नादबीजं” तु एतद् वै बीजपञ्चकम् ॥ ३४ ॥ तेषां स्थानानि वै पञ्च गुरुवक्त्रे प्रतिष्ठिताः” । पृथिवी कन्दचक्रे तु आपो वै योनिमण्डले ॥ ३५ ॥ तेजो वै ँ नाभिचक्रस्थं वायुर्हृदयमण्डले“ । आकाशं च भ्रुवोर्मध्ये बीजस्थानानि पञ्च च ।। ३६ ।। ९९ १०२ बीजबीजाश्रमा: पञ्च कृत्वा आद्येन संयुतम् ' । लब्ध्वा गुरूपदेशं तु न्यस्तव्यं बीजपञ्चकम् ।। ३७ ॥ १०३ अन्यथा न भवेऽवस्था बीजहीना च सुन्दर । पृथिव्यादिषु तत्त्वेषु बन्ध चास्तमन भवेत् ॥ ३८ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-ONE 79 The eight consisting of the deities BrahmāSī and the others (become) sixty-four in number. One should deposit Aghoryan˜aka in this way according to the sequence of pervasion. (29) The Deposition of the Five PraSavas in the Five Sacred Seats of the Wheels in the Body Now (comes) the deposition of the sequence of the Vidyā in conjuction with the limbs of the body of the Siddhas and with the sequence of deposition on the hands as explained by me before.14 (30) Now (I will explain) the deposition of the seed-syllables and the five sacred seats. (31ab) One should cause the Great Letter namely, the vowel preceding Emission (¤), to be formed five times. Then, O god, having fashioned the Great Element conjoined with the long lotus (?) and marked with Energy (kalā) and the Point, that is indeed the pentad of seed-syllables. (31cd-32) It should be deposited along with the Five Principles (tattva) of the goddess. The Earth is the Seed of Energy (śaktibīja), Water the Seed of the Moon, Fire (tejas) the Seed of the Sun, Wind is the Seed of the Point, while Space is the Seed of Sound. This is the pentad of seed-syllables.15 (33-34) Their locations (sthāna) are five and are established in the teacher's mouth. Earth is in the Wheel of the Root, Water in the Circle of the Yoni,16 Fire (tejas) is located in the Wheel of the Navel, Wind in the Circle of the Heart, and Space between the eyebrows. (These are) the five locations of the seed-syllables. (35-36) Having fashioned the five seed-syllables, and the Hermitages of the seed- syllables having been conjoined with the first, and having (also) obtained the teacher's instruction, one should deposit the five seed-syllables. (37) Otherwise, O handsome one, (if there were) no seed-syllables there would be no (higher) state in (this) phenomenal existence. (In their absence) there is bondage and the loss (astamana) (of the higher states) on the Earth and in the other principles. (38)

sanskrit: 80 कुमारिकाखण्डः सदाभ्यासेन“ कौलेऽस्मिन् पुनर्जन्म ” कुतो भवेत् । एतदुन्मनीकरण न्यासेद बीजपञ्चकम् ।। ३९ ॥ । तत्त्वानां पञ्चकं देव अधिकारक्रमे स्थितम् । उपदेशे भवेदेव” न्यासेद पीठपञ्चकम् ।। ४० । ११६ उक्ता ये पूर्वं ते पञ्च प्रणवानि समभ्यसेत्”” । तेषामग्रे तु पीठानि कृत्वा न्यास समारभेत्” ॥ ४१ ॥ १२० •१२१ उत्तरं पूर्वपीठं तु पञ्चमाद्यन्तभूषितम् । भ्रूमध्ये कृष्णवर्णीभं तथा जालन्धरं पुनः ।। ४२ ॥ द्वितीयाद्यन्तरूपं तु आरक्त२४ हृदि मण्डले । तथा पूर्णगिरिर्नीम तृतीयाद्यन्तरोपितम् ॥ ४३ ॥ पीतवर्णं च नाभिस्थ कामरूप तथापरम् । १२७ प्रथमाद्यन्तमध्यस्थ“ हिमकुन्देन्दुगुह्यतः ।। ४४ ॥ तिस्रोवे” पञ्चमं पीठं चतुर्थाद्यन्तयोजितम् १३१ । हरितं तन्महारौद्रं कन्दस्थाने प्रकाशितम् ।। ४५ ।। १३३ ३४ उदय” कामरूपे तु स्थिति पूर्णगिर्य५ । १३७ संहार दक्षिणे पीठे निर्वाणं पञ्चमे स्थितम् ॥। ४६ ।। विश्राममाद्यपीठे तु न्यासेदं पीठपञ्चकम् । यथा ध्यानं तु पीठानां कामरूपादि भैरव ॥ ४७ ॥ तथा क्रमेण३९ तत्त्वानां कुर्याद् वै ध्यानपञ्चकम् । यथा तत्त्वानि बीजानि तथा वै पीठपञ्चकम् ॥ ४८ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-ONE 81 By constant practice of this Kaula (teaching), rebirth ceases. This is the process that brings about the supra-mental state (unmanīkaraSa), namely this, the deposition of the five seed-syllables. (39) O god, the group of five principles (tattva) is located in the Transmission of Authority (adhikārakrama). This, the deposition of the five sacred seats, is a part of the teaching in this way. (40) One should practice the Five PraSavas (as) explained previously. Placing the (five) sacred seats before them, begin the deposition. (41) The first sacred seat (OÆÆiyāna) is above. It is adorned, at its beginning and end, with the fifth (seed-syllable). It is dark blue in colour and is (located) between the eyebrows. (42abc) Similarly, the second (seed-syllable) is at the beginning and end of Jālandhara. Light red, it is in the Circle of the Heart. (42d-43ab) In the same way, the third (seed-syllable) is fixed onto the beginning and the end of the sacred seat called PūrSagiri. It is yellow in colour and is located in the navel. (43cd-44a) After this comes Kāmarūpa, which is between the first (seed-syllable) that comes at the beginning and the end. It (is located) in the genitals, which are (white like) snow, jasmine and the moon. (44bcd) Above is Tisra, the fifth sacred seat, which is conjoined, at the beginning and the end, with the fourth syllable. Green and very terrible, it is manifest in the Root (kanda). (45) Arising (udaya) takes place in Kāmarūpa, persistence in PūrSagiryaka and withdrawal in the southern seat. Extinction (occurs) (nirvāSa) in the fifth, while repose (visrāma) (takes place) in the primordial seat (ādyapī˜ha).17 O Bhairava, this is the deposition of the five seats. One should practice the five visualizations (dhyāna) of the Principles in due order as (one does) the visualization of the sacred seats, including Kāmarūpa and the rest.18 (46-47) In the same way, one should practice, in due order, the five visualizations of the Principles. The five sacred seats correspond to the (five) Principles and the seed-syllables. (48)

sanskrit: 82 कुमारिकाखण्ड: सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं ज्ञात्वा को न मुञ्चति बन्धनात् ४२ । पीठन्यासे कृते देव किञ्चित् पश्यन्ति योगिनः ॥ ४९ ॥ अदृष्टमण्डले देव अखण्डपुरमण्डलम् । तत्र सा कौलिनी विद्या अन्तः करणभेदिता ।। ५० ।। तत्त्वानां चाधिकार४३ तु प्रत्यय तु यदा भवेत् । तस्मात्४५ न्यासवरं प्रोक्तं यत् सुरैरपि दुर्लभम् ।। ५१ ।। आख्यातं तव सिद्धस्य सिद्धमार्गे प्रसिद्धकम् । इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहिताया“ अव्वाक्रम– भाषिते४९ तत्त्वपञ्चकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। २१ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-ONE 83 Knowing (this) internally and externally, who is not freed from bondage? O god, once the deposition of the sacred seats has been performed, yogis perceive something (of ultimate reality). (49) O god, (they see) the Unbroken MaSÆala of the City within the invisible maSÆala. The Kaulinī Vidyā is (located) there conjoined to the internal mental organ.19 (50) If (one attains) authority and experience (pratyaya) of the principles, (it is then) and for that reason said to be the best of depositions, hard to obtain even by the gods. I have told you who are accomplished (siddha), (this) the bestower of fame on the path of the Siddhas. (51-52ab) This is the (twenty-first) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description of the Five Principles. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with ‘KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: द्वाविंशानन्दः श्रीवक्रा उवाच' अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि न्यासं त्रिदशपूजितम् । षोढा द्वादशभेदेन न्यासं कुर्याद् गमागमे ॥ १ ॥ षोढा शक्तिः समाख्याता परा एकाक्षरा शुभा । तस्यासन ै षोढासंज्ञा षोढाशक्तिपुरं विशेत् ।। २ ॥ तस्य ते षोडशो भेदाः शृणु मार्गेण सुन्दर । जटाहार गौर्या स्थाप्य द्वादशधा पुनः ।। ३ ॥ बिन्दुना भेदित ँ कृत्वा चन्द्रार्कशिरसाहतम् । तस्याङ्गा द्वादश ं ख्याताश्छायाच्छत्रमनुक्रमात् ॥ ४ ॥ सिंहासनं तु प्रथम चाद्यासन द्वितीयकम् । १४ तृतीयं ह्येकवीर स्यात् चतुर्थं हरमण्डले ॥ ५ ॥ पञ्चमं शक्तिबीजं तु मकारासन षष्ठकम् । सप्तमं जिह्मभागस्य अष्टमं हरमस्तकम् ॥ ६ ॥ हशिरं नवमं देव दशम तारणं शिरः । राज्यमेकादशं चेति द्वादश तारकं न्यसेत् ॥ ७ ॥ वेधके वेधयेत् सर्वान् एकवीरेण भूषितान् । चन्द्रज्योतिकलाशुद्धाः” रुद्रद्वादशभेदिताः” ।। ८ ॥ २४ पुनरेव हि देवेश गौयी द्वादशभिः पुनः । रुद्रशक्तिसमायोगात्” षोढान्यासं ममाकृतिः ।। ९॥ न तस्या ँ दीपनं किञ्चिद् गौर्याद्वादशदीपिता” । एषा वै रुद्रशक्तिस्तु षोढाशक्तिर्नपुंसका ।। १० ॥ २७
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-TWO Concerning ±oÆhā The Deposition of ±oÆhā in Twelve Divisions The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Next I will tell (you) of the deposition venerated by the gods. One should perform the deposition of ±oÆhā in twelve divisions within the going and coming (of the breath).1 (1) ±oÆhā is said to be the Supreme (parā) energy. Auspicious, it consists of one syllable.2 Its seat is (also) called ±oÆhā. One should enter the city of the energy of ±oÆhā. (2) It has sixteen divisions, O handsome one; listen (to how they are known) according to the path.3 (3ab) Having established Dreadlock (µha) along with Gaurī (Ī) twelve times and having conjoined it with the Point and the head of the Moon and Sun, (the seed- syllable is complete).4 (3cd-4ab) Its limbs are said to be twelve, (beginning with) the Umbrella (K±a) (and proceeding) in due order. The Lion's Throne (Kha) is the first, the second is the seat of the first (letter) (Jha), the third is the Solitary Hero (Ma), the fourth is in the circle of Hara (Bha). (4cd-5) The fifth is the Seed of Energy, the sixth is the seat of the letter Ma (Ha), and the seventh belongs to the Deceitful One (Cha). The eighth is the head of Hara (Ja). (6) O god, the head of Ha (Ma) is the ninth, the tenth is the head of the Saviour (Pha). Kingdom is the eleventh. Deposit the Saviour (Na), which is the twelfth. (7) All being adorned with the Solitary Hero (Na) and conjoined with twelve Rudras who are pure by virtue of the energy of the light of the Moon, penetrate them with the Piercer (Ū). (8) Again, O Lord of the gods, (conjoin them) with twelve Gaurīs, and by uniting (them) with Rudra’s energy, the ±oÆhā deposition which is my form (is complete). (9) Illumined by the twelve Gaurīs, it has no (need of) any illuminator (dīpana). This is indeed Rudra's energy, the energy of ±oÆhā, the Neuter (nampuˆsakā). (10)

sanskrit: 86 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३२ .३३ तस्या” द्वादशधान्यासं आदौ ” सृष्टिक्रमेण तु । पश्चात् कुर्यादङ्गन्यासं गमागममिति स्मृतम् ।। ११ ॥ कोपस्थाने च नेत्राभ्यां कर्णनासापुटावुभौ । कण्ठे च हृदये नाभौ योनौ आधारमण्डले ॥ १२ ॥ ४१ षोढान्यास” क्रमेणोक्त गौर्याकादिर्गमः स्मृतः । आगम र सृष्टिबीजादौ इन्दुबिन्दुविकासितम् ॥ १३ ॥ मकारादिक्रमेणैव गमागमे” पदद्वयम् । सदा न्यस्तेन देवेश मण्डलाग्रे क्रमाग्रतः ॥ १४ ॥ वर्षेकेन च अभ्यासात्” दिव्याज्ञा संप्रवर्तते । द्वादशाब्दे तु संप्राप्ते पाषाणानपि वेधयेत् ।। १५ । चूर्णयेत्” पर्वतशृंगान् मुद्रास्फोटान्यनेकशः । कुरुते विविधाश्चर्यान्” आज्ञावेशप्रभावतः ।। १६ ॥ यं सोऽवलोकयेज्जन्तुः” पाशानां वज्रपञ्जरम् । तं तु संशोधयेत् शक्त्या कलिस्या साधयेत् प्रिय ।। १७ ।। विद्यासिंहासनेद ै तु न्यस्त्वा शक्तिः प्रवर्तते । । कालान्तराद् ँ गुणोत्पत्तिमचिराल्लभते ध्रुवम् ।। १८ ॥ गुरोर्वक्त्रं च निर्वाणं तथा द्वात्रिंशदक्षरा । आज्ञा सा च क्रमे” गुरोरधिकार समारभेत् ।। १९ ॥ विद्यात्रितयसंयुक्तं मण्डलं देवताक्रमम् । तथा च द्वादश`` श्लोका उलित्रितयनिर्णयम् ।। २० ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-TWO 87 Initially, her twelvefold deposition is done according to the sequence of emanation. After that one should perform the deposition of the limbs. (These two together) are said to be the `going and coming'. (11) (The deposition is done) in 1) the place of wrath (between the eyebrows), 2-3) on both eyes, 4-5) on both the ears and 6-7) nostrils, 8) on the throat, 9) the heart, 10) the navel, 11) the Yoni and 12) on the Circle of the Foundation. (12) (Thus) the deposition of ±oÆhā has been declared in due order. The going is said to commence with Gauryākā, (while) the coming, which is developed (vikāsita) by the lunar Point, commences with the seed of emanation (AI¤).5 (13) The two conditions within the going and the coming6 (take place) in accord with the sequence beginning with Ma, O Lord of the gods, by always depositing (it) in front of the maSÆala and the Krama. (14) By one year of practice the divine Command is set into operation. At the advent of the twelfth year (of practice) one is able to pierce even stones. (15) One can crush the peaks of mountains and (cause) countless explosions of luminous energy by means of gestures (mudrāspho˜a). By the power of the penetration of the Command, one can perform many kinds of wonders. (16) Whatever cage of felters (powerful as) thunderbolts of (any) person he sees, he purifies with (his) energy. O beloved, he should accomplish (this) in the Age of Strife. (17) Once he has deposited this, the lion throne of the Vidyā, (its) energy is set into operation and in a short time, he certainly attains the arising of (all the yogic) powers. (18) The mouth of the teacher is NirvāSa and the thirty-two syllable (Vidyā).7 It is the Command within the transmission (krama) that makes the teacher's authority function. (19) The maSÆala is the sequence of deities conjoined with the three Vidyās, the Twelve Verses and the teaching concerning the three lineages (uli). (20)

sanskrit: 88 कुमारिकाखण्ड: •६३ ज्ञात्वा तु प्रथमं देव चित्रं दमयते ततः । मन्त्रपादेन चैकेन विद्यापादार्धमेव च ।। २१ ।। मुद्रा चैवाष्टभागेन गुरुपादैकसंज्ञकः । निर्वाणे च निरंशे च तदा सिद्धिं लभेन्नरः ।। २२ ।। एतत् पूर्वक्रमं ज्ञात्वा पश्चात् षोढा समभ्यसेत् । •७१ ७२ तच्च” द्वादशभिर्भेदैः सिंहासनं समुद्धृतम् ॥ २३ ॥ तस्यैव नायकी विद्या परा चैकाक्षरा भवेत् । मेरुमध्ये तु कौलेश: ३ कपालासनसंस्थितः ।। २४ ।। अधः सृष्टिसमायुक्तः त्रयोदशविभूषितः । विसर्गस्था परा ह्येषा प्लुतस्वरविवर्जिता ।। २५ ।। नपुंसकपदेनैव न स्त्रीकारणपुंगवम् । तस्याधिकारमायात श्रीमच्चन्द्रपुरे गृहे ।। २६ ।। ७९ पारम्पर्योपदेश” तु तस्याध्यात्मिकनिर्णयम् । ८० आदौ सा सकला ं प्रोक्ता कूटभूता धोमुखी ।। २७ ।। हिमकुन्देन्दुधवला श्रवमाणा मनोन्मना । कोपान्ते” विन्यसेद् देव सिंहरूपक्रमेण तु ॥ २८ ॥ न चास्या“ दीपनं देय स्वभावेनैव दीपिता । लक्षजापाद्“ भवेत् सिद्धिस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ।। २९ ।। इत्याद्यावतारे मन्थानभैरवयज्ञे” अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे” मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये” कादिभेदे आज्ञा– पारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रम- भाषिते“ षोढाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। २२ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-TWO 89 O god, once he knows the first, he controls the variegated (universe) (citra). Then, with one part (pāda) of the mantra and half a part of the Vidyā, (and with) the Gesture (i.e. Śakti) with (its) eight sections and the single term (formed from the) part (concerning the) teacher, a man achieves success (siddhi) within NirvāSa devoid of aspects. (21-22) Having learned that, the initial sequence, one should then practice (the deposition of) ±oÆhā. That, with (its) twelve divisions, is the extraction of the Lion's Throne. Its mistress (nāyakī) is the Parā Vidyā of one syllable.8 (23-24ab) Kauleśa is in the centre of Meru, established on the seat of the Skull. (He is) conjoined below (with the letter of) Emanation and is adorned with the thirteenth (letter) (AI). This is the Supreme (Vidyā) located in Emission, devoid of prolated vowels. (24cd-25) Its authority has come to the House which is the venerable City of the Moon because of its neuter state (napuˆsaka) and not as feminine (or) masculine.9 (26) (This) is the teaching of the transmission from teacher to disciple (pāramparyopadeśa) (and its) inner significance (nirSaya). Initially, she is said to be energized (sakalā) in the form of a Peak (seed-syllable) (kū˜a) and is facing downwards. She is the Transmental (manonmanā) who, white as snow, jasmine and the moon, flows (downwards). (27-28ab) O god, it should be deposited (between the eyebrows) within the (the place of) Wrath10 according to the transmission (krama) of the Lion. O god, she (requires) no energizing (syllable) (because) she is illuminated by (her) own nature. By repeating it a hundred thousand times, (one gets) success (siddhi), and thereafter one reaches the Supreme State. (28cd-29) This is the (twenty-second) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) concerning the description of ±oÆhā. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It is on the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) and is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

english: CHAPTER TWENTY-THREE Concerning Tadgraha and the Samayā Vidyā. The Formation of Tadgraha Mantra The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: I will now explain Tadgraha (which is) conjoined with the three Vidyās that has emerged from A1, and which is the root, in accord with the eight classes (of letters). (1) The first part is A NA A,2 Ā THA GHO is the second, I ¬ RE is the third, Ī ­ HRĪ¤ is the fourth. (2) The fifth is U ŀ PA, Ū Ŀ RA is said to be the sixth, ¬ CA MA is the seventh, and ­ DHA GHO, the eight. (3) ŀ ¦A RE is given in the ninth (place), Ŀ U HRAU¤ is said to be the tenth and E Ū GHO is the eleventh, (while) AI Ī RA is the twelfth. sanskrit: 92 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ८५ म म ऐं एकचारिंश य श ह्रीँ द्विचत्वारिंशम् । ९३ र अ हूं त्रिचत्वारिंशं ल त ह्रीं चतुश्चारिंशम् ॥ १२ ॥ व ए ऐं पञ्चचारिंश श ऐ ह्रीं षट्चत्वारिंशम् । १०२ ष ओ ऐं सप्तचारिंश स औ क्षं अष्टचारिंशम् ।। १३ ।। १०३ १०८ ह द°३ ह्रीँ ऊनपञ्चाशत् क्ष फ हस्रौं शतार्धकम् । पञ्चाशत्पदसंयोगात् संग्रहेण तु तद्ग्रहम् ॥ १४ ॥ शब्दराशिक्रमेणैव न्यासं कुर्याच्च तद्ग्रहे । भवेद् दिव्यतनुर्मत्यो” अस्य न्यासस्य सेवनात् ॥ १५ ॥ षण्मासात्”” पठिते”४ सिद्धिः अथवाब्देन निश्चयात् शस्त्रघातैर्न भिद्येत अच्छिद्रो' वज्रयोगिनः ११९ कृत्वादौ रावबीजं तु पदस्यान्ते तथा पुनः । रावबीजपुटान्तस्थ” विद्यात्रितयभेदतः ।। १७ ।। सुदीप्त” तद्ग्रहं तस्माद् बीजरिक्तं परांमुखम् । । ११५ । ॥ १६ ॥ परदेहाद् विनिष्क्रान्तं योगिनीमुखसंचयम् ॥ १८ ॥ एवं तद्ग्रहक्षेत्रं तु विधानवदशेषतः ' १२४ एवं वै कुलसंचार कुलाचारे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ १९ ॥ यस्येदं वक्त्रगं न्यासं सोऽपि शान्तपदे स्थितः । १२८ १२६ पूर्वाभ्यस्तं न संदेहो अन्यायं न प्रवर्तते ॥ २० ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच' २९ १३० पुनरन्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि न्यासं तु समयक्रमम् । पदभेदक्रमेणैव विद्या पीठेश्वरी भवेत् ।। २१ ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-THREE 93 MA MA AI¤ is the forty-first, YA ŚA HRĪ¤ is the forty-second. RA A¤ HŪ¤ is the forty-third and LA TA HRĪ¤ is the forty-fourth. (12) VA E AI¤ is the forty-fifth and ŚA AI HRĪ¤ is the forty-sixth. ±A O AI¤ is the forty-seventh and SA AU K±A¤ is the forty-eighth. (13) HA DA HRĪ¤ is the forty-ninth and K±A PHA HSRAU¤3 is the fiftieth. Tadgraha (is formed in this way) by the conjunction of these fifty parts (pada) taken together. (14) One should perform the deposition according to the sequence of the Assembly of Sounds (śabdarāśi) within the Tadgraha. By the practice of this deposition, a mortal man becomes one who possesses a divine body. (15) One achieves success (siddhi) by reciting it for six months or, certainly, (by doing so) for a year. (This) adamantine yogi, free of weak points (acchidra), cannot be pierced by the blows of weapons. (16) The seed-syllable of Sound (rāvabīja)4 having been formed at the beginning as well as at the end of each part (pada), Tadgraha — established within the capsule of the seed-syllable of Sound and conjoined with the Triple Vidyā — is well inflamed. Therefore, devoid of the seed-syllable, it is not propitious (parā‰mukha). (17-18ab) Such, in its entirety, is the field of Tadgraha according to the prescription (of the scripture). (Being) the aggregate (of the teaching that comes) from the mouth of the Yoginīs, it has emerged from the Supreme Body (paradeha). (18cd-19ab) Such, indeed, is the movement of energy (within the body) (kulasañcāra) which is established in the practice of Kula (kulācāra). Also, he on whose lips this deposition resides abides on the plane of peace. There can be no doubt that once this has been practiced, no injustice can take place. (19cd-20) Ko‰kaSā — the Samayā Vidyā of Pī˜heśvarī The venerable goddess Vakrā said: Again, I will tell (you) another deposition and transmission of the Rule (samayakrama) in due order, according to the division of its parts (pada), namely, the Vidyā who is the Mistress of the Sacred Seat (pī˜heśvarī).5 (21)

sanskrit: 94 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १३२ च्चे वि चेति” पदं पूर्वं णिकि णिकि च द्वितीयकम् । च्छ र ई च सचन्द्रार्ध ३३ च्छ र आ सार्धचन्द्रमा ॥ २२ ॥ उभयोस्तृतीय'' रेघो३५ विरभै येमस७ पुनः । १३६ ग ल ऊ३८ सशशि” कृत्वा चतुर्थपदमुद्धृतम् ।। २३ ।। १४१ १४२ कहशब्द द्विरभ्यास संयोगात् पदषष्ठमम्' । सहशब्द४३ द्विरभ्यास देवताष्टपद स्मृतम् ।। २४ ।। १४६ हर औ चन्द्रशून्यस्थं द्विधाभूतं नवमं स्मृतम् । णिकक¨ द्विपञ्च च णिकको ” दशैकाधिकम् ।। २५ ।। हशक्ति:५१ शून्यचन्द्रार्धं कला ५२ रेफं च चन्द्रमा । गौर्या शून्यं क्रमादेकपिण्डमेवं तु द्वादशम् ।। २६ ।। मेनणञङः १५३ पदं तु५४ इदमेव त्रयोदशम् । हरगौरी शशि : शून्यं हरा शून्यं च मौलिनी ॥। २७ ।। चतुर्दशपदं ख्यातं खिमुराघो अ एव च । पञ्चदश५७ समाख्यातं राव रेघो - अ षोडशम् ॥ २८ ॥ रेघोर ९ सप्तदश १६४ १६१ स्यात् रे रा रा स्यात् १ रे रा रा २ च दशाष्टमम् ' १६६ १६७ १६३ । केब्जिकु हसौः ४ विंशेति श्रीं ह्रीँ ऐं पद विंशमम् ।। २९ ।। सिंहक्रमेण वाख्यातं ऐंकारादि १७४ अनुक्रमात् १७२ । उदय' ३ सूर्यमार्गेण सोममार्गेण रोधनम् ।। ३० ।। १७७ चन्द्रसूर्यक्रमेणैव वर्णैश्च चतुःषष्टिभिः । १७८ ८० समयाख्या कुले कौले आदिमे नाम योजिता ॥ ३१ ॥ आद्यन्तेन” समायुक्ता बीजयुक्ता मनोन्मना २ । सा च पीठेश्वरी माया समया कुलमालिनी ।। ३२ ।।

sanskrit: 96 कुमारिकाखण्ड: सा दीप्ता बीजसंयुक्ता बीजरिक्ता ४ अदीपिता । १८६ १८७ महानेषाधिकारी यः सेव्यमाना स सिद्ध्यति ।। ३३ । १८८ बीजैश्चतुर्दशै : प्रोक्ता कोंकणा ज्वलभूषिता । लक्षैकेन तु जप्तेन रुद्रशक्तिः प्रवर्तते ।। ३४ ॥ अनया ज्ञातमात्रया” सकृदावर्तनादपि । विद्यायाः स्मरणादेव उद्धारोद्धृतमात्रतः ।। ३५ ॥ स्मरणादपि सौभाग्यं महापापक्षयो भवेत् । सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं पठनादेव नश्यति ।। ३६ ॥ तत्क्षणान्मुच्यते शिष्यो चक्रे वा मण्डलान्तरे । विद्यापीठोपपीठे४ च योगिनीचक्रमध्यतः ।। ३७ ।। एकवृक्षे श्मशाने च मेलके वा चतुष्पथे । ।। ३८ ।। तर्पणात् पात्रसंपूर्णे विश्वामित्रकपालके अथवा नृकपालें च पूजयेत् तर्पयेत्” ततः । २०५ १९९ २०३ समयलोपाद् मुच्येत” तेजश्चायुः” पराक्रमम् वर्तते ज्ञानसद्भाव०४ योगिनीकुलमेलकम् । लभते समयायुक्तो वीरद्रव्यं चरुं तथा ।। ४० । प्राशनाद् भवते सिद्धिः अन्यथा मरणं भवेत् । निर्विशङ्के पदे प्राप्ते संग्राह्यं समयाक्रमम् समयाचरुकं प्राश्यं सर्वसिद्धिफलप्रदम् । २०७ ।। ३९ ।। ।। ४१ ।। व्रतस्थो व्रतहीनो वा असमयी समयी भवेत् ॥ ४२ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-THREE 97 (When) she is conjoined with the seed-syllables, she is energized (dīptā). Devoid of these seed-syllables, she is not (adīpitā). Great is he who has the authority and practices (this Vidyā). He is successful. (33) She, along with the fourteen seed-syllables,8 is said to be KoˆkaSā, adorned with flames. By repeating (this Vidyā) 100,000 times, Rudra's energy is set into operation. (34) Benefits, ritual application and admonitions Great sin is destroyed merely by knowing (the Vidya), or by just rotating through it once (āvartana). By remembering the Vidyā or merely by enunciating it, or by recalling it, (one attains) good fortune. By reciting it, the sin of seven lifetimes is destroyed.9 (35-36) The disciple is freed that very moment (wherever he may be,) in the cakra10 or within the maSÆala, in the sacred seats of wisdom (vidyāpī˜ha), primary or secondary, in the midst of the Yoginīcakra, in (a desert where there is only) one tree, in a crematorium, in a gathering (melaka) or on a crossroad. (37-38ab) (This happens) when, by offering libation (tarpaSa), the vessel is full. (This may be made) of the palmyra fruit as (a substitute for) a skull (viśvāmitrakapāla) or else one should worship (the Vidyā) in a human skull11 and then offer (it) libation. (38cd-39ab) By transgressing the Rule (samayalopa),12 power (tejas), longevity and valour (shall surely) abandon one. (Whereas) the essence of knowledge which conjoins with the Yoginīkula abides (for) one who is intent on the Rule (samayāyukta). In the same way, he acquires the offering of the Heroes, the sacrificial pap (caru) by eating; it comes success (siddhi). Otherwise, (failing in this), there is (only) death (for him). (39cd-41ab) Having attained the plane free of doubts, one should take up the rite (krama) of the Samayā. One should eat the sacrificial pap of the Samayā that bestows the fruit of every accomplishment (siddhi). (Through it), one devoid of vows is established in the vow and one who does not possess the rule (asamayin) comes to possess it. (41cd-42)

sanskrit: 98 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २०९ अदीक्षितो“ दीक्षितोऽसौ ” दुर्भगः सुभगो भवेत् । २१३ अल्पायुषो दीर्घमायुर्दरिद्रो १२ धनवान् भवेत् ॥ ४३ ॥ समयविद्याधरो मन्त्री ४ वीरद्रव्यसमाश्रितः । तस्याधिकारमतुल५ शास्त्रेऽस्मिन् कौलिनीपुरे ॥ ४४ ॥ समयविद्याविनिर्मुक्तो कुलाचारविवर्जितः । मन्त्राचारविलुप्तस्तु दीक्षितोऽपि पशुर्भवेत् ॥ ४५ ॥ समयभङ्गेषु दारिद्र्यं” मरणं गुरुलङ्घनात् । आज्ञाभङ्गे कुतः सिद्धिरचिरान्नरकं व्रजेत् ।। ४६ ।। •२२० २२१ गोपयेत कुलाचार गुर्वौघं च कुलागमम् । २२२ नैवेद्यं चरुद्रव्यं च यत् किञ्चित् क्रमसंस्थितम् ।। ४७ ।। २२३ २२५ मम विद्याव्रतस्थस्तु प्राशयेद् समयाग्रतः ' २२६ २२७ गुरूच्छिष्टं तु चरुक समयायुतमन्त्रितम् ।। ४८ ॥ २२८ २२९ साष्टाङ्गप्रणिपातेन कृत्वा मण्डलक पुनः । हस्तयोरुभयोः कृत्वा देह्यनुज्ञां प्रसादतः ॥ ४९ ॥ २३२ एवमुक्तस्तु शिष्येण गुरुवक्त्रप्रसादतः । २३३ प्राशनात् कौलिकी सिद्धिर्निर्विकल्पस्य नान्यथा ।। ५० ।। न्यासं विद्याधुना४ वक्ष्ये सृष्टिन्यायेन कौलिकम् । आद्यार्णसप्तक२३५ वक्त्रे रा रा २३६ चक्षुद्वये स्मृतौ ॥ ५१ ॥ २४० रेफ२३८ तृतीयकं चक्षुषे९ कोपान्ते च विन्यसेत् । रा रा २४९ कर्णौभयोर्देव २४२॥ कुब्जिके २४२० कुलनायिका ४३ ॥ ५२ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-THREE 99 One who is not initiated becomes an initiate and one who is unfortunate becomes fortunate. One who has a short life span becomes long-lived and a poor man, rich. (43) The reciter of mantra who possesses the Samayā Vidyā and who is devoted to (the consumption) of the sacrificial substance of the Heroes has unequalled authority in this scripture and in the City of Kaulinī.13 (44) One who does not possess the Samayā Vidyā and who does not practice Kula conduct (kulācārā) is devoid of the practice of mantra, even though he is an initiate, is (an uninitiated), fettered soul (paśu). (45) When transgressions of the Rule occur, poverty and death (are the consequences) because one has disobeyed the teacher. When the Command has been contravened, how is accomplishment (siddhi) (possible)? (Indeed,) one quickly goes to hell. (46) One should keep Kula conduct secret; so too the Lineage of the Teacher (gurvaugha), Kula scripture, the food offering (naivedya), the sacrificial pap and whatever is in the Krama. (47) He who is established in the vow (of practicing) my Vidyā should eat the remains of the offering to the teacher (gurūcchin˜a) in front of the Samayā. (This is) the sacrificial pap that (has been energized with) mantra (by the recitation) of the Samayā Vidyā millions of times (ayuta). (48) Graced by the teacher's mouth, the disciple (achieves) the Kaulikī Siddhi of the state free of thought constructs (nirvikalpa). (He attains this) only by eating it after having again (worshipped) the maSÆala by prostrating (before it) and (joining) together both hands, saying: "By your grace, give me (your) permission!"14 (49-50) The Kaulika deposition of the Vidyā Now I will tell (you) the Kaulika deposition of the Vidyā according to the pattern of emanation (srn˜i). (51ab) The first group of seven syllables15 is (to be deposited) on the face. RĀ RĀ are said to be on the two eyes. Deposit the third letter RA (i.e. RE) in the eye (between the eyebrows) within Wrath. RĀ RĀ are (to be deposited) on the two ears and KUBJIKE is the mistress (nāyikā) of Kula. (51cd-52)

sanskrit: 100 २४५ कुमारिकाखण्ड: अघोरे २४ नासिकाग्रे ५ तु त्रिशूलं विन्यसेदिति । •२४७ जिह्वायां रावबीजं तु अघोरा चासनत्रये २४८ ॥ ५३ ॥ मुखि४९ उष्टद्वयारोप्य ह्रां ह्रीं गण्डस्थलावुभौ । •२५१ •२५२ ङकार ५१ चिबुके न्यस्य ञकार ५२ कण्ठमेखला ॥ ५४ ॥ •२५३ •२५४ णकारं चक्रकाद्यायां क्र५५ इति गलमेखला । •२५६ २५७ •२५८ मेकार हृदयात्मानं हूंकारं प्राणमध्यतः ॥ ५५ ॥ कोंकणि“” स्तनयोरेतत् त्रिकमेवानुविन्यसेत् ं । कोंकण २६१ उदरे न्यस्य इकार १२ नाभिमण्डले •२६२ २६७ २६३ ।। ५६ ।। २६८ ह्रौं २६४ ह्रौं करयोः ६५ कहौ हसशब्द तु पृष्ठतः हसशब्दान्वितं ९ चैव स्कन्धयोः कह विन्यसेत् ॥ ५७ ॥ २७० कहान्यं बाहुयुग्मे तु ग्लँकार योनिमण्डले । २७३ सहशब्द कराभ्यां तु समयेति करांगुली ।। ५८ ॥ २७५ २७७ भैरवीति तथाघोरे २०४ च्छ्राँ च्छ्रीं ऊरुकयुग्मकें । ९ किणीति जानुजङ्घाभ्यां किणि २८२ २८१ । पादद्वये न्यसेत् ।। ५९ ।। विच्चे पादांगुलीप्रान्ते वाग्भवं वक्त्रमध्यतः .२८३ । यत्र स्थानात् ३ समारभ्य कृतं न्यासं च विद्यया ।। ६० ।। पादान्तात् पुनस्तत्रैव८५ उच्चारो यत्र तल्लयः । २८४ २८६ २८७ उदयास्तममेव तु संपुट परिगीयते ।। ६१ ।। २८८ २८९ एषा सा समया विद्या अपसव्याद् “ विनिर्गता' । २९० तद्ग्रहस्य तु क्षेत्रस्य एष एवाधिकारिणी ।। ६२ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-THREE 101 AGHORE is on the tip of the nose; there one should deposit the Trident. The seed-syllable of Sound (rāva) (PHRE¤) (should be deposited) on the tongue and AGHORĀ on the triple seat (āsanatraya). (53) Having placed MUKHI on the two lips, HRĀ¤ and HRĪ¤ (correspond) to the two cheeks. Having deposited the letter ¥A on the chin, the letter nA (corresponds) to the band (mekhalā) around the throat. (54) The letter ¦A (is deposited in the energy which is) the first within the Wheel (cakrakādyā), while NA corresponds to the band around the throat. The letter ME corresponds to the Self in the heart, while HŪ¤16 is in the middle of the vital breath (prāSa). (55) Deposit the triad (of syllables) KO¤KA¦I in this way on the two breasts and, having deposited KO¤KA¦A on the stomach, (place) the letter I in the circle of the navel. (56) HRAU¤ HRAU¤ are (to be placed) on the two hands while KAHA and the word HASA are on the back. Deposit KAHA along with the word HASA on the two shoulders. (57) Another KAHA is on the pair of arms and the syllable GLŪ¤ is in the circle of the Yoni. The word SAHA is with the two hands, while SAMAYĀ corresponds to the fingers of the hand. (58) BHAIRAVI and AGHORE CCHRĀ¤ CCHRĪ¤ are on the pair of thighs. KI¦I should be deposited on the knees and shanks and KI¦I (again) on the two feet. VICCE is at the extremity of the toes and Vāgbhava (AI¤) in the middle of the face. (59-60ab) From whichever place one starts and performs the deposition by means of the Vidyā, one must again (return) there, that is, the end of the feet, where the recitation (of the Vidyā began). That is the merger (of the Vidyā). The arising and falling away (of the Vidyā) in this way is said to be (its) encapsulated condition (saˆpu˜a). (60cd-61) This is the Samayā Vidyā that has emerged from the left. She alone has authority over the field of Tadgraha. (62)

sanskrit: 102 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २९२ विद्यान्यासेन”” सिद्ध्येत १२ कूटेनैव विधानतः । पञ्चोपचारपूजायां मण्डलाग्रे गुरोग्रतः २९५ २९४ ॥ ६३ ॥ २९६ विद्यापीठेऽथवा चक्रे यत्र क्रमाग्रतः कृतम् । •२९७ तत्र तस्य महावस्थाप्रत्ययं कौलिकं भवेत् ॥ ६४ ॥ २९९ ३०० तस्य देव्याश्च”“ कारुण्यं कुरुते स्वप्नदर्शनम् । सर्वद्वन्द्वविनिर्मुक्तः अचिरात् खेचरं पदम् ।। ६५ ।। ३०२ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अवाक्रमभाषिते तद्ग्रहसमयविद्याधिकारवर्णनक्रमो नामानन्दः ।। २३ ।। ३०४ ३०३
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-THREE 103 One achieves success by the deposition of the Vidyā by means of the Peak (seed-syllables), in accord with the prescribed procedure, in the course of the rite of adoration performed with five sacrificial offerings (pañcopacārapujā) in front of the maSÆala and the teacher. (63) (Regardless of) whether (it is) done within the sacred seat of the Vidyā (vidyāpī˜ha), in the Wheel or in front of the Krama, there (the adept) shall have the Kaulika experience (pratyaya) of the Great State (mahāvasthā). (64) And the goddess has compassion (for him and he shall receive) a vision of (her) in his dreams (svapnadarśana). Free of all duality, (he) quickly (attains) the Plane of Flight. (65) This is the (twenty-third) chapter called the Transmission Concerning the Description of the Authority of Tadgraha and the Samayā Vidyā. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses) along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with ‘KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: चतुर्विंशानन्द श्रीनाथ उवाच श्रुतं वक्रे 'मया 'वाक्यं कुमारीखण्डनायिके । कथं सा मातृका नाम श्लोकद्वादशभेदिता ॥ १ ॥ न ज्ञाता च मया' देवि श्लोकार्थं कथय स्फुटम् । श्रीवक्रा उवाच महानन्दविकासेन' यत् त्वया पृच्छिता ं ह्यहम् ।। २ ।। तत्सर्वं कथयिष्यामि मातृकाक्रमनिर्णयम् । योऽसौ परापरोऽनन्तः विभुः कारणमव्ययं ॥ ३ ॥ प्रशान्तमपरं नाम शान्तातीतमनामयम् । पूर्वसंकृत्यमाकारं भैरवस्य महेश्वरः ॥ ४ ॥ कल्पे पराम्परे पूर्वं मन्वन्तरशतैरपि । युगैश्चतुरशीतिः पाषणवत् या तु संस्थिता ॥ ५ ॥ एकाहं भैरवे यज्ञे भैरव त्वमहं पुनः । न स्त्री न पुरुषाकारं नाकारं विद्यते क्वचित् ।। ६ ।। शून्याकारें तमैकत्वे रमणानन्दचेतसम्” । शमनं” कुलसंकाशं किञ्चिज्जानाम्यहं हर ।। ७ ॥ २३ न वाचा श्रुतिचक्षुभ्यां न च बुद्ध्याम्यह ै हर । कैवल्यानन्दमाह्लादं” संवतीन्तं शतार्धकम् ॥ ८ ॥ २७ तस्येच्छा” किञ्चिच्चिन्मात्रं अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिरूपिणम् । २९ तदाहं विस्मयमापन्ना किमिदं शून्यरूपकम् ॥ ९ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR The Casket of the Sixfold Deposition. The Creation and the Production of the Primordial Sound Śrīnātha said: O Vakrā, mistress of the KumārīkhaSÆa!1 I have heard (your) discourse. (Now tell me) how Mātrkā, (the energy of the letters of the alphabet,) is conjoined with the Twelve Verses. I have not known (this energy). O goddess, explain the meaning of these Verses clearly. (1-2ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Questioned by you (and inspired by) the expansion of great bliss, I will tell (you) all this, namely, the teaching concerning the Sequence of Mātrkā. (2cd-3ab) O Great Lord, that which is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent), endless and pervasive, the imperishable cause, extremely tranquil and, free of defects, is also called ‘beyond the tranquil’, this is the first form of Bhairava to be fashioned.2 (3cd-4) In the prior series of Kalpas, for a period of a hundred Manvantaras and eighty-four Yugas and more, it was I who was alone, (inactive) like a stone, in Bhairava's sacrifice. Again, O Bhairava, both you and I bore neither male or female form. (Indeed,) there was no form anywhere. O Hara, within this void form and at one with darkness was the mind of the bliss of the play (of transcendental Being). It was tranquillity (itself), close to Kula, and I knew nothing at all. (5-7) O Hara, I was not aware of anything through speech, hearing or sight. The fiftyfold joy which is the bliss of liberation (kaivalya) was within the Fire of Destruction (saˆvartā).3 (8) Its will is pure consciousness (cinmātra), the Unmanifest whose form is subtly manifest. Then I was overcome with wonder and (asked myself): "What is this voidness?" (9)

sanskrit: 106 कुमारिकाखण्ड: इति मत्वा गहन” घोरं भीताहं सुप्तचेतसा । प्रविष्टा भैरवे यज्ञे स्थिताहं पररूपतः ।। १० ।। परमाणुस्वरूपेण किञ्चिद्रूपं च सिंहकम् । सिंहसंवर्तक नाथ व्यावृतं तमसाकुलम् ॥ ११ ॥ अकुलादिकुल चैव व्याकुलं कुलकौलिकम् । कलनात्” ध्वनिनादान्तं तन्नादं पञ्चधागतम् ।। १२ ॥ तच्च” च वर्णादितत्त्वं च कलानां च महोदयम् । ४४ कलाढ्यं” च तथा शान्त र ४ सविसर्गादि चालयम्” ॥ १३ ॥ महोग्रं कालिक५ रावं रूपाख्यं च तथापरम् । •४६ ४७ कुलावलितयोगेन“ विन्यसेत् कुलपद्धतिम्” ॥ १४ ॥ ५३ द्वादशानि तु श्लोकानि कर्णात् कर्णगतानि च । सदोच्चारप्रयोगेन गृह्णणते साधकोत्तमः ।। १५ ।। तस्य देयमिदं ज्ञानं अन्यथा न कदाचन । ५७ पञ्चप्रणवसंघातैः६ सामान्यैरेव भैरव ॥ १६ ॥ हंसाख्यैर्महतैर्दिव्यैः“ परामूर्तिरधिष्टितैः” । ६४ उद्धरेद् द्वादश श्लोकान् षट्कूटाधिष्ठितान् शुभान् ।। १७ ।। चत्वारः षोडशैर्भेदैस्तथा षट् नभान्तरे । । सृष्टिमध्यगता ँ ये“ च हक्षस्था द्वयभेदतः ॥ १८ ॥ कथं युग्मं कथाख्यं च अनङ्गं सृष्टिसंयुतम् । तदधो” हनुमान् नाथ रावमार्गसमन्वितम् ॥ १९ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 107 And, realising that it was terrible and deep, I was frightened and (my) mind slumbered. Having entered into Bhairava's sacrifice I remained there in (my) supreme (form). (10) And as an atom (of consciousness), the Lion (siˆhaka) (bore) a subtle form. O Lord, the Lion Fire (siˆhasaˆvartaka), full of darkness, became manifest (vyāvrta).4 (11) Kula, (which contains all things) beginning with Akula and which is Kulakaulika, became disturbed.5 By virtue of (its spontaneous) differentiation (kalana), that Sound (nāda) assumed five forms ending with the Resonance (dhvani) of Sound.6 (12) The Vidyā called Twelve Verses That (Sound) is the primordial principle of the letters, the great arising (mahodaya) of the energies (kalā). Rich with energy and tranquil, it is the (universal) abode possessing emission (visarga) and the rest (of the energies). It is supreme and greatly terrible. Called ‘Form' (rūpa), it is the sound (rāva) of Kālikā. (This), the Kula liturgy (kulapaddhati), should be deposited by means of the union enveloped in Kula (kulāvalitayoga).7 (13-14) The Twelve Verses have been transmitted by word of mouth.8 The best of adepts lays hold of them by regular recitation. This knowledge should be given (only) to him and never in any other circumstance.9 (15-16ab) O Bhairava, the Twelve Verses,10 auspicious and sustained by the six Peak (seed-syllables),11 should be enunciated along with the universal (sāmānya) Five PraSavas which, called Haˆsa, are powerful, divine and sustained by the Supreme Form (parāmūrti).12 (16cd-17) (They are) four along with sixteen divisions, and so too are the six within the Void those that are in the middle of Emanation, and those established within Ha and K±a are divided in two.13 (18) The Seed-syllables linked to the Vidyā called Twelve Verses The First Syllable The pair Ka and Tha and that which is called Katha, with Ana‰ga (Sa), are conjoined to Emanation (Ö). Below that, O Lord, is Hanumān (Kha) endowed with the Path of Sound. (19)

sanskrit: 108 गजेन्द्रशिरसाक्रान्तं बिन्दुनादकलाङ्कितम् । कुमारिकाखण्ड: ७४ आज्ञाज्योतिसमायुक्त श्लोकद्वादशनिर्णये ।। २० ।। द्वितीयमक्षर प्रोक्तं तृतीयं तु यथा भवेत् । व्योमबिन्दुशिरोभिन्न ै अग्निवेधकभेदितम् ।। २१ ॥ नादशक्तिकलायुक्तं महोग्रमिति कथ्यते । अमृतं स्रवमाण ँ ँ च शान्तयुक्तं समुच्चरेत् ।। २२ ।। द्विरभ्यास” महाशम्भो यावद् वै मातृकाक्षरम् । ० एतद् विन्यासविज्ञानं परमं देवदुर्लभम् ॥ २३ ॥ कुलावलितयोगेन उद्धार्या कुलपद्धतिः” । संहितार्थमिदं सत्यं अकथ्यं तव दर्शितम् ॥ २४ ॥ योऽसौ परापरो देवो भैरवो भवच्छेदकः । तस्य इच्छा ह्यनामाख्या किञ्चिच्चेता चिनोति यत् ।। २५ ।। सा च वै व्यापकत्वेन संपूर्ण कौलिनी परा । ८७ अमा ँ सूक्ष्मा अनामा च निरानन्दे लयंगता ।। २६ ।। सा च वै भैरवी शान्ता अनन्तेन विभाजिता” । तस्मान्मन्थानभेदेन भेदितं च परापरम् ।। २७ ।। एवं सृष्टिगतानङ्ग” अनङ्गं कामनाशनम् । तच्च हंस महात्मानं ज्वलनादमृतोद्भवम् ।। २८ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 109 Conjoined with the Head of the Lord of Elephants (AI i.e. Ta), marked with Sound (nāda) and the Point and united with the Light of the Command, (this is) said to be the second letter in the teaching concerning the Twelve Verses. (Now I will tell you) how the third should be. (20-21ab) The head, conjoined with the Point of the Void, united with Fire (Ra) and the Piercer (Ū), endowed with the power of the energy of Sound, is said to be ‘greatly terrible' (mahogra). It flows with the nectar (of immortality) and, having conjoined the peaceful (śānta) (transcendent), O Great Śambhu, one should utter (this) the letter of Mātrkā twice. (21cd-23ab) This is the supreme knowledge of the deposition, hard to acquire (even) by the gods. The Kula liturgy (kulapaddhati)14 should (thus) be extracted by means of the union enveloped in Kula (kulāvalitayoga).15 This is the (entire) purport of (this) scripture (saˆhitā). The truth that cannot be told (to the uninitiated) has been revealed to you. (23cd-24) The Bhairavī Vidyā The will (icchā) of the god Bhairava, the destroyer of conditioned existence (bhava), who is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent), is called Anāmā (the Nameless) and, of subtle consciousness, discerns (cinoti) (reality). (25) She is the supreme Kaulinī (energy) who, because (she is all-) pervasive, is perfectly complete (saˆpūrSā). (She is) Amā (the New Moon) and, subtle, is Anāmā (the Nameless) who has dissolved away in the Bliss of Stillness (nirānanda).16 (26) She is indeed Bhairavī the Tranquil One (śāntā), conjoined with (Bhairava) the Endless (ananta). Thus, (reality) is divided into supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent) by the division (brought about by) the churning (manthāna) (of power and its possessor).17 (27) In this way, Ana‰ga (Ha), which is the Passion that is the destruction of desire (kāma), is present within emanation (Sa). And that is Haˆsa (the Gander), the Great Soul who is the nectar generated from the (primordial) conflagration (jvalana). (28)

sanskrit: 110 कुमारिकाखण्ड: द्वावेतौ ँ शिवशक्त्याख्यौ ओतप्रोत जगत्त्रयम् । एतद् रहस्यमाख्यातं महामन्थानसंज्ञया ।। २९ ॥ श्रीनाथ उवाच कथं नाथे का? मे संज्ञा कुत्रोत्पत्तौ | निरामये । १०४ १०७ व्याकुलोऽहं समुत्पन्नो निःसंदिग्ध वदस्व मे ।। ३० ।। श्रीवक्रा उवाच । सरहस्यं कृतं प्रश्न” अमोघाज्ञा कुलेश्वर । कथयामि न संदेहो इच्छां कामदुग्धां कलाम् ।। ३१ ।। १११ यथाहं चिद्घनानन्दा”” आनन्दतनुतां गता३ । ११४ । तेन तृप्तिः ४ पुरास्माक भवते पृथिवी हर ११९ ११७ १२१ ।। ३२ ।। पृथिव्याह” त्व”” महच्छब्द शब्दब्रह्माक्षराणि च । सा च श्रीशाम्भवेच्छाख्या सुशान्तमिति ३ लक्षणम् ।। ३३ ।। अहं काचित् कला काली विकला कुलशाम्भवी । इच्छा ह्यहं परोत्पन्ना अव्यक्ता व्यक्तरूपिणी ॥ ३४ ॥ १२७ कुलाली कुलकौलेशी अकुलाद् व्यापकी २८ भवेत् । व्यापकत्वेन रूपेण संयोगादुपजायते ।। ३५ ।। १२९ संयोगेन तु संवती निरावर्तीत् प्रवर्तिता' । प्रथमं च अनामाख्यं नित्यं च शिरशेखरम् ।। ३६ ।। महाभैरवज्योतिश्च” व्यापकं पश्चिमे गृहे । एव३२ षट्कक्रम त्व३३ हि विद्या ३४ व्योमेन ३५ वेष्टिता' १३६ ।। ३७ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 111 These two are called Śiva and Śakti. The triple universe is woven warp and woof (by them).18 This is the secret called the `Great Churning' (mahāmanthāna).19 (29) Śrīnātha said: O Mistress (nāthā), what is my name, how and where (am I) during the immaculate creation? I have become disturbed; tell me (the truth) that is free of doubt. (30) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O Lord of Kula, (you have) asked a question (the reply to which) is a secret. I will tell (you), without any doubt, about the unfailing Command which is the (divine) will, the milch cow of desire and energy. (31) Just as I, the bliss of dense (uninterrupted) consciousness, have assumed a body of bliss, in the same way, O Hara, our satisfaction formerly became the earth. (32) I am the earth, you are the Great Word (mahaccabda) and the letters of the Word Absolute (śabdabrahman). She is called the will of the venerable Śāmbhava (absolute) and her characterizing mark is her extreme tranquillity. (33) I am a certain (subtle) energy (kalā), (the goddess) Kālī Who, particularly powerful (vikalā), is Kulaśāmbhavī. I am (the divine) will, come forth as the Supreme (goddess) (Parā). (I am) unmanifest and my nature is (all that is) manifest.20 (34) Kulālī, the mistress of the Kulakaula, is the pervasive (power generated from) Akula. (She) is born from the conjunction (saˆyoga) that takes place by virtue of (her) pervasive nature.21 (35) (Thus) Saˆvartā has issued forth out of the immobile (nirāvarta) by the conjunction (of Śiva and Śakti). 1) The first is called the Nameless, 2) (then comes) the Eternal (nitya), 3) the Peak of the Head, 4) the Great Bhairava, 5) the Light and 6) the Pervasive One in the Western House. In this way are you the Vidyā (says the god) in the sequence of the group of six, enveloped within the Void (vyoman) (of transcendence).22 (36-37)

sanskrit: 112 कुमारिकाखण्ड: उदय विमलं नाम अमृत बिन्दुभैरवम्” । ४० १४१ संयोगेन समुत्पन्ना तदान्ते द्वादशः स्मृताः ॥ ३८ ॥ १४३ मम मूर्तिगता कुर्यात् सृष्टिहेतूपलक्षणाम् ' अहं सा च परा चैका अपरा सिद्धिसागरें १४५ सागर १४६ मन्मथ४७ नाम कुलाकुलकुलान्तगम् १५१ १४८ । ।। ३९ ।। । त्रिकुलं त्रीणि तत्त्वानि” त्रिधा मन्त्री च शक्तयः ।। ४० ।। त्रीणि''' सिद्धास्त्रयस्रोतस्त्रितत्त्व'५३ त्रिपथान्तरम्' १५४ । तत्परं च महास्थानं मया व्याप्तं तु सागरम् ।। ४१ ।। सागरं शशिसूर्यान्तं अखण्डमिति मण्डलम् । अखण्डमपर चैव अनन्तश्चाक्षयं तथा ।। ४२ ।। १५७ अकुलं पञ्चमं नाथ विज्ञेया: १५६ कुलभूषणाः । एवं नादः समुत्पन्नः पञ्चधा तु क्रमागतः ।। ४३ ॥ क्रमात् सृष्टि:५८ स्थिता योनौ एका एव ह्यधोमुखी । सद्भावा सा महामूर्तिज्योतिरूपा मनोन्मनी ॥ ४४ ॥ उन्मना मनवेगेन'६२ शक्ति: कुण्डलिनी कला । अमा नाम कला काली ३ स्थिताहता १४ च भैरव ॥ ४५ ॥ अस्याश्चैवासन६५ पात्रं १६ इडानामेन गीयते । १६८ १६९ इडा सा भैरवी शान्ता शक्तिपात्रमुदाहृता ।। ४६ ।। १७० उदय शशिबिम्बस्य सूर्यं मुञ्चति भास्वरम् । तच्च बिन्दु¨२ घन¨ घोरं घर्घरामृतसंभवम् ।। ४७ ।। शाम्भवं षट्कभेदेन कला कलति कौलिनी । मफ्रेखसहरावेण स्थिताग्निप्रकृतिरूपिण ।। ४८ ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 113 The arising (udaya) (of the group of six) is called the Pure (vimala) Nectar, which is the Bhairava of the Point. By the conjunction (of these principles) the Twelve are then said to have arisen at the end. (38) She is the sign of the cause of emanation and should be placed within (AI¤, which is) my Form (mūrti), (says the goddess). I am she who is the one supreme (goddess) (Parā) and also the inferior (immanent one) in the (Point which is) the Ocean of Accomplishments (siddhisāgara). (39) The Ocean is (the ocean) of passion (manmatha) located at the end of the Kula of Kulākula. Three are the Kulas, three are the Principles (tattva), threefold is the reciter of mantra and (three) the energies, three the Siddhas; (there are) three Currents, three Principles and three paths. Beyond that is the Great Place (mahāsthāna), which is the Ocean pervaded by me.23 (40-41) The Ocean is located between the Sun (SA) and Moon (HA); it is the Unbroken (akhaSÆa) MaSÆala. The Unbroken (AI¤), the Inferior (HRĪ¤), the Endless (ŚRĪ¤), the Imperishable (KHPHRE¤) and Akula (HSRŪAU¤) as the fifth: these, O Lord, should be known to be the Ornaments of Kula. Sound (nāda) that has arisen in this way has entered the sequence (krama) fivefold.24 (42-43) Emanation (srn˜i) (generated) in due order (kramāt) abides alone in the Yoni, facing downwards (as the syllable AI¤). (This energy is) the Transmental (manonmanī), the essential being (of all things) (sadbhāvā) and the Great Icon (mahāmūrti) (of the goddess) whose form is Light. (44) (She is) the Transmental who, as the force of the mind (manovega), is the energy KuSÆalinī; (she is) Kālī, the power of the New Moon (amākalā) who, O Bhairava, abides as Unstruck Sound. (45) And (this) is her throne. It is the vessel called ‘IÆā'.25 IÆā is Bhairavī who, tranquil, is said to be the Vessel of Energy (śaktipātra). (46) The dawn (udaya) of the Lunar Orb releases the brilliant Sun. That is the Point, dense and terrific, born from the nectar of the jar.26 (47) The energy (kalā) Kaulinī differentiates (kalati) the Śāmbhava (state) as the sixfold division. She abides as the nature of Fire, by means of the Sound (rāva) MA PHRE KHA SA HA.27 (48)

sanskrit: 114 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १७८ १७९ सत्त्वरजतमैकत्वे स्थिता व्योमान्तवर्तिनी । व्योम्न्यादितत्त्वसंघात तत्त्वाद् वर्णी ह्यजायन्त ॥ ४९ ॥ आक्रान्ताश्च“” कलैर्ज्ञेया: ८३ पञ्चकादिस्वभावत: ८४ । १८५ १८६ पञ्च भूता: स्वराः पञ्च सूक्ष्मशाम्भवसंभवा:' ॥ ५० ॥ शाम्भव सरहस्येद रेफखसहकारकम् ' १८९ । तस्यैव वक्त्रमाद्यं च अनामानामसंयुतम् ॥ ५१ ॥ यथा सृष्टिक्रमेणोक्त° तथा शृणु महेश्वर । १९२ व्योम जीवसमायुक्तं वह्निरर्घीशसंयुतः ॥ ५२ ।। अनुग्रहशिराक्रान्तं सूक्ष्मनादेन भेदितम् । बिन्दुचन्द्रकलाक्रान्त अक्षर भैरव हर ॥ ५३ ॥ शून्य खेचरसंयुक्तं फरमन्ते समाश्रितम् । एकपादेन संभिन्नं नादबिन्दुकलाङ्कितम् ॥ ५४ ॥ एषा सा खेचरीविद्या त्रैलोक्याकर्षणी परा । २०० २०२ यसमध्यगतं” देवं हधमध्यगतं पुनः ।। ५५ ॥ २०४ .२०५ णटमध्यगतं ३ गृह्य तदन्तरगतं विदुः । गौरीशिखरमाक्रान्तं इन्दुबिन्दुकलान्वितम् ।। ५६ ॥ कथिता शाङ्करी विद्या तृतीया कुलनायिका । २०६ २०७ चतुर्थी मायया नाम हर व्योमासनस्थिता' अग्निधामेन” संभिन्ना इ–उ–मध्यगतेन च २११ २१० २०८ । ॥ ५७ ॥ बिन्दु – अर्धकलायुक्ता रौद्ररूपा च १ अम्बिका ।। ५८ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 115 She abides within the Void in the unity of sattva, rajas and tamas. Within the Void is the aggregate of the First Principle (āditattva), and from (that) Principle arose the letters. (49) One should know that (the letters) are pervaded by energies, which are initially (found) in groups of five. Five are the gross elements and five the vowels, products of the subtle Śāmbhava (state). (50) This is the secret of the Śāmbhava (state) that generates RE PHA KHA HA SA. That is its primary face conjoined with Anāmā and Anāma (anāmānāmasaˆyuta).28 (51) Listen, O Maheśvara, as it is explained (to you) according to the sequence of emanation.29 (52ab) Bhairava (HSRŪAU¤) The Void (Ha) conjoined with the Individual Soul (Sa) along with Fire (Ra) conjoined with the Lord of the Offering (Ū), pervaded by the head of Grace (AU) and conjoined with subtle Sound (nāda), pervaded by the Point and the energy of the Moon: (this,) O Hara, is the (seed-) syllable of Bhairava. (52cd-53) Khecarī Vidyā (KHPHRE¤) The Void (Kha) conjoined with the Skyfarer located within PHARAM, conjoined with the One-footed (E) and marked with the energy of Sound and the Point: this is Khecarī Vidyā, the supreme (Vidyā), which attracts the triple world. (54-55ab) Śa‰karī Vidyā (HŚRĪ¤) (Extract) the god who is between Ya and Sa (Ha) and then (the letter) between Ha and Dha (Śa). One must lay hold of (the letter) between ¦a and µa (Ra), which (the wise know) is within it. It is pervaded by the Peak of Gaurī (Ī) and endowed with the energy of the lunar Point. (Thus) Śā‰karī Vidyā, the third mistress of Kula, has been explained.30 (55cd-57ab) Raudrī (HRĪ¤) O Hara, the fourth (Vidyā) is the one that goes by the name of Māyā, located on the seat of the Sky, conjoined with the Abode of Fire (Ra) and (Ī, the letter) between I and U. Conjoined with the Point and the Half Moon (ardhakalā), (her) form is fierce (raudra) and (she is) the mother. (57cd-58)

sanskrit: 116 कुमारिकाखण्ड: । अकथ्यमातृका शक्ति: १२ हसफ्रेकारभेदिता १३ । नादबिन्दुकलायुक्ता वाग्भवाकाररूपिणी ।। ५९ ॥ कौलिनी कुलनाथानां सिद्धानां ज्ञानभूमिका । २१४ शाम्भवाः प्रणवाः पञ्च षष्ठं चैतन्यमुत्तमम् ॥ ६० ।। षडङ्गवक्त्रसंयुक्ता पूर्णा देवी परापरा । २१६ २१७ षड्बीजानुक्रमेणैव१५ उच्चरेद् गुरूपदेशतः ९७ ।। ६१ ॥ द्विषट्कदिव्ययोगेन श्लोकद्वादशपद्धतिम्”“ । । २२० यो वेत्ति महतीं”” शम्भो श्लोकार्थपदसंयुताम् ।। ६२ ।। सोऽपि एकेन जन्मेन” कौलिकाज्ञाधरो भवेत् । यं यं २३ स्पृशति हस्तेन यं यं पश्यति चक्षुषा ।। ६३ ।। यं यं स्मरति भावेन सर्वं २४ संपद्यते क्षणात् । २२६ दुष्टान्यनेकक्रूराणि २५ भूचरोरगराक्षसा: ।। ६४ ।। तस्यालोकनमात्रेण पलायन्ति ७ दशो दिश: २२८ २२९ । इति सत्यं मया प्रोक्तं श्लोकार्थमतमुत्तमम् ॥ ६५ ॥ ये २३० न्यस्यन्ति ३१ त्रिकालज्ञास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् । श्रीवक्रा उवाच २३४ २३२ .२३६ अथ चान्यक्रम३५ वक्ष्ये श्लोकद्वादशके स्थिताः ।। ६६ ।। २३७ द्वादश सिद्धयोगिन्यो २३८ अभिधानेन २३९ ताः २४० शृणु ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 117 Kaulinī (AI¤) (She is) the inexplicable energy of the letters (mātrkā) (Kha)31 and is conjoined with the letters HSPHRE. Her form is Vāgbhava32 and she is endowed with the energy of Sound and the Point. (59) (She is the goddess) Kaulinī, the plane of knowledge of the Siddhas who are the Lords of Kula (kulanātha). The Five PraSavas are Śāmbhava; the sixth is excellent consciousness (caitanya).33 (60) The goddess PūrSā (the Full Moon), endowed with six limbs and faces, is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent). (Her Vidyā) should be recited in accord with the sequence of the six seed-syllables following the instructions of the teacher.34 (61) O Śambhu, also he who knows the liturgy of the Twelve Verses by means of the divine union (yoga) of the two groups of six — namely, the great (Vidyā) along with the parts (that is, seed-syllables, that denote) the realities of the verses (ślokārthapada) — becomes the bearer of the Kaulika Command in (just) one lifetime. (62-63ab) Whatever he touches with (his) hand, whatever he sees with the eye and whatever he recollects with feeling — everything is attained in a moment. (63cd-64ab) Evil and cruel beings of many kinds, demons, snakes and animals that move on the earth flee in all directions at his mere sight. (64cd-65ab) I have spoken the most excellent truth, the teaching concerning the meaning of the (Twelve) Verses. Those who deposit it know the three times and attain the supreme state. (65cd-66ab) The Twelve Yoginīs of the Twelve Verses and the Deposition on the Twelve Limbs The venerable (goddess) said: Now I will tell (you) another sequence. There are twelve Siddhayoginīs present within the Twelve Verses. Listen to (who) they are by name. (66cd-67ab)

sanskrit: 118 कुमारिकाखण्ड: नन्दा भद्रा जया काली कराली विकृतानना ।। ६७ ॥ क्रोष्टुकी भीमभद्रा च वायुवेगा हयानना । २४२ गम्भीरा घोषणी चैव योगिन्यो द्वादश स्मृताः ।। ६८ ।। कृत्वादौ वाग्भवास्त्रीणि अन्ते तेऽपि विलोमतः । संपुटेन युता देव्यो द्वादशाङ्गप्रसिद्धये ५ ।। ६९ ।। २४६ २४७ २४५ नन्दा शिरसि विन्यस्या भद्राख्या च ललाटके । जया च दक्षिणे नेत्रे काली चैव तु वामके ।। ७० ।। कराली दक्षिणे कर्णे वामे च विकृतानना । क्रोष्टुकी ४८ नासिकाग्रे तु भीमरुद्रा तथा मुखे ॥ ७१ ॥ वायुवेगा गले चैव हृदयस्था हयानना २५१ २४९ । गम्भीरा नाभिमध्ये २५० तु घोषिन्या गुह्यमध्यतः ।। ७२ ।। एवं २५२ न्यासं तु देवीनां दिव्यदेहकरं परम् । एतदावरणं न्यासं द्वादशाङ्गमुदाहृतम् ।। ७३ ॥ समयस्य तु सिंहस्य योगिन्यो द्वादश स्मृताः । २५३ २५७ २५४ व्रजेन्नरः ॥ ७४ ॥ पुष्कलम् । २५८ एतन्यास पुरा कृत्वा यत्र यत्र तत्र तत्र महालाभं ज्ञानं लभति मेलकं योगिनीसार्धं गुप्तानां द्वादशाङ्गप्रभावेन ज्ञानं ताः . २६१ कथयन्ति हि । च महेश्वर ।। ७५ ॥ ददन्ति चरुकं दिव्यं प्रसन्नास्त्वरितां गतिम् २६३ दिव्यरूपधरो योगी यदि गुप्तो २६५ २६२ महेश्वर । ।। ७६ ।। पुनरन्यक्रम वक्ष्ये न्यासं क्षेत्रपरिग्रहम् ६६ ।। ७७ ।। २६९ अमृतादि६७ च जीवान्तं दृक्षसंज्ञासमायुतम् । •२७० तावन्यासं प्रकर्तव्यं शब्दराशिक्रमेण तु ।। ७८ ।। २७२ उपदेश प्रवक्ष्यामि परं देव्याः परिग्रहम् । दीपनं च प्रकर्तव्यं वर्णे३ वर्णे पृथक् पृथक् ॥ ७९ ॥ हक्ष संज्ञाद्वयं स्थानं प्राण २४ क्रोध च खे बलम् । •२७४ २७६
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 119 1) Nandā, 2) Bhadrā, 3) Jayā (Victory), 4) Kālī, 5) Karālī (Big Teeth), 6) Vikrtānanā (Deformed Face), 7) Kron˜ukī (She-wolf), 8) Bhīmabhadrā (Terribly Auspicious), 9) Vāyuvegā (Force of the Wind), 10) Hayānanā (Horse Face), 11) Gambhīrā (Profound) and 12) GhonaSī (Howler) are said to be the twelve Yoginīs. (67cd-68) Having placed three Vāgbhavas at the beginning and also at the end in reverse order, the goddesses are encapsulated in order to form the twelve limbs.35 (69) One should deposit 1) Nandā on the head, 2) the one called Bhadrā on the forehead, 3) Jayā on the right eye, 4) Kālī on the left one, 5) Karālī on the right ear and 6) Vikrtānanā on the left one, 7) Kron˜ukī on the tip of the nose, 8) Bhīmarudrā on the mouth and 9) Vāyuvegā on the throat; 10) Hayānanā resides in the heart, 11) Gambhīrā is in the middle of the navel and 12) GhoniSyā is in the middle of the genitals. In this way the supreme deposition of the goddesses generates a divine body. This, the deposition of the encompassing host (āvaraSa), is called the Twelve Limbs. (Thus) the Yoginīs of the Lion of the Rule are said to be twelve.36 (70-74ab) Wherever a man goes, having first performed this deposition, he obtains extensive knowledge and great gain. O Maheśvara, (he achieves) union with the secret Yoginīs and, by the power of the twelve limbs (of the Vidyā), they impart knowledge to him. Pleased, they give (him) the divine sacrificial pap and quick progress. O Maheśvara, the yogi bears a divine form if (he keeps himself) concealed. (74cd-77ab) The Deposition of the Enclosure of the Field Once more, I will explain another sequence, that of the deposition of the Enclosure of the Field (knetraparigraha). Beginning with Nectar (A) and ending with the Individual Soul (Sa) conjoined with the letters Ha and K±a, one should perform this deposition in accord with the sequence of the Assembly of Sounds (śabdarāśi). I will impart the supreme teaching (concerning) the enclosure (parigraha) of the goddess.37 (77cd-79ab) One should energize (dīpaSa) each letter separately. Ha and K±a are the two terms,38 the place is the vital breath (Ha) and Anger (K±a) is the power within the Void (khe balam). (70cd-80ab)

sanskrit: 120 २७७ कुमारिकाखण्ड: २७८ ताभ्यां न दीपनं देयं स्वभावेनैव दीपिताः ।। ८० ।। वर्णदीप्तात्मक ९ पिण्डं आदिकादिक्रमेण तु । आदिकादिक्रम° क्षेत्रं परादेवीपरिग्रहम् ॥ ८१ ॥ दीपमानन्दयोगं १८२ च शक्तेर्ज्ञेय परिग्रहम् । २८४ आदौ वै स्वरचक्रं तु तत्त्वषोडशनिर्णयम् ।। ८२ ।। ये च उक्ता ककाराद्या जीवं ते सर्वदेहिनाम् ८६ । २८७ .२८५ २८८ । विसर्गेण तु निष्पत्ति: “७ एतत् क्षेत्रपरिग्रहम् ॥ ८३ ॥ क्रोधः प्राणकला चोक्ता रुद्रशक्त्या च वेष्टिता २८९ । ताभ्यां संयोगकरणं” गुरुवक्त्रात् समभ्यसेत् ।। ८४ ॥ २९१ सृष्टिन्यायेन मूर्धदिन्यास २ क्षेत्रपरिग्रहम् । २९४ २९५ क्षेत्रपरिग्रहे ९३ हीने मत्यैः साध्यं न सिद्ध्यति ।। ८५ ।। तु तेषां व साधनार्थाीय आख्यात -२९६ च परिग्रहम् । अनेनाभ्यसिते देव आज्ञायामभिषेचनम् ।। ८६ ।। अभ्यासाद् हि मासैकेन २९७ प्रत्ययं २९८ संप्रवर्तते । ३०० न शृणोति न पश्येत” तदा क्षेत्रपरिग्रहम् ।। ८७ ।। • ३०२ ३०४ अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि अधिकार पुनस्त्रयं । येन विज्ञातमात्रेण०३ अधिकार: प्रवर्तते ।। ८८ ।। २४ उलीना५ त्रितयं देव ज्येष्ठं मध्यं कनीयसम् ँ । ३०८ बालक्रमं तु कौमारं वृद्धमेव क्रमत्रयम् ॥ ८९ ॥ •३०९ तेषा” कूटत्रयं शम्भो परादेहाद् विनिर्गतम् ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 121 One should inflame (the letters) with these two who are in this way energized by their own nature. An Aggregate (piSÆa) is (a seed-syllable) energized by a letter in accord with the sequence beginning with A (i.e. the vowels) and that which begins with Ka (i.e. the consonants). (80cd-81ab) The field is in the sequence beginning with A and Ka. It is the form of the goddess. The flame (dīpa) is the Yoga of Bliss and should be known to be the form (parigraha) of energy (śakti). (81cd-82ab) At the beginning comes the Wheel of the Vowels, which is the teaching of the sixteen principles (tattva). (The letters of the series) beginning with the letter Ka (i.e. the consonants) are said to be the living soul (jīva) of all embodied beings. Generation (ninpatti) takes place by means of Emission (visarga).39 This is the Enclosure of the Field. (82cd-83) Anger (K±a) is said to be the energy of the vital breath (Ha) that is enveloped with the energy of Rudra (AI¤).40 By means of these two, practice the instrument of conjunction (according to the method learnt) from the teacher's mouth. (84) The Form of the Field is a deposition that begins from the head (and is performed) according to the order of emanation. Without the Form of the Field, mortals do not achieve (their) goal. (Therefore,) the Form has been explained so that they may have a means (to do so). (85-86ab) O god, one who has practiced by this (means achieves) consecration (abhinecana) in the Command. The sign of accomplishment (pratyaya) comes about after practicing for one month. The Form of the Field (is realised) when (the yogi) neither sees nor hears.41 (86cd-87) The Deposition of the Triple Authority Again, after this, I will tell (you) of the triple authority merely by knowing which (one has) authority. The triad of lineages (uli) (consists of) the Eldest, the Middle One and the Youngest. (88-89ab) The Transmission (krama) of the Child, the Youth and the Aged is the triple Transmission. O Śambhu, the triad of their three Peak (seed-syllables) has emerged from the body (of the) supreme (goddess) (Parā). (89cd-90ab)

sanskrit: 122 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३११ प्राणात्माद्यन्तनिकर” आदिस्थं च नितम्बकम् ।। ९० ।। वामस्तनं तथा कण्ठं दण्डं च स्कन्धदक्षिणम् । पुनः प्राणं पुनर्दण्ड क्षीरमेकत्र पिण्डितम् ।। ९१ ।। एवमेकादशा रुद्रा एकत्र विनियोजिताः । रुद्रकूटं समाख्यातं खं चन्द्रार्धविभेदितम् ।। ९२ ॥ दीपितं छिन्नमुण्डेन एतद् वृद्धक्रमोद्धृतम् । ३१५ ३१६ ३१८ तदेव” क्षीरनिर्मुक्तं नासिकया”“ विभेदितम् ।। ९३ ॥ कौमारक्रमकूटेदमाख्यातं” ” तव सुन्दर । तच्चैव° चैव नासया रिक्तं वामकुण्डलभेदितम् ।। ९४ ।। •३२१ तृतीयं च कनिष्ठं च बालक्रममुदाहृतम् । ३२३ ओलित्रितयविन्यास” कुर्यात् कूटत्रयं गुरु: ॥ ९५ ॥ ज्येष्ठं च विन्यसेच्चक्रे भ्रूमध्ये कोपमण्डले ३२४ ३२६ । मध्यमं ३२५ नाभिदेशे तु कनिष्ठं कामरूपतः ॥ ९६ ॥ त्रिभिरौलिक्रमे २७ जाता ये शिष्याः १२८ सिद्धसन्ततौ ३२९ । तेषां तु त्रिविधं न्यासं आख्यातं सततं हितम् ।। ९७ ।। क्रमेणानेन देवेश इत्याज्ञा पारमेश्वरी । ३३० •३३१ तत्क्षणात् तत्र तच्छा क्रमं तत्र परांमुखम् ॥ ९८ ॥ ३३२ स्वतुल्यां गुरुडद्यं (?) ``तु निर्बीजं पूजयन्ति ये । ३३४ संसारे वर्तते भूयः संसारान्न निवर्तते ।। ९९ ॥ ३३६ न तेषां दीपनं किञ्चित् शाम्भवकूटदीपिताः । तस्मात् कूटस्थविन्यास” त्रिधा मन्त्रक्रमोद्धृतम् ॥ १०० ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 123 The Self (Sa), the vital breath (Ha) (and) the aggregate of the beginning and end (of the consonants) (K±a) (are extracted) (then), in the beginning (of the following series is) the hip (Ma), the left breast (La), the throat (Va), the stick (Ra), the right shoulder (Bha), again the vital breath (Ha) and again the stick (Ra) along with the milk (Ā), (all) put together in one place. In this way the eleven Rudras are (all) applied in one place.42 (90cd-92ab) It is called Rudra's Peak (seed-syllable). The Sky (Kha) conjoined with the Half Moon and energized by the Severed Head (chinnamuSda)43 is extracted from the Transmission of the Aged. (92cd-93ab) The same (seed-syllable) devoid of milk (Ā) and conjoined with the nose (¦a) is, O fair one, the Peak (seed-syllable) of the Transmission of the Youth. (And so) this (too) has been told to you. (93cd-94ab) The same (seed-syllable) without the nose (¦a) and conjoined with the left earring (Ū) is the third (syllable) which is that of the Youngest, said to be the Transmission of the Child. The teacher should perform the deposition of the triple Lineage and form the three Peak (seed-syllables). (94cd-95) The Aged should be deposited in the wheel between the eyebrows which is the Circle of Wrath (kopamaSÆala). The Middle One (should be deposited) in the location of the navel and the Youngest in Kāmarūpa (i.e. the genitals). (96) The threefold deposition, which is always beneficial, has been explained in this sequence, O Lord of the gods. This is the Command of the goddess. (It belongs to) those disciples who have arisen in the Transmission of the Lineages (olikrama) in the Line of Siddhas by means of these three (seed-syllables). (97-98ab) Those who worship (a lineage that is) without seed-syllables are cursed there that very instant and the Transmission there is averse (to them) * * * * * (?) (He who commits this transgression) returns again into the world of transmigratory existence and is not freed from it. (98cd-99) There is no (ulterior process required) to energize those (seed-syllables already) energized by the Śāmbhava Peak (syllables). Therefore, the threefold deposition based on (these) Peak (syllables) is extracted from the sequence of mantras. (100)

sanskrit: 124 कुमारिकाखण्ड: विपर्यायक्रमेणैव ते च सिद्धास्त्रिभिः पुनः ३३९ ३४१ । ।। १०१ ।। ओकारश्च षकारश्च मिकारश्च त्रि–उलिका: नायकास्तत्र विन्यस्य ३४२ तेषां १४३ पिण्ड ३४४ स्वरूपतः । उपदेशेन विन्यासं करोत्यावेशमुत्तमम् ।। १०२ ॥ कनिष्ठं मध्यमं ज्येष्ठं मध्यमं योनिमध्यतः । ३४७ ३४६ अपरं यत् कनिष्ठं च योनिमध्ये तृतीयकम् ॥ १०३ ॥ एवं क्रमेण विन्यासं न कुर्यादपि चान्यथा । अधिकारत्रय४९ शम्भो ज्ञात्वा यजनमारभेत् ।। १०४ ॥ ३५१ ३५२ रत्नपञ्चकविन्यासं वक्ष्याम्याहमतः परम् । सिद्धसंकेतसिद्धानां प्रोक्तं सर्वत्र पञ्चकम् ।। १०५ ।। तृतीयं दशनं देव्यास्तस्यात्मानं ३ हृदि पुनः । नितम्बं च शिखा तस्या दक्षस्तनविभेदितम् ॥। १०६ ।। वामकुण्डलसंपूर्ण खशक्तिशिवभेदितम् । ३५६ रत्नपञ्चकमाख्यातं प्रोक्तं सर्वजनप्रियम् ।। १०७ ।। ३५८ ओषमैत्रचसिद्धानां सिद्धं ह्यमरिकाक्रमम् । •३५९ लाभ्यं तेन च गूढार्थं प्रकटं कुलकौलिकम् ।। १०८ ।। कर्मक्षयान्महादेव विद्येय ११ पञ्चधा भवेत् । ३६१ सेव्या सन्ताने ६३ सतत ४ ततः कर्मरिहो भवेत् ३६७ ३६८a ततः कर्मारिहो भवेत् ॥१०९ ॥ रत्नाद्य यत् परं पिण्डं तच्च आधारमण्डले ' चतुर्थं कण्ठदेशे तु पञ्चमं तुर्यमण्डले ।। ११० ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 125 Furthermore, there are the three Siddhas in reverse order. (The Siddhas) of the three lineages (are denoted by) the letters O (for OÆÆīśa), ±A (for ±anthīśa) and MI (for Mitreśa). They are the leaders there (of the three lineages) and their (mantric syllabic) form (piSÆa) is to be deposited according to (their) essential nature. (101-102ab) The deposition (performed) according to the teaching brings about the most excellent form of possession (āveśa). (The lineages are those of) the Youngest, the Middle One and the Oldest. The Middle One is in the centre of the Yoni. The other one, the Youngest, which is the third, (is also) in the middle of the Yoni. One should perform the deposition in this order and not in any other way. O Śambhu, once know the triple authority, one should commence the sacrifice. (102cd-104) The Deposition of the Five Jewels After this, I will explain the deposition of the Five Jewels.44 (This) Pentad is everywhere said to belong to the Siddhas of the Convention of Siddhas (siddhasaˆketa). (105) (Extract) the third tooth of the goddess (Ga) and (the following letter) again is her Self (Sa) in the heart (Pa). Her buttock (Ma) and topknot (Na), conjoined with the right breast (Cha), filled with the left earring (Ū) and conjoined with the Void of Śakti and Śiva (¤).45 (106-107ab) The Five Jewels, said to be loved by all, have been explained. The transmission of Amarikā (the Immortal One) — which belongs to the Siddhas (called) O (for OÆÆiśanātha), ±A (for ±an˜inātha), Maitra and CA (for Caryānātha) — has been accomplished. (107cd-108ab) The profound meaning made manifest (praka˜a) of the Kulakaula (teaching) can be acquired by means of this. O Maheśvara, (this) fivefold Vidyā operates by the destruction of Karma. (This Vidyā) should always be practiced (sevyā) within the Tradition (santāna); (thereby one becomes) a destroyer of enemies. (108cd-109ab) The first Jewel, which is the supreme seed-syllable (piSÆa), is located in the Circle of the Foundation (ādhāramaSÆala). The fourth is located in the throat and the fifth is in the Circle of the Fourth State (turyamaSÆala).46 (109cd-110)

sanskrit: 126 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३६८b एकवीरान् न्यसेत् पञ्च न तेषां दीपनं क्वचित्९ । ऐंकारान्तरयोगेन भगमध्ये लयंगताः ।। १११ ॥ ३७१ क्षेत्रस्था विन्यसेत् पञ्च स्वभावेन च दीपिता: । ३७२ चिरायुन्यासमात्रेण अच्छिद्रो भवते नरः ।। ११२ ।। दिव्यपीठपुरक्षोभं वीरसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् । प्राप्नोति विविधान् भोगान् वीरैः पञ्चाशद्भिः सह ।। ११३ ।। यद्यावर्तयते देव स्मरणात् पठनादपि । ३७५ सर्वसिद्ध्यालयं तस्य योगिनस्तु प्रवर्तते ।। ११४ ।। ३७७ दिव्यदृष्टिः पुरक्षोभं सिद्धिः पञ्चाश्रितेन तु । दशलक्षकृते जाप्ये”” तीव्राज्ञा संप्रवर्तते ।। ११५ ।। पञ्चरत्नेन संसिद्धि:° निर्वाणं प्राप्यते पदम् । ३८२ मतार्थं पूर्वतो ज्ञात्वा मन्त्रपदं स्फुटम् ।। ११६ ।। एतद् वै३ कौलिकं सूत्रं षोढान्यासेन वेष्टितम् ८५ । षोडशान्वयमन्त्रौघ क्रमं षोडशरूपिणम् ।। ११७ ।। एतद् विमलविज्ञान कुलमार्गविनिर्गतम् । ३८७ ३८९ ३९० कुलं च षोडशैर्भेदैः सन्तानं ९ षोडशैः पुनः ।। ११८ ॥ षोडशाज्ञाप्रसूतिस्तु न्यासमञ्जूषकोद्धृतम् । गोपनीयं प्रयत्नेन तान्त्रिकानां न दर्शयेत् ॥ ११९ ॥ एवं प्रभावमाख्यातं”” षोढान्यासस्य सुन्दर ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 127 Deposit the five solitary ones (ekavīra) (directly just as they are). They (do not need to be) energized in any circumstance. One should deposit the five (Jewels) that, energized by their very nature, are located in the field and, by internal conjunction with the syllable AI¤, have dissolved away in the middle of the Yoni.47 (111-112ab) By its mere deposition, a man becomes free from (any) physical defects (acchidra) and has a long life. He obtains the Accomplishment of a Hero (vīrasiddhi), namely, the arousal (knobha) of (the energies in) the body (pura), which is the divine seat (of the deity) (divyapī˜ha). (112cd-113ab) He gets diverse pleasures (bhoga) with the (the power of the) fifty heroes (who govern the letters). O god, if that yogi causes (the Vidyā) to rotate (through its phonemes) by recalling it or even by reading it, he comes to possess the repository of all accomplishments. One who is established in the Five (Jewels) (obtains) yogic power (siddhi), divine sight and the Arousal of the City. (113cd-115ab) The intense (form of the) Command functions once one has repeated (this Vidyā) one million times. Accomplishment is attained by means of the Five Jewels (as is) the plane of NirvāSa. (115cd-116ab) Once one has, first of all, understood the meaning of the scripture (matārtha), (each) part (pada) of (every) mantra (mantrapada) (becomes) clear. This indeed is the Kaulika Sūtra, enveloped by the sixfold deposition (noÆhānyāsa). (116cd-117ab) (It is) the Current of mantra (mantraugha) of the sixteenfold teaching (anvaya), that is, the sixteenfold transmission (krama).48 This is the pure (vimala) knowledge that has emerged from the Kula path. (117cd-118ab) Drawn from the casket (mañjūnaka) of depositions, it is the Kula with sixteen divisions, the Tradition (santāna) with sixteen (parts) and the progeny of the sixteenfold Command. (118cd-119ab) It should be kept hidden with effort and should not be shown to Tāntrikas. O fair one, the power of the sixfold deposition has thus been explained. (119cd-120ab)

sanskrit: 128 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३९४ गुरूपदेशतो ज्ञेयं संहितार्थसमुच्चयम् ।। १२० ।। विस्तरं पूर्वमाख्यातं लक्षपादाधिके ९५ मते । •३९७ ३९८ अत्र संक्षेपतः ९६ प्राप्तं चतुर्विंशत्सहस्रके ।। १२१ ।। षोढान्यासस्य सूत्रं तु आख्यातं तव सुन्दर । ३९९ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये ९ सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते” षोढान्यासमञ्जूषाक्रमवर्णने ४०२ क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। २४ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FOUR 129 The aggregate of the meaning of the scripture (saˆhitā) should be known from the instructions of the teacher. (Its) extent has been previously explained in the scripture (mata) of 125,000 (verses). It has been received in a concise form here, in (the scripture) of twenty-four thousand (verses) (caturviˆśatsahasra). O fair one, I have told you the Sūtra of the Sixfold Deposition (noÆhanyāsa). (120cd-122ab) This is the (twenty-fourth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the Transmission of the Casket of the Sixfold Deposition. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with ‘KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's Command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: श्रीनाथ उवाच' पञ्चविंशानन्दः •४ कुलं च षोडशैर्भेदैर्मया ज्ञातं महेश्वरि । 6 विपर्यायेण' अपरं स्वाभाविककुल कथम् ॥ १ ॥ षट्चक्रं षोडशाधारं त्रिलक्षं व्योमपञ्चकम् । ° संस्फुट च न मे ज्ञात कुलमार्गक्रमेण तु ।। २ ।। इदानीं कथ्यताम् देवि कुलभेदं यथा भवेत् । श्रीवक्रा उवाच एतत् प्रश्न महाश्रेष्ठं देवदेवावतारितम् ॥ ३ ॥ विचारं तस्य वक्ष्यामि कुलपञ्चाशिकाक्रमम् । कुलमूलक्रम शम्भो शृणु वक्ष्यामि भैरव ।। ४ । -१६ अधोमुखं तु प्रथम कन्दनालसमुद्भवम् । १७ गुप्तं त कन्दचक्रं तु अधोमुखव्यवस्थितम् ॥ ५ ॥ चतुर्दलसमायुक्त' पद्मरागसमप्रभम् । चत्वारस्तस्य भेदाश्च आधारे चक्रनायकाः ।। ६ ।। पिण्डं तस्य प्रसादं तु” हिमकुन्देन्दुनिर्मलम्” । तस्य ऊर्धवे” द्वितीयं च योगराजमधोमुखम् ।। ७ ।। वह्निकपिलसंकाश‍ ज्वालाज्वलितविग्रहम्” । २५ तस्य भेदा: ५ षडिर्ज्ञेयाः ६ चक्रेश स्वाधिष्ठानकम् ॥ ८ ॥ ३१ तस्य पिण्ड” महारावं आरक्त शुद्धवासनम् ।
