english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE The Fifty (Verses) concerning Kula. Preamble Śrīnātha said: O Great Goddess, I have understood the Kula with sixteen divisions. (What is) the other innate (svābhāvika) (nature), which is (realised) by a process of reversal (viparyāyena)? (1) I have not clearly understood the Six Wheels, the Sixteen Supports, the Three Signs and the Five Voids according to the Kula path. O goddess, tell (me also about) the Kula division (kulabheda).1 (2-3ab) The Six Wheels2 The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: This question, brought down (to earth by you), the God of the gods, is the best one. I will (now) tell (you) the teaching (vicāra) (concerning this, namely), the transmission of the Fifty (Verses) concerning Kula (kulapañcāśikākrama). O Śambhu, listen as I explain, O Bhairava, the Sequence of the Root of Kula (kulamūlakrama). (3cd-4) The Wheel of the Foundation The first one faces downwards3 and arises from the tube in the Root (kanda) (genital centre). That is the hidden Wheel of the Root that faces downwards. It has four petals and is as brilliant as a ruby. Four are its divisions. The (residents thereon) are the masters of the Wheel in the Foundation (ādhāra). Its seed-syllable (piSÆa) is Grace (prasāda) (HSRŪAU¤), pure (white like) snow, the moon and jasmine. (5-7ab) The Wheel of the Self-supported Above it is the second one, the King of Yoga that faces downwards. It is tawny red like fire and its form burns with flames. Its divisions should be known to be six. It is the Self-supported (svādhin˜hāna), the Lord of the Wheel. Light red in colour, its seed-syllable (piSÆa) is the Great Sound (mahārāva) (KHPHRE¤) and its abode is pure. (8-9ab)

sanskrit: 132 कुमारिकाखण्डः तस्य ऊर्ध्व” तृतीयं तु चक्रं नाभिहुताशनम् ॥ ९ ॥ महारत्नं महादीप्तं तस्य भेदानि वै दश । स्वरषष्ठसमाक्रान्तं बिन्दुसंस्थशशाङ्कधृक् ।। १० ॥ दाडिमीकुसुमप्रख्यं ज्वलन्तं भैरवानलम् । •३८ ३६ तं“ पिण्डं मणिपूरस्य सिद्धस्य इति निश्चयम् ॥ ११ ॥ चक्रनायकविख्यात सुरसिद्धनमस्कृतम् । ४२ चतुर्थं तस्य ऊवे” तु हृदि चक्रमधोमुखम् ॥ १२ ॥ ४३ ४५ वर्णं तद्द्वैरिकाभासं तस्य भेदानि द्वादश । चक्रनायकविख्यातं, तत्रानाहतभैरवम् ।। १३ ॥ खेचरीहृदयं तस्य पिण्ड” द्वादशवर्णकम् । ध्यानं” तस्य भवेद् रक्तमीषद्श्यामविमिश्रितम् ॥ १४ ॥ अतोध्व संप्रवक्ष्यामि अपरं चक्रनिर्णयम् । हिमकुन्देन्दुधवल तस्य भेदानि षोडश ।। १५ ।। ५४ विशुद्धं भैरवं तत्र कथितं चक्रनायकम् । तस्य पिण्ड भवेद् वाह त्रिपदेन विभेदितम् ॥ १६ ॥ ७ हरितं तस्य वर्ण तु नीलजीमुतसन्निभम् । ५९ तस्योध्व परमं चक्रं तुर्यस्थानगतं पृथु ॥ १७ ॥ गोक्षीरसदृशानन्दं° तेजोरूपं भगाकृतिः” । तस्य भेदद्वयं प्रोक्तं आज्ञाचक्रेश्वरं प्रभो ॥ १८ ॥ वाग्भवं तस्य तत् पिण्डं सिन्दूरारुणसन्निभम् । ६३ षट्त्यागात् सप्तमं ऊध्व आकाशे शून्यमण्डले ॥ १९ ॥ तुर्यातीत तु तत् प्रोक्तं तस्मात् षट्क विनिर्गतम् ँ । सृष्टिक्रमेण ऊध्वाद्धि चक्रौघं तत् विभाव्यते ।। २० ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE 133 The Wheel of the City of Gems Above it is the third Wheel, the fire in the navel.4 (It is) the Great Jewel; greatly inflamed, its divisions are ten. Pervaded by the sixth vowel (Ū), it bears the Moon established in the Point. (Red) like a pomegranate flower, it is the burning fire of Bhairava. That is the seed-syllable of the accomplished City of Jewels (maSipūra) (RŪ¤). This is the teaching. This is said to be the Lord of the Wheel, honoured by the gods and Siddhas. (9cd-12ab) The Wheel of Unstruck Sound The fourth (Wheel) is above it. It is the Wheel in the heart that faces downwards. Its colour is like that of red chalk and its divisions are twelve. The Lord of the Wheel there is said to be the Bhairava of (the Wheel of) Unstruck Sound (Anāhatabhairava). The Heart of the Skyfarer (khecarīhrdaya), consisting of twelve letters, is its seed-syllable (piSÆa) (HSKHPRE¤). Its visualized form (dhyāna) is red mixed with a little blue. (12cd-14) The Pure Wheel I will tell (you) another teaching concerning the Wheel above this. White as snow, the moon and jasmine, its divisions are sixteen. The Bhairava there, said to be the Lord of the Wheel, is the Pure One (viśuddha). Its seed-syllable is VĀHA¤, divided into three parts. (15-16) The Wheel of the Command The colour (of the Wheel of the Command) is green and it is like a dark blue cloud. Above it is the supreme Wheel that, extensive, is located in the abode of the Fourth State. It is (white) like cow's milk and is bliss (itself). It is brilliant energy (tejas) and its form that of the Yoni. It is said to have two divisions and is the Lord who is the master of the Wheel of the Command (ājñācakra). Its seed- syllable is Vāgbhava, red as vermillion. (17-19ab) The Circle of the Void Abandoning the six (Wheels below), it is the seventh (Wheel, located) in the Sky — that is, within the Circle of the Void (śūnyamaSÆala). That is said to be (the state) Beyond the Fourth5 from which the group of six (Wheels) have emerged. That current of the Wheels is contemplated from above in accord with the process (krama) of emanation.6 (19-20)

sanskrit: 134 कुमारिकाखण्डः द्विरा तुर्यचक्रं तु कण्ठे” वै षोडशारकम् । ७४ हृदयं द्वादशारं तु नाभिर्वै दशभिः” स्मृतः ।। २१ ।। •७६ षडारं योनिचक्रं तु चतुरा गुदं स्मृतम् । पुनः सिद्धक्रमं तेषां विशुद्धादिक्रमेण तु ।। २२ । विशुद्धं षोडशैर्भेदैः द्वादशैस्तु¨ अनाहतम् । दशभिश्च मणिर्भिन्नः” स्वाधिष्ठानं षडात्मकम् ।। २३ ।। आधारे भेदाश्चत्वार” आज्ञा भेदद्वयं विदुः । ८३ अकारादिविसगीन्ता भेदानि षोडश : स्मृताः ।। २४ ।। ककारादिठकारान्ता द्वादशानि“ अनाहते । डकारादिफकारान्ता भेदानां दशकं मणौ ।। २५ ।। बकारादिलकारान्तं— ँ भेदषट्कं क्रमेण तु । स्वाधिष्ठाने महादेव आधारे तु यथा शृणु ।। २६ ।। वकारादिसकारान्ता भेदाश्चत्वाराधारगाः । षष्ठं चक्रं भ्रुवोर्मध्ये हक्षद्वयविनिर्मितम् ।। २७ ।। ९३ हक्षद्वयविनिर्मुक्ताः” श्लोकानि ” द्वादशः स्मृताः । षट्त्यागात् सप्तमे मुक्तिस्तत्रानन्दं व्यवस्थितम् ।। २८ ।। अपरं षोडशाधारा लक्षत्रितयमेव च । अमृतादिविसर्गीन्ताः कलाधाराणि षोडश ।। २९ ॥ तेषां च योगिनीसिद्धाः स्वशरीरे व्यवस्थिताः । १०२ अनन्त चैव आकाशं इन्दुः २ ईश्वरसंज्ञकम् ।। ३० ।। उदयं ऊर्जनाथं च ऋक्षकर्णं च ऋषभम् लिप्ताङ्गं लुलिहश्चैव एकपादं महेश्वर' १०६ १०३ १०५ । ।। ३१ ।। तथा वै रावणो नाम ओवली नाम औमुनिः । १०७ अम्बुनाथं अह्ववाह ँ आधाराः षोडश : स्मृताः ।। ३२ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE 135 The Wheel of the Fourth State7 has two rays while (the Wheel) in the throat has sixteen. The (Wheel of the) heart has twelve rays while the navel is said (to be divided) into ten. The Wheel of the Yoni (yonicakra)8 has six rays while the rectum is said to have four. (21-22ab) Again, the Sequence of the Siddhas9 of these (Wheels) begins with the Pure (Wheel) (and continues) in due order. The Pure (viśuddha) (Wheel is formed) with sixteen divisions, (the Wheel of) Unstruck Sound with twelve. The (Wheel of the City of) Gems is divided into ten. (The Wheel of the) Self- supported is sixfold. There are four divisions in (the Wheel of the) Foundation and (the wise) know that (the Wheel of) the Command has two. (22cd-24ab) The sixteen divisions are said to be the letters from A to Emission (visarga). The letters from Ka to µha are the twelve in (the Wheel of) Unstruck Sound. The letters Õa to Pha are the ten divisions in (the Wheel of the) Jewel. (Next comes), O Great God, in due order, the sixfold division within (the Wheel of) the Self-supported consisting of the letters from Ba to La. (24cd-26abc) (Now) hear how things are in (the Wheel of the) Foundation. The divisions within (the Wheel of) the Foundation are four, namely, the letters beginning with Va and ending with Sa. The sixth Wheel is between the eyebrows and is made of the two, Ha and K±a. (26d-27) The Twelve Verses are said to be free of the two, Ha and K±a. By abandoning the (other) six, liberation is in the seventh (Wheel) and there Bliss is well established.10 (28) The Sixteen Supports The next (topics are) the Sixteen Supports and the Three Signs. The sixteen supports of the energies (kalā) are (the letters) from A to Emission (visarga). Their Yoginīsiddhas reside within one's own body. (29-30ab) O Great Lord, the Sixteen Supports are said to be Ananta (Endless) (A), Ākāśa (Space) (Ā), Indu (Moon) (I), the one called Īśvara (Lord) (Ī), Udaya (Arising) (U), Ūrjanātha (Lord of Strength) (Ū), ¬knakarSa (Bear Ears) (¬), ¬nabha (Bull) (­), Liptā‰ga (Oiled Body) (ŀ), ĿLiha (Ŀ), Ekapāda (One-footed) (E), RāvaSa (AI), Ovalī (Lineage) (O), Aumuni (the Sage Au) (AU), Ambunātha (Lord of Water) (¤) and Ahvavāha (the Bearer of of the Call) (Ö).11 (30cd-32)

sanskrit: 136 कुमारिकाखण्डः १०९ एते चैव महासिद्धा आद्यन्ते ऐँसमायुताः । एतैस्तु व्यापितं पिण्डं तेषा स्थानानि षोडश ।। ३३ ॥ प्रथम”” घण्टिकाया३ तु द्वितीयं तालुमण्डले । ११६ मज्जे मेदे तथा शुक्रे अन्यच्चैव तु कुण्डली ॥ ३४ ॥ स्नाय्वस्थित्वचरोमाणि” केसर च तथामृतम् । १२० मांसं च रुधिरं चैव वाडवानल मारुतम् ।। ३५ ।। आकाशं च तथा देव एवमाधारषोडशः । १२१ १२२ तेषां ओलित्रयं देव सत्त्वरजस्तमस्त्रयम् ।। ३६ ।। १२४ लक्षत्रय समासेन मनो बुद्धिरहंकृति: । १२७ तेषां वै त्रीणि१५ सिद्धाश्च कूटस्था ओषमित्र च ।। ३७ ।। एतेषां तु लय” देव पञ्चव्योमस्तु भैरव । १३१ आधारे हृदये चैव तथा कुले कपाटके ॥ ३८ ॥ पञ्चव्योमगतं लक्ष २ भित्त्वा चैव तु खेगति:' । १३२ १३४ सोममण्डलमध्यस्थं अपरं सूर्यमण्डलम् ॥ ३९ ॥ वायुमण्डलमध्यस्थं अपरं व्योममण्डलम् आकाशं पञ्चधा प्रोक्तं अधो मध्ये च मूर्धनि ।। ४० ।। एतेषां व्यापकाः पञ्च बिन्दुमार्गप्रभेदका : ' १३७ । शिवाद्यन्तसमायुक्तं तेषां वै सिद्धपञ्चकम् ॥ ४१ ॥ पृथिव्यापस्तथा तेजो वायुराकाशमेव च । एते पञ्च महाभूता निर्मिताः सृष्टिकारकाः ॥ ४२ ॥ ।। १४१ श्रीकण्ठः शङ्करोऽनन्तः सादाख्यः पिङ्गलस्तथा । १४४ पञ्चैते४२ सृष्टिकर्ताीर:४३ सिद्धाः पञ्चकुले तथा ।। ४३ ।। श्रीकण्ठः पृथिवी ज्ञेयः शङ्करो ४५ आप उच्यते । तेजोऽनन्त इति ४६ प्रोक्तः सादाख्यो वायुरुच्यते ॥ ४४ ॥ ४७ आकाशः पिङ्गलो ज्ञेयः पञ्चैते सृष्टिकारकाः ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE 137 These great Siddhas are conjoined with (the seed-syllable) AI¤ at the beginning and the end. The body (piSÆa) is filled with them and their locations are sixteen.12 (33) The first is in the uvula (at the back of the throat and) the second in the Circle of the Palate; (the others are) in 3) the fat, 4) marrow and 5) semen. Another (support) is 6) KuSÆalinī and the 7) sinews, 8) bones, 9) skin, 10) hair, and 11) saliva (amrta), 12) meat, 13) blood, 14) the Fire of the Aeons (vāÆavānala), 15) the vital breath (vāyu) and 16) the spaces (ākāśa) (in the body). Such, O god, are the Sixteen Supports.13 (34-36ab) The Three Signs O god, their three lineages (oli) are the three, sattva, rajas and tamas. The Three Signs are, in brief, the mind, intellect and ego.14 They correspond to the three Siddhas who are within (three) Peak (seed-syllable mantras), namely, O (OÆÆīśanātha), ±A (±an˜hanātha) and Mitra (Mitranātha). (36cd-37) The Five Voids O Bhairava, their merger (corresponds to) the Five Voids in 1) the Foundation, 2) the Heart, 3) the Kula and 4 and 5) (the Two) Door (Panels) (kapā˜aka).15 Once pierced through the Target within the Five Voids, (one achieves) flight (khegati).16 (38-39ab) In the middle of the Circle of the Moon is another one, namely, the Circle of the Sun. In the middle of the Circle of the Wind (there is also) another one, namely, the Circle of the Sky. Space (ākāśa) is said to be fivefold, below, in the middle and on the head.17 (39cd-40) The Five Siddhas The five that pierce the Path of the Point pervade them. These five Siddhas are conjoined with Śiva at the beginning and the end. Earth, Water, Fire, Air and Space, these are the five gross elements. They are created (as well as being) the agents of emanation. ŚrīkaS˜ha, Śa‰kara, Ananta, Sādākhya and Pi‰gala: these five are the five Siddhas who are the agents of emanation in the five Kulas. (41-43) Know that ŚrīkaS˜ha is Earth and Śa‰kara is said to be Water. Ananta is said to be Fire and Sādākhya is said to be Air, while Pi‰gala should be known to be Space. These five are the agents of emanation.18 (44-45ab)

sanskrit: 138 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ९४८ एतद् वै कुलमार्ग तु तवाख्यातं रहस्यकम् ।। ४५ ।। गुप्ता कुलवधू यद्वत् तद्वद् गोप्यतरं कुलम् । उद्धारं पूर्वतो ज्ञात्वा पश्चाद् यजनमारभेत् ।। ४६ । एतत् कुलक्रमाचार बिन्दुमण्डलभेदितम् । तत्र लक्षे २ मति कृत्वा रुद्रशक्तिः प्रवर्तते ।। ४७ ।। १५५ अधो मध्ये च ऊवे' ५४ वा आत्मतुल्याधिकारकम् कुर्याच्चैव स्वदेहस्य चित्तं दमयते ततः ।। ४८ ॥ बहिरन्तरभावेन तदा चोत्पद्यते सुखम् । ५७ तत्कुलाकुलमादाय शरीरं षट्कभेदितम् ।। ४९ ॥ नवसंज्ञ पुनर्भूयः कुलभेदार्णवं भवेत् । शङ्ख शक्तिस्तथा योग महागृह २ चतुर्थकम् ॥ ५० ॥ १६३ १६४ पञ्चमं च प्रभु प्रोक्तं पादं तु षष्ठमुच्यते । अतीतमावली १६६ चैव उत्तरौ परिकीर्तितौ८ ।। ५१ ।। नवमं कुलम् । १७१ । ।। ५२ ।। तस्योत्तमं महादेव आनन्द कुलं तु नवधा भिन्नं विख्यातं सर्वतोमुखम् १७३ •९७४ उड्डामरं सिद्धकौल गणाख्य खेचरीमतम् । १७६ चन्द्राख्य रौरवं देव वीराख्य भूतडामरम् ।। ५३ ।। •१७७ १७८ नवमं तु महाकौल प्रत्ययं स्वाधिकारकम् । तेनावतारिता चाज्ञा लक्षपादाधिके मते ॥ ५४ ॥ तस्मात् तत्° सिद्धकौल तु तदा कौलस्य प्रत्ययम्” । अवस्था उन्मनी भाव८३ एतत् कौलोपदेशकम् ।। ५५ ।। कुलकौलं समाख्यातं आद्यान्त८५ तमनाहत ६ । कुलमेकं विजानीयात् व्योमपञ्चकभेदितम् “ ॥ ५६ ॥ आसनं भेदनं तेषां कुलपञ्चाशिकाक्रमम् ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE 139 This, indeed, is the secret Path of Kula and I have told it to you. Just as a widow of good family is (kept) hidden, so Kula is to be kept most secret. (45cd-46ab) Once one has known the enunciation (of the seed-syllables), (only) then should one begin the sacrifice. This is the practice (ācāra) of the Kulakrama, associated with the Circle of the Drop. Rudra's energy (emerges) once the mind has been fixed on that target. (46cd-47) Below, in the middle and above, one should form a controlling authority (adhikāraka) who is equal to the Self of one's own body; the mind is thereby controlled. Then bliss arises inwardly and externally. (48-49ab) The Nine Kulas Having assumed the (division into) Kula and Akula, the body is (further) divided into six. Then, there should be the nine names and the ocean of the Kula division. (49cd-50ab) (The first three divisions are) Śa‰kha (Conch), Śakti (Energy) and Yoga (Union), with Mahāgrha (Great House) as the fourth, while the fifth is said to be Prabhu (Lord) and Pāda is said to be the sixth. Atīta (Beyond) and Āvalī are said to follow after. O Great God, better than that is Ānanda (Bliss), the ninth Kula.19 Kula, divided ninefold and facing everywhere, has been explained. (50cd-52) 1) UÆÆāmara, 2) Siddhakaula, the one called 3) GaSa, 4) Khecarīmata, 5) the one called Candra (Moon), 6) Raurava (Terrible), 7) the one called Vīra,20 8) BhūtaÆāmara and 9) Mahākaula as the ninth.21 This is the sign of attainment (pratyaya) and is the self-regulating authority that brought the Command down into the scripture (mata) that consists of a hundred and twenty-five thousand (verses). (53-54) Therefore that is the Siddhakaula. Thereafter (one experiences) the sign of accomplishment of a Kaula. The state is the Transmental (unmanī) and that condition imparts the Kaula (teachings). (55) It is called Kulakaula and is conjoined, in the beginning and end, with Unstruck Sound. Know that there is (only) one Kula22 conjoined with the Five Voids. Their seat (āsana) is their division, which is the tradition of the Fifty (Verses) Concerning Kula. (56-57ab)

sanskrit: 140 कुमारिकाखण्ड: इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रम- भाषिते कुलपञ्चाशिकाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। २५ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE 141 This is the (twenty-fifth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description the Fifty (Verses) concerning Kula. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with ‘KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: षड्विंशानन्दः श्रिनाथ उवाच किं कुलं किं क्रमाचार का पूजा क्रममण्डले । कथयस्व महेशानि प्रसादाद् वद मे प्रभो ॥ १ ॥ ४ श्रीवक्रा उवाच' क्रमाद्यं मूलसूत्र तु वृत्ताध्युष्टप्रमाणतः । तस्यारभ्य ँ क्रमात् सृष्टिः इत्याह' खेचरसमम् ॥ २ ॥ या सा शक्तिर्भगाख्या त्रिविधगतियुता त्र्यक्षरा त्रिप्रकारा तस्या श्री-ओड्डियाण परकलसहित मध्यसंस्थं सुदीप्तम्” । तच्छ्रीजालन्धराख्यं प्रकटितनिलय” दक्षिणे चैव कोणे वामे श्रीपूर्णपीठ” पशुजनभयकृत्” कामरूपं तदग्रे ॥ ३ ॥ तस्योध्वे तिस्रपीठ परमकलयुतं चन्द्रपीठं ललाटे त्रिकोणान्ते” समस्तं परमशिवकलाक्षोभितं दिव्यमोघम् । तन्मध्ये” वक्रलिङ्ग” परमसुखकरं बिन्दुरूपं त्रिभिन्न •३२ नित्यानन्दस्वरूपं” तदुपरिमथनात् षट्प्रकाराधिकारम् ॥ ४ ॥ पूर्वाम्नायक्रमौघं तदुपरि अपरं वृद्धकौमारबालम् एवं व्याप्तं समस्तं स्थितिलयजननी रुद्रशक्तिस्त्रिभेदैः” ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX The Root Sūtra and the Hymn to Māyā Preamble Śrīnātha said: What is Kula? What is the Practice of the Krama (kramācāra)? How is the rite of worship in the KramamaSÆala? Tell (me), O Great Goddess; by (your) grace, O Lord, explain. (1) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: The first Root Sūtra1 of the Tradition (krama) consists of three and a half verses. Starting from that, in due order (krama), comes emanation. Thus it is said to be equal to the Skyfarer. (2) The Root Sūtra That energy called the Yoni (bhaga), endowed with three dynamic modes (gati)2 consists of three letters3 and (triangular) has three aspects (triprakāra).4 Well energized in the middle is the venerable OÆÆiyāna, endowed with the Supreme Energy (parakalā). That venerable (sacred seat) called Jālandhara, whose abode5 has been made manifest, is in the right corner. In the left (corner) is PūrSa, the venerable sacred seat that inspires fear in the fettered (paśu).6 In the front of that (Yoni) is Kāmarūpa.7 (3) Above that is the sacred seat (called) Tisra8 (and that too) is endowed with the Supreme Energy.9 The sacred seat (called) Candra is on the forehead10 (above the Triangle).11 Within the Triangle is the entire Divine Current (divyaugha),12 aroused with13 Śiva's Supreme Energy.14 In the centre of that (Triangle) is the Crooked Li‰ga (vakrali‰ga)15 in the form of the Point that gives supreme bliss.16 It is divided into three17 and its nature is eternal bliss.18 By churning it from above, the sixfold authority (is established).19 (4) Above the current of the transmission (krama) of the previous tradition (pūrvāmnāya)20 is another one21 consisting of the Aged, the Youth and the Child. In this way, everything is pervaded22 by the three divisions23 of Rudra's energy,

sanskrit: 144 कुमारिकाखण्ड: चिञ्चाज्ञा कादिभेदैरकुलकुलमयानन्ददा बोधरूपा” गुर्वाज्ञा षट्प्रकारा” पशुभयहरणी ” चन्द्रबिम्बस्य मध्ये ॥ ५ ॥ नित्यक्लिन्ना सुरक्ताभयमुदितपरानन्दशक्तिः प्रसिद्धा कुर्वन्ती शाम्भवौघ क्षुभितवरतनुः श्रीकुजा दिव्यलिङ्गम् । मयावतारित”” तुभ्यमाद्यसूत्रमधोमुखम् या सा शक्तिः पराख्याता सा च देवी भगाकृतिः ।। ६ ।। तस्यान्ते सा परा देवी पीठानां पीठदेवता । या सा शक्तिर्भगाख्याता गतिस्तस्यास्त्रिधा पुनः ।। ७ ।। ५४ आदिकादिथकारादिब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । ५५ ज्येष्ठा वामा च रौद्री च द्वादशश्लोकभेदिताः ॥ ८ ॥ परा सा रुद्रशक्तिस्तु त्रिभिः स्थानैव्यवस्थिता । ललाटे हृदये योनौ क्षरते त्रिषु कारिषु ।। ९ ॥ शुक्रं च शोणितं कृच्छ्र नाडीत्रितयसन्धिषु । इडा च पिङ्गला चैव सुषुम्ना मध्यमा त्रयः ॥ १० ॥ एवमानन्दयोगेन त्रिशक्तिः स्वाधिकारिका । तस्यायात? क्रमं देव बालकौमारवृद्धकम् ॥। ११ ॥ पीठपञ्चकसंयुक्तं क्रममेक३ त्रयोलिषु४ । ·६६ आनन्दानन्दबिन्दुश्च अक्षर परमा कला ॥। १२ ॥ पीठान्येते क्रमात् पञ्च अन्तरङ्गे प्रतिष्ठिताः । ४८
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 145 who is the mother of preservation and destruction.24 She is Ciñcā's Command, which is consciousness (bodha) and, by means of the divisions of the (tradition) beginning with KĀ,25 she bestows the bliss that consists of Kula and Akula.26 (She is) the sixfold27 Command of the teacher28 who, in the middle of the lunar orb, removes the fear of the fettered.29 She is well known as Nityaklinnā (Ever Wet); beautifully passionate (suraktā), (she is) the energy of supreme bliss, delighted by fearlessness.30 Her excellent body is aroused31 and she fashions the Śāmbhava current.32 She is the venerable (goddess) Kujā, the Divine Li‰ga.33 (5) The Wisdom Sūtra: An Explanation of the Root Sūtra I have brought down (to earth) for you the First Sūtra, which faces downwards. That energy called 'Supreme' (Parā) is the goddess whose form is the Yoni (bhagākrti). (6) Within her, the same Supreme Goddess, are the deities of the sacred seats. The dynamic modality of that energy called the Yoni (bhaga) is then again threefold. (7) The (series of) letters beginning with ‘A', ‘Ka' and ‘Tha' (correspond, respectively) to Brahmā, VinSu and Maheśvara and (the three energies) Jyen˜hā, Vāmā and Raudrī conjoined with the Twelve Verses.34 (8) She is the supreme energy of Rudra established in three places. She oozes (nectar) into the three agents (kārin) (there), that is, into the Forehead, Heart and Yoni. (9) Semen, blood and hardship (krcchra) (flow) in the junctures of the three psychic nerves (called) IÆā, Pi‰galā and SunumSā, the middle one. (10) In this way, by the Yoga of Bliss, the triple energy exercises her own authority. O god, the sequence of the Child, Youth and Aged depend on her. (Ultimately), there is (only) one Krama, associated with the five seats, in the three lineages. (11-12ab) Bliss (ānanda) (O), the Drop of Bliss (JĀ), the Letter (aknara) (PŪ), the Supreme (paramā) (KĀ) and Energy (kalā) (TI): these, in due order, are the five internal sacred seats. (12cd-13ab)

sanskrit: 146 कुमारिकाखण्ड: बहिरङ्गे च ते कूटा ओजापूका च तिस्रकम् ॥ १३ ॥ समस्तं च कुल कौलं शिवशक्तिकलावृतम् । आनन्दावृतवृन्दस्तु” आनन्दे तु प्रवर्तते ॥ १४ ॥ उद्भवानन्दचित्तस्य समत्वं च प्रवर्तते । ७३ तन्मध्ये सूक्ष्मलिङ्ग ं तु दिव्यलिङ्गमधोमुखम् ।। १५ ॥ परमाकाशमध्यस्थ चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यतः । ७७ तदा तत् ँ सुषिर ँ” याति” लक्षितेनान्तरात्मना ।। १६ ।। ८२ पश्यते तु समाधिस्थो” बिन्दुरूपं नभस्तलम् । चिदानन्दसमुत्पत्तिः” आवेशः संप्रवर्तते ।। १७ ॥ तद्रूपं च स्वरूपं च इत्याश्रावणप्रत्ययम्¨ । मथिते चित्तचैतन्ये“ मथितं कर्मसंश्रयम् ॥ १८ ॥ मथनादपि चक्रस्य योगावेश मुहुर्मुहुः । आरक्त तत्कुले चक्रं तत्रस्थं बिन्दुमण्डलम् ।। १९ ।। भेदितं द्रावित ं यस्मात् मथितं स्मरणेन तु । षट्प्रकारैर्विभिन्न” तु भेदैश्चैवाष्टविंशतिः” ।। २० ।। •९५ •९६ चतुष्कं पञ्चकं षट्कं चतुष्कं पञ्च चतुः । षट्प्रकारक्रमं ह्येतत्“ यो वेत्ति ” स च कौलिकः ।। २१ ।। आदौ पीठचतुष्कं तु चत्वारः पीठदेवता: १०१ । सिद्धपञ्चकमन्य” तु ज्ञानषट्कसमन्वितम् ।। २२ ॥ महन्तारीपञ्चक॰३ च४ ओलित्रयकुलक्रमम् । १०७ १०८ अष्टाविंशतिभिर्भेदै: प्रकाराणि षडिः स्मृताः ।। २३ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 147 Externally, they are the Peak (seed-syllables corresponding to) O (OÆÆiyāna), JĀ (Jālandhara), PŪ (PūrSagiri), KĀ (Kāmarūpa) and Tisraka. Together (samasta) (they constitute) Kula,35 while Kaula (the sixth component) is enveloped by the energy of Śiva and Śakti. (13cd-14ab) The aggregate, enveloped in the bliss (of the energy of Śiva and Śakti), functions within bliss. (Thus) there comes about the equilibrium (samatva) of the mind which is the bliss of the outpouring (udbhava) (of bliss). In the middle of that is the subtle Li‰ga, the Divine Li‰ga that faces downwards.36 (14cd-15) It is in the core of the Supreme Void in the middle of the Circle of the Moon. Then, perceived by the Inner Self, it enters the cavity (sunira) (of the Void). (16) He who is established in contemplation (samādhi) sees the surface of the Void which is in the form of the Point. (Then) penetration (āveśa), which is the arising of the bliss of consciousness, takes place. The experience of the proclamation (of the scripture) (āśrāvaSapratyaya) is that that is one's own nature.37 (17-18ab) When mental consciousness (cittacaitanya) is churned, the (very) foundation of Karma is churned. So too, by churning the Wheel, the possession of Yoga (yogāveśa) takes place again and again.38 The Wheel in that Kula is the Circle of the Sun39 and is light red (in colour). The Circle of the Point is located there. (18cd-19) The First Sequence of Twenty-eight40 Churned by Passion (smaraSa), (the Point) is split up and melted. It is (then) divided into six parts and twenty-eight divisions. (20) A group of four, (then of) five, six, four, five and four: this is the sequence of the six units (prakāra) and he who knows it is a (true) Kaulika.41 (21) The first is the group of four sacred seats and the four deities of the sacred seats. Another (that follows) is the group of five Siddhas endowed with the sixfold knowledge.42 (22) And there is the pentad of Mahantārī43 and the Kulakrama along with the three Lineages (oli). (In this way) the six parts are said to consist of the twenty- eight divisions. (23)

sanskrit: 148 कुमारिकाखण्ड: एतैर्भिन्न” कुलात्मान” तदा आनन्दसन्ततिः । कलिस्यान्ते च कामाख्ये समीपस्थं च पञ्चकम् ॥ २४ ॥ ।। ।। ११२ अवस्था च कुले कौले तिस्राख्ये जायते हि ४ च । स चाष्टाविंशमो १५ भेदो १६ भविष्ये च भविष्यति ।। २५ ।। ११९ एवं ते पञ्चभि:”“ पीठा:”” पूर्वसूत्रे विसर्पिताः । तथा च देवतादीनि सृष्टिन्याये अतः शृणु ।। २६ ।। गजजिह्वा अग्निजिह्वा” तडिज्जिह्वा तृतीयका । शुक्रजिह्वा च अमरा” रसजिह्वा च पञ्चमी ।। २७ ।। तेषां सिद्धी:२३ क्रमात् पञ्च इदानीं चन्द्रार्कीनलबिम्बस्थ“ बिन्दौ च १२६ १२४ प्रवदाम्यहम् । गणपञ्चकम् ।। २८ ।। १२९ । आवेश ७ घूर्णिरानन्द:२८ ऊष्मा क्रोषणशोषणम् एतद् वै ज्ञानषट्कं तु प्रकृतिस्थं प्रमेयतः ।। २९ ॥ १३० १३१ माया च शाम्भवी शक्ति: इच्छा ज्ञानी क्रिया तथा । एतच्चतुष्कमाख्यात” पञ्चकं महन्तारिका ३ ।। ३० ॥ शब्दा स्पशी रसा देवी रूपव्यापी ३५ च १३६ गन्धिनी १३७ । १३४ •१४० । एते ३८ वै त्वदहंकार्याी: १९ पञ्चक परिकीर्तितम् ।। ३१ ।। विमलान्तरमात्मान एवं ओलित्रिक४२ स्मृतम् । एव४३ ते क्रमभेदानि कथितान्यष्टविंशतिः ।। ३२ ।। एतैर्भिन्नं महालिङ्गं दिव्यमण्डलसंज्ञकम् । १४५ तेषां विद्यान्वय यच्च परा सा परमा कला ॥ ३३ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 149 The Tradition of Bliss (ānandasantati) (arises) when the essence (ātman) of Kula is divided by these (divisions). At the end of the Age of Strife in Kāmākhya, the pentad is at hand. (24) And there arises the state that is in Kula and Kaula within (the sacred seat) called Tisra. This is the twenty-eighth division that will occur in the future.44 (25) Such are your five sacred seats that have emerged in the previous sūtra. Now, in the same way, listen to the (teachings concerning) the deities and everything else, according to the order of emanation. (26) The Second Sequence of Twenty-Eight Gajajihvā (Elephant Tongue), Agnijihvā (Fire Tongue) with TaÆijjihvā (Lightning Tongue) as the third; (the fourth is) Śukrajihvā (Sperm Tongue) and the immortal Rasajihvā (Juice Tongue), the fifth. (27) Now I will tell (you) their five accomplishments (siddhi) in due order. (This) group of five is located in the Moon, Sun, Fire, the Image (bimba) and the Point. (28) Possession (āveśa), mystic inebriation (ghūrSi), bliss (ānanda), (mystic) heat (ūnmā), shouting (ākronaSa) and drying out (nonaSa): this, indeed, is the sixfold knowledge located in Nature (prakrti) in the midst of objectivity. (29) Māyā, (which is) Śāmbhavīśakti, will, knowledge and action: this is said to be the group of four. The pentad of Mahantārikā (consists of the goddesses) Śabdā (Sound) and Śparśā (Touch), the goddess Rasā (Juice i.e. Taste), Rūpavyāpinī (Form-pervading i.e. Sight) and Gandhinī (Smell). These, the products of your ego, are said to be the group of five.45 (30-31) The pure inner Self is in this way said to be the triad of Lineages (oli). Thus, I have explained the twenty-eight divisions of your Krama.46 (32) Concerning the Great Li‰ga — the triangular Divine MaSÆala in the Body The great Li‰ga, which is termed the Divine MaSÆala, is divided with these (divisions). The lineage of knowledge (vidyānvaya) is the Supreme (Goddess) who is the paramount energy (kalā). (33)

sanskrit: 150 कुमारिकाखण्डः नित्योदिता सुसूक्ष्मा च नासाग्रे संव्यवस्थिता । ऊर्णतन्तुनिभाकारा गोक्षीरहिमशीतला ।। ३४ ॥ तयासौ जीवते जीवो दिव्यलिङ्गं महेश्वर' ४९ तस्य सिद्धान्वयं सर्वं भेदाश्चैवाष्टविंशतिः १५० तया प्राशितमात्रा या अन्तर्भावः प्रवर्तते । -१५२ । ॥ ३५ ॥ त्रिनाडिसंगम” स्थूलं एकत्र यत्र तिष्ठति ।। ३६ ।। १५४ तेन त५३ त्रिपुरं पीठं त्रिभिः स्रोतप्रवाहकम्' । १५७ तिस्राख्य५५ च ललाटस्थ ब्रह्मग्रन्थिरधोमुखी ॥ ३७ ॥ ललाटसुषिर चक्रं प्रत्यय ज्ञानरश्मयः । एवं व्याप्तं क्रमं मेरोर्योगिनी च अधोमुखी ॥ ३८ ॥ सा शक्ति: परमा तत्र स्थिता विश्रामकारिणी । दक्षिणोत्तरयोः पार्शवे जननी चलते पुरे ॥ ३९ ॥ भगमध्यमशृङ्गस्य'६३ तस्याग्रे तु लयं पुनः । १६५ एवं सा रुद्रशक्तिस्तु त्रिभिर्भेदैः प्रतिष्ठिता ।। ४० ॥ आदिस्थाने स्थिता तत्र देवदेवी कुलेच्छया । ददते ज्ञानसद्भावं कुटिलाङ्गी स्वतन्त्रतः ।। ४१ ।। १६७ १६८ तदानन्द:१६ प्रवर्तेत मोक्षमार्गमहोत्सवः । आज्ञा गुरुमुखाद् लब्ध्वा रुद्रशक्तिः प्रवर्तते । ४२ ॥ १७० वक्त्राद् वक्त्रगता ँ आज्ञा बन्धुभूता कुक्रमे । १७२ १७३ वाचासिद्धिः कुले कौले भवनात् संप्रवर्तते ॥ ४३ ॥ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 151 Perpetually active (nityoditā), she is extremely subtle and is located (between the two channels of the breath) at the tip of the nose. Her form is (that of very subtle fibre) like a spider's thread, and (she) is as cool as snow and (white) as cow's milk.47 (34) O Great Lord, it is due to her that this living being (jīva), the Divine Li‰ga, lives.48 To it belongs the entire lineage of the Siddhas and the twenty-eight divisions. (35) She is the assimilated energy (prāśitamātrā) (of KuSÆalinī). It is due to her, merely by her being eaten, that the inner (mystic) state (antarbhāva) comes about. It is where the gross union of the three psychic channels (nāÆī) abides together in a single place. (36) Therefore that is the sacred seat of the Three Cities (tripura) that, by the three (lineages), transports the current (srotas) (of the teaching). Again, (the sacred seat) called ‘Tisra' is located in the forehead. It is the Knot of Brahmā that faces downwards.49 (37) The Wheel (corresponding) to the cavity (sunira) in the forehead is the experience (pratyaya) (which is the sign of accomplishment) and (consists of) the rays of knowledge. In this way the Krama of Meru is pervaded and the Yoginī50 faces downwards. (38) She who is established there is the supreme energy who brings repose (viśrāmakāriSī). The Mother moves in the City on the right and on the left. (39) Again, merger (occurs) in front of that, in the middle corner of the Yoni.51 In this way, she, Rudra's energy, is well established with (her) three divisions. (40) The Goddess of the gods resides there, in the first place (ādisthāna), by the will of Kula. (And from there), she whose limbs are crooked freely bestows the essence of knowledge. (41) Then the bliss, which is the great festival of liberation, arises. Once the Command has been obtained from the teacher's mouth, Rudra's energy52 begins to function. (42) (Transmitted) from mouth to mouth, the Command is (one’s) companion in the Kulakrama. It is the Accomplishment of Speech (vācāsiddhi), the contemplation (bhāvanā) that takes place within Kula and Kaula.53 (43)

sanskrit: 152 कुमारिकाखण्डः १७५ कर्मणा मनसा वाचा त्रिशुद्धिर्भक्तिवत्सले ५ । तस्याज्ञा वर्तते शिष्ये भावहीनो •१७७ १७८ न सिद्ध्यति ।। ४४ ।। पशुपाशभय शिष्ये अन्यथा च भवेद् ध्रुवम् रुद्रशक्तिर्महादेवी अमोघा च जगत्सुता ।। ४५ ।। दिव्याज्ञाया: स्वरूपा सा सिद्धरूपा त्वनेकधा । १८० १८१ १७९ नित्यक्लिन्नाप्रभावेन अतिरक्तस्वरूपतः ।। ४६ ।। १८२ उदयं लभते शिष्यः परमानन्दलक्षणम् । १८४ । प्रतिरूपा च '८३ या शक्तिः प्रसिद्धा च्छायजा परा ।। ४७ । कुर्वन्ती नित्य कर्माणि मनेच्छया यथा सुधीः । मोचयेच्छक्तिचक्रस्थों“ दिव्यलिङ्गतनुर्धरः ।। ४८ ।। १८९ चन्द्रादित्यजले च्छाया अग्निसोमार्कदर्पणे । तथा सा तारकान्ते च परा देवी सुसूक्ष्मगा ॥ ४९ ॥ पशुधीरा” यथा पश्येत् कुटिला च अधोमुखीम् । सा च देवी ह्यहं मूर्तिः कुब्जिका कुलकौलिनी ॥ ५० ॥ १९६ १९७ तस्या: सूत्रक्रमं चोक्तं क्रम - ओघ विनिर्गतम् । प्रज्ञार्थं संगतं पश्येन्मूलसूत्रोपदेशकम् ।। ५१ ।। १९९ इत्यागमविशुद्धस्य प्रज्ञासूत्रमय हर । मलस्यैवोपघातार्थं निर्णीतामिह संहिताम् ।। ५२ ।। .२०२ अनेन सूचितं सूत्रं मूलसूत्रं तु मूलतः । प्रज्ञासूत्रविनिर्मुक्तो योऽन्यथा अवधारयेत् ॥ ५३ ॥ २०३ २०४ न तस्य सूत्रं न मूलं तु न ज्ञानं ज्ञेयरूपतः ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 153 By action, mind and speech, the triple purity abides in one who is the darling of devotion. The Command of (such a one) abides within (his) disciple. Otherwise the disciple will certainly fear the bondage of the fettered.54 One who is devoid of deep spiritual feeling (bhāva) is not successful. (44-45ab) Rudra's energy is the Great Goddess; she is the unfailing mother of the universe. She is the essential nature of the Divine Command and (her) nature is (fully) accomplished in many ways. (45cd-46ab) The disciple achieves elevation (udaya), the mark of which is supreme bliss, through the power of (the goddess) Nityaklinnā (Perpetually Wet) by virtue of (her) extremely loving (atirakta)55 nature. (46cd-47ab) She is the energy who is every form. Supreme and well known, she is born from the shade (of the Tree of Consciousness)56 and always acts according to the mind's desire. The wise own who is established in the Wheel of Energies (śakticakra), and who has as (his) body (this) Divine Li‰ga, is freed. (47cd-48) The Supreme Goddess, established within the extremely subtle, is the shade (cchāyā) in the net (of the rays) of the Sun and Moon, (reflected) in the mirror of Fire, Moon and Sun. And in the same way she is within the Star (tāraka i.e. the Point).57 (49) Crooked and facing downwards, (she is seen below), just as the fettered soul sees the earth (below him). And I am that goddess, the Form (mūrti) (of Ultimate Reality) (called) Kubjikā, the Kaulinī (energy of) Kula. (50) The Transmission of (the goddess's) sūtra (sūtrakrama) has been explained, namely, the Current of the Transmission (kramaugha) that has emerged (into the world). One should perceive the sense of (its) wisdom and coherence which instructs in (the true sense of) the Root Sūtra. (51) O Hara, this is the Wisdom Sūtra of one who has been purified by the scripture. (This) scripture (saˆhitā) has been taught here in order to destroy (the individual soul's) impurity. (52) (It is a) ‘sūtra' because it is by this that (the teaching) is expounded (sūcita). Moreover, it is the ‘Root Sūtra' because (it is the very) root (of the teaching). He who does not possesses the Wisdom Sūtra, (or) who understands it in another (incorrect) way, does not possess the sūtra, nor the root (of the teaching), nor knowledge of that which is to be known. (53-54ab)

sanskrit: 154 कुमारिकाखण्ड: न कुलं च क्रमं नैव नाचार्य नैव पुत्रकम् तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन मूलसूत्रं समाश्रयेत् । श्रीनाथ उवाच .२०६ ॥ ५४ ॥ क्रमौघ मूलसूत्रं तु प्रज्ञासूत्रेण बोधितम् ।। ५५ । त्वन्मुखाच्च मया ज्ञातं सिद्धोऽहं नात्र संशयः । दिव्यानन्दप्रकाशोऽयं” उत्पन्नस्त्वत्प्रसादतः ॥ ५६ ॥ २१० । ऐं नमोऽस्तु ते महामाये अजिते तेजरूपिणि १२ । सोममण्डलमध्यस्थे”३ नादरूपे खमाश्रिते ।। ५७ ।। ऐंकारविग्रहावस्थे”५ दिव्यलिङ्गे नपुंसके । २१७ २१८ । कलिस्यां”६ परमे मातः अन्ते अम्बे कुलाम्बिके ॥ ५८ ॥ २२१ आदिपीठसमुद्भूते पञ्चाशत्पीठमाश्रिते । वह्निकपिलसंकाशे१२ स्फुरन्नाडीप्रबोधके ॥ ५९ ॥ विसर्गीन्ते समुद्भूते वाग्भवे परमेश्वरि । हकारार्धकलाधारे शून्यभूते खगोदिते ।। ६० ।। बिन्दुस्थे चैव चन्द्रस्थे खेचरीचक्रमाश्रिते । देवीनां गुरुमानाम्बे २५ कुब्जिके परमेश्वरि ।। ६१ ।। ईश्वरान्तर्गते मात : २२६ आत्मानन्दविभेदिते । २२७ कूटस्थे देवदेवेशि योगपीठे व्यवस्थिते ॥ ६२ ॥ दुर्गमार्गोदिते भीमे मण्डलान्ते कलौ युगे । २३० २३१ आवर्ते च निरावर्ते२९ लये विश्रामकारिणि ॥ ६३ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 155 (He has) no Kula, no Krama, no teacher and no disciple. Therefore, one should make every effort to attend (to the meaning of) the Root Sūtra. (54cd-55ab) Śrīnātha said: From your mouth I have know the Current of the Krama, that is, the Root Sūtra, explained by the Wisdom Sūtra. (Thus) I have achieved the goal (siddho 'ham): there is no doubt about it. This is the light of divine bliss which has arisen by your grace. (55cd-56) The Māyāstava58 AI¤! Salutations to you who are Mahāmāyā! Unconquered one! Radiant energy (tejas)! You who reside in the centre of the Circle of the Moon! You who are Sound! O you who reside in the Void (of Ultimate Reality)!59 (57) O Mother! O Mother of Kula! (Salutations to you) who abide in the form of the syllable AI¤! (O you who are) the Divine Li‰ga (divyali‰ga)! O (female) Neuter (napuˆsakā)!60 O Supreme Mother in the end of the Age of Strife!61 (58) (Salutations to you) who have arisen from the primordial sacred seat and are established in the fifty sacred seats,62 tawny like fire and who, pulsing effulgently (sphuran), awakens the channel (nāÆī) (of KuSÆalinī)!63 (59) (Salutations to you) O Supreme Goddess, O Vāgbhava (AI¤)! (You) arise at the end of emission (visarga), the foundation of the energy of half of the letter Ha, the Void arisen as the Skyfarer!64 (60) (Salutations to you who are) established in the Point, in the Moon and the Wheel of the Skyfarers (khecarīcakra), O Supreme Goddess Kubjikā! O mother respected as the most senior (gurumānāmbe) of (all) the goddesses!65 (61) (Salutations to you) O Mother who are within the Lord (īśvara)! (You are) endowed with the bliss of the Self! O Mistress of the God of the gods! (You) reside in the Peak (seed-syllable)! (You) abide within the Sacred Seat of Yoga!66 (62) (Salutations to you who have) arisen on the path (of KuSÆalinī) that is difficult to approach (durgamārgoditā)! O horrifying one (bhīmā) within the maSÆala in the Age of Strife! O whirpool (of energy) (āvartā)! Free of rotation (nirāvrtā), (you) bring about repose within merger!67 (63)

sanskrit: 156 मङ्गला त्वं महादेवि ॐकारपीठमाश्रितें कुमारिकाखण्ड: २३२ देवि जालन्धरे३३ माये पूर्णपीठे अधोमुखि ।। ६४ ।। त्वं च कामेश्वरी क्लिन्ने योगिनी कामरूपके । २३६ माया त्वं भैरवीशक्तिनीयकी२३५ पीठपञ्चकें ॥ ६५ ॥ काली त्वं चैव उज्जैन्यां७ अर्धपीठेश्वरेश्वरी' २३९ २३८ । त्वं च पीठोपपीठेषु त्वमाद्या क्रममण्डले ९ ।। ६६ ।। २४० पञ्चप्रणवमध्यस्थे पूर्णान्ते कुलमातरे । मातृचक्रस्थिते देवि षड्योगिनिपरावृते” ।। ६७ । २४२ त्वं च सा डाकिनी माया अप्रमेयातितेजसा । किङ्किणी ज्वालघोषाणां वीणापटहदुन्दुभी३ ।। ६८ ।। त्रिधामधामसंघट्टे त्रिधागतिसमाश्रिते । त्रिप्रकारगते४६ शान्ते मातृमन्त्रतनुप्रिये ।। ६९ ।। ऐंकारासनमारूढे बिन्दुरूपे त्रिधागते । ह्रीँकारजननि ८ देवि २४९ क्षाँ क्षाँ क्लीँकारभेदनि २५० २५२ व्यापकि२५१ व्याप्तिवर्णानां याँराँलाँवाँनिवासिनि । हेमहेमावति२५३ देवि हंसिनि ४ हंसमध्यगे ।। ७१ ।। २५४ हंसनादेश्वरि २५५ भीमे वक्रदेहे २६ अधोमुखि २५८ २५७ । सुभगे विमले शान्ते प्रमेयज्ञानवल्लभे ।। ७२ ।। ।। ७० ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 157 O Great Goddess! (you) reside in the sacred seat of O¤! You are Ma‰galā (Auspicious)! (Salutations to you) O goddess! O Māyā! (You are in the sacred seat of) Jālandhara! (You) face downwards in the sacred seat of PūrSa(-giri)!68 (64) O Klinnā (Wet One), you are Kāmeśvarī (Mistress of Passion), the Yoginī in Kāmarūpa. You are Māyā, the energy Bhairavī and mistress in the five sacred seats.69 (65) And you are Kālī in Ujjain and the mistress of the Lord of the Half Sacred Seat.70 You (are present in all) the sacred seats, (both) primary and secondary;71 you are the first (goddess) (ādyā) in the KramamaSÆala. (66) (Salutations to you), O Mother of Kula (who is) within the Full (Moon) in the midst of the Five PraSavas;72 (you) reside, O goddess, in the Wheel of Mātrkā surrounded by the six Yoginīs.73 (67) You are Õākinī who is Māyā, immeasurable due to (your) intense energy (atitejas). Not an object of knowledge, (you are) the radiant energy beyond. (You are) Ki‰kiSī (Tinkle), the vīSā, the barrel drum and kettledrum74 of the roaring sounds of the flaming fire (of consciousness). (68) O conjunction (saˆgha˜˜a)75 of the abode of the three abodes! You who are established in the threefold movement (of energy) and are of three kinds! Peaceful one! You are the beloved whose body is mantra and the letters (mātr)! (69) O you who are in the form of the Point! Threefold, you are seated on the seat that is the letter AI¤! O (you who) are the mother of the syllable HRĪ¤! O goddess who pierces through (bhedanī) the syllables K±Ā¤, K±Ā¤ and KLĪ¤.76 (70) You pervade (vyāpakī) the letters of pervasion (vyāptivarSa)! (You) reside in (the seed-syllables) YĀ¤, RĀ¤, LĀ¤ and VĀ¤! O goddess! O golden daughter of the mountains! O (you who are) amidst the Gander (haˆsa)! sanskrit: 158 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ब्रह्मरूपस्वरूपे च ऐं - ह्रीं – श्रीं – समयावृते । २६० ह्रीँकारत्रिगुणावर्ते ह्रीँ ह्रीँ मन्त्रतनु प्रिये ॥ ७३ ॥ मायारूपधरीदेवि गजजिह्वे गजेश्वरि । २६१ २६३ त्वमेव विद्युज्जिह्वा च ह्राँ ह्रीँ हूँ१२ च ३ भगोद्भवे ।। ७४ ।। २६४ भवोद्भवे भवातीते तुर्यथे ४ तुर्यमूर्धनि । २६६ ।। ।। प्रशान्तपदमारूढे६५ षट्त्यागात् सप्तमेश्वरि ॥ ७५ ॥ २६७ सूक्ष्मे चैव सुसूक्ष्मे च सुस्थिते च सुराधिपे । आनन्दे६९ च निरानन्दे अमरीक्रमभूषिते ।। ७६ ।। २७० २७२ ग्लँकारे पार्थिवे ब्राह्मी स्लँकारे २७३ त्वं च २४ वैष्णवी । २७५ प्लँकारे त्वं कुले रौद्री म्लँकारे त्वं च ईश्वरी ।। ७७ ।। न्लँकारे २७६ नायकी नन्दा नित्यानन्दपरे ७७ रता । २७८ माया त्वं सर्वसिद्धीनां पीठानां संस्थिता उमे ।। ७८ ।। मे माते ९ परमे माये मे शिवे मे सरस्वति । मे माता मे च मे भायी मे च जीवान्तरालये ।। ७९ ।। २८१ प्रभुर्मे दिव्यशक्तिस्त्वं आरक्ते तत्त्ववाससे । सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि८२ क्लिन्ने जीवनाडिगते शुभे ॥ ८० ॥ २८३ ह्राँह्रीँहूँकारमन्त्रैस्तु चलसे४ स्यन्दसे“५ जगत् । । मन्त्रावेशपदे गौरि शक्त्यन्ते च समाश्रिते ।। ८१ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 159 O you whose nature is the absolute (brahmarūpa)! You are enveloped in AI¤, HRĪ¤ and ŚRĪ¤,78 (which are the seed-syllables of the) Rule (samaya)! You are enveloped by the three qualities (guSa) of the syllable HRĪ¤!79 You are the beloved whose body is the mantra HRĪ¤ HRĪ¤! (73) O goddess who bears the form of Māyā! O Gajajihvā (Elephant-tongued)! O Gajeśvarī (Mistress of the Elephants)! And you are also Vidyujjihvā (Lightning Tongue)80! HRĀ¤ HRĪ¤ HRŪ¤! O (you) who have emerged from the Yoni (bhagodbhava). (74) O you who emerge out of phenomenal existence and are beyond it! You are established within the Fourth State at the head of the Fourth State! O you who are mounted on the plane of perfect tranquillity! By abandoning the six (lower states), you are the mistress of the seventh (supreme one)!81 (75) O subtle one, O extremely subtle one! O mistress of the gods, well established! O bliss! O Bliss of Stillness! You are adorned with the Transmission of Amarī (the Immortal One)! (76) You are Brāhmī in the earth syllable GLŪ¤ and VainSavī in the syllable SLŪ¤. You are Raudrī in the Kula in the syllable PLŪ¤ and Īśvarī in the syllable MLŪ¤.82 (77) You are the mistress Nandā in the syllable NLŪ¤, devoted to the supreme and eternal bliss within it.83 O Umā! You are established as the magic (māyā) of all magical powers (siddhi) of the sacred seats. (78) O my mother! Supreme One! Māyā! My Śivā! My Sarasvatī! O innermost recess of my soul! You are my mother, you are my wife. (79) You are my lord and my Divine Power. Intensely passionate one (āraktā)! (You) reside in (ultimate) reality (tattva)! O (you who) are beautiful in every limb! O wet one! O auspicious one! (You) are present in the Channel of the Soul (jīvanāÆī)!84 (80) By means of the mantras consisting of the syllables HRĀ¤ HRĪ¤ HRŪ¤, you move and melt the universe.85 O Gaurī! (You are) on the plane of possession (āveśa) (brought about by) mantra. You are at the extremity of Power!86 (81)

sanskrit: 160 कुमारिकाखण्ड: कुलमातङ्गिनीचक्रे विद्यादेवीति कुब्जिके । .२८८ पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाकारे चन्द्रपूर्णभगानने ।। ८२ ।। सप्ताविंशपदैर्भेदैः९ अष्टाविंशत्पदोद्भवे .२९० २९२ । चक्रनायकि कौलीशे”” ईश्वरीकुलमाश्रिते ।। ८३ ॥ सिद्धपञ्चाशरूपेण ९३ कमले कमलेश्वर । अट्टहाससमुद्भूते”४ हंसमण्डलभूषिते ।। ८४ ।। सोममण्डलमध्यस्थे माया त्वं सूर्यमण्डले । त्वमग्निमण्डलान्तस्थे दीप्तजिह्वे महेश्वरि ॥ ८५ ॥ २९६ वायुवेगे मनान्तस्थे परापरविसर्पिते । शून्ये शून्यान्तरावस्थे मारुति सिद्धसेविते ।। ८६ ॥ २९८ निरालम्बे गते देवि आकाशे दुरतिक्रमें । २९९ ज्ञानविज्ञानगम्भीरे ज्ञेयरूपे च केवले ॥ ८७ ॥ स्थितिलयकरीदेवि जननि” तत्त्वमण्डले । तत्त्वानां २ क्षोभणी शक्ति : ३३ अज्ञानतमभेदनी४ ।। ८८ ।। मातरी ५ सर्वदेवानां मम प्राणप्रिये उमे । ३०७ विश्वेश्वरी ६ जगद्धात्री संप्रदायप्रदायिनी ।। ८९ ।। ३०८ नमस्ते परनिर्वाणे जगद्योनिमहाम्बिके । स्मर त्वं समयं पूर्वं स्नेहेन मनविग्रहम् ३११ ३१२ ३१० ॥ ९० ॥ तुष्टा भव परेऽस्माकं माता त्वं त्रिदशैरपि । इति मायास्तव” ३ प्रोक्तं योगीवाणीक्रमागतम् ।। ९१ ।। तस्यावतारं कुरुते वक्रिका पीठदेवता ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 161 O Kubjikā! (You are) the goddess of the Vidyā (Vidyādevī) in the Wheel of Kulamāta‰ginī (the Kula Sweeper-woman). O you whose face is the Yoni of the Full Moon, and whose form is like that of the full moon!87 (82) O you who have emerged from the parts (pada) of the (Sequence of) Twenty-eight divided into twenty-seven parts (pada)!88 O Mistress of the Wheel! O Mistress of Kula! (You are) established in the Īśvarīkula! (83) O Mistress of the Lotus! (You are) in the Lotus (MaSÆala) in the form of the fifty Siddhas. You have come forth from A˜˜ahāsa89 and are adorned with the Circle of the Gander (haˆsamaSÆala)! (84) O you who reside in the middle of the Circle of the Moon (somamaSÆala)! In the Circle of the Sun, you are Māyā. O Maheśvarī! Flaming tongue! You reside within the Circle of Fire!90 (85) O you who are the force of the Wind and reside within the mind! You have emerged from the supreme (transcendence) and the inferior (immanence)! O Void! You are the vital breath (mārutī)! (You) reside within the Void and are served by the Siddhas! (86) O goddess! You are within Space which is unsustained and hard to traverse! You are profound with knowledge and consciousness! O (you who) should be known! O you who are alone (and unique)!91 (87) O goddess who brings about persistence and merger! O Mother in the Circle of the Principles of Existence!92 (You) shatter the darkness of ignorance and are the energy that arouses the principles (to engage in their functions). (88) O Umā! You who are dear to my (very) life! You are my mother and (the mother) of the gods. You are the mistress of all things, the benefactor of the universe, she who bestows the tradition.93 (89) Salutations to you who are the supreme NirvāSa! O Great Mother, Womb of the universe! Recall with affection the form of the mind, your ancient Rule. You who are the mother even of the gods, be satisfied with us!94 (90-91ab) Thus the Hymn to Māyā (Māyāstava) has been uttered. It has come through the transmission of yogis’ speech and Vakrikā, the deity of the sacred seat, brings it down (into the world). (91cd-92ab)

sanskrit: 162 कुमारिकाखण्ड: •३१५ सुखमारोग्यसंपत्तिमवस्थां ५ लभते नरः ।। ९२ ॥ सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो भवते तत्क्षणादपि । न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिर्मायास्तवमुदीरणात् ।। ९३ । ३१९ इहैव प्राप्नुयाद् भोगान् लाभ पूजायशः श्रियः । अवस्था क्रमयुक्तस्य पारम्पर्येण तस्य च ।। ९४ ॥ समयाचारयुक्तस्य तीव्राज्ञा संप्रवर्तते । इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते २१ लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे २४ आज्ञापारमेश्वरे २५ स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्र- संहितायां६ अव्वाक्रमभाषिते मूलसूत्राधिकारवर्णने ३२७ ३२८ मायास्तवाधिकारो नामानन्दः ।। २६ ।। ३२३
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX 163 (Through it) a man achieves happiness, the state (of liberation) and the wealth of good health, and in that very moment he is freed of all sin. By reciting the Hymn to Māyā, there is no more return for him (into this world). In this very place he gains profit, enjoyments, the fame of (performing) the sacred rites (pūjā) and (many forms of) wealth (and power) (śrī). (92cd-94ab) He possesses the state of one who is part of the transmission (kramayukta) because he belongs to the lineage. And, intent on the Practice of the Rule (samayācāra), an intense (level of the) Command operates (within) him. (94cd-95ab) This is the (twenty-sixth) chapter dedicated to the Hymn to Māyā that forms a part of the Description of the Authority of the Root Sūtra. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with ‘KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: सप्तविंशानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच देवि सिद्धे' जगत्स्वामि' आदिनाथे कुलोद्भवे । ब्रूहि ज्ञानोपदेशं तु यत् सारं पश्चिमान्वये ॥ १ ॥ प्रकटं कुरु' कौलीशे पूजा – आगममण्डलम् । श्रीवक्रा उवाच सारं शैवस्य जगतो भुवनाकृतिमण्डलम् ।। २ ॥ बाह्यस्थं च स्वदेहस्थं अन्तरङ्गं चिदात्मकम् । तदहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि गुरुमण्डलकं यथा ।। ३ । ११ योऽसौ अनादिरव्यक्तः शिवः परमकारणः । मन्त्रमूर्तिरभून्नाथ लोकानुग्रहहेतुना ॥ ४ ॥ अवतीर्णस्तु भूलोके अनुग्रहकरः परः । १४ पूज्योऽसौ मण्डले देव नवात्मानन्दभैरवः ।। ५ ॥ पञ्चमूर्तिधरो नाथः षोडशावयवान्वितः । नवधामूर्तिमाश्रित्य अवतीर्णः कलौ युगे ॥ ६ ॥ पञ्चाशद्रुद्रमूर्तिस्थों यथा पूज्यस्तथा ँ शृणु । -२२ १७ तस्योद्धार” महादेव श्लोकैः पञ्चभिः सूचितम् ॥ ७ ॥ अकारे चत्वरे” मध्ये पञ्चमं च तथा पुनः । लकयक्षतन” रमडख४ चेति विपर्ययेत् ॥ ८ ॥ २६ २८ ड६ ढ७ ठ ट दपर्यन्तं सृष्ट्या मेरोर्विनिर्गतम् । मण्डलं तं स्मृतं देव द्वितीयं चाधिकारयोः ॥ ९ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN The MaSÆala of the Transmission (kramamaSÆala) and the MaSÆala of the Teachers (gurumaSÆala) The MaSÆala of the Teachers Śrīnātha said: O goddess! O accomplished one (siddhā)! Lord (svāmin) of the universe! O first teacher (ādināthā)! O outpouring of Kula! Impart the teaching concerning the knowledge which is the essence of the Western Tradition (anvaya). O Kaulīsā, make the MaSÆala of the Scripture and the rite of adoration clear (to me). (1-2ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: The essence of the Śaiva (scripture) is the maSÆala of the universe whose form is that of the worlds. It is located (both) outside (in the external world) and within one's own body. The (most) internal one is (pure) consciousness. I will explain this, the MaSÆala of the Teachers (gurumaSÆala).1 (2cd-3) He who is beginningless, unmanifest, benign (śiva) and the supreme cause assumed, O Lord, a form consisting of mantra in order to grace the world. (4) Having descended into the world, he is the supreme bestower of grace. He, the Bhairava of the bliss of Navātman should, O god, be worshipped in the maSÆala. (5) He is the Lord (nātha) who has five forms (pañcamūrti) and possesses the sixteen limbs (avayava). Having entered into the ninefold form,2 he has descended down (into the world) during the Age of Strife and resides in the form of the fifty Rudras. Listen to how he should be worshipped. (6-7ab) O Great God, the enunciation of his (mantra) is outlined in (the following) five verses: in the letter A, in the fourth, in the middle and, again, the fifth and (then) the reverse La Ka Ya K±a Ta Naˆ and Ra Ma Õa Khaˆ. Õa Õha µha up to Da have come forth from Meru by way of (the order of) emanation. That, O god, is said to be the second maSÆala of the two who have authority.3 (7cd-9)

sanskrit: 166 कुमारिकाखण्ड: इन्द्र आपस्तथा तेजो वायुराकाशमेव च । ३३ ज्ञानोऽय” कुण्डली कोटि: तृतीया वरवर्णिनि ॥ १० ॥ हृदयं” समय चैव सर्वज्ञं च कदम्बकम् । खगीशं गुरुनाथं च रत्नबीजं चतुर्थकम् ॥ ११ ॥ कदम्बं विमलौघ६ च समयं भैरवावली । ३७ ·३८ पादुकान्ते मनुं स्मृत्वा पूजयेद्” गुरुमण्डलम् ।। १२ ।। विद्यापीठाग्रतो देव गुरुमण्डलपूजनम् । पूर्वक्रमे यथा चोक्तं पञ्चासनसमन्वितम् ।। १३ ।। प्रसादत्रयसंभिन्नं अर्चयेत् गुरु¨ पञ्चधा । ईशकोणात् ” समारभ्य यावन्मध्यं तु पञ्चमम् ।। १४ । ४६ मण्डलं चाधिकार च सिद्धाः ४५ समय योगिनी । पञ्चधा पञ्चभिर्भिन्न ँ पञ्चधाकौलिनीयुतम् ॥ १५ ॥ वाग्भवं मायया सार्धं लक्ष्मीप्रसादभेदितम्” । नवात्मानन्दसंयुक्तं पञ्चभिर्गुरुमण्डलम् ।। १६ ।। पादुकान्तं महादेव पूजयेत् सततं वरम् । ५२ अन्तरङ्गगताः” पूज्याः मण्डलानि तथात्मनि ॥ १७ ॥ आधारे प्रथमं प्रोक्तं द्वितीयं योनिमण्डले । तृतीयं नाभिचक्रे तु चतुर्थ ३ च ४ अनाहते ॥ १८ ॥ पञ्चमं कण्ठदेशे तु आदिनाथं तु मूर्धनि । श्रीकण्ठादि पिङ्गलान्त पञ्चधा पञ्च कल्पितम् ॥ १९ ॥ ५७ प्रभाते चैव मध्याह्ने सन्ध्याकाले तु सुन्दर । विद्यापीठाग्रतः कुर्यात् गुरोरग्रे तु पञ्चधा ॥ २० ॥ आराधनं तु कर्तव्यं संपूर्णं सिद्धिदं भवेत् । न रिक्तं मण्डलं कुर्यात् गुरोरग्रे कदाचन ।। २१ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN 167 Earth (indra), Water, Fire (tejas), Wind and Sky4 — O most excellent lady of the gods, this is knowledge, KuSÆalī, which is the third polarity. (10) One should worship the MaSÆala of the Teachers having recollected the mantra which the (Teacher's) Sandals (pāduka), and (having worshipped therein) 1) the Heart, 2) the Rule, 3) the omniscient Kadambaka Tree, Khagīśa, who is the Lord and Teacher (gurunātha), 4) the seed-syllable of the Jewel (ratnabīja) as the fourth, 5) the Kadamba which is the pure Current (of the teaching), and 6) the Rule which is the series of Bhairavas. (11-12) O god, the worship of the MaSÆala of the Teachers takes place in front of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) as explained in the preceding transmission (pūrvakrama).5 (13abc) The (MaSÆala of the) Teachers has five seats and is conjoined with three (repetitions of the syllable of) Grace (prasāda — HSRŪAU¤).6 The teacher, fivefold, should be worshipped starting from the north-east corner up to the center, where the fifth (resides). (13d-14) (The following should be worshipped): the MaSÆala, Authority, the Siddhas, the Rule and the Yoginī. (Thus the Circle of the Teachers), divided into (these) five, is fivefold and is endowed with the fivefold Kaulinī (Vidyā).7 (15) The Circle of the Teacher (is formed) by means of (the following) five: (the seed-syllable called) Vāgbhava (AI¤) along with Māyā (HRĪ¤), is conjoined with Laknmī (ŚRĪ¤) and Grace (KHPHRE¤) and is endowed with the bliss of Navātman (HSK±MLVRYŪ¤).8 O Great God, one should constantly worship (this, the) best of things within the (Teacher's) Sandals (pādukā). (16-17ab) The Inner Worship of the MaSÆala of the Teachers One should worship the internal maSÆalas within oneself in the same way. The first is said to be in the Foundation, the second is in the MaSÆala of the Yoni, the third in the MaSÆala of the Navel, the fourth in (the MaSÆala of) Unstruck Sound, the fifth in the throat, while Ādinātha (the Primordial Lord) is in the head. The five, fivefold, are conceived to begin with ŚrīkaS˜ha and end with Pi‰gala.9 (17cd-19) One should do (this) five times at dawn, noon and at sunset, O fair one; one should worship in front of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) and the teacher. (If the worship is) complete, (it) bestows success. One should never (leave) the maSÆala empty at any time in front of the teacher.10 (20-21)

sanskrit: 168 कुमारिकाखण्ड: यथावित्तानुसारेण कृत्वा संपूर्णपूजनम् । ६३ आरात्री चन्दनं दीप वीरद्रव्यसमन्वितम् ॥। २२ ।। निवेदनं प्रकर्तव्यं साष्टाङ्ग च नमस्करेत् । त्रिधा च पञ्चधा चैव साष्टाङ्ग दण्डवत् सुधीः ।। २३ ।। प्रदक्षिणशतं कृत्वा पूजयेद् गुरुपादुकाम् । एतदाचारसमय पालयेत् सततं बुधः ।। २४ ।॥ ६७ पालनाद् भवते सिद्धि: ँ अन्यथा नरकं व्रजेत् । ओलिपर्वेषु सर्वेषु नित्यनैमित्तिकेषु च ।। २५ ।। मण्डलक्रमपूजायां सर्वं संपूर्णतां व्रजेत् । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु भैरव तत्त्वतः ।। २६ ।। श्रीक्रमं तु ततः पूज्य यथोक्तं श्रीकुलाग । तस्यावतारं संक्षेपात् पर्यङ्के सततं कुरु ।। २७ ।। मृगाजिने तु संकल्प्य आसने वाग्भवं शुभम् । श्रीखण्डचन्दनं शुद्ध कंकुमं चालिमिश्रितम् ॥ २८ ॥ 06 अभिमन्त्र्य च विद्यायाः क्रमं लिख्य त्रिधाविधम् । आद्यक्रमस्य वृद्धस्य¨ योगपीठं त्रिधोदितम् ।। २९ ।। तद्बाह्ये लिख्य ं षट्कोण ऐंकारेण तु वेष्टयेत् । अष्टारं पद्मकं बाह्ये मेखलात्रितयावृतम् ॥ ३० ॥ चतुष्कोण तु तद्बाह्ये संलिख्य च सुसूत्रितम् । ० षट्कोणचक्रसंयुक्त” कौमारस्य क्रमं लिखेत् ।। ३१ ।। अष्टारपद्मसंयुक्त क्रमं बालक्रमस्य च । एवं ते क्रमभेदोऽयं मण्डलस्य प्रकाशितम् ।। ३२ ।।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN 169 Once one has made the mind full (and satisfied) according to one's means, one should make the offering of a flame (ārātrika), sandalwood and a lamp along with the substance of the Heroes, and salute (the maSÆala) with a full-length prostration. The man of sound intellect should prostrate the full length (of his body, as straight as) a stick three or five times. (22-23) Having circumabulated it a hundred times, one should worship the teacher's sandals. The wise man should always observe this, the rule of (right) conduct. (24) By observing it (he gets) success (siddhi); otherwise, (if he fails to do so), he goes to hell. (He should perform this ritual) on the lunar days sacred to the lineages (oliparva) and in the course of the regular and occasional rites. Through the rite of worship (krama) of the maSÆala everything is perfectly fulfilled. (25-26ab) The KramamaSÆala O Bhairava, now I will expound the next (teaching) as, in truth, it is. Listen. The Śrīkrama should be worshipped next, as explained in the scripture of the Śrīkula. You should always perform (the rite of) its descent onto the pedastal (parya‰ka) (of the maSÆala).11 (26cd-27) One must first fashion the auspicious Vāgbhava (AI¤) on a seat made of deerskin with pure sandalwood (paste) and vermillion mixed with wine. (28) Having invoked and written the threefold transmission (krama) of the Vidyā, (next comes) the Sacred Seat of Yoga (yogapī˜ha)12 of the first sequence, which is that of the Aged, and which has manifest (udita) threefold.13 (Then,) having drawn a hexagon outside it, (the Point) should be enveloped with the syllable AI¤.14 (29-30ab) Outside (the hexagon) is a lotus of eight rays encompassed by three round enclosing lines (mekhala) and, outside that, a well-formed square should be drawn. (30cd-31ab) Having done that, one must draw the Transmission of the Youth, in conjunction with the wheel of the hexagon and the sequence of the Transmission of the Child in conjunction with the lotus with eight rays. In this way, this division of the Kramas of the maSÆala has been revealed to you. (31cd-32)

sanskrit: 170 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ८७ न्यासभेदं यथा ँ देव वृद्धकौमारबालकें“ । प्रथमः” शब्दराशिस्तु द्वितीया मालिनी तथा ॥ ३३ ॥ विद्यात्रितयमेवं तु तदङ्गानि चतुर्थकम् । अघोर्यष्टकमेवं तु तथा सिद्धाङ्गपञ्चकम् ।। ३४ ॥ षोढान्यासमिदं कृत्वा पश्चाद् यजनमारभेत् । .९२ वृद्धक्रमस्य” ज्येष्ठस्य न्यासावरणमुत्तमम् ।। ३५ ।। अथ मध्यमसिद्धस्य कौमारस्य यथाक्रमम् । प्रथमं तद्ग्रह क्षेत्रं द्वितीयं बीजपञ्चकम् ।। ३६ ॥ द्वादशाङ्गं तृतीयं च सिद्धाङ्गं च चतुर्थकम् । पञ्चमं तु षडङ्गं स्यात् पीठन्यासं तु षष्ठकम् ।। ३७ ।। खेचर सप्तमं नाम कृत्वा यजनमारभेत् । अथ तृतीयकं वक्ष्ये“ क्रमस्यावरणं पुनः ।। ३८ ॥ प्रथमा समया विद्या सिद्धाङ्गं च द्वितीयकम् । तृतीयं तु षडङ्गं स्यात्” श्लोकानि तु चतुर्थकम् ॥ ३९ ॥ पञ्चमं चाधिकार” स्यात् षष्ठं क्षेत्रपरिग्रहम् । सप्तमं रत्नविन्यासं विद्यान्यासं तथाष्टमम् ।। ४० ।। एवं न्यासक्रमं न्यस्य पश्चाद् बालक्रमं यजेत् । क्रमाणां मण्डलं ज्ञात्वा एकचक्रे तु पश्चिमे ।। ४१ ।। सिद्धाङ्गं च षडङ्गं च द्वावेतौ तु विशोधयेत् ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN 171 The Depositions of the Three Transmissions O god, (I will now tell you) of the various depositions (to be performed in the Transmissions) of the Aged, the Youth and the Child.15 (33ab) The Depositions of the Transmission of the Aged 1) The first is that of the Assembly of Sounds, 2) the second is Mālinī, 3) then the triple Vidyās and 4) its limbs as the fourth, 5) the Octad of Aghorī and 6) the Pentad of the Limbs of the Siddhas.16 (33cd-34) Once one has performed this sixfold deposition (noÆhānyāsa), one should commence the sacrifice. (This), the covering of the deposition of the Transmission of the Aged — namely, that of the Eldest (jyen˜ha) — is the best. (35) The Depositions of the Transmission of the Youth Now, in due order, comes (the Transmission) of the middle Siddha, that of the Youth. 1) The first is (the deposition of) the field of Tadgraha, 2) the second is the Five Seeds, 3) the Twelve-limbed is the third, 4) the Body of the Siddhas is the fourth, 5) the fifth is the Six Limbs (naÆa‰ga) while 6) the Deposition of the Sacred Seats is the sixth. And having performed the seventh, namely 7) that of the Skyfarer, commence the sacrifice.17 (36-38ab) The Depositions of the Transmission of the Child Now, again, I will tell (you) the third sphere (āvaraSa) of the Transmission. The first is the Samayā (Vidyā). The second is the Body of the Siddhas. The third is the Six-limbed. The (Twelve) Verses is the fourth. The fifth is (the Triple) Authority. The sixth is the Enclosure of the Field. The seventh is the deposition of the (Five) Jewels, while the eighth is the deposition of the Vidyā.18 Having deposited the sequence of the depositions (nyāsakrama) in this way, one should afterwards offer sacrifice to the Transmission of the Child. (38cd-41ab) Having learned the maSÆala of the Transmissions within the one Wheel of the Western (Kula), one should purify these two, namely, the Limb of the Siddhas and the Six-limbed. (41cd-42ab)

sanskrit: 172 कुमारिकाखण्ड: विश्वामित्रकपालं तु सुसिद्धं योगिनां शुभम् ।। ४२ ।। पीठाग्रे द्रव्यसंपूर्णं व्रतीनां नृकपालकम् । कोङ्कणास्त्रेण संशोध्य कवचेनावगुण्ठयेत् ।। ४३ ।। मूर्ति प्रविश्य हृदये नेत्रे षण्मुखमाहरेत् । शिखासान्निध्यकरणं संपूर्णं तु शिरेण तु ॥ ४४ ॥ एवं षड्विधसंस्कार मूलविद्या नियोजयेत् । योनिमुद्रा महामुद्रा तयासौ मुद्रितो भवेत् ।। ४५ ।। । अवतारं ततो देव करालाख्य नियोजयेत् । मूलविद्या त्रिधा जप्त्वा सान्निध्यं क्रममण्डले ॥ ४६ ॥ अपरं द्वितीय पात्र चन्दनामृतपूरितम् । ११८ पञ्चकाद्येन” संस्थाप्य पुनस्तेनाभिमन्त्रितम् ॥ ४७ ॥ अथ तृतीयकं पात्रं स्थापित” रत्नपञ्चके । तेन यष्ट्वा पुनस्तत्र दक्षिणोत्तरमध्यतः ।। ४८ ॥ एवं पात्रत्रयं पूर्वं कृत्वा पूजा समारभेत् । १२३ चन्दनेन तु विन्यासं विद्याया आत्मसन्ततौ ।। ४९ ॥ भकारादिचकारान्तं स्थाने स्थाने पृथक् पृथक् । आत्मानं धूपितं कुर्याद् विन्यासं मूलविद्यया ।। ५० ।। अङ्गन्यासं समारभ्य स्व - ओल्या तु यथाक्रमम् । १२४
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN 173 The Worship of the Transmission (kramārcana) The First Vessel — the Skull 19A coconut in place of a skull (viśvāmitrakapāla) is auspicious for yogis and is easily available (susiddha). For those who observe the Vow, a human skull (should be placed) in front of the maSÆala,20 well filled with the sacrificial substances. (42cd-43ab) It should be enveloped with the Armour once it has been purified with the Weapon of Ko‰kaSa and, having introduced the Form (mūrti) (of the deity) into the Heart,21 one should bring (Va˜uka) the Six-faced One22 into the (third) eye. The invocation23 of the Topknot (śikhā) is completed by means of the Head. (43cd-44) (Once performed) the sixfold purification (saˆskāra) in this way, one should apply the root Vidyā. (The adept) is sealed with the Great Gesture (mahāmudrā), that is, with the Gesture of the Yoni (yonimudrā).24 (45) Then, O god, one should apply the ‘descent’ (avatāra) called Karāla. Once (one has) repeated the root Vidyā three times, the presence (of all the mantras) (sānnidhya) (is established) within the KramamaSÆala. (46) The Second Vessel The other, that is, the second vessel, is filled with the nectar of sandalwood (oil) once it has been installed with the first group of five (mantras) and, again, invoked with those same (mantras). (47) The Third Vessel Now the third vessel is placed on the Five Jewels once offerings have been made there, again on the right, on the left and in the middle. (48) Once the three vessels have been prepared in this way, one should commence the rite of adoration (pūjā). (49ab) The Vidyā is deposited onto one's own lineage with sandalwood paste. The letters Bha to Ca (of the root Vidyā are placed) individually in (their own) particular place. Having begun the deposition of the limbs in due order within one's own lineage (oli), one should offer incense to the Self and (perform) the deposition with the root Vidyā (49cd-51ab)

sanskrit: 174 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तिलतैलाष्टदीपानि २५ पञ्चाद्येन प्रदीपयेत् ॥ ५१ ॥ दिग्विदिक्षु च पीठस्य अधिवासमनन्तरम् । १२७ चन्दनं धूपसौगन्धकुंकुमाक्षतसंयुतम् ।। ५२ । मूलमन्त्रस्य सिद्धस्य कुर्याद् दान २८ च सन्ततौ । । मुद्रात्रितयं कृत्वादौ ततः पूजां समारभेत् ।। ५३ ॥ पूर्वक्रमेण कर्तव्यं देहस्थं क्रमपूजनम् । पश्चाद् बाह्ये तु पीठस्थं सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं क्रमम् ।। ५४ ॥ १२९ चन्दनाक्षतसंमिश्रैरादौ ” कुर्यात् क्रमार्चनम् । १३० श्वेतपुष्पैः सुगन्धैश्च तैस्तु पूज्यं कुलक्रमम् ।। ५५ ।। अभावाद् रक्तपुष्पैस्तु तथा पीतैः सुगन्धिभिः । सुमनाचम्पकैः पद्मैस्तथा नीलोत्पलैः शुभैः ॥ ५६ ॥ देशाचारेण लब्धैस्तु तैस्तु पूज्यं कुलक्रमम् । १३३ निर्गन्धैश्च सकण्टकैर्भग्नैः ३४ संकुचितैर्द्रुमैः ॥ ५७ ॥ क्रमपूजा न कर्तव्या मनसापि सुरेश्वर । १३७ धूपार्चनं पुनश्चैव पृथक् ७ आज्ञाक्रमं पुनः ॥ ५८ ॥ अलिपूजा ततः कार्या वैष्णवीपदमात्रत: । १३८ प्रत्यय” व्याकुलं तत्र महाराव ः प्रवर्तते ।। ५९ ।। सान्निध्यमतुलं चोग्रं पशूनां च भयावहम् । १४० मूलमन्त्रेण विद्याया वामपाण्यक्षसूत्रकम् ।। ६० ।। स्फाटिकं पुत्रजीवं वा मात्रा अष्टोत्तरं शतं । १४२ द्विमात्रां वा त्रिमात्रा” वा इच्छया वा मनीषिणाम् ।। ६१ ।। स्थूल वा सूक्ष्ममणि वा न मेरु लङ्घयेत् क्वचित् ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN 175 After the preliminary purification (adhivāsa), one should, with the first group of five mantras,25 light eight lamps of sesame oil in the primary and secondary directions (around) the maSÆala (pī˜ha).26 (51cd-52ab) One should make an offering to the lineage (santati) of the accomplished root mantra of sandalwood along with vermillion, fragrant with incense and unbroken grains of rice. (52cd-53ab) Having first made the three gestures,27 one should commence the rite of adoration. One should perform the worship of the Transmission (kramapūjana) in the body in accord with the previous rite (pūrvakrama). Then (one should worship) the internal and external Transmission externally, in the sacred seat. (53cd-54) One should first perform the worship of the Transmission (kramārcana) with mixtures of sandalwood paste and unbroken rice grains. One should worship the Kulakrama with white and fragrant flowers. (55) If there are none, (one may do so) with red or yellow sweet-smelling flowers and with beautiful campaka flowers and auspicious (red) and blue lotuses. One should worship the Kulakrama with those (flowers) obtained according to the common practice of the place. (56-57ab) O Lord of the gods, one should not worship the Transmission even mentally with flowers that are without smell, that have thorns and sharp points, or that are bent or wilted. (57cd-58ab) One (should) again worship with incense and (then) (worship) the Transmission of the Command separately. Then the liquor should be worshipped (alipūjā) with the word ‘vainSavī’.28 (This) stimulates realisation (pratyaya) and the Great Sound (mahārāva) (of Ultimate Reality) arises there. By means of the root mantra of the Vidyā, (the adept experiences) an unequalled proximity (sānnidhya) (to the deity) which, for fettered souls, is terrible and frightening. (58cd-60abc) The Rosary of the Hand The left hand can serve as a rosary;29 otherwise (one can use a rosary made of) crystal or Putraˆjīva.30 (A single) measure (of the rosary consists of) 108 (beads). (It may be) of double or triple measure as the wise desire. Whether the beads are big or small, one should not cross over the Meru in any circumstance (kvacit).31 (60d-62ab)

sanskrit: 176 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १४७ अंगुष्ट वर्जयित्वा तु यथा प्राप्त चतुष्टयम् ।। ६२ ।। मध्यमौ द्वौ तथा वज्यौं” वामावर्तपरिभ्रमात् । १४८ एतत्“” पाणिकृतं जप्यं अक्षसूत्रेण वा कृतम् ।। ६३ ॥ चूलाग्रममलं शुद्धं उपरिस्थमक्षमालया । । तं च५२ मेरुं विजानीयाल्लङ्घनान्नरकं व्रजेत् ।। ६४ ॥ वामावर्तक्रमेणैव १५३ सद्योजातं विधीयते । तदारूह्य परं ध्यानं मन्त्रं वापि च मुक्तिदम् ॥ ६५ ॥ १५८ स्व–ओल्यामात्मपीठस्य ५५ आत्मानं ६ मण्डलेऽपि वा । मन्त्रत्रिष्कोणमध्ये तु अथवा पूर्णविद्यायाम् ॥ ६६ ॥ द्विचत्वारिंशत्संज्ञायां जप्यं ध्यानं त्रिकोणके । १५९ कुर्यात् तन्मानसं जप्यं आत्मकूटमथापि वा ॥ ६७ ॥ मुद्रितं योनिमुद्रायाममानामाङ्कित शिवम् । आदौ तन्मूलविद्याया अग्निकुण्डस्य मध्यतः ॥ ६८ ॥ ध्यानमारक्तकृष्णं तु कुर्यात् कर्मानुरूपतः । ऊध्वमध्यमधः कुर्यात् संस्कारं च तथा पुनः ।। ६९ ।। मम योनिगतं ध्यायेन्न बाह्ये विनियोजयेत् । इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे १ अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे'१२ स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रम– भाषिते'३ क्रममण्डलगुरुमण्डलाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। २७ ।। १६४
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN 177 Omitting the thumb, one reaches the fourth (finger). Similarly, the two middle (fingers) should be omitted while moving in an anticlockwise direction.32 This is (the way mantra is) repeated with the hand or by means of a rosary. (62cd-63) Know that the Meru is the stainless and pure peak of the crest (cūlāgra) that is at the top of the rosary. By crossing over it, one goes to hell. (64) By moving (through the rosary) in an anticlockwise sequence, one attains Sadyojāta. Mounting up to him, (one achieves) supreme meditation (dhyāna) and the mantra bestows liberation. (65) One should practice the repetition of mantra and meditation (dhyāna) in the Triangle in one's own lineage (oli) of one's own sacred seat and of the Self (ātman) in the maSÆala. (This should be done) in the middle of the triangle of mantra or in the complete Vidyā33 called that of the forty-two (syllables). (66-67ab) Alternatively, one may perform the same mental recitation of the Peak (seed-syllable) of the Self.34 Śiva is sealed and marked with (the energy of the Vidyā) called the New Moon (amā) within the Gesture of the Yoni (yonimudrā). (67cd-68ab) Initially, in the middle of the heart, one should meditate on the root Vidyā which is light red or dark blue according to the work (karman). Then one should perform the purifying sacrament (saˆskāra) above, in the middle and below. One should meditate on (all this) as being within my Yoni. (This meditation) should not be directed outside. (68cd-70ab) This is the (twenty-seventh) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description of the authority of the MaSÆala of the Teachers (gurumaSÆala) and the MaSÆala of the Transmission (kramamaSÆala). It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with ‘KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: अष्टाविंशानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच श्रुतं देवि मया सर्वं पूजाविधि' यथाक्रमम् । अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि क्रममेकं त्रिधा कथं ॥ १ ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच शृणु नाथ प्रवक्ष्यामि क्रममेकं त्रिधा यथा । ओलित्रितयभेदेन बालकौमारवृद्धकें ।। २ ।। - वृद्धक्रमं तु प्रथमं ज्येष्ठ ओलिक्रमागतम्' । मन्त्रिणां तु यथा देव आयातं ज्ञाननिर्णयम् ॥ ३ ॥ पीठानामाद्यवर्णाश्च ओजापूकाचतुष्टयम् । ते युगानि चत्वारस्ते पीठानि ऐहिकीभुवि ॥ ४॥ ते च पञ्चमहाभूताश्चतुव्यापकसंयुताः । ॐकारादिक्रमेणैव व्योमतत्त्वादितः क्रमात् ।। ५ ॥ ॐकार व्योमतत्त्वस्थं जाकार तेजसि स्थितम् । पूकारमापतत्त्वस्थ काका पृथिवीगतम् ।। ६ ॥ १८ कुर्याच्छक्तिमधस्तेषां अधः शक्त्याङ्गसंस्थया” । २२ तेषामधोगतं पार्थं आपो दण्डश्च मालिनी ॥ ७ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-EIGHT The Authority of the Triple Transmission Preamble Śrīnātha said: O goddess, I have heard the entire method by which the rite of adoration should be performed in due order. Now I want to hear how (it is that) the one Transmission is threefold. (1) The venerable (goddess) said: O Lord, listen, I will explain how the one Transmission is threefold according to the division of the three lineages (oli) within (the Transmissions of the) Child, the Youth and the Aged.1 (2) The Transmission of the Aged The Group of Four Sacred Seats The first is the Transmission of the Aged, which has come through the Transmission of the Lineage of the Eldest (jyen˜hā). O god, it is how the teaching of the knowledge of those who recite mantra has came down (through the transmission of the Tantra). (3) The initial letters of the sacred seats are the four O, JĀ, PŪ and KĀ. These, your four sacred seats, are the (four) Ages here in the world. (4) And the five Great Elements are endowed with these four pervading (seats). Thus, (all five) beginning with Space (vyomatattva) (correspond), in due order, to the (the sacred seat of) O¤2 and the rest. (5) The (sacred seat of) O¤ is established in Space, JĀ (i.e. Jālandhara) resides in Fire (tejas), PŪ (i.e. PūrSagiri) is in Water while KĀ (i.e. Kāmarūpa) is in Earth.3 (6) Place Energy (śakti) below them by means of the energy that resides in the lower limb. Below them (all) is the Earth, (then comes) Water, the Stick (daSÆa) and Mālinī. (7)

sanskrit: 180 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २७ एवं पीठाश्चतुर्भिन्ना लाञ्छिता चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । आज्ञा मूर्ध्नि कृता ह्येषा ख्याता” पीठचतुष्टयम् ॥ ८ ॥ तेषां” चतुर्विधं ध्यानं वक्ष्ये” आत्मगतं प्रिय ै । अघोरसदृशोद्याण” जाकार पुरुषं विदुः ॥ ९ ॥ ३७ पूकारं वामदेवं तु काकारं” सद्यरूपकम् । अन्तरङ्गे स्थिता देव्यो” भ्रूमध्ये हृदि नाभिगाः ।। १० ।। योनिमध्ये समाख्यातास्तेषु ” देव्याचतुष्टयम् । ककारादिषु चत्वारः स्त्रीनपुंसकभेदिताः ।। ११ । पीठेश्वर्य: ५ समाख्याताः पीठध्यानसमायुताः । तेषु सिद्धाश्च चत्वारः पूज्याः पीठचतुष्टये ॥ १२ ॥ हरशब्दश्चतुन्यास हरशब्दश्चतुष्टयम्” । आद्यदीर्धैश्चतुर्भिन्नं” आज्ञायाः” शिखराङ्कितम् ।। १३ ॥ पीठबीजाश्च चत्वारः” ध्यानं तेषां च पूर्ववत् । ५३ ५४ अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि व्योमपञ्चकनिर्णयम् ॥ १४ ॥ व्योम तु पञ्चधा स्थाप्य शक्त्याधस्तेजबृंहितम् । दीर्घपञ्चकसंभिन्नं बिन्दुनादैरलंकृतम् ।। १५ ।। व्योमपञ्चकमेतद्धि ध्यानं तेषामघोरवत् । आज्ञासंक्रामकं देव तस्य मन्त्रक्रमं भवेत् ।। १६ ।। ५८ ये चोक्ता व्यापका : पञ्च तेजोरूपा महाबलाः । ६१ तेषां स्थानानि° वै पञ्च अस्मिन् शास्त्रे प्रचक्ष्महे ॥ १७ ॥ श्रोत्रे नासापुटे वक्त्रे ज्ञातव्यं व्योमपञ्चकम् । ६३ पृथिवी चापतत्त्वं तु तेजो वायुः खसंज्ञकम् ॥ १८ ॥ ६४ शक्तितत्त्वं तथा षष्ठं तेषां चैवाधो रविः ।
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-EIGHT 181 Divided thus into the four sacred seats and marked within the Sun (Ha) and Moon (Sa), this, the Command placed on the head, is said to be the four sacred seats. (8) O dear one, I will now tell (you about) their visualized form (dhyāna) within myself. UdyāSa is similar to Aghora. Know that JĀ (i.e. Jālandhara) is Puruna (i.e. Tatpuruna). (9) PŪ (i.e. PurSagiri) is Vāmadeva, while KĀ (i.e. Kāmarūpa) is Sadya (i.e. Sadyojyota). The goddesses reside within them. They are said to be between the eyebrows, in the heart, in the navel and in the Yoni. The four goddesses are in these (places). The four, divided into neuter and female, are in (the sacred seats) KĀ (i.e. Kāmarūpa) and the rest.4 (10-11) They are said to be the mistresses of the sacred seats (pi˜heśvarī) and are associated with the visualization (dhyāna) of the sacred seats. Four Siddhas are to be worshipped within these four sacred seats. (12) (Their mantra is) the word HARA, the fourfold deposition, (again) the word HARA and the group of four conjoined with the four long (vowels) beginning with Ā and marked with the Crest of the Command5 along with the four seed (syllables).6 Their visualized form (dhyāna) is as before. (13-14ab) The Pentad of Space Next I will explain the teaching concerning the Pentad of Space (vyomapañcaka). Having already established Space five times, it is augmented with the Brilliance (tejas) located below Energy, conjoined with the pentad of long (vowels) and adorned with Sound and the Point.7 (14cd-15) This, indeed, is the pentad of Space. Its visualized form is like that of Aghora.8 O god, its sequence of mantras (mantrakrama) transmits (saˆkrāmaka) the Command.9 (16) The aforementioned five pervading (seed-syllables) consist of brilliant energy (tejas) and are very powerful. Their locations are five and we will tell (you where they are) in this scripture. One should know that the Pentad of Space is in the ears, nostrils and the mouth. (17-18ab) The Hexad of the Command (The hexad is comprised of) Earth (Va), Water (La), Fire (tejas) (Ra), Air (Ya), that (which is) called Space (Ha) with Energy (śaktitattva) (Sa) as the sixth and the Sun (Ha) below. (18cd-19ab)

sanskrit: 182 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तथा तद् वायुतत्त्वं च नादाक्षरविभेदितम् ॥ १९ ॥ बिन्दुस्थं नादशक्तिस्थं आज्ञाकूट महेश्वर । ६७ गुदे योनौ तथा नाभौ हृदि कण्ठे भ्रुवोन्तरे ॥ २० ॥ एतेषां कथितं षट्कं संकेतेन च षड्विधम् । श्वेता ँ च प्रथमा वर्तिर्द्वितीया” पीतरूपिनी ।। २१ ।। तृतीया नीलवणी च चतुर्थी हरिता भवेत् । ७४ पञ्चमा३ गैरिकाभा च षष्ठी आरक्तवर्णिका ॥ २२ ॥ पञ्चकं चापरं वक्ष्ये महन्तायी मनोहरम् । हंसेति ँ पञ्चधा स्थाप्य अ- इ - उ –ए– ओसमन्वितम् ।। २३ ।। नादशक्तिसमाक्रान्त” महन्तार्याश्च पञ्चकम् । कुक्षिभ्या ं स्तनयोर्मध्ये कुर्यात् पृष्ठेऽपि कारकं ।। २४ ।। श्वेतं पीतं च आरक्तं हरितं गणपञ्चकम् । ८७ ८४ ध्यान वै पञ्चधा तेषां त्रिकमध्ये यथा भवेत् ।। २५ ।। त्रिकण्टकं समाख्यातं विद्यात्रितयमभ्यसेत् । आधारे हृदये तूर्ये तेषां स्थानत्रय भवेत् ।। २६ ।। आरक्तं प्रथमं ध्यानं द्वितीयं पीतकं भवेत् । ९२ तृतीयं शुद्धधवल सत्त्वराजसतामसम् ।। २७ ।। •९४ सप्ताविंशतिभेदैस्तु” मन्त्रक्रमं समुद्धृतम् । तस्य संज्ञाक्रमं वक्ष्ये साम्प्रतं शृणु भैरव ।। २८ ।। ओजापूकाचतुष्कं तु कापूजा – ओचतुष्टयम्” । प्रकट पीठदेवस्य मन्त्रपीठे निरन्तरम् ।। २९ ।। ९६
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-EIGHT 183 Then that Air principle, conjoined with the letter (denoted by) Sound, established in the Point and the energy of Sound, O Great Lord, is the Peak (syllable) of the Command. (19cd-20ab) (They are located) in the anus, the Yoni, the navel, the heart, the throat and between the eyebrows. (Thus) their group of six has (thus) been explained according to the sixfold convention. (20cd-21ab) The first wick (varti) is white, the second is yellow, the third blue, the fourth green, the fifth brown and the sixth is light red. (21cd-22) The Pentad called Beginningless I will tell (you) of another pentad, namely, the beautiful one of (the Vidyā) of Mahantārī. First establish HA¤SA five times along with A, I, U, E and O and conjoin it with Sound: this is the pentad of Mahantārī. (23-24ab) One should establish the (mantra’s) agent (kāraka) in the two armpits, between the breasts and also on the back. The pentad of the group is white, yellow, light red and green. Their visualized form is (thus) fivefold.10 . . . (24cd-25abc) The Triple Thorn . . . as it is in the midst of the Triad (trika). The Triple Thorn (trikaS˜haka) has been explained. It is the triple Vidyā that should be practiced. Their three locations are in the foundation, the heart and the skull (tūrya). The first visualized form is light red, the second yellow and the third pure white (corresponding) to sattva, rajas and tamas (respectively).11 (25d-27) The Conventions The sequence of mantras with (its) twenty-seven divisions has been explained. O Bhairava, I will now tell (you) (the corresponding) sequence of denotations (saˆjñākrama); listen. (28) The Group of Four Sacred Seats and Goddesses The tetrad O, JĀ, PŪ, KĀ and the four KĀ, PŪ, JĀ, O belong to the deity of the sacred seat and are clearly manifest without break in the sacred seat of mantra (mantrapī˜ha). (29)

sanskrit: 184 कुमारिकाखण्डः तेषां वै गुप्तनामानि अवि—मे—ते—असंज्ञया । मन्त्रदेव्यस्ततो देव तेषां नामचतुष्टयम् ।। ३० ॥ सममेति च साकार इति देव्याः परिग्रहम् । उपदेशवशेनैव पीठदेव्याः समर्चयेत् ।। ३१ ।। व्योमपञ्चकमेवं तु मन्त्रयुक्तं समभ्यसेत् ँ । १०३ तेषां वै देवता:“ पञ्च पूजाकाले प्रचक्ष्म ।। ३२ ।। व्योम तु पञ्चधा कुर्यात् तेषां पञ्चाधिकारकम् । कासिरेफसिये”” पञ्चसंयोगाद् व्योमपञ्चकम् ।। ३३ ॥ ११३ ततश्चाज्ञा भवेत् षट्कं गुप्ता ३ संज्ञा क्रमस्य वै । आज्ञाकुकारसंभिन्नं षड्विधं च नियोजयेत् ॥ ३४ ॥ तेष्वग्रे संगता देव्यो अधिकारक्रमे स्थिताः । लवरहयशः षड्भिः”“ संकेताश्च प्रकीर्तिताः ।। ३५ ।। ११८ ११९ तथा सिद्धाश्च चत्वारः पूर्वोक्तक्रमसंयुताः । । असन्ततिसु° पञ्चैतास्तेषा ” गुप्ताभिधानकम् ।। ३६ ॥ विषुव संक्रमणान्त अनादिपञ्चक्षेत्रकम् ' २२ १२४ । त्रिकं त्रिकण्टकादीनि ५ विद्यात्रितयभूषितम् ।। ३७ ।। १२७ । एकार च अकारं च ककार ७ च तृतीयकम् । एषां गुप्ताभिधानानि कु कु कु देवतात्रयम् ।। ३८ ॥ चतुष्कं पञ्चकं षट्कं चतुष्कं पञ्चकं त्रिकम् । एतानि षट्प्रकाराणि ” भेदानि सप्तविंशतिः १३१ ।। ३९ ॥
english: CHAPTER TWENTY-EIGHT 185 Their secret names are (indicated) by the terms AVI, ME, TE and A. O god, their four names are the goddesses of the mantra.
