(8) The ritual washing (proknaSa) (of the sacrificial area) should be done with (repetitions of the) Weapon of the Command and it should be enveloped (avaguS˜hana) with the Armour (of the goddess’s Vidyā).6 The uprooting (unmūlana) (of obstacles should be done) with the Eye and then with the Mahantārī (Vidyā). (The holes in the sacrificial area) are filled with (the mantra) in the Khecarīcakra (the Wheel of the Skyfaring Goddess) and it is levelled with Vāgbhavas (AI¤). It is sprinkled with (the mantra called) Candragarbha and pounded with Bhairava's will (AI¤). (9-10) It is cleaned with (repetitions of the syllable of) Supreme Bliss (AI¤) and smeared with the seed-syllables of the Vidyā. Ritual washing with invocation (proknaSāmantrana)7 and drying (śonaSa) should be done with the five sacred seats (that is, the Five PraSavas). (11) (Those two along with) ritual washing (proknaSa), envelopment (avaguS˜hana), uprooting (unmūlana), filling (prapūraSa), levelling (samīkaraSa), sprinkling (siñcana), pounding (ku˜˜ana), cleaning (saˆmārjana), smearing (lepana), washing (with invocation) (proknaSa) and drying (śonaSa) - these are the thirteen purifications (saˆskāra) (brought about) by the instrument (of mantra) that grants fearlessness. (12-13) (Even if) the four (divine) forms (mūrti) of the fire pit are functional, (if) the fire pit has not been purified here, it does not give success. (14) One should make the Aghora Weapon8 the seat there in the middle of the image (bimba). One should enounciate (AI¤) the Triangle, which is the world (bhuvana) of the Peak (syllable) with the Weapon of the Scalpel.9 (15)

sanskrit: 90 कुमारिकाखण्डः सूर्यकान्तिसमुद्भूत अथवा होमशालायाम् । आनयेदस्त्रराजेन वह्निं कपिलपिङ्गलम् ।। १६ ॥ आदौ शक्तिं समुत्थाप्य वाग्भवाकाररूपिणीम्” । रेचकेन परामुद्रां विनिवेश्य प्रसन्नधीः ।। १७ ॥ भगवत्या च देवेशि“ कुलवागीश्वरीक्रमम् । आदौ कृत्वावतारं तु विच्चेपादान्तसंस्थितम् ॥ १८ ॥ हृदाद्यङ्गेन सकला” वागीशी ” ज्ञानमण्डले ३ । स्थानशुद्धिं ततः कृत्वा तन्मध्ये लिङ्गमध्यसेत् ॥ १९ ॥ कूटमेकं पुरा कृत्वा ततो बीजमनन्तरम् । सृष्टिं सृष्टिगता कृत्वा चक्र योनिगत स्मरेत् ।। २० ।। तस्य मध्ये तु चैतन्यं यावत् पूर्वक्रमेण तु । । तदङ्गाज्जायते” सृष्टिर्भवते चानुवर्तिनी ।। २१ ।। एवं संपूज्य सकल ं पश्चात् कर्माणि होमयेत्” । आत्मा३ तेजोमयं ध्यात्वा शुक्रवत् वह्निमण्डले ।। २२ ।। तेजोरूपधरं बीजं गर्भे तस्य प्रवर्तते । कालाग्निरुद्रविख्यातं“ भैरवे सकले कृतम् ॥ २३ ॥ जायते च परे तत्त्वे परमानन्दभूषिते । चन्द्रगर्भेण संभूते गर्भाधानक्रमं भवेत् ।। २४ ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 91 One should bring the fire, red and tawny, born of the sun's beauty, into the pavilion of the fire sacrifice, by means of the king of weapons.10 (16) The Rites of Passage (saˆskāra) of the Fire Impregnation (garbhādhāna) First, Energy is generated in the form of the syllable Vāgbhava (AI¤) as the man of contented intellect forms the Supreme Gesture (parāmudrā) while exhaling the breath. (17) O mistress of the gods, once formed the Transmission (krama) of Kulavāgīśvarī11 with `bhagavati' in the beginning, the descent (of the Vidyā is completed) at the end of the word `vicce'. (18) Vāgīśī (Vidyā), with her energy (sakalā) and body (consisting of the six limbs) beginning with the Heart, is in the Circle of Knowledge (jñānamaSÆala). After the site has been purified, place the Li‰ga12 in the middle of it. (19) Having initially formed one Peak syllable (AI¤) and then (another) seed- syllable (AI¤) and (so) having placed Emanation (srn˜i) within Emanation, one should recollect the Wheel in the Yoni. (20) In accord with the previous liturgy (krama), Consciousness (caitanya) (HSKHPHRE¤) is in the centre of that.13 Emanation comes from that limb and it follows after it (and serves it) (anuvartinī). (21) After one has worshipped everything (sakala) in this way, one should offer (one's) actions to the fire. Once the Self which is radiant energy (and white) like sperm has been visualized in the Circle of Fire,14 the seed-syllable whose form is radiant energy (tejas) functions within its womb. (22-23ab) He who is called Kālāgnirudra is formed (in this way) within the differentiated (sakala) (form) of Bhairava. He arises within the Supreme Principle, which is adorned with Supreme Bliss (AI¤). Generated by the Womb of the Moon, (this) is the process (krama) of impregnation (garbhādhāna). (23cd-24)

sanskrit: 92 कुमारिकाखण्ड: त्रिराहुतीन्” हुनेदग्नौ” हृदयेन तु पूजयेत् । ९३ ततः प्रसवनं तस्य हृत्कूटेन परान्मुखात् ।। २५ ।। आहुतिभिस्त्रिभिः” कृत्वा शिखाबन्धेन पूजयेत् । ९७ सीमन्तोन्नयनं शक्त्या तदीकारसमायुतम् ।। २६ ।। आहुतिभिः” शिर पूज्य सीमन्तोन्नयन” भवेत् । सन्मुखीकरणं तस्य आहुतिभ्यां चतुष्कले ।। २७ ।। कवचेनार्चन कुर्यात् ततो निवृत्तिपञ्चकें । आहुतीनां समासेन नेत्रमन्त्रेण पूजयेत् ॥ २८ ॥ ततः कङ्कणकं केशैर्वामहस्ते तु सन्मतम् ँ । १०७ १०८ । विद्यास्त्रेण विशालाक्ष अतस्तत्त्वविनिर्णयम् ॥। २९ ।। पृठिव्यापस्तथा तेजो” वायुराकाशमेव च । १११ ११४ शब्द : स्पर्शो रसो रूपं गन्धस्तन्मात्रपञ्चकम् ।। ३० ।। वाक्पाणिपाद पायुश्च उपस्थ: कर्मपञ्चकम् । श्रोत्र त्वक् चक्षुषी जिह्वा घ्राणेति करणपञ्चकम् ।। ३१ ।। ११८ मनो बुद्धिरहंकारों रागो विद्या कला तथा । माया कामेश्वरीतत्त्वं शुद्धविद्या शिवाख्यं च ।। ३२ ।। आज्ञादेवी परावस्था द्वात्रिंशत्तत्त्वनिर्णयम्” ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 93 The Parting of the Hair (sīmāntonnayana) One should make three offerings into the fire and worship with the (seed- syllable of the) Heart. Then he is born (prasavana) from the supreme mouth by means of the Peak (syllable) of the Heart. (25) Having done (this) with three offerings to the fire, one should worship by tying the topknot. The parting of the hair (sīmantonnayana), conjoined with the the letter `Ī', is done by means of Energy. Having worshipped the head with offerings to the fire, (the sacrament of) the parting of the hair is (complete). (26-27ab) Placing the Disciple Before the Teacher (sanmukhīkaraSa) His placing before (the teacher) (sanmukhīkaraSa) (is done) by making two fire offerings within the four energies (catunkala). Then worship with the (mantra of the) Armour in the Pentad of Nivrtti. One should worship with the mantra of the Eye and (a few) brief fire offerings. It is agreed that then, O wide eyed one, (one should hold) a bracelet with hairs (of the head) in the left hand (and offer them) with the Weapon of the Vidyā. (27cd-29c) The Purification of the Newborn Child The Thirty-Two Principles Next (comes) the teaching concerning the principles. Earth, water, fire (tejas), air and space (these are the gross elements). Sound, touch, taste, form and smell — (this) is the pentad of the subtle elements. (29d-30) Speech, hands and feet, the genitals and the anus are the pentad of action. The pentad of the senses (consists of) the ear, skin, eyes, tongue and nose. (31) The mind, intellect and ego, attachment (rāga), (limited) knowledge (vidyā), (limited) power (of action) (kalā), Māyā, the principle of Kāmeśvarī, Pure Knowledge (śuddhavidyā) and (the Principle) called Śiva, the goddess who is the Command and the Supreme State — this is the teaching concerning the thirty-two principles.15 (32-33ab)

sanskrit: 94 कुमारिकाखण्डः आदौ बिन्दुयुता विद्या कालाग्निरुद्रमण्डले ।। ३३ ॥ वाषोऽर्थः१२३ रूणसंयोगात् २४ देवो २५ नादः सबिन्दुकः । महाबीजकर २६ बीजं बीजौघ तत् पुनः पुनः ॥ ३४ ॥ १२७ १३० ततः सूतकसंशुद्धिर्विद्यास्त्रेण” तथाहुति: । त्रिभिः क्रमेण कथिता मुमुक्षूणां विमुक्तये ॥ ३५ ॥ ३८ १३४ केशकंकणक मुक्त्वा अलिना भावित हुनेत् । तेनैव शुद्धिमाप्नोति तदा नामाभिषेचनम् ।। ३६ ।। १४३ कलिकाले कुचन्द्राख्य४२ द्वापरे षष्ठसंज्ञया' । त्रिते चर्याधरो वह्निः कृते मित्रो विधीयते ।। ३७ ।। एव सिद्धचतुष्केन अग्नित्व” प्राप्नुवानसि । आत्मामन्त्रचतुष्केन“ ं आहुतिभिस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः ।। ३८ ॥ संज्ञाकरणचत्वारि आदौ कृतचतुष्टये ५२ । १५१ दन्तानामुदय ५३ शोध्य ४ कवर्गेण तु पञ्चधा ।। ३९ ॥ बिन्दुभिर्देवदेवेश कर्तव्या आहुतिस्त्रिभिः । १५७ अन्नप्राशनमन्त्रेण“६ त्र्यक्षरेण तु होमयेत् ॥ ४० ॥ १५९ वाग्भवं नाममाश्रित्य जुहुयादाहुतित्रयम् । आहुतिभिस्त्रिभिश्चान्यैर्विद्युज्जिह्वा गरीयसी ॥। ४१ ।। चूडाकरणमित्युक्तं यत् सुरैरपि दुर्लभम् ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 95 Initially, the Vidyā, conjoined with the Point, is in the Circle of Kālāgnirudra (K±a).16 VA±A, conjoined with RŪ¦A and the god of the Sound along with the Point. (This is) the seed-syllable that generates the Great Seed- syllable. (One should repeat) the current of seed-syllables again and again. (33cd-34) Then the newborn child is purified by means of the Weapon of the Vidyā along with three offerings to the fire. This (purification) has been explained in due order to liberate those who desire liberation. (35) By this same (rite) one attains purity (śuddhi). (In order to do this) one should, omitting the hair and the bracelet,17 make an offering to the fire sanctified with liquor. (36abc) The Consecration of the Name Then comes the consecration of the name. The one called Kucandra(nātha)18 belongs to the Age of Strife. (He goes) by the name of ±an˜ha(nātha) in the Dvāpara Age, in the third Age the fire bears (the form of) Caryā(nātha) and Mitra is (the name) enjoined in the Krta Age.19 (37) In this way, you have attained the status of fire along with the four Siddhas by means of their four mantras20 and three offerings to the fire (for each one). (38) The First Feeding of Solid Food (annaprāśana) First (one should utter) the four names that serve as the instruments (of mantra) in the four (Ages) (beginning with) Krta. The arising of the dental (letters) should be purified five times with (the five) gutturals.21 (39) O god of the gods, the offering to the fire should be made with three drops. One should make the offering to the fire with the three-lettered mantra of the (first) feeding of solid food (annaprāśana). (40) The Tonsure (cūÆākarman) One should make three offerings to the fire of Vāgbhava in association with the name (of the Siddha). With another three offerings to the fire (the goddess) Vidyujjihvā (Lightning Tongue) is (lauded as) the greatest.22 Thus the (sacramental) Tonsure (cūÆākaraSa), which is hard to acquire even by the gods, has been explained. (41-42ab)

sanskrit: 96 कुमारिकाखण्ड: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि मेखलासूत्रतबन्धनम् ।। ।। ४२ ।। व्यापकादिचतुष्कं तु संहार ३ बिन्दुसंयुतम् । मन्त्रेण पञ्चधा हुत्वा सन्निधानाय योगिनीम् ।। ४३ ।। उपनयनसर्वस्व शोध्यमध्वनि तत्पुरे १६७ हृच्चक्रे व्रतबन्ध तु वह्निबीजे त्रितीयके हुत्वाचार्यो हुनेन्मन्त्री नवात्मानन्दभैरवम् ७१ १७० ।। ॥ ४४ ॥ । व्रतनिष्पत्तिसंसिद्धयै योगेश्वर विशोधयेत् ।। ४५ ।। आदौ मायापुरी बन्ध संहार दीर्घबिन्दुना । गर्भीधानादिक' कुर्यात् संस्कारकृतकर्मणि ।। ४६ ।। चतुर्भिश्चाष्टभिः” सर्व तद्ध्यानेन तु होमयेत् । रुद्रैः परिवृतो मन्त्री पञ्चाक्षरविभूषितः ।। ४७ ।। निरालम्बगतश्चोध्वं वह्निर्वै खेचराज्ञया । १८३ १८२ ब्रह्मविद्याधरः श्रीमान् होमयेद् ब्रह्मविद्यया ।। ४८ ।। आदौ शक्तिसमूहेन खेचरान्तमनुक्रमात् । तावद् विद्याक्रमे होम संस्कारेण यथागतम् ।। ४९ ॥ ब्रह्मविष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च ईश्वरश्च सदाशिव: १८७ । पञ्चेते“ सृष्टिकर्तीर: पञ्चार्णेन तु पूजयेत् ।। ५० ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 97 The Investiture of the Sacred Thread (upanayana) Now I will explain the investiture of the thread of the girdle (mekhalāsūtrabandhana).23 (The girdle is) the group of four, consisting of the Pervasive One (vyāpakā) and the rest, Withdrawal conjoined with the Point.24 Having made the offering to the fire five times with the mantra in order to (invite) the Yoginī to be present (sannidhāna), the whole of the sacred thread (upanayana) should (then) be purified on the Path in that place (pura). (42cd-44ab) The vow is sealed (vratabandha) in the Wheel of the Heart within the seed-syllable of fire25 which is the third. Once the teacher has made a fire offering he, the reciter of mantra, should make a fire offering to Ānandabhairava of the Navātman (mantra). O Lord of Yoga, one should purify (it) in order to successfully complete the vow. (44cd-45) Impregnation and the other (rites) should be performed. When (these) rites of passage (saˆskāra) have been completed, one should offer everything to the fire with four and eight (offerings) along with that visualization. (46-47ab) The Purification of the Fire Pit The Offering to the Fire with the Five PraSavas and Location in the Directions The reciter of mantra, adorned with the five-syllable (mantra),26 is surrounded by the Rudras. By the Command (of Śiva) who is the Skyfarer (khecara), the fire is freed from the support (to which it is attached) and (travels) upwards.27 The venerable (adept) who possesses the Brahmā Vidyā (AI¤)28 should make fire offerings with the Brahmā Vidyā. (47cd-48) Beginning with (AI¤), the aggregate of energies (śaktisamūha)29 and ending with the Skyfarer30 (KHPHRE¤), in due order, such is the fire offering in the Vidyākrama31 along with the rites of passage (saˆskāra) as it has come (down through the tradition). (49) Brahmā, VinSu, Rudra, Īśvara and Sadāśiva - these five are the authors of emanation and should be worshipped with the five-syllable (mantra).32 (50)

sanskrit: 98 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ब्रह्मा दक्षिणमूर्ती तु विष्णुरुत्तरतः” स्थितः । १९२ १९३ रुद्र: ९९ पश्चिमदिग्भागे ईश्वर : पूर्वसन्ततौ ।। ५१ ।।95 सदाशिवो ९६ भगस्यान्ते पिण्डमेको हि पञ्चधा । ब्रह्मनः शुष्कगोमय“ आसनं विष्टरेण तु ।। ५२ ।। तिलपिण्डिकया विष्णोः रुद्रस्यासनमागमम् २०० २०१ १९९ २०२ । शिरोध्वे ईश्वरस्यात्र द्रव्यासनं सदाशिवे ॥ ५३ ॥ विष्टरेषु पुरा कृत्वा पञ्चमूर्तिधरो भवेत् । बाह्यतो०३ लोकपालान् च २४ पूर्वादीशानमन्तगान् ॥ ५४ ॥ पूजयेदस्त्रविधिना रक्षाकुण्डस्य संस्कृते । २०८ इन्द्रमग्निर्यमो रक्षो वरुणो वायुरेव च ।। ५५ ।। कुवेरमीशपर्यन्ता: २९ पूजनीया यथाक्रमम् । •२११ २१२ २१० २१६ । २१४ वज्रं?” शक्त्यायुधं दण्डं नागेन्द्र कुण्डलं ध्वजम् ।। ५६ ।। मुद्गरं १५ च त्रिशूलं च अष्टमं समुदाहृतम् । मायाश्रीमादितः” कृत्वा पादं ततोऽभिधीयते' २१८ २१९ ॥ ५७ ॥ ऊध्वं ब्रह्मा अधो विष्णुः पद्मचक्रायुधद्वयम् । एवं संपूज्य यत्नेन सर्वविघ्नव्यपोहनम् ॥ ५८ ।। ज्वलनं दीपनं चैव वेधनं त्रासनं २२५ .२२२ •२२३ परम् । २२४ २२६ अमलीकरणाप्यायं ५ अभिषेक च सन्मुख्यम्) २२८ २२९ प्रकृत्यानलसंस्कारा अष्टाभिः पूर्वशासने । २३० २३१ २२७ ॥ ५९ ॥ एतैः प्रजुह्वते वह्निजीयते मुखपञ्चकम् ।। ६० ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 99 Brahmā is in the southern image (mūrti).33 VinSu is in the north. Rudra is in the western quarter. Īśvara is in the eastern family (santati),34 while Sadāśiva is within the Yoni (in the centre). (Thus) the one aggregate (piSÆa) is fivefold. (51-52ab) Brahmā's seat is made of dry cow dung, VinSu’s (seat) with a ball of sesame seed. Rudra's seat is the scripture. Īśvara's (seat) is above the head,35 while a seat made of (sacrificial) substances (dravya) (is prepared) for Sadāśiva. First of all, (they are placed) on seats of Kuśa grass (vin˜ara).36 (In this way, the sacrificial area) possesses the five (divine) forms (mūrti).37 (52cd-54ab) The Guardians of the Quarters The guardians of the quarters are outside (located in the directions) from the east to the north-east. When the fire pit that serves as protection (raknā) has been purified, they should be worshipped with the Weapon in accord with the prescribed procedure. (54cd-55ab) The (quarters) should be worshipped in due order, namely, the east, south- east, south, south-west, the west, the north-west, up to the north and north-east.38 (55cd-56ab) 1) The Thunderbolt, 2) the Weapon of Power, 3) the Staff, 4) the King of Snakes, 5) the Earring, 6) the Flag, 7) the Pestle and the Trident, said to be the eighth. (The seed-syllable of) Māyā (HRĪ¤) and Śrī (ŚRĪ¤) should be placed at the beginning (and then) the word (i.e. the name of the deity) is uttered (next). (56cd-57) Brahmā is above, VinSu is below and (their) two weapons are the lotus and the wheel. Having worshipped it in this way with effort all impediments are removed.39 (58) The Eight Rites of Purification and the Five Faces of the Fire Burning (jvalana), inflaming (dīpana), piercing (vedhana), causing fear (trāsana), which is supreme, purification (amalīkaraSa), satisfying (apyāyana), consecration, and placing (the deity) in front of oneself (sanmukhya) — the purification (saˆskāra) of the fire takes place naturally by means of (these) eight in accord with the previous teaching. Offerings to the fire are made with these (eight rites of purification). (Thus) the group of five faces comes into being. (59-60)

sanskrit: 100 कुमारिकाखण्डः उड्डियानसमूहेन”” उलिभेदे” पृथक् पृथक् । २३५ विन्यसेत् पूर्वविधिना जिह्वान्यास तु पञ्चधा ।। ६१ ।। कपाली चैव कापाली काकिनी च कुमारिका २३७ २३६ । कुब्जिका च क्रमादेता जिह्वा बीजत्रयेण तु ।। ६२ ॥ होमयेद् योगपीठस्य३८ ततोऽष्टकलमादिशेत् २३९ । नादिफान्ताक्षरवृन्दैः४° मालापञ्चाशदेवता: २४९ ॥ ६३ ॥ २४२ २४४ संस्मृत्य परया भक्त्या ततः सिद्धाङ्गपञ्चकम् । अङ्गानि पूर्वविधिना आदौ त्रिकण्टकादित: ।। ६४ ।। सकलं न्यासमार्गेण २४५ कृत्वा ४६ प्रत्ययमादिशेत् । २४७ प्रकृत्यात्मनि संस्कार”“ यजनक्रमनुक्रमात् २५० कर्तव्यमुडनाथस्य ज्वलनादिसमूहतः । •२५२ २४९ । ।। ६५ ॥ ऊध्वाधोऽग्नि ५१ समासेन भानुमध्यगतं स्मरेत् ।। ६६ ।। २५३ त्रिपादेन अधः कृत्वा सृष्टिवर्गे समाहितः । २५७ ज्वल५५ नाम२५६ तदाख्यातं वायुषट्कसमन्वितम् ॥ ६७ ॥ आभ्यां मध्यगतं रेफ बिन्दुस्थं दीपनं भवेत् । षट्कं शक्तिगतं कृत्वा अधः शक्तिनियोजितम् २६१ वेधनं तत् समुद्दिष्टम् त्रासनं रावपञ्चकम् । ।। ६८ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 101 One should deposit (the mantras of the five faces of the fire) along with the group of (sacred seats, namely) UÆÆiyāna (and the rest) with the previous method, individually, according to the division of the lineages (uli). (Thus) the deposition of the tongues (of flame) is fivefold. (61) The tongues (of flame) are, in due order, Kapālī, Kāpālī, Kākinī, Kumārikā and Kubjikā.40 One should make fire offerings (to these five who) belong to the sacred seat of Yoga41 with the three seed-syllables and then one should indicate the eight energies (kalā). (by uttering their mantras).42 (62-63ab) The Purification of the Self, the Descent of the Vidyā and the Rise of KuSÆalinī A garland of fifty deities (is formed) with the aggregate of the letters ranging from Na to Pha. Having first recalled them with devotion, (one should worship) the five limbs of the Siddhas. First of all, the limbs are (marked with) the TrikaS˜hakā (Vidyā) as in the previous procedure. (Then) having fashioned everything (sakala) by means of the deposition (of mantras), one should indicate the sign of attainment (pratyaya) (that manifests when this is done). (Thus) the rite of passage (saˆskāra) takes place within the (individual) Self who is related to Nature (prakrtyātman) by following the sequence of the liturgy (krama) of the sacrifice.43 (63cd-65) It should be done for UÆanātha by means of the (mantra of) ignition44 and the other (rites performed) together. One should recollect briefly the Fire, which is above and below in the middle of the Sun (bhānu). (66) It is placed below in the category of emanation with the three sections (pāda of the Vidyā).45 Then it is called the Flame (jvala) and is endowed with the group of six winds. (67) The letter Ra in the middle is in between these two, while the (fire) is inflammed (dīpana) within the Point. Having placed the group of six within Energy, it is conjoined to the lower Energy. That is said to be the (act of) piercing (vedhana). The (act of) frightening (trāsana) consists of the group of Five Sounds (rāvapañcaka). (68-69ab)

sanskrit: 102 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २६३ अमलीकरणमन्त्रेण१२ विद्यादेव्यावतारयेत् ।। ६९ ॥ आप्याय २६४ चन्द्रगर्भेन ६५ आज्ञायामभिषेचनम् । २६७ २६८ अस्त्रेण ६६ सन्मुखीकुर्यान्न कुर्यादन्यथाक्रमे २ ।। ७० ।। सकलस्योडनाथस्य चक्रकालानलस्य च । २७१ ज्वलनाद्यैस्तु संस्कारैरष्टाभिः प्रत्ययः कृतः ।। ७१ ।। समाप्य सर्वत:२७२ ह्येवं विद्याहोममनुत्तमम् २७४ २७५ २७६ । एतदेव क्रियायातं संस्कार होमपद्धतौं ॥ ७२ ॥ अविज्ञात्वा न होमोऽस्ति प्रत्ययो वा स्वतन्त्रता । -२७७ २७९ २७८ कुण्डसंस्कारनिर्मुक्तो यः कश्चिद् होममाचरेत् ॥ ७३ ॥ विकर्मस्थः स विज्ञेयो न २८२ मोक्षाय ८३ विधीयते । २८० २८४ .२८६ नाभिस्थानात् समुत्थाप्य स्पन्दकुण्डलिनीं पराम् २८७ नादेन सहजा बोध्या त्रिः कोणान्ते च चित्पुरे । वक्त्रकूटमनुस्मृत्य आरक्तं वह्निवर्चसम् ।। ७५ ।। २९० २९३ सा च देव्या”? ह्यहं नाथ स्मृता आवेशमाप्नुयात् । तद्गतं४ च मनः कृत्वा त्वप्येवं कृतमात्मनि ।। ७६ ।। मन्त्रं९५ ध्यात्वा”६ हुतिं कृत्वा क्रमविद्यामहेश्वर । दशांशे यवराजाभ्यां सिद्धि: ९ कर्मानुरूपतः ३०१ २९७ ३०२ २९९ ३०० स्फाटिका” चाक्षमाला २ च अनुलोमविलोमतः । ३०४ ।। ७४ ।। ।। ७७ ।। हुतिकर्म समासेन दशांशस्य तु निर्णयम् ।। ७८ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 103 The Completion of the Purification with the Fire Offering to the Vidyā One should bring the goddess of the Vidyā down to earth with the mantra of purification (amalīkaraSa). Filling (āpyāya) (takes place) by (means of the mantra called) Candragarbha46 and consecration (takes place) within the Command (AI¤). One should place it in front of oneself with the Weapon. This should not be (done) in any other order. (69cd-70) Having thus concluded in every way the most excellent fire offering of the Vidyā (vidyāhoma), UÆanātha in all his parts (sakala) and the Wheel of the Fire of Time have been realised (pratyayaƒ krtaƒ) by means of the eight purifications (saˆskāra) beginning with ‘burning’ (jvalana) and the rest.47 (71-72ab) This is the purification (saˆskāra) based on (ritual) action (that forms a part of) the liturgy of the fire offering. Without knowing (this), there is no fire offering, realisation (pratyaya) or freedom. (72cd-73ab) Know that he who has not purified the fire pit and makes offerings to the fire acts wrongful. He is not ordained for liberation. (73cd-74ab) The Offerings to the Fire, their Number, Benefits and Timings. Having elevated the supreme KuSdalinī of vibration (spanda) from the locus of the navel, and having recollected the Peak (syllable of the goddess's) face, light red with the splendour of fire, she who is born along with Sound (nāda) should be experienced (in the End of the Twelve) within the Triangle in (the Point which is) the abode of consciousness. (74cd-75) O Lord, I am that goddess. One attains the penetration (āveśa) (of my power by) recollecting (me).48 O Great Lord of the Vidyā of the Krama, having placed the mind there and, in the same way, in the Self, and having meditated on the mantra and made fire offerings (one should make offerings) with barley and rice (rājā)49 of the tenth part (daśāˆśa).50 (Thus one attains) success (siddhi) in accord with one's actions. The rosary of letters (should be) made of crystal (and in the course of repeating the mantra is to be moved through the fingers) forwards and backwards.51 (76-78ab) (Now follows), in brief, the teaching (nirSaya) concerning the fire offering of the tenth part. (78cd)

sanskrit: 104 कुमारिकाखण्ड: .३०८ मात्रैकया ६ च आवेश शरीरे संप्रवर्तते । ३०९ सर्वशान्तिपदावाप्तिर्मात्राद्वितीयहोमतः ।। ७९ ।। मात्रात्रयेन मेधावी चतुर्भिः श्रेयमाप्नुयात् । ३१२३१३ ३१५ मात्रापञ्चकृते होमे सौभाग्यं वर्तते सुखम् ॥ ८० ॥ मात्राषट्ककृते होमे वपुस्थैर्य प्रवर्तते । सप्तभि:३१७ प्राप्यते कीर्तिरष्टभिज्ञीनप्रत्ययम्” ।। ८१ ॥ ३२० नवमात्राकृते”” होमे वागीशत्वं प्रवर्तते ।३२१ दशमात्राकृते””” होमे३ विद्यादेहमनामयम् ।। ८२ ॥ ३२६ द्विसहस्रकृते५ होमे परोक्षे पशुवेधनम् । ३२७ घटकाष्ठादिषु स्तम्भं वर्तते मूलविद्यया ॥ ८३ ॥ मुद्रास्फोट २८ त्रिभिर्विद्या चतुर्भिर्वृक्षपातनम् ३२९ । आगारस्फोटनादीनि सर्वकार्याणि साधयेत्” ॥। ८४ ।। पञ्चभिः पर्वतानां`३२ च समुद्रस्यापि शोषणम् । षड्भिर्द्वीरावलीस्तम्भ३४ पलितानां ५ निवारणम् ।। ८५ ।। सप्तभिर्देवतानां च वश्यं नायति नान्यथा । ३३७ ३३६ किं पुरुषाश्च कन्याश्च यक्षकन्यास्तु” का कथा ।। ८६ ।। अष्टभिज्ञीनमासाध्य” ब्रह्मरूपधरो भवेत् । नवभिर्भैरवं रूपं रुद्ररूपं द्विपञ्चके ३४१ खेगति: ३४२ पश्चिमे भागे उत्पतेन्नात्र ३४३ ।। ८७ ।। संशयः ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 105 Possession (āveśa) (by the goddess) in the body takes place with one measure (mātrā) (of the offering). By offering the second measure to the fire one attains the state of complete tranquillity. (79) (A man becomes) wise (medhāvin) with three measures and with four one attains the (supreme) good (śreyas). Having made an offering to the fire with five measures, (one attains) good fortune and happiness. (80) When the fire offering with six measures has been made, the body becomes firm (and free from disease). One gains renown with (the offering) of seven (measures) and with eight the realisation of knowledge. (81) When the fire offering of nine measures has been made, (the adept attains) mastery over speech. When the fire offering of ten measures has been made, (one acquires) the flawless body of the Vidyā. (82) When two thousand fire offerings have been made the fettered soul is invisibly pierced (with the piercing that penetrates) through the jar, wood and the rest. (This way the fetters are) paralysed (stambha) by means of the root Vidyā. (83) The explosive radiance of gesture (is experienced) with three (thousand offerings); with four (thousand), (the adept) accomplishes all (magical) feats. (He can) fell a tree (with his magical power), cause houses to explode and more. (84) With five (thousand offerings, he bursts apart) mountains and even the sea dries up (at his command). With six (thousand), the series of entrances (to the body) are blocked and (his) grey hairs are removed. With seven (thousand), he brings the gods under his control, (a feat that is impossible) in any other way. (If he can do this to the gods) then, what to say of men, young women or (even) the maidens of the Yaknas. (85-86) With eight (thousand offerings) he obtains knowledge and bears Brahmā’s form; with nine (thousand) (he attains) Bhairava's nature and when (he has made) ten (thousand) that of Rudra. (He attains mystical) flight (khegati) and flies up (when) the last portion (bhāga) (is offered). There is no doubt about this. (87-88ab)

sanskrit: 106 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३४४ एवं सिद्धिविभागेन दशांशस्य विधीयते ॥ ८८ ॥ वीरभद्रेण कर्तव्यं विद्याहोममनुत्तमम् ३४५ । वायुवर्गेण कारयेत् ॥। ८९ ।। ३४८ सिद्धिं होमविभागेन लिङ्गाग्रे तु समाचरेत् ।। ३५० ३५१ नित्यकर्मणि शान्त्यर्थं अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दशी ॥ ९० ॥ मात्राहोमं प्रकर्तव्यं दीक्षाकालेऽथवा सुधीः ३५२ । होमयेच्च शतान्यष्टौ तदा ते सिद्धिभाजनाः ।। ९९ ।। ३५४ ३५५ एवमष्टशतान्येव ५३ शिवरात्र्यादौ २४ सर्वशः । सदा पवित्रके वापि पर्वकालेषु पूजयेत् ।। ९२ ॥ वीरत्वं प्राप्यते सिद्धि:३५६ रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयात्“ । क्रतुयज्ञसहस्रेषु अश्वमेधशतेषु च ।। ९३ ।। यत् फलं प्राप्नुयान्मन्त्री“ तस्माच्छतगुणं लभेत् । ३५९ नित्यहोमकृते मन्त्री गङ्गास्नानफलं लभेत् ।। ९४ ।। अष्टम्यां६१ च कृते २ होमे वाराणस्यां च तत् समं । ३६४ ३६३ चतुर्दश्यां कृते होमे केदारे सदृशं फलम् ।। ९५ ।। सर्वतीर्थाभिषेक ५ च होमराजपवित्रकम् ३६६ । सर्वमन्त्राधिपत्यं तु सर्वहोमे कृते सति ।। ९६ ॥ सिद्धिहोमप्रदानेन“ सर्वसिद्ध्यारिहो भवेत् ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 107 In this way, the (fire offering) in ten parts has been prescribed in accord with the types (vibhāga) of accomplishments (siddhi) (it gives). One should make the most excellent fire offering of the Vidyā by means of Vīrabhadra. * * * * * * * * one should cause this to be done with the Wind (vāyuvarga). One should practice (the attainment of) accomplishment in front of the Li‰ga in accord with the parts of the fire offering. (89-90ab) The wise man should make the fire offering with (these) measures (mātrāhoma)52 to pacify (adverse influences) during the daily rite on the eighth and fourteenth (of the lunar fortnight) or during (the rite) of initiation. (90cd-91ab) One should make eight hundred offerings to the fire. Then (those who do so) possess the accomplishments (siddhi). In this way, eight hundred (are to be offered) in every way on Śiva’s Night (śivarātri) and other (such occasions). (91cd-92ab) One should always worship (in this way) when the rite of offering the sacred thread (pavitraka)53 is performed and on the sacred lunar days (parvan).54 (Thus) one attains success (siddhi), the heroic state (vīratva) and Rudra's world. (92cd-93ab) The reciter of mantra gets a hundred times more fruit (from this ritual) than a thousand Vedic sacrifices (kratuyajña) or a hundred horse sacrifices. (93cd-94ab) The reciter of mantra who has made the (daily) obligatory fire offering, gets the fruit of having bathed in the Ganges. When a fire offering is made on the eighth (lunar day), it is the same as doing it in VārāSasī. (94cd-95ab) When the fire offering is performed on the fourteenth (lunar day), the fruit is similar (to that obtained by doing it) in Kedāra. (This), the sacred king (of all) fire offerings, (is equivalent) to the consecration (obtained) in all the sacred bathing sites (tīrtha) (put together). (95cd-96ab) Once all the fire offering has been completed (one attains) mastery over all mantras. By offering the fire sacrifice of accomplishment (siddhihoma), (the adept) becomes the destroyer of all the enemies of accomplishment. (96cd-97ab)

sanskrit: 108 कुमारिकाखण्ड: गृहस्थानां सदाचार विद्याहोमं विधीयते ।। ९७ ।। क्रमस्य दक्षिणे मूर्ती अलिना शोधित हुनेत्२ । ३७० श्वेतार्केश्च ७३ हयारैश्च श्वेतपुष्पैर्मनोरमैः | ३७५ ॥ ९८ ॥ नैमित्तिके७६ महाद्रव्यैरणिमादिगुणाष्टकम् । ३७७ । अतीतानागतं किञ्चिद् वर्तमाने प्रवर्तते ।। ९९ ।। ३८० श्रीनाथ उवाच । द्रव्यमानं कथं चात्र सविधान २ च निर्णयम् । होमसंभारमानं तु कथं मात्रा विधीयते ॥ १०० ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच ३८३ ३८६ ।। ॥ १०१ ॥ अत३८४ ऊध्वं प्रमाणं तु द्रव्याणां परिभावना । नित्यकर्मणि सक्तानां शान्त्यर्थं सर्वकामदम् श्वेतार्क तिलपात्रेण युक्तं कृत्वा तदश्नुते । । सर्पिषा अग्निबीजेन अग्नीनां कृतकृत्यता ।। १०२ ।। प्रसिद्धश्चात्मज्ञानेन” दक्षिणेन करेण तु । ३९३ गुग्गुलगुटिका” शस्ता वनराण्डप्रमाणतः ।। १०३ ।। तिलाक्तामर्दिता४ कृत्वा सर्पिषैकपल ९५ हुनेत् । नगरे शुभकार्येषु आहुतीः सर्वसिद्धिदाः ।। १०४ ॥ विद्यावक्त्रेषु पीठानां पक्वान्नाहुतिपञ्चकम् । ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 109 The Substances Offered to the Fire The fire offering of the Vidyā (vidyāhoma) is enjoined as the regular (daily) practice (sadācāra) for householders.55 One should make a fire offering, purified with liquor, to the image (mūrti) on the southern side of the Krama (maSÆala) with white Arka (flowers),56 Hayāras57 (and other) beautiful white flowers. (97cd-98) In the case of an occasional rite, (the offering is made) with the great (Kaula) substances (mahādravya). (Thus one attains) the power to make oneself small at will (aSima) along with the other eight yogic powers (guSa) and whatever has past or will be occurs in the present (and is known to the adept). (99) Śrīnātha said: What is the extent (and form) of the sacrificial substance (offered) here (in this case)? (What is) the teaching and the prescribed rite (vidhāna)? What is the extent (and nature) of the accessories (saˆbhāra) to the fire sacrifice? In what measure (mātrā) is it enjoined? (100) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Now follows a reflection on the extent (and form) of the sacrificial substances (offered) in the regular rite for those engaged (in this practice) to pacify (adverse forces) and fulfil all one's desires. (101) (The adept) attains that by combining the white Ark flower with sesame leaf. The fires have fulfilled their function when (this is offered) along with clarified butter and the seed-syllable of fire.58 It is perfectly complete when (offered) with knowledge of the Self and the right hand. (102) It is enjoined that a ball of guggula59 resin the size of a monkey's testicle (should be offered to the fire).60 Once it has been smeared with sesame (oil) and kneeded, it should be offered to the fire (with) one pala61 of clarified butter. (103cd-104ab) The offerings to the fire confer complete success in all the auspicious (public) works (one may undertake) in (one’s) town. Five fire offerings of cooked rice (anna) are made to the sacred seats in the faces of the Vidyā. (104cd-105ab)

sanskrit: 110 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३९९ ४०० पिशितस्य पलान् पञ्च गुटिकां होमयेत् ततः ।। १०५ ।। मात्रामानेन संसिद्धिर्नित्यहोमफलं महत् । ४०४ रुद्रशक्त्या हुनेन्मन्त्री विचरेत यथासुखम् ॥ १०६ ॥ अणिमादीनि सिद्धीनां त्राता भवति नान्यथा । •४०७ मात्राहोममयं“ कृत्वा ततश्चासौ अन्वयी भवेत् ।। १०७ ।। •४१२ अतो नैमित्तिकस्यात्र विधानं संप्रगीयते । तिलाक्तासर्पिणा३ सार्धं प्रस्थान्यष्टशतानि च ।। १०८ ।। कृत्वा चैव तु गुटिकां अर्केन्दुफलमानतः । ४१४ ४१६ ४१८ गुग्गुलेन पुरा कृत्वा होमयेत विचक्षणः ॥ १०९ ॥ एवं मासस्य मानं तु अप्रमाण न होमयेत् । •४२० ४२४ शतमष्टोत्तरं४२१ रक्त४२२ गोक्षीर ४२३ सर्पिमेव गोक्षीर४३ सर्पिमेव च ।। ११० ।। चतुर्वणानि पुष्पाणि होमयेत विधानतः । •४२८ ।। ।। आदौ त्रिकण्ठक२७ न्यास ४८ कुण्डमध्ये तथात्मनि ॥ १११ ॥ विद्यान्यास २९ तथैवेह अपरं सिद्धपञ्चकम् । -४३१ ४३२ ४३० षडङ्गमालिनीं कृत्वा मुखजिह्वान् यथाक्रमम् ।। ११२ ।। मात्राणां होमयेत् कुण्डे पृथग्रूपविभागशः ४३४ । उड्डियाण३५ महावक्त्रं सिद्धयोगिनिसेवितम् ।। ११३ ॥ कुण्डमध्ये स्मरेद् देवं जालवक्त्रं तु दक्षिणे । ४३७ उत्तरे पूर्णगिर्यं तु कामरूपं तदग्रतः ।। ११४ ॥ तदूवे पीठमेकं तु पञ्चमं तिस्रनामतः ४४२ ४४० । ।। एते पीठमुखाः पञ्च तेषु जिह्वाः क्रमेण तु ।। ११५ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 111 (First), one should offer five palas of meat to the fire and then the ball (of guggula). According to the size of the measures (mātrā) (offered one attains) complete success. The fruit of the regular (nitya) fire offering is (indeed) great. (105cd-106ab) The reciter of mantra should make offerings to the fire with Rudra's energy and (then) wander as he pleases. In this way alone he becomes the guardian of the powers (siddhi) to become small at will (aSima) and the rest. (Indeed), he who has made the fire offering in the (right) measures (mātrāhoma) becomes a member of the tradition (anvayin). (106cd-107) The Fire Offering for the Occasional Rites Next the prescribed method of performing the occasional rite is discussed. Having prepared eight hundred and fifty prasthas62 of sesame seed smeared with clarified butter and a ball (gu˜ikā) of guggula the size of the fruit of the Ark tree, the expert should offer (all that) to the fire. Such is the measure of the monthly (offering). One should not make an offering to the fire that has no measure (apramāSa). (108-110ab) One should offer according to the prescribed method, blood, cow's milk, clarified butter and flowers of four colours, one hundred and eight times. (110cd-111ab) First comes the deposition of the Three Thorns (trikaS˜haka)63 in the centre of the fire pit and within oneself. (One should perform) the deposition of the (Samaya) Vidyā in the same way and after that the (PraSavas of) the five Siddhas. (One should) then form, in due order, the six-limbed deposition of Mālinī and (that of the) faces (of the fire) and the tongues (of flame). One should offer the measures (mātrā) in the fire pit part by part (each according to their own) separate form. (111cd-113ab) UÆÆiyāna is the Great Face, attended by Siddhas and Yoginīs. One should recollect the god in the centre of the fire pit. The face of Jālandhara is in the south. (The face of) PūrSagiri is in the north and Kāmarūpa is in front of it. Above that is one (more) seat, the fifth, called Tisra. (113cd-115ab) These are the five faces of the sacred seats. The tongues within them (will now be explained) in due order. (115cd)

sanskrit: 112 कुमारिकाखण्ड: •४४३ व्यापकादिचतुष्कं तु संहार बिन्दुसंयुतम् । रेफषष्ठसमाक्रान्तं पूर्वनामविभागशः ।। ११६ ॥ । कुलदेवीं च कुब्जेशीं मध्यपीठे हि विन्यसेत् । वटुकयोगिनीनां“ तु बलि ९ बाह्ये विनिक्षिपेत् ।। ११७ ॥ अपरं पूजयेत् तत्र विद्यादेव्या महाक्रमम् । वक्त्राङ्गैस्तु समोपेतं तथा पीठचतुष्टयम् ।। ११८ ।। 52 देवतैश्चतुरोपेत५३ कुलदेव्या तथाष्टकम् । श्रुक्श्रुवं ज्वालयेद् देव अस्त्रराजेन बुद्धिमान् ।। ११९ ॥ ज्वालयित्वा महेशान कवचेनावगुण्ठयेत् । ४५७ ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च दर्भेषु हि पुरत्रयम् ।। १२० ॥ श्रुश्रुव ५८ स्थापयेत् तत्र विद्याबीजेन सन्मुखम् । •४६० सर्पिपूर्ण श्रुवं कृत्वा विद्यादेवी प्रपूजिता ।। १२१ ।। योनिमुद्रा निरालम्बा पूरकेन तु होमयेत् । ४६४ वामहस्तेन तत्सर्वं ६३ कर्तव्य होमकर्मणि ।। १२२ ॥ पुष्पाञ्जलिं ५ ततो विद्यां विनिवेश्य प्रसन्नधीः । वक्त्राङ्गपूर्णतां कृत्वा होमयेत विचक्षणः षडङ्गेन तु संपूर्ण ९ हुत्वा जिह्वाचतुष्टयम् ४७० ४६८ । ४७२ ।। १२३ ।। कुलदेव्यस्तथा चाष्टौ होमयेत् पूर्वमाहुतिम् ॥। १२४ ॥ इति पञ्चाहुती: पञ्च हुत्वा होमः प्रवर्तते । ४७३ ४७५ गमागमेनाक्षमालावामहस्तेन चित्पुरे ।। १२५ ।। ४७६ होमयेत् सात्विकं होम विद्यासकलकामदम् ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 113 The group of four, consisting of the Pervasive One (vyāpaka) and the rest, Withdrawal conjoined with the Point (K±A¤).64 They are conjoined with six letter Ras65 separately in accord with their previous name. (116) The Kula goddess, Kubjeśī, should be deposited in the sacred seat in the centre.66 One should throw an animal offering (bali) outside (the sacrificial area) for Va˜uka (Bhairava) and the Yoginīs.67 One should worship the rest (apara) there, namely, the great Krama of the goddess of the Vidyā. (117-118ab) Similarly, (one must worship) the four sacred seats along with the faces and limbs (of the goddess), the four deities, the group of eight (Mothers) and the goddess of Kula. (118cd-119ab) O god, the wise man should ignite the two spoons (śruk and śruva) with the King of Weapons.68 O great lord, once they have been ignited (in this way), he should envelope them with the Armour. (119cd-120ab) Brahmā, VinSu, and Rudra, (installed on seats made of) Darbha (grass) are the three locations. The two spoons should be placed there, in front of oneself with the seed-syllable of the Vidyā. Having filled one of the spoons (the śruva) with clarified butter and the goddess of the Vidyā has been worshipped, it should be offered to the fire while making the self-sustained (nirālambā) Gesture of the Yoni (yonimudrā) and inhaling. All that should be done with the left hand, when performing the ritual offering to the fire. (120cd-122) Then the man of contented intellect, offers a handful of flowers once he has penetrated into the Vidyā. Having completed (the rite and the mantras) of the faces and limbs, the expert should make the offering to the fire. (123) Once the four Tongues along with the six-limbs have been completely offered to the fire, one should then offer the first fire offering to the eight Kula goddesses. Once one has made (all) five of the five offerings, then the fire offering is complete. (124-125ab) Holding a rosary in the left hand, one should offer in the Citadel of Consciousness, with the going and coming,69 the spiritual (sāttvika) offering to the fire that bestows all one (could) desire of the Vidyā. (125cd-126ab)

sanskrit: 114 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४७८ न मेरु ँ लङ्घयेत् कश्चिन्मेरुच्छायां न लङ्घयेत् ।। १२६ ।। ४७९ तिलाश्च सर्पिणा भाव्या अग्निबीजप्रदीपिताः । ४८० होमयेच्च दशांशेन जपसंख्याप्रमाणतः ।। १२७ ।। पुष्पयुक्ते तिलाक्ते तु सर्वसिद्धिप्रदो भवेत् । ४८४ ४८५ अपामार्ग २ च शार्दूल सोमराजा तु पिप्पलम् ॥ १२८ ॥ ईश्वरं च तथा ब्रह्म जी मेघवाहनम् । ४८८ •४८७ इत्यष्टौ समिधा: “ प्रोक्ता होमयेत् सर्पिणा सह ।। १२९ ।। ४९२ ४९३ ४९४ तिलाक्तैश्च सुपुष्पैश्च सहस्राणि त्रयः स्मृता: । शतद्वयं वरारोह९५ अर्ध ९६ वा सर्ववक्त्रेषु संक्षेपेण चतुर्भागं अत अर्धमसिद्धिदम् ।। १३० ।। । आज्ञाविद्या विशालाक्ष २ वक्त्राङ्गानि तथा पुनः ।। १३१ ।। जिह्वानां कुलदेवीनां लोकेशानामनन्तरम् । ५०३ होमयेच्चाधिकं होमं अघोरास्त्रमतः परम् ।। १३२ ।। शतमष्टोत्तर हुत्वा पश्चादाहुतिपञ्चकम् ५०५ वक्त्राणां तु षडङ्गस्य॰॰ जिह्वानां कुलदेवीनाम् ँ ।। १३३ ।। वृत्त माषेण ९ चारुका आहुतिं देव तर्पयेत् । ५०९ ततः पूर्णाहुतिं दद्याद् यजमानोऽपि साधकः ।। १३४ ॥ सर्वसिद्धिप्रसादं तु गुरूणां पूजिते सति । । •५१४ दानं वित्तानुसारेण स्वशरीर निवेदयेत् ॥ १३५ ॥ दक्षिणादानात् ते सिद्धिर्भवेद् यज्ञफल तदा । वित्तशाठ्येन”“ नरकं कृतं तदकृत भवेत् ।। १३६ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 115 None should cross over the Meru (of the rosary while repeating the Vidyā).70 (None) should cross (even) the shade of the Meru. The sesame seeds should be sanctified with clarified butter and inflammed with the seed-syllable of fire. (126cd-127ab) The number of offering to be made to the fire should be a tenth of the repetitions (of the Vidyā). (If the offering is made) with flowers and sesame seed smeared (with clarified butter), (the offering) grants every accomplishment (siddhi). (127cd-128ab) Apāmārga, Śārdūla, Somarājī, Pippala, Īśvara, Brahmā, Jīmuta and Meghavāhana71 - these are said to be the eight fuels (for the sacrificial fire). They should be offered to the fire with clarified butter, sesame seed smeared (with clarified butter) and beautiful flowers. O handsome one, (the offerings) are said to be three thousand two hundred, or half of that, for (each of) all the Faces. Shortened to a quarter or (even) a half, (the sacrifice) does not give success (siddhi). (128cd-131ab) O long-eyed one, one should make an extra fire offering for the Vidyā of the Command, the mouths and limbs, the tongues, the goddesses of Kula and then the Lords of the Worlds. Then (one should recite) the Weapon of Aghora. Once a hundred and eight offerings have been made, then come the five fire offerings. (131cd-133ab) Once (this) has been completed with lentils (māna), one must make a libation to the fire offering consisting of the sacrificial pap for the faces, six limbs, the tongues and the Kula goddesses. Then the patron (yajamāna) and the adept (sādhaka) should make the (final) complete offering to the fire (pūrSāhuti). (133cd-134) Once the teachers have been worshipped, (one receives) the grace (prasāda) of every accomplishment (siddhi). Money (should be offered to the officiant) according to one's means and one’s own body. Then, by donating the sacrificial fee (dakniSā), they (achieve) success (siddhi) and the fruit of the sacrifice.72 Hell (is the result) of cheating about (one's) means. Moreover, (even if the fire offering) is performed, it is (as if) it had not been done. (135-136)

sanskrit: 116 ५२० कुमारिकाखण्डः ५२१ .५२३ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये १ सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णयें कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहिताया अव्वाक्रमभाषिते २५ होमनिर्णयो नामानन्दः ।। ३४ ।। ५२६ •५२४
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FOUR 117 This is the (thirty-fourth) chapter called the Teaching Concerning the Offering to the Fire. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: पञ्चत्रिंशानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच श्रुतं भेद तन्त्रमार्गे वामदक्षिणसंग्रहे । त्रिकभेद' समस्तेषु यामलादिष्वनेकशः ।। १ । नित्यातन्त्राण्यनेकानि आगमा गह्वरादयः । अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि कुलभेदँ त्रिकं यथा ।। २ ॥ येन विज्ञातमात्रेण त्रिकभेदः प्रवर्तते । श्रीवक्रा उवाच साधु साधु महाशम्भो सम्यक्पृष्टा त्वयाधुना ॥ ३ ॥ तथाहं कथयिष्यामि तव भक्त्या वरानन । न मया कस्यचित् ख्यातं तव प्रीत्या वदाम्यहम् ।। ४ ।। o ममापि अशरीरेण पूर्वमीशेन भाषितम् । यस्मिन् देव निराकारे शून्यभूते चराचरे ॥ ५ ॥ अनन्तदेवा गन्धव यक्षोरगराक्षसाः” । न चन्द्रार्कौ ग्रहा ऋक्षा नाश्रमा ऋषयस्तथा ।। ६ ।। १६ नाहं देव न त्वं तथा न गणा: शैलकाननाः । तमार्णवे निराकारे अद्वैते घोरदारुणे ।। ७ ॥ निरानन्दात् ँ परास्थानात् दिव्याज्ञा संप्रवर्तिता । शिवेच्छा निर्गता” शक्ति: साहं चैव पुन: शिवा” ॥ ८ ॥ २३ २४ २५ शिवशक्तिरयं भेदः” संजाता कुटिलाह्यहम् । २२ त्रिधा सृष्टमिदं तेन त्रिकोणाकारविग्रहा ॥ ९ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE The Emanation of the Triple Division and its Authority. The Emanation of the Triangle of the Sacred Seats Śrīnātha said: I have heard about the variety of types (bheda) on the Tantric Path, which consists of the collection of the (Tantras of) the Right and the Left. (I have heard) about Trika (trikabheda) which is in all (the Tantras), including the Yāmalas and the rest of many kinds, the numerous Nityā Tantras, the Āgamas, the Gahvara (Tantras)1 and the rest. (1-2ab) Now I wish to hear about the Kula variety, namely, the Trika by knowing which the triple division (trikabheda) functions. (2cd-3ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O Great Śambhu! Congratulations! This time you have questioned me well. So, O handsome one, because of your devotion, I will tell you this. I have not told (this) to anybody, but out of love for you I will tell (you), (just as) the disembodied Lord (Īśa) previously told me. (3cd-5ab) O god, when the moving and immobile (universe) was a void, there were (none of) the endless number of gods, heavenly musicians (gandharva), Yaknas, Snake (deities) and Rāknasas, there was no moon or sun, no planets, constellations, hermitages or the ¬nis. (5cd-6) O god, I did not exist and nor did you. The host (of our attendents) did not exist and there were no mountains or forests. In the (one) non-dual, formless, and fearsome ocean of darkness (tamas), the Divine Command was impelled out of the Abode of the Supreme Goddess (parāsthāna), the Bliss of Stillness (nirānanda).2 I am that Energy who emerged (thus). (I am) Śivā (who is) Śiva's will. (7-8) This division is that of Śiva and (his) Energy. (In this way) I, the Crooked One (ku˜ilā), have come into being. This has been emanated (srn˜a) created threefold and so its form is the shape of a triangle. (9)

sanskrit: 120 कुमारिकाखण्ड: अधोध्वमध्यभागेन” व्याप्याशेषमिदं स्थितम्” । कुलमार्गगता देवी अव्यक्तपदचिन्तका ।। १० ।। ३४ अव्यक्ता व्यक्तरूपेण तेन सृष्टि प्रकाशिता । अव्यक्ताव्यक्तनादात्मा जाता प्रीतिः परस्परम् ॥ ११ ॥ ३७ ३५ ३६ उभौ तौ ईश्वर आज्ञा तयोः सृष्टमिदं जगत् । इच्छया सृज्यतें सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥ १२ ॥ पीठोपपीठक्षेत्राणि” चन्द्रार्कौ देवदानवाः । ४३ ४४ गणा” नागा ग्रहा यक्षाः” सिद्धगन्धर्वमानुषाः ॥ १३ ॥ शैलाश्चैव समुद्राश्च एवं सर्वे विनिर्मिताः । ४५ त्रिभिभीगैर्गता देवी त्रैलोक्यं सृजते क्षणात् ॥ १४ ॥ ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च त्रयो देवा विनिर्मिताः । ४९ पीठत्रिकं च देवेश समासाच्च विनिर्मितम् ॥ १५ ॥ यत्र स्थिता च देवेशी एकानेकस्वरूपतः । तया सृष्टमिदं सर्वं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम् ॥ १६ ॥ क्रीडामात्रविनोदेन सृष्टिसंहारकारिका । त्रिधा च सृजते विश्वं श्रङ्गाट पुरमुत्तमम् ॥ १७ ॥ ५३ तत्र देवास्त्रयो जाता ब्रह्माविष्णुमहेश्वराः । त्रिकोणाकाररूपेण पीठत्रय विनिर्मितम् ॥ १८ ॥ तन्मध्ये चाधिकारिण्या सुखोपायेन कौलिनी । ५७ पूर्वकोणे तु कामाख्यं पूर्णगिर्यं तथोत्तरे ॥ १९ ॥ दक्षिणे जालपीठं तु उड्डिया ँ तु पश्चिमे । उपपीठानि क्षेत्राणि संदोहानि ह्यनेकधा ।। २० ।। दिशि च विदिशि चैव अत्र मध्ये व्यवस्थिताः ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 121 It abides having pervaded all this with (its) lower, upper and middle portion. The goddess is (thus) on the Path of Kula and contemplates the plane of the Unmanifest. (10) It is because the unmanifest (goddess appears) in manifest form that the emanation (of all things) has been made manifest. (Thus) the unmanifest (avyaktā) love between us which is unmanifest Sound (nāda) came into being. (11) Those two are the Lord and the Command. This world has been emitted from them. The entire triple world with all that moves and is immobile is emanated by (the Lord's) will. (12) Everthing has been created in this way — the (sacred) fields, the sacred seats, primary and secondary, the sun and the moon, the gods and demons, the (celestial) hosts, the snake (gods), the planets, Yaknas, Siddhas, Gandharvas and men, the mountains and the seas. (13-14ab) The goddess who assumes three parts emanates the triple world in a moment. O lord of the gods, the three gods, Brahmā, VinSu and Rudra and (so too), the three sacred seats are fashioned collectively (samasāt) where the one mistress of the gods resides, through (her) multiple nature. All this moving and immobile universe has been created by her. (14cd-16) She brings about the emanation and withdrawal (of all things) merely for the pleasure of play. She emanates the triple universe, the most excellent City of the Triangle (śrSgā˜a). (17) Three gods have arisen therein, namely, Brahmā, VinSu and Maheśvara. The three sacred seats have been fashioned in the form of a triangle in the centre of which is Kaulinī who possesses authority (which she applies) through blissful means (sukhopāya). (18-19ab) Kāmākhya is in the eastern corner, PūrSagiri is in the north, Jālandhara is in the south, while UÆÆiyāSa is in the west. The secondary seats, the (sacred) fields and many kinds of sacred meeting places (saˆdoha) are (also) located here, in the middle and in the primary and secondary directions. (19cd-21ab)

sanskrit: 122 श्रीनाथ उवाच कुमारिकाखण्ड: पूर्व बहिस्त्वया ख्यातं देव्याः ४ पीठत्रिक विभो ।। २१ ।। अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि समासात् कथयस्व मे । श्रीवक्रा उवाच ६६ .६८ कथयिष्यामि¨ ते“ नाथ अतिस्नेहेन भैरव ।। २२ ।। ७१ यन्न कस्यचिदाख्यातं स्कन्दनं हि पुरे गतम् । ७३ मह्यमीशेन कथितं देहे पीठत्रयं पुरम् ।। २३ ।। पीठाधिपा हि देवेश पीठदेव्यस्तथा पुनः । अधोध्वमध्यभागेन देहे पीठत्रयं शुभम् ।। २४ ।। त्रिकोणाकाररूपेण त्रिभिः स्थानैव्यवस्थिता । स्वाधिष्ठाने” तु कामाख्यं उड्डियाणमनाहते ।। २५ ।। नासा पूर्णगिरिर्ज्ञेया उज्जेनी बिन्दुसंस्थिता । इच्छाशक्तिः क्रियाशक्तिज्ञानशक्तिस्तृतीयका ।। २६ ।। स्वे स्वे स्थाने स्थिता देव्यः परिवारेण संयुताः । इच्छाशक्तिस्तु कामाख्ये उड्डियाणे “ क्रियात्मिका ।। २७ ।। ज्ञानशक्तिस्तु देवेश पूर्णपीठे तृतीयका । षट्चक्राधारभेदेन भेदोऽयं परिकीर्तयते ं ।। २८ ।। डरलकसहयादिभेदषट्कसमन्वितः । तेषां भेद” न जानन्ति अज्ञानतममोहिताः ।। २९ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 123 The Projection of the Sacred Seats into the Wheels (cakra) of the Body Śrīnātha said: Previously you talked about the external (location of these sacred places). Now, O all-pervasive one, I want to hear about the three sacred seats of the goddess (as they are) collectively (samasāt). Please tell me (this). (21cd-22ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O lord Bhairava, out of the great love (I have for you), I will tell you what has not been told to anybody, namely, the emission (of energy) (skandana) within the abode (pura) (of the three seats in the body). The Lord (Īśa) has told me that the abode (pura) of the three sacred seats is within the body. (22cd-23) The rulers and the goddesses of the sacred seats are also (within it). The three auspicious seats within the body are divided into upper, lower and middle.3 (24) (The goddess) resides (in the body) in the form of a triangle with these three places. Kāmākhya is in the (Wheel called) Self-supported (svādhin˜hāna). UÆÆiyāSa is in (the Wheel of) Unstruck Sound (anāhata). One should know that KuSÆalinī (nāsā)4 is PūrSagiri, while Ujjain5 is in the Point (in the centre of the triangle). (25-26ab) The goddesses (who correspond to) the powers of will, action and knowledge as the third, reside in their own places along with their entourage. The power of the will is (located) in Kāmākhya. She who is (the power of) action is in UÆÆiyāSa, O lord of the gods, the power of knowledge, which is the third, is in PūrSagiri (pūrSapī˜ha). This variety (bheda) is said (to be formed) in accord with the division of the foundation of the Six Wheels. It possesses the first division of six, namely, Õa Ra La Ka Sa Ha and Ya.6 Those who don't know (this) variety (bheda) of these (Yoginīs) are deluded by the darkness of ignorance. (26cd-29)

sanskrit: 124 श्रीनाथ उवाच •९४ अतिसंशयमुत्पन्नं व्याकुलं हृदयं मम ९५ कुमारिकाखण्ड: । ।। न जानामि अहं देवि विज्ञानज्ञानदायिनि ॥ ३० ॥ भैरवि देवदेवेशि सर्वज्ञे परमेश्वरि” । कथं पीठत्रये देव्या उत्पन्ना सपरिग्रहा ।। ३१ ।। १०४ षट्चक्रे षडिदेव्यश्च एकानेकविभेदश: । त्रिधाभेदेन संभिन्ना: षट्प्रकारे व्यवस्थिताः' १०८ श्रीवक्रा उवाच १०७ ।। ३२ ।। अतिगुह्यतर” प्रश्न त्वयोदित सुरेश्वर २ । रक्षणीयं त्वया शम्भो नायिका पीठसंभवा ॥ ३३ ॥ एकापि बहुधा भिन्ना सबाह्याभ्यन्तरे स्थिता १६ । ११७ क्षेत्रे क्षेत्रे स्थिता देव्या पीठे पीठे व्यवस्थिता ।। ३४ ।। यथाज्ञायाता”” ते देव नाम चिह्नं तथा शृणु १२२ । एकापि व्यापिका सूक्ष्मा कलानाहतवर्षणी २३ ।। ३५ ।। चन्द्रपूर्येति सा ज्ञेया तुयीतीतावलम्बिनी । हिमकुन्देन्दुधवला६ बालाग्रशतभागिका ।। ३६ । श्रवन्ती २७ स्वेन रूपेण ॐ कारे सा च गीयते । हकारार्धीर्ध” या मात्रा अर्धेन्दुपदमध्यगा ।। ३७ ।। उड्डियाणं तदाख्यातं अर्धचन्द्राद्” विनिर्गतम् । शक्तिर्विमलरूपेण इच्छयाज्ञा विनिर्गता ॥ ३८ ॥ सुषुम्नानाडिभेदेन” तालुरन्ध्रं समागता३ । वाडवानलयोगेन पूरयन्ती समन्ततः ।। ३९ ।। १३४
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 125 Śrīnātha said: O goddess who bestows knowledge and wisdom, a great doubt has arisen (within me) and my heart is troubled, O Bhairavī! Mistress of the God of the gods! Omniscient Supreme Goddess! How has the goddess arisen in the three sacred seats with (her) enclosure7 (saprigrahā)? (How is it that) the six goddesses in the Six Wheels have been, by single and multiple divisions, divided threefold and reside in the (maSÆala with) six aspects? (30-32) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: The (reply to the) question you have asked, O lord of the gods, is extremely secret. O Śambhu, you should guard (the answer as a great secret). (33abc) The Mistress (nāyikā) has arisen threefold within the sacred seats. Although she is one, she is divided in many ways and is both within and outside. The goddess is in every (sacred) field and in every sacred seat. O god, listen to the characteristic feature and name (of these realities) according to the Command that has come down to you. (33d-35ab) Oˆkāra — the End of the Twelve There is one, all-pervasive and subtle energy (kalā) of Unstruck Sound that rains down (nectar). Sustained by the State beyond the Fourth (turīyātīta), it should be known to be the Island of the Moon. White as the moon, snow and the jasmine flower, (it is as fine) as the hundreth part of the tip of a hair. It oozes (nectar) spontaneously by its very nature and is said (to be) within the syllable O¤.8 (35cd-37ab) OÆÆiyāSa — The Half Moon The measure of Half of Half of Ha9 is located in the centre of the Half Moon. It is called OÆÆiyāSa and it has emerged from it. (37cd-38ab) The Cavity of the Palate The (Divine) Command is the Energy that emerges in a pure form by the will (of the Supreme Principle). (Then), by spliting apart the channel of SunumSā, she reaches the cavity of the palate. She fills (everything) all around by (her) conjunction with the Fire of Time (vāÆavānalayoga). (38cd-39)

sanskrit: 126 कुमारिकाखण्डः इद'३५ तस्य परं दिव्यं पीठं चैवातिदुर्लभम् । १३६ १३७ तत्सकाशात् समुत्पन्ना ऋजुरेखा ह्यधोमुखी ॥ ४० ॥ आकर्षयन्ती” सर्वात्मा ज्वालामाला करालिनी । १४० १४१ अनाहते तु संप्राप्ता या सा हंसविकासिनी ॥। ४१ ।। ज्वालामुखी समाख्याता पीठे४ जालाख्यसंज्ञके ४३ । सा कला कालरूपेण काकिनी हंसविग्रहा ॥ ४२ ॥ मणिपूर्णे महानीला पूर्णिमाकाररूपिणी । । १४६ पीताम्बरधरा दिव्या नागा ४५ सुप्ता च कुण्डली ॥ ४३ ॥ क्षोभयन्ती जगत् सर्वं पूर्णपीठे स्थिता स्वयम् । १४७ । मणिनाभिस्थिता मध्ये त्रिकोणाकृतिविग्रहा¨ ॥ ४४ ॥ कदम्बगोलकाकारा ४९ ज्ञानविज्ञानभैरवी । १५० ।। स्वयमुत्पन्ना सा देवी आदिकादिसमायुता ॥ ४५ ॥ १५२ थकारादि च सा भिन्ना सा शिला सिद्धनिर्मला १४ । १५६ जननी५५ सर्वदेवीनां सदेवासुरमानुषी ।। ४६ । उत्पन्ना कामरूपे तु कामिनी कलुषापहा । । षट्पीठ च समाख्यातं षट् चक्राणि तथा शृणु ।। ४७ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 127 This is his supreme and divine seat (pī˜ha) which is extremely hard to attain. From its presence (the goddess) has arisen (in the form of) a straight line and faces downwards.10 (40) Jālandhara (Anāhata) Terrible (karālinī) and encompassed by a garland of flames, she is all things and attracts (them all) to herself. When she who expands out the Gander (haˆsa) (of Unstruck Sound), reaches (the Wheel of) Unstruck Sound (anāhata), she is called Jvālāmukhī (Flame Mouth) and (resides) in the sacred seat called Jāla. (41-42ab) PūrSagiri (MaSipūrSa) That (same) energy (kalā), as Time, is (the goddess) Kākinī who, in the form of the Gander (of Unstruck Sound), (resides) in MaSipūrSa. She is deep blue in colour (mahānīla) and She is shaped (like) the Full Moon. (42cd-43ab) Divine and wearing yellow clothes, she is the sleeping serpent (who, coiled, is circular like an) earring (kuSÆalī). She disturbes (knobhayantī) the entire universe and resides alone in the sacred seat of PūrSa. She resides in the centre of the navel of the (Wheel of the City of) Jewels and her form is that of a triangle. (43cd-44) Kāmarūpa (ādhāra) The Bhairavī of knowledge and wisdom, shaped (like) the bud of a Kadamba tree (kadambagolaka), is self-generated (svayamutpannā). She is the goddess endowed with (all the vowels) from A onwards and (the series of consonants) from Ka onwards (up to Tha). She is also divided up into (the consonants ranging from) the letter Tha (up to the end of the alphabet). She is the Stone (śilā) which is perfect (siddha) and pure.11 (45-46ab) She is the mother of all the goddesses, gods, demons and men. She is Kāminī who arises in Kāmarūpa and removes impurity. (46cd-47ab) A Description of the Six Wheels and the Triangle Beyond The six sacred seats have been explained. (Now), in the same way, listen to (a description of) the Six Wheels. (47cd)

sanskrit: 128 आधारं प्रथमं चक्रं चतुर्दलसमन्वितम् । १५९ कुमारिकाखण्ड: सिद्धकोटीश्वर नाम डाकिनी ९ तत्र देवता ।। ४८ ।। द्वितीयं स्वाधिष्ठान तु दलषट्कसमन्वितम् । मुद्राकोटीश्वरं नाथं राकिनी तत्र जृम्भते ।। ४९ ॥ १६२ तृतीयं दशपत्रं तु मणिपूर्णे विरामत: । मन्त्रकोटीश्वर १६३ नाथ१६४ अम्बा'६५ चैव तु लाकिनी ।। ५० ।। १६६ चतुर्थं द्वादशारं तु नाम्ना चैवमनाहतम् । १६८ १६९ विद्याकोटीश्वरं तत्र काकिन्यया समन्वितम् ॥ ५१ ॥ विशुद्ध पञ्चमं नाम षोडशा तु शोभनम् २ । समयकोटीश्वरं नाथ७३ साकी४ संज्ञास्वरूपिणी षष्ठमाजस्वरूपेण शिवशक्तिपदद्वयम् । बिन्दुकोटीश्वरं तत्र हाकी आज्ञास्वरूपिणी ॥ ५३ ॥ हंसेश्वरीति विख्याता सृष्टिसंहारकारिणी । ।। ५२ ।। एकापि व्यापिका सूक्ष्मा सा“ सृष्ट्यभिमुखी स्थिता ।। ५४ ।। ज्ञानशक्तिस्तदूवे तु त्रिभिर्भेदैर्विनिर्गता । १८२ इच्छाशक्ति: क्रियाशक्तिज्ञानशक्तिस्तृतीयका १८४ ॥ ५५ ॥ इच्छाशक्तिस्तु वामे तु क्रियाशक्तिस्तु दक्षिणे । ज्ञानशक्तिस्तयोर्मध्ये दिव्यज्ञानानुवर्तिनी ॥ ५६ ॥ ८७ रौद्रीभावे स्थिता देवीं रुद्रशक्तिस्तु कथ्यते । तत्र पीठत्रयं देव परमेव व्यवस्थितम् ॥ ५७ ॥ १९० वामे तु कामरूपाख्य” पूर्णगिर्यं तु दक्षिणे । उड्डियाण” तयोर्मध्ये उज्जेनी बिन्दुसंस्थिता ॥ ५८ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 129 The Foundation (ādhāra) is the first Wheel and it has four petals. (The god) there is the Lord of the Thousand Million Siddhas and the deity is Õākinī. (48) The second (Wheel) is the Self-supported (svādhin˜hāna) and it has six petals. The lord (nātha) there is the Lord of the Thousand Million Seals (mudrā) and (the goddess) Rākinī unfolds there. (49) The third (Wheel) has ten petals and (is attained) by resting in (the Wheel called) Full of Jewels (maSipūrSa). The Lord (there) is the Lord of the Thousand Million Mantras and the mother (ambā) is Lākinī. (50) The fourth (Wheel) has twelve spokes and and is called Unstruck Sound (anāhata). The Lord of the Thousand Million Vidyās (resides) there along with (the goddess) Kākinī. (51) The Fully Purified (viśuddha) is the fifth (Wheel). It is beautiful with sixteen spokes. The Lord is the Lord of the Thousand Million Rules (samaya) and (the goddess) is Sākinī who is designation (saˆjñā). (52) The sixth (Wheel) is the Command (ājñā) by nature and, as such, it is the non-dual plane of Śiva and Śakti. The Lord of the Thousand Million Drops (resides) there (with the goddess) Hākinī who is the Command. (53) She is called Haˆseśvarī (the Mistress of the Gander) and she brings about emanation and withdrawal. She is one, pervasive and subtle and is propense (abhimukhī) to emanation.12 (54) Above that is the power of knowledge that has emerged in three parts. (These are) the powers of the will, of action and of knowledge as the third. (55) The power of the will is on the left, the power of action is on the right, while the power of knowledge, which follows the divine Command, is between the two. (56) (If) the goddess is in Raudrī's state (bhāva),13 she is then called Rudra's power. O god, in this way, there are three supreme sacred seats. (57) On the left is (the sacred seat) called Kāmarūpa. PūrSagiri is on the right. OÆÆiyāSa is between the two and Ujjain14 is located in the Drop (in the centre of the triangle).15 (58)

sanskrit: 130 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १९४ वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्री च नाम्नैताः परिकीर्तिताः' । नवशक्तिस्ततो जाता ब्रह्माण्याद्याश्च मातरः श्रीनाथ उवाच १९६ नवशक्तिप्रकारं तु चतुष्कं तु जयादिकम् । १९९ १९७ ॥ ५९ ॥ रुद्राण्येकादशो याश्च रुद्राणी च महेश्वरी ।। ६० ।। तत् किमर्थं पुनश्चोक्तं भ्राम्यसे मम विस्तरात् । २०२ प्रसीद देवदेवेशि श्रीकुजाख्ये यथाक्रमम् ॥ ६१ ॥ •२०३ एकापि बहुधा भेदैः कथं देवी व्यवस्थिता । २०४ परिवारं कथं तस्याः २०५ प्रसीद कथयस्व मे ।। ६२ ।। श्रीवक्रा उवाच २०६ २०७ उत्तमानि च प्रश्नानि वाक्यानि विविधानि च । वदामि ते प्रसन्नाह“ सावधानोऽवधारय २१२ २०९ ॥ ६३ ॥ शृणु देव” प्रवक्ष्यामि भेदं तस्याः २ यथास्थितम् । इमे सर्वाणि तस्यास्तु४ भेदानि १५ परमेश्वर' इमे१३ २१६ वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्री च त्रिधा ह्येवं व्यवस्थिता । २१७ २१८ २१९ ।। ६४ ।। पुनरेतान् तु तस्या हि भेदान् ” ” शृणु यथा स्थितान् ॥ ६५ ॥ बिन्दुस्थाने तु या आज्ञा अर्धचन्द्रोपरिस्थिता । २२२ बिन्दुस्था सर्वभूतानां कला चामृतवर्षणी ।। ६६ ।। ज्योतिरूपा२३ स्थितान्ते तु तारारूपा तथोपरि ४ । २२५ गुरुवक्त्रं तदूध्वे तु अजाख्यं तु निरामयम् ।। ६७ ॥ •२२७ ईश्वरान्ते २६ स्थितं देवं शाश्वतं शिवमव्ययम् । नवात्मनस्ततो“ जातं नवधा देहपञ्जरम् ।। ६८ ॥ तथा शक्ति: समुद्भूता नवस्थानगता परा २३१ २२९ । दशधा कारणं योगं द्विधा भेदोद्भवं प्रिय ।। ६९ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 131 The Nine Powers, the Eleven RudrāSīs, the One, Two, Three, Four and Eight Energies These (three powers) are said to be called Vāmā, Jyen˜hā and Raudrī. The (group of) nine powers, namely, (the nine) Mothers, BrahmāSī and the rest, arises next. (59) Śrīnātha said: (There are) the modality of nine powers, the tetrad consisting of Jayā and the rest,16 the eleven RudrāSīs and (the goddesses), RudrāSī and Maheśvarī. Why have you referred to (all) this again? You are confusing me very much. O mistress of the God of the gods, O venerable one called Kujā, be gracious (and explain this to me) in due order. How is it that the goddess, although one, exists (vyavasthitā) in many different forms (bheda)? How is her entourage? Be gracious and tell me. (60-62) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: I am pleased with you and so (I will tell you the answer to) these excellent questions. (Now I will) tell (you many interesting) and varied things (vākya). (63) O god, listen carefully, I will tell you how (the goddess) is divided. O Supreme Lord, all these divisions are (part) of her. She abides threefold in this way, as 1) Vāmā, 2) Jyen˜hā and 3) Raudrī. Again, listen to the manner in which these, her divisions, exist. (64-65) The Command, which is above 4) the Half Moon, is in the location of 5) the Point. Residing in the Point, she is the (vital) energy (kalā) of all living beings and she rains down nectar. (66) 6) Similarly, above (that) her form is that of a star and she is located at the end (of the Point) (sthitānte)17 in the form of (divine) Light. 7) Above that is the teacher's mouth, which is called ‘Unborn’ (aja) and is free of all defects. (67) At the end of 8) Īśvara is 9) the god Śiva who is eternal and unchanging. From that is born the ninefold cage of the body of Navātman.18 (68) In this way, the Supreme Energy has come into being and resides in (these) nine places. O dear one, the tenfold cause is Yoga and (so) the dual division (of Śiva and Śakti) has arisen.19 (69)

sanskrit: 132 कुमारिकाखण्ड: त्रिधा बद्ध२ जगत् सर्वं सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं तथा । उभौ तौ मन्मथायातौ द्वादशान्ताद्” विनिर्गतौ २३६ २३३ तेन तेन क्रमेणैव रौद्रीभावमुपागता । २३५ ।। ७० ।। कन्दाधारपुरस्था तु धुननावेशनी स्मृता ।। ७१ ।। । कम्पनी रौद्री २३८ विख्याता घूर्मणी २३९ उद्भवात्मिका एकाङ्गनर्तनीमाख्या अश्रुपाती” कुरङ्गिणी ।। ७२ ।। २४४ २४३ सिंहशब्दी पुलिन्दी च एकादश ४५ प्रकीर्तिताः । रुद्रभागे ४६ स्थिता ह्येते द्वादशान्ते लयंगताः ।। ७३ ।। वामादित्रितयेनैव पीठक्रममुदाहृतम् श्रीभैरव उवाच २४९ २४८ । किमहं चाल्पबुद्धिस्तु जडप्रायं हि मन्यसे ।। ७४ ॥ येन मां भ्राम्यसे देवि किमर्थं च सुरेश्वरि । २५० २५१ अहं सर्वगतः कर्ता त्वदीयाज्ञावधिष्ठितः ।। ७५ ।। तस्मात् कारुण्यतो देवि ब्रूहि ज्ञानं महोदयम् ५३ । २५२ श्रीवक्रा उवाच २५४ २५५ साधु साधु महाभाग अमोघज्ञानभाजन' ।। ७६ ।। कथयामि न५६ संदिग्धं ज्ञानं भ्रान्तिविनाशनम् । २५७ २५९ कौलिनी यद् रहस्य तु गुह्यं मन्त्रोदितं प्रिय१ ।। ७७ ।। २६३ यन्न कस्यचिदाख्यात१२ तद् यथा कथयाम्यहम् ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 133 The entire universe is bound three times, both internally and externally. When both of these become passionate, they emerge from the End of the Twelve. (70) The Eleven RudrāSīs Through each of the sequences (of emanation) she assumes Raudrī's state.20 1) (When) she is in the Abode of the Foundation of the Root, she is said to be 2) the one who shakes (dhunanā) and 3) takes possession (of her devotee) (āveśanī). (71) Raudrī is said to be 4) the one who causes trembling (kampani), while 5) the one who throbs with inebriation (ghūrmaSī) is 6) the upward movement (towards higher levels of consciousness) (udbhavātmikā). 7) She is the doe (kuraSginī) called the 8) `one who dances on one limb' and 9) `she who weeps'. (72) These, together with 10) the Lion's Roar (siˆhaśabdī) and 11) Pulindī, are said to make eleven. They are within Rudra's portion and have dissolved away in the End of the Twelve.21 (73) (Thus) the sequence of the sacred seats has been explained in terms of the three (goddesses) beginning with Vāmā. (74ab) The venerable (god) Bhairava said: O goddess, is it because I have little intelligence and you consider me to be a dullard that you are confusing me? O mistress of the gods, why (are you doing this)? I am the omnipresent agent (of all action) and (yet) I am guided (avadhin˜hita) by your Command. Therefore, out of compassion (for me), O goddess, tell me the knowledge which is the great arising (of enlightenment). (74cd-76ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Well done, O Great Souled One, you who possess unfailing wisdom! I will explain that knowledge which is certain and destroys (all) error, O beloved, the secret that is Kaulinī, the mystery generated from mantra. I will tell you what has not been told to anyone (before). (76cd-78ab)

sanskrit: 134 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २६४ पूर्वमादौ युगे देव दिव्याज्ञायाः समुद्भवः ।। ७८ ।। तत्रोत्पन्ना च सा देवी अङ्कराकाररूपिणी । २६७ तया चीर्णं २६५ तपश्चग्रं २६६ दिव्याज्ञया जितेन्द्रियम् ॥ ७९ ॥ २६८ । ततः सा कुब्जिकाकारा कुटिला नग्नवाससा त्रिस्वरूपा ह्यहं जाता वृद्धत्वं समुपागता ।। ८० ।। २६९ शिवशक्तिसमायोगो गीयते सर्वशाम्भवम् । २७० वामे शक्तिः समुद्भूता दक्षिणे तु शिवः स्मृतः वामे चैव तु ब्रह्माणी २७२ रौद्री चैव तु दक्षिणे । इडापिङ्गलभावेन गीयते सर्वजन्तुषु ॥ ८२ ॥ २७३ २७४ २७१ ।। ८१ ।। चन्द्रस्तु वामसंभूतः रौद्र्या चैव तु भास्करः । २७७ द्विधा भिन्नं जगत् सर्वं ओतप्रोत २६ वरानन ॥ ८३ ॥ त्रिविधभेदभिन्नं“ तु वक्ष्यते” शृणु साम्प्रतम् । २८० २८१ २८२ त्रिधा भिन्नं जगन्नाथ भूतग्रामं चराचरम् ।। ८४ ।। सुषुम्नाचरसंचारी २८३ विचित्रा नाम विश्रुता । चित्रितास्त्रिस्वरूपेण४ ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः २८५ ॥ ८५ ॥ वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्री च त्रिधा देवी व्यवस्थिता । पुष्करान्ते सदा लीना महापथपदाश्रिता महापथपदाश्रिता । ८६ ॥ २९० शिवानामेन८९ विख्याता सदा शिवे लयंगता । अपर२९२ वक्ष्यते देव येन भेदेन संस्थिता ।। ८७ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 135 The One Division O god, the Divine Command came forth, initially, in the first Age. That (was the) goddess (who) emerged there in the form of a sprout. At the instance of the Divine Command she performed fearful austerity by which the senses are conquered.22 (78cd-79) And so it is that I who have the form of a hunched-backed woman (kubjikā) and am crooked and naked (nagnavāsasā) and possess three aspects have become old. (80) The Two Divisions The union of Śiva and Śakti is said to be Śiva's universal condition (sarvaśāmbhava). Energy arises on the left, while Śiva is said to be on the right. (81) Again, BrahmāSī is on the left and Raudrī on the right. (This pair) is said (to be present) within all living beings as (the channels) IÆā and PiSgalā. (82) The Moon has arisen from the left (side), while Raudrī is the Sun (which is on the right). O handsome one, the entire universe is divided into two parts, and is threaded warp and woof (by these two aspects).23 (83) The Three Divisions Now, O lord of the universe, listen. (How the one reality) is divided into three types of divisions will be explained. The aggregate of existing things (bhūtagrāma),24 mobile and immobile, is divided into three kinds. (84) (The energy that) wanders with the gait of SunumSā is known as Vicitrā (Marvellously Diverse). Brahmā, VinSu and Maheśvara are diversified with this triple form. (85) The goddess is triple as Vāmā, Jyen˜hā and Raudrī. She resides within the Blue Lotus25 (punkara) and is on the plane of the Great Path. She is called Śivā and is always merged in Śiva.26 (86-87ab) O god, another way in which (the goddess) abides in a multiple form (bhedena) is as follows. (87cd)

sanskrit: 136 कुमारिकाखण्डः २९६ २९५ । इडा च पिङ्गला चैव शिवा९३ चैव २९४ त्वनामया सत्त्वादिगुणसंभूता इच्छाद्याः शक्तयस्त्रिधा ।। ८८ ।। एवमेव प्रकारेण संस्थितस्तु त्रिधात्मक : २९८ २९७ । अधुना प्रोच्यते देव चतुधीभेदमुत्तमम् ॥ ८९ ॥ सुषिरादिविभागेन या विभिन्ना हि ते प्रिया३ । ३०४ ३०० ३०५ ३०६ ३०२ ज्ञातव्या ४ कौलिकेनैव चतुधी ते कुलेश्वर ।। ९० ।। ३०७ ३०८ वामदक्षिणमार्गेण चतुधी त्वष्टधा स्मृता । वामा चैव जया ३०९ देवी विजया दक्षिणे तथा ।। ९१ ।। ३१० एता एतैस्तु भेदैस्तु अष्टधा पुनरेव हि । अष्टादशक्रमाम्नायं”” उन्मनाज्ञाविनिर्गतम् ॥ ९२ ॥ ३१२ ३१३ चतुःप्रकारसंयुक्तं पञ्च षट् च त्रिधात्मकम् । एतदेव मया ख्यातमष्टादशक्रमोदयम् ।। ९३ ॥ चन्द्रसूर्यविभागेन वामदक्षिणयोगतः । उदयास्तमन५ देव चतुधी देव चतुधी” तु वरानन पुनः सृष्टिप्रयोगेन पञ्चब्रह्मोदयेन च । ३१७ ॥ ९४ ॥ पञ्चावस्थास्तु कुलजा”“ विमलाद्यस्तु संज्ञया ।। ९५ ।। एवं पञ्चप्रकारेण जगद्योनिः स्थिता ह्यहम् । ३२० शृणु देव” प्रवक्ष्यामि षड्विधोत्तरमुत्तमम् यन्न कस्यचिदाख्यातं तच्च ते कथयाम्यहम् । ३२३ ३२४ ।। ९६ ।। पूर्वकाले तु देवेश हिमवन्तमुखाच्छुतम् ॥ ९७ ॥ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 137 IÆā, PiSgalā and Śivā, who is without defect, are born of the (three) qualities, sattva and the rest and the three types of energy, namely, will, (knowledge and action correspond to them). (The Lord) is triple in the same way.27 (88-89ab) The Four and the Eight O god, (the time has come) now to mention the excellent fourfold division. O Kuleśvara, the (true) Kaulika should know your beloved (goddess) who is divided into four (aspects) in conformity with the division of the cavities (sunira) and the rest. (89ab-90) She is said to be fourfold and eightfold by way of the right and the left path. Jayā is the goddess on the left (vāmā). Similarly, Vijayā is on the right. Again, because of these divisions, these (goddesses) are eightfold.28 (91-92ab) The Four, Five, Six and Triple Aspects of the Divine Current of the Eighteenfold Transmission The tradition (āmnyāya) of the Transmission of the Eighteen has emerged as the Command of the Transmental. Endowed with four aspects, (there are) five and six (divisions) and it is threefold.29 This is what I call the arising of the Eighteenfold Transmission. O god, in accord with the division of the Sun and Moon associated with the right and the left (currents of the breath), (along with) the arising and falling away (of each of the two), (the division is) fourfold, O handsome one. (93-94) The Five States Again, by the application of emanation and by the (consequent progressive) arising of the Five Brahmās,30 the Kulajā (Yoginīs `Born from Kula') who are called Vimalā and the rest (correspond) to five states.31 In this way, I who am the Yoni of the universe, abide in five modalities. (95-96ab) The Sixfold Form O god, listen as I explain the excellent sixfold (form) that follows after. I will tell you what has not been told to anybody. O Lord of the gods, (I) heard it in the past from the mouth of Himavat. (96cd-97)

sanskrit: 138 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३२६ षड्विधाह२५ समुत्पन्ना त्रिधा शृङ्गाटरूपिणी । । पीठत्रयं ३२८ समाख्यातं नानाभेद ९ तव प्रिय ॥ ९८ ॥ इडा च पिङ्गला चैव सुषुम्ना च तृतीयका । ३३२ ३३३ पीठत्रितयविज्ञेया” देव्य २ एते त्रयान्विताः ॥ ९९ ॥ एतेभ्यो देव्य ३५ उत्पन्ना एकैके च द्विकं द्विकम् । ३३६ । षट्कभेदेन ता ह्येव षट्चक्रेषु व्यवस्थिताः ।। १०० ॥ ३३९ द्वे द्वे३८ पीठेषु विख्याताः”” संभूताः कुलभूषणाः । तासां नामानि वक्ष्यामि येषु पीठेषु संस्थिताः ॥ १०१ ॥ ३४१ हाकिनी शाकिनी”‍ चैव उड्डियाणाद् ४३ विनिर्गते ३४७ ३५० । काकिनी लाकिनी५ चैव पूर्णगिर्याद् विनिर्गते ।। १०२ ॥ राकिनी डाकिनी ४९ चैव कामरूपाद् विनिर्गते एवं देव्यः ३५१ समुत्पन्ना निग्रहानुग्रहक्षमाः ।। १०३ ॥ । ३५५ देशे ३५२ देशे ३५३ तु विद्यन्ते विख्याता: ३५४ सिद्धशासनें । कुलजा: सहजाश्चैव सप्तसप्तार्णवार्णवाः ।। १०४ ।। ३५६ सहजा कुलजा चैव खेचरी भूचरी तथा परिवारं तु देवेश अनेकाकाररूपतः ३५९ । ३५७ ।। १०५ ।। ३६२ वामाद्यानां चतुष्कानि शिवाद्यान्येव? ये चतुः । ३६६ चतुःषष्टिस्तथा देव्यो ४ द्वात्रिंशच्च प्रजातिकाः ।। १०६ ॥ ता: षोडशकलोपेता: ८ द्वादशानि द्वादशानि च सूर्यजा: । ३६७ ३६८ । अष्ट देव्यः कुलोत्पन्नाश्चतुष्कं च त्रिक २ तथा ।। १०७ ।। सर्वमेवं हि देवेश श्रीमत्कुब्जाविनिर्गतम् । ३७३
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 139 The Triad I have arisen sixfold and threefold in the form of a Triangle (śrSgāta). (O beloved, this) the triad of sacred seats, which has many varieties (bheda) has been explained to you. (98) The Six Goddesses in the Three Seats One should know that IÆā, PiSgalā and SunumSā as the third, are the three sacred seats. They have three goddesses.32 The goddesses have arisen from them, two at a time in each one. In this way they are arranged in the Six Wheels as the division of the group of six (na˜kabheda). (99-100) (These goddesses), the ornaments of Kula, are said to reside in pairs in the sacred seats. I will tell (you) their names and in which of the sacred seats they reside. (101) Hākinī and Śākinī have emerged from UÆÆiyāSa. Kākinī and Lākinī have come forth from PūrSagiri. Rākinī and Õākinī emerge from Kāmarūpa. Capable both of gracing and restraining, the goddesses have arisen in this way. (102-103) The Four Yoginīs (The Yoginīs) are found in every country and are well known in the teachings of the Siddhas (siddhaśāsana). The Kulajā (energies `Born from Kula') and the Sahajā (energies `Born from the Innate') are the forty-nine letters (each one vast and powerful as the) sea. (104) Sahajā (Born from the Innate), Kulajā (Born from Kula), Khecarī (the Skyfaring Goddess) and Bhūcarī (She Who Moves on the Earth) have many forms and so, O Lord of the gods, they constitute the (goddess's) entourage. (105) The four (goddesses) beginning with Vāmā (along with)33 Śivā and the rest make four. There are sixty-four goddesses and thirty-two mothers (prajātikā).34 Those (goddesses) who possess the sixteen digits (of the moon) (kalā) and the twelve born from the Sun, the eight goddesses born from the Kulas,35 the group of four and the triad. O Lord of the gods, all of this has come from the (goddess) Kubjā. (106-108ab)

sanskrit: 140 ३७४ कुमारिकाखण्ड: • ३७८ ३७७ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे ४ अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते त्रिकभेदसृष्ठिसाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। ३५ ।। ३८० ३७५
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-FIVE 141 This is the (thirty-fifth) chapter called the arising of the transmission concerning the description of the Emanation of the Triple Division and its Authority. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat36 along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: षट्त्रिंशानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच एतत् सर्वं मया ज्ञातं त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वरि '। अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि अनुष्ठाज्ञा यथा भवेत् ॥ १ ॥ भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा देवि विज्ञानज्ञानभूमिका । निर्वाणं श्रोतुमिच्छामि अव्यक्तं च परापरम् ॥ २ ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ' संसारतरणक्षम । कथयामि न संदेहो निर्वाणाज्ञा यथा भवेत् ।। ३ ॥ वक्ष्ये परापरं तत्त्वं श्रूयतां कमलानन । समयाचारमार्गेण यथा गुरुमुखागतम् ॥। ४ ॥ कणीत् कर्णगत तत्त्वं नित्योदितमखण्डितम् । सदोदितमहानन्द अव्युच्छिन्न निरन्तरम् ॥ ५ ॥ १२ सर्वानन्दकरं देव साधका सिद्धिकाङ्क्षिणाम् । गुरुवक्त्रस्थितं तच्च शास्त्रमुद्देशमात्रकम् ।। ६ ।। सदानुष्टानशीलस्य नित्यमेकस्तथासि ं ते । चित्त चेत्यात्मचैतन्य चेतितं येन पुद्गले ॥ ७ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-SIX The Competence for Knowledge and Wisdom. Maintaining and Cultivating the Liberated State Śrīnātha said O Great Goddess, by your grace, I have understood all this. Now I want to hear about the Command of Ritual Observance (anun˜hājñā) that bestows both liberation and worldly enjoyment and is, O goddess, the plane of knowledge and wisdom. I want to hear about the unmanifest NirvāSa that is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent). (1-2) The venerable (goddess) said: Well done, well done, O greatly wise one, you who can convey (the fettered) across the ocean of transmigratory existence! I will tell (you) without a doubt, what the Command of NirvāSa is.1 (3) I will tell (you) about the Principle that is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent). Listen, O lotus faced one, to what has come down from the teacher's mouth by the path of the Practice of the Rule (samayācāra). (4) The Reality (tattva) that is perpetually active (nityodita) and unbroken (has been) transmitted by word of mouth.2 It is the Great Bliss, eternally manifest, unconditioned and continuous. (5) O god, just the subtle hint (uddeśa) on the teacher's lips (that conveys the entire purport of the) scripture gives the adepts who crave accomplishment (siddhi), every joy (sarvānanda). (6) For one whose habit it is to attend constantly to spiritual discipline (anun˜hāna), you are always one and the same. Such also is your mind (citta), contemplated (cetita) within the individual soul by the consciousness (caitanya) that is the essential nature of the object of thought. (7)

sanskrit: कुमारिकाखण्डः 144 । भरिताज्ञः” सदानन्दो निरपेक्षोऽविशङ्कितः । २३ निष्कले कुलचारी स न निद्रा न क्षुधा तृषा ।। ८ ।। न मनो नापि संज्ञा च विरक्तश्च सदात्मवान् । नायासो न रतिश्चैव न च शीतोष्णमेव च ॥ ९ ॥ सुखदुःखादिक सर्वं न विजानाति किञ्चन । गीता च हसिका नित्यं वाद्यचेष्टादिकं तथा ।। १० ।। धावनं वल्लनं” चैव स्वेच्छयापि प्रवर्तते । एवमादि प्रकाराणि” संपद्यन्ते यथा यथा ।। ११ । तथा तथा न भेतव्यं क्रीडितव्यं यदृच्छया । इत्येवं परमानन्द” उन्मना च सदोदिता ॥ १२ ॥ अवस्था” कथिता देव दुर्लभा तव भैरव । ३७ ३८ उपहास्यन्ति” पशवो दिव्यज्ञानबहिष्कृताः ॥ १३ ॥ ३९ •४० शास्त्रमार्गे यथा मूर्खः कुमारी स्त्रीसुखं यथा । तथा तत्त्वं न विन्दन्ति योगमार्गोपहासका : ॥ १४ ॥ अन्यथा वेदमार्गोक्तं अन्यथागमवेदितम्” । अन्यथा कौलिकं मार्ग अन्यथा पारमार्थिकम् ॥ १५ ॥ तस्माद् भ्रान्तिं त्यजेदेव निर्विकल्पं समाचरेत् । स्वयं गुरुः स्वयं शिष्यः स्वयं शक्तिः स्वयं शिवः ।। १६ ।। स्वयं स्थूलः स्वयं सूक्ष्मः” स्वयमेव परापरः । ४६ ४५ आधारयेत् तु शान्तात्मा स्वशरीरे परापरम् ॥ १७ ॥ उन्मनान्तं त यै: प्राप्तं” सिद्धास्ते शाक्तशाम्भवाः । तु ४८
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-SIX 145 (Such a one) is always master of himself (ātmavat), he is full of the Command. Always blissful, independent and free of worries, he moves in Kula within indeterminate reality (ninkala). (He does not need to) sleep. (For such a one) there is no hunger, no thirst. (8) (In that state) there is no mind or discoursive consciousness (saˆjñā) and he is detached. There is no exertion or sexual passion (rati), nor is there heat or cold. He knows nothing of pleasure and pain or anything else (of the play of opposites). (9-10ab) He always laughs, sings, and plays musical instruments and the like. He runs or rolls around (on the ground) freely as he desires. (10cd-11ab) These kind of things just happen spontaneously (in higher states of consciousness) and (so the adept) should not be afraid, but should play freely as he wishes.3 Such is Supreme Bliss and the Transmental (Energy) (unmanā) that is perpetually active (sadoditā). (11cd-12) O god, (this) state, which is hard to attain, has been explained to you. O Bhairava, those who ridicule it are fettered souls who have been deprived of divine knowledge. (13) Those who ridicule the path of Yoga do not attain (ultimate) reality (tattva). (They are) like the fool who follows the path of the treatises (on external matters) (śāstra) or the virgin (who does not know) the (sexual) pleasure of a mature woman. (14) The Vedic path is said to be one thing and Āgama is known to be another. The Kaula path is one thing and ultimate reality, another.
