(35ab) This is the (thirty-eighth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the Root Sūtra which is the Womb (yoni) of the Ocean of the Kula Tradition concerned with the language of Kaula practice (kulacaryā). It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: ऊनचत्वारिंशानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच पारम्पर्यक्रमायातं आज्ञाशेखरभाषितम् । नमामि सिद्धसन्तान' श्रीनाथं तु जगद्गुरुम् ॥ १ ॥ ऋषिभिः किन्नरैः सार्धं भूतवेतालपन्नगैः । राक्षसैर्यक्षसंघातैर्मरुतैश्च मरुद्गणैः ।। २ ।। ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्ररुद्राद्यैर्बिन्दुतारागणैस्तथा । यमवरुणकुवेराद्यैर्वसुभिर्वसुधादिभिः ॥ ३ ॥ नन्दिस्कन्दमहाकालैर्भूङ्गिञ्चण्डविनायकैः । वीरभद्रादिभिर्मुख्यैः समग्रैः परिवारितम् ।। ४॥ पुत्रकैः समयज्ञैश्च साधकाचार्ययोगिभिः । तत्त्वविद्भिरनेकैश्च योगिभिः परिवारितम् ॥ ५ ॥ समस्तयोगिनीवृन्दैः कुलजैज्ञीनयोगजैः । ज्ञानविज्ञानसंपन्नैः सहजैर्मन्त्रतन्त्रजैः ।। ६ ॥ पीठजैर्गर्भजैश्चैव क्षेत्रजैर्योनिजैस्तथा । १८ समयसंदोहजैश्चैव ँ डाकिनीराकिनीषु च ॥ ७ ॥ लाकिनीकाकिनीभिश्च शाकिनीहाकिनीषु च । अन्यैश्च विधिभिर्दिव्यैरावृतं तु निरामयैः ॥ ८ ॥ गुह्यकैः पूतनाभिश्च योगिनीभिर्विभूषितम् । आस्थानं” मण्डपं दिव्यं विचित्रं सुमनोरमम् ॥ ९ ॥ विचित्रचित्ररचितं मणिमालाविभूषितम् । अनेकवस्त्रसंच्छन्नं नानाद्रुमलतावृतम् ।। १० । प्राकारतोरणोपेत बहुरत्नोपशोभितम् ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE Concerning the Pure Division (vimalabheda) Śrīnātha meets the Goddess surrounded by her host Śrīnātha said: I salute (the teaching) that has come down through the succession of the series (of teachers and disciples) and has been expounded from the (very) pinnacle of the Command. (I salute) the lineage (santāna) of the Siddhas and Śrīnātha, the teacher of the universe. (1) The mistress of the God of the gods, Kuleśvarī, (immersed) in a state of bliss resided in a divine, beautiful and marvellous place. This was a pavilion made of wonderful pictures and adorned with jewel necklaces. Strewn with countless (kinds of precious) cloth, it was surrounded with many trees and creepers. It had ramparts and arches and was decorated with many jewels. Very beautiful with its (many) large gems, it was made by Viśvakarma (himself). (The pavilion was filled) with rnis along with the heavenly attendants (kinnara), snakes, Vetālas, ghosts, Rāknasas, assemblies of Yaknas, hosts of Maruts, Brahmā, VinSu, Indra, Rudra and the rest. The hosts (there were as numerous as) the stars and drops (in the ocean), Yama, VaruSa, Kubera and the rest, the Vasus, Vasudhā and the rest, Nandi, Skanda, Mahākāla, BhrSgi and fierce Vināyakas. It was surrounded by the chief groups (of divine beings) including Vīrabhadra and the rest along with the spiritual sons, those who know the Rule, adepts, teachers and countless yogis who know (ultimate) reality. There were all the troupes of Yoginīs, (including) those (Siddhas) born of Kula, knowledge and Yoga and, endowed with knowledge and wisdom, those born from mantra and Tantra. (There were) those who are innately such (sahaja), those born from the sacred seats, wombs, the sacred fields, the Yoni, and the meeting places (saˆdoha) of the Rule. Amongst (them were the) Õākinīs and Rākinīs along with the Lākinīs and Kākinīs, as well as the Śākinīs and Hākinīs. (Thus) adorned with Yoginīs, (it was also) surrounded by other kinds of divine and faultless beings, including Guhyakas and Pūtanās. (2-12ab)

sanskrit: 202 कुमारिकाखण्ड: महारत्नैः सुशोभाढ्यं निर्मितम् विश्वकर्मणा ।। ११ ।। तत्रस्थां देवदेवेशीं सुखावस्थां कुलेश्वरीम् । २८ २७ दृष्ट्वा तं विनयाविष्टः “ श्रीनाथः” परिपृच्छति ं ।। १२ ।। भगाख्ये श्रीकुजेशानि अनाख्ये परमेश्वरि” । ३४ संशयोऽयं ममाद्यापि अस्मिन् देवि कुलार्णवे ॥ १३ ॥ पारम्पर्यक्रमायातं पृच्छामि त्वां कुलेश्वरि । ३७ सद्योजातक्रमाम्नाय सिद्धाज्ञायोगसन्ततौ ।। १४॥ गृहभेदं तु विमलं बहुभेदार्थविस्तरम् । सर्वसंकेतकोपेतं गुह्यमत्यन्तदुर्लभम् ।। १५ ।। आज्ञाभाषासमायुक्तं” गुरुवक्त्रे कथं? स्थितम् । •४२ तमेवमभ्यर्थन ब्रूहि देवि निःसंशयं मम ।। १६ ।। कारुण्यं कुरु मे देवि शिलाशेखरभैरवि ६ । •४४ श्रीवक्रा उवाच ४७ साधु शम्भो प्रवक्ष्यामि दिशादिशं क्रमोदयम् ॥ १७ ॥ संकेतकार्थविपुल कुकारान्वयमर्णवम् । ५१ । उत्तरषट्कभेदोऽय यथा लब्ध मया पुरा ।। १८ ॥ तथा ते कथयिष्यामि शृणुष्वायतलोचनः । श्रीनाथ उवाच ५४ अद्य मे सफला देवि तपश्चर्या कुलान्वये ॥ १९ ॥ अद्य मे मोक्षसंप्राप्तिस्त्वत्प्रसादान्महाप्रभो ँ । ५९ भूयो मे तत्त्वतो ब्रूहि यथालब्ध त्वया पुरा ।। २० ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 203 When Śrīnātha, filled with humble respect (vinaya), saw this, he asked: “O you who are called the Yoni! O venerable Kujeśānī! Anākhyā (the Unnameable)! O Supreme Goddess! O goddess! You who are the ocean of Kula! Today also I have a doubt. O Kuleśvarī, (what) I am (now) asking you about is the tradition (āmnāya) of the Sadyojātakrama that belongs to the lineage (santati) of the Yoga of the Accomplished Command (siddhājñāyoga). (12cd-14) This pure variety of the House (of the Western Tradition) contains the extensive purport of many varieties. Possessing all the conventions, it is secret and extremely hard to acquire. Endowed with the language of the Command (ājñābhānā), how is it (and in what form is it) established in the teacher's mouth (and orally transmitted)? (15-16ab) O goddess, this is my (my) request. Tell me (the teaching that is) free from doubt. O goddess! Bhairavī of the Peak of the Stone!1 Be compassionate towards me (and responded to my request)." (16cd-17ab) The Higher Groups of Six (uttarana˜ka) — the Formation of the Yoni (bhagodaya) and the Emergence of the Triangle, the Hexagram and the Centre The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O Śambhu, well done! I will tell you about the arising of the Transmission in all its details (diśādiśa). (I will tell you) the extensive meaning of the convention, the ocean of the tradition (anvaya) (of the goddess) Kukārā. This is the division of the higher groups of six (uttarana˜ka) as I have acquired it in the past. I will tell it to you thus. O you who have beautiful long eyes! Listen. (17cd-19ab) Śrīnātha said: O goddess, today my practice of austerity in the Kula tradition has born fruit. Today, O great lord, I have attained liberation by your grace. Tell me about that (teaching) once more as it truly is, just as you have acquired it in the past. (19cd-20)

sanskrit: 204 कुमारिकाखण्ड: श्रीवक्रा उवाच ६२ ६४ । अकुलं च कुल ैः चैव कुलाकुलविनिश्चयम् । विकलादिकलैर्भिन्न तदूवे चन्द्रिकाकुलम् ।। २१ ।। • ६७ कादिभान्तस्वरूपेण वामाचारं कुलात्मकम् । ६८ मादिक्षान्तं गता योनिर्दक्षयोनिः अयोगिनी ।। २२ ।। 06 त्रिमात्रामुद्रितं चक्रं पू-का-ओ - जाचतुष्टयम्” । तद्बाह्ये” षट्प्रकारं तु आधाराद्याज्ञमन्तगम्” ।। २३ ॥ षट्प्रकारमिदं कौल षट्कोशकुलसंभवम् । परम परमपरं हृत्कुल कुलगोचरम् ।। २४ ।। •७७ .८० अकुलं योनिमध्यस्थ ठकाराकृतिगोलकम् । तस्यान्ते तु कलाशेषं तदूवे शकटार्धकम् ।। २५ ।। तस्याधीर्धं तदधीर्धस्फुरिताभा सुदीपवत्” । तत्रस्था परमा शक्तिस्त्रिविधा या च मूर्धनि ।। २६ ।। वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्री च विज्ञेया त्रिविधा च सा । दक्षिणे निर्गता ज्येष्ठा वामा चोत्तरमार्गगा ।। २७ ।। ताभ्यां मध्यस्थिता ँ रौद्री कलाशेषाद् “ विनिर्गता । त्रिविधा सा च विज्ञेया सूर्यावधिचरेण तु ॥ २८ ॥ कलाशेषांशको मध्ये तेन व्याप्ता भगाकृति: । ९०
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 205 The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Akula and Kula along with the realisation (viniścaya) of Kulākula and above that the Candrikā (Moonlight) Kula2a that is split up into the energies (kalā) beginning with Vikalā. (21) The Practice of the Left (vāmācāra) consists of the (letters) beginning with Ka and ending with Bha and is Kula. (The horizontal portion of the) Yoni is associated with (the letters) from Ma to K±a. The right (part of) the Yoni is conjoined with A (and the rest of the vowels).2b (22) The Wheel is stamped (mudrita) with three units (mātrā) (and there are) the four, namely, Pū (PūrSagiri), Kā (Kāmarūpa), O (OÆÆiyāSa) and Jā (Jālandhara). Outside that is (the hexagram) with six parts (na˜prakāra) beginning with the (Wheel of the) Foundation and ending with (the Wheel of the) Command. (23) This Kaula (reality) is this (group of) six parts (na˜prakara) born from the Kula of six sheaths (na˜kośa). It is the Supreme that is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent), the Kula of the Heart that is in the sphere of Kula.3 (24) Akula is located in the centre of the Yoni.4 It is a ball, the form of the letter µha.5 All the energies (kalā) are within it. Above that is the Half Cart (śaka˜ārdha).6 (25) The light of a quarter of a quarter of that (Half Cart) shines radiantly above beyond it, like a beautiful lamp. Established there (in the Light) is the Supreme Energy which, threefold, is located in the head.7 (26) She should be know to be triple as Vāmā, Jyen˜hā and Raudrī. Jyen˜hā has emerged in the right (corner), while Vāmā is on the left path. Raudrī is in the middle of these two and has emerged from the remaining energies (kalā). (27-28ab) She should be known to be triple by (her) movement that reaches the extreme limit of all things (sarvāvadhi). Her form is that of a Yoni and she is pervaded by the possessor of all the energies who is in the centre (within her).8 (28cd-29ab)

sanskrit: 206 कुमारिकाखण्डः सा योनिर्निर्मला” माया द्विगुणा सा च मेखला ।। २९ ।। शकटार्धं विजानीयात् ज्योतिरीश्वरभैरवम् । १२ कारणं योगविख्यातं भैरव भरणात्मकम् ॥ ३० ॥ आनन्दशक्तिमध्यस्थं ज्ञानविज्ञानचोदितम् । क्रमानन्दं च संशुद्धं आज्ञानन्दात्मनन्दितम् ।। ३१ ॥ नित्यानन्दकरानन्दं” आनन्दं पश्चिमान्वयम् । आनन्दसन्ततिं” ज्ञात्वा को न मुच्यति बन्धनात् ।। ३२ ।। १०१ शाश्वत वा निरानन्द २ पदे प्राप्ते निरामये । आनन्द३ तु निरानन्दं लोकत्रयप्रकाशकम् ।। ३३ ॥ प्रसर सर्वभूतानां योनिगह्वरसंज्ञया' २०५ । आनन्दोत्संगगा देवी नवदेव नवात्मकम् ॥ ३४ ॥ अवस्था उद्भवानन्दाच्चिदानन्दस्तथात्मनि“ । ११२ शकट सुषिरं तत्त्व” त्रितत्त्वगुणविश्रुतम् ।। ३५ ।। सत्त्व३ कामाख्यविज्ञानं तम जालन्धरोदितम् । ११५ ११४ रजं पूर्णगिरि : ९५ शम्भो त्रिपीठकुलनिर्णयम् ॥। ३६ ।। पिण्ड भूतक्रमेणैव उड्डियाण जगत्त्रये”” । १२३ । तद्वै२° देवो'२१ ह्यनाकार” नभमध्ये कुलात्मकम् ॥ ३७ ॥ तद्४ ज्ञेयं ज्ञानविज्ञानं तन्मोक्ष' सिद्धकौलिकम् २६ । १२७ २८ नाभिकोशस्य मध्यस्थ कौलीश खगमीश्वरम् १३० १२९ सा शक्ति: परमानन्ता कौलिनी भैरवेच्छया । ॥ ३८ ॥ कुलं तस्यास्त्रिधाभिन्नं त्रिबिन्दुश्च त्रिशेखरम् ।। ३९ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 207 That Yoni is stainless Māyā9 and, doubled, she is the girdle (mekhalā) (that surrounds the Yoni in the centre).10 Know that the Half Cart is Bhairava, the Lord of Light. (29cd-30ab) Bhairava, who is the act of filling (all things) (bharaSa)11 is the (universal) cause which is said to be Yoga. He is in the centre of the Energy of Bliss (ānandaśakti), impelled by knowledge and wisdom. (He is) the perfectly pure bliss of the Krama that is (filled with) joy (nandita) by (the goddess) who is the bliss of the Command.12 (30cd-31) Bliss, which is the delight that bestows eternal bliss, is the Western Tradition (paścimāmnāya). Who is not freed from the bonds of fettered existence, once known the Lineage of Bliss (ānandasantati)? (32) Or, the eternal Bliss of Stillness13 (nirānanda) (is realised) when one attains the flawless plane (of existence). Indeed, (true) bliss is the Bliss of Stillness that illumines the Three Worlds. It is the unfolding (prasara) of all the elements as (the reality) called the `Abyss of the Yoni' (yonigahvara). (33-34ab) Bliss is the goddess who is in union with (utsaSgagā) Navātmaka (Bhairava), the ninefold god (navadeva). (She is) the state (avasthā) (that arises) from the bliss of creation (udbhavānanda) and is the bliss of consciousness within the Self. (34cd-35ab) The Cart (śaka˜a) is the Cavity (suśira) (of the Void) and is known as the principle of the three qualities. O Śambhu, sattva is the consciousness (vijñāna) of Kāmākhya, tamas is derived from Jālandhara and rajas is PūrSagiri. (Such) is the teaching concerning the Kula of the three sacred seats. (35cd-36) The Body (piSÆa) (of Navātman) in the triple universe is, in accord with the sequence of the gross elements (bhūta), UÆÆiyāSa. That indeed, is the god, (the reality) without form which is Kula in the centre of the Void (of the transcendent).14 (37) One should known that to be the realisation of knowledge (jñānavijñāna), the liberation of the Siddhakula. Kaulīśa, the Lord in the Void (of the transcendent), is in the centre of the sheath of the navel.15 (38) She is Kaulinī, the Energy (śakti) who is paramount and endless. By Bhairava's will, her Kula is divided into three, three Points and three Peaks (śekhara). (39)

sanskrit: 208 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तत्र मध्यस्थितं लिङ्गं भैरवं तं नवात्मकम् । •९३४ कलैर्युक्त कलातीतं परायुक्त च युक्तकम् ॥ ४० ॥ तदिदं हंसरूपं तु आकाशस्थं विलक्ष्यते' १३५ । कामयेत् सा३६ च३७ वै पिण्डं नाम्ना पिङ्गलभैरवम् ।। ४१ ।। १३८ सूर्यानन्दस्य मध्यस्थं चन्द्रानन्दं कुलाकुलम् । १४० वृद्धिस्तस्यैव” मध्यस्था परा रेखान्तरङ्गता ।। ४२ ।। तच्छिव४२ चन्द्रिकालीनं साक्षात् तत् खेचरं पदम् । एवं योगगत चक्र४५ मात्रात्रयविभेदितम् ।। ४३ ॥ १४७ । उदय६ मातृकायोगं चान्यद्¨¨ जालन्धरोदयम् । वामे पूर्णक्रमं विद्याद्” दक्षिणे सिंहशासने ।। ४४ ।। १५० -१५२ । कामाख्य५१ च तदग्रस्थं योनि–ईकारमण्डितम्' खमध्यान्निर्गता'५३ सा तु क्रमेण प्रसरोद्भवम् ॥ ४५ ॥ एवं भगोदयं ज्ञानं पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् । सप्ताविंशत्पदैर्भिन्न गूढार्थ षट्प्रकारकम् ॥ ४६ ॥ ।। एवं क्रमगतैर्भेदैर्भेदयेद् गुह्यमण्डलम् । मेखला भेदभिन्ना तु नाम्ना कौमारकं क्रमम् ॥ ४७ ॥ सिंच्यमानमिदं कौलं आब्रह्मभुवनान्तिकम् । १६१ धवलं कामदेवोऽय अग्रे सृष्टिविशारदम् ।। ४८ ॥ वामे पीतधरो विष्णुः स्थितेस्तत्त्व॰ समाश्रितः । दक्षे रक्ताम्बरो ६२ रुद्रो लय कर्ता महाप्रभुः ।। ४९ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 209 There, in the centre, is the Li‰ga. It is the ninefold (navātmaka) Bhairava. Beyond the energies (kalā), he is endowed with (all) the energies. He is conjoined with Parā (the Supreme Goddess) and he conjoins (those in bondage to her).16 (40) This (Li‰ga) is the Gander (haˆsarūpa) perceived in the Void (ākāśa) (of the transcendent). And (the goddess) passionately desires the Body (piSÆa) (of Navātman)17 called Pi‰gala Bhairava. (41) Kulākula is the bliss of the Moon located in the centre of the bliss of the Sun. Its development (vrddhi) is the supreme Line (rekhā) that (represents) the interiority within the centre.18 (42) That is Śiva merged in the Moonlight (candrikā). That is the plane of the Skyfarer directly apparent.19 In this way, the Wheel that is present within Yoga is divided into three measures (mātrā).20 (43) The arising (of UÆÆiyāSa) is the Yoga of the Mothers (mātrkā).21 Another is the arising of Jālandhara on the left. Know that according to the Teaching of the Lion (siˆhaśāsana) the transmission of PūrSa is on the right. (44) The (sacred seat) called Kāma is located in front of them and is adorned with the Yoni (the letter E) and the letter Ī. She has emerged from the centre of the Void (of the transcendent) and is the generation of the extension (of emanation) (prasarodbhava) that takes place progressively.22 (45) Such is the arising of the Yoni (bhagodaya), the knowledge that has come down through the succession of the series (of teachers and disciples). It is (the Krama) divided into twenty-seven parts (pada).23 It has six sections (prakāra) and its meaning is profoundly secret. (46) In this way, one should divide up the secret maSÆala with the divisions of the Krama. The (hexagram which is the) girdle (mekhalā)24 (of the Triangle thus) divided up into sections is called the Transmission of the Youth. It sprinkles (with the nectar of realisation) this Kaula (universe) right up to the world of Brahmā. (47-48ab) Kāmadeva is in front. He is white and is skilled in emanation. VinSu, who wears yellow, is on the left. He is established in the principle of persistence. Rudra, who wears red, is on the right. He is the great lord who brings about destruction.25 (48cd-49)

sanskrit: 210 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १६६ एवं ते त्रिस्वरूपोऽय अनन्तं तु कुलक्रमम्। •९६७ इदं कुलक्रम कौल कोंकणे संप्रगीयते ॥ ५० ॥ १६९ चन्द्रपूर्ये गृहे रम्ये मेरुलिङ्गसमावृते । तत्रामृतं पिबेद् यस्तु तस्याज्ञा क्रमते ध्रुवम् ।। ५१ ।। १७० संप्रदायामृत देव शिवशक्तिसमागमम्' १७१ । प्रधानाख्यौ तु तौ पुष्पौ अम्बानाथोभयात्मक ॥ ५२ ॥ १७४ १७५ ७७ तयो: सृष्टि: समायोगात् अवर्ण तेन उच्यते । १८० आर्णवाज्ञा जगन्माता अष्टधामव्यवस्थिता ।। ५३ ।। ब्रह्माण्यादिस्थिता देव लक्ष्मी मोक्षस्वरूपिणी । पुनः सानेकधाभेदैः अष्टाष्टकविभेदिनी ॥ ५४ ॥ अतश्चैकविधाख्याता' षड्विधाक्रमशोदिता । तस्यान्वय“५ विनिष्क्रान्तं सप्तकोटिप्रमाणकम् ।। ५५ ।। लक्षकोटिसमुत्तीर्णं मन्थानभैरवागमम् । ँ तस्य मध्योद्धृत“ सार अन्वय सप्तकोटिकम् ।। ५६ ।। सर्पिवद् विमलं शास्त्रं क्रियाजाललतावृतम् । सारभूतमिदं गुह्यं उत्तमं शैवशासनम् ।। ५७ ।। प्रथमावतारभेदोऽय सृष्टिमार्गस्य निर्णयम् ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 211 Such is your triple form, the endless Kulakrama. This Kulakrama is called Kaula in Ko‰kaSa. (50) The City of the Moon is the beautiful House (of the Tradition). It is (the inner core of the maSÆala) completely covered with the Meru Li‰gas (of the letters). The Command is certainly transmitted to one who drinks the nectar there within it. (51) O god, the nectar of the tradition (saˆpradāya) is the coming together of Śiva and Śakti. These are said to be the two fundamental (pradhāna) Flowers and they are both the Mother (Ambā) and the Lord (Nātha).26 (52) The Eight Mothers and the Origin of the Scripture Emanation takes place by their union and so is called the letter A. The Command of the ocean of the letter A is the mother of the universe who resides in eight abodes.27 (53) O god, as BrahmāSī and the other (Mothers), she is Laknmī who is liberation itself. Then, by many kinds of divisions, she is divided into sixty-four (energies) (an˜ān˜aka). Then, she who is said to be (of just) one kind arises progressively sixfold (as the maSÆala). (54-55ab) Seventy million (verses) (saptako˜i) is the extent of her tradition (anvaya) that has emerged (in this way). The Manthānabhairavāgama consists of more than a million million (verses) (laknako˜i). The essence extracted from within it is (this) tradition of seventy million (verses).28 (55cd-56) (This) scripture, pure as clarified butter, is enveloped in the creeper of the network of ritual (kriyā). This secret is the essence, the most excellent Śaiva teaching (śāsana). This is the division of the first descent (into the world of the scripture). It is the teaching (nirSaya) concerning the path of emanation. (57-58ab)

sanskrit: 212 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १९६ अथ योगं प्रवक्ष्यामि योगिनीमुखनिर्गतम् ॥ ५८ ॥ भाषा ४ मुद्रा च दृष्टिश्च मातृकाक्षरपंक्तिभिः । स्थानानि देहविन्यासे गुवाम्नायक्रम त्रिधा ।। ५९ ।। यो° वेत्ति षट्प्रकार१ वै २०२ स साक्षात् पश्चिमान्वयी २०३ २०४ १९७ मठमुद्रा गुहामुद्रा योनिमुद्रा तृतीयका ॥ ६० ॥ २०६ कराला०५ पद्मिनी ५ चैव सिद्धिर्भेदे त्रिकोदितम् । २०८ सिद्धवल्लयस्त्रयं “ चैव कुलवृक्षत्रयं तथा ।। ६१ ।। क्रमं च त्रिविधं योगं बालं कौमारखेचरम् । स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं चान्यं त्रिभेदमिदमन्वयम् ।। ६२ ॥ २११ २१० २१२ पञ्चरत्नक्रमाः पञ्च ब्रह्माद्या जगति स्थिता: । मुद्रात्रयं परं ज्ञानं मठमार्ग ३ प्रकल्पितम् ॥ ६३ ॥ २१४ वसन्ताकृतिं संयोज्य षट्प्रकारमठं गृहम् । २१६ श्लोकज्ञानं १५ महादिव्यं दिव्याद् दिव्यतरं स्मृतम् २१८ । २१७ ॥ ६४ ॥ ठकारान्ते स्मृता पूर्वे कैलासं यावत् पश्चिमम् । आनन्दादिविभेदेन ज्ञातव्या मठिका च तु ।। ६५ ।। २२० २१९ गुरुतः सम्यग्”” ज्ञात्वैवं मठपूजां समारभेत्” । भुवनं २२२ च २२३ महास्थानं एकैक४ च सुखोद्गतम् ।। ६६ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 213 The Projection of the Transmissions, their Contents and Groups of Six Now I will tell (you) the Yoga that has come from the mouth of the Yoginīs. (I will tell you) the Language (bhānā) (1), the Gesture (mudrā) (2) and the Gaze (drn˜i) (3), along with the series of the letters of the alphabet (mātrkā) (4), the (sacred) places (sthāna) in the deposition (of the letters and mantras) on the body (5) and the threefold Transmission of the Masters (gurvāmnāyakrama)29 (6). He who knows (this reality with) six parts (na˜prakāra) is (truly a full and) clearly apparent member of the Western Tradition. (58cd-60ab) The Gesture of the Monastery (ma˜hamudrā), the Gesture of the Cave (guhāmudrā) and the Gesture of the Yoni (yonimudrā) as the third.30 The (goddesses) Karālā (Horrific), Padminī and Siddhi (Success) have arisen from (this) triad within (this) division (bheda). (60cd-61ab) There are three lines (vallī) of Siddhas and three Kula trees. The Transmission (krama) is the threefold Yoga of the Child, Youth and the Skyfarer. This Tradition (anvaya) (consists of the triad of) gross, subtle and supreme and (every) other triple division.31 (61cd-62) The sequences of the Five Jewels, namely, the five beginning with Brahmā, are established in the universe.32 (Knowledge of) the three Gestures is the supreme knowledge conceived to be the Path of the Monastery (ma˜hamārga). (63) Once the form of spring has been added (?),33 the House (of the hexagram), which is the Monastery34 with six parts, (is complete). (64ab) The knowledge of the Verses is very divine. (Indeed) it is said to be more divine than the divine.35 (64cd) (The goddess) was previously said to be within the letter µha (that represents the Point)36 (and in all the maSÆala) up to Kailāsa in the west. Again, one should know the Monastery (ma˜hikā) with (its) divisions into Ānanda and the rest.37 (65) Once this has been correctly known in this way from the teacher, one should commence the rite of adoration of the Monastery (ma˜hapūjā). The world (bhuvana) and the Great Place (mahāsthāna)38 — each single one has arisen out of bliss. (66)

sanskrit: 214 कुमारिकाखण्ड: मठ १२५ मुद्रा क्रम२६ भेदं निर्णीतं सप्तकोटिषु । •२२७ इदं भेदवरं गुह्यं यो जानाति स देशिक: २३० आनन्दश्चावलिश्चैव प्रभुर्योगी तथैव च । २३१ •२३२ २२९ ।। ६७ ।। अतीतश्चैव पादश्च षट्प्रकारं कुलक्रमम् ॥ ६८ ॥ षोडशारं महानन्दं द्वादशारं तु आवली । २३३ दशारं प्रभुरित्युक्तं षडारं योगिसंज्ञकम् ॥ ६९ ॥ चतुरारमतीतं च द्विकार४ पदसंज्ञया । षट्प्रकारमिदं३५ ज्ञानं श्लोकार्थस्य प्रबोधकम् ।। ७० ।। यो वेत्ति३६ श्लोकपाठज्ञ : २३७ स कुले सिद्धिभाग् भवेत् । चतुष्कं पञ्चकं चैव त्रिकं अम्बासमन्वितम् ।। ७१ ॥ त्रिप्रकारमिदं कौलं पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् । इदं बालक्रमं शम्भो गोपितं तु मया पुरा ।। ७२ ।। चतुष्कं पञ्चकं षट्कं चतुष्कं पञ्चकं त्रिकम् । षट्प्रकाराणि यो वेत्ति सबाह्याभ्यन्तराणि च ।। ७३ । स योग्य: क्रमिको ज्ञेयः अन्यथा नामधारकः । इदं कौमारकं देव क्रमं योगिनिवल्लभम् ।। ७४ ॥ पूर्वैव तु मयाख्यातं क्रमं कौमाररूपिणम् । २४० २४१ चत्वारि च चतुष्कानि पञ्चकाः पञ्च एव च ।। ७५ ।। षट् षट्कानि”” वरारोह त्रिकाणि त्रितयं तथा । षट्प्रकारमिदं देव खेचरक्रम५ निर्भयम् ।। ७६ ।। खेचरं सिद्धसन्तानं मयाद्य प्रकटीकृतम् ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 215 The division into Monastery (ma˜ha), Gesture (mudrā) and the Transmission has been explained in the (scripture of) seventy million (verses). He who knows this, the most excellent division, is a teacher. (67) The Location of the Kulakrama in the Six Wheels The Kulakrama has six aspects, namely, Ānanda, Āvali, Prabhu, Yogin, Atīta and Pāda.39 The sixteen spoked (Wheel) is Mahānanda, the twelve spoked (Wheel) is Āvali, the ten spoked (Wheel) is said to be Prabhu, while the six spoked (Wheel) is called Yogin. The four spoked (Wheel) is Atīta, while the two spoked (Wheel) goes by the name of Pāda.40 This knowledge, which awakens to the meaning of the Verses, has six aspects. The one who knows the recitation of the Verses and knows this (in every way) is successful (siddhibhāk). (69-71ab) The Six Groups in the Four Transmissions The Transmission of the Child This Kaula, which has come down through the succession of the series (of teachers and disciples), has three aspects namely, the Tetrad, the Pentad and the Triad along with the Mother (Ambā). O Śambhu, this is the Transmission of the Child I have concealed in the past. (71cd-72) The Transmission of the Youth The six aspects are: the Tetrad, the Pentad, the Hexad, the Tetrad, the Pentad and the Triad. He who knows them in (their) internal and external (forms) should be known to be a suitable member of the Krama (kramika), otherwise he is so (only) in name. O god, this is the Transmission of the Youth, pleasing to the Yoginīs. I have explained (this same) Transmission of the Youth before.41 (73-75ab) The Transmission of the Skyfarers Four tetrads, five pentads, six hexads, a triad of triads, O handsome one, this is the fearless Transmission of the Skyfarers that has six aspects.42 Today, I have revealed the Khecara (Skyfaring) lineage (santāna) of the Siddhas. (75cd-77ab)

sanskrit: 216 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २४६ चतुष्कानि तु चत्वारि पञ्चकं पञ्चधागतम् ।। ७७ ।। २४७ षट्क षड्विधाभिन्नं चतुष्कं चतुः प्रकारतः । पञ्चकं पञ्चधाभिन्नं त्रिधा त्रिकमतः परम् ॥ ७८ ॥ इदं वृद्धक्रमं स्थूलं सिद्धयोगिनिसेवितम् २४८ । वृद्धभाव” मया देव तथैव प्रकटीकृतम् ॥ ७९ ।। अभिगुप्ततरं कार्यं २ अन्वयं पारमेश्वरम् । २५२ षट्प्रकारं ५३ स्वरूपेण ज्ञातव्यं च कुलक्रमम् ॥ ८० ॥ •२५४ एवं ५४ चतुर्विधं ज्ञानं क्रमं प्रत्ययपूर्वकम् । २५६ सबाह्याभ्यन्तरैकत्वे५५ यो वेत्ति स च देशिकः ।। ८१ ।। एवं क्रमत्रयं देव संहितार्थमुदीरितम् । यो २५७ वेत्ति श्रीमतं देव गुप्तसंकेतसंज्ञया ।। ८२ ॥ स भवेन्नाथसायोज्य : २५८ श्रीकुलागमवेदकः । ठकारान्ते २५९ महापीठे कलौ प्राप्ते तु सुन्दर ।। ८३ ।। गोपित श्रीगुहायां तु कनकमञ्जरिमन्दिरे । संकेतकेन गुह्येन कृतं‍ समयपूर्वकम् ॥ ८४ ॥ २६४ नाभिवर्तिरहीका ३ च वज्रसन्धिः कपाटयोः । संकेतान् वेत्ति योऽप्यत्र५ तस्य देयं कुलागमम् ।। ८५ ॥ श्रीनाथ उवाच २६६ २६८ । संकेतक २७ महागुह्यं दुर्बोधं देवदुर्लभम् । कारुण्येन समाख्याहि परमार्थेन निर्भयम् ॥ ८६ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 217 The Transmission of the Aged Four tetrads, the Pentad multiplied five times, the Hexad divided into six kinds, the Tetrad of four kinds, the Pentad divided in five ways and, after that, the Triad of three kinds — this is the gross Transmission of the Aged (vrddhakrama) attended by Siddhas and Yoginīs. (77cd-79ab) O god, in this way, I have revealed the state of the (Transmission of the) Aged. It is the tradition (anvaya) of the Supreme Lord and should be kept extremely well protected (abhiguptatara). One should know the essential nature of the Kulakrama with six parts.43 (79cd-80) Such is the fourfold knowledge, the Transmission based on realisation (pratyayapūrvaka). He who knows it along with the oneness of (its) inner and outer (forms) is (truly) a teacher. (81) In this way, O god, the Triple Transmission is said to be the (most essential) meaning of (this) scripture (saˆhitā). O god, he who knows the Śrīmata along with the terminology of the secret convention is one who knows the scripture (āgama) of the Śrīkula and is fit to be conjoined with the Lord (Nātha). (82-83ab) O handsome one, when the Age of Strife began, it was hidden in the great sacred seat, that is, in the letter µha (that is, the Point), which is the Cave44 of the venerable (goddess śrīguhā) in the temple of the spring of gold (kanakamañjarimandira). This was done, in accord with the Rule, by means of the secret convention. (83cd-84) The Wick of the Navel is the female serpent and the Conjuction of the Thunderbolt (vajrasandhi) of the two door panels. The Kula scripture should be given to one who knows the conventions here also.45 (85) Śrīnātha said: The great secret of the convention is hard to understand and hard to acquire (even) by the gods. Out of compassion tell (me that which is) free from fear as it truly is. (86)

sanskrit: 218 श्रीवक्रा उवाच २७० •२७१ २७२ कुमारिकाखण्डः मूलं नाभिः कुल मेरुर्वर्तिरात्मा २ च २३ मालिनी । पारम्पर्यमहिज्ञानं सन्धिराज्ञाक्रमोदयम् ।। ८७ ।। त्रिसिद्धोलित्रयं २७५ हृद्गं२६ अवतारत्रयं • २७७ तथा । २८० २८१ ।। ८८ ।। एकधा चतुर्भेदै: २७८ चतुधी च ९ त्रिधा पुनः यो वेत्ति कुलभेदं तु स भवेत् क्रमपालकः । कूटत्रयं त्रिबीजं तु शक्तिबीजं परापरम् ।। ८९ ॥ अष्टकं च नवात्मानं षोढा द्वादशभेदतः । -२८३ २८४ २८५ खेचरं खेचरीमार्ग तथा च समयक्रमम् ॥ ९० ॥ वृक्षं वज्रकुलो द्वीपं षट्कोणाख्यं कपाटयोः । एतद् दीपनविज्ञानं कादिभेदे उदाहृतम् ।। ९१ ॥ २८७ २८८ कुलक्रमं च विद्या च समयमण्डलक्रमम् एवं यो वै विजानाति स भवेत् मतबोधकः २९१ त्रितत्त्वं च त्रिबीजं च चतुष्कं षट्कमेव च । २९२ २९० ।। ९२ ।। षट्कं तु अष्टकं चान्यं गुरुवक्त्रात् तु लभ्यते ॥ ९३ ॥ तत्त्वावतारमित्युक्तं क्रमं गुरुमुखाद् विदुः । २९४ पञ्च पञ्च परापञ्चौं अपरापञ्च एव९५ च । ९४ ॥ षट्कं षट्कं पुनः षट्कं षट्क चैव तथापरम् । । चतुष्कं चतु:संयुक्तं द्विकं च द्विविधं मतम् ।। ९५ ।। दशकं तु मया प्रोक्तं सुन्दर क्रमकौमारम् । २९७ २९८ पञ्च पञ्च तथा पञ्च अपरं षट्कमेव च विमलक्रमभेदं”” तु पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् । ।। ९६ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 219 The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: The Navel is the Root. Kula is Meru while the Wick is the Self and Mālinī. (The teaching) belonging to the succession (of teachers and disciples) is the Knowledge of the Snake. The Conjunction is the arising of the Transmission of the Command (ājñākrama).46 (87) The three lineages (oli) of the three Siddhas in the heart and the three incarnations (avatāra), one kind with four divisions, four kinds and then three kinds — he who knows the Kula variety (kulabheda) is one who guards the Transmission (krama). (88-89ab) The three Peak (syllables), the three seed-syllables, the Seed of Energy, superior and inferior, the Octad, the ninefold (navātman), the sixfold (noÆhā) and that divided into twelve. (89cd-90ab) The Skyfarer (Khecara), the path of Khecarī, and the Transmission of the Rule (samayakrama), the Tree, the Kula of the Thunderbolt (vajra) and the Island — (this is) called the hexagram of the two door panels.47 This is the knowledge of the energization (dīpana) declared in the division beginning with KĀ (kādibheda). (90cd-91) He who knows the Kulakrama, the Vidyā, the Krama of the MaSÆala of the Rule is one who awakens (others to the meaning of the) Mata. (92) (An explanation of) the Triple Principle, the Triple Seed, the Tetrad, the Hexad, another Hexad and the Octad (can be) had from the teacher's mouth. This is the Transmission called the Descent of the Principles (tattvāvatāra) the (wise) know from the teacher's mouth.48 (93-94ab) Five and five, the five of the (goddess) Parā, the five of the (goddess) Aparā, the Hexad, the Hexad and, again, the Hexad and, after that, another Hexad, the Tetrad which is along with the four, while the pair is said to be of two kinds. O handsome one, I have declared the group of ten constituting the Transmission of the Youth. (94cd-96ab) The five, five and five along with the other Hexad is the division of the Pure Transmission (vimalakrama) that has come down through the succession of the series (of teachers and disciples). (96cd-97ab)

sanskrit: 220 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३०२ चतुश्चैव चतुष्कानि अपराणि चतुस्तथा ।। ९७ ।। अपरं तु त्रिकं विद्या बीजानि द्वादशानि वै । एवं पीठक्रमं देव पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् ।। ९८ ॥ एवं प्रकार यो वेत्ति स क्रमे वीरवन्दित: । ३०६ ३०४ ३०५ द्वादशानि तु श्लोकानि मुद्रासमयमण्डलम् ॥ ९९ ॥ गोपनीय प्रयत्नेन पठ्यते न च लिख्यते । ३१० द्वादशानि च श्लोकानि सुगुप्तानि” वरानन ॥१०० ॥ प्रमादाद् दीयते नैव कर्णात् कणीन्तगोचरम् ३ । ३११ तं ज्ञात्वा तु भवेत् सिद्धिः ४ उच्चारादेव जायते ॥ १०१ ॥ ३१७ षट्प्रकाराधिकारज्ञः पञ्चरत्नविभूषितः । अम्बाद्वादशपाठज्ञः”“ शक्तिबीजपरायणः ।। १०२ ॥ आदृष्टा”” खेचरीमुद्रा तथा विद्यात्रयं गुरु: । एवं विज्ञायते यो हि स भवेन्मतबोधक: ३२४ ३२२ ३२१ ।। ॥ १०३ ॥ ईदृशं च गुरुं प्राप्य को न मुच्यति बन्धनात् । विद्याद्वयसमायुक्ता“ तथा वै महतारिका ३२६ ३२७ कूटषट्कं महाशम्भो तारकाष्टकमालिनी । ।। १०४ ॥ एवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वज्ञो“ स गुरुर्मोक्षदायकः ॥ १०५ ॥ ३२९ ३३० ।। आदौ पीठचतुष्कं तु चत्वारः पीठदेवता:' । पञ्चकं रत्नसंज्ञं च योगषट्क ३३२ तथापरम् ॥। १०६ ।। सिद्धाश्चत्वारमन्यच्च३३ पञ्चकं विमलाज्ञया । सिद्धत्रिक ३३४ चापरं च ३५ अम्बानाथ तथैव च ।। १०७ ।। षट्प्रकारसमोपेतं पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् । ३३७ न्यासक्रियासमायुक्तं आदिपुष्पं चतुष्टयम् ॥ १०८ ॥ सिञ्च्यते३३८ नात्र” संदेहो आज्ञाभङ्ग न कारयेत् । ३४३ एवं देव मताख्यातं‍ रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ॥१०९ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 221 Four tetrads and another four, the other Triad, the Vidyā and the twelve seed-syllables — such, O god, is the Transmission of the Sacred Seats that has come down through the succession of the series (of teachers and disciples). He who know (this) aspect (prakāra) (out of the six) is praised in the Transmission by the Heroes. (97cd-99ab) The Gesture, the MaSÆala of the Rule and the Twelve Verses49 should be kept hidden with effort. (All this) should be studied (with a teacher). It has not been written down. (99cd-100ab) O handsome one, the Twelve Verses are kept well hidden. (The teaching transmitted orally, whispered) from ear to ear is not to be given carelessly. (But) having known it, success (siddhi) comes by the utterance (of the mantras). (100cd-101) He who, adorned with the Five Jewels,50 knows the authority of the six parts and the reading of the Mother's (Ambā) Twelve (Verses) and is intent on the seed-syllable of power (AI¤), has seen the Gesture of the Skyfarer (khecarīkrama) and (knows) the Three Vidyās is a teacher who awakens (others to the meaning of the) tradition (mata). Who is not freed from bondage once he has obtained a teacher such as this? (102-104ab) O Mahāśambhu, the knower of reality who knows the Mahantārikā (Vidyā) conjoined with the (other) two Vidyās, the six Peak (syllables), the Octad of Tāraka and Mālinī is a teacher who bestows liberation. (104cd-105) First comes the Tetrad of four sacred seats and the four deities. The Pentad is that denoted as the (five) Jewels.51 Then comes the Hexad of Yoga. There are four Siddhas, and another is the Pentad along with the Pure Command (vimalājñā). Next comes the other triad of Siddhas and Ambānātha. (Thus the teaching) that has come down through the succession of the series (of teachers and disciples) has six aspects. (106-108ab) The first Flower, which is the group of four (transmissions?), is linked to the rite of the deposition (nyāsa) (of syllables and mantras on the body). There is no doubt here that it is (regularly) watered (in this way). One should not cause (any) transgression of the Command. O god, in this way, the Mata, the supremely astonishing secret, has been explained. (108cd-109)

sanskrit: 222 कुमारिकाखण्ड: पीठमण्डलसंकेत वर्णराशिस्तथैव च । लिङ्गं वै४५ मालिनी चाष्टौ तथा चास्त्रचतुष्टयम् ॥। ११० ।। पञ्चमूल तथा योगं चत्वारो गृहनिर्णयम् । •३४६ ३४७ नवभेदमिद४८ देव यो वेत्ति स च देशिकः ।। १११ ।। ३५० गृहाः क्षेत्राश्च पीठाश्च पीठद्वारचतुष्टयम् । उपपीठाश्च५ संदोहा:५२ षड्विधं मुक्तिलक्षणम् ।। ११२ ।। मुद्रात्रितयसंकेतं पीठसंकेतमेव ३५४ च । •३५५क •३५६क ३५६ख स्थानसंकेतक चैव २५५ख पुष्पसंकेतक पुष्पसंकेतक तथा ।। ११३ ।। वर्णराशिस्तथैव च । अधिकारत्रयं चैव ३५६ग तु मण्डलं त महेशान मम ३५७क ३५८ ३५७ख मुद्रेति संज्ञया ।। ११४ ।। एतानि नवसंकेता यो जानाति स चान्वये । तस्य पट्टचतुष्कं तु आरावीचार्यमेव ( ? ) च ।। ११५ ।। कृत्वा दण्डनमस्कार सर्वस्वं विनिवेदयेत् । प्रदक्षिणशतं कृत्वा साष्टाङ्गेन नमस्करेत् ।। ११६ ।। यद्येवं न विजानाति ११ तदा नैव नमस्करेत् । प्रणामे न कृते देव आज्ञाया हरणं भवेत् ।। ११७ ।। आज्ञाहीनो जपेल्लक्षं तीव्राज्ञा संप्रवर्तते । अथवा न जपेल्लक्षं च्छिद्रं तस्य प्रजायते ।। ११८ ।। म्रियते अचिराद् देव विषमे कुलगोचरे १२ । ३६२ । श्रीक्रमस्याग्रतो देव६३ तथा स्वगुरुसन्निधौ ।। ११९ ।। सुप्रसिद्धे तथा ज्येष्ठे डम्भमायाविवर्जिते ६४ । । एतेषां३६५ मण्डलं कार्य अन्येषां तद्विलोमकृत् ।। १२० ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 223 The convention concerning the maSÆala of the Sacred Seats, the Assembly of Letters, the Li‰ga, Mālinī, the Eight, the four Weapons, the Root of the Five, Yoga and the teaching concerning the Four Houses — O god, he who knows this ninefold division is a (true) teacher. (110-111) The houses, the (sacred) fields, the sacred seats, the four doors of the sacred seats, the secondary sacred seats, and the meeting places (saˆdoha) — (this is) the sixfold characteristic of liberation. (112) The nine conventions are (as follows): the convention of the three Gestures, the convention of the sacred seats, the convention of the (sacred) places (sthānasaˆketa), the convention of the flowers,52 the three (types of) authority, the Assembly of Letters,53 the maSÆala and, O Great Lord, that which is called my Gesture. He who knows them is a (true member) of the tradition (anvaya).54 (113-115ab) * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *55 Having first prostrated full length (before the teacher) one should offer (him all one's) wealth. Having circumambulated (him) a hundred times, one should salute (him) by prostrating full length (before him). (115cd-116) If (the teacher does not know these things) in this way, then one should not salute (him) like this. But, O god, if (a true teacher) is not saluted (in the right way) the Command is taken away (from the disciple). (117) An intense Command operates (for one) who, devoid of the Command, repeats (these mantras) a hundred thousand times. But, if he does not repeate (them) a hundred thousand times, he is at fault. O god, he dies in a short time in a family adverse (to him). (118-119ab) O god, (one should do this) in front of the Śrīkrama, in the presence of the teacher (or) that of a well known elder who is free of deceit and delusion. (119cd-120ab) One should fashion their maSÆala. (He who makes one for those who are unworthy of it) acts in a manner contrary (to the Rule) (vilomakrt). (120cd)

sanskrit: 224 कुमारिकाखण्ड: । कूटमेकं द्वियुग्मं तु तथा वै पुष्पपञ्चकम् । संज्ञाकूटक्रमं सूत्रं गुरुवक्त्राच्च लभ्यते ।। १२१ । तस्माद्”” गुरोः परं नास्ति इत्याज्ञा च कुलान्वये । ३६९ •३७० अथान्यक्रमभेद” तु त्रिविधं तद् ब्रवीम्यहम् ।। १२२ ।। शाक्तेयं शाम्भवं चैव २ आणवं च तृतीयकम् । ३७७ ३७८ षट् सिद्धाः षड्युगाश्चैव षड्योगिन्यः¨¨ षडध्वगाः षट्पीठानि च षड्मुद्रा यो वेत्ति स कुलक्रमे स योन्यन्ते७९ च° सन्ताने शेषा पुस्तकवाचकाः ३७५ । ।। १२३ ।। ३८२ ।। १२४ ॥ सिद्धाश्चत्वार देवैश्च३ रत्नपञ्चकभूषितम् । महन्तारीपञ्चक चैव८५ तथा पीठचतुष्टयम् ॥ १२५ ॥ ३८६ •३८७ ।। ।। पुनरथ चतुष्कं तु षट्प्रकारं क्रमं त्विदं । एवं शाक्तेयभेदं तु कथितं ते मया पुरा ।। १२६ ।। ३८९ ३९० शेषान्ये ९ आणवाः प्रोक्ताः” सिद्धाः पञ्चाशत् कौलिका: ३९४ एवमाणवभेद तु सर्वमेतच्चतुर्युगे ।। १२७ ।। योन्यार्णव”५ समाख्यातं उक्तं त्विदं क्रमोदयम् । मुद्रात्रयसमोपेतं मन्थानमठविश्रुतम् ।। १२८ ॥ ३९९ यक्षिणी”“ रूपमध्यस्था गुप्तसंज्ञा तदग्रतः । तस्मादाज्ञा विनिष्क्रान्ता प्रत्ययश्चाधिकारिणी ॥ १२९ ॥ शङ्खिनी शङ्खिनी तत्र शङ्खमुद्रा द्वितीयका ४०१ । प्रसिद्धं कामरूपं तु सुप्रसिद्धं गुरुक्रमम् ।। १३० ॥ मुद्रात्रयसमोपेतं शङ्खमठमुद्राहृतम् । देवीगुहा सिद्धगुहा कदम्बाख्या त्रितीयकी ।। १३१ ।। योनिमुद्रा तथा देव प्रसादात्“ लभ्यते क्वचित् । देवीमुद्रा त्रिधा चैव पुरा तव प्रकाशिता ।। १३२ ।। ३९२ ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 225 One Peak (syllable), two pairs (yugma) and the Pentad of Flowers. (By reciting these syllables) one obtains the Sūtra (that teaches) the sequence of the names and Peak (syllables) (that are not found in books) from the teacher's mouth. Therefore, the Command in the Kula tradition is that there is nothing greater than the teacher. (121-122ab) Now I will tell (you about) another variety of the Transmission which is of three kinds, (namely), Śākteya, Śāmbhava and ĀSava as the third.56 (122cd-123ab) The six Siddhas, the six Ages, the six Yoginīs residing on the six Paths (adhvan), the six sacred seats and the six Gestures — he who knows (these things) is a (true member) of the Kulakrama. He (lives) in the Yoni and (is a part of) the lineage (santāna). All others (merely) speak about (what they have read in) books.57 (123cd-124) The four Siddhas, along with (the four) gods, (the group) decorated with the Five Jewels, the Pentad of Mahantārī, the four sacred seats and then a group of four — this is the Transmission with six aspects. Such is the Śākteya division I have told you about before.58 (125-126) All the remaining ones are said to be the fifty ĀSava Kaulika Siddhas. Such is the ĀSava division. All this (is revealed) in the fourth Age. (127) It is called the Ocean of the Yoni (yonyārSava) and is said to be this arising of the Transmission. It has the three Gestures and is well known as the Monastery of the Churning (Bhairava) (manthānama˜ha). (128) YakniSī is located in the middle of Form (rūpa). In front of that is (the goddess) whose name is secret. The Command that carries authority is realisation (pratyaya) and it has emerged from that. (129) Śa‰khinī who holds a conch (śa‰khinī) reside there with the Gesture of the Conch (śa‰khamudrā) which is the second. Kāmarūpa is well known and so is the Transmission of the Teachers (gurukrama) that, possessing the three Gestures, is said to be the Monastery of the Conch (śa‰khama˜ha). (130-131ab) Devīguhā (the Cave of the Goddess), Siddhaguhā (the Cave of the Siddhas), the one called Kadambā as the third and, O god, the Gesture of the Yoni (yonimudrā). One acquires this somewhere by (my) grace. I have (already) revealed the triple Gesture of the Goddess (devīmudrā) to you in the past. (131cd-132)

sanskrit: 226 कुमारिकाखण्ड: कुचुकुलाकुली चैव देवी नाम त्रिकं तथा । मि-ओ- षचर्यनामानि सिद्धसन्तानसंज्ञया ४०७ ।। १३३ ।। शृङ्गाटकेश्वरं नाथं रत्नत्रिकं प्रकीर्तितम् । पीठाश्चोपपीठाश्चैव पीठसिद्धा वरानन ।। १३४ ॥ चतुधी सिद्धसन्तानं तच्च उलित्रिके क्रमात् । ४११ ४१० अथ”” सिद्धं परं बिन्दुभैरवममृताम्बरम् २ ।। १३५ ।। कलिस्यान्ते मतङ्गीशं पञ्चमपीठनायकम् । तत्रस्थं युग्मभेदं तु एका मुद्रा कुलान्वये ।। १३६ ।। लिङ्ग–उली भवेत् तत्र बालानामेन विश्रुता । एवं पीठावतारं तु कलिस्यान्ते न संशयः ।। १३७ ।। ४१७ शङ्खं शक्तिस्तथा योग महागृहं चतुर्थकम् । पदं चन्द्रपुरं प्रोक्तं षट्कं चैव विरामणम् ४२ ॥ १३८ ॥ अतीतमावली २३ चैव उत्तरौ परिकीर्तितौ ४२४ । तस्योत्तमं वरारोह ४२५ आनन्दं कुले गृहान् च×२८ यो वेत्ति ४२९ । ४२७ नवमं गृहम् ॥ १३९ ॥ स कले४३० सिद्धिभाग् भवेत् । उड्डामरं सिद्धकौलं गणाख्यं खेचरीमतम् ।। १४० ।। ४३२ चण्डाख्यं४३१ रौरवं चैव घोराख्यं भूतडामरम् । नवमं च महाकौलं आज्ञा यत्र प्रकाशिता एकमूल४ स्थितं कौलं नवधा परिपाटितम् ।। १४१ ॥ ४३५ । सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं ज्ञात्वा को न मुच्येत बन्धनात् ।। १४२ ।। गुर्वाज्ञामाश्रयं भेदं गुप्तं वै पीठपञ्चकम् । ४३८ अधिकारत्रयं देव सृष्टिनाथं सदाशिवम् ॥ १४३ ॥ •४४० शब्दराशिरघोर्यष्टौ तद्ग्रही तद्वहनं तथा ।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 227 The goddess is the triad Kucā, Kulā and Akulī. The names (of the teachers), according to the (secret) terminology of the lineage of Siddhas (siddhasantāna), are MI (Mitranātha), O (OÆÆīśanātha), ±A (±an˜hanātha) and Carya (Caryānātha). (133) The lord (Nātha) is ŚrSgā˜akeśvara (the Lord of the Triangle) and is said to be the Triad of Jewels. O handsome one, the (primary) sacred seats and the secondary seats along with the Siddhas of the sacred seats and the Line of the Siddhas is fourfold and that is present in the three Lineages (uli) in due order. (134-135ab) Now, the supreme Siddha is Bindubhairava who is clothed in the nectar (of immortality). At the end of the Age of Strife (he manifests as) Mata‰gīśa, the lord of the fifth sacred seat.59 (135cd-136ab) The Division of the Couple (yugmabheda)60 is located there and (so is) the one Gesture in the Kula Tradition. The (goddess of) the Lineage of the Li‰ga known by name as the Child (Bālā) is (also) there. Such, without a doubt, is the descent (of the deity) (avatāra) into the sacred seats that takes place at the end of the Kali Age. (136cd-137) Śa‰kha (Conch), Śakti (Energy) and Yoga (Union) with Mahāgrha (Great House) as the fourth, the Pada (the Place) and Candrapura (the City of the Moon) are said to be the Hexad which is repose. Atīta (Beyond) and Āvalī are said to follow after. O handsome one, better than that is Ānanda (Bliss), the ninth house.61 He who knows the Houses in the Kula is successful in the Age of Strife. (138-140ab) 1) UÆÆāmara, 2) Siddhakaula, the one called 3) GaSa, 4) Khecarīmata, 5) the one called CaSÆa,62 6) Raurava, 7) the one called Ghora,63 8) BhūtaÆāmara and 9) Mahākaula, as the ninth where the Command has been revealed. (140cd-141) The Kaula (teaching) has one root and is said to be ninefold. Once one has known it internally and externally, who is not freed from bondage? (142) The group of five sacred seats is the secret division that rests on the teacher's Command. O god, the three positions of authority (adhikāra), Srn˜inātha, Sadāśiva and the Assembly of Sounds, the eight Aghorīs, Tadgrahī **** (?). (143-144ab)

sanskrit: 228 कुमारिकाखण्ड: मालिनीषोढासंकेत षोढा द्वादशभेदतः ।। १४४ ॥ ४४४ । षोढा षष्ठा ४२ परा षोढा षोढा ३ षोढ़िणी कौलिनी ४४५ शवरी षोढा ४६ सा४४७ षोढी४४८ अष्टधा षोढसंज्ञया ४९ ॥ १४५ ॥ ४५० ४५१ एवं चाष्टविधा षोढा गूढार्थेन प्रकाशिता । यो वेत्ति४५२ षोढाविन्यास ५३ स४४ भवेत् कुलनन्दनः -४५७ ।। ४५५ ।। १४६ ।। परा एकाक्षरा षोढा षोढी ४५६ व्योम समाख्याता' । चतुर्दशभुवनोपेता ठबिन्दुकुलशेखरा ।। १४७ ॥ ४६३ शक्तिकुण्डलिमध्यस्था॰ सा६१ देवी६२ जगमातरः । सा परा परमा काली कला वै पारमेश्वरी ६५ ।। १४८ ॥ ४६४ ४६७ तथा ६६ प्रकाशितामात्रा पुनरागमनं कुतः । ४६८ जीवमुद्रा स्मृता ह्येषा निर्णीता सप्तकोटिषु ॥ १४९ ॥ गुरुवक्त्रं गुरुदीप आलयं पारमेश्वरम् । • ४७२ तद्वक्त्राल्लभ्यते४७१ ज्ञान तच्छ्रुत्वा¨¨ नान्यथा यतः ।। १५० ।। ४७७ अथ४०४ ते४७५ नवसंकेता: सूत्रार्थेन शृणुष्व तत् । ४७९ मुद्रा च त्रिविधा चैका गुप्ता वै पीठपञ्चके ॥ १५१ ॥ स्थानसंज्ञाश्रमं षट्कं पुष्पदेवकृतं युगम् । •४८० अधिकारत्रयं गुह्यं श्लोकार्थं वर्णराशिकम् ।। १५२ ।। मण्डल८२ त्रिविध८३ प्रोक्तं मुद्रा वै परमेश्वरी । ४८४ ४८६ तारकं समये ४८५ सारं संज्ञा वै महतारिका ॥ १५३ ॥ अतिगुप्ततराः सर्वे लभ्यन्ते गुरुवक्त्रतः । ४८९ ४९० एवं विचारयेद्“ यो हि स भवेत् सिद्धशासने ।। १५४ ।।
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 229 1) The ±oÆhā convention of Mālinī, 2) ±oÆhā associated with the Twelve, 3) the ±oÆhā of the Sixty, 4) the supreme ±oÆhā, 5) ±oÆhā, 6) ±oÆhinī 7) Kaulinī, and 8) Śavarī ±oÆhā — (the Energy) ±oÆhī is eightfold as is the name ±oÆhā (noÆhāsaˆjñā). (144cd-145) Thus, the eightfold ±oÆhā has been revealed along with (its) hidden meaning. He who knows the deposition of ±oÆhā64 is the delight of the Kula. (146) ±oÆhā is the Supreme One Syllable (Vidyā),65 ±oÆhī is called the Sky.66 She possesses the fourteen worlds and is the summit of the Kula of the Point µha.67 (147) The goddess in the middle of the KuSÆalinī of Energy (śakti) is the mother of the universe. She is the Supreme (goddess) (Parā), the supreme Kālī, the energy (kalā) of the Supreme Goddess (Parameśvarī). (148) The mere revelation (of the goddess) in this way (puts an end to) the repeated return (to this world of transmigration). She is said to be the Seal of the Living Being (jīvamudrā) and is taught in (the scripture of) seventy million (verses). (149) Knowledge is obtained from the mouth (called) the teacher's mouth, the teacher's light (gurudīpa) and the abode of the Supreme Lord's (scripture) (pārameśvara).68 (One acquires it) once one has heard it (uttered from there, not from books) or in any other way. (150) The Nine Conventions Now listen to the nine conventions in accord with the meaning of the Sūtra. There is one Gesture, which is of three kinds, kept hidden in the five sacred seats. The names of the (sacred) places (sthāna), the group of six Hermitages, the pair created by Punpadeva (the god of the Flowers), the three positions of authority, the secret meaning of the Verses, the Aggregate of Letters and the maSÆala, which is said to be threefold.69 The Gesture is, indeed, the Supreme Goddess. The Tāraka (Saviour mantra) is the essence of the Rule while the (secret) name (saˆjñā) is Mahātārikā. (151-153) All these are most secret. They can be obtained (only) from the teacher's mouth. He who reflects in this way is a part of the Siddha Tradition (siddhaśāsana). (154)

sanskrit: 230 अथ षट्कं स्वरूपेण ४९४ डा रक्तोदरा का लका कुम्भा भगोदरा ४९५ ४९६ख कुमारिकाखण्ड: निग्रह९२ परिभाष्यते ४९६क ४९३ । कराला लम्बकोदरा ।। १५५ ।। ४९७ कका चैव कृशोदरा । ५०० शका ४९८ यक्षोदरा ९ घोरा हा ४९९ घोरा हका रक्षोदरा कुला ।। १५६ ॥ ५०४ । एवं सा षड्विधा' कार्याी चिञ्चामाता ३ च विश्रुता एतासा“ देवताना च पूजा कुर्यात् कुलान्वये“ ।। १५७ ।। ५०९ ज्योतिर्वस्त्र तथा दीपं कपालं भैरवाश्रितम्' -५१० । पुष्पाणि पिशितं दिव्यं दशदिक्षु निरीक्षणम् ।। १५८ ।। एवमेव३ प्रकर्तव्यं ततः सिद्धिः ५१४ ५१८ प्रवर्तते । •५१९ जृम्भनं ९ तथा ।। १५९ ।। ताडन १५ हरण १६ मोह स्फोटन स्तम्भनोच्चाटन° चैव मारणं तु यथेप्सितम् । ५२२ । षट्कस्याराधनादेव प्रत्ययानि बहून्यपि ॥ १६० ॥ श्रीनाथ उवाच ५२३ ५२४ ५२५ । षट्प्रकार ? यथाध्यात्मे ब्रूहि देवि प्रसादत: येन विज्ञातमात्रेण सर्वभूतानुकम्पना ।। १६१ ।। श्रीवक्रा उवाच ५२७ षट्प्रकारमयं ज्ञानं षट्प्रकारमयं शिवम् । षट्प्रकारमया विद्या षट्प्रकारमयं कुलम् ।। १६२ ।। षट्प्रकारमया पूजा कौलिकं षट्क्रमेण तु । षड्विधं मूलसूत्रं तु कौमारक्रमषट्क्रमे ।। १६३ ।। षट्क्रमे पीठमार्गं तु षट् षट्कानि क्रमेण तु । षट्क्रमेण तु संस्कारं स्वाधिकाराणि षट्क्रमे ॥ १६४ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 231 Now the Hexad of Restraint (nigraha) will be explained as it is. Õakā, Raktodarā (Red Belly), Rakā, Karālā (Terrible One), Lambakodarā (Long Belly), Lakā, Kumbhā, Bhagodarā, Kakā, Krśodarā (Thin Stomach), Śakā, Yaknodarā (Yakna Stomach), Ghorā (Horrific), Hakā, Raknodarā (Raknas Stomach) and Kulā.70 (155-156) She who is well known as Mother Ciñcā should be made into six kinds in this way. One should perform the rite of adoration of these deities in the Kula tradition. (157) Light, a cloth, a lamp, a skull offered to Bhairava, flowers, meat, the divine gaze in the ten directions — one should (offer these things and) do this. In this way (one obtains) magical power (siddhi). (158-159ab) The striking (of one's enemies) (tāÆana), theft (haraSa), delusion (mohana), explosion (spho˜ana), causing yawning (jrmbhaSa), immobilization (stambhana), expulsion (uccā˜ana) and murder (māraSa) as one wishes — many are the signs of accomplishment (pratyaya) such as these (that manifest) by worshipping the group of six (goddesses). (159cd-160) Śrīnātha said: O goddess, tell (me by your) grace, how the (maSÆala) with six aspects resides in the inner Self by knowing which (one has) compassion for all living beings. (161) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: (This) knowledge consists of six aspects. Śiva consists of six aspects. The Vidyā consists of six aspects. The Kula consists of six aspects. (162) The rite of adoration (pūjā) consists of six aspects and the Kaulika (rite) takes place by means of the Sixfold Transmission. The Root Sūtra is of six kinds in the Sixfold Transmission of the Youth. (163) The path of the sacred seats is part of the Sixfold Transmission. There are six hexads in sequence. The sacrament of purification (saˆskāra) takes place by means of the Sixfold Transmission. The positions of authority are part of the Sixfold Transmission. (164)

sanskrit: 232 कुमारिकाखण्ड: षट्क्रमे समयामार्ग ” कुलरत्नं तु षट्क्रमे । षट्क्रमे ३२ योगिनीवृन्दं कूटमेकं तु षट्क्रमे ५३३ ।। १६५ ।। षट्क्रमे ४ विमलार्थं तु मण्डलाः ३५ षट्क्रमे पुनः । षट्क्रमार्थेन देवेश कुलरत्नक्रमोदयम् ।। १६६ । मतार्थ ३७ यो विजानाति आचार्य: स कुलेश्वरः । साध्यादि३८ भवते सर्वं आज्ञासिद्धि: ” कुलक्रमे ॥ १६७ ॥ ५४१ ५३९ ५४२ एवं साध्यविहीना ये ४९ पश्चिमाम्नायवर्जिताः । न तेषामभिषेक३ तु देशिकत्वं न विद्यते ।। १६८ ॥ ५४४ ५४७ कुलार्णवेन यो हीनो नाधिकारी शिवागमे । ५४८ ५४९ दीक्षितास्तेषु ये शिष्या ४ न ते कल्याणभाजनाः प्रकटं न लिखेद् देव“ क्रमार्थेदं “ ” मुखोद्गतम् । ५५४ ५५० ।। १६९ ॥ गुरुवक्त्रे ५३ स्थितं नित्यं गुरुवक्त्रात् तु लभ्यते ।। १७० ।। ५५५ एवं बोधसमायुक्तः कौलिकाज्ञाधरो भवेत् । ५६० । असत्सङ्गं न कर्तव्यं सत्सङ्गं न परित्यजेत् ।। १७१ ।। असत्सङ्गाद् विनश्येत यदि साक्षात् कुलेश्वर : विशुद्धिकारण यद्वदसत्सङ्गाद् विनश्यति ।। १७२ ।। एवं शुद्धवतः सोऽपि ४ पशुसंगाद् ६५ विनश्यति । सर्वद्वन्द्वपरित्यागात् सर्वभूतानुकम्पया ।। १७३ ।। शत्रुमित्रसमत्वेन मोक्षं प्राप्नोति नान्यथा । कुलाचार्यपदे प्राप्ते गृहस्था येऽभिषेचिता : ५६९ ५७० प्रमादादपि वर्तन्ते समयाचारपारकाः । ५७१ ।। १७४ ।। समयभङ्गान्न मुक्ति: स्यादित्याज्ञा पारमेश्वरी ।। १७५ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 233 The Path of the Rule is a part of the Sixfold Transmission. The Jewel of Kula is a part of the Sixfold Transmission. The troupe of Yoginīs is a part of the Sixfold Transmission as is the one Peak (syllable). (165) The Pure Meaning is part of the Sixfold Transmission. Again, the maSÆalas are part of the Sixfold Transmission. O Lord of the gods, the arising of the Transmission of the Jewel of Kula takes place by means of the reality of the Sixfold Transmission. (166) He who knows the meaning of the Mata is (indeed) Kuleśvara and a (true) teacher. (He attains his) goal (sādhya) and everything else (if he achieves) the accomplishment of the Command (ājñāsiddhi) in the Kulakrama. (167) Those who have not achieved the goal (sādhya) in this way and are devoid of the Western Tradition, are not consecrated and cannot be teachers.71 (168) He who does not possess the Ocean of Kula is not fit for the Śaiva teaching (śivāgama). The disciples they initiate do not possess anything of benefit (kalyāSa).72 (169) O god, one should not clearly set down to writing this Krama teaching (kramārtha) that has come from (the teacher's) mouth. It is always in the teacher's mouth and it is obtained from the teacher's mouth. He who is thus connected to this awakened consciousness (bodha) possesses the Kaulika Command. (170-171ab) One should not keep the company of false (people just as) one should not abandon the company of the righteous. One is destroyed by the company of false (people) even if one is Kuleśvara himself. Similarly, (even the very) cause of purification is destroyed by the company of false (people). Thus even one who is pure is destroyed by association with the fettered. (171cd-173ab) One attains liberation by abandoning all the opposites, by having compassion for all living beings and by (viewing) friend and foe as the same. (There is) no other way. (173cd-174ab) Those householders who have been consecrated and attained the status of a Kulācārya and have, even if due to an error, transgressed the practice of the Rule (will) not (achieve) liberation if they break the Rule. This is the Supreme Goddess's Command. (174cd-175)

sanskrit: 234 ५७२ कुमारिकाखण्ड: इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे २ अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते ३ विमलभेदाधिकारो नामानन्दः ।। ३९ ॥
english: CHAPTER THIRTY-NINE 235 This is the (thirty-ninth) chapter called Concerning the Pure Division. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command.

sanskrit: श्रीनाथ उवाच चत्वारिंशानन्दः श्रुत' देवि यथातथ्य' रहस्यं गूढगोचरम् अन्वये पुनः पृच्छामि' भ्रान्तिरद्यापि मे । ॥ १ ॥ वामदक्षिणमार्गीश्च मायादम्भसमन्विताः । सिद्धान्ताश्च' सुरेशानि° दशाष्टदशभेदतः ।। २ ॥ अत्राचायी वरा ज्ञेया योगज्ञानविशारदाः । १७ सबीजा धारणा ह्येषा निर्बीजा च पृथक् पृथक् ।। ३ ।। अनेकोपाययोगेन संयोगो ह्यात्मन प्रति । २० नादस्थं बिन्दुसंयुक्त ं स्वस्थ च हृदि संस्थितम् ॥ ४ ॥ २३ देव अदृष्टं रूपवर्जितम् । विसर्गस्थं भ्रुवोन्तस्थं ब्रह्मनाड्यां व्यवस्थितम् ॥ ५ ॥ तुयीतीतपदान्तस्थ ब्रह्मद्वारान्तगस्तथा ँ । २७ । ३० उद्भवस्थं तु योगोऽयं“ विश्लेषस्थ तु शूलिनि ॥ ६ ॥ लयस्थं तु” लयातीतं आदिसंस्थं सुरेश्वरि” । सर्वान्तस्थ सुरेशानि यद् बीजं सिद्धिकारणम् ।। ७ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY Concerning the Venerable Knowledge. Preamble Śrīnātha said: O goddess, I have heard the secret as it truly is of what is concealed in the tradition (anvaya). But even now, O Lord, I am confused (and so) I am asking (you about this) again. (1) O mistress of the gods, the (many) paths of the left and the right are full of illusion and deceit (as are) the Siddhāntas, in (their) ten and eighteen divisions.1 Here (in the Kubjikā tradition) the teachers (ācārya) are experts in (both ritual) knowledge and Yoga and should be known to be the best. (2-3ab) This meditative concentration (dhāraSā) is (both) with seed (sabījā) and without seed, (each practice is) separate as it is associated with many means to (achieve) the union of the Self (with the Supreme Principle).2 (3cd-4ab) (It is) established in Sound (nāda) conjoined with the Drop; (it is) present in oneself and established within the Heart; **** (seen) and unseen and devoid of form (it is) established in emission (visarga) and between the eyebrows, is arranged within the channel of Brahmā. (The same reality is) established within the state Beyond the Fourth. Located within the Door of Brahmā, established in the act of generation (udbhava), O bearer of the trident, this Yoga is established in disjunction (viślena). (4cd-6) Established in merger (laya), beyond merger, O mistress of the gods, it is established in the beginning. O mistress of the gods, the seed (syllable) that is the cause of success (siddhi) is established in all things.3 (7)

sanskrit: 238 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३६ ३७ ३८ तत् किमर्थं पुनर्देवि गोपित सुरसत्तमे” । ये ँ त्वया कथिताः सर्वे पूर्वैव वामदक्षिणाः ॥ ८ ॥ सप्तकोटिरसंख्याताः पशूनां नुग्रहार्थतः । किमर्थं ते न सिद्ध्यन्ति कल्पान्तेऽपि कृते सति ।। ९ ।। क्लिष्यन्ति मनुजात्यर्थं मुक्तिहेतोर्जगत्पते । ५२ ५३ कथं मोक्षं च सिद्धिं च न प्राप्नुवन्ति सुन्दरि ॥ १० ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच ५६ ५७ एतद् देव हि वक्ष्यामि यत् त्वया परिपृच्छितम्” । ६३ ६१ ६४ मन्त्राणा” जननी या सा वामाख्या शक्तिरव्यया ।। ११ । तया गुप्ताश्च देवेश कुण्डल्या ते लयं गताः । कथ सा ज्ञायते सूक्ष्मा तेजोरूपा परा कला ॥ १२ ॥ ६७ ७० यथाग्नेदीहिकाशक्तिर्भगत्वं च गता तु या ँ । ६८ तद्वदेव शिवस्यापि धर्मत्वेनोपचार्यते ॥ १३ ॥ ७३ कृतकृत्याः स्वयं सर्वे यैश्च तच्चावधारितम् । ७८ ८० ते वै“ शक्तेरधिष्ठानात्” सिद्ध्यन्ते मन्दबुद्धयापि ं ॥ १४ ॥ सर्वोपायकरं ज्ञानं सद्यःप्रत्ययकारकम्” । योगिनीहृदयानन्दं” पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् ।। १५ । कथयामि समासेन¨ त्वत्प्रीत्या सुरनायक । ८७ बिन्दुरात्मा समाख्यातः“ आत्मा ँ बिन्दुरिति“ स्मृतः” ।। १६ ।। व्यापकः परतो बिन्दुर्लयातीते व्यवस्थितः” । ९२ बिन्दुद्वयं ततो ज्ञात्वा संसाराद् स विमुच्यते ।। १७ ।। चतुष्कलसमोपेतो” हुताशकणिकाकृतिः“ । ९८ तिष्ठते भगवानीशो¨ हृत्पद्मे सुरनायकः ॥ १८ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY 239 O goddess, you who are the best of the gods, why has that been hidden again? In the past, you have uttered all these seventy million (mantras) and countless (scriptures) of the right and the left in order to grace the fettered. Why are they not successful also when they are applied at the end of the (Kali) Age?4 (8-9) O Lord of the universe, men suffer very much to (attain) liberation. How is it, O beautiful one, that they achieve neither success (siddhi) nor freedom?5 (10) The Upward Movement (uccāra) and the Development (pravrtti) of the Energies, Vital Forces and the Merger of the Causal Lords The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O god, I will tell (you) what you have asked (me) about. The mother of mantras is the imperishable energy called Vāmā. O Lord of the gods, (the letters) have been hidden by (that power who is) KuSÆalī, and they have dissolved away (layaˆ gatāƒ). (So) how can that subtle, radiant energy, the supreme power (kalā) be known?6 (11-12) (Concealed within Śiva) like the power to burn is within fire, she has assumed the form of the Yoni. In the same way, Śiva is also figuratively said to possess that (divine) attribute.7 All those who have been successful have understood that for themselves. Sustained by (Śiva's) energy they are successful, (even with a) dull intellect.8 (13-14) (This) knowledge impliments all the means (to realising one's goals) and affords immediate realisation. It is the bliss of the Heart of the Yoginī that has come down through the series (of teacher's and disciples). O Lord of the gods, out of love for you, I will tell (you this) in brief.9 (15-16ab) The Drop (bindu) is said to be the Self and the Self is said to be the Drop. The Supreme Drop pervades (all things) and is established in (the reality) beyond destruction (layātīta).10 Once one has know the two Drops in this way, one is freed from the world of transmigration.11 (16cd-17) The Lord of the gods, the Lord who possesses (all) phenomenal existence, resides in the lotus of the Heart. He is endowed with the four energies (kalā) and (his) form is (like) that of a spark from fire.12 (18)

sanskrit: 240 मायोदरगतस्तिष्ठेत्” विद्योत इव वर्चसा कुमारिकाखण्ड: १०० । माया प्रसुप्तनागाख्या संस्थिता ” कुण्डलाकृतिः ३ ॥ १९ ॥ १०४ कुण्डली तेन सा प्रोक्ता चिद्रुपा ह्यात्मनस्य च । तया नीयत्यसौ जीव अधश्चोध्वे च सुन्दर ।। २० ।। सा च” माया समाख्याता वामावती तु कुण्डली । ११९ ज्येष्ठा”३ नाम१४ द्वितीया तु ऋजुरेखा च सा स्मृता ।। २१ ।। पद्मतन्तुनिभाकारा सृष्टिमार्गे प्रकीर्तिता । २१ २२ रौद्री शृङ्गाटकाकारा” निरोधी सा तु गीयते ।। २२ ।। २७ इच्छा ज्ञानी क्रिया विश्वी २५ चतुष्क २६ तव कथ्यते । पञ्चमी“ शिवशक्तिस्तु” या करोति गमागमम् ।। २३ ।। एकाकर्षयते ऊर्ध्वं प्राणं चाधो द्वितीयका । १३२ आभ्यां संयोगरूपेण अनच्क ३३ जायते प्रिय४ ।। २४ ।। इच्छा सप्तादशी ज्ञेया संकल्प या प्रकुर्वति” । १४० १४३ | सा च त्रिभेदतो ज्ञेया ४२ सत्त्वराजसतामसा ' ।। २५ ।। -१४५ ज्ञानशक्तिस्तथा ज्ञान अवैराग्यवती स्थिता' । १४७ ज्ञानमष्टप्रकार तु करोति विकरोति च ।। २६ ।। संकल्पञ्च विकल्पञ्च व्यवहारार्थकर्मणि ४९ । क्रिया च कुरुते कर्म धर्माधर्मात्मक पशो: १५३ ।। २७ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 241 Spiral Radiant like a lightning flash, he abides within the belly of Māyā.13 Māyā is called the sleeping snake whose (coiled) form (is circular like) an earring (kuSÆala). (19) Left Line Thus, she who is the conscious nature of the Self is called KuSÆalī. O handsome one, the individual soul is led up and down by her. And she is said to be Māyā, that is, KuSÆalī, turned towards the left (vāmāvarta).14 (20-21ab) Straight line Jyen˜hā is the second (energy). She is said to be like a straight line. Her form is (extremely subtle) like a lotus fibre and is said to be on the path of emanation.15 (21cd-22ab) Triangle Raudrī's form is (triangular like) a water chestnut. She is said to be the obstructing (force) (nirodhikā).16 (22cd) (Again), your Tetrad is said to be (the powers of) will, knowledge, action and Viśvī (the Universal One). The fifth is Śiva's energy, who ‘comes and goes’. One (energy) drags (the breath) upwards and the second (energy) (pulls) the breath downwards. O dear one, Anacka (Unstruck Sound) arises by the union of these two.17 (23-24) (The energy of) the will that formulates intentions (saˆkalpa) should be known to be the Seventeenth (Digit of the Moon).18 One should know her to be divided into three as sattva, rajas and tamas. (25) (When) the power of knowledge is not detached (from the object of knowledge), knowledge (is the result). She makes and destroys (vikaroti) knowledge with (its) eight aspects,19 along with (one's) intention (saˆkalpa) and thought (vikalpa), in the course of the action (the fettered undertakes) for the sake of the transactions (of daily life). (26-27ab) Again, (the power of) action performs the action,20 good and bad, of the fettered soul. (27cd)

sanskrit: 242 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १५५ विश्वी बोधनी ज्ञेया ५४ चिच्छक्तिप्रतिबोधनी । १५६ पञ्चमी या स्मृता शक्तिस्तथाधारा व्यवस्थिता ।। २८ ।। एका एव पराशक्ति : १९ क्रियाभेदेन संस्थिता' धर्मार्थकाममोक्षं च भुञ्जते तद्वशात् प्रिय १६१ १६२ १६० । ।। २९ ।। १६७ एतच्च६४ मानस६५ सर्ग सत्त्वराजसतामसम् । १६८ शब्द : स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो १७२ मनो बुद्धिरहंकार : पुर्यष्टक इति प्राणोऽपानः १७५ समानश्च उदानो व्यान १७७ गन्धश्च पञ्चमः नागः कूर्मोऽथ कृकरो” देवदत्तो १८२ १७४ स्मृतः । १७६ १७१ ।। ३० ।। एव च ॥ ३१ ॥ ।। ।। धनञ्जयः । १८० प्राणो नाम महावायुस्तस्याधाराश्च नाडय: ।। ३२ ।। इडा च पिङ्गला चैव“” सुषुम्णा च तृतीयका । गान्धारी हस्तिजिह्वा च पूषा चैव यथा तथा' ॥ ३३ ॥ अलुम्बुषा कुहुश्चैव शङ्खिनी दशमी स्मृता ” । १९२ १९३ १९४ १८६ १९५ एतैः सह महाशम्भो हृदबिन्दुस्तिष्ठते ततः ।। ३४ ॥ ब्रह्मादिदेवतास्तस्य अकाराक्षरवाचकाः १९९ २०० १९७ । द्विधा भूत अकारस्तु तत्र कृत्य प्रकुर्वति ।। ३५ ।। इच्छा याति०३ लयं ज्ञाने ४ ज्ञानाख्य क्रियया २६ पुनः । २०७ २०९ क्रिया याति लय बिन्द्व्यां बिन्द्वी चैव शिवात्मकें ॥ ३६ ॥ २११ । स्वे स्वे १० स्थाने १९ लयं यान्ति १२ ब्रह्मभागैरधिष्ठिता: २१३ ब्रह्मा अपि स्वकार्याणि”४ उपसंहृत्य” गच्छति ।। ३७ ।। •२१७ •२१८ २२० २२१ इकारान्तं परं स्थानं यत्र” विष्णुः संतिष्ठति '
english: CHAPTER FORTY 243 One should know that Viśvī is (the energy who) awakens. She awakens the power of consciousness. She is the fifth energy who is established as the foundation. (28) There is only one supreme energy (with diverse forms) in accord with the diverse activity (in which it is engaged). O dear one, under its sway, (the individual soul) enjoys (worldly experience) in the (domains) of the (three goals of life, namely) Dharma (moral rectitude), prosperity (artha) and sexual love (kāma). And that is the creation of the mind, which is sattvic, rājasic and tāmasic. (29-30ab) The City of Eight (puryan˜aka) is said to be sound, form, taste, smell, mind, intellect and ego. (30cd-31ab) (The forms of the vital breath are) PrāSa, Apāna, Samāna, Udāna, Vyāna, Nāga, Kūrma, Krkara, Devadatta and Dhanañjaya.21 (31cd-32ab) The vital breath (prāSa) is the Great Wind and its supports are the vital channels (nāÆī).22 (These are) IÆā, Pi‰galā and SunumSā as the third, Gāndharī, Hastijihvā, Punā, Yaśasvinī, Alambunā, Kuhu and Śa‰khinī, which is said to be the tenth.23 (32cd-34ab) O Mahāśambhu! The Drop always abides (tin˜hate) along with these things. Then come the deities Brahmā and the rest who are the denotators of the letter A and (the Drop’s) deities. (34cd-35ab) Split in two, the letter A performs its function there. The will dissolves into knowledge. Knowledge (dissolves) with action. Action dissolves into the Bindvī and Bindvī (dissolves) into Śiva's nature.24 (35cd-36) Governed by (these) aspects of Brahmā, they (all) dissolve away into their own particular places. Brahmā also, having withdrawn his own creations (svakārya), goes to (his) supreme place (sthāna), namely, the end of the letter I,25 where VinSu resides.26 (37-38ab)

sanskrit: 244 .२२२ कुमारिकाखण्ड: विष्णुरपि कण्ठदेशे सर्व २३ संहृत्य गच्छति २२८ २२४ २२७ ॥ ३८ ॥ २२९ रुद्रोऽपि१२५ तत् परं१२६ स्थानं उकारो यत्र तिष्ठति ताल्वन्तं तद्” विजानीयात् सर्वेषां तु समागमम् रुद्रोऽपि ३० ईश्वर ३१ याति ३२ मकारो यत्र ३३ तिष्ठति' कथितेय ३५ त्वया २३६ तन्त्रे ३७ वामदक्षिणयामले तत्र चयी क्रिया योगो ३९ ज्ञानं च २४२ २३४ सुरनायक' २४१ । २४३ । ॥ ३९ ॥ । ।। ४० ।। तत्र ते भ्रामिताः सर्वे ये यस्मिन् तत्र पृच्छकाः न तत्र संस्फुट५ ज्ञानं दिव्यानन्दप्रदायकम् २४८ २४६ विज्ञाय योग्यतां नैषां कथितं वीरवन्दित मुद्रामण्डलमन्त्रैश्च व्रतैश्चान्द्रायणादिभिः २५० । २४४ ।। ४१ ।। २४९ ।। ४२ ।। २५३ रेचकैः २५१ पूरकैर्योगै: २५२ कुम्भकैश्च तथा प्रिय ॥ ४३ ॥ भ्रामिता : २५४ कर्मकाण्डैश्च ५५ न ज्ञानं २५६ कथितं मया २५८ २६२ २६१ २६३ २५७ । ॥ ४४ ॥ तैस्तु ज्ञानावलेपेन नाहं पृष्टा अवज्ञया ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्राद्या: शक्राद्या लोकपालका: स्कन्दनन्दिगणाः सर्वे ऋषयो यक्षकिन्नराः ।। ४५ ।। २६४ अविनाभावयोगेन २६६ सर्वत्रैवोपचर्यते २७० २७१ २६७ । २७२ । न शिवेन २६८ विना २६९ शक्ति: न शक्तिरहितः शिवः ।। ४६ ।। २७४ २७५ वियोगो२७३ नैव दृश्येत वायुरम्बरयोरिव । २७६ २७७ २७८ शक्त्या करणरूपा या सर्वमेवोपचर्यते ।। ४७ ।। २८० न चान्यं” करणं तस्य येन कृत्यं करोति सः २८२ २८१ २८५ । ।। मन्त्र: शिव: २८३ समुद्दिष्ट अव्यया शक्तिरुच्यते ॥ ४८ ॥ विश्वस्य २८६ जननी २८७ या च मन्त्ररूपा कथं तु सा । २८८ २८९
english: CHAPTER FORTY 245 (Similarly), having withdrawn everything into the throat centre, VinSu also goes (to his own abode). Rudra also (goes to) that supreme place where the letter U is located. Know that that is the end of the palate (tālvanta) the confluence of all things. Rudra also goes to the Lord (Īśvara) where the letter Ma is located.27 (Thus), this (Energy taught) in the Tantras of the left, right and the Yāmala, has been explained (to you). (38cd-40) 28O Lord of the gods, conduct (caryā), ritual (kriyā), Yoga and knowledge are (explained) there (in the Tantras). All those who inquire therein (about them) are confused. (This is because) the power there (within them) that bestows divine bliss is not evident.29 (41-42ab) (O god who is) praised by the Heroes! Once I came to know of their (lack of) competence (to receive it), I did not tell them (the teaching).30 O beloved, (people) have been confused by (the practice of ritual) gesture, maSÆalas, vows and (austerities) such as the CāndrāyaSa and by (the practice of forced) exhalations, inhalations, and breath retentions and by rituals and so I have not imparted (this) knowledge (to them). (42cd-44ab) It is because of (their) pride (in their limited) knowledge and (their) indifference that I have not been asked (about this). Brahmā, VinSu, Rudra and the rest, Śakra and the other (gods), the protectors of the quarters, Skanda, Nandi and all of (Śiva's) host, the ¬nis, Yaknas and Kinnaras (none have cared to ask).31 (44-45) The Relationship between Śiva and Śakti (The relationship between Śiva and his power) is everywhere figuratively said to be (upacaryate)32 one of invariable concomitant union. Śakti is not without Śiva and Śiva is not devoid of Śakti.33 (46) Like the wind and the sky, they are never seen separately. Everything is figuratively ascribed to Śakti and she is (Śiva's) instrument. Nor does (Śiva) have any other instrument with which he does what he aims to do (krtya). (47-48ab) Śiva is taught to be mantra, while Śakti is said to be imperishable.34 How can she who is the mother of the universe be mantra?35 (48cd-49ab)

sanskrit: 246 कुमारिकाखण्ड: निरोधी”° सा समुद्दिष्टा” लम्बिकान्ते व्यवस्थिता ऊध्वमार्गनिरोधिन्या९३ रौद्री तेन २९४ प्रपद्यते २९५ तस्या२९६ नादान्तजं१९७ लक्षं मकारो यत्र तिष्ठति ३०० । २९८ २९२ शिवस्थानं तु”” तत् प्रोक्त विसर्गान्ते तदेव हिं ॥ ४९ ॥ ॥ ५० ॥ ३०२ । महाशून्य तु तत् प्रोक्तं द्वादशान्ते तदेव हि ।। ५१ ।। कलान्तं ४ च स्वरान्तं च मनान्तं चैव तत् स्मृतम् ३०९ “ ३०७ ३०८ तत्र चोत्पद्यते शब्दो” रौद्री भिन्ना” यदा भवेत् ।। ५२ ।। नादोऽपि गच्छते १२ देव” ३ यत्र कुण्डलिनी ४ स्थिता । ३१४ नादान्तं तद्६ विजानीयाद् विसर्गादूध्वतो भवेत् ॥ ५३ ॥ तस्योध्वे ज्ञानशक्तिस्तु ऊध्वश्रोता तु विश्रुता ३२० ३२३ ३२४ ३२५ ३२२ व्यापिन्यन्ते तु देवेश नवमा समना स्मृता स्फोटमुत्पद्यते तत्र७ गुरुवक्त्रं ततो भवेत्९ । ३३० ३३१ । ॥ ५४ ॥ ३३२ गुरुवक्त्रस्य ऊध्वे तु ब्रह्मस्थानं तु तत् स्मृतम् ।। ५५ ।। ३३४ शक्त्यन्तं३ च भवेत् तच्च लयं यच्च तदुच्यते । ३३७ तस्यान्ते तु लयातीतं कथितं तु न संशयः ॥ ५६ ॥ एष बिन्दोस्तु संचार ३९ प्रबुद्धानां वरानन ३४१ ३४० ३४४ अप्रबुद्धास्तु ये देव३४२ निरोधिन्या४३ निरोधिताः ।। ५७ ।। तेषां तिर्यग्गति:३४५ प्रोक्ता ४६ संसारस्य निबन्धनी४८ । ३५० ३४७ । एषोच्चारः समाख्यातः प्रवृत्त इति सर्वदा ५२ ॥ ५८ ॥ ग्रहण ३ तु पुनर्वक्ष्ये ५४ येन त्यागं३५५ भविष्यति ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 247 She is located at the end of the uvula (lambikā) and is said to be Nirodhī (She Who Blocks) because she blocks the upper path. Raudrī is attained by means of that.36 (49cd-50ab) Her goal (lakna) is born at the End of Sound where the letter A is located. That is said to be Śiva's abode (sthāna) which said to be at the End of Emission (visargānta).37 (50cd-51ab) That is said to be the Great Void (mahāśūnya) and is located at the End of the Twelve (dvādaśānta).38 That is said to be the End of the Forces (kalānta), the End of the Vowels and the End of Mind (manānta).39 (51cd-52ab) Word (śabda) arises there (and becomes manifest) if Raudrī is split apart. Moreover, O god, Sound (nāda) also goes to KuSÆalinī's place. (52cd-53ab) Know that that is the End of Sound (nādānta) and is above Emission. Above that is the power of knowledge said to be the upward current.40 (53cd-54ab) O Lord of the gods, the Equal One (Samanā), which is the ninth (station), is said to be at the end of the Pervasive (Vyāpinī). It arises there in a clearly evident way after which comes the Teacher's Mouth (guruvaktra). 41 (54cd-55ab) The Abode of Brahmā (brahmasthāna) is said to be above the Teacher's Mouth. And that is the end of Śakti which is said to be 'merger' (laya).42 (55cd-56ab) Without a doubt Beyond Merger (layātīta) is said to come at the end of that. O handsome one, that is the movement (saˆcāra) of the Drop43 of those who are awake. (56cd-57ab) O god, those who are not awake are obstructed by (the power of) obstruction (nirodhinī). Their movement is said to be the crooked one (tiryaggati) which is the binding power (nibandhinī) of transmigratory existence.44 (57cd-58ab) That is said to be the enunciation (uccāra) (of mantra) which is constantly taking place (pravrtta).45 (58cd) The Abandoning of the Five Causal Lords Again, I will tell about the act of laying hold (of higher states) (grahaSa), by virtue of which the abandoning (tyāga) (of the lower levels) (eventually) takes place. (59ab)

sanskrit: 248 •३५६ ३५७ कुमारिकाखण्डः पञ्चकारणक त्यक्त्वा ं स्वच्छन्दगतिमाप्नुयात् ३५८ ।। ५९ ॥ एवं सिद्धात्मको ५९ योगी शाक्तं ध्यानं समभ्यसेत् । तदा तस्य भवेद् ९ देव २ अणिमादिगुणाष्टकम् ।। ६० ।। ३६४ ब्रह्मग्रन्थिसमुच्छेदात्३ यदा ऊध्वमुखी भवेत् ५ । ३६६ तदा ब्रह्मासहैकत्वं शब्दस्पर्शं च गच्छति ।। ६१ ।। तौ त्यक्त्वा ऊध्वतो याति कण्ठदेशे तु कारणम् । ३७१ कार्यरूपी भवेद्७२ ब्रह्मा यत्र विष्णुव्यवस्थितः स चैव प्राकृतैर्भवैस्त्यक्तैर्मुक्तो न संशयः । केशवोऽपि ७५ ललाटस्थो ७६ व्यापारत्यक्तचेतसः अधिकारनिवृत्तोऽसौ केशवो गुरुवेदक ः १९ । ३८० ३७८ ३७९ यत्र रुद्रः स्वयं तिष्ठेत् गुरुव्यपारसंयुतः ३८४ ३८२ ३७० ३७३ ।। ६२ ।। ३७७ ।। ६३ ।। ॥ ६४ ॥ रुद्रोऽपि याति देवेश तेजोरूपं तु ईश्वरम् । । बिन्दुस्थानं तु तत् प्रोक्तं तेजोराशि विनिर्दिशेत् ।। ६५ ।। तेजात्मकविभागं तु“ प्राणव्यापारमेव च ९ । ३८८ •३९२ ३९३ । ३९४ तौ९० त्यक्त्वा व्रजते ऊर्ध्वं रुद्रस्य गुणवृत्तयः ।। ६६ ।। ३९७ ईश्वरोऽपि तथा नादे शब्दाद्यैस्तु सदाशिवे । बुद्ध्यादिकरणैर्युक्तो अहंकारगुणान्वितः ।। ६७ ।। ३९९ ३९८ ४०० ४०२ गच्छते”” च तदा ईशस्तथा व्यापारसंहृतः । ४०४ शिवविद्यागुणाधारो३ यत्र देवः ४ सदाशिवः ।। ६८ ।। तत्रैव निहितस्तिष्ठेदीश्वरो ज्ञानवेदक : ४०६
english: CHAPTER FORTY 249 Having abandoned the Five Causes one attains freedom (svacchandagati). The yogi who has been pierced (viddhātmaka) (with Energy) should practice (this) visualization of Energy (śāktadhyāna) in this way.46 Then he possesses the eight (yogic) powers (guSa), namely, the power to make oneself small at will (aSima) and the rest. (59cd-60) The Knot of Brahmā If, by severing the Knot of Brahmā,47 (the energy within it) faces upwards,48 then a state of oneness with Brahmā (arises) and (the energy) makes contact with (the essence of) Word (śabda). Once abandoned these two, (the yogi) travels up to the Cause49 that is in the throat.50 (61-62ab) VinSu (Keśava) (There), where VinSu resides, Brahmā is in the form of an effect (of the higher principle beyond) and abides there in supreme Keśava. He too should be abandoned. And, freed of the states of Nature (prakrti), he is certainly liberated. (62cd-63ab) Rudra The mind of Keśava,51 who is on the forehead, is also freed of activity. Keśava, who knows the (true nature of) the teacher quits his post where Rudra himself, engaged in the teacher’s work, resides. (63cd-64) O lord of the gods, (in the same way) Rudra also goes to Īśvara whose nature is radiant energy (tejas). That is said to be the location (sthāna) of the Drop, which is said to be a mass of radiant energy (tejas). Having abandoned the two, namely, (this) division which is radiant energy (tejātmakavibhāga) and the activity of the vital breath, (Rudra) travels upwards (and abandons) the modalities of Rudra’s qualities (guSavrtti). (65-66) Īśvara and Sadāśiva In the same way Īśvara (merges) into Sound (nāda) along with Word and the rest into Sadāśiva. Then, conjoined with (the mental) senses, namely, the intellect and the rest and endowed with the qualities of the ego, Īśa, (his) activity withdrawn, similarly goes (to the next higher level) where the god is Sadāśiva who is the foundation of the qualities of Śiva and Vidyā (his energy). Īśvara, who knows the knowledge (contained in the scripture), is present there. (67- 69ab)

sanskrit: 250 कुमारिकाखण्ड: स्वकृत्यमुपसंहृत्य ँ गच्छते च पुनर्लयम् ।। ६९ ।। ४१ ० लयातीतं तु तत् स्थानं यत्र कृत्यं न विद्यते ४११ । स्वभावोत्पादितो” ” बुद्धिः शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा ।। ७० ।। सवीतीतपदं प्राप्य मुच्यते भवबन्धनात् । ४१३ ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रो ईश्वरश्च चतुर्थकः ॥ ७१ ॥ ४१५ क्रियारूपधराः सर्वे यत्र बिन्दुश्च तिष्ठति •४१८ ४१७ । उद्भव च तथा श्लेष ९ लयं चैव पृथक् पृथक् ॥ ७२ ॥ ४२३ ४२४ लयातीता” परा शक्तिर्या सा बिन्दुः शिवात्मिका । तत्राधारे ४२५ सुरेशान संचरन्ति क्रमात् क्रमम् •४३० ४२८ सदाशिवोऽपि४२९ संहारं कुरुते स्वेच्छया प्रभुः । उन्मनान्ते ४३१ वरारोह ४३२ योऽसौ ४३३ वेत्ता ४३४ महाध्वनि ४३७ ४३९ ।। ७३ ।। ४३५ ।। ७४ ।। तेन संस्मृतमात्रेण काष्ठवत् तिष्ठते नरः । धर्माधर्मात्मकौ बन्धौ ४९ तदा नष्टौ न संशयः ।। ७५ ।। तैर्नष्टैर्देवदेवेश४३ गच्छते च परं पदम् ४४४ । यावद् देहो महाबन्धैः ६ मुच्यते न कदाचन ४४८ ४४७ ।। ७६ ।। तावत् तस्य कुतो मोक्षः षड्विधार्थेऽपि शोधिते ४५२ । ४५७ एव५३ त्यागो मया ५४ देव४५५ ख्यापितो५६ विद्यया तव ।। ७७ ।। शिवत्व५८ गच्छते येन५९ समस्तगुणसंयुतः । ४६१ ४६० यत्र सा कुण्डली शक्तिरनामाख्या ६२ मनोन्मनी ४६३ ४६५ शक्तित्रयसमोपेता ४ बोधनी च निरोधनी । अधोगा ४६८ ।। ७८ ।। रोधनी ज्ञेया ऊध्वगा च प्रबोधनी ।। ७९ ॥ ४६९ ४७० द्विधा भावगता ह्येका पश्चाद् भिन्ना‍ अनेकधा ४७३ ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 251 Having withdrawn his own creation, he again dissolves away. That place is (known as) Beyond Merger (layātīta) where there is no creation (krtya). (69cd-70ab) Once the intellect, generated from the innate nature by ritual performed in accord with scripture, has attained the plane beyond all (others), one is freed from the bondage of fettered existence (bhava).52 (70cd-71ab) Brahmā, VinSu, Rudra and Īśvara as the fourth, all assume the form of action where the Drop is located.53 (The actions of each one) separately are generation (udbhava), conjunction (śleśa) and merger (laya) respectively. (71cd-72) The Supreme Energy, whose nature is Śiva and is beyond merger is the Drop.54 O Lord of the gods, they move there through the foundation, step by step, successively (kramāt kramam). (73) The Lord (prabhu) Sadāśiva also brings about the withdrawal (of manifestation) according to (his) own desire. O fair one, he is the knowing subject (vettr) at the end of the Transmental55 on the Great Path (mahādhvani) (of manifestation). (74) By merely recollecting that a man becomes (stiff) like a piece of wood. Then the fetters of good (dharma) and evil (adharma) are certainly destroyed. O god of the gods, when they have been destroyed, he attains the supreme level (of existence). (75-76ab) As long as the body (is fettered) with (these) great bonds, he is never freed. Even if the sixfold reality has been purified,56 as long as this is so how can there be liberation? (76cd-77ab) Thus O god, I have told you about (how the lower states are) abandoned (tyāga) with knowledge (vidyā) by virtue of which one who is endowed with all the qualities reaches Śiva's state where KuSÆalī, the energy called Anāmā (Nameless),57 who is the Transmental (manonmanī), (resides). (77cd-78) She possesses three energies and is both (the energy that) awakens (bodhanī) and obstructs (nirodhanī). One should know her to be obstructive when she is below (adhogā) and awakening when above (ūrdhvagā). The one (energy thus initially) assumes two states. Subsequently, she is divided in countless way.58 (79-80ab)

sanskrit: 252 कुमारिकाखण्डः ४७४ ४७५ ४७६ सृजते सा जगत् कृत्स्नं… आब्रह्मभुवनान्तिकम् ।। ८० ॥ ४७८ ४८१ सद्यते तन्न संदेहो” कृत्यभेदेन भैरव । ४८२ वामा सृष्टि: स्मृता सूक्ष्मा ज्येष्ठा पालनतत्परा ४८४ ४८६ ४८३ ४८७ रौद्री संहरणी ४ प्रोक्ता एका ह्येव त्रिधा भवेत् ४८८ ४९१ ।। ८१ ।। । सा“ च४८९ पञ्चविधा प्रोक्ता अष्टधा नवधा पुनः ॥ ८२ ॥ पञ्चाशद्भेदसंभिन्ना”” अनन्तानन्ततां गता । सा एव पररूपेण ४९३ ज्ञातव्या ४९४ वीरनायक' ४९६ ४९७ ४९५ ॥। ८३ ।। । ४९८ तया व्याप्तमशेषं तु यत् किञ्चिद् वामयं जगत् तेन माया समाख्याता ज्ञानरूपा -५०२ ४९९ ५०० तामवाप्य ं भवेद् देव‍ उन्मनो ५०१ च कुण्डली कुण्डली ॥ ८४ ॥ मनवर्जितः । गुणाष्टकसमोपेतः सर्वज्ञत्वादिसंयुतः ५०८ ५११ ५०७ ५०५ ।। ८५ ।। ये धर्म: करणे” देव तैर्युक्तः क्रीडयत्यसौ १२ पश्चाद्१३ याति लयं कृत्वा ४ शून्य शिवात्मकं भवेत् ।। ८६ ।। मनातीत तु तत् स्थानं सुषिरं द्वादशान्तगम् । ५१९ तस्मिन् युक्तो यदा शून्ये स्वकृत्यमुपसंहृतम्” ।। ८७ ।। .५२२ ५२३ -५२४ ५२५ तस्योध्वे तु स्मृतो व्यापी निर्गुणो गुणसंयुतः । ५२६ ५२७ निश्चेतन: सचेतश्च गुणातीतो निरञ्जनः ५२९ ५२८ ।। ८८ । अनन्तः शाश्वतः सूक्ष्मः”” विकल्पातीतगः परः ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 253 She creates the entire universe from Brahmā up to the (lowest) world. And she is certainly attained59 by means of (her) diverse functions.
