(80cd-81ab) The subtle Vāmā is said to be emanation, the subtle Jyen˜hā is intent on protecting (the universe that has been emitted), while Raudrī is (said to be the power) that withdraws (it). (Thus) the one (power) is threefold.60 (81cd-82ab) Again, she is said to be fivefold, eightfold and ninefold. She is (also) split into fifty divisions.61 (Thus) she who is endless has become of endless (forms). (82cd-83ab) O Lord of the heroes, she should be known (as she is in herself) through (her) supreme form. She pervades each and everything in the universe of speech. (83cd-84ab) Therefore, KuSÆalī, who is consciousness (jñāna), is called Māyā.62 O god, once she has been attained, (the yogi) transcends the mind (unmana) and is devoid of it. (84cd-85ab) Endowed with the eight yogic powers (guSa), omniscience and the rest and endowed with the attributes in (each of the five) causes (of phenomenal existence), he plays (freely).63 (85cd-86ab) After that he goes (to the supreme level) and, having dissolved (everything away), the (resulting) Void (śūnya) is Śiva.64 (86cd) That Place (sthāna) is beyond mind (manātīta). It is the Cavity (śunira) at the End of the Twelve (dvādaśānta).65 (87ab) If he is in a state of union (yukta) within the Void, (then his) creation (krtya) is withdrawn.66 Above that he is said to be all-pervasive and, devoid (of phenomenal) qualities (nirguSa), is endowed with (all the divine) qualities (guSa). (87cd-88ab) Devoid of (conditioned) consciousness, he possesses (universal) consciousness. Transcending the qualities, he is stainless (nirañjana).67 (He is) endless, eternal, subtle,68 beyond thought and supreme. (88cd-89ab)

sanskrit: 254 •५३१ ५३२ कुमारिकाखण्ड: ५३३ नैव पुण्यमपुण्य वा सर्वानन्दकरः स्मृतः ॥ ८९ ॥ स्वयं कर्ता स्वयं हती संसारार्णवसंस्थित: ५३४ । ५३८ स्वात्मनात्मा'३५ पुनर्बद्ध:३६ मुक्तश्चैवात्मना आत्मा ॥ ९० ॥ अनेन क्रमयोगेन योगबिन्द्वात्मको भवेत्” । ५४० ज्ञातव्यं तु समासेन बिन्दुसंस्थ सदाभ्यसेत्” ।। ९१ ।। अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि नादस्थं शृणु साम्प्रतम्' ५४३ । ५४७ नादकुण्डलिनी ज्ञेया नाभिमध्ये व्यवस्थिता निर्गता४८ ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण४९ त्यक्त्वा वै पञ्चकारणम् । ब्रह्मादिशिवपर्यन्त भित्त्वा ऊध्वगतिं ।। ९२ ।। व्रजेत् ॥ ९३ ॥ मनोबिन्दु गृहीत्वा तु भित्त्वा वै व्योमपञ्चकम् । । शरदसुशशिप्रख्या तडित्कोटिसमुज्ज्वला ।। ९४ ।। उदितार्ककराभासा प्रवालांकुरसन्निभा । ऊर्णातन्तुनिभाकारा``२ पद्मसूत्रे च निर्गता ६३ तुहिनेन्दुकराभासा' स्थिरदीपशिखोपमा । -५६५ ।। ९५ ।। तस्यान्ते६६ तु ततो७ बिन्दुर्हुताशकणिकाकृतिः ।। ९६ ।। एवं बिन्दु गृहीत्वा तु ध्वनिना पूरित यदा । •५६९ •५७१ •५७० पञ्चकारणक त्यक्त्वा शङ्खबन्धं परिस्थितम् विसर्गेण ३ ततो याति ४ आकृष्टा च शनै: ५७७ ५७२ ५७६ ।। ९७ ।। शनैः । पद्मनाले यथा तोयं अम्बरस्थश्च कर्षयेत् ॥ ९८ ॥ यथा—७९ दीपो° निवातस्थो अव्युच्छिन्नगतिर्भवेत् ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 255 (For him there is) neither merit (puSya) nor demerit (apuSya) and he is said to be one who makes all (beings) blissful. (Even as he) resides in the ocean of transmigratory existence, he is himself the creator and the destroyer (of all things).69 (89cd-90ab) The Self is bound repeatedly by the Self and the Self is liberated by the Self.70 By means of this sequential Yoga (kramayoga), (the liberated one) is the Drop of Union (yogabindu).71 One should know (the reality) established in the Drop in (the most essential and) succinct way and one should practice constantly. (90cd-91) Establishment in Sound and the Rise of KuSÆalinī Next I will tell (you) about (the reality) within Sound (nādastha).72 Now listen. (92ab) One should know the KuSÆalinī of Sound (nāda) located in the middle of the navel. Having abandoned the Five Causes, (KuSÆalinī) exits (from the body) by means of the Cavity of Brahmā. Having pierced through (the series of Causes) from Brahmā to Śiva it goes to the upper state (ūrdhvagati)73 having grasped the Point of the Mind (manobindu) and broken through the Five Voids.74 (92cd-94ab) (KuSÆalinī in this state) is brilliant like the beautiful autumn moon and burns radiantly like ten million lightning flashes. She shines (beautifully like) the rays of the risen sun and is (tender and fine) like the sprout of a new leaf. (94cd-95ab) Her form is (subtle) like a woolen fibre and emerges along the lotus fibre (that threads through SunumSā).75 She shines (like) the rays of a winter moon and is like the steady flame of a lamp. (95cd-96ab) The Drop, whose form (ākrti) is (like) a spark from a fire, is at the end (agra) of that. If, having grasped the Drop in this way, it is filled with the resonance (dhvani) (of consciousness), and having abandoned the Five Causes, the bandha of the conch (śa‰kha)76 is established.77 (96cd-97) Then she moves (impelled) by emission (visarga) and is slowly dragged along.78 It should be dragged (up) like (the cloud) in the sky (sucks up) water in a lotus fibe (padmanāla).79 Its movement should be continuous like (that of) a flame in a (sheltered place where) there is no wind.80 (98-99ab)

sanskrit: 256 ५८३ कुमारिकाखण्ड: ५८४५८५ तदोवे क्षेपगौ द्वौ तु भ्रुवौ चैव शुभेक्षण ॥ ९९ ॥ विक्षेपमूध्वतः“ कृत्वाकुञ्चयेत् संपुटद्वयम् “ । •५८९ ५८७ ५८८ ५९० त्रिशूल“ खेचरान्तस्थं कर्तव्यं मोक्षकांक्षिणा शक्त्यग्रे विनियोज्येत तुषारकणिकाकृतिम् । ५९४ -५९२ । ।। १०० ॥ ५९५ मध्यनाड्या:३ प्रवाहेन तदा कारणकान् ४ त्यजेत् ॥ १०१ ॥ रेचकैः पूरकैश्चैव कुम्भकैश्चोपबृंहतैः । ५९८ ५९९ तदा कारणकान् “ त्यक्त्वा यदा शक्तिसमो भवेत् ॥ १०२ ॥ तदा तस्य” भवेत् सिद्धिरणिमादिगुणाष्टकम् ६०५ ६०२ । ।। ६०७ । अतीतानागतं ०३ ज्ञानं १०४ वर्तमान ५ तथैव च ॥ १०३ ॥ ६०६ विन्दते नात्र संदेहो रुद्रशक्तिप्रभावत: नादस्थ“ कथितं देव” बिन्दुस्थं पूर्वमेव हि ॥ १०४ ॥ साम्प्रतं शक्तिसंस्थ११ च ११२ यथा भवति तच्छृणु । ६१३ अवर्णी वर्णयोगेन४ कुलयोन्यार्णवे यथा •६१६ ६१५ ६१७ पूर्वैव कथिता तुभ्यं सप्तकोटिप्रमाणकें । ॥ १०५ ॥ गोपिता तु पुनर्देव वर्णरूपा प्रकाशिता ।। १०६ ।। तेन ते नैव सिद्ध्यन्ति जप्त्वा कोटिशतैरपि । ६२२ ६२३ मन्त्राणा जीवभूता तु स्थिता या शक्तिरव्यया ६२५ ६२६ ६२७ तया हीना वरारोह ५ निष्फला शरदम्बुदाः । ६२४ ।। १०७ ।। या सा वै मातृका१२८ देव १२९ परापरसमन्विता ।। १०८ ।। •६३१ ६३२ तया व्याप्तं जगत् कृत्स्नं आब्रह्मभुवनान्तिकम्' ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 257 Then, O (god) with auspicious eyes, the two eyebrows are raised upwards.81 Having cast (the Drop upwards), the two eyelids should be closed.82 (99cd-100ab) One who ardently desires liberation should fashion the Trident within the Skyfarer (Khecara).83 (KuSÆalinī) whose form is (subtle and white like) a snow- flake should be conjoined to the extremity of Energy (śaktyagre).84 (100cd-101ab) One should then abandon the (five) causes by means of the flowing current of the Central Channel (madhyanāÆī). (One should) then abandon the (five) causes85 by means of exhalations and inhalations, strengthened with breath retentions. (101cd-102ab) If (by this method the yogi) becomes one with Energy (śaktisama), having abandoned the (five) Causes, he attains magical power (siddhi) and the eight yogic powers (guSa) of making himself small at will and the rest. By the power of Rudra's energy, he certainly acquires the knowledge of (all things in the) past, present and future.86 (102bcd-104ab) Established in Energy87 (Thus), O god, the (reality) within Sound has been explained and (the reality) within the Drop, before that. Now listen to how (the state) Established in Energy is, that is, how (the energy of) Unstruck Sound (avarSā) (abides) in the Ocean of the Yoni of Kula in union with (the energy of) Letter.88 (104cd-105) I have told you this before in (the scripture of) seventy million (verses). O god, (the Energy) in the form of Letter (varSa) has been revealed and then again hidden.89 Thus (mantras) are not successful even if they have been repeated (japtvā) a hundred million times. (106-107ab) She, the imperishable energy (of Śiva) is the very life of mantras. O handsome one, devoid of her, they are fruitless (like) autumn clouds (that give no rain).90 (107cd-108ab) O god, she is the Mother (of the letters) (mātrkā) endowed with both supreme (transcendence) and inferior (immanence).91 The entire universe from Brahmā up to (this) world is pervaded by her. (108cd-109ab)

sanskrit: 258 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ६३३ ६३४ ६३५ तत्रस्था तु यदा देव परापरसमन्विता ॥ १०९ ॥ ३७ अवर्णस्थं यथा१३६ वर्ण स्थितं सर्वगतं •६३८ ६३९ स्थितं सर्वगतं भुवि भुवि । तथाह कथयिष्यामि निर्णयं तु महाप्रभो ६४० या सा ६४२ शक्ति: ६४३ ।। ॥ ११० ॥ ६४५ शक्ति: परा सूक्ष्मा निराचारेति कीर्तिता ६४७ ६४८ । हृबिन्दु वेष्टयित्वा तु प्रसुप्ता भुजगाकृति: ।। १११ ।। तत्र सुप्तो महायोगी न किञ्चिद् मन्यते प्रभो ५१ । प्रबुद्धा सा निनादेन१५२ परमानन्दरूपिणी ५३ ।। ११२ ।। बिन्दुना क्षोभमायाता ऋजुरेखैव कुण्डली । ६५५ ६५८ रेखिनी ५७ नाम सा ज्ञेया बिन्दुद्वयपुटान्तगा ।। ११३ ।। त्रिपथा सा६५९ समाख्याता रौद्रीनामेति ६६० गीयते ६६१ । निरोधी सा च निर्दिष्टा मोक्षमार्गनिरोधिनी ।। ११४ ॥ ६६२ ६६५ ६६३ । ६६६ शशांकार्धकला ज्ञेया अम्बिका मध्यचन्द्रिका । ६६७ ६७० ।। एका एव पराशक्तिस्त्रिधा सा९ च प्रजायते ।। ११५ ।। एभ्यो युक्तवियुक्तेभ्य: १७२ संजाता नववर्गजा ६७३ । ६७४ ६७५ नवधा च त्रिधा सा सा ँ तु नववर्गाीक्षमालिका ६७७ ६७९ ६७६ ६८० पञ्चमन्त्रगता देव¨८ सद्यादीनां यथाक्रमम् । तेन १८९ सा पञ्चधा १८२ प्रोक्ता ज्ञातव्या सुरनायक ६८५ स्वरद्वादशगा देव १४ द्वादशस्था उदाहृता । ६८३ ६८८ । ।। ११६ ।। ।। ११७ ।। अकारादिक्षकारान्ता स्थिता पञ्चाशद्भेदतः ।। ११८ ।। ६९० ६९१ एकाणवा तु हृद्देशे कण्ठे ज्ञेया द्विराणवा९ । त्र्याणवा वेदितव्या तु जिह्वामूले यदाश्रिता ।। ११९ ।। ६९६ जिह्वाग्रे वर्णनिष्पत्तिर्नवभेदे १५ व्यवस्थिता । ६९८ एवं शब्दस्य चोत्पत्ति:१९७ सर्वस्यैव हि जृम्भते ॥ १२० ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY 259 O god, if she is there, possessing both a supreme (transcendental) and inferior (immanent form), it is like the phonemic energy (varSa) (of the letters) that is omnipresent in the world, present in the letter A (of Unstruck Sound) (avarSa).92 (109cd-110ab) O Great Lord, I will tell (you) the final conclusion (the scriptures have reached concerning Her nature).93 That subtle and supreme power is said to be beyond the bounds of scriptural injunction (nirācārā).94 (110cd-111ab) Wrapping herself around the Drop of the Heart she slumbers (there) in the form of a snake. There the great yogi (also) sleeps and, O Lord, he knows nothing at all.95 (111cd-112ab) She is supreme bliss and is awakened by the resonance (of consciousness).96 Aroused by the Drop (of Śiva's seed), KuSÆalī (assumes the form of) a straight line.97 (112cd-113ab) She should be known to be Rekhinī (the Line) (who) is in (the middle of) the capsule of the two Drops. (In the next phase) she is said (to flow) in three channels and is called Raudrī. She is (also) called Nirodhinī98 (the Obstructress) who blocks the path to liberation. (113cd-114) Ambikā, who is the moonlight of the Centre, should be know to be the half digit (kalā) of the moon.99 The Supreme Power who is only one becomes threefold. She is born as the nine classes (of letters) by the union and separation of these (her three aspects). (115-116ab) (Thus KuSÆalinī), who is the garland of the letters of the nine classes, is threefold and ninefold. O god, she (then) assumes the form of the five mantras of Sadyojāta and the rest, in due order. One should know, O Lord of the gods, that she is then said to be fivefold. (116cd-117) O god, (when) she is within the twelve vowels, she is said to be twelvefold. Divided by fifty, she is (all) the letters ranging from A to K±a. (118) In the heart centre she is a single atom (ekāSavā). In the throat she should be know to be two atoms and three when she is in the root of the tongue. (119) The letters, belonging to the nine classes, are formed at the tip of the tongue. Everybody's speech (śabda) originates and develops in this way.100 (120)

sanskrit: 260 कुमारिकाखण्ड: यथा ह्येकस्तथा सर्वे षोडशैते महाबलाः ७०२ ७०३ 006 । पञ्चविंशत्” ततः पश्चात् तस्योध्वे तु नव तथा अनेन क्रमयोगेण पञ्चाशाना समुद्भवः ७०९ ७०७ । ७०४ ।। १२१ ।। व्यवहारार्थे“ मया सृष्टा: शब्दविश्लेषणं प्रति ।। १२२ ।। ७११ ७१२ ७१४ न च व्यक्ति:”” विना৺”‍ तैस्तु भवते च कदाचन' ७१५ । तस्माद् देव६ विजानीयात् सर्वेद” मातृकोद्भवम् ।। १२३ ।। ७१९ न मातृकात् परो मन्त्रो नावस्था उन्मनी परा । न गुरोरपरो देवः न मुद्रा खेचरीपरा ।। १२४ ॥ न मातृकात् परं ज्ञान न ध्यानं मातृकात् • ७२२ • ७२३ ७२४ ७२५ परम् । मातृकोद्भवम् ।। १२५ ।। स्थूलसूक्ष्मविभागेन सर्वेदं तस्मादुत्पद्यते सर्वं सर्वं २९ तत्रैव लीयते ३० ७३१ जले बिन्दुर्यथा देव तथा चैव हि भूतात्मा ७३४ ७३३ उत्पत्तिश्च विनाशनम् ।। १२६ ।। मनोबिन्दौ ३५ विलीयते ३६ । ७३९ । शिरे रौद्री परित्यज्य ३८ ज्येष्ठा चायुधरूपिणी ।। १२७ ।। वामा कुण्डलिनी शक्तिरम्बिका च वरानन ७४३ स भवेच्छक्तिमान् वीरः प्रणयी ७४७ ७४२ । ७४५ मम भैरव' ७४६ ।। १२८ ॥ ७४८ भवते नात्र संदेह: साधकेन्द्रैस्तु पूज्यते । ब्रह्मा वामाश्रितो४९ देव देव ज्येष्ठा विष्णु: ५१ प्रकीर्तितः रौद्र्या ३ रुद्रो ४ महेशान अम्बिकामीश्वर विदुः । ७५९ ७६० । ७५२ ।।१२९ ॥ संयोगाच्छब्दो देव : ५७ शिवो नादात्मकः परः ।। १३० ।। पञ्चकारणक६१ ह्येव ँ६२ व्यापकत्वे ७६३ ७६४ व्यवस्थितम् ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 261 Just as one (of them) is, so are all of these sixteen great flames (mahānila).101 Fifty (come first). Then after that come nine. The fifty arise in this sequence. I have created them so that words may be articulated (śabdaviślenaSa) for the daily commerce of life.102 (121-122) Without them the ninefold manifestation could never take place.103 Therefore, O god, one should know that all this is born of the Divine Mother (mātrkā).104 (123) There is no mantra higher than Mātrkā, no state higher than the Transmental (unmanī). There is no god other than the teacher and no Gesture higher than Khecarī. There is no knowledge higher than Mātrkā and no meditation (dhyāna) higher than Mātrkā. (124-125ab) All of this, divided into gross and subtle, is a product of Mātrkā. Everything comes from that and everything dissolves away there itself.105 (125cd-126ab) O god, just as a drop comes into being and is destroyed in water, in the same way the elemental Self (bhūtātman) (comes into being) and dissolves away in the Drop of the Mind (manobindu). (126cd-127ab) The Unfolding States and Powers of Raudrī, Jyen˜hā, Vāmā and Ambikā Having abandoned Raudrī who is on the head (then comes) Jyen˜hā who is the weapon (āyudha).106 O handsome one, Vāmā is KuSÆalinī and Ambikā is energy.107 (127cd-128ab) O Bhairava, he (who knows this) possesses power and is a (true) Kaula (vīra). He loves me and is, without a doubt, worshipped by the best of adepts.108 (128cd-129ab) O god, Brahmā is associated with Vāmā. VinSu is said to be Jyen˜hā. O Great Lord, Rudra is with Raudrī and (the wise) know that Īśvara is Ambikā. (129cd-130ab) The god Word is (formed) by (their) union. Śiva, who is Sound, is supreme.109 (He who is) the Five Causes abides in this way in a pervasive state (vyāpakatva).110 (130cd-131ab)

sanskrit: 262 उदय वामयोद्दिष्ट ज्येष्ठा मध्यंदिनं ७७० कुमारिकाखण्डः ७६८ स्मृतम् सन्ध्या रौद्र्या तु विज्ञेया तस्यामस्तमन भवेत् । ७७२ रेचको २ वामया प्रोक्तो ज्येष्ठया पूरक: स्मृतः ७७७ ७७४ रौद्र्या कुम्भकमुद्दिष्ट, स्वभावस्था तथाम्बिका इडा वामा समाख्याता ज्येष्ठा वै पिङ्गला स्मृता रौद्री तु सुषुम्नान्तस्था विषुवस्था निगद्यते ७८३ ७८० ७८४ ७७९ ७८२ ७८५ । ७७८ ।। १३१ ।। ।। १३२ ।। । ॥ १३३ ॥ उद्भवे कुण्डली ज्ञेया वामा सा समुदाहृता ।। १३४ ।। विश्लेषस्था तथा ज्येष्ठा लये रौद्री निगद्यते । ७८७ ७८८ लयातीता तथा अम्बा ज्ञातव्या सुरनायक नाभिस्था कुण्डली ज्ञेया कण्ठस्था चोध्वतो”” रौद्री ७८९ प्रसुप्ता” भुजगाकृतिः । ७९७ ७९४ ।। १३५ ।। यत्र ४ रुद्रो जगत्पतिः ।। १३६ ।। प्रवाहे९५ ज्येष्ठिका मध्ये बिन्दुद्वयपुटान्तगा” । ७९९ अम्बिका ब्रह्मरन्ध्रस्था ज्ञातव्या तत्त्ववेदिभिः ।। १३७ ।। मनस्था कुण्डली ज्ञेया जाग्रावस्था प्रकीर्तिता' ज्येष्ठया ३ प्रेरिता रौद्री ४ रौद्री उन्मनकारिका ८०२ । ।। । ॥ १३८ ॥ । प्रसुप्ताख्या महादेव उन्मनान्ते लयं गता अम्बिका तु मनातीता तुर्यस्थानगता तु सा ।। १३९ ॥ .८१२ कुण्डली प्रथमा ज्ञेया वामा चैव द्वितीयका?” । तृतीया रौद्रिका देव३ त्रिशक्तिकलितं जगत् ।। १४० ।। ८१७ उद्भवश्चैव विश्लेषो लयो ज्ञेयस्तृतीयकः । ८१८ लयातीता परा शक्ति: मोक्षमार्गविकासिनी ॥। १४१ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 263 The dawn (udaya) is represented by Vāmā. Jyen˜hā is said to be at midday. (The third) juncture (saˆdhyā) should known to be Raudrī. Sunset (astamana) (takes place) within her.111 (131cd-132ab) It is said that exhalation is (brought about) by Vāmā. Inhalation is said (to be brought about) by Jyen˜hā. It is taught that the breath is retained by Raudrī. While Ambikā is established in one's own essential nature. (132cd-133ab) Vāmā is said to be IÆā, whereas Jyen˜hā is considered to be Pi‰galā. Again, Raudrī is within SunumSā and is said to be located in the equinox (vinuva). (133cd-134ab) One should know KuSÆalī to be within emergence (udbhava). She is said to be Vāmā.112 In the same way Jyen˜hā is in disjunction (viślena). Raudrī is said to be in merger. O leader of the gods, one should know that Ambā is beyond merger. (134cd-135) One should know that KuSÆalī is located in the navel. She sleeps and (her) form is that of a snake. Raudrī is above in the throat where Rudra is the lord of the universe. (136) Present (between the eyebrows) within the capsule of the two Drops,113 Jyen˜hikā is within the flux in the middle. Those who know (ultimate) reality should know that Ambikā is located in the Cavity of Brahmā (brahmarandhra).114 (137) One should know that KuSÆalī is located in the mind and is said to be the waking state. Raudrī is impelled by Jyen˜hā.115 Raudrī brings about the transmental (unmana) state. (138) O Mahādeva, she is called deep sleep and has dissolved away at the extremity of the Transmental.116 Again, Ambikā is beyond mind. She is in the abode of the Fourth State.117 (139) KuSÆalī should be known to be the first118 and Vāmā, the second.119 O god, the third is Raudrikā.120 The universe is differentiated (kalita) by (this) triple energy (triśakti). (140) Emergence (udbhava), disjuction (viślena) and merger (laya), which should be know to be the third.121 The Supreme Energy, who unfolds the path to liberation, is beyond merger.122 (141)

sanskrit: 264 कुमारिकाखण्ड: क्रियाकारणनिर्मुक्त” हेतुतर्कविवर्जितम्” । हेयोपादेयरहितं ज्ञात्वा न भवबन्धनम् ८२४ ८२६ ।। १४२ ।। । प्रिय ँ । ।। १४३ ।। ८३० आमिषं तु यथा खस्थ:२५ पश्यते शकुनिः क्षिप्रमाकर्षयेद्“ यद्वदं” आवेशेन तु सुन्दर तद्वदेव हि योगीन्द्रो” मनोबिन्दुं तु कर्षयेत् ८३२ ८३६ । यथा रौद्र्या विलीनस्था मन्त्रमुच्चारणावधि : ५ ॥ १४४ ॥ तथा बिन्दुर्वरारोह उच्चारेणानुगच्छति । ८३७ ८४० ८४६ ८३९ खस्थ खकरणं” कृत्वा खस्थाने” योज्य कूर्मं तु मङ्गले योज्य स्वरान्ते तु प्रेरयेत् तदुदानेन तदा स खमुख -८५४ -८५२ ८४३ •८४४ -८४५ खं॰ स्थिरम् ।। १४५ ॥ ८४९ । द्विभिर्युतम् व्रजेत् ॥ १४६ ॥ मङ्गलं कूर्मसूत्रं तु“ परार्थेनैव शोधनम् । -८५६ शुद्ध्यते नात्र संदेहो द्विजमार्गेण शोधयेत् ।। १४७ ।। •८६० अनेनैव ५९ तु मार्गेण ग्रहण च विलक्षयेत् । नाभिस्थं कम्पनं ज्ञेयं ६२ जृम्भनं ३ मुखमार्गतः ८६७ ८६४ अश्रुपात च भ्रूभङ्ग चित्तव्याकुलतैव च । •८७० •८७१ ॥ १४८ ॥ कण्ठस्थो“ धुनुते१९ गात्र राव मुञ्च्यत्यनेकधा ॥ १४९ ॥ ८७३ ८७४ -८७५ शिरःकम्पः प्रलापश्च हूंकारं च महारवम् रुद्रस्थान विजानीयाद् योगतो निष्ठतत्परः ८७८ अभावस्थ” पुनर्वक्ष्ये यथा भवति तच्छृणु । । ।। १५० ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY 265 Having known that which is without cause or action, reason and reasoning or that which should be taken up or abandoned, the bondage of phenomenal existence ceases.123 (142) O dear one, just as a bird in the sky who sees (a piece of) meat quickly (lays hold of it and) drags (it towards himself with great force), in the same way, O handsome one, the best of yogis should drag the Drop of the Mind (along SunumSā) by means of the penetration (āveśa) (of power). (143-144ab) Just as Raudrī has dissolved away and is the extreme limit (avadhi) of the utterance (uccāra) (and upward movement of mantra), in this way, O handsome one, the Drop follows after (impelled) by the utterance (of mantra).124 (144cd-145ab) Once one has formed the instrument (karaSa) of the Void (kha) that is in the Void and conjoined the stable Void within the Abode of the Void (khasthāna), the Tortoise should be conjoined within the Auspicious (ma‰gala) and with the two at the end of the vowels. It should be impelled by the upward moving (breath) (udāna). Then one reaches the entrance of the Void. (145cd-146) The Auspicious is the Thread of the Tortoise that is purified in order to (attain) the supreme goal.125 It should be purified by the path of the twice-born. (Then) it is certainly purified. (147) By this same path, one should perceive possession (by the deity) (grahaSa).126 Know that trembling (kampana) (is a sign that KuSÆalinī) is in the navel. (The yogi) yawns through the path of the mouth, tears fall (from his eyes), (his) eyebrows move up and down (bhrūbhaSga) and (his) mind is disturbed.127 (148-149ab) (When the energy) is in the throat (centre) (the yogi's) body shakes and he lets out a (loud) sound again and again. (His) head shakes; (he) babbles and loudly and shouts `hūm!'128 Know that the (yogi) who is established in Rudra's abode (sthāna) is intent on (this) practice (nin˜hā).129 (149cd-150) Establishment in Non-being and One’s Own Nature Next I will explain (the condition called) ‘established in non-being (abhāvastha)' 130 Listen to how that is. (151ab)

sanskrit: 266 कुमारिकाखण्डः ८८२ न निरोधो न चोच्चारो न ध्यानं लक्षयोजना' ८८४ ।। १५१ ।। स्वरूपस्थं ततो ज्ञात्वा मुक्तोऽसौ नात्र संशयः । संकल्पश्च““ महाबन्धो“ उच्छेदोद्भवकारणम् ।। १५२ ॥ तँ“ त्यक्त्वा मुच्यते योगी संकल्पे न तु मुच्यते । .८८८ ८८९ ८९१ मनो नापि मन्तव्यो न च मन्ता ९२ विभाव्यते ।। १५३ ।। यावत् संकल्पते देव” तावद् द्वन्द्वं प्रवर्तते । ८९६ ८९४ ८९७ न बिन्दुर्न च नादश्च न शक्ति: शिव एव च ।। १५४ ।। अविद्यावासना“ ह्येषा ९९ संसारस्य निबन्धना । ९०२ ९०० ९०३ अमूर्तौ” नास्ति संकल्पस्त्राता क: किं करिष्यति ॥। १५५ ।। तं.४ त्यक्त्वा त्यजितं सर्व०६ आशापाशमशेषतः । •९०४ ९०७ आशा एव महाबन्धस्तया“ बद्धोऽखिल जगत् ।। १५६ ।। यावन्न त्यज्यते”° सा वै तावन्मुक्तिः कुतो भवेत् । ९११ ९१६ ९१२ •९१८ ९१९ न बन्धं ४ मोक्षवादीनां यत्र सर्व लम् ।। १५७ ।। मोक्षेऽपि यस्य नोत्कण्ठः १ स मोक्षमधिगच्छति । • ९२२ ९२१ न मोक्षे कल्प्यते स्थान न ध्यानं न९२३ च धारणा सर्वत्र वितता१२५ दृष्टिः९२६ सर्वव्याप्युपलक्षणा ९२८ ९२९ ९३० ९३१ । ९२४ ।। १५८ ॥ अलक्षस्य कुतो लक्षो अमनस्के कुतो मनः ९३३ ९३४ ९३६ ९३२ अमनस्य कुतः स्थानं ५ कर्तव्या कल्पना बुधैः ६ । ९३९ ।। १५९ ॥ नास्तित्वे९३७ कारयेच्चित्तं १३८ अस्तित्वं च परित्यजेत् ।। १६० ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 267 There is no blocking (of anything), no utterance (of mantra), no meditation or conjuction with (any) object of perception. Thus having known (the reality that is) ‘established in the innate nature’, he is free without a doubt. (151cd-152ab) Discursively represented intention (saˆkalpa) is a great bond. It is the cause of cessation and origination.131 Having abandoned that, the yogi is freed. When intent prevails, he is certainly not freed.132 (152cd-153ab) No mind, object of thought or thinker is perceived (in that state). O god, as long as one continues to formulate intentions (saˆkalpate), duality (dvandva)133 prevails. (153cd-154ab) (In that state there is) no Drop, no Sound, no Śakti nor Śiva.134 This is the latent trace of ignorance (avidyāvāsanā), which is the bondage of transmigratory existence.135 (154cd-155ab) There is no intention (saˆkalpa) in (the one) formless (reality). What can (any so-called) saviour do?136 Once that has been abandoned, all has been abandoned, (including) all the fetters of (vain) hope (for worldly things). (155cd-156ab) Hope is the great fetter. The entire universe is bound by that.137 As long as that is not abandoned, where is liberation?138 (156cd-157ab) Where everything has dissolved away there is no bondage for those who believe in liberation (moknavādin).139 He who has no desire even for liberation attains it. No level of existence (sthāna) is conceived in the liberated state, nor (is there) meditation or concentration (dhāraSā).140 (157cd-158) (The yogi's) vision (drn˜i), which bears the mark of all-pervasive (consciousness), is extensive everywhere.141 (159ab) How can the Signless (alakna) have a sign? How can there be mind in that which is No Mind (amanaska). (159cd) Thus the wise should think: how can No Mind have a place (sthāna)? One should make the mind (abide) in Non-being (nāstitva) and abandon existence.142 (160)

sanskrit: 268 ९४० कुमारिकाखण्ड: नास्तिभावे यदारुह्येत्” तदास्तीति विभावयेत् ९४५ ९४३ अस्तिनास्तिपदं त्यक्त्वा सर्व४६ शून्यं विभावयेत् ।। १६१ ॥ ९४९ चलाचलात्मविज्ञानं चित्तवृत्तिमपेक्षते । ९५१ ९५३ सकल९५° निष्कलं ज्ञात्वा तदा मुच्येत बन्धनात् ॥ १६२ ॥ यावद् भावयते“४ ज्ञानं विज्ञानाधारकेवलम् । ९५५ •९५७ ९५८ ।। ।। वायुना केवलीभूतो केवलीभूतो अविद्यावासनां त्यजेत् ॥ १६३ ॥ प्राणायामादिभि: क्लेशैर्मनोबोधैस्तु वर्जितः ६१ । अन्यकालस्य`` कुर्वीत निष्कलं तु तदाश्रितम् ।। १६४ ।। तस्मादेवं तु विज्ञाय शून्यरूपं चराचरम् । •९६६ ९६५ भग्नघटवदाकाशं तत्तद्व्यापी अखण्डितम् ।। १६५ ।। ९७० मुक्त्यावस्थ९ जगत् सर्वं व्यामोहो बन्धकारकः । ९७३ ९७४ ९७५ व्यामोहो यदि शाम्यते मुक्ति: स्वाभाविकी स्थिता ।। १६६ ।। इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते ९७८ श्रीज्ञानाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। ४० ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY 269 If one ascends to the condition of Non-being, then one realises that it exists. (Thus), having abandoned the level of (both) being and non-being, one should realise that everything is emptiness (śūnya).143 (161) Insight into the moving and immobile Self depends on the activity (vrtti) of the mind.144 Once one has know (the one reality which is both) with parts (sakala) and without (ninkala), then one is freed from bondage.145 (162) To the degree in which one contemplates cognitive consciousness (jñāna) (all that remains is) the foundation of consciousness (underlying perception).146 (In that state, the yogi is) rendered independent by (the activity of) the breath and, free of mental perceptions (manobodha) and the afflictions of breath control and the like, he should abandon the (last) trace of ignorance. (163-164ab) Whatever has been done at any other time, it is placed in the formless (reality). Therefore, having understood in this way that the moving and immobile (world) is emptiness, (the yogi) pervades each individual thing, as does the unbroken space of a broken jar.147 (164cd-165) The entire universe is established in the liberated state. Delusion is the cause of bondage. If delusion is quelled, then the naturally liberated condition remains.148 (166) This is the (fortieth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the Venerable Knowledge. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It is on the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) and is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: एकचत्वारिंशानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच' महत् कौतूहलं दिव्यं समुत्पन्न मम प्रियें । यन्नास्ति' तत्र को लक्ष : अलक्षे भवना कुतः ॥ १ ॥ भावना' द्वन्द्वजननी भावहीनं निरामयम् । ध्यान पूजा जपो योगो नानारूपा तु भावना ।। २ ।। ४ किमर्थ ं सा त्वया देवि सूचिता परमेश्वरि । श्रीवक्रा उवाच नानारूपाणि” वर्णीनि लक्षध्यानान्यनेकशः ॥ ३ ॥ २३ मनःप्रसादनार्थाीय” मया ह्येते प्रकाशिताः । मनो हि चञ्चल नित्यं प्रमादी २७ बलवद् दृढ” ॥ ४ ॥ तत् कथं” शक्यते” धर्तु” यस्य वाय्वधिका गतिः” । ३२ यावद् भावयते” ह्येक तावदन्यदुपस्थितम् ॥ ५ ॥ ३७ ३९ न ध्यानं न च ँ वा लक्षं न संकल्प कदाचन । अनेन कारणाद् देव सर्वं त्यज्यमशेषतः ॥ ६ ॥२ उल्काहस्तो यथा कश्चित्” द्रव्यमालोक्य” तां त्यजेत्” । ज्ञानेन ज्ञेयमालोक्य तदा ज्ञानं परित्यजेत् ॥ ७ ॥ ४७
english: CHAPTER FORTY-ONE The Competence to Practice Yoga Apophansis, Detachment from the Opposites and the Realisation of Non- duality Śrīnātha said: O dear one, a great and sacred curiosity has arisen within me. What mark (lakna) can there be of the non-existant? How can there be contemplation (bhāvanā) of that which has no mark? (1) Contemplation (bhāvanā) gives rise to duality. The (supreme) flawless (reality) is devoid of (phenomenal) being (bhāva). There are many forms of contemplation including, visualization (dhyāna), the rite of adoration (pūjā), the repetition of mantra and Yoga. O goddess, O Supreme Goddess, why have you spoken about that? (2-3ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: The letters (varSa) are of many forms and the (forms of) meditation on (inner) objects (lakna) is of many kinds. I have revealed them in order to calm (prasādana) the mind. The mind is always fickle (cañcala), negligent, powerful and firm.1 Its activity greater (even) than the wind, how can it be controlled? (3cd-5ab) As long as one perceives one (thing), another will be present. (In the supreme state, there is) no meditation, no mark or intentional thought (saˆkalpa) ever. It is for this very reason that everything, without exception, should be abandoned. (5cd-6) Just as someone who holds a torch abandons it once he has seen the (precious) substance (he is looking for), (similarly) having perceived the object of knowledge by means of knowledge, one should then abandon knowledge. (7)

sanskrit: 272 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ५० मनोद्भव” तु यल्लक्षं ध्यानं वा कल्पनात्मकम् । सर्व विनश्यते देव' नाहमस्मीति भावयेत् ॥ ८ ॥ नाहमस्मि न चान्योऽस्ति अद्वैतक्रियया रतः '६ ६० ५७ । नैव मन्यति मुक्तोऽहं न बद्धस्तु कदाचन ।। ९॥ ६२ व्रतस्थोऽहं” गृहस्थो वा` अविद्यावासनां त्यजेत् । नैव मन्यति विप्रोऽहं नान्त्यजातिर्न देवता♛ ॥ १० ॥ ७० न युवो वृद्ध बालो वा सुलीनस्य तु लक्षणम् । नाह मन्यति” स्वर्गस्थो न पातालान्तरीक्षगः ॥ ११ ॥ न चास्म्यह न चास्तीद सुलीनस्य तु लक्षणम् । न योगी न वियोगी च निराशी निष्परिग्रहः ।। १२ ।। ७७ सर्वज्ञो निरहंकारी सुलीनस्य तु लक्षणम् । ७९ नाह” मन्यति” सर्वज्ञो न मूर्खो न च पण्डितः ।। १३ ।। ८७ यावन्न त्यजते“ ह्येव ं तावत् तस्य न किञ्चन“ । अहमित्येव यो भावः” सदा बद्धो गुणत्रये” ॥ १४ ॥ ९३ यावन्न” त्यजते देव स निरुद्धो भविष्यति ९५ ९७ यस्य तुल्यं सुखं दुःखं मित्रामित्रं शुभाशुभम् ॥ १५ ॥ मुक्तोऽसौ नात्र संदेहो ” जन्मसंसारबन्धनात् ' १०२ १०३ १०० । क्षीरक्षयाद्” यथा वत्सः मातराद् विनिवर्तते ॥ १६ ॥ तथा मनःक्षयात् पुंसां निर्वाणं परमं पदम् । १०७ पुत्रदारकुटुम्बेषु सक्त ँ सर्वमिदं जगत् ।। १७ ।। १०८ । तान् त्यक्त्वा निर्गुणो भूत्वा निर्वाणं तु प्रवर्तते । भवाग्रमपि ये प्राप्ता योगं तन्निष्ठतत्पराः ११२ ॥ १८ ॥ तृष्णाहंकारग्रस्ताश्च१३ ते १४ पतन्ति १५ भवार्णवे १६ । अहंकार” परित्यज्य ममत्व च परित्यजेत् ॥ १९ ॥ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-ONE 273 O god, everything is (eventually) destroyed (whether it is) a mental object of concentration (manobhavalakna) or visualization, which is imagination (kalpanā). (Thus) one should reflect that: `I am not'2 and, intent on non-dual action (that): `I am not, nor is there anything else.' (Such a one) does not think: `I am liberated'. Nor is he ever bound. (8-9) One should abandon the (last) trace of ignorance (that induces one to think): `I am observing the vow (of a renouncer)', or `(I am) a householder'. Nor should one think: `I am a Brahmin' or `(I belong) to the lowest caste', (or even) `(I am) the deity'. (10) The mark of one who is well merged (in the supreme reality) is not that (he is) a youth, an old man or a child. He does not think: `I am in heaven', or `(I am) in hell’ (or ‘I am in) the middle region’. (11) The mark of one who is well merged (in the supreme reality) (is the realisation that): `I am not, nor does (any of) this exist'. He is neither a yogi (lit. `one who is connected') nor is he disconnected (from Yoga) (viyogin). He wishes for nothing (he does not have) and is detached (from what he possesses). (12) The mark of one who is well merged (in the supreme reality) is that he is omniscient and egoless. One who is omniscient thinks: `I am not. (I am) not a fool nor (am I a great) scholar'. (13) Until he does not abandon3 (everything) in this way, he has nothing. The feeling that `I am' is always bound within the three qualities. (14) O god, as long as he does not abandon (the ego) he will (always) be bound.4 He for whom pleasure and pain, friend and foe, auspicious and inauspicious are equal is certainly free from the bondage of rebirth. (15-16ab) Just as a calf leaves (its) mother when (her) milk finishes, similarly when the mind ceases, men attain NirvāSa, the supreme abode. (16cd-17ab) All this universe is attached to sons, wives and family. NirvāSa (the liberated state) begins when, having abandoned those (things), (one is) is free of the (influence of the) qualities (of Nature). Those who have reached even the extreme limit of fettered existence (and are about to go beyond it) but are (still) consumed by craving and ego fall (back) into the ocean of fettered existence.5 Having abandoned the ego (ahaˆkāra), one should give up the sense that `(this is) mine' (mamatva). (17cd-19)

sanskrit: 274 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १२० आशापाशान्यशेषाणि”” त्यक्त्वा योग” समभ्यसेत्” । १२३ भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पी च २४ चतुर्वेदोऽपि यो द्विजः १२६ न स मुच्यति पापेभ्यो यावद् योगं न चाभ्यसेत् । । ।। २० ।। सर्व पश्यति मुक्तात्मा आत्मा सर्वत्र केवलम् ।। २१ ।। यथाहं वै२९ तथा सर्वं एकभावेन पश्यति' । १३० १३२ एकत्व” बहुधावस्थ” ऊणीतन्तुसहस्रशः ५ ।। २२ ।। १३६ मानापमानयोस्तुल्यो तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः । स मुक्तो मोचयेत् सर्वान् नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।। २३ ।। ९ १४२ १४३ निर्विकल्पो अनिर्देश्यों मनातीतगतः परः । मुच्यते नात्र संदेहो स्वरूपे संस्थितो यदा ।। २४ ।। ँ स्वभावगतिसंस्थस्य भवेत् त्वाध्यात्ममीश्वरे“ । १५० । न तस्य कल्पना प्रोक्ता भावनानामवर्जितः ।। २५ ।। हिरण्यगर्भवद् ज्ञेयो“ येनेदं विततं जगत् ५२ । । श्रीनाथ उवाच १५३ सर्वद्वन्द्वविनिर्मुक्ते५४ सर्वलिङ्गविवर्जिते ।। २६ ।। १५७ १५८ अद्वैते न द्वितीयोऽस्ति कथं स्थास्यति निश्चल:' । श्रीवक्रा उवाच १५९ १६० १६१ विना चराचर देव संयोगाच्च चलाचले ६२ ।। २७ ।। चलाचलात्मविज्ञान ३ चित्तवृत्तिमपेक्षते । येनेदं चाल्यते६५ सर्वं योगिभिस्तदुपास्यते ।। २८ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-ONE 275 Having abandoned all the bonds of longing (āśā) without exception, one should practice Yoga.6 Even if he is a Brahmin who knows the four Vedas, one who is responsible for an abortion or has had sex with his teacher's wife is not freed from his sins unless he practices Yoga. (20-21ab) The liberated soul sees everything (and realises that): `there is only the Self everywhere. Everything is as I am'. He sees (in this way that everything) is one.7 This one (reality) is in many states, (like) the countless thousands of woolen fibres (that are woven together in a blanket). (21cd-22) He who is the same in both honour and blame and for friend and foe alike, is certainly liberated and liberates everybody.8 (23) One who is free of thought constructs, is undefineable, beyond mind and supreme, established in his own nature (svarūpa), is liberated without a doubt.9 (24) The inner Self of one who is established in the fundamental condition (gati) of his own essential nature is within the Lord.10 It is said that he is free of thought (kalpanā) and contemplation (bhāvanā). One should know him to be like the Golden Womb by virtue of which this universe has been spread out (vitata). (25-26ab) The Yoga of Tranquility Śrīnātha said: Within the (one) non-dual (reality), which is free of all the opposites and distinguishing marks (li‰ga), there is no second (reality). (So) how does the Immobile One abide (within it)? (26cd-27ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O god, without association with the mobile and the immobile there (could be) no mobile and immobile (universe).11 Insight into the mobile and immobile Self depends on the activity (vrtti) of the mind. Yogis worship that by which all this (universe) is impelled.12 (27cd-28)

sanskrit: 276 १६७ शब्दस्पर्शरसोरूपगन्धतन्मात्रपञ्चकम्' । १६९ १७० कुमारिकाखण्ड: एते संगा : १६८ स्मृता देव देहिना सुमहाबलाः सङ्गदोषेण बध्यन्ते शान्तियोगरता हि ये । १७६ १७७ १७२ सङ्गात् संजायते कामः कामादर्थपरिग्रहः ॥ ३० ॥ ।। २९ ।। परिग्रहाच्च' वैकल्प” तस्मात् सङ्गं परित्यजेत् । कुसङ्गाल्लोकयात्रा च शास्त्रचिन्ता तथैव च २ ॥ ३१ ॥ सर्वसङ्गपरित्यागात् स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम् । श्रीनाथ उवाच १८६ १८८ हृदि संस्थितम् ।। ३२ ।। १९१ ' बिन्दुस्थं चैव नादस्थं शक्तिस्थ हृदि संस्थितम्' शक्तिस्थ हृदि संस्थं च स्वरूपस्थं विशेषेण ' यत् ९२ प्रोक्तं च त्वया देवि तत् सर्वमवधारितम् ।। ३३ ।। साम्प्रतं वर्णसंस्थ च' उपदेश च तत् कथम् । श्रीवक्रा उवाच २०० २०२ वर्णस्थ'” कथयिष्यामि शृणुष्वायतलोचन ॥ ३४ ॥ २०५ ग्रहण०४ नाभिदेशस्थ पूर्ववत् ते उदाहृतम् २०७ २०९ २०६ १० २११ २०३ योगं तत्र पुनर्देव लयं ९ चैव निरामये ।। ३५ ।। एवं ज्ञात्वा तु देवेश १२ योजयेत् परमे पदे १३ । आत्मतत्त्व”४ हृदिस्थ१५ तु१६ विद्यातत्त्वं तु लम्बकें शिवतत्त्वं लयस्थाने”” ब्रह्मरन्ध्रगतं भवेत् । .२१७ ।। ३६ ।।२१८
english: CHAPTER FORTY-ONE 277 O god, it is said that, for embodied beings, the five subtle elements of sound, touch, taste, form and smell are very powerful bonds (saˆga).13 (29) Even those who are devoted to the Yoga of Tranquillity are troubled by the defect of associating (with them). Desire arises due to (this) association and from desire comes clinging. (30) From clinging comes (the world of) thought and so one should abandon association (with their) company. Worldly life and reflection on (the meaning of) the scripture (to remedy the consequent suffering), is due to (this) bad company. (But), by abandoning the company of all (people and things), one reaches the highest state.14 (31-32ab) Grasping KuSÆalinī, the Wheels of the Letters, Merger in the Transmental and Pervasion Śrīnātha said: O goddess, I have understood all that you have said concerning the (condition of one who is) established in the Drop, in Sound, in Energy and in the Heart, (as well as) the one who is established in Energy and within the Heart and, in particular the one who is established in the innate nature (svarūpastha).15 Now (tell me), what is (the condition of the reality) established in the letters and the teaching (concerning it)? (32cd-34ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: O long eyed one, I will tell (you the condition of the reality) established in the letters.16 (34cd) As (I) have told you before, (KuSÆalinī) is grasped (grahaSa) in the navel centre.17 Again, O god, union (yoga) (takes place) there and merger (laya) (takes place in the supreme reality that is) free of defects. (35) O Lord of the gods, once known in this way, conjoin (KuSÆalinī) in the supreme state. The Principle of the Self (ātmatattva) is within the heart, the Principle of Knowledge (vidyātattva) is (within) the uvula. The Śiva Principle is in the Aperture of Brahmā, that is, in the locus of merger. (36-37ab)

sanskrit: 278 पूर्व शक्तिस्थं कथितं साम्प्रतं“ भुवनीशस्थो २२६ .२२९ एकैकं तु यथा वर्ण २२३ २२७ २२४ कुमारिकाखण्ड: अध्वाने तु यथा स्थितम् ।। ३७ ।। यथा ते .२२८ कथयाम्यहम् । २३३ ।। ३८ ।। शक्तिस्थं भवते ३२ प्रिय चक्रमालागत २४ तूर्णं ३५ मन्त्रसिद्धिर्जिगीषूणाम् २४१ २३६ । २४० २३७ श्रीकण्ठादि३८ स्मृताश्चक्रा:३९ संवर्तीन्तावसानगाः पञ्चाशच्च क्रमे प्रोक्ता ४२ यैव्याप्तमखिलं जगत् ।। सर्वे ते२४३ शक्तिमध्यस्था ज्ञातव्यास्तु त्रिलोचन न तैर्विना २४६ भवेन्मन्त्रो दृष्टादृष्टार्थसाधकः' २५१ २४८ २४५ ॥ ३९ ॥ ।। ४० ।। एकैक४९ वर्णमुच्चार्य द्वादशस्वरभेदितम् ।। ४१ ।। अनलानिलसंयुक्त””” बिन्दुनादकलांकितम् । - २५६ आत्मशक्तिशिवान् तत्र ५५ तेजोरूपान् विचिन्तयेत् ।। ४२ ।। २५७ २५९ लोलीभूतमिदं सर्वं शक्तिस्थाने लयं कुरु । स्फुरत्किरणसंकाशं तडित्कोटिसमुज्ज्वलम् ॥ ४३ ॥ यदा तल्लयतां६३ याति४ कालज्ञान २५ तदा भवेत् । सदाशिवपदावस्थं६६ पश्यते दिव्यचक्षुषा ।। ४४ ॥ अवस्थान्तरितं२६८ पश्येत् तत्त्वव्रतं सदोदितम् । अन्तस्थ२७२ पश्यते २७३ सर्वमस्य चक्रप्रभावतः ।। ४५ ।। षण्मासादुत्पतेत्७५ क्षिप्रं सत्यमेतन्न संशयः । २७७ २७४ २७६ गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं सर्वं गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः २८० नाशिष्याय प्रदातव्यं नापुत्राय कदाचन । २८२ २७९ ।। ४६ ।। अन्यशास्त्ररता ये२१ च कपटव्रतधारिणः ।। ४७ ।। अन्यदेवतभक्ता ये शठा ये न कदाचन २८७ २८५ । डम्भकोटिल्यनिरता६ अद्वैताचारदूषकाः ।। ४८ ।। २८८ २९० २९१ न दातव्यं च ते रत्नं ज्ञानकोश कुलागमम् । २८३ २६२
english: CHAPTER FORTY-ONE 279 The (condition of the reality) established in Energy on the (Cosmic) Path (adhvan) was explained previously. Now I will tell you about (the condition of one who is) established in the Lord of the Worlds (bhuvanīśastha). (37cd-38ab) O beloved, each letter is established in Energy and is in the garland of Wheels. (Thus) the accomplishment (siddhi) of mantra of those who seek to conquer (bondage) is quickly (effected).18 (38cd-39ab) The Wheels are said to be the series (of deities associated with the letters) beginning with ŚrīkaS˜ha and ending with Saˆvarta and Ananta.19 They are said to be fifty within the sequence20 and the entire universe is pervaded by them. O three eyed one, one should know that all of these are within (the very) centre of (Śiva's) Energy. No mantra that accomplishes (one's) visible or invisible goals is devoid of these (fifty). (39cd-41ab) Each letter is uttered along with the twelve vowels conjoined with Fire and Wind and marked with the energy of Sound and the Drop. Then one should meditate on (the Principles of) the Self, Energy and Śiva, whose form is radiant energy (tejas), there (in their respective places). (41cd-42) All this is in a state of vibrant union (lolībhūta). Merge it into the locus (sthāna) of Energy. If (this aggregate of Principles) brilliant with radiant rays, burning brightly like ten million lightning flashes,21 merges with that, then (the yogi attains) the knowledge of time (kālajñāna). (43-44ab) (Thus) he sees the state of Śiva's abode with (his) divine eye. Within (that) state he sees the perpetually active (sadodita) aggregate of Principles and, by the power of the Wheel, he sees everything established within (that). After six months, he flies up with great speed. This is true and there is no doubt about it.22 (44cd-46ab) More secret than secret, it should all be kept hidden with effort. It should not be given to one who is not (one's own initiated) disciple and never to one who is not (one's own spiritual) son. (46cd-47ab) One should not give this jewel and the treasury of wisdom, the Kula scripture (kulāgama),23 to those who are devoted to other scriptures, to those who observe deceitful vows, to those devoted to other deities, never to those who are dishonest, to those devoted to cheating and deviousness or to those who criticize the practice of non-duality (advaitācāra). (47cd-49ab)

sanskrit: 280 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २९५ ॥ ४९ ॥ प्रमादाद्”” ददते तेषां उपदेश ४ सुरार्चित योगिन्यस्तस्य९६ कुप्यन्ति शोषयन्ति वसामिषम् गुरुदेवसुभक्तानां अग्निकार्यरतानां च कुमारीयोगिभक्तानां शुचिव्रतरतानां च । ३०३ ३०४ ॥ ५० ॥ दीक्षाकाले ३ परीक्षेत ४ पाशस्तोभादिप्रत्ययैः ३०६ ३०७ ३०५ २९९ ।। ५१ ।। । यत्र लीना तु सा शक्तिरमनस्के मनोन्मनी । तस्मिन् नियोजयेत्”” नीत्वा शक्तिसूत्रेण साधकम् तावत्”” स्तोभ”” भवेत् क्षिप्रं उद्गाथयति”५ शास्त्राणि शक्तिना ३१० ।। ५२ ।। मुद्राबन्धान्यनेकधा । स्तोभितो यदा ॥ ५३ ॥ ३१८ अतीतानागतं चैव पृष्टोऽसौ कथयिष्यति उत्पतेन्निपतेद्”” भूमौ आवेश च मुहुर्मुहुः | ३२१ एवं ते कथितं देव शृणु भेदं यथा भवेत् । नपुंसकगणं त्यक्त्वा द्वादशारमुदाहृतम् ।। ५५ ॥ द्वात्रिंशद्वर्णसंयोगात्३ महाचक्रं निगद्यते २४ । ३२५ ३१७ ।। ५४ ।। एवं तु मातृका: ५ सर्वा: २६ चक्राम्नायव्यवस्थिताः ३२९ पश्चिमगृहसंभूता सबाह्याभ्यन्तरस्थिता । ३३० तालुके षोडशारं तु यत्र सा अमृतावहा कला ३३६ ३२७ ॥ ५६ ॥ ३३२ ।। ५७ ।।३३३ विसर्गस्थ४ यदा देव३५ तदा दूरात् शृणोति च । ३४० स्पर्श३३८ च विन्दते देव” हिमशिखरसन्निभम् ॥ ५८ ॥ लम्बिकामृतसंतृप्तो” वाङ्मयं वदतेऽखिलम् । ।। ३४६ वञ्चन३ कुरुते मृत्यो रोगानां ४५ च क्षयं तथा ॥ ५९ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-ONE 281 O you who are worshipped by the gods, the Yoginīs are angry and dry up the flesh and fat (of the teacher who) gives the teaching to (people like) them, (even if he does so) by mistake. (49cd-50ab) (The teaching should only be given to) those who are good devotees of the teacher and the deity, to those who are intent on the sacrifice (agnikārya) and the vow of purity and are devoted to the virgins (kumārī) and yogis. He should test (them) at the time of (their) initiation by means of (the appearance or otherwise of) the signs of attainment (pratyaya) such as the paralysis of (their) fetters (pāśastobha) and the rest.24 (50cd-51) (The teacher) should conjoin the adept to No Mind (amanaska) within which that energy, Mind Beyond Mind (manonmanā), is merged,25 once he has led (him there) by means of the Thread of Power (śaktisūtra).26 (52) In this way, (the bonds are) quickly paralysed and (he makes) many kinds of ritual gestures (mudrā). If (his bonds) have been paralysed, he quotes from (many) scriptures by virtue of (his spiritual) power.27 (53) (If) asked, he will tell (you) the past and the future. He leaps up from the ground and falls (back) onto it and he is repeatedly possessed (āveśa) (by the deity).28 (54) Thus, O god, it has been told to you. (Now) listen to how (it is) divided. The Twelve-spoked (Wheel) is said to be (all the vowels) except the group of neuters (¬ ­ ŀ Ŀ). Conjoined with the thirty-two (consonant) letters, it is called the Great Wheel (mahācakra). In this way, all the Mātrkās form a part of the teaching (āmnāya) concerning the Wheels.29 (55-56) Born in the Western House, (KuSÆalinī) is both inside and outside.30 The sixteen spoked (Wheel) is located in the palate where (KuSÆalinī) generates nectar. (57) O god, if he is established in Emission (visarga), he hears to a great distance and feels a (cool) tactile sensation, like a spray of snow.31 (58) Satisfied by the Nectar (that drips from the) uvula, he speaks of all that speech expresses (vāSgmaya). He cheats death and (all) diseases are destroyed. (59)

sanskrit: 282 ३४७ कुमारिकाखण्ड: शक्तिस्थ: कुरुते ह्येवं मुच्यते विषयादिभिः अणिमादिगुणावाप्तिर्भवते ४९ च ५० न संशयः तल्लयो ३५२ यदि तत्रैव तदा चोत्पतते ३५ क्षिप्रं ३५३ ३४८ । ३५१ ।। ६० ।। ३५४ स्थिरीभवति सुन्दर । सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः •३५९ ३६२ ३५७ ।। ६१ ।। ३६० । रन्ध्रस्थं सकल ज्ञेयं तदतीतं तु व्यापकम् घटमध्ये यथाकाश६१ परिच्छिन्नं च दृश्यते ।। ६२ ।। एवं शरीरविच्छिन्न े६३ व्यापक ४ त्वनुभासते५ । घटे ३६६ भग्ने ३६७ यथा देव आकाशं तदवस्थितम् बहिरन्तरभावेन तद्वज्जीवो” नभोपमः ३७० ३७२ यथा दीपो घटान्तस्थ३३ एकदेशप्रकाशक: ३७५ ३६९ ॥ ६३ ॥ ३७४ ॥ ६४ ॥ ३७७ तथा चात्मा च लिङ्गस्थो मनोव्यापारपेशल: । ३८० घटे भग्ने ३७८ यथा देव २९ सर्वत्रैव प्रकाशक : ।। ६५ ।। तथा पाशैर्विनिर्मुक्तो व्यापकः ३८२ परमेश्वरः । ३८३ ८४ एवं व्याप्तिः समाख्याता ३८५ तव भक्त्या च सुव्रत ३८६ ।। ६६ ।। यथा ह्येक तथा सर्वं पञ्चाशच्चक्रभैरवम् । अनलानिलसंयुक्त” नादबिन्दुकलांकितम् ।। ६७ । ३९५ सर्वकर्मकर: ९२ प्रोक्तो यथाशक्तिः” समीकृतः ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-ONE 283 One who is established in (Śiva's) energy does this and is freed from the objects of sense and (all) the rest (that is binding). (Again, he) acquires, without a doubt, the yogic power to make himself small at will and the rest. (60) O handsome one, if this state of merger is made firm there (in that same place), he then flies up swiftly (from the ground). (This is) true, true without a doubt.32 (61) The (deity) with form (sakala) should be known to be located in the Cavity (of Brahmā). Beyond that is the pervasive (aspect of the deity). Just as the space within a jar appears to be divided, similarly the pervasive one appears to be divided up (vicchinna) by the body. (62-63ab) O god, just as when a jar is broken (the space that was within it goes on being) space, similarly, the individual soul by virtue of the fact that (his experience of his essential) condition is both internal and external, is like space (nabhas).33 (63cd-64ab) Just as a lamp placed in a jar illumines (only) one place, similarly, the Self in the Li‰ga is artificially formed by the activity of the mind. (64cd-65ab) O god, just as when the jar is broken (the lamp) illumines everywhere, similarly, the Supreme Lord, free of the fetters, is (all) pervasive.34 (65cd-66ab) In this way, O one of good vows, by virtue of your devotion, Pervasion (vyāpti) has been explained. (66cd) All the fifty are like (any) one of the Bhairavas in the Wheel, namely, conjoined with Fire and Wind and marked with the energy of Sound and the Drop. (67) (One who knows this) is said to be the one who performs all action (karman) and, according (to his) power, is made equal (to the Lord). (68ab)

sanskrit: 284 कुमारिकाखण्ड: इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वयसप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते ४०० ३९७ लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्र- संहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते योगाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ४०२ ।। ४१ ।। ३९९
english: CHAPTER FORTY-ONE 285 This is the (forty-first) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to a description of the Competence to Practice Yoga. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: श्रीनाथ उवाच द्विचत्वारिंशानन्दः मूलशक्त्यवतारं तु मूलान्वये क्रमागतम् । यथा त्वं' तत्त्वतो वेत्सि' तथा ' कथय कौलिनि ॥ १ ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि कुकारान्वयनिर्णयम् । सार्धवृत्तत्रयं ज्ञानं मूलसूत्रं कुलान्वये । क्रियासूत्रविकासज्ञ: त्रैलोक्याकर्षणक्षमः” ।। २ ।। o ७ या सा शक्तिर्भगाख्या त्रिपथगतियुता त्र्यक्षरा त्रिप्रकारा तस्या:“ श्री—ओड्डियाण” परकलसहित मध्यसंस्थ” सुदीप्तम् । तच्छ्रीजालन्धराख्य” प्रकटितनिलय दक्षिणे चैव कोणे वामे श्रीपूर्णपीठ” पशुजनभयकृत् पूरित येन विश्वम् ।। ३ ।। तस्याग्रे” कामरूपं मदनकलयुतं” सर्वसिद्ध्यालय च त्रिष्कोणान्ते” समस्तं परमशिवकलालंकृतं योगिवृन्दम्” । तन्मध्ये दिव्यलिङ्ग” परमसुखकरं बिन्दुरूपं खरूप नित्यानन्दस्वरूपं” तदुपरिमथनात्” षट्प्रकारैर्विभिन्नम् ॥ ४ ॥ •३७
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO The Sūtra of the Sequence of Emanation. The Third Root Sūtra Śrīnātha said: O Kaulinī, tell (me), as you know it in truth, about the descent (into this world) of the Root Energy that has entered the transmission (krama) in the root tradition (anvaya). (1) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Now I will tell (you) the teaching concerning the tradition of the (goddess whose name begins with) the syllable `Ku' (kukārā). It is the Root Sūtra in the Kula Tradition and is the knowledge set in three and a half (verses). The one who knows the unfolding of the Sūtra of Action is capable of attracting (the entire) triple world (to himself).1 (2) The Energy called the Yoni (bhaga) moves along three paths, consists of three letters and three aspects. Located in the centre (of it), along with the Supreme Power (parakalā), is the venerable (seat called) OÆÆiyāSa that is beautifully luminous (sudīpta). In the right hand corner is the venerable (seat) called Jālandhara. It is located in (the Supreme Reality) that has been made manifest. In the left (corner) is the venerable PūrSapī˜ha that arouses fear in the fettered2 and fills the universe (pūrita).3 (3) In the forepart of (the Yoni) is Kāmarūpa. Endowed with the energy of passion, it is the abode of all the accomplishments (siddhi). The entire troupe of yogis, adorned with the energy of Supreme Śiva, resides within the Triangle. In the middle of the (Yoni) is the Divine Li‰ga that generates supreme bliss and is the Drop whose form is the Void (of transcendence). It is eternal bliss and, by churning it from above, it is divided into six aspects.4 (4)

sanskrit: 288 •४२ कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४३ विद्याभोगं क्रमार्थं सततमनुभव तिस्रमाज्ञाललाटे ४७ एवं व्याप्तं समस्तं स्थितिलयजननी रुद्रशक्तिस्त्रिभेदैः । मध्यस्था देवदेवी” अकुलकुलमयानन्ददात्री स्वतन्त्रा तस्याज्ञा बिन्दुभूता' पशुभयहरणी सिद्धिदा बोधरूपा ।। ५ ।। ५७ ५८ नित्यक्लिन्ना सुरक्ता ँ भगमुदितपरानन्दशक्ति : “ प्रसिद्ध ६२ •६३ ५९ कुर्वन्ती ं तत्र कामान् क्षुभितवरतनुं श्रीकुब्जिकाख्यां४ नमामि“ । त्रिप्रकारस्वरूपेण मूलसूत्रं प्रकाशितम् । ६९ प्रधानाः “पीठाश्चत्वारः च्छायावृक्षैस्तु संयुताः ।। ६ ।। ७० भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा या सा¨ भगाख्या परमेश्वरी । या सा त्रिकोणशक्तिः” अकुलकुलयुता संप्रवाहती षट्कं मध्ये ॐकारपीठं मदनकलयुतं कामरूपं तदग्रे । दक्षांशे जालसंज्ञं परममृतमय वामकोणे तु पूर्णं वामे श्रीशैलगियीँ रतिसुखनिलय भोगमाहेन्द्र दक्षे ।। ७ ।। अग्रे कैलासपूर्ण त्रिभुवनसहित योगकैलासमेतत् वामान्ते पञ्चकोऽन्य” विमलकलयुतं तुर्यसिद्धाश्च पूर्वे । षट्कोणे योगिषट्कं तदनु कलमयं षट्प्रकारे तु षट्कं दक्षान्ते पञ्चकोऽन्य” परमपदगतं पश्चिमे ओलिनाथ” ।। ८ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 289 Located on the forehead of the Command,5 it is (the sacred seat called) Tisra which is the expanse of the Vidyā, the Reality of the Transmission (kramārtha) and eternal experience. In this way, everything is pervaded by the three divisions of Rudra's energy who is the mother of persistence and destruction. (She is) the Goddess of the gods and is in the middle.6 Free and the bestower of bliss, she is (both) Kula and Akula. Her Command is the Drop. She is awakened consciousness who removes the fear of the fettered and bestows accomplishment (siddhi).7 (5abcd) Very passionate, she is Nityaklinnā (Perpetually Wet with the nectar of immortality) and is well known as the energy of supreme bliss that is infused with joy (mudita) by the Yoni. I salute the venerable (goddess) called Kubjikā who generates desires there and whose most excellent body is aroused (with divine passion).8 (5ef) (Thus) the Root Sūtra in its threefold form has been revealed. (6ab) The Sūtra of the Śrīkrama9 The main sacred seats are four and they (all) have trees that afford shade.10 The Supreme Goddess who bestows both worldly experience and liberation, is called the Yoni (bhaga). (6cdef) The Energy of the Triangle, endowed with Kula and Akula, transports (and sustains) the group of six.11 The sacred seat of O¤ is in the centre. In front of that, endowed with the Energy of Passion (madanakalā), is Kāmarūpa. The (sacred seat) called Jāla is on the right side, while (the sacred seat called) Full, which is the supreme nectar (of immortality), is in the left corner. On the left, mount Śrīśaila12 is the abode of the joy of sex; while the (mount) Māhendra of worldly experience (bhoga) is on the right.13 (7) In front stands (mount) Kailāsa, full (of all things).14 Along with the three worlds, it is the Kailāsa of Yoga. In the end of the left, endowed with the Pure (lunar) Energy (vimalakalā), is the other Pentad, while the four Siddhas are in front. The group of six yogis is in the hexagram. After that comes the group of six made of energies (kalā) within the six parts.15 At the end of the right, there is another Pentad, while Olinātha, who resides within the Supreme Abode, is in the west.16 (8)

sanskrit: 290 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तस्यादौ एकपुष्पं तदपरमकुल ओलिनाथस्य चान्ते पीठास्ते पीठदेव्यास्तदनुचरविभव त्रित्रिभेद त्रिदेशे । दक्षाष्टौ” योगिनीभिस्तदनुपरिवृतं साधकैः पुत्रपूर्वै:' ९३ ओड्डाव्वा¨ आदिशक्तिः सकलगुणयुता वक्त्रषट्क¨ तदन्ते ॥ ९ ॥ तद्बाह्ये चाङ्गषट्कं तदनु कुलबहिर्मण्डलान्येकविंश मध्ये या कादिपूर्व सकलगुणनिधिर्मण्डलानां विधानम् । अष्टाष्टौ तत्र बाह्ये वितरितपरमा दिक्षु अस्त्रप्रयोगात् खम्भाश्चत्वारिं कोणैर्विदिशकुलगत सिद्धमादिचतुष्क । एवं कुर्यात् कुलाद्यं यजनक्रमपद श्रीक्रमस्यादिसूत्र” ॥ १० ॥ क्रियासूत्रमिदं शम्भो षट्क्रमे परिपठितम् । एवं पूज्य विधानेन परत्रं निर्मलं भवेत् ॥ ११ ॥ द्वावेतौ यावन्न” ” ज्ञातौ द्वावेतौ तत् कुतो भवेत् । कारुण्येन विना मुक्तिः कुतो भवति श्रीक्रमे ॥ १२ ॥ १२० ११७ बिन्दुस्थं कामरूपं तदनु शशिकलामध्ये पीठोड्डियाण नादान्ते”“ जालपीठं तदधपथगत” मन्त्रपीठ त्रिकोणे । पीठोत्पत्ति:११ कुलौघे‍ स्थितिलयजननी प्रत्ययं तं ललाटे वन्दे सिद्धैः समेता २३ परमपदगतां दिव्यशक्ति २४ भगाख्याम् ॥ १३ ॥ ·१२६ पुनः सृष्टिक्रमं सूत्र संहितार्थे ब्रवीम्यहम् । १२५
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 291 There is One Flower (ekapunpa) at the beginning of that and the lower (immanent) Kula is at the end of Olinātha. These are the sacred seats and the goddesses of the sacred seats and the glorious power that is associated (with them). (This is) the triple triple division (tritribheda) in the three places. After that it is surrounded by the eight Yoginīs and by the adepts along with the sons (on the eight petals of a lotus). Mother OÆÆā is the Primordial Energy (ādiśakti), endowed with all the qualities. Within that, outside (the Triangle in the corners of the hexagram) come the groups of Six Faces and Six Limbs. (9) After that, outside the Kula (of the maSÆala), there are twenty-one maSÆalas.17 In the middle is the (Vidyā) who is the treasury of all qualities and the prescription (vidhāna) beginning with `Kā' concerning the maSÆalas. There are sixty-four (Yoginīs) outside there and the supreme (Command) that has been spread out in (all) directions by applying the Weapon. There are four pillars in the corners. The first group of four that has been accomplished is in the Kulas of the intermediate directions. One should fashion in this way the first Sūtra of the Śrīkrama which (describes the maSÆala) endowed with the Kula and is the location of the sacrificial rite (yajanakrama).18 (10) O Śambhu, this is the Sūtra of Action (kriyāsūtra). It is recited in the course of the sixfold liturgy (na˜krama). Having worshipped in the prescribed way, the future world (paratra) is purified. (11) As long as one does not know these two (sūtras) where can that (reality be realised)? There is no liberation in the Śrīkrama without compassion. (12) The Sūtra of the Sequence of Emanation (Srn˜ikramasūtra)19 Kāmarūpa is in the Drop. After that comes the sacred seat UÆÆiyāSa, which is in the centre of the energy (kalā) of the Moon. The sacred seat Jālandhara is located at the End of Sound (nādānta). (PūrSagiri) the sacred seat of mantra within the Triangle is on the path below it. The arising of the sacred seats takes place within the (Triangle) in the current of Kula (kulaugha). The mother of persistance and destruction20 (resides there, while) the sign of (its) accomplishment is (experienced in the) forehead. I praise the divine Energy who is in the Supreme Abode and, in the company of the Siddhas, is called the Yoni (bhaga).21 (13) Again, I will recount the sūtra22 concerning the sequence of emanation in accord with the teaching of the scripture. (14ab)

sanskrit: 292 कुमारिकाखण्ड: प्रथम २७ शक्तिक रूपं अव्यक्तव्यक्तिगोचरम् ” ॥ १४ ॥ १३१ १३२ अव्यक्तो भैरवो ह्यात्मा आत्मानन्दः प्रकीर्तितः । त्रिकोणान्ते३३ तु संजातं खमध्ये गगनान्तरे ॥ १५ ॥ पातङ्गरूपिणों वायुस्तेन ओद्याणक भवेत् । तन्मध्याच्छ्रयोद्यानात्” बिन्दुः पतितश्चाग्रकोणके ॥ १६ ॥ तत्र कामाख्यमुत्पन्न” सर्वसिद्धालय स्मृतम् । बिन्दोश्च निर्गतस्तेजस्ततो भगदक्षिणे ॥ १७ ॥ तत्र'४३ जालाख्यमुत्पन्न ं तीव्रतेजः सुदुःसहम् । तेजसा४६ त्यजिताभासा च वामांशे कुलोत्तरे ॥ १८ ॥ तेन पूर्णगिरिः प्रोक्त: एवं पीठचतुष्टयम् । सृष्टिमार्गेण४९ कथितं पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् ।। १९ ॥ तेषां गुप्तानि नामानि संकेतेन ब्रवीम्यहम् । योगतन्त्रस्य'५० मध्यस्थं मायापीठ भगान्तरे ॥ २० ॥ मोक्षमार्गप्रदातारमव्यक्तात्५२ संप्रवर्तते
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 293 OÆÆiyāna (Kalā) 23The form of Śakti comes first and its sphere is the manifestation of the Unmanifest. The Unmanifest is Bhairava who is the Self and is said to be the bliss of the Self. He arises in the middle of the Sky (of Ultimate Reality) within the Void (gagana) inside the Triangle. The form of the breath is that of a bird (that flies upward) and so is OdyāSaka.24 (14cd-16ab) Kāmarūpa (Bindu) The Drop falls in the front corner from the middle of the venerable Odyāna.25 (The sacred seat) called Kāmarūpa, which is said to be the abode of all the Siddhas, arises there. (16cd-17ab) Jālandhara (Nādānta) Again, the radiant energy (tejas) that emerges out of the Drop has gone to the southern (corner) of the Yoni. (The sacred seat) called Jāla whose energy is extremely intense and hard to bear, arises there.26 (17cd-18ab) PūrSagiri (Mantrapī˜ha) Again, the light emitted by the radiant energy (emerges) in the left part, that is, the northern part of the Kula.27 Thus it is called PūrSagiri. Such are the four sacred seats. (18cd) (The teaching concerning the four seats) that has come down through the series (of teachers and disciples), has been imparted in accord with the path of emanation. (18cd-19) The Secret Names of the Seats OÆÆiyāna 28I will (now) tell (you) their secret names according to the convention (saˆketa).29 The bestower of the path to liberation, the Sacred Seat of Māyā30 of the Yoga Tantra, is in the centre within the Yoni. It comes forth from the Unmanifest (avyakta).31 (20-21ab)

sanskrit: 294 कुमारिकाखण्डः सूर्यतत्त्वगतं विद्याद् विद्यापीठं तु दक्षिणे ।। २१ ।। ज्ञानसिद्धिप्रदातारं नादमध्याद् विनिर्गतम् । सोमतत्त्वप्रभामध्ये मन्त्रपीठं तथोत्तरे ।। २२ ॥ ज्ञानसिद्धिप्रदातार तेजमध्यात् प्रवर्तितम् । । १५८ १५९ ब्रह्मतत्त्व ं विजानीयात् मुद्रापीठं तदग्रतः पिण्डसिद्धिप्रदातार१ बिन्दुदेहात् प्रवर्तितम् । १६० ।। २३ ।। इदं संकेतकं गुह्यं क्रमस्यादि प्रकीर्तितम् ।। २४ ॥ नाम्ना पीठावली ह्येव‍ योगिनीचिह्नलक्षणम् । १६३ संकेतस्य ४ प्रभावेण अन्वये चान्वयी भवेत् ।। २५ ।। इति सूत्रार्थमुद्दिष्ट निर्णीत सप्तकोटिषु । । अथ भाषाक्रमं देव कुलमार्गे ब्रवीम्यहम् ।। २६ ।। १७१ १७२ १७३ कुभु कुक्षि: कुनि: कुमा' कुला कुशा कुवे कुया प्रकल्पितम् ।। २७ ।। इदं संकेतक कोश भावमार्गे १७७ ७६ १७८ १७९ अस्य ँ भाषार्थविज्ञानं गुरुवक्त्रात् तु लभ्यते । १७४ ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 295 Jālandhara One should know that the Sacred Seat of Vidyā, which is within the Solar Principle, is in the south. It has emerged from the centre of Sound and bestows accomplishment in knowledge.32 (21cd-22ab) PūrSagiri The Sacred Seat of Mantra is in the north, in the centre of the light of the Lunar Principle. It bestows accomplishment in knowledge and has emerged from the midst of the radiant energy (tejas) (of the deity). (22cd-23ab) Kāmarūpa In front of that is the Sacred Seat of Gesture.33 One should know that to be the Principle of Brahmā that bestows the accomplishment of the body (of the energies of the letters) (piSÆasiddhi) and has come forth from the body of the Drop. (23cd-24ab) This is the secret convention and is said to be the first of the Transmission. It is called the `group of sacred seats' (pī˜hāvalī) and its mark is the sign (of the presence of) the Yoginīs (in each sacred seat). The initiate (anvayin) is a part of the tradition (anvaya) by the power of the convention. (24cd-25) Thus the meaning of the Sūtra has (just) been indicated (uÆÆin˜a) (here and) expounded in full (nirSīta) in the (scripture of) seventy million (verses).34 (26ab) The Language on the Path of Kula Now, O god, I will tell (you) the Sequence of (the Secret) Code (bhānākrama) on the Kula path. (26cd) The Group of Eight Codes KULĀ,35 KUŚĀ, KUVE, KUYĀ, KUBHU, KUK±E, KUNI and KUMĀ — this is the vocabulary (kośa) of the convention, conceived on the path of (phenomenal) existence. Knowledge of the meaning of (the Kula) language is obtained from the teacher's mouth. (27-28ab)

sanskrit: 296 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १८४ कुलावलीति इत्युक्त्वा कुशा शाकिनि एव च ।। २८ । कुवे वेश्यावली नाम कुया याकिनिभैरवी । कुभु भुक्तिवती या तु कुक्षे क्षेमंकरीति च ।। २९ कुनि निष्क्रमणा देवी कुमा वै मङ्गला सा च । एवं चाष्टविधा ह्येका कुब्जिका गृहदेवता ॥ ३० ॥ तया चयी कृता पूर्वं अद्वैतगृह अष्टके । १९३ १८९ प्रयागा वरुणा कोला १२ अट्टहासा जयन्तिका ।। ३१ ।। चरित्रैकाम्रक१९४ चैव देवीकोट्टं तथाष्टमम् । १९६ गृहाष्टकं समाख्यातं सद्यःप्रत्ययकारकम् ।। ३२ ।। दिव्याधिकार” सर्वेषां ज्ञानदं भोग भवेत् । २०० अतीताश्च” स्वयं देव्या वेश्याद्याश्च गृहाष्टके ॥ ३३ ॥ २०३ वेश्या शुण्डिनि कैवर्ती खट्टिकी कञ्चुकी तथा । रजकी च तथा शिल्पी ४ अष्टमी कौशिकी तथा ।। ३४ ।। अष्टावेता:°५ समाख्याता गृहाश्चोदयकारिकाः २०६ । २०७ प्रयागे तु स्थिता वेश्या वाराणस्यां तु शुण्डिनी ।। ३५ ।। कौल्लगिर्ये तु कैवर्ती अट्टहासे तु खट्टिकी । २०८ २१२ २०९ जयन्त्यां” कञ्चुकी प्रोक्ता चरित्रे रजकी २ तथा ।। ३६ ।। एकाम्रे शिल्पिका ३ देव १४ कौशिकी १५ देवकोटके | •२१६ एवं चाष्टविधा भाषा कुकारा चाष्टधा स्मृता ।। ३७ ।। मन्त्रजा सहजा चैव योगजा १७ तन्त्रजा १८ तथा । कुलजा ज्ञानजा चैव योनिजा व्योमजा तथा ॥ ३८ ॥ शक्तिश्चाष्टविधा प्रोक्ता वेश्यादिसमुदीरिता । मन्त्रजा सकला प्रोक्ता सहजा रौद्रिका भवेत् ।। ३९ ।। योगजा च क्रियाक्रान्ता तन्त्रा क्षुद्रकर्मसु । २२१ २२२ २२३ कुलजा प्रियसंवादी ज्ञानजा समयार्थिनी ।। ४० ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 297 (KULĀ) is said to be Kulāvalī (the Troupe of Kula) and KUŚĀ is Śākinī. (KUVE) is Veśyāvalī (the Troupe of Courtesans), while KUYĀ is Yākinī Bhairavī. KUBHU is Bhuktivatī (Endowed with Enjoyment), while the (goddess called) KUK±E is Knemaˆkarī (the Forgiving). KUNI is the goddess NinkramaSā (the Exit), while KUMĀ is Ma‰galā (the Auspicious). In this way, Kubjikā the one deity of the House (grhadevatā), is of eight kinds. (28cd-30) Previously, in the eight houses of non-duality, she observed the conduct (of union with the god) (caryā). (These are): Prayāgā, VaruSā, Kolā, A˜˜ahāsā, Jayantikā, Caritra, Ekāmraka and Devīko˜˜a as the eighth. (31-32ab) (This) is said to be the group of Eight Houses (grhān˜aka) that gives immediate realisation. They all possess the divine authority that bestows knowledge and worldly benefits. Veśyā (the Courtesan) and the other goddesses who are, in themselves, transcendental (atītā), (reside) in the Eight Houses.36 (32cd-33) (These goddesses are): Veśyā (the Courtesan), ŚuSÆinī (the Barmaid), Kaivartī (the fisherwoman), Kha˜˜ikī (the Butcher Woman), Kañcukī (the Debauchee), Rajakī (the Washerwoman), Śilpī (the Sculpteress) and Kauśikī (the Female Owl), who is the eighth. These eight are said to be the generators of the Houses. (34-35ab) Veśyā is in Prayāga, ŚuSÆinī is in VārāSasī, Kaivartī is in Kaullagiri, Kha˜˜ikī is in A˜˜ahāsa, Kañcukī is said to be in Jayantī, Rajakī is in Caritra, Śilpikā is in Ekāmra and Kauśikī is in Devako˜aka. In this way, the language is of eight kinds. And so too (the goddess) Kukārā is said to be of eight kinds. (35cd-37) The Energy called Veśyā etc. is said to be of eight kinds, namely: Mantrajā (Born of mantra), Sahajā (Innately Born), Yogajā (Born of Yoga), Tantrajā (Born of Tantra), Kulajā (Born of Kula), Jñānajā (Born of Knowledge), Yonijā (Born of the Yoni) and Vyomajā (Born of the Sky). (38-39ab) 1) Mantrajā is said to contain (all the) energies (sakalā). 2) Sahajā is said to be terrible (raudrikā). 3) Yogajā is pervaded by action. 4) Tantrajā is (engaged) in the lower works (of magic). 5) Kulajā converses pleasingly and 6) Jñānajā desires the Rule. (39cd-40)

sanskrit: 298 कुमारिकाखण्ड: योनिजा४ मोहयेद् भूतान् व्योमजा मारयेद् ध्रुवम् •२२७ २२८ २२६ एवं क्षेत्राष्टके ज्ञेया ब्रह्माण्याद्यष्टकं विदुः ॥ ४१ ॥ अष्टावेते २९ च बोधव्याः पूजितव्याः प्रयत्नतः । २३० तदा श्रेयस्करा ज्ञेया अपमान्य मरणं भवेत् ।। ४२ ।। इदं भाषाष्टकं दिव्यं कुलाम्नाये प्रकाशितम् । रक्षितव्यं प्रयत्नेन३२ परशिष्ये ३ न दापयेत् ॥ ४३ ॥ २३६ २३३ २३७ आकहा३४ हाकहा१५ चैव कुकहा डाकहा ँ २३९ २३८ तथा । राकहा लाकहा चैव काकहा साकहा तथा ॥ ४४ ॥ २४० २४१ हाकहा कुकहा सिद्धा जगतश्च चतुर्युगे । ज्ञानं २४२ प्रकाशयेद् यस्य कहाशब्दस्तदुच्यते ।। ४५ ।। ज्ञानतत्त्वस्वरूपेण४३ कुलभाषा मयोदिता २४५ • २४७ । । तद्भाषादशकं ५ मे२४६ चोक्त कहार्थेन तु योजितम् ।। ४६ ।। •२४८ अनया भाषया देव कुल तत् प्रकटीकृतम् । यो न वेत्ति इमां ४९ भाषां५० नासौ २५१ योग्य : २५२ कुलान्वये ।। ४७ ।। २५३ कै कखमा आगजाद्या५४ कुशदीपी ५५ च षट्कोऽयम् ५६ । इयं द्वादशिका भाषा आदिदेव्या प्रकाशिता ॥ ४८ ॥ योगभाषाक्रमो ह्येष आचार्यपददायकः ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 299 7) Yonijā deludes living beings while 8) Vyomajā certainly kills (one's enemy). They should be known to be in the eight fields in this way.37 (The wise) know that (they are the same as) the group of eight (Mothers) beginning with BrahmāSī. One should know these eight and worship them with effort. Then they should be known to be beneficial, (but if they are) disrespected, (they) kill (the offender). (41-42) This is the divine group of eight of (the secret) language revealed in the Kula tradition. It should not be given to the disciple of another (teacher), (but) streneously protected (from the uninitiated). (43) The Sixty-eight Codes ĀKAHĀ, HĀKAHĀ, KUKAHĀ, ÕĀKAHĀ (Õākinī), RĀKAHĀ (Rākinī) LĀKAHĀ (Lākinī), KĀKAHĀ (Kākinī), SĀKAHĀ (Śākinī), HĀKAHĀ (Hākinī) and KUKAHĀ (Kubjikā) are accomplished in the four ages of the universe. (44-45ab) The one who reveals knowledge is referred to with the word `KAHĀ'. I have spoken the language of Kula in the form of the knowledge of (ultimate) reality. That is the group of ten of (the secret) code that, conjoined with the reality (artha) (expressed by) `KAHĀ', was told to me.38 (45cd-46) O god, that Kula has been revealed by means of this language. He who does not know this language is not fit to be a member of the tradition (anvaya). (47) KAI, KA, KHA, MĀ, Ā, GA and the six, JA, ĀDYĀ, KU, ŚA, DI and PI. This is the twelvefold code revealed by the Primordial Goddess (Ādidevī). (48) This is the transmission of the language of Yoga (yogabhānākrama) that bestows the status of a teacher (ācārya) (to one who knows it). (49ab)

sanskrit: 300 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २५९ . २५८ कैलासं कमलं बिन्दु : २५७ खमध्ये समय प्रभो ।। ४९ ।। मातङ्गं कौलमद्वैतं जगतः प्रलयोदयम् । आदिकादिशिव२६१ सिद्धं याकिनीयोनिमुद्रितम् ॥ ५० ॥ यजन१२ पादुकान्तं१३ च कुकारान्वयदर्शनम् । २६४ शवरी-अधिकारं तु दीपवर्तिश्च मालिनी ॥ ५१ ॥ २६७ ॐकारादितः६५ पीठाश्च सिद्ध योगेश्वरं पदम् । २७० इय२६८ द्वादशिका भाषानिर्णीता ९ श्रीकुलागमे ।। ५२ ।। भाषाभेदं च यो वेत्ति आचार्यः स कुलान्वये । २७२ २७१ खेखकौखशिकाश्चैव कुषा भाषाचतुष्टयम् ।। ५३ ।। गवि सग पवि त्रीणि मावि मामश्च पञ्चमम् । २७३ डाहो गमे लधू त्रीणि काहि साहा च खेचरी ॥ ५४ ॥ २७४ काकुमातरिका सप्तषट्कभेदमुदाहृतम् । २७५ ओजापूकाचतुर्भीषा ओचषमिचतुष्टयम् ।। ५५ ।। २७९ २८० अवि यवि २७७ च२७८ यो त्रीणि मवि यविस्तु पञ्चमम् .२८१ अकुसि कु¨ अकु त्रीणि कविमुषचतुष्टयम् ॥ ५६ ॥ आस्वाम? अवि आ षट्क ३ गुप्ता भाषा मयोदिता । २८४ अष्टषष्टिस्त्विमा भाषा अन्वये परिपठिताः २८६ २८५ ।। ५७ ।। एवं प्रश्नानि यो वेत्ति स भवेत् पश्चिमे गृहे । इति भाषाक्रमं ज्ञानं अतिगूढार्थविस्तरम् ॥ ५८ ॥ यो न वेत्ति महादेव स कथं देशिकोच्यते .२९० २८८ २९१ । अष्टषष्टिः २८९ प्रभेदेन भाषाश्चैव कुलान्वये ॥ ५९ ॥ गोत्रमार्गे प्रयुञ्जीत मोक्षमार्गविनिर्णये । ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 301 O Lord, (KAI is) Kailāsa. (Ka is) the Lotus. (KHA is) the Drop in the centre of the Sky (of Supreme Principle). (MĀ is) MātaSga, (Ā is) Kaula, (GA is) Nonduality. (JA is) the arising and falling away of the universe. (ĀDYĀ is) Śiva who is both the vowels (ādi) and the consonants (kādi) and, stamped with the seal of the Yākinī's Yoni, is accomplished. (KU is) the teaching (darśana) of the tradition of the (goddess) Kukārā (beginning with) the sacrifice and ending with the (teacher's) sandels. (ŚA is) Śavarī and (her) authority. (DI is) the wick of the lamp and Mālinī. (PI is) the sacred seats beginning with O¤. (By knowing this) one achieves the plane of the Lord of Yoga. (49cd-52ab) This is the twelvefold code taught in the scripture of the Śrīkula. He who knows the various codes (bhānābheda) is a (true) teacher (ācārya) in the Kula tradition. (52cd-53ab) KHEKHA, KAUKHA, ŚIKĀ and KU±Ā are the fourfold code. GAVI, SAGA and PAVI make three along with MĀVI and MĀMA as the fifth. ÕĀHO, GAME and LADHŪ make three. KĀHI, SĀHĀ, Khecari and Kākamātrkā are said to be the division of seven hexads (that is, forty-two). (53cd-55ab) O (OÆÆiyāSa), JĀ (Jālandhara), PŪ (PūrSagiri) and KĀ (Kāmarūpa) make the code of four. O (OÆÆīśanātha), CA (Caryānātha) ±A (±an˜hanātha) and MI (Mitranātha) make a group of four. AVI, YAVI and YO make three. Along with MAVI and YAVI, the fifth. AKUSI, KU and AKU make three. KA, VI, MU and ±A make a group of four, while Ā, SVĀ, MA, A, VI and Ā make the group of six.39 I have thus uttered the secret code. (55cd-57ab) These are the codes, sixty-eight (in number), that are recited in the tradition. He who knows (these) cunnundrums (praśna) in this way (truly) belongs to the Western House. This is the knowledge of the sequence of codes (bhānākrama), the meaning of which is most profound and extensive. (57cd-58) O Mahādeva, how can one who does not know this be said to be a teacher (deśika)? (These are) the sixty-eight codes in the Kula tradition that should be applied individually on the Path of the Clan (gotramārga) in order to understand the path to liberation. (59ab-60ab)

sanskrit: 302 कुमारिकाखण्ड: अथ मेलकसंयोगं यथा भवति तच्छृणु ।। ६० ॥ २९३ एकांगुलिप्रदेशिन्या”” स्वागतं मन्त्रिणां वदेत् । द्वाभ्यां सुस्वागतं चैव क्षेममंगुष्ठपीडनात् ।। ६१ ।। गगनस्था यदा”” दृष्टि: ९५ सुक्षेमगृहमागतः । एव चतुर्विधा मुद्रा गोत्रसंकेतके स्मृता ।। ६२ ॥ २९६ ऐन्द्री च चञ्चला दृष्टियम्ये दृष्टिस्तु भीषणा । सौम्ये तथास्तु विज्ञेया अन्तरीक्षे तु निश्चला ।। ६३ ।। चतुर्विधा चक्षुर्मुद्रा पीठमार्गे प्रकीर्तिता । ३०५ स्वरैः३०३ षोडशभिर्भिन्ना” ब्रह्ममात्रा तु मूर्धनि ॥ ६४ ॥ ३०७ कादितान्तं गता देव विष्णुमात्रा तथोत्तरे । थादिसान्तविभेदेन रुद्रमात्रा तु दक्षिणे ॥ ६५ ॥ तु इति पंक्तित्रयं प्रोक्तं मातृकाक्षरडम्बरम् । ३१० ।। दिव्यन्यास स्वयं देहे नाम्ना वै वर्णराशिकम् ।। ६६ ।। स्थानषट्कं प्रवक्ष्यामि २ उपदेशार्थविस्तरम् । विशुद्ध”३ षोडशैर्भिन्नं द्वादशैस्तु अनाहतम् ३१५ •३१६ ३१४ ।। ६७ ।। ३१७ दशभिश्च मणिर्भिन्नः स्वाधिष्ठानं षडात्मकम् । आधारे भेदाश्चत्वार आज्ञाभेदद्वयं विदुः ॥ ६८ ॥ •३१८ गुर्वाज्ञायाश्च दशकं सारं संसारसागरे ३१९ ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 303 The meeting of Siddhas and Yoginīs. The Language of Gestures Now listen to how the union of the meeting (melaka) (between Siddhas and Yoginīs) takes place. (60cd) (A Yoginī) who shows one finger is (in this way) saying welcome (svāgata) to (adepts) who recite mantras. With two (fingers she says that) he is very welcome (susvāgata). By pressing the thumb (with the finger she indicates) well-being (knema). If (she) gazes (up) at the sky, (she indicates that) he has come to the house of well-being. Gesture (mudrā) is in this way said to be of four kinds in the convention of the clan (gotrasaˆketaka). (61-62) The gaze directed to the east is playful (cañcalā). The gaze directed to the south is wrathful (bhīnaSā) and one should know that the one directed to the north is also such. (The gaze directed upwards) to the sky is fixed (niścalā).40a The Gesture of the Eyes (caknurmudrā) is said to be of four kinds on the path of the sacred seats. (63-64ab) The Triangle of Letters and their Projection into the Six Wheels Brahmā's measure (mātrā) consists of the sixteen vowels and is on the top (of the Triangle). Similarly, O god, VinSu's measure is associated with (the letters) from Ka to Ta and is on the left (of the Triangle). Again, Rudra's measure is on the right and is formed from the (letters) Tha to Sa.40b (64cd-65) Thus the three lines (of the Triangle) are said to (make up) the collection of the letters of the alphabet. And the aggregate of letters by itself is called the Divine Deposition within the body.41 (66) (Now) I will tell (you) the extensive sense of the teaching concerning the Six Places (sthānana˜ka). (67ab) The Pure (Wheel) (viśuddha) consists of sixteen (vowels) and the (Wheel of) Unstruck Sound (anāhata) of the twelve (consonants from Ka to µha). The (Wheel of the City of) Jewels (maSipura) consists of the ten (consonants from Õa to Pha) while the (Wheel of) the Self-supported (svādhin˜hāana) consists of the six (consonants from Ba to La). There are four divisions (Va to Sa) in the (Wheel of the) Foundation (ādhāra) and (the wise) know the two (Ha and K±a) in (the Wheel of the) Command. The group of ten associated with the teacher's Command is the (very) essence of the ocean of transmigratory existence. (67cd-69ab)

sanskrit: 304 कुमारिकाखण्ड: खेचरं वै कृतयुगे त्रेतायुगे वृद्धक्रमं मध्यमं द्वापरे ज्ञेय ३२० आत्म- ओलिस्तथैव च ।। ६९ ।। ज्येष्ठ—– ओलिक्रमागतम् । •३२२ •३२३ ३२४ कलौ बालक्रमं भवेत् ।। ७० ।। । त्रिविध २५ क्रम - ओलं –ओलं तु बालकौमारवृद्धकम् चतुर्थ व्यापकं सूक्ष्मं एकमेव क्रमं त्रिधा ।। ७१ ।। ३२९ श्लोकमेवमिदं सारं देव्याज्ञयाः प्रकाशितम् । ३३० ये बुद्ध्यन्ति नरा देव ते मुक्ता नात्र संशयः ।। ७२ ।। शुभाशुभैर्न लिप्यन्ते ब्रह्महत्यादिपातकैः । ३३१ निर्मलास्ते भविष्यन्ति श्लोकार्थस्य विदास्तु ये ।। ७३ ।। ३३४ शास्त्रार्थेन विना भ्रान्तिः कुतः शम्यति पश्चिमे । ३३६ ३४० तेन श्रीमतबोधो यः निर्मलहेमवद् यथा ।। ७४ ॥ दर्शनात् स्पर्शनाद् वाथ पशूनां पापहा भवेत् । स भवेत कुलाचार्यो वेधज्ञानविशारदः ।। ७५ ।। ३४४ आज्ञाधरोऽथ भवेत४३ उपदेशधृतव्रतः । शोभते स कुले देव श्रीमतार्थप्रबोधकः ।। ७६ ।। मतार्थे३४५ च परीक्ष्य यो यो हि मिथ्यावभाषकः । आचार्यः सह शिष्यैस्तु नरकं रौरवं व्रजेत् ।। ७७ ।। अन्यथा आगमार्थं तु बुध्यते नैव तत्त्वतः । स्वयमेवोत्पादयेदर्थं स याति नरकं ध्रुवम् ।। ७८ ।। स्वयं हती“ च पापिष्टो ४९ न स ५० वै पाशहा भवेत् । ३४८ भैरव्याधिष्ठितं ज्ञानं भैरवस्य तु लीयते ॥ ७९ ॥ भैरव्या प्राप्यते भुक्तिर्मुक्तिर्वै भैरवाद् भवेत् ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 305 The Transmissions The (Transmission taught) in the Krta Age is that of the Skyfarer and the Lineage (oli) of the Self. The Transmission of the Aged (is taught) in the Tretā Age and has come down through the transmission of the Lineage of the Eldest (Jyen˜ha Oli). One should know that the middle one (is revealed) in the Dvāpara Age while the Transmission of the Child is (revealed) in the Age of Strife. The Lineage of the Transmission (kramānvaya) is triple, namely, that of the Child, the Youth and the Aged. The fourth one (which is that of the Skyfarer) is subtle and pervasive. The one Transmission is (thus) of three kinds. (69cd-71) Thus this verse, which is the essence of the goddess's Command, has been revealed. O god, those men who understand it, are certainly liberated. They are not stained by either auspicious or inauspicious (actions), (even) by (great) sins, including brahminicide. Those who understand the meaning of the verse will be pure. (72-73) The Kulācārya Without knowing the purport of the scripture, (one is induced into) error so how can one find peace in the Western (Tradition)? Thus one who understands the Śrīmata is like pure gold. By seeing or by touching, he destroys the sins of the fettered.42 He is a Kulācārya, skilled in the knowledge of (how to) pierce (vedha) (the Wheels in the body). (74-75) He possesses the (divine) Command and is firm in (his) the vow (to observe) the teaching (of the scripture). O god, beautiful is he in the Kula who explains the meaning of the Śrīmata. (76) Having tested (a teacher) in the meaning of the doctrine (matārtha), the teacher who (is found to) speak falsely will go to hell together with (his) disciples. (77) He who explains the meaning of the scripture incorrectly (anyathā) and not according to the truth but makes up the meaning by himself, will go to a terrible hell. He, by himself, destroys (all that is beneficial) and, the greatest of sinners, he certainly does not remove the fetters (of others). (78-79ab). The knowledge of Bhairava, presided over by Bhairavī, dissolves away (the fetters of those in bondage). From Bhairavī one obtains worldly benefits (bhukti). Liberation comes from Bhairava. (79cd-80ab)

sanskrit: 306 ३५२ ३५४ कुमारिकाखण्ड: इति भैरवभाषेयं गूढार्थी विमलोत्तरा सर्वदानन्दसन्तानं भैरवात्५३ संप्रवर्तते । तच्चिदानन्दबोधेन ये विद्धाश्च महाव्रताः ३५५ ३५७ ।। ८० ।। ।। ८१ ॥ ते मुक्ता नात्र संदेहो संभवन्ति युगत्रये । ३५९ इत्याद्यावतारे५८ महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते' सृष्टिक्रमसूत्राधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ॥ ४२ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-TWO 307 This is Bhairava's language (bhānā) and its meaning is profound and extremely pure. A continuous flow (santāna) of bliss comes forth perpetually from Bhairava. Those who observe the Great Vow and have been pierced by insight into that bliss of consciousness are certainly liberated in all the three times. (80cd-82ab) This is the (forty-second) chapter called the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the Sūtra of the Sequence of Emanation. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It is on the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) and is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).
