sanskrit: त्रिचत्वारिंशानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच युगे युगे समाचारं सिद्धयोगिनिसंकुलम् । अवतारं युगावस्थं' वद मे शंकरार्चिते ॥ १ ॥ श्रीवक्रा उवाच ४ साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ आदिनाथ जगत्पते । ७ कथयामि न' संदिग्धं यत् त्वया परिपृच्छितम् ।। २ ।। चतुर्युगावतारं तु संक्षेपेण वदाम्यहम् । पारम्पर्यक्रमं देव यन्मया भाषितं पुरा ।। ३ ॥ o १३ सादाख्यो नाम सिद्धस्तु अधिकारी कृते युगे । उत्तरानन्ददेव्यायाः अव्वागृह समागतः ॥ ४ ॥ तस्य पुत्राश्च¨ संजाताश्चत्वारः” कुलनायकाः । तेषां नामानि वक्ष्यामि एकैकस्य पृथक् पृथक् ।। ५ ।। प्रथमममरो नाम अजरश्च द्वितीयकः । ॐकारश्च“ तृतीयः स्याच्चतुर्थश्चामृतोद्भवः ॥ ६ ॥ अमरीभिर्दीक्षिता” देवा: ” संख्यां शृणु उमापते । सप्तसप्ततिकोटीनि एकैकेन तु दीक्षिता: ॥ ७ ॥ खेचरत्वं गताः सर्वे मदीयाज्ञाप्रभावतः । २८ २६ २९ एव” कृतयुगे देव कथिता सिद्धसंख्या सा” ।। ८॥ ३० अतः कुदण्डमध्यस्थ अमृतोद्भवसंभवम् । दिव्यकायं महादीप्तं” देवानुग्रहकारकम् ।। ९ ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-THREE The Sūtra of the Descent (of the Teachers) in the Four Ages Śrīnātha said: (O goddess) worshipped by Śa‰kara! There is a (teaching concerning the practice of) right (Kaula) conduct for Siddhas and Yoginīs in every Age. Tell me of (its) descent (into the world) in relation to each Age.1 (1) The venerable (goddess) said: Well done, O greatly wise one! Ādinātha! Lord of the Universe! I will tell (you) what you have asked (me about) that is free of doubt. O god, I will tell (you) in brief about the descent (of the teaching) in the four Ages, namely, the transmission of the line (of teachers and disciples), as I have declared it in the past. (2-3) The Descent of the Teacher in the First Age The Siddha called Sādākhya has authority in the Krta Age. He came to the Mother's House (avvāgrha) of the goddess of the bliss of the northern (seat) (uttarānandadevī). He had four (spiritual) sons who were leaders of the Kula. I will tell (you) the names of each one of them individually.2 The first is Amara, the second, Ajara, Oˆkāra is the third and the fourth is Amrtodbhava.3 (4-6) O Umāpati, listen (now) to the number of gods initiated by the immortal (Siddhas). Seven times seven hundred million gods were initiated one by one. They all attained (the liberation of mystical) flight (khecaratva) by the power of my Command. Thus, O god, (I have) told (you) the number of Siddhas in the Krta Age.4 (7-8) Thus the Divine Body (divyakāya), born from (the bliss) generated from the Nectar (of consciousness) (amrtodbhava), is situated in the middle of the spinal cord (kudaSÆa). Burning very brilliantly (mahādīpta), it bestows God's grace (devānugrahakāraka).5 (9)

sanskrit: 310 कुमारिकाखण्ड: द्वितीययुगसद्भाव ं कथयामि सुरार्चित । ३६ पारम्पर्यक्रमादेव यन्मया भाषितं पुरा ।। १० । ३७ यस्यैव शंकरो नाम सिद्धस्य वरदस्य च । व्रजेत् स” दक्षिणे मार्गे मङ्गलार्थे गृहाश्रमम् ॥ ११ ॥ ४७ ४१ ४४ तस्यैव पुत्राः” संजाताः चत्वारः कुलदीपकाः अनुष्ठानरता देव मन्त्रयोगसमाधिना ।। १२ ॥ तेषां नामानि वक्ष्यामि पृथक् न्यायेन सुन्दर । अरुणो वरुणश्चैव वरदश्च तृतीयकः ।। १३ ॥ चतुर्थः संचरो” नाम कथितस्तव सुव्रत । ५३ ५० । पुत्रसुदीक्षिताः” सिद्धाः” संख्या शृणु महेश्वर ॥ १४ ॥ नवनवतिकोटीनि एकैकेन तु दीक्षिता: । बालार्कोदितवद्रूपं सुतप्तकनकप्रभम् ।। १५ ।। गुहामध्यगतं पीठं शूलिना चोत्तरे स्थितम् । द्वितीये च युगे प्राप्ते सिद्धानुग्रहकारकम् ।। १६ ॥ द्वापरे च युगे देव अधिकारक्रमं यथा । ६३ ६४ तव स्नेहेन वक्ष्यामि एकचित्तः शृणु प्रिय ं ॥ १७ ॥ ६७ पश्चिमाम्नायिकादेव्याः“पिङ्गलो गृहमागतः । तस्य पुत्राश्च संजाताः” एकैकवरदायकाः ॥ १८ ॥ विजय” विन्ध्यनाथ च मार्तण्डो मेषमेव च । एभिस्तु दीक्षिताश्चान्ये वक्ष्यामि तव सुन्दर ।। १९ ॥ लोकपालाश्च नक्षत्रा” ध्रुवं नक्षत्रमण्डलम् । ७४ कोटिद्वादशसंख्या च दीक्षितान्येकमेकतः ।। २० ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-THREE 311 The Descent of the Teacher in the Second Age O (Lord) worshipped by the gods, (now) I will tell (you about) the essence of the second Age as (I have) told (you about it) in the past in accord with the transmission of the sequence of (teachers).6 (10) The name of the Siddha who bestows boons (in the second Age) is Śa‰kara. He travelled on the southern path to the Hermitage of the House (of the goddess) (grhāśrama) to meet (the goddess) Ma‰galā. (11) He had four (spiritual) sons who were luminaries of the Kula. O god, they (were) devoted to the practice of religion by means of mantra, Yoga and concentration. O handsome one, I will tell (you) their names, individually and correctly. (They are) AruSa, VaruSa and Varada, who is the third. O observer of good vows, the fourth (is) called Saˆcara; (so) you have been told about (him also).7 (12-14ab) O Great Lord, listen to the number of the Siddhas well initiated by (these spiritual) sons. Nine time nine hundered million were initiated, one by one. (14cd-15ab) The sacred seat is in the north in the centre of the Cave, along with Śiva (Śūlin). Its light is (like) that of heated gold and (its) form like the young risen sun. It graces the Siddhas when the second Age comes. (15cd-16) The Descent of the Teacher in the Third Age O god, out of affection for you, I will tell (you) the transmission of authority (adhikārakrama) in the Dvāpara Age. O beloved, listen attentively. (17) Pi‰gala came to the House of the goddess of the Western Tradition.8 He had (spiritual) sons who all bestowed boons (on others). (They were) Vijaya, Vindhyanātha, MārtaSÆa and Mena. O handsome one, I will tell (you the names of) the others they initiated. (18-19) The guardians of the quarters, the constellations (naknatra), the fixed (dhruva) circle of the constellations and others, one hundred and twenty million in number, (all) were initiated one by one.9 (20)

sanskrit: 312 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तृतीय सूचितं दिव्य ं पीतवर्णं समुज्ज्वलम् । नक्षत्रा लोकपालाश्च अनुग्रहात् परमेश्वर ।। २१ ।। चतुर्थे च युगे देव अधिकारक्रमं शृणु । अवतार” कृतं येन वक्ष्यामि तव शंकर ।। २२ ।। पूर्वाम्नायस्थिता देवी अव्वा” भैरवरूपिणी । श्रीकण्ठो नाम सिद्धश्च तस्यास्तद्गृहमागतः ।। २३ ।। ८७ तेनापि यत् कृतं चान्य ं शृणु तत्त्वेन सुन्दर । वेदसिद्धान्ततत्त्वज्ञा“ दीक्षिताश्च बलोत्कटाः ।। २४ ।। चतुर्युगे तु सिद्धा ये पूर्वाम्नायेऽधिकारिण: । ते सिद्धा दीक्षिता:” सर्वे श्रीकण्ठपश्चिमान्वये ।। २५ ।। ९१ खगेन्द्रः कूर्ममीनाख्यौ मच्छेन्द्रश्च चतुर्थकः । ९७ एभिस्तु¨ दीक्षिता: सिद्धा: काद्यः षोडश षोडश ।। २६ ।। एवं ते कथितं सर्वं युगानुयुगरूपकम् । कृद्युगे दीक्षिता देवा:`` त्रेते ” सिद्धास्तथा” यथा ।। २७ ।। ०६ १०७ १०८ द्वापरे गणगन्धर्वाः कलौ चैव तु मानवा: १०९ असंख्या दीक्षिता देव चतुर्थे तु महायुगे ।। २८ ।। ११२ अन्तिमे च युगे प्राप्ते भ्रमराञ्जनसमप्रभे३ । कलौ युगे महाघोरे किल्विषेन परिप्लुते ।। २९ ।। सिद्धावतारमर्थे तु भेदे भेदेऽवतारितम् । । १११ ओड्डीश तूष्णिचिञ्चीश स्थानुसंज्ञ चतुर्थकम् ॥ ३० ॥ पदे पदे च विख्यातं युगानुयुगरूपकम् । रहस्यं परमं शंभो तीव्राज्ञाद्योतित महत् ।। ३१ ।। चतुर्युगावतारं तु दिव्यौघ गुरुमण्डलम् । यो न विन्दति तत्त्वेन” स कथं चान्वयी भवेत् ॥ ३२ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-THREE 313 (Thus the transmission of) the third (Age), which is divine and burns with (a brilliant) yellow colour,10 has been described. O Supreme Lord, (this includes, by my) grace, the constellations and the guardians of the quarters. (21) The Descent of the Teacher in the Fourth Age O god, listen to the transmission of authority (adhikārakrama) in the fourth Age. O Śa‰kara, I will tell you who descended (into the world). The goddess who belongs to the previous tradition (pūrvāmnāya) is Avvā (the Mother), who is (one with) Bhairava (bhairavarūpiSī). The Siddha called ŚrīkaS˜ha11 came to her House. (22-23) O handsome one, listen to what else he really (tattvena) did. The Siddhas of the fourth Age, who were office bearers in the previous tradition (pūrvāmnāya) and were initiates who, proud of their might, knew the truth of the teaching (siddhānta) of the Veda were all initiated in the Western Tradition of ŚrīkaS˜ha. (24-25) (These were) Khagendra, Kūrma, Mīna and Macchendra, the fourth.12 They each initiated sixteen Siddhas belonging to Western Tradition (kādi).13 (26) Thus I have told you everything as it is, Age by Age. Gods are initiated in the Krta Age, Siddhas in the same way in the Tretā Age, celestial musicians and the host in the Dvāpara Age and men in the Age of Strife. O god, countless numbers are initiated in the fourth great Age. (27-28) The descent of Siddhas into the tradition (artha), each descending into a particular division, takes place when the last Age comes which, (black) in colour like a bumble bee, is the Age of Strife, very terrible and full of impurity. (They are): OÆÆīśa, TūnSīśa, Ciñcīśa and the fourth, called Sthānu.14 (29-30) (Thus everything) has been explained with regards to each position (of authority) in accord with each of the Ages. O Śambhu, (this is) the great and supreme secret that has been illumined by an intense Command. (31) (This is) the descent (of the Siddhas in) the four Ages, the Divine Current (divyaugha) and the Circle of the Teachers (gurumaSÆala). How can one who has not acquired it as it truly is be a member of the tradition? (32)

sanskrit: 314 कुमारिकाखण्ड: इत्याद्यावतारे’२३ महान्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरस्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशतिसहस्रे चतुर्युगावतारसूत्रवर्णनो१५ नामानन्दः६ ।। ४३ ।। १२४
english: CHAPTER FORTY-THREE 315 This is the (forty-third) chapter called the Description of the Sūtra of the Descent (of the Teachers) in the Four Ages. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: चतुश्चत्वारिंशानन्दः श्रीवक्रा उवाच अथान्यं विमलं वक्ष्ये क्रमोदयं तु दुर्लभम् । योऽसौ सर्वगतो देव बिन्दुः कारणमव्ययम् ॥ १ ॥ तस्येच्छा' निर्गता शक्तिश्चिद्रूपा ं तु कुलालया । तद्धर्मधर्मिणी' सा तु अग्राह्या गुणचित्परा' ।। २ ॥ तत्त्वभासा ँ स्फुरन्ती च ऋजुरेखैव' कुण्डली । सा च वामा समाख्याता ज्येष्ठा रौद्री षडात्मिका ॥ ३ ॥ अधो नादनिरोधाच्च शान्त्याख्या उन्मनाव्यया । महापीठस्थिता तत्र कुलकौलावतारिका ं ।। ४ ।। रूपातीतं तथा रूपं पदं पिण्डमनुक्रमात् । पिण्ड” कुण्डलिनी शक्ति : पदं हंसः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ ५ ॥ रूपं बिन्दुमयं प्रोक्त रूपातीतमनामयम् । तत्र पीठचतुष्कं तु संजातं तु कुलेच्छया ।। ६ । रूपातीतं तु कामाख्यं रूपं पूर्णगिरिर्महान् । पदं जालन्धराख्यं तु पिण्डमोडुं प्रकीर्तितम्।। ७ । का - पू- जा - ओचतुष्क तु मूलकौलक्रमागतम् ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FOUR The Emanation of the Śrīkrama The Arising of the Transmission (kramodaya) in Twenty-eight Parts The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Now I will talk about another (manner in which) the Krama arises (kramodaya) that is pure and hard to acquire. (1ab) O god, the omnipresent Drop (of Śiva's consciousness) is the imperishable cause (of all things). His will is the energy that emerges from it. (This energy is the goddess who is) consciousness and the repository of Kula. Endowed with the attributes of that (Drop), she cannot be grasped. She is the (goddess) Parā whose (fundamental) quality is consciousness. (1cd-2) She is KuSÆalī, the light of the (Supreme) Principle who manifests in the form of a straight line. Sixfold, she is (also) said to be Vāmā, Jyen˜hā and Raudrī. (3) (This) imperishable Transmental (energy) called Peace (śāntyākhyā), (emerges) below by the constraint of Sound (nādanirodha) and, residing in the great sacred seat, brings Kula and Kaula down there (into the world).1 (4) The Four Sacred Seats (This descent takes place in the following stages): Beyond Form (Rūpātīta), Form (Rūpa), Word (Pada) and Body (PiSÆa), in due order. The Body is the energy KuSÆalinī. Word (pada) is said to be the Gander. Form is said to be the Drop and Beyond Form is the reality free of all defects (anāmaya). (5-6ab) The four sacred seats have arisen there by the will of Kula. Beyond Form is Kāmākhya. Form is the great PūrSagiri. Word is said to be Jālandhara, while the Body is said to be OÆÆa. The group of four, KĀ, PŪ, JĀ and O has come (into the world) through the root Kaula transmission.2 (6cd-8ab)

sanskrit: 318 कुमारिकाखण्ड: सादाख्यं तु महासिद्धं सदाशिवपदे स्थितम् ॥ ८ ॥ विभज्यते स चात्मान” पुनरेव त्रिधाकृतम् । २० २१ .२२ शिवः शक्तिस्तथात्मा स एक एव त्रिधा स्थितः ।। ९ ।। अघोरः परमो नाथ घोराख्या शक्तिरुच्यते । २४ श्रीकण्ठश्च तथात्मानं स च एव चतुर्विधः ॥ १० ॥ योऽसौ मित्राभिधानो वै स च देवो उमापतिः २७ २६ । एषा व्याप्तिः समाख्याता ओड्डीशो गोलकं भवेत् ॥ ११ ॥ षष्ठो“ नादः” समाख्यातः चर्य आनन्दमुच्यते । पिण्डं चैव पदं रूपं रूपातीतं चतुर्थकम् ॥ १२ ॥ दिव्यक्रमात्” क्रम” जातं सृष्टि - ओघेन कौलिकम् । या सा शक्तिः परानन्दा सृष्टिरूपा व्यवस्थिता ।। १३ ।। श्वेता पीता तथा रक्ता श्यामा देवी कुलात्मिका । एवंवणी” समुत्पन्ना स्वररूपेण पीठका ॥ १४ ॥ ३४ अकारश्च इकारश्च ओकारैकारमेव च । ॐकार” यत् समाख्यातं तस्याः” सृष्टिर्विनिर्गता ॥ १५ ॥ पृथिव्यादिक्रमेणैव ओजापूकाचतुष्टयम् । पञ्चमं यत्” समाख्यातं पीठं मातङ्गसंज्ञया ॥ १६ ॥ व्यापकं परमं सूक्ष्ममगम्यं गुरुवर्जितैः । । ऋग्वेदश्च यजुर्वेदः सामवेदो ह्यथर्वणः ।। १७ ॥ ओमिति सदाशिवं प्रोक्तं एकारो मित्रसंज्ञकः । ४६ ओकारमोड्डीशो नाम इकारः षष्ठ उच्यते ॥ १८ ॥ ४७ अकारेण तु चर्याख्यः सिद्धाम्नायावतारका: । ऋग्वेदी” भवते मित्रो” यजुर्वेदी उड्डमेव च ॥ १९ ॥ सामवेदी” भवेत्” षष्ठश्चर्यानाथो ह्यर्थर्वणः” । ५५ तथा पीठानि चत्वारः संजातानि वरानन ।। २० ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FOUR 319 Sādākhya is the great Siddha who resides on Sadāśiva's plane. He divides himself up into three parts. He is one alone, abiding threefold as Śiva, Śakti and the Self. O Lord, Aghora is supreme and (his) energy is called Ghorā, while ŚrīkaS˜ha is the Self,3 which is fourfold.4 (8cd-10) The (Siddha) called Mitra is the god who is Umā's husband. This is called pervasion. OÆÆīśa is the Ball (golaka) (of the Drop). ±an˜ha(nātha) is said to be Sound and Carya(nātha) is said to be bliss. (11-12ab) The Body, Word, Form and Beyond Form as the fourth — (this) Kaula sequence has arisen from the divine transmission (divyakrama) as the current of emanation. (12cd-13ab) That Energy who is supreme bliss abides in the form is emanation. She is the goddess who is Kula and is white, yellow, red and black. Coloured thus, She is the energy of the sacred seats (pī˜hakā) who arises in the form of the vowels (svara).5 (13cd-14) The letters A, I, O and E and the one called the syllable O¤ are her emanation. (They correspond), in due order, to the (gross elements of) Earth onwards as the four (sacred seats) O (OÆÆiyāSa), JĀ (Jālandhara), PŪ (PūrSagiri) and KĀ (Kāmarūpa). The fifth sacred seat, which is called Māta‰ga, is pervasive, supreme, subtle and unapproachable for those who have no teacher. (15-17ab) (The four correspond to) the ¬gveda, Yajurveda, Sāmaveda and AtharvaSa. O¤ is said to be Sadāśiva and the letter E is called Mitra(nātha). The letter O is called OÆÆīśa, while the letter I is said to be ±an˜ha(nātha). Caryā(nātha) is called the letter A. (These are the teachers) who brought the Tradition of the Siddhas (siddhāmnāya) down (to earth).6 (17cd-19ab) Mitra is a ¬gvedin, UÆÆa is a Yajurvedin, ±an˜ha(nātha) is a Sāmavedin, while Caryānātha is an Atharvan. O handsome one, the four sacred seats have arisen in a similar way. (19cd-20)

sanskrit: 320 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ऋकार चैव ऋकारं ऌ ॡकारं तथैव च । ऋकारे कामरूपं तु ऋकारे पूर्णपीठकम् ।। २१ ।। ऌकारे जालसंज्ञं तु लूकारे चोड्डियाणकम् । ६२ ऋकारे तु ऋकारे तु ऌ ॡ चैव तु संभवाः ।। २२ ।। ओलिश्चैव समाख्याता ए और आत्मानमेव च । ॐ मषं यामलं विद्या कुब्जा इत्यष्टशांभवम् ६७६८ सादाख्यं तु विसर्गाख्यं एवं सृष्टिक्रमं स्मृतम् । पीठाद्यां योगिनीम् आहुर्नपुंसकचतुष्टयम् ।। २४ ।। ७० विमलादिविभेदेन श्रीमतं कथयाम्यहम् । ।। २३ ।। एकारे विमला प्रोक्ता ओकार तु पुलिन्दिका ।। २५ ।। इकारे योगिविमला” अकारेण तु चम्पका । ॐ कारे समया प्रोक्ता यस्मात् सृष्टिः प्रवर्तते ।। २६ ।। ७६७५ख आधारभेद एकारं स्वाधिष्ठान ओकारकम् । इकार” ँ मणिमित्युक्त“ अकारे हृद्यनाहतम् ।। २७ ।। उकारेण विशुद्धं स्याद् विसगीज्ञा” प्रकीर्तिता ं । षट्प्रकारामिमां सृष्टि षट्चक्रेषु कुक्रमे ॥ २८ ॥ तव वै कौलिनी ह्येका सृष्टिरूपा व्यवस्थिता । वकारे तु डकाराख्या शकारे राकिसंज्ञया ।। २९ ।। ८४ षकारे लाकिनी ज्ञेया सकारे काकिनीं विदुः । क्षकारे साकिनी प्रोक्ता हकारे हाकिनी मता ।। ३० ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FOUR 321 The letters are ¬, ­, ŀ and Ŀ. Kāmarūpa is in the letter ¬. PūrSapī˜ha is in the letter ­. (The sacred seat) called Jāla is in the letter ŀ, while UÆÆiyāSa is in the letter Ŀ. (21-22ab) The letters Ŀ and ŀ are generated in the letters ¬ and ­. The Lineage (oli) is said to be E and AU and is the Self. O¤ and the couple, Ma and ±a constitute (with the other letters) the Vidyā of Kubjikā. These are the eight Śāmbhava (letters). (22cd-23) Sādākhya is called emission (visarga). Such is said to be the sequence of emanation (srn˜ikrama). They say that the four neuter (letters) are the first (ādyā) Yoginī of the sacred seats. (24) The Five Goddesses7 (Now) I will tell (you about) the Śrīmata according to (its) division into (the goddesses) Vimalā and the others. 1) Vimalā is said (to reside) in the letter E and 2) Pulindikā in the letter O. (25) 3) Yogavimalā is in the letter I, while 4) Campakā is (associated) with the letter A. 5) Samayā, from which creation proceeds, is said to be in the letter O¤. (26) The Six Wheels and the Six Yoginīs The letter E corresponds to the (centre of the) Foundation (ādhāra), while the letter O is in the Self-supported (svādhin˜hāna). The letter I is said to be the Jewel (i.e. maSipura), while the Unstruck Sound (anāhata) in the Heart is in the letter A. (27) The Perfectly Pure (viśuddha) is (associated) with the letter O¤, while the Command (ājñā) is said to be Emission (visarga). This emanation is of six kinds and it takes place within the six (cakras) in the Sequence of Kula (kulakrama).8 (28) Kaulinī is actually one and (O, god) she is your emanation. She who is designated by the letter Õā (i.e. Õākinī) is located in the letter Va9 along with the one called Rāki (i.e. Rākinī) who is in the letter Śa. (29) One should know that Lākinī is in the letter ±a, while (the wise) know that Kākinī is in the letter Sa. Sākinī is said to be in the letter K±a, while Hākinī is considered to be in the letter Ha. (30)

sanskrit: 322 कुमारिकाखण्डः •८६ ७ एव ं डादिमहावृन्दे ँ विसर्गे” याकिसंभवः । योगिनीषट्कमाख्यात” दिव्यं ज्ञानप्रदायकम् ।। ३१ ।। पकारे गगनाख्या तु फकारे स्वर्गसंभवा । बकारे” पवनाख्या च भकारे मत्यसंभवा ॥ ३२ ॥ मकारे नागलोके हि” पञ्चरत्नमुदाहृतम् । ९४ शिला शेखरसंज्ञा तु मकारे संव्यवस्थिता ।। ३३ ।। नकारे संघसंज्ञा च ककारे तु कुमारकम् । श्रीमते तत् समाख्यातं वर्णभेदक्रमेण तु ॥ ३४ ॥ अष्टाविंशतिभेदानि यो विन्दति स सिद्ध्यति । अवर्गे तु भवेद् ब्राह्मी कवर्गे तु महेश्वरी ।। ३५ ।। कौमारी च चवर्गस्था टवर्गे वैष्णवी स्मृता । वाराही च तवर्गस्था ऐन्द्राणी च पवर्गगा ।। ३६ ।। ९८ यवर्गे च भवेत् शुष्का महारावा प्रकीर्तिता । शवर्गस्था महालक्ष्मी अष्टावेताश्च मातरः ।। ३७ ।। १०० श्रीकुजा चाष्टधा ह्येका विख्याता पीठदेवता । एवं पश्चिमतः” सृष्टिः संवती मालिनी स्वयम् ।। ३८ ।। जगद्योनिर्भवेदेका' ं' तस्मात् सृष्टिरनेकधा । ये मन्त्रा देवताः सर्वे मुद्रा विद्या ह्यसंख्यया ॥ ३९ ॥ १०६ भवयोनिः पराख्याता सृष्टिरूपा चिदात्मिका' । कुब्जीश कुब्जिनी माता तनुबद्धा तु मालिनी ॥। ४० ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FOUR 323 In the same way, Yāki (i.e. Yākinī) is born within emission (visarga) in the midst of the great troupe of (energies) commencing with Õā (i.e. Õākinī). (This) is said to be the group of Six Yoginīs (yoginīna˜ka). It is divine and grants knowledge. (31) The Five Jewels The (Yoginī of this Jewel) is called Gaganā (Sky), (she) is in the letter Pa, while Svargasaˆbhavā (Born in Heaven) is in the letter Pha. The one called Pavanā (Pure) is in the letter Ba, while Martyasaˆbhavā (Born in (the world of) Mortals) is in the letter Bha. 10Nāgaloka (the World of Serpents) is in the letter Ma. These are said to be the Five Jewels.11 Śilā (the Stone), which is called the Peak (śekhara), is (likewise) established in the letter Ma. (32-33) The one called Saˆgha is in the letter Na, while Kumāraka is in the letter Ka.12 That is explained in the Śrīmata according to the sequence of the various letters (varSabhedakrama). He who obtains the twenty-eight divisions is successful. (34-35ab) The Eight Mothers and the Eightfold Goddess Brāhmī is in the vowels, while Maheśvarī is in the gutturals. Kaumarī is located in the palatals and VainSavī is said to reside in the cerebrals. Vārāhī is located in the dentals and AindrāSī is in the labials. Śunkā, who is said to be Mahārāvā (The Great Sound),13 is in the semi-vowels and Mahālaknmī resides in the sibilants. These are the eight Mothers. (35cd-37) The venerable (goddess) Kujā is (thus) both one and eightfold. She is said to be the deity of the sacred seats. Emanation takes place in this way14 from the Western (Tradition) (paścimataƒ) and is itself (the goddess) Saˆvartā who is Mālinī. (38) She is the one womb (yoni) of the universe and from that proceeds creation which is of many kinds, including the mantras, all the deities and the innumerable Gestures and Vidyās. (39) She is the womb of phenomenal existence and, called Parā (the Supreme), she is (herself) emanation and her nature is consciousness. O Kubjīśa, she is Kubjinī, the Mother, Mālinī in embodied form. (40)

sanskrit: 324 कुमारिकाखण्ड: अवर्गेण शिरो देव कवर्गं बाहुदक्षिणम् । चवर्ग वामबाहुश्च दक्षजङ्घा टवर्गजा ।। ४१ । तवर्गे वामजङ्घा च पवर्गे कुक्षिद्वयं स्मृतम् । पृष्ठं च हृदयं नाभि ऊरु: १२ चैव नितम्बकम् ।। ४२ ।। शवर्गेण”४ भवेत् देव देहं देवस्य १५ राजते । ११७ त्वच रक्तस्तथा मांसं स्नायुरस्थिसमंकलम् ॥ ४३ ॥ प्राण शुक्र तथा क्रोध क्षयमध्ये व्यवस्थिताः । -११९ १२० १२१ कुजीशस्य तनुश्चैव २२ पराशान्ताद् विनिर्गतः १२३ ।। ४४ ॥ १२५ जगद्योनीति'' विख्याता सृष्टिरूपा महाम्बिका' । सा योनि:१६ सर्वभूताना २७ वर्णरूपा व्यवस्थिता ।। ४५ ।। ये१२९ वर्णदेवताः सर्वे वीराश्च भैरवास्तथा । १३० रुद्रा: सिद्धाश्च तेऽप्येवं वर्णरूपा विनिर्गता:१३१ ।। ४६ ।। कालाग्न्यादिशिवान्ते च २ सा योनिः संव्यवस्थिता । एवं दिव्यं महादिव्यं दिव्यादिव्यैर्न ३ गोचरम् ।। ४७ ।। १३६ तदेवमन्वय१३४ तत्त्व ३५ गोचराचारमेलकम् । कथितं ते महाशंभो रहस्यमतिदुर्लभम् ।। ४८ । १३८ दिव्येदं विमलं ज्ञान उद्धृतं सप्तकोटितः । ये विन्दन्ति” नरा देव ते मुक्ता नात्र संशयः ॥ ४९ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FOUR 325 The Sonic Body of the God15 O god, (his) head (is fashioned from) the vowels. (His) right arm is the gutturals. The palatals are the left arm, while the right shank (ja‰gha)16 is born from the cerebrals. (41) The left shank17 is in the dentals, while the two (parts of) the diaphragm are said to be in the labials. O god, the back, heart, navel, thigh and hip are part of the labials.18 (In this way) the body of the god shines with glory (rājate). (42-43ab) Skin (Ya), blood (Ra), flesh (La), sinew (Va), the bones (Śa), marrow (±a), semen (Sa), the vital breath (Ha) and anger (K±a) are located between Ya and K±a. In this way, Kujīśa's body has emerged from the tranquillity of (the goddess) Parā.19 (43cd-44) The Goddess — Womb of the Universe and the Letters She is called the womb of the universe (jagadyoni). She is the Great Mother (mahāmbikā) and her form is emanation. She is the womb of all existing things and her nature is (every) letter (varSarūpā). (45) All the deities of the letters, the Heroes, Bhairavas, Rudras and Siddhas — these too have emerged in the form of letters.20 (46) She is the womb of (all the worlds) established (in all of them) from Kālāgni (the Fire of Time) to Śiva. Such is the sacred (divya) (reality), the greatly sacred (reality), beyond the sacred and profane.21 (47) Admonitions to Secrecy and to the Practice of Moral Discipline In this way, it is the Tradition (anvaya), the reality (tattva) that unites (right) conduct (ācāra) with the field (of its application) (gocara). O Great Śambhu, I have told you a secret that is extremely hard to acquire. (48) This divine and pure knowledge has been culled from (the scripture of) seventy million verses. O god, (all) those men who obtain it are certainly liberated. (49)

sanskrit: 326 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४० विना विमलभेदेन दीक्षां शिक्षा च यो ददेत् । न दीक्षा नैव शिक्षा च अहुतीना निरर्थका ।। ५० ।। मातृका विदिता ह्येषा सिद्धज्ञानेन संयुता । न देया कस्यचिद् देव विशेषाद् भक्तिवर्जिते ।। ५१ ॥ क्रमपूजारते शान्ते रागद्वेषविवर्जिते । १४७ तेषा४६ देयमिदं देव नान्येषां तु कदाचन ।। ५२ ।। १५० पापिष्ठा निन्दका ४९ क्रूरा रागद्वेषसमन्विताः न ते ५२ योग्याः कुले १५४ १५१ । कौले विचरन्ति नराधमाः न ते यान्ति परं स्थानं निषिद्धास्ते मया पुरा । १५९ १५५ ॥ ५३ ॥ श्वानेन तु यथा श्वानो दृष्टो ८ बुद्ध : प्रवर्तते ॥ ५४ ॥ तथा च निष्फला चेष्टा अज्ञानतमसावृता । संसारार्णवगम्भीरे? ये मग्ना भुवि मानवाः ।। ५५ ।। दीक्षितापि न मुच्यन्ति क्रोधलोभपरायणाः । विष्ठामध्ये कृमिर्यद्वदमेध्यमुपजीवति ।। ५६ ।। एवं ते कुलविभ्रष्टाः पतन्ति नरकार्णवे । १६७ भजन्ते १८ मेऽप्रतिष्ठा ये अहंकारवशानुगाः ।। ५७ ।। न तेषामैहिका सिद्धिः परत्र च न विद्यते । पारम्पर्यक्रमारूढा दीक्षिता: सिद्धशासने ।। ५८ ।। अभिषिक्तास्तथा’७२ शंभो विनयेन विवर्जिताः । नयहीना न सिद्ध्यन्ति इहलोके परत्र च ॥ ५९ ॥ १७३ विनयात् प्राप्यते सर्वं तस्माद् विनयमाचरेत् । एवं विनयहीना ये पापिष्ठा भुवि गर्विताः ॥ ६० ॥ न ते योग्याः कुले कौले भवन्ति ज्ञानवर्जिता: । १७५ ।। १७७
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FOUR 327 The initiation and teaching imparted without the Pure Division (vimalabheda) (of the Manthānabhairavatantra)22 is not (a true) initiation or (a true) teaching. (That initition consists of just) fruitless offerings to the fire. (50) She is known as Mātrkā and is endowed with accomplished knowledge. O god, it should not be given to (just) anybody, especially to one devoid of devotion. (51) It should be given to one who is devoted to the worship of the transmission (kramapūjā), tranquil and devoid of attachment and aversion. This should be given to those (who are like that). O god, it should never be given to others (who are not). (52) The sinful, those who censor others, those who are cruel and those (full of) attachment and aversion are not fit (to be members) of the Kula and Kaula. These inferior men wander about (in the world frustrated). They do not reach the Supreme Place (sthāna). I have previously prohibited them (from achieving success). (53-54ab) Just as a dog seen by (another) dog wakes up, such is fruitless action enveloped in the darkness of ignorance. Those people who are immersed in the world, the deep ocean of transmigratory existence, given to anger and greed are not freed, even though they have been initiated. (54cd-56ab) Like a worm (who lives) in dung feeds on impure filth, similarly those who have fallen from (the teachings of the) Kula fall into the ocean of hell. (56cd-57ab) Those who worship me (but) are fickle and are in the grips of the ego do not achieve success either here or in the next world. Those who belong to a lineage (pāramparyakrama) and are initiated into the teachings of the Siddhas and those, O Śambhu, who have been consecrated (as teachers), (but) have no moral discipline (vinaya) and are devoid of the teaching (naya) do not achieve success either in this world or the next. (57cd-59) Everything is attained by moral discipline (vinaya) and so one must practice it. Those who are devoid of moral discipline, most sinful and proud in (this) world, have no knowledge and are not fit (to be members of) the Kula and Kaula. (60-61ab)

sanskrit: 328 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १७९ विनयामृततृप्तानां शान्ताचारपरायणाम् ।। ६१ ॥ मुखनामपि' या सिद्धिर्न साहंकृतपण्डिताम्' इदं ज्ञानोदयं नाम शैवसार तु कौलिकम् । कथितं देवदेवेश सत्येन तु मया तव ।। ६२ ॥ •९८३ १८७ । १८४ १८५ तत् ख्यात? ज्ञानखण्ड निहतकलिरिपुध्वंसित: ४ पापराशि: योनौ संगृह्य वेगात् क्रमति अहनिश तत्त्व सन्ध्याक्षरेण । तं नाद” चित्स्वरूपं प्रणमत सततं वन्दनीय सुराणां •१९०. दातार भुक्तिमुक्ति” नमत गुरुवरं श्रीमहानादिनाथम् ।। ६३ ।। १९६ मोक्षार्थ ज्ञानहेतोः प्रकटितनिलये सिद्धशब्दं अमोघं विघ्नव्याघातदक्ष स्थितममलमजं मङ्गलानां निधानम् । ज्ञानभावैः प्रपन्नं बहुविविधफलं दिव्यमानन्दभूतं श्रीमदोडीशनाथं व्यपगतकलुषं पादपद्मं नमामि¨ ।। ६४ ।। २०० यस्यानन्त” न दूरं न च दिवसनिशा कालवेला न चैव २०२ २०३ .२०५ जाग्रत्सुप्ते सुषुप्ते गगनमतिरतं मोक्षकामानुरक्तम् । मत्यानां २०६ तारणार्थं भवभयहरणं तीव्रमाज्ञाधरं च ०७ २०८ २१० लीलाभावैः” प्रपन्नं नमत गुरुवरं श्रीमहातूष्णिनाथम् ।। ६५ ।। २१४ २१६ आज्ञासिद्धैरमाद्यैः११ कलिकलुषहरै: १२ तर्पते ३ दिव्यपानैः दृष्टं चादृष्टरूपं१५ पतति शुद्धकायो भवेत् सः पश्चात् क्रीडास्वरूपः सुसमविधिपरो जायते दिव्ययोगी सर्वेषां वन्दनीयो जयति स भगवान् पातु मां चर्यनाथ: २१८ २१९ । ।। ६६ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FOUR 329 The success (siddhi) those who are satisfied with the nectar of moral discipline and are intent on tranquil practice (achieve), even though they may be illiterate, proud scholars do not have. O Lord God of the gods, I have told you this as it really is, namely, the dawn of knowledge and the Kaula essence of the Śaiva (teachings). (61cd-62) Obeiscence to the First Lord — Ādinātha23 The part (of the teaching concerned with) direct insight (jñānakhaSÆa) has been imparted. The enemy, which is the Age of Strife, has been killed and the heap of sins has been destroyed. Having laid hold of the (Supreme) Principle within the Yoni, (the yogi) traverses (the spheres of existence) night and day with great force (vega) by means of the syllable which is the conjunction (sandhyā) (between them).24 That Sound is the consciousness (citsvarūpa) of the gods; worthy of praise, (all) constantly bow before it. (All) bow before the venerable and great Ādinātha (the First Teacher), who bestows both liberation and worldly enjoyment. (63) In order to (gain) knowledge and achieve liberation, I salute the venerable OÆīśanātha, the lotus made of the parts (pāda) (of mantras), free of impurity, the infallible and accomplished Word within the abode (of mantras) made manifest (in the world). Skilled at removing obstacles, he abides pure and uncreated, the treasure of (all) auspicious things. Divine and bliss (itself) attained by states of insight (jñānabhāva), he is (the source of) many and various fruits. (64) (We) salute the great and venerable TūnSinātha, the best of teachers, attained by playful states (of elevated consciousness) (līlābhāva). He who possesses the (one) endless (reality) and is neither far (because he is everywhere) nor (is there in him) time and moment, night or day. In waking, dreaming and deep sleep, he is intent on the mind of emptiness (gaganamati) and is devoted to the passion (kāma) of liberation. and the removal of the fear of phenomenal existence. The foundation of (the most) intense (power of the goddess's) Command that removes of the fear of phenomenal existence, his goal is the salvation of (all) living beings. (65) May the Lord Caryānātha protect me. Deserving all peoples' praise, he is victorious. Both seen and unseen, * * * * (his) body is pure. He is lustrated with divine drinks (divyapāna)25 of (the nectar) of the New Moon and the like, by those who have been perfected by the (goddess’s) Command and remove the impurities of the Age of Strife. Afterwards (he assumes) a playful form and, intent on the practice of equality, he is born (into the world) as a divine yogi. (66)

sanskrit: 330 - .२२० कुमारिकाखण्ड: २२३ येनेदं सिद्धमार्गं प्रकटित – भुवने कीर्ति कोल्लापुरे वा बिल्वस्फोटं विधाय पुनरपि च गतः संस्थितश्चन्द्रपुर्याम् । चिञ्चामालोकयित्वा२५ त्रिभुवनविदितां यस्य कीर्तिर्बभूव' २२७ २२६ । तीव्राज्ञाया वरो यो कलिकलुषहरो नौम्यहं वृक्षनाथम् ।। ६७ ।। .२३० २३२ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे २२८ अन्वये २९ सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदें आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते श्रीक्रमसृष्ट्यधिकारो५ नामानन्दः ।। ४४ ।। २३४
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FOUR 331 I salute Vrknanātha, the choosen one of the intense (power of the goddess's) Command, who removes the filth of the Age of Strife. (He who) has revealed the Path of the Siddhas in the world and is famous in Kollāpura where, having burst apart the Bilva tree (bilvaspho˜a), he then returned and resides in the City of the Moon. (I salute him) who, having seen the (goddess’s) Tamarind Tree (ciñcā), known (throughout) the three worlds, attained fame. (67) This is the (forty-fourth) chapter called concerning the Emanation of the Śrīkrama. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: पञ्चचत्वारिंशानन्दः श्रिवक्रा उवाच' अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि त्रिकभेदविनिर्णयम्' । परापरमनुत्तमम् ।।१ ॥ परं चैव तु बीजस्थं निर्बीजं परमं पदम् । अद्वयं परमं ज्ञानं मन्त्रातीतमगोचरम् ।। २ ।। एवं त्रिविधभेदः स्यात् स^ तम् । कृता येन महाचर्या प्रत्ययं प्रकटीकृतम् ॥ ३ ॥ प्रत्ययाज्जायते मुक्तिर्मुक्तेर्बध न विद्यते । एवं सृष्टिक्रमं प्रोक्तं त्रिकभेदस्य निर्णयम् ।। ४॥ दिव्याम्नायक्रमाज्जात पश्चिमे परमेश्वर । प्रथमावतारसंकेत उक्तं कुलक्रमोदयम् ॥ ५ ॥ २० यश्चावधारयेत्” श्रीमान् श्रीकुजाख्यामहामतम् । स मुक्तः स कुलाचार्यः परमानन्दनन्दितः ॥ ६ ॥ २१ एवं शक्तिस्वरूपोऽयं अव्यक्तं च ब्रवीम्यहम् । अव्यक्ताज्जायते” सिंहः सिंहात् संवर्तविभ्रमः” ॥ ७ ॥ विभ्रमाज्जायते” शक्तिः शक्तेः “किञ्जल्कभैरवम् । २७ भैरवादकुलं जातं अकुलाद् विकुल तथा ॥ ८ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FIVE The Casket of the Transmissions The Sūtra concerning the First Descent of the Tradition (ādyāvatārasūtra) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Now, from here onwards, I will tell (you) the teaching concerning the Triple Division (trikabheda) * * * * Most excellent (anuttama), it is both superior (transcendent) and inferior (immanent). (1) Supreme, it is established in the seed-syllable, (while) the Supreme Abode is seedless. The supreme knowledge is non-dual, transcends mantra and is not in the field (of the senses and the mind). (2) Such is the threefold division * * * *. Having observed the great Kaula practice (mahācaryā), a sign of attainment (pratyaya) manifests. (3) From the sign of attainment comes liberation of which there is no bondage. Thus the Sequence of Emanation (srn˜ikrama), which is the teaching of the Triple Division, has been explained. (4) O Supreme Lord, it originated in the Western (Tradition) from the transmission of the Divine Tradition (divyāmnāya). The convention concerning the first descent (of the Tradition into the world), which is the arising of the Kulakrama, has been explained. (5) The noble soul, who listens carefully to the great teaching (mahāmata) (concerning the goddess) called Śrīkujā is liberated and is a (true) Kulācārya, joyful with supreme bliss. (6) Such is the nature of (Śiva's) energy. (Now) I will explain (the nature of the) Unmanifest (avyakta). (Bhairava) the Lion is born from the Unmanifest and from the Lion the amorous sport (vibhrama) of Saˆvartā (the goddess). (7) Energy is generated from (this) activity, and from (this) energy, Kiñjalka Bhairava. Akula is born from Bhairava and Vikula from Akula. (8)

sanskrit: 334 कुमारिकाखण्ड: विकुलात्” पुंकुल” चैव पुंकुलात् खकुलं पुनः । ३० खकुलात् पञ्चधा ं ह्यात्मा” अकुलात् कुलसन्ततिः ।। ९ ।। भविष्यन्ति” न संदेहः” कलिस्यान्ते” महातप । सिद्धज्ञानमिदं दिव्यं कुलाम्नायमुदाहृतम् ।। १० ॥ आद्यावतार यो वेत्ति सोऽन्वयी कुलशासने इदं सृष्टिक्रमं ज्ञानं सिद्धसन्ततिनिर्णयम् ।। ११ ।। न कस्यचिन्मयाख्यातं त्वदृते परमेश्वर । रक्षितव्यं प्रयत्नेन” अप्रकाश्य” तु कारयेत् ॥ १२ ॥ •४० इत्याद्यावतारसूत्रं तु पारम्पर्यविनिर्णयम् । यो जानाति वरारोह तस्य आज्ञा चतुष्टये ॥ १३ ॥ प्रथमं तु कुलाम्नायं” क्रमाम्नायं द्वितीयकम् । द्वीपाम्नायं तृतीयं तु पीठाम्नायं चतुर्थकम् ॥ १४ ॥ सिद्धाम्नायं पञ्चमं च देव्याम्नायं तु षष्ठकम्” । एतदाम्नायषट्कं च अन्वये परिकीर्तितम् ।। १५ ।। ४५ ४७ प्रथमं दिव्यपुष्पं तु युग्मसंज्ञमतः परम् । एकमेवमिदं गुह्यं पुष्पसंकेतपञ्चकम् ।। १६ ।। पुष्पपञ्चकमेतद्धि” कुले च प्रकटीकृतम् । कौमारमूध्वतो दिव्यं शिरस्थ यो हि धारयेत् ॥ १७ ॥ कौलिकः स च विज्ञेयः ३ आचार्यमतबोधकः ४ । । खेचरत्वमवाप्नोति सिद्धिस्तस्य करस्थिता ।। १८ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FIVE 335 Puˆkula (comes) from Vikula and Khakula comes from Puˆkula. The fivefold Self comes from Khakula and the Kula Lineage (santati) comes from Akula.1 (9) O greatly austere one, (all these things) will certainly take place at the end of the Age of Strife. This is the divine knowledge of the Siddhas called the Kula teaching (āmnāya). (10) He who knows (this), the first descent (of the teachings into the world), is a (true) member of the lineage of the Kula teachings. This sequence of emanation (srn˜ikrama) is knowledge, the teaching of the lineage of Siddhas (siddhasantati). (11) O Supreme Lord, I have not told this to anyone except you. It should be guarded with effort and not made public. (12) This is the Sūtra concerning the first descent (ādyāvatārasūtra), the teaching of the line of teachers. O fair-hipped one, he who knows it possesses the Command in the group of four (sacred seats). (13) The Path of Flight and the Sixfold Kula Taught in the Language of the Kula The first is the teaching (āmnāya) concerning Kula, the second is the teaching concerning the Krama, the third is the teaching concerning the Islands and the fourth is the teaching concerning the sacred seats. The teaching concerning the Siddhas is the fifth and the teaching concerning the Goddess is the sixth. This is the group of six teachings (āmnāya) well know in the tradition (anvaya). (14-15) The teaching concerning Kula (kulāmnāya) The first is the (Drop which is the) Divine Flower, the following one is called the Couple (Śrīnātha and Ciñcinī). This secret is only one, namely, the pentad of the Convention of the Flower. This group of Five Flowers2 has been revealed in the Kula. (16-17ab) The divine (transmission) of the Youth is above. He who bears it on (his) head should be known to be a (true) Kaula who explains the doctrine of the teachers (ācārya). He attains Flight and success lies in the palm of his hand.3 (18)

sanskrit: 336 कुमारिकाखण्ड: कविमुख पुष्पस्येद पश्चिमे तु विनिर्णयम् । पारम्पर्यक्रमायात दिव्यमेतत् कुलोदयम् ॥ १९ ॥ आद्यन्त” स्मरते यो हि कौमारे तु परे पदे । कुलसिद्धिर्भवेत् तस्य खेगतिश्च न संशयः ।। २० ।। ६४ खेगतिं‍ खेचरीं चैव खेगतवीरवन्दित । • ६७ लभते नात्र संदेहो आनन्द स्वाधिकारकम् ।। २१ ।। ७० खेचर खेचरीसिद्धिः गमनात् खेचरस्य तु । खेचरीसिद्धिसिद्धस्य सिद्धिश्चैव तु खेचरी ।। २२ ।। एतत् ते खेचरं मार्गं दिव्याज्ञा नात्र संशयः । ७४ ७३ कुलाम्नायमिदं ह्येषा ँ कौलभाषा उदाहृतम् ।। २३ ।। अथातः क्रमभेदं तु कुलाम्नाये व्यवस्थितम् । ।। ओजापूकाचतुष्कं तु देवीचतुष्कभूषितम् ॥ २४ ॥ खसमतासमोपेतं सार्धं विद्याचतुष्टयम् । मि—ओषचेति” चत्वारः सर्वविद्यायुताः पृथक् ।। २५ ।। ८३ गसपमनान्तरे” रत्नं संज्ञा रत्नं च पञ्चकम् । रत्नोत्थ” पञ्चकोपेतं विनिविविससंज्ञकम् ।। २६ ।। योगिनीभिर्डकाराद्यैः“ षट्कं सप्तमसंयुतम् । अपरकर्तरी विद्या तथा सप्तसमस्तेषु ।। २७ ।। ९० असंयोविसमध्ये तु विद्यायुक्तं च पञ्चकम् । त्रियुग्मं च त्रिकूटं च असिक्त त्रिकसंज्ञकम् ॥ २८ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FIVE 337 This is the poet’s mouth of the Flower (of the Divine Current), the teaching of the Western (Tradition). This divine emergence of Kula (kulodaya) has come down through the sequence of the lineage of teachers. (19) He who recollects (the reality) within the Supreme Abode of the (transmission of the) Youth (from) the beginning to the end undoubtedly attains Flight and the accomplishment (siddhi) of Kula. (20) O (goddess) venerated by the Heroes who wander in the Void! He surely attains Flight (khegati) and the (goddess) Khecarī, along with the bliss that is his authority.4 (21) The Accomplishment of Flight (khecarīsiddhi) (is the attainment of) the movement within the Void (khecara) that occurs by the movement of (the accomplished yogi) who moves in the Void (of absolute reality) (khecara). Khecarī is the accomplishment (siddhi) of the one who has achieved the Accomplishment of Flight (khecarīsiddhi). (22) This is your Path of Flight. It is, without a doubt, the Divine Command. This is the Kula teaching, said to be the language of Kula (kulabhānā). (23) The Krama (kramāmnāya) of Twenty-Seven of the Youth Now (I will tell you about) the Krama variety within the Kula teaching (kulāmnāya). (This is) the group of four, namely, O (OÆÆiyāSa), JĀ (Jālandhara), PŪ (PūrSagiri) and KĀ (Kāmarūpa). It is adorned by the four goddesses along with the group of four Vidyās and is one with the Void (khasamatā). (There are also) four (Siddhas): MI (Mitranātha), O (OÆÆīśanātha), ±A (±an˜hanātha) and CA (Caryānātha), each one of whom possesses all the Vidyās. (24-25) The Jewel (KuSÆalinī) is within GA SA PA MA NA. (`Jewel') denotes the (Vidyā called) the Pentad of Jewels. It is generated from (KuSÆalinī who is) the Jewel and endowed with the pentad called VI, NI, VI, VI, SA. (26) The group of six (is formed by) the Yoginīs, Õākinī (Æakārā) and the rest and is associated with the seventh (Yoginī).5 The Vidyā that operates as Aparā (?) is present in the seven aggregates. (27) The group of five, conjoined with the Vidyā, is in the midst of (the Vidyā) A SA¤ YO VI SA. (The other mantras are) the triple pair, the three Peak (seed- syllables) and the (group) called the Consecrated Triad (asiktatrika). (28)

sanskrit: 338 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ९४ क्रमभाषा इयं देव भेदानि सप्तविंशतिः । योगमार्गेण सिद्ध्यन्ति ध्यायमानाश्चतुर्युगे ।। २९ ॥ एवं क्रममिदं देव युग्मनाथेन दीपितम् । ९७ भाषा चैकाक्षरा विद्या पुरा वै या समाख्याता ॥ ३० ॥ ९८क स्वगुरुस्तत्त्वमाला तु तथा पञ्चाशिकाक्रमम् । ९८ख समया मालिनी विद्या तथा तु भैरवाष्टकम् ।। ३१ ।। ततः कुलाष्टकं दिव्यं अष्टाष्टकसमन्वितम् । एवं पूजाक्रमं प्रोक्तं कौमारं तु युगे युगे ।। ३२ ।। आम्नाये पश्चिमाम्नाये दिव्यमेतत् कुलक्रमम् । दक्षिणतः” शतातीते शताब्दशतकेन तु ॥ ३३ ॥ ततो दक्षान्तकेऽशेष सिद्धिनाथस्य भाषितम् । न लिखेत् पुस्तके देव क्रमौघमिदमुत्तमम् ।। ३४ ।। ०४ कर्णाकर्णगत” ज्ञेय मतार्थ विमल क्रमम् । पूजनात् प्राप्यते मोक्षो जन्मसप्तविमोचनम् ॥ ३५ ॥ १०९ दिव्यमेतत् क्रमाम्नाय“ सप्ताविंशत् कुलाज्ञया । एवं वै विन्दते” यो हि स भवेत् कौलभाजन : १११ ११२ ।। ३६ ।। स मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो गत्वासौ”” पश्चिमे गृहे । कैलाशस्योपरि ३ दिव्ये विचरेत यथासुखम् ।। ३७ ।। जरामरणनिर्मुक्त:”” सिद्धतुल्यो भवत्यसौ । ११८ यमोऽपि वञ्चितस्तेन येनाम्नाय : प्रपूजितः ॥ ३८ ॥ ११९ क्रमिकः स च विज्ञेयः पश्चिमे योगिनीगृहे । १२१ । सोऽधिकारी कुलकौले देशिकः सोऽभिधीयते ।। ३९ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FIVE 339 O god, this is the language of the transmission (kramabhānā). If one contemplates the twenty-seven divisions6 in accord with the path of Yoga they are successful in (all) four ages. (29) O god, this transmission (krama) has been energized in this way by Yugmanātha (the Lord of the Couple). The language is the Vidyā of one syllable that was explained before.7 (30) 1) One's own teacher, 2) the garland of (metaphysical) Principles, 3) the sequence of fifty (letters) (pañcāśikākrama), 4) the Samayā, which is the Mālinī Vidya, 5) the group of eight Bhairavas, 6) the (Eight Mothers of the) Octad of Kula along with the divine (group of) sixty-four (an˜ān˜aka) (Yoginīs). Thus the liturgy of the rite of adoration (pūjākrama) of the (Transmission of the) Youth in each Age has been declared. (31-32) This is the divine Kulakrama in the Tradition, that is, in the Western Tradition. (It proceeded) from the south (of India) ten thousand one hundred years ago and then all that has been said by Siddhanātha was (uttered) in fornt of Dakna. O god, this, the most excellent current of the transmission (kramaugha), should not be written in a book. (33-34) One should known that the transmission (krama), the pure meaning of the teaching (matārtha), is transmitted verbally. By worshipping (it), one attains liberation within seven lifetimes. (35) This Krama teaching (āmnāya) of twenty-seven (constituents) is, by virtue of the Command of Kula, divine. He who acquires it in this way is a (true) Kaula. (36) He is freed from all sins and, having entered the divine Western House on the top of Kailāsa, he can wander about as he pleases. Free of birth and death, he is equal (to the supreme) Siddha. He who has worshipped the Tradition (āmnāya) has cheated Yama (the Lord of Death). (37-38) He (alone) should be known to be a follower of the Krama (kramika) in the Western House of the Yoginīs. He has authority in the Kulakaula and is said to be a (true) teacher. (39)

sanskrit: 340 अन्यथा विन्दते यो हि क्रमभेदान् १२३ १२२ १२४ न मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो नरकान्न दारिद्र्य'५ वर्धते तस्य स्वल्पायुः १२६ कुमारिकाखण्ड: पृथक् पृथक् । निवर्तते ॥ ४० ॥ ।। संप्रजायते ७ । अन्यथा तु क्रियाचारं मुद्रामण्डलक यथा ।। ४१ ।। पीठं च पादुकां देव्याः संज्ञामन्त्रार्णव यथा । यो वदेत्” सिद्धसन्ताने स पापिष्ठतरो भवेत् ।। ४२ ।। दिव्यक्रममिद देव भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्” । एतद् देव तवाख्यात कौमारक्रमनिर्णयम् ।। ४३ ॥ श्रीनाथ उवाच एतद् वै क्रमकौमार दिव्यभाषासमन्वितम्' १३७ १४० ज्ञानसाध्य ३८ स्फुटं भद्रे कथ पीठान्वय भवेत् ॥ ४४ ॥ विस्तरेण मम ब्रूहि यदि तुष्टासि वक्रिके । श्रीवक्रा उवाच अथान्यं क्रमसंदेश विमलार्थं यथा स्थितम् ।। ४५ ।। पीठादिक्रमचत्वारस्तथा बालक्रमोदयम् । बालक्रमस्य संयोगात् कौमारं कथितं तव ।। ४६ ।। कौमारक्रमसंयोगाद् भवते खेचरं क्रमम् । खेचरक्रमसंयोगात् वृद्धक्रम स्फुटं भवेत् ॥ ४७ ॥ षट्प्रकारमिदं कौल गुह्यसंकेतक क्रमम् । गुरुक्रम नवात्मान मायाचक्रसमन्वितम् ॥ ४८ ॥ १५३ देव्याष्टकक्रमं चैव अष्टाष्टकमतान्तरम् । । एवं तु क्रमशो ज्ञात्वा तथा वै खेचरीक्रमम् ॥ ४९ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FIVE 341 He who acquires the varieties of the Krama part by part in some different way is not freed from all (his) sins and does not come out of hell. He becomes increasingly poor and his lifespan is shortened. (40-41ab) The greatest sinner in the Lineage of the Siddhas (siddhasantāna) is the one who explains the ritual (kriyācāra), the Circle of Gesture (mudrāmaSÆala), the sacred seat, the sandals of the goddess and the ocean of terms (saˆjñā) and mantras in some other way (than this). (41cd-42) O god, this is the divine transmission (divyakrama) that bestows both worldly benefits and liberation. O god, I have told you that, namely, the teaching of the Transmission of the Youth. (43) The Pī˜hāmnāya — the Transmission of the Child Śrīnātha said: That, indeed, is the Transmission of the Youth along with the Divine Language (divyabhānā). (Now) O Vakrikā, if you are pleased (with me), tell me in detail about the teaching (anvaya) concerning the sacred seats. Attainable (only) by knowledge, how, O benevolent one, can it be made clearly comprehensible (sphu˜a)? (44-45ab) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Now (I will give you) another Krama teaching the sense of which is pure (vimalārtha),8 namely, the four transmissions of the sacred seats and the rest along with the arising of the Transmission of the Child.9 (45cd-46ab) I have explained (the Transmission) of the Youth in conjunction with the Transmission of the Child. (Similarly), the Transmission of the Skyfarer10 is (such) by conjunction with the Transmission of the Youth. By conjuction with the Transmission of the Skyfarer, the Transmission of the Aged becomes clearly evident. (46cd-47) This secret convention, the Kaula Transmission, is of six kind's11 namely: 1) the Transmission of the Teachers, 2) the Ninefold mantra (navātman) along with 3) the Wheel of Māyā, 4) the Transmission of the Group of Eight Goddesses, then follows 5) the Doctrine of the Sixty-four (an˜ān˜aka) and, once one has know (these Transmissions) in this way in due order, 6) the Transmission of the Skyfarer (follows). (48-49)

sanskrit: 342 कुमारिकाखण्ड: सिद्धक्रमं निराचारं मालिनीक्रमराजकम् । १५४ शब्दराशिक्रमं चान्यं तथा वीरावलीक्रमम् ।। ५० ।। वीरावलीक्रम चैव मातृकाक्रमनिर्णयम् १५७ १५६ योगिनीक्रममाद्यं च तथा वै समयाक्रमम् ॥ ५१ ॥ रत्नमालाक्रम दिव्यं मण्डलक्रमनिर्णयम् । गृहभेदक्रमं चान्यं दिव्यक्रममतः ५९ परं ।। ५२ ॥ मेरुक्रमं शिवमेभिः° सप्ताविंशत्क्रमोदयम्” । ९६३ एवं वै क्रमसंजात ज्ञात्वा मुक्तिर्न संशयः ॥ ५३ ॥ अतः क्रमोत्तर १६४ नाम मन्त्राणां मातरीगृहम् । पूर्वपश्चिममध्यं च वामदक्षिणकौलिकम् ।। ५४ ।। योनिषट्कं च शृङ्गाट आदिक्षान्त १६९ कुलेश्वरम् । १७२ एवं वै यो विजानाति स साक्षाद् भैरवः स्वयम् ॥ ५५ ॥ १७३ एवं क्रमार्थतस्तत्त्वं सप्तकोट्याद् विनिर्गतम् ' इदं मतमिदं ज्ञेयं इदं तत्त्व कुलार्णवम् ॥ ५६ ॥ कुलोऽयं क्रम - ओघ च ज्ञानौघ च तथोत्तमम् । पूजनीयं प्रयत्नेन निन्दते न कदाचन ॥ ५७ ॥ पञ्चश्रोतात्मके शैवे षष्ठे कुलविनिश्चये । -१८३ १८४ आख्यातं तु क्रमाम्नाय इदं तत्सारसंग्रहम् ॥ ५८ ॥ सिद्धसन्तान“ सुभगं प्रत्ययाज्ञाविशारदम् । नाम्ना क्रमोदयं ज्ञानं श्रीकुजेशीमहामतम् ॥ ५९ ॥
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FIVE 343 The Transmission of Siddhas, Stillness (nirācāra), the Transmission of Mālinī,12 the king (of all Transmissions), the Transmission of the Assembly of Sounds (śabdarāśi),13 the Transmission of the Line of Heroes (vīrāvalī) and, along with the Transmission of the Line of Heroes, the teaching concerning the Transmission of the Mātrkās along with the Transmission of the Yoginīs.14 The Transmission of the Samayā (Vidyā),15 the divine Transmission of the Garland of Jewels,16 the teaching concerning the Transmission of the maSÆala, the Transmission of the various Houses and, after this, the Divine Transmission, the Transmission of Meru that is beneficial (śiva) and, along with these, the arising of the Transmission of Twenty-seven Parts.17 (One) certainly (achieves) liberation once one has known (all that has) originated from the Transmissions in this way. (50-53) After this comes a higher Transmission (kramottara), which is the Mother's House of mantras. It consists of the Northern (vāma) and Southern (dakniSa) Kaulika (Transmissions) along with (those of) the East (pūrva) and the West (paścima).18 (There is also) the (hexagram consisting of the) group of six Yonis (yonina˜ka), the Triangle (śrngā˜a) and Kuleśvara (who consists of the letters) ranging from A to K±a. He who knows19 this is Bhairava himself, directly apparent. (54-55) The Kaula Teachings of Sadyojāta In this way, the truth (tattva) has emerged from the teaching (artha) of the Krama, that is, from the (scripture of) seventy million (verses) (ko˜i). This is the doctrine (mata). This is what is to be known.20 This is the truth (tattva). This is the Ocean of Kula. One should worship with effort the Current of the Kula, the Current of the Krama and the most excellent Current of Knowledge. It must never be denigrated.21 (56-57) The Tradition of the Transmission (kramāmnāya), which is a part of the Kula teaching, the sixth (current) amongst the five currents of Śaiva (scriptures), has been explained. This is a synopsis of its essence (sārasaˆgraha). (58) The finest part of the line (santāna) of Siddhas, it is proficient in the Command of insight (pratyayājñā). It is the knowledge that comes by the arising of the transmission called the great Mata of the venerable (goddess) Kubjeśī.22 (59)

sanskrit: 344 कुमारिकाखण्ड: सद्योजातमिदं कौलं सद्यः सृष्टिक्रमोदयम् । सद्यो आदिः स्मृतश्चैव असद्योद्भवकारक : ।। ६० ।। खेगतिं कुरुते सद्यो” सद्यो कौलस्य निर्णयम् १९९ खेगति९२ कुरुते सद्यो सद्यो शेखरभाषितम् ॥ ६१ ॥ सत्यं कुलाश्रम श्रेष्ठं योगिनीपश्चिमं गृहम् ' १९६ । सर्वानन्दं स्मृतं सद्य: सद्यो वै सप्तकोटिकम् ॥ ६२ ॥ संप्रदायमिदं° सद्यः१ सद्योऽनुग्रहनिग्रहम् । पारम्पर्यक्रमं सद्यः .२०२ सद्यो २०३ शैवस्य निर्णयम् ।। ६३ ।। २०६ सद्यो २०४ हि०५ भवते सर्वं श्रीमतं पश्चिमं गृहम् २०७ २०८ । एवं सद्योविहीना ये पश्चिमाम्नायवर्जिताः ॥ ६४ ॥ न तेषामभिषेक”” तु देशिकत्वं न विद्यते । २१० २१२ कुलान्वयेन हीनो यो नाधिकारी शिवागमे ॥ ६५ ॥ दीक्षितास्तेन२१३ ये देव १४ न ते मोक्षस्य भाजना: २१५ प्रकटं न लिखेद् देव१६ क्रमार्थेदं मुखोद्गतम् ।। ६६ ।। गुरुवक्त्रे स्थितं नित्यं गुरुवक्त्रात् तु लभ्यते ९ । २१८ २२१ २२२ एवं सद्य:समायुक्त:° कौलिकस्तु यदा भवेत् ।। ६७ ।। पशुसंगाद् विनश्येत यदि साक्षात् सदाशिवः असत्सङ्गं न कर्तव्यं असत्सङ्गाद् विनश्यति २२४ २२३ । ।। ६८ ।। विशुद्धं काञ्चनं यद्वन्नागसङ्गाद् विनश्यति । एवं शुद्धवतः सोऽपि ७ असत्सङ्गाद् २८ विनश्यति ।। ६९ ।। २२९ पशुसङ्गान्न मुक्तिः स्यादभिषेकान्न मुच्यति । |
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FIVE 345 This Kaula (teaching) is that of Sadyojāta (Born in an Instant),23 the immediate arising of the sequence of emanation. The `Immediate' (sadyo) is said to be the first (of all things) and it generates time (asadyas).24 (60) The Immediate brings about Flight. The Immediate is the Kaula teaching. The Immediate is said to be the pinnacle.25 (61) In truth it is the Western House of the Yoginīs, the best Kula Hermitage. The Immediate is said to be universal bliss. The Immediate is indeed (the scripture of) seventy million verses. (62) The Immediate is this tradition (saˆpradāya). The Immediate is both grace and restraint. The Immediate is the transmission of the line of teachers, the teaching of the Śaiva (scripture). (63) The Immediate (sadyas) is all things, the Śrīmata and the Western House. Those who are devoid of the Immediate and are devoid of the Western Tradition are not consecrated and cannot be teachers.26 (64-65ab) One who is not part of a Kula lineage has no authority in the Śaiva Āgamas. O god, those who are initiated by (such a one) are not liberated. (65cd-66ab) O god, one should not clearly set down to writing this Krama teaching (kramārtha) that has come from (the teacher's) mouth. It is always in the teacher's mouth and it is obtained from the teacher's mouth. (66cd-67ab) (Even) if a Kaula adept is conjoined in this way to the Immediate he is destroyed by the company of the fettered, (even) if he is Sadāśiva himself. One should not keep the company of the worldly. Bad company brings about one's destruction. (67cd-68) Just as pure gold is destroyed by contact with lead (nāga), in the same way, one who is pure is destroyed by contact with the worldly. By keeping the company of the fettered liberation is not possible. (He who keeps it) is not liberated (even) by consecration. (69-70ab)

sanskrit: 346 कुमारिकाखण्ड: इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके३१ विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अव्वाक्रमभाषिते ‍ क्रममञ्जूषाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। ४५ ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-FIVE 347 This is the (forty-fifth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the Casket of the Transmissions. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It is on the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) and is the ultimate purport of the Pure Six Thousand (verses) (vimalana˜ka) in the division beginning with `Kā' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (avvākrama).

sanskrit: षट्चत्वारिंशानन्दः श्रीवक्रा उवाच' अथान्यं संप्रवक्ष्यामि तत्त्वपीठोदय' शुभम् । कामाख्ये पृथिवी ज्ञेया तेजो दक्षिणपीठके ॥ १ ॥ आपः पूर्णगिरिस्थितः वायुरोंकारसंस्थितः । ७ आकाशं सर्वपीठेषु पीठभूतानि मे स्मृताः ॥ २ ॥ o शब्दोद्याणे विजानीयात् स्पर्श तस्यैव चाग्रतः । रस तदुत्तरे मार्गे रूपं दक्षिणकोणके ।। ३ ।। कैलाशान्ते तु गन्धत्वतन्मात्रमिति पञ्चकम् । १३१४ आकाशे संस्थिता तु वाक् पाणिश्चाग्रे सदाशिवः ॥। ४ ॥ पादौ दक्षिणपीठे तु पायुश्चोत्तरकोणगः । २० उपस्थं तिस्रमध्ये तु पञ्चकर्मेन्द्रियाणि मे ॥ ५ ॥ श्रोत्रं जालन्धरे पीठे त्वचोक्त पूर्णगिर्यके । चक्षुर्मध्ये विजानीयाज्जिह्वा कामाख्यमण्डले ।।६॥ २२ नासिका तिस्रपीठे तु एवं ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणि तु । २४ कामाख्ये तु मनः प्रोक्तं बुद्धिश्चोद्याणमण्डले ॥ ७ ॥ दक्षिणस्थमहंकारं प्रकृतिः पश्चिमे विदुः । .२५ पुरुषो मध्यमे पीठे पञ्चैते कुलभूषणाः ।। ८ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-SIX The Glory of Emission (viknepādhikāramāhātmya) The Contents of the Five Sacred Seats The Location of the Twenty-five Principles in the Five Sacred Seats The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: Now I will explain something else, namely, the auspicious arising of the sacred seats which are the principles of existence (tattvapī˜ha).1 (1ab) One should know that Earth is located in Kāmarūpa (kāmākhya). Fire (tejas) is in the southern sacred seat. Water is located in PūrSagiri, while Air is in (the sacred seat of) O¤. Space is in all the sacred seats. (These) are said to be my gross elements belonging to the sacred seats (pī˜habhūta).2 (1cd-2) Know that Sound is in (the sacred seat of) UdyāSa, while Touch is in front of that. Taste (rasa) is on the path to the north of it and Form is in the southern corner. The subtle element of Smell is within Kailāsa,3 thus (completing) the group of five (subtle elements). (3-4ab) Speech is located in space.4 O Śiva, the hand is always (located) in (Kāmarūpa, the seat) in front. The feet are in the southern sacred seat, while the anus is in the northern corner and the genitals are in the middle of (these) three. These are my five organs of action. (4cd-5) The ear is in the sacred seat of Jālandhara, while the skin is said to be in (the sacred seat of) PūrSagiri.5 The eye is in the centre, while one should know that the tongue is in the circle of Kāmarūpa (kāmākhya) and the nose is in the sacred seat (called) Tisra. Such are the organs of knowledge. (6-7ab) The mind (manas) is said to be in Kāmarūpa (kāmākhya) and the intellect is in the circle of UÆyāna. The ego is in the south. (The wise) know that Nature (prakrti) is in the western (seat) and the Person (puruna) is in the sacred seat in the centre. These five are the ornaments of Kula. (7cd-8)

sanskrit: 350 पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वानि योगपीठे उदाहृताः २७ कुमारिकाखण्ड: । ज्ञातव्यास्तु प्रयत्नेन गुणत्रयसमन्विताः” ।। ९ ॥ सत्त्वमग्रे” विजानीयाद् रजमुत्तरमण्डले” । तमं तु दक्षिणे मार्गे पञ्चरत्नमतः शृणु ॥ १० ॥ कामरूपे स्थितो ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्चोत्तरपीठके । ३३ .३४ रुद्रो” जालाख्यसंज्ञे तु ईश्वरस्तिस्रपीठके ॥। ११ ॥ सदाशिवस्तयोर्मध्ये पञ्चैते सृष्टिकारकाः । गुप्ता संज्ञा प्रवक्ष्यामि यथोक्ता सप्तकोटिषु ।। १२ ।। शंकरोऽनन्त” श्रीकण्ठः पिङ्गलश्च चतुर्थकः । ४० सादाख्य: पञ्चमो देव पञ्चैते अमरकारकाः पूजनीयाश्च सततं सिद्धि–ऋद्धिप्रदायकाः” । ४१ ॥ १३ ॥ योनिमुद्रा तु कामाख्ये कराला दक्षिणे विदुः ॥ १४ ॥ पद्मिनी पूर्णगियायां घटमुद्रान्तरालके । कदम्बिनी तिस्रपीठे मुद्राणां पञ्चकोदयम् ॥ १५ ॥ चतुर्विधं स्मृतं ध्यानं श्यामवर्णोड्डियाणकम् । ५० रक्तं जालन्धरं प्रोक्तं पीतं वै वामगोचरे ॥ १६ ॥ श्वेतं तु चोत्तर ध्यानं कामाख्ये तु विजानतः । निश्चलं मध्यमं ध्यानं चलं दक्षिणतः स्थितम् ।। १७ ।। उत्तरे द्विस्वभावं तु सुस्थिरं ध्यानमग्रतः ।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-SIX 351 The twenty-five Principles are said to be in the sacred seat of Yoga (yogapī˜ha). One should make an effort to know them along with the three qualities (of Nature) (guSa).6 (9) Know that sattva is in front and that rajas is in the circle of the north. Again, tamas is on the southern path. Now listen to the (location of) the Five Jewels.7 (10) The Location of the Five Brahmās in the Five Sacred Seats Brahmā resides in Kāmarūpa while VinSu is in the northern seat. Rudra is in the one called Jālākhya, while Īśvara is in the sacred seat (called) Tisra. Sadāśiva is in the centre between these two.8 These five bring about emanation. (11-12ab) I will (now) tell (you) (their) secret names as stated in (the scripture of) seventy million verses. Śa‰kara, Ananta, ŚrīkaS˜ha with Pi‰gala as the fourth and Sādākhya, O god, as the fifth.9 These are the five bestowers of immortality (amarakāraka). They bestow both wealth and accomplishment and should always be worshipped. (12cd-14ab) The Five Gestures in the Five Sacred Seats (The wise know that) Yonimudrā is in Kāmākhya. (They also) know that Karālā in the south, Padminī is in PūrSagiri, and that Gha˜amudrā is in between them10 (whereas) Kadambinī is in the sacred seat (called) Tisra. The pentad of Gestures has arisen (in this way). (14cd-15) The Colour and Motion of the Five Seats The visualization (dhyāna) (of the sacred seats) is said to be of four kinds. The colour of OÆÆiyāSaka is dark blue (śyāma). Jālandhara is said to be red. (PūrSagiri) on the left is yellow. The following visualization is white and is known to be in Kāmākhya. (16-17ab) The visualization in the centre is immobile while that in the south moves. That in the north is of both natures. The visualization in front is very stable. (17cd-18ab)

sanskrit: 352 कुमारिकाखण्डः ५२ मध्ये कृतयुग देव त्रेता ? दक्षिणकोणगा ॥ १८ ॥ उत्तरे द्वापरं ज्ञेयं अग्रतः कलिरुच्यते । एवं चतुर्युगं प्रोक्तं मुद्राचक्रे महेश्वर ।। १९ । वृक्षत्रयं त्रिकोणस्थं कदम्ब चाग्रतो विदुः । दक्षिणे कथितं बिल्व चिञ्चाख्य” तु तथोत्तरे ।। २० ।। एवं तत्त्वविभागेन योगपीठमुद्राहृतम् । कुलवृक्षत्रयं वक्ष्ये कुलमार्गेण सुन्दर ।। २१ ।। ६२ तेजमध्यगता बुद्धिश्चित्तवृत्तिरुभावपि । ६३ अद्वैतवासनायां तु त्रिधा त्रीणि व्यवस्थिताः ।। २२ ।। समरसं तत्र विद्येत भगाह्लादेन चिञ्चिणी । कलाशेषं मनो गत्वा भ्रमते तु कदम्बकम् ।। २३ ।। मणिपूर्णकलाधारे जायते म्रियते सदा । ६५ आत्मा च वदते नित्यं विरुते तु कदम्बकम् ।। २४ ।। ६९ बिल्व च“ जायते बिन्दुः ऊध्व ऊध्वविघट्टनात् । दृष्टादृष्टविभेदेन चिञ्चिणीवृक्षसंज्ञकम् ॥ २५ ॥ वृक्षोपदेशमाख्यातं कुलवृक्षत्रयं बहिः । यो जानाति महादेव मतार्थी स निगद्यते ॥ २६ ॥ श्रीनाथ उवाच पीठानां कीर्तनं ज्ञानं येन सिद्ध्यन्ति साधकाः ७४ । अन्यद् मे संशय देवि कथयस्व प्रसादतः ।। २७ ।।
english: CHAPTER FORTY-SIX 353 The Cosmic Ages O god, the Krta Age is in the centre, the Tretā Age is in the southern corner. One should know that the Dvāpara Age is in the north while the Age of Strife is said to be in front. O Great God, the four Ages are thus said to be (located) in the Wheel of Gestures (mudrācakra).11 (18cd-19) The Teaching of the Three Trees There are three trees in the triangle (of AI¤).12 (The wise) know that the Kadamba (tree) is in front. The Bilva (tree) is said to be in the south, while the (tree) called Ciñcā is in the north. The sacred seat of Yoga (yogapī˜ha) has thus been explained in accord with the division of the Principles. (20-21ab) O handsome one, I will (now) tell (you), about the three trees according to the Path of Kula. The intellect is in the centre of Fire (tejas). Both are modifications of the mind stuff (cittavrtti). The three are established threefold in the latent trace of non-duality. CiñciSī who is the state of unity (samarasa) exists there by virtue of the bliss of the Yoni.13 (21cd-23ab) Once the mind reaches the Kadambaka (consisting of) all the energies (kalā), it (begins to) rotate. It arises and dies away constantly in the foundation of the energy (kalā) of MaSipūrSa. The Self speaks constantly and the Kadambaka resounds (without interruption). (23cd-24) The Drop (bindu), which is the Bilva (tree), arises above by breaking through to the upper (levels). (Then) by dividing the seen from the unseen (drn˜ādrn˜a) (one attains the reality) called the CiñciSī tree.14 (25) The teaching concerning the Trees has been declared with relation to the three outer trees. O Great God, he who knows it is said to be one who (really) desires the Doctrine (matārthin).15 (26) The Five Siddhas Śrīnātha said: O goddess, I have another doubt concerning (the manner of) praising the sacred seats by means of which adepts attain knowledge. By (your) grace please tell me. (27)

sanskrit: 354 कुमारिकाखण्ड: श्रीवक्रा उवाच ७६ न कस्यचिन्मयाख्यातं तव देव वदाम्यहम् । ब्रह्मादिदेवतादीनां न मया संप्रकाशितम् ।। २८ ।।77 यथावतारितं तेन देवेन परमेष्ठिना । तत् तेऽहं कथयिष्यामि आत्मासंवित्तिकारणम् ।। २९ ।। यादृशं पूर्ववृत्तान्तं तादृशं कथयामि ते । ८० श्रीकण्ठः शङ्करोऽनन्तः” सादाख्यः पिङ्गलस्तथा ।। ३० ।। पञ्चैते व्यापका लोके भूतग्रामे चतुर्विधे । श्रीकण्ठः पृथिवी ज्ञेय:” शङ्कर आप उच्यते ॥ ३१ ॥ तेजोऽनन्त“ इति ँ ख्यात: “ सादाख्यो” वायुरुच्यते । ९० आकाशः पिङ्गलो” ज्ञेयः पञ्चैते सृष्टिकारकाः ।। ३२ ।। एवं पञ्चात्मकं देव ै निग्रहानुग्रहे स्थितम् । ९७ चिञ्चिणीनाथदेवोऽयं आज्ञासिद्धिमहातपः ॥ ३३ ॥ विद्यात्” सर्वज्ञभावेन लोलीभूतेन चेतसा । उन्मत्तचर्यचारेण” चरत्येवं चराचरें ।। ३४ ॥ ०३ यदुक्तं पिङ्गलं नाम सिद्धनाथमनामयम्” । सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं नित्यं अवतीर्ण धरातले ॥ ३५ ॥ क्षीरोदस्योत्तरे कुले हेमरत्नमोत्तमे । १०४ विचित्रमणिशोभाढ्ये रत्नकूटाचले शुभे ॥ ३६ ॥ महाक्षीरोदकल्लोले“ नित्य धौतशिलातलें ' सिद्धर्षिगणगन्धर्वसुरासुरनिषेविते ।। ३७ ।। १०७
english: CHAPTER FORTY-SIX 355 The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: I will tell you, O god, what I have not told to anybody else. I have not revealed it (even) to Brahmā and the other gods.16 (28) I will tell you (the teaching) the Supreme Lord has brought down (to earth), the cause of knowledge of the Self (ātmāsaˆvittikāraSa). I will tell you as it happened in the past.17 (29-30ab) ŚrīkaS˜ha, Śankara, Ananta, Sādākhya and Pi‰gala. These five pervade the world and the creatures (bhūtagrāma)18 of four kinds. (30cd-31ab) One should know that ŚrīkaS˜ha is Earth, while Śa‰kara is said to be Water. Ananta is said to be Fire (tejas) and Sādākhya, Air. One should know that Pi‰gala is Space. These five bring about emanation. In this way the Lord who is fivefold is present (and active) in both grace and punishment.19 (31cd-33ab) This is the god (deva) CiñciSīnātha who has observed the great penance (mahātapa) which is the accomplishment (siddhi) of the (goddess's) Command.20 (33cd) O god, one should know that by virtue of (his) omniscience and vibrant (lolībhūta) mind he moves in the mobile and immobile (universe) by the Practice of Ecstatic Madness (unmattacaryacāra). (34) The Legend of Siddhanātha, the First Siddha 21Siddhanātha, who is called Pi‰gala, faultless, omniscient, omnipresent and eternal, has descended onto the surface of the earth on the northern bank of the milky ocean. Made of gold and jewels, it is most excellent. (He descended) onto the mountain with jewelled peaks, rich with wonderful (vicitra) gems. (It lies in the midst) of the waves of the great ocean of milk22 (with which its) stone surface (śilātala) is constantly washed. It is attended by the gods, demons, heavenly musicians (gandharva) and troupes of ¬nis and Siddhas. (35-37)

sanskrit: 356 कुमारिकाखण्ड: उमा दाक्षायणी” कन्या तत्र तेन अनुग्रहम् । कृत्वा तु भारते वर्षे चतुर्मूत्यावतारकम् ।। ३८ ॥ त्रैलोक्यनगरे सर्वलोकाना तारकं परम् । भवार्णवनिमग्नाना”” गोत्रभेदकृत प्रिय ।। ३९ ॥ प्रथमं मित्रनाथ वै चर्याीनाथ द्वितीयकम् । तृतीयं षष्ठसंज्ञाख्य” ओड्डीशाख्य चतुर्थकम् ॥ ४० ॥ आद्यमेतच्चतुष्कं तु चतुर्युगे मुखाम्बुज । चतुःपीठाधिकारार्थमवत्तीर्ण दिनोत्तमे ।। ४१ ॥ श्रीमदोड्डीशनाथोऽय” तूष्णीशाख्येन २३ विश्रुतः १२४ । १२७ ॥ ४२ ॥ तदेकं स्वेच्छया देहमालम्ब्य १२५ नवधा २६ पुनः' शिष्यत्वेन स्वयं देव २८ भविष्यत्यात्मन: २९ कलौ । अनुग्रहार्थं जगत: संज्ञाभेदमिहोच्यते ।। ४३ । १३० १३३ गगनेन्द्रों” महाकुब्जों” रत्नेश: पद्मभास्करः । देववक्त्रामृतश्चान्यो” भैरवाब्जश्च पञ्चमः ॥ ४४ ॥ कमलार्क : १३५ शिवाम्भोजो' रामतत्त्वात्मा' एव च । कृष्णमार्तण्डनाथश्च नवैते” सिद्धनायकाः ॥ ४५ ॥ १३७ १४० पौण्ड्राख्ये च अहिच्छत्रे पुरे श्रीभोगवर्धने १४७ १४३ १३८ । पाटलीनगरे रम्ये ४५ मायापुर्य रम्ये ४५ मायापुर्या वरानन ं ।। ४६ ।। कन्यकुब्जे अलम्पुरे अयोध्या वर्धमान । स्थानेष्वेतेषु देवेश दिव्यमानुषयोनिजाः ।। ४७ ।। ज्ञानयोगबलोपेता: १५३ स्वाधारा: १५४ कौलिकान्वये । अनुगृहीता देवेश देवेनाज्ञार्कबिम्बजै: ।। ४८ ।। १५७
english: CHAPTER FORTY-SIX 357 The virgin Umā, daughter of Dakna (DāknāyaSī) (lived) there and so an act of grace took place. (Then), he who is the supreme saviour of all people in the city of the triple world, came down into the land of Bhārata in four forms (caturmūrti).23 (In this way), O beloved, those sunk in the ocean of phenomenal existence where divided into (four spiritual) clans (gotra).24 (38-39) The first is Mitranātha, the second Caryānātha, the third is called ±an˜hanātha and the fourth is called OÆÆīśa(nātha). O lotus faced one, this is the foremost group of four in the four Ages.25 (Each) on the most excellent (and auspicious) day, (the four) came down (into the world) in order to (assume) authority over the four sacred seats.26 (40-41) This, the venerable OÆÆīśa, is well known by the name of TūnSīśa.27 (42ab) The Nine Nāthas He, (though) one, assumed of his own free will, a body and became ninefold again. O god, he himself will assume the status of a disciple in the (Age of) Strife. It is said here that the (purpose of his) various names is to grace the universe.28 (42cd-43) 29(These are) Gaganendra (Lord of the Sky), Mahākubja (who is) Ratneśa (Lord of Jewels) and Padmabhāskara (Sun of the Lotus). Another is Devavaktrāmrta (Nectar from the Mouth of God). Bhairavābja (Bhairava’s Lotus) is the fifth. (The rest are) Kamalārka (Sun of the Lotus), Śivāmbhoja (Śiva's Lotus), (Rāma) who is the principle of delight (rāmatattva)30 and KrnSamārtaSÆanātha (Lord of the Black Sun). These are the nine leaders of the Siddhas.31 (44-45) O Lord of the gods, they were born in the wombs of divine human beings in the following places: (the city) called PauSÆra, Ahicchatra, the city (called) Śrībhogavardhana, the city of Pā˜alī, the beautiful Māyāpuri, O handsome one, Kanyakubja, Alampura,32 Ayodhyā and Vardhamānaka. (46-47ab) Endowed with the power of Yoga and knowledge, they are good supports (svādhāra) (of the teaching transmitted) in the Kaula tradition (kaulikānvaya). O Lord of the gods, they have been graced by the god (TūnSīśa)33 with the three kinds of divine rays34 that bestow liberation and worldly enjoyment and are born from the sun of (the goddess's) Command in due order. (47cd-48)

english: CHAPTER FORTY-SIX 359 O god, (the) descent (into the world) of the five Nāthas beginning with Gaganeśa actually took place (tattvatodita) in due order, on the five full (moon) days of ŚrāvaSa, ĀnāÆha, Vaiśākha, Caitra and Kārttika. (The descent of) the four Lords of the Siddhas beginning with Kamala is said (to have taken place) on the eighth day of the bright fortnight of (the month of) Kaumāra, on the twelfth day of the month of Mrga, on the seventh of the bright fortnight (arkasaptamī) of Caitra, and on the day of the fourteenth of the dark fortnight (bhūtahna) of the month of Phālguna. One should not rashly reveal this secret hard to acquire in the world. (49-52) The first (Gagana), the second (Ratneśa) and the eighth (KrnSa), in reverse order — these three have merged into the Supreme Abode and have no (spiritual) descendents (santāna).35 (53) The third (Padma), the fifth (Bhairavābja) and the sixth (Kamalārka) were commanded by the Lord to grace with compassion the sages.36 These three were terrific (ugra) and stayed celibate. They went to the village (grāma) called Kalpa. (54-55ab) The ninth (MārtaSÆa), the seventh (Śivāmbhoja) and the fourth (Devavaktrāmrta), these three belong, as before, to the Śrīsantānakula37 of which they are the eldest, middling and youngest (members, respectively).38 The leaders of the Siddhas, that is the lords of creation (srn˜inātha) and the others, have (thus) been declared in due order.39 (55cd-56) Their Command is very powerful. They do good and, fearless, they are intent on gracing and restraining. They give the nectar of liberation and worldly enjoyment to all the moving and immobile universe. Ecstatic with the inebriation of the wine of knowledge, their eyes roll with bliss. (57-58ab) Content with the bliss of their own essential nature, they are all said to bring about the accomplishment (siddhi) of (the goddess's) Command by virtue of (their) omniscience and (their) vibrant mind. (58cd-59ab) In each Age they will apply (themselves) on the plane of action (karmabhumi) on the surface of the earth to (observe) the penance (krcchra) called the Practice of Ecstatic Madness (unmattacaryā)40 by means of (their Kaula) practice (caryā). Wandering about they reached the auspicious Island of the Moon which, with all manner of wealth, is rich with jewels, gems and gold.41 (59cd-61ab)

english: CHAPTER FORTY-SIX 361 In the triangle within that City of Bliss42 that extends for seven furlongs (yojana), stand three auspicious monasteries (ma˜hikā). (61cd-62ab) Rich with the (powerful) light of the upper noonday sun they are full of knowledge and wisdom. ****** imperishable, they should be known in due order. (????) These Siddhas lived in them mighty with the power of Yoga and knowledge, intent on the sacred observance of the deity (anun˜hāna) for a hundred and one years. (62cd-64ab) The Legend of Siddhanātha continued 43Then, when spring began and the pleasure of winter had past, during the great festival of Harakāntā that falls on the third day of the bright fortnight of (the lunar month of) Caitra, the Supreme Lord, having marked himself with the practice of non-duality, entered the venerable city (śrīnagara) at twilight (raudrasandhyāˆśakāla)44 in the form of a mad man (unmattarūpa) to play (his spiritual games). The venerable Vrknanātha is well know by the name Gaganendra.45 He who is called Kūrma in this universe arrived at the boundary of the king’s palace.46 (64cd-67) The king Candrabimba47 had a daughter (called) Gaganāvatī. She was a virgin, (just) sixteen year old, endowed with beauty and youth, and (attended) by excellent men, women, eunochs, children and virgins.48 (68-69ab) Surrounded all around by (her) attributes (lakna), aspects (aˆśa) and the rest, that young woman mocked him (saying): “Who has come here? (His) practice is (that of demon) Piśācas and Ucchunmas (piśācocchunmacaryā) that makes the hair bristle intensely (with fear)!" When he heard (these words spoken in) jest (hāsya), he let out a sound eight times more frightening (than his appearance) and in half an instant, again disappeared. (69cd-71) The daughter of the wise king was astonished along with the citizens (who had seen him). Overcome with fear, her eyes agitated with confusion (vibhrama), she fainted. At night, trembling and her eyes tremulous (with fear), she fell asleep in the womens' apartment (antaƒpura). (72-73ab)
