english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 239 The three RAKAs, the letter Ra and the rest of the two Skulls of the Sun (ravi) and the Jewel (ratna). The part (pada) (of the mantra is completed by) the Skull of the letter Ra of the Skull which is the Skull of Vi. (32cd-33ab) Lampa˜ā — Lākinī The YakniSī of the Skull of the letter La is called Lampa˜ā. There are two letter Las and three along with word that is within it. Both VALĀMEKALA and LAKEMA,35 the Skull of the play of (the letter) La. (It is the) Terrible and Pure One, the Mark, and the Skull of (the letter) La, which is the supreme letter. (33cd-35ab) Karparī — Kākinī Karparī is the name of the Guhyakā of the Skull of the letter Ka. She has assumed the form of (the letter) Ka in the Wheel of the Practice of the Rule (samayācāracakra).36 The letter Ka whose form is the letter Ka, the letter Ka, and the Skull (karpara) in the (letter) Ka. (She is) the Kālī of Ka‰kālakāla (the Skeleton Time).37 (He is) the Bhairava of the nectar of the Skull. (35cd-37ab) Śavarī — Śākinī Śavarī born from the womb of a demon (daitya) (is the Yoginī) of the letter Śa. Having drunk blood in the course of battle, (take up) Mud and the Skull, then again Mud and Battle (placed) in the letter Sa thrice repeated and Ra. (Then come) A Ra Re and the letter Kha with the Skull located in the letter Kha. (37cd-39ab) Ha˜adūtī — Hākinī Ha˜adūtī is the deity of the Skull of the letter Ha.38 Ha˜anī is within the two Skulls in the letter Ha by the application of the Practice of the Night (niśācāra). (She is) the pentad of knowledge (jñānapañcaka) of the letter Ha. The Skull called Ha˜˜a is that of the letters Ha and µa. (39cd-41ab)

sanskrit: 240 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १९५ यकारस्य कपालस्य विरजामूर्तिमक्षरम् ।। ४१ ।। १९९ १९८ तच्च षट्सु प्रकारेण त्रिशूलस्य तु यच्छूल त्रिशूलाख्य कपालकम् । २०० २०४ २०२ त्रिशूल शूलयोः क्रमात् ।। ४२ ।। २०५ .२०६ रजोमध्ये ३ पुरं भित्त्वा त्रिशूल तु कपालकम् २०७ २०८ । सप्त देव्यः कपालं तु कपाल कपालं तु कपाल सप्तधा गतम् ।। ४३ । एका तु” सप्तधा भेदैः सप्तभिः सप्त संस्थिताः । २०९ •२११ २१२ २१० सप्तसप्तकलाग्रासं सप्तज्ञानशलाकया ।। ४४ ।। सप्तसप्तोपदेश”३ तु ज्ञात्वा सप्तकुलात्मकम् । सप्ताक्षरकुलाम्नायं”४ समुद्राम्नायमध्यगम् ।। ४५ ।। २१६ २१५ २१७ पिण्डाम्नायमशेषस्य पीठानां सप्त देवता:' । देवतानां च” कूटस्था बीजानां प्रणवादिषु २२४ २२० ।। ४६ ।। २२५ विद्यैका २१ भेदकी २२ शक्ति: २२३ सर्वग्रासा महाद्भुता । • २२६ २२७ २२८ ग्रासमध्यगतं ग्रासं ग्रासकूटमनेकधा ।। ४७ ।। एका सा२९ सप्तभिर्भिन्ना २३० ग्रासीकरणवल्लभा २३१ २३२ २३३ २३४ । करणाज्ञा परा व्याप्तिव्याप्तिः करणदृक्क्रिया ।। ४८ ।। करणज्ञानकर्तृत्वे करणं मलनिग्रहम् । २३६ २३७ २३८ निर्मलीकरणैकत्वे गुहाना गुहदेवता ।। ४९ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 241 Virajā — Yākinī The syllable of the of the Skull of the letter Ya is the form of Virajā. That is the Skull called the Trident which is in the six, (divided up according to) the part (of the maSÆala to which it belongs). (It consists of) the Spear of the Trident and the Trident of the two spears, in due order.39 Having broken through the abode in the middle of rajas, the Skull of the Trident (is formed). (41cd-43ab) The Skull consists of the seven goddesses. (Thus) the Skull has become sevenfold. (Similarly) the one (Yoginī) is sevenfold. Due to the seven divisions there are seven (Yoginīs). The seven times seven energies are consumed by the Scalpel of Knowledge40 of the seven. (43cd-44) Having known the teaching concerning the seven times seven, (one has understood) the teaching of the seven which is the Kula of the Seven. The teaching concerning the Kula of seven syllables is part of the teaching concerning the Ocean (of the maSÆala). The seven deities of the sacred seats are (part) of the teaching concerning the seed-syllable (which is the aggregate) of all of them (piSÆa).41 (45-46ab) (Essentially) there is (just) one Vidyā who is the energy that divides up (the mantras) (bhedakī) and, greatly astonishing, devours all things. She resides in the Peak (syllables of all) the deities and in the PraSavas and rest of the seed- syllables. (46-47ab) (The act of) devouring (and absorbing these energies into the Vidyā) is a part of the (process) of devouring (and absorption of all the other energies of the mantras of the Krama). The (one) Peak (syllable) that consumes (all the others) (grāsakū˜a) is of many kinds. (47cd) She, (the Vidyā of absorption, the goddess) Grāsā (the Devouring One) who delights in the process of absorption (grāsīkaraSa), is one divided by the seven. The Command of the (these) instruments (of mantra) is supreme pervasion and pervasion is the knowledge and action of the instruments (of mantra).42 (48) The instrument (of mantra) supresses impurity through the agency of the knowledge of the instrument (of mantra). When the instruments are one (the yogi realises the) Deity of the Cave of the Caves.43 (49)

sanskrit: 242 २३९ २४० कुमारिकाखण्ड: गुह्यगुहाप्रकाशेन ९ गुहैका पारमेश्वरी । २४२ गुहानन्दः” कलानन्दः २ आनन्दौघो हि आज्ञया २४४ २४५ विज्ञानममृतं काल: कलाविज्ञानसप्तभिः । २४७ २४८ २४९ देव्यः २४६ सप्त कला: सप्त ं गृहाः २५० २४३ ॥ ५० ॥ २५१ सप्त शलाकया ।। ५१ ।। तेषां बोधविकासेन १५२ विकास : २५३ सप्तमे २५४ पदे २५७ - २५५ २५८ विकास५६ सप्तधानन्दं विकासास्वादरश्मयः ।। ५२ ।। रश्मयौघकला ह्यष्टौ २५९ अष्टावेका २६० परा २११ कला । कलाविकलविज्ञान१२ कलनज्ञानसागरम् ॥ ५३ ॥ २६४ २६३ २६५ सागरान्तर्गता शक्तिर्महाशक्ति: षडिः स्मृता २६९ २६६ । २७० षडिः षट्क६७ षडि:२६८ पञ्च षडिः पञ्चविधा कला ।। ५४ ।। २७३ षड्यार्णवा षडिमात्रा७१ षड्भिर्मात्रोपदेशकम् । २७५ शिवाज्ञा शिवमध्यस्था शिवविज्ञानभूमिका ॥ ५५ ॥ २७६ २७८ शिवतन्तुकलात्मा स शिवः षट्त्रिंशदेवता' । २७९ २८२ षडि: षट्त्रिंशभेदानि मुद्रा षट्त्रिंशभेदिता व्याप्तितत्त्वं षडात्मानं८३ बोधषट्कविकासकम् । २८६ २८४ ।। ५६ ।। घटमध्यस्थिता मुद्रा सा च सप्त प्रकारतः ।। ५७ ।। २८७ त्रिप्रकाराक्षरव्याप्तिर्मुद्रैका व्यापयेज्जगत् । जगद्व्याप्तिकरी विद्या षोडशस्वरदीपिता विज्ञाने २९९ चेच्छया शक्ति: २९२ शक्तिभेदस्त्रिभेदतः २९४ २९५ ।। ५८ ।। २९३ । त्रिषु सा त्रिविधा शक्तिस्त्रिगुणाक्षरदीपिता ॥ ५९ ॥ त्रीणि भावा विकासेऽपि विकासेऽपि विकासानन्दभैरवी | २९६ २९८
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 243 The Cave of the Supreme Goddess is the one (reality illumined) by the light of the Cave of the Yoni (guhyaguhā).44 1) The bliss of the cave, 2) the bliss of the energies (kalā), 3) the current of bliss, along with 4) the (the goddess's) Command, 5) knowledge (vijñāna), 6) nectar and 7) time are the seven (aspects) of the knowledge of the (Deity’s) energies (kalāvijñāna). (50-51ab) The goddesses are seven,45 the energies are seven, the houses (grha) are seven46 along with the scalpel (of the seed-syllables of the seven).47 They expand on the seventh plane by the expansion of awakened consciousness.48 (51cd-2ab) (This) expansion is sevenfold bliss.49 (It consists of) the rays of the aesthetic savour (āsvāda) of expansion. There are eight energies of the current of (these) rays. The eight (together constitute) the one supreme energy. The knowledge of the permutations (vikalavijñāna) of the energies is the process of manifestation (kalana) of the ocean of consciousness (jñānasāgara).50 (52cd-53) The power within the ocean (of the Yoni) is the great power known as the (goddess) ±aÆi (the Six). The Six is (this) group of six. The Six is the fivefold energy.51 The Six is the ocean (of the Yoni). The Six is the measure (of energy) (mātrā).52 The teaching concerning the measure is by means of the six. (54-55ab) Śiva's Command is within Śiva and is the plane of Śiva's consciousness (vijñānabhūmikā), which is the thread of Śiva's energies. He is Śiva, the deity of the thirty-six. There are thirty-six divisions of the Six and Gesture is divided into thirty-six. The principle of pervasion (vyāptitattva) is the essential nature of the six and expands the group of six (energies) of awakened consciousness (bodhana˜ka).53 (55cd-57ab) (The goddess) Mudrā (Gesture) is within the jar (on the maSÆala)54 and she is seven in accord with the parts (of the maSÆala) (prakārataƒ). The one (goddess) Gesture, who is the pervasion of the syllable (of the Triangle) in three parts (triprakāra),55 pervades the universe. The Vidyā, illumined by the sixteen vowels, engenders the pervasion of the universe. (57cd-58) Again, in accord with (her) desire, power resides within consciousness (vijñāna). This form of power (śaktibheda) (is such) because it is divided into three. Within the three that power is of three kinds; it has three qualities and is illumined by the syllable of the three qualities. There are three states of being in the process of expansion also, (wherein the goddess) Bhairavī of the bliss of expansion (resides). (59-60ab)

sanskrit: 244 ३०० कुमारिकाखण्ड: वीरमार्गेण १९९ ये वीरा मातृचक्रसमुद्भवाः ३०२ द्वीपसिद्धा द्वीपमुद्रा: २ षट्कस्य प्रथमं कुलम् कुलक्रमं च विद्या च कुलक्रमत्रयान्वयम् ३०५ ३०३ ३०८ ॥ ६० ॥ । । ।। ६१ ।। आम्नाये॰६ भैरवानन्दश्चक्रस्थो मातृमध्यगः । ३१० ३१२ मातॄणां मध्यमा माता मातृविद्या च खिङ्खिणी २ ।। ६२ ।। खिड्डिणी १३ षड्विधा भेदैर्मुद्रैषा कामरूपिणी । •३१७ ३१८ मातृचक्रस्य चक्रस्य मातॄणां रतिशेखरम् ।। ६३ ।। शेखरान्ते च कैलास कैलासे” मातृमण्डलम् । मातरीणां े २२ च मेलापं भवत्योद्यानपीठके ॥ ६४ ॥ ३२४ ३२३ ३२७ तत्रस्थाः ४ कामयेद् २५॥ देव्या २५b भेदव्या: २६ सप्त मातर: मातरीणां १२८ च सर्वासां ९ योगिन्यष्टशलाकया' ॥ ६५ ॥ ३३० मण्डले भेदका ३३१ शक्ति: शक्तिर्विद्या शक्तिः शक्तिर्विद्या ३२ च कौलिकी । कौलिकी”” कुलमध्यस्था' कौलज्ञानविकासकी सा३३६ चोदयप्रभेदेन जायते परवासना ३३७ । ३३५ ॥ ६६ ॥ वासनान्ते३८ मनोमाया मायान्तेन” पुटीकृता ।। ६७ ।। एकीभूतप्रकारेण वासनान्ते मनोन्मना ३४३ ३४२ । ३४५ ।। ६८ ।। प्रकारोऽयं समाख्यातः प्रकार:४४ षट्स्वरूपतः ।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 245 The Heroes who, by the Heroes' Path have been arisen in the Wheel of the Mothers, are the Siddhas and the Gestures of the Islands. (They are) first (and foremost) the Kula of the group of six, that is, the Kulakrama, the Vidyā and the tradition (anvaya) of the three Kulakramas.56 (60cd-61) The Eight Yoginīs Khi‰khinī Bhairava's bliss57 within the tradition (āmnāya)58 is within the Wheel in the midst of the Mothers. The Mother who is in the middle of the Mothers is Khi‰khiSī, the Vidyā of the Mothers. (62) Khi‰khiSī is of six kinds due to (her) varieties. This Gesture is Passion by nature (kāmarūpiSī). She is the peak of sexual pleasure (ratiśekhara) of the group of Mothers of the Wheel of the Mothers. (63) Kailāsa is at the summit of the peak and the Circle of the Mothers is within Kailāsa.59 The union of the Mothers takes place in the sacred seat of Udyāna. (64) One should desire the goddesses who reside there. They are the Seven Mothers60 who should be (discerned and) differentiated (from one another) by means of the Scalpel of all the Mothers, that is, (the mantra) of the eight Yoginīs. (65) She is the power who divides up (the parts) within the maSÆala and is the Kaulikī Vidyā. Residing in the midst of the Kula, she is Kaulikī who brings about the expansion of the knowledge of the Kula. (66) Õākinī — Nirodhinī She becomes the Supreme Will (vāsanā) by the differentiation of the arising (of the energy of consciousness). The Māyā of the mind comes at the end of the Will and is encapsulated by the end of Māyā.61 (67) In its unified aspect (prakāra), it is Mind Beyond Mind at the end of the Will. This said to be the part (prakāra) (of the maSÆala) and is sixfold. (68)

sanskrit: 246 ३४७ कुमारिकाखण्ड: एवं च षड्विधो ह्यात्मा ँ गुणत्रयनिरोधितः निरोधनी९ तदा शक्तिर्डकाराम्बा व्यवस्थिता ३४८ ३५१ ' ।। ६९ ।। ३५३ आहोरात्रगतिमीया५२ घण्टवत् तिष्ठते सदा । तदा घण्टालका ४ शक्ति: ३५५ रकारादिः ३५६ प्रकीर्तिता ।। ७० । ३५८ उदयास्तमनैकत्वे शकारा सा च ५९ शांकरी ३६० । ३६२ तदा षट्कौशिका शक्तिर्लकारादिव्यवस्थिता ।। ७१ ।। उभयोः ३ परमानन्दा गतिरागतिभेदकी ३६४ । तदा सा ३६५ भेदकी ३६६ शक्ति: ३६७ ककारादिव्यवस्थिता बोधिनी षडिमुद्रायाः षडात्मानन्दविग्रहा । ३७० ३७१ तदा सानन्दकौमारी प्रकारादिविभञ्जनी ॥ ७३ ॥ ३६८ ।। ७२ ।। ३७४ ३७५ गुदमेढ्रान्तरे प्राण: ७३ प्राणान्ते भैरवोदयः । ३७७ ३७९ तदा चोद्घाटनी नाम हकारादिषु व्यापिका ।। ७४ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 247 In this way, the Self is sixfold and is blocked (nirodhita) by the three qualities. Then the power which blocks (nirodhanī) is established as the Mother who is the letter Õa.62 (69) Rākinī — GhaS˜ālakā The dynamic state of Māyā is night and day (and resounds) constantly like a bell. Then the energy (called) Gha˜ālakā is said to be the letter Ra and the rest. (70) Śākinī — Śā‰karī The letter Śa is (the energy present) in the oneness of arising and falling away and she is Śā‰karī.63 (71ab) Lākinī — ±a˜kauśikā Then (comes) the energy (called) ±a˜kauśikā (Six Sheaths) who is established as the letter La and the rest. (71cd) Kākinī — Bhedakī Then (that energy arises which) divides (bhedakī) the ‘coming and going’ (of energy from the transcendental Void and back to it) and is the supreme bliss of both. She is the power Bhedakī (the Divider),64 who is established as the letter Ka and the rest. She awakens the six Gestures and her form is the bliss of (the maSÆala) that consists of six (parts). Then that virgin bliss (ānandakaumarī) divides the parts and the rest (of the maSÆala). (72-73) Hākinī — Udghā˜anī The vital breath is (located) between the anus and the sexual organ. Bhairava arises at the end of the vital breath. Then (she is the power) called Udghā˜anī (She Who Unlocks) that pervades within the letter Ha and the rest.65 (74)

sanskrit: 248 कुमारिकाखण्डः ३८० ३८२ व्यापकान्ते मनो यच्च या चर माया त्रिधा भवेत् । ३८४ तदा सा त्रिगुणा रौद्री यकारादिव्यवस्थिता ।। ७५ ।। । ३८७ भगमध्ये ३८६ भगाशक्तिर्भगमध्ये भगाकृतिः । ३८८ भगानन्दोद्भवा शक्तिर्भगविग्रहव्यापिनी ।। ७६ ।। ३९१ व्याप्तिभावः” कलाव्याप्तिव्याप्तिः खे च त्रिधा९२ भवेत् । त्रिधा च ९४ पञ्चधा मार्गे ३९५ तदा मार्गविकासिनी ३९९ ३९६ मार्ग ९७ षट्कोणभुवन८ मार्ग ९ षट्कोणगोलकम् । ।। ७७ ।। ४०३ मठमध्ये” डकाराख्या डामयी क्षेत्रपार्वतीँ ।। ७८ ।। पर्वतोदरमध्यस्था अध्वशृङ्गाटभञ्जनी' । ४०४ विभज्य भगमात्मानं मनसः क्षोभकारकम् ।। ७९ ।। ४०७ सिंहकारणकर्तृत्वे कर्तृत्वे' सिंहकद्वयम् ४११ । द्वयं द्वयं विभागेन” लकारपुरविग्रहम् ।। ८० ॥ लकारान्ते यदात्मानं ४१२ निरासपदमुज्झितम् ४१३ ।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 249 Yākinī — Raudrī The mind is at the end of the pervasive one as is the threefold Māyā. Then she is Raudrī who consists of the three qualities and is established in the letter Ya and the rest. (75) The power Bhagā (the goddess Yoni) is in the middle of the Yoni (bhaga).66 In the middle of the Yoni (her) form is that of the Yoni (bhagākrti). She is the power who is generated from the bliss of the Yoni and pervades the form of the Yoni.67 (76) (This is) 1) the condition of pervasion (vyāptibhāva), 2) the pervasion of the energies (kalāvyāpti) and 3) pervasion in the Void (kha): (thus pervasion is) of three sorts. Then (when that energy is in this way) threefold and fivefold on the path, then (that power) unfolds the Path. The Path (mārga) is the World of the Hexagram (na˜koSabhuvana).68 The Path is the Ball (golaka) of the Hexagram. 69 (77-78ab) The Five Yoginīs Õāmaryā Õāmaryā, who is called the letter Õa, which is within the monastery (ma˜ha), is the mountain goddess of the field (knetrapārvatī). Situated within the belly of the Mountain,70 she splits apart the Triangle of the (cosmic) Path (adhvan), once (she has) split apart her own Yoni that arouses (knobhakāraka) the mind.71 (78cd-79) Lākinī Two Lions are within agency when the agency of the Lion who is (the universal) cause (is operant). The form of the abode of the letter La (is formed) by division into parts, two by two. The Self within the letter La is free of the plane of destruction (nirāsapada).72 (80-81ab)

sanskrit: 250 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४१७ ४१४ ४१५ •४१६ या शक्तिरुदितानन्दा सकारं शिलशेखरम् ॥ ८१ ॥ शिलाशेखरयोर्मध्ये या ९ च रण्डा ह्यधोमुखी । ४२० सिंहकं विपरीतेन सकार४२ सिंहसंज्ञया ४२३ ।। ८२ ।। -४३१ ४३२ ४२८ । या ४२४ शक्ति: ४२५ पद्मगर्भस्था ४२६ हंसिनी ४२७ योगदेवता योगात्मनो४२९ विपाकस्य आज्ञाक्षरं हकारकम् ॥। ८३ ।। यकारान्तर्गता शक्तिर्हंसमध्योदर भगम् । •४३४ ४३५ भगवद्” मेरुगात्मानं यकार४८ भगवच्छिवम् ॥ ८४ ॥ ४४० ” एवं क्लिन्नात्मिका शक्ति: सृष्ट्यार्थे पञ्चधा३ गता । गमागमविभेदज्ञा रौद्री देवी तथा भवेत् ॥ ८५ ॥ ४४४ ४४५ ४४६ -४५० । या च४७ रौद्री भवेन्माया४८ सा४९ वामामृतसुष्मना सुषुम्ना सा स्मृता ज्येष्ठा ज्येष्ठास्थानप्रभञ्जनी ५२ ॥ ८६ ॥ भञ्जनी४५३ नाम ५४ उद्दिष्टा ५५ भगवर्णे४५६ व्यवस्थिता । रजोमध्ये विलीनत्वात् रजः शक्तिर्निपातनी -४५९ ।। ८७ ।। ४६३ निपातस्य तु चोत्पातं? विद्योत्तमेन सिद्ध्यति । ४६४ ४६५ षडारपद्मपत्रस्थाः “ षट्पत्रा: षडिदेवताः •४६८ ४६६ मात्रान्ते४७ यत् परं पत्रं तत्पत्र वाडवीमुखम् ।। ८८ ।। ४६९ । तदा तुष्टिः स्मृतो योग: योगी स्मरति भैरवम् ७२ ॥ ८९ ॥ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 251 Śākinī — RaSÆā The power which is active bliss is the letter Sa, which is the Peak (śekhara) of the Stone (śilā). The (goddess) RaSÆā (the Courtesan), who is between the Stone and the Peak, faces downwards.73 By reversing (her she becomes) the Lion who is the letter Sa, which is called the Lion.74 (81cd-82) Hākinī — Haˆsinī The power who is in the (Point which is the) womb of the Lotus75 is Haˆsinī (the female Gander), the deity of Yoga. The syllable of the Command of the process of the maturation (of Karma) which is Yoga is the letter Ha. The power within the letter Ha is the Yoni (bhaga) which is the womb (udara) within the Gander.76 (83-84ab) Yākinī — Raudrī Like the Yoni (bhaga), the Self is within Meru and, like the Yoni, the letter Ya is (Śiva) the Auspicious One. (84cd) In this way, the wet (klinnā) power77 has become fivefold in order to create. Such is the goddess Raudrī78 who knows the divisions (within) the going and coming (of the energy of the goddess). (85) Raudrī is Māyā. She is Vāmā who is gracious (sunmaSā) with nectar. She is SunumSā who is said to be Jyen˜hā, while the one who shatters the abode of Jyen˜hā is called Bhañjanī (Hurricane), who resides in (Vāgbhava) the letter of the Yoni (bhagavarSa).79 (86-87ab) She is merged within rajas and so (she is) the power of rajas that throws down (the ignorant). The elevation of one who has fallen is achieved by the best of Vidyās.80 (87cd-88ab) The six deities are the six petals of the six-petelled lotus. The supreme petal, which is at the end of the measures (mātrā) (of energies), is the Doomsday Fire (vāÆavīmukha). Then Yoga is said to be satisfaction and the yogi recollects Bhairava.81 (87cd-89)

sanskrit: 252 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४७३ भैरवस्य तु पीठस्य या मूर्तिर्वीरविक्रमा । वीरचर्याीनियोगेन ४७४ •४७७ वीरोऽमल: ४७५ स्थितोऽनघ ४७९ ४७६ ।। ९० ।। उत्थानं कौलिकी ४८ शक्तिः सा च ऊकारसंज्ञया ४८१ ४८० । एका मध्यमा ज्ञेया ८२ ए- ऊ—–वर्णात्मिका ए– ऊ—– वर्णात्मिका८३ क्रिया ।। ९९ ।। ए–ऊ–ऊध्वगता तिस्रे रेफात्मानं पुटीकृतम् । ४८८ ४८५ •४८९ ४९० परमध्यगतांकारं ऊकार शक्ति: सप्तधा ।। ९२ ।। ४९३ सप्तधा योजयेद्” योगं सप्तानां भुवनाकृतिः । आकृतिविकृति: सप्त तदा १५ तत् खेचर पदम् ४९४ ४९५ खमध्ये च खगीशस्य ”” खगीशस्थ च मण्डलम् । ५०३ ०५०५ । ४९८ ॥ ९३ ॥ स्थान” च संपुट॰२ तस्य ज्ञात्वा वै०४ शाश्वतं “ पदम् ।। ९४ ।। चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधस्य यकारों यकारो यत्र तिष्ठति ५१० -५०८ । विद्धशक्तिप्रभावेण सा शक्ति ऋजु जायते ।। ९५ ।। ५११ १२ ५१३ तदा“”” चोत्पद्यतेऽवस्था” धुननावेशकम्पनम् । चलन १४ च पदव्याप्तिरवस्था चेति पञ्चधा ।। ९६ ।। अवस्था प्रत्ययोत्पत्ति: १६ उत्पत्तिरिति यकारे १८ प्रेरणस्थान १९ तदा क्षुभ्यति •५२१ पञ्चधा । कौलिकम् ।। ९७ ।। कौलीश बिन्दुनादाख्यं नादबिन्दुविसर्गयोः ५१२ । तस्यापि ३ शक्तिबीजं तु बीजशक्तिस्त्रिधा भवेत् ।। ९८ ।। ५२५ •५२६ त्रिधा देवमशेषस्य २ ठकार यस्तु पश्यति । कलाशेषविलीनत्वात् तदा हंसगतिर्भवेत् ॥ ९९ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 253 The form (mūrti) of Bhairava's sacred seat is the (energy which is the) valour Heroes possess. O sinless one, by applying the Conduct of Heroes (vīracaryā),82 the Hero abides devoid of impurities. (90) 1) The upward expansion (utthāna) is the power Kaulikī and she is termed the letter Ū. 2) One should know that the middle (energy) is in the letter E (and that 3) the energy of) action is the letter E and Ū. 4) (The energy) that is above E and Ū is in (the sacred seat of) Tisra (where) 5) the Self which is (the letter) Ra has been encapsulated. 6) The letter A¤ is in the centre of the supreme and 7) the letter U is the sevenfold energy.83 (91-92) One should apply the sevenfold Yoga. The seven have the form of the world.84 Form85 and (its) mutation are seven. Then (one attains) the plane of the Skyfarer.86 (93) The maSÆala within Khagīśa (the Lord of Skyfarers) is that of Khagīśa and it is in the middle of the Sky (of consciousness).87 Having known his abode, encapsulated (in the Void) (one attains) the eternal plane. (94) That energy straightens under the influence of the power (of consciousness) that has been penetrated (by mantra)88 where the letter Ya, (associated with) the checking of the fluctuations of the mind, is established.89 (95) Then that state arises (which is attended by) shaking, possession, trembling, motion and pervasion of the plane (of ultimate reality). Thus (that) state is fivefold. (96) (This) state is (that of the) emergence of the signs of attainment and this emergence is fivefold. The locus of impulse is in the letter Ya. Then (when its energy arises) the Kaula (reality) (kaulika) is aroused. (97) Kaulīśa is called the Point and Sound of the emissions (visarga) of the Sound and the Point.90 His seed (syllable) is that of Power and the power of the seed-syllable is threefold.91 (98) Then, because all the energies have dissolved away, he who sees the threefold god of all, the letter µha,92 (attains) the state (gati) of the Gander. (99)

sanskrit: 254 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ५२८ ५३० भुवनस्य तु हंसस्य उदरे २९ प्रथमा कला । सा च चण्डा २ अमा नाम उमा``` बोधप्रकाशिनी ॥ ३३ ।। १०० ।। ५३६ संबोधन ३४ तु कौलस्य उदये ३५ षट्सु देवता' । ५३८ .५४० देवता च ३७ गुहाम्नाये सापि षट्सु प्रकारतः ५४१ ॥ १०१ ॥ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे ४२ अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलभेदोत्तरषट्कनिर्णये ४३ कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अम्बाक्रमभाषिते आज्ञाषट्कभूमिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। ६३ ।। ०५४४
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-THREE 255 In the womb (udara) of the World of the Gander93 is the first energy and she is the fierce one (caSÆā) called Amā, (the goddess) Umā who reveals awakened consciousness. (100) It is the awakening of Kaula and, in its arising, it is the deity within the six. And the deity of the teachings of the Cave is also within the six in accord with the parts (of the maSÆala) (prakārataƒ).94 (101) This is the (sixty-third) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description of the Plane of the Hexad of the Command. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It is on the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha) and is the ultimate purport of the Subsequent Six Thousand (verses) of the Pure Division (vimalabhedottarana˜ka) in the division beginning with `KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (ambākrama).

sanskrit: चतुःषष्टानन्दः श्रीवक्रा उवाच' विमलस्य अशेषस्य पञ्चकस्य' त्रिकस्य' च । भूमिकासंप्रदायोऽय अधुना संप्रगीयते ॥ १ ॥ विमलानां तु विश्राम ँ आक्रान्तकरणालयम् । o ११ आलयं विमलात्मानं विमलं पञ्चधा स्मृतम् ॥ २ ॥ तेषा ं च विमला शक्ति: भेदं विमलसंज्ञया¨ । संज्ञाविमलभेदेन विमलं मण्डलक्रमम् ।। ३ ॥ विमलं मण्डल” नाम विमलवृक्षसंज्ञया । पञ्चभेदप्रकारेण तदा विमलरूपिणी ।। ४॥ विमल” पञ्चधा भिन्नं भिन्ना” शक्तिस्तु पञ्चधा । परमात्मा द्विभिर्भेदैर्भगाना विधिविग्रहे ॥ ५ ॥ २३ आसीदनाद्यनन्तानां” अनादिविमलाज्ञया । २६ आज्ञापञ्चकभेदेन विमल पञ्च उदीरितम् ॥ ६ ॥ ससंज्ञाविमलात्मानं सर्वज्ञ शशिशेखरम्” । शेखरं सर्वमात्मानं आत्मानं सर्वसंज्ञया ।। ७ ।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR The Plane of the Pentad and the Triad The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: The tradition concerning the plane (bhūmikā) (which is the inner meaning) of the Triad (trika) and the entire Pentad of the Pure (vimala) (mantras) will now be extolled. (1) The Pure Pentad (vimalapañcaka)1 The repose2 of the Pure Ones is the abode of the (five) instruments (of mantra) that have been (progressively) traversed (ākrānta).3 (That) abode is the Pure One who is said to be fivefold. (2) Their pure (vimalā) power is the aspect (bheda) that is called the Pure One. The transmission (krama) of the maSÆala is pure by virtue of the division of the convention (referring to) the Pure One.4 (3) The maSÆala is the Pure One (also). It is called the Pure Tree.5 (Its power) is pure by virtue of the fivefold division. (4) The Pure One is divided fivefold and (its) power is (similarly) fivefold. By virtue of the two categories (bheda),6 the Supreme Soul is within the maSÆala (vidhivigraha)7 of the Yonis (bhaga). (5) Anādivimala — the Pure One Without Beginning By the beginningless and pure Command of the ones without beginning8 and end the one called the Pure One is said to be five due to the the division of the pentad of the Command. (6) Sarvajñavimala — The Omniscient Pure One The Pure Self called ‘Sa’ is the omniscient one and the Summit which is the Moon (śaśiśekhara). The Summit is all things and the Self which is called the All.9 (7)

sanskrit: 258 ३१ सर्वसंहारवेत्ता यो” ज्ञानरश्मिप्रकाशक : ' ३४ ३५ कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३२ । ३६ प्रकाशो निर्मलानन्द एकपादः शिखिध्वजः ॥ ८ ॥ शिखिध्वजध्वजा ँ शक्तिः अहिच्छत्रध्वजामृतम्” । पताकाध्वजमध्यस्थः” प्रजानां अमरात्मकः ॥ ९ ॥ •४० ४१ ध्वजमध्ये ध्वजा शक्तिः सा च रौद्री मनोन्मना । उन्मना पञ्चभेदैस्तु” सर्वज्ञेति च संज्ञया ।। १० ॥ शिखिश्चन्द्रकलाज्योति:“ ज्योति: शिखरशेखरम्” । शेखरे“ शेखरानन्दः” शिखर पञ्चधा गतम्” ।। ११ ।। ५२ ५३ शिखरे पञ्चधा व्याप्ति: अध्वर शिखरालयम् । आलयं मलयाकार मलयात्मकपञ्चकम् ॥ १२ ॥ ५७ पञ्चकात्मानुभूतार्थं विभूतिः शिवशासनम् । शासनं पुष्कलानन्त विकलाक्षीणवर्जितः ।। १३ ॥ ६५ विरामो रमणानन्दो सर्वदा निर्भयः शुभः । ६७ शासनं वेधनत्यागात् विबुद्धः करणेन्द्रियः ॥ १४ ॥ आत्मानवेन“ शृङ्गस्य आराम कल्पसागरम् । सागरस्य मनः सेतुरावलीसेतुबन्धकः ।। १५ ।। ७२ पञ्चत्रयप्रयोगेण” संयोगनिधनोभयोः २ । ३ विभवानन्दसारस्य ं तदासौ पञ्चकं भवेत् ।। १६ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 259 The one who knows (the nature of) universal destruction illumines (prakāśaka) the rays of knowledge. The light (prakāśa) is pure bliss, the One- footed (E), the one whose flag is Fire (śikhidhvaja).10 (8) Power is the Flag (dhvajā) of the one whose flag is Fire. It is the nectar of the Flag which is the Umbrella of the Snake (ahichatra).11 The one who is in the middle of the Flag (dhvaja) of the Banner (patāka) is the immortal Self of (all) living beings. (9) The power of the Flag (dhvajāśakti) is in the centre of the Flag. She is Raudrī who is Mind beyond Mind. (This power), the Transmental (unmanā), along with (its) five divisions, is called the Omniscient.12 (10) 1) Fire, 2) the Light of the digit of the Moon, 3) the Light, 4) the Peak of the Summit (śikharaśekhara), and 5) the Bliss of the Summit within the Summit - (thus) the Summit (śikhara) has become fivefold.13 (11) 1) The fivefold Pervasion in the Summit, 2) the Path and 3) the Abode of the Summit, 4) the Abode, 5) the Form of Malaya - (this is) the Pentad of Malaya. (12) The glorious power (vibhūti) which is the teaching of the Śaiva (scripture) is the reality (artha) experienced by the one who is the Pentad. The teaching is copious and, without end, it is free of defects and decay. (13) Repose is the Bliss of Sport (ramaSānanda). It is always free of fear and auspicious. Abandoning (the lower Wheels) by piercing (the Wheels through the upward motion of KuSÆalinī), the Teaching (manifests to) the awakened organs of the senses. (14) By means of the boat of the Self (one attains) the repose14 of the Summit and the Ocean of the Aeons. The Mind (manas) is the Bridge (that crosses over) the Ocean. It is the Bridge (setubandhaka)15 over the series of energies (āvalī). (15) By applying the three (groups of) five of both union and (its) termination then that group of five of the essence of the bliss of emanation (arises). (16)

sanskrit: 260 ७७ •७८ कुमारिकाखण्ड: ८० पशुशृण्ङ्गत्रये लक्षं अलक्ष” विरजो रजः । ८२ आप्यायनमशेषस्य” विमलं पञ्चरात्रिकम् ॥ १७ ॥ विमल“” पञ्चरात्रस्य पञ्जरं पञ्चरात्रिकम्” । त्रिरात्रिचतुःपदाकाश”” तदावृतोऽभिजायते ।। १८ ॥ स्वमन्त्रज्ञानदेहस्थं ँ रसनावलिसंज्ञया“ । ९० एवं बन्धतमा” शक्ति: दुर्विज्ञा त्रिवलीबलात् ॥ १९ ॥ विलीना” सर्वसत्त्वानां मन्त्राणाममितौजसाम्¨ । एका योनिः कुलेच्छा या विमलभेदसंज्ञया ँ ।। २० ।। ९८ ९९ १०० कूटा: पञ्च” कला: पञ्च बीजपञ्चाक्षराणि वै । संयोगमुपचर्याया” अनादिरिति पञ्चकम् ।। २१ ।। पञ्चपञ्चकपञ्चाना' पञ्चपञ्चकलावुभौ । विज्ञेय६ मन्त्रसद्भाव दृढपक्षकर तु यत् ।। २२ ।। ११० आधार: सर्ववणीना देहिनामालयोद्धृतः ११५ ११२ । उद्धृत३ ज्ञानषट्कस्य पञ्चपञ्चकभेदतः ।। २३ ।। ११८ अभेद्यभेदको १६ देव:१७ भेदभेदकशक्त्ययोः । १२१ परानन्द”” क्रियानन्दमानन्द पञ्चधागतम् ।। २४ ॥ १२३ अधरा नादिफान्तश्च” अन्तरश्चतुरः पदः । पदत्रयसमैकत्वे पदवृक्ष त्रयात्मकम् ।। २५ ।। तूष्णिमेकाक्षराकाश विकास शिखराजितम् । तत्रस्था विमलाशक्तिर्जडानुक्षोभकरी” स्मृता ।। २६ ।। १२७
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 261 The mark (lakna) is within the Three Horns of the fettered soul, the one without a mark (alakna), the dust and without dust - the Pure One belonging to the Five Nights is the act of nourishing (āpyāyana) all things. (17) The Pure One of the Five Nights is the cage of the Five Nights. The Three Nights, the Void of the Four-footed - then he becomes enveloped (thus). (18) Located within one's own body of the consciousness of mantra (mantrajñāna), it goes by the name the ‘Lineage of the Tongue’ (rasanāvali). Thus, due to the strength of the three enclosures, it is hard to know the power that is the greatest bondage. (19) She is merged in all living being and in the mantras of unlimited vitality. She is the one Yoni, the will of Kula who is called the Pure Division. (20) The five Peak (syllables), the five energies, the five letters of the seed- syllables, the Conjunction within Worship and the Beginningless - (this) is the Pentad. (21) Both of the two (groups of) five pentads of the five (groups of) five pentads should be known to be the essence of mantra that renders (each) polarity (pakna) firm. (22) The foundation of all the letters is extracted from the abode of (all) embodied beings. (As such it is) the extraction of the Hexad of Knowledge16 conjoined with the five pentads. (23) Bliss has become fivefold as the 1) Lord (deva) who is the indivisible divider (of the letters) of 2, 3) the powers pertaining to division and the divider, 4) Supreme Bliss and 5) the Bliss of Action. (24) The supports, (the Mālinī order of the alphabet that) commences with Na and ends with Pha and the fourth part (pāda) in the middle (?) - when the three words are (united) equally in a unity, the Tree of the Parts is threefold.17 (The essence of that is) the Void of the single syllable (Vidyā related to) TūnSi, which is expansion, radiant with the flame (of its higher developments).18 The pure (vimalā) power, which is said to arouse the insentient, is located there.19 (25-26)

sanskrit: 262 १३१ कुमारिकाखण्ड: एवं तूष्णिः पर पिण्डं पिण्डमेकाक्षराक्षरम् १३३ १३७ विहङ्ग४ पक्षमध्यस्थ हत्रिक तूष्णिमण्डलम् ।। २७ ।। एवं संक्षेपतोद्देश हकारत्रयपञ्चकम् । १३९ षडि:४० सप्ताष्टनवभिर्नवाष्टादशभेदतः ॥ २८ ॥ विपरीतक्रिया यत्र विपरीतपदात् पदम् । १४४ १४५ १४२ १४३ पदाः' पदाक्षराः पञ्च पदमेकाक्षराक्षरम् १४९ ।। २९ ।। अक्षरैक४७ च जीव४८ त विसर्गकलयायुतम् । अजितं परमं बीजं अन्तिम आदिपञ्चकम्॥ ३० ॥ आदिपञ्चकनिर्मुक्त५३ मध्ये ४ पञ्चविभूषितम् । १५७ अन्तपञ्चकपञ्चस्थ पञ्चविंशाक्षर पदम् ।। ३१ ।। १५९ पदपञ्चक्रमाचार वामाचार च दक्षिणम् । दक्षिणं पश्चिमाचार° पश्चिमं सर्वतो लयम् ।। ३२ ।। । लयालयमथैकत्वात्” दुर्विज्ञमुच्यते पदम् । सर्व१६३ पञ्चप्रकारेण पश्चिमं पञ्चधा गतम् ।। ३३ ॥ पञ्च वै पञ्चधा४ पिण्डं दक्षिणं पञ्चधा गतम् ' १६५ । पञ्चधा पूर्वक पिण्ड पिण्डक च चतुर्विधम् ॥ ३४ ॥ चर्तुधी कथितं मार्ग सिद्धमार्ग चतुर्विधम् । चतुधीज्ञाविकासेन स्वभावानन्दकौलिकम् ।। ३५ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 263 In this way TūnSi is the supreme aggregate (of letters) (piSÆa). The aggregate is the syllable of the single syllable (Vidyā) (AI¤). (It is) the Bird in the middle of the polarities (of the breath). It is TūnSi's maSÆala consisting of three (letter) Has. Such, in brief, is the teaching concerning the pentad of the three letter Has. (27-28ab) Six, along with seven, eight and nine (i.e. twenty four), conjoined with nine, eight and ten (i.e. twenty-seven) - the part (pada) (of the mantra is formed) from the part (uttered) in the reverse order where (the blissful and liberating) reverse action (viparītakriyā) (of KuSÆalinī takes place).20 (28cd-29ab) The parts (of the Vidyā) (pada) and the letters of the parts are five. (Along with them is another) part consisting of the letter of the single-syllabled (Vidyā). That one letter is the living being (jīva) conjoined with the energy of Emission (visargakalā).21 (29cd-30ab) (This is) the supreme, unconquered seed (syllable), the last and the first pentad. Free of the first pentad, in the centre it is adorned with the five. (30cd-31ab) The part (of the Vidyā) located in the five of the last pentad consists of twenty-five syllables. The five parts are the practice of the Krama (kramācāra). (They are the practice of) the left and the right. (The practice of) the right is the practice of the end (paścimācāra) and the end (paścima) is the dissolving away (of all things) completely.22 (31cd-32) The abode of merger is oneness and so (that) plane (of being) is said to be hard to understand. Everything being of five types, the end (paścima) has become fivefold. (33) The five is indeed the fivefold aggregate (piSÆa) (of the syllables), (the one on the) right has become fivefold. The preceding (pūrvaka) aggregate (of syllables) is (also) fivefold. Again, the aggregate (piSÆaka) is fourfold. (34) The fourfold path has been explained, that is, the Path of the Siddhas which is fourfold. (This is) the Kaula (reality consisting of the) bliss of one's own nature (which develops) by the expansion of the fourfold Command.23 (35)

sanskrit: 264 कुमारिकाखण्ड: कुलकौलकुलानन्दं कुलमातङ्गभैरवम् । ७७ आर्णव सर्वभूतानां महोद्याण च व्यापकम् ॥ ३६ ॥ १७९ तत्रस्थ' यत् स्वय ँ” वृक्ष शाखापञ्चकभेदितम् । नादबिन्दुप्रयोगेण संजात शक्तिपञ्चकम् ।। ३७ ।। १८४ अन्वय८३ प्रथमं ज्ञानं प्रत्ययं पञ्चधा गतम् । स्थितं पञ्चप्रकारैस्तु ज्ञात्वाज्ञा भवते क्षणात् ॥ ३८ ॥ १८७ ।। १८९ अनादिशिलमध्ये तु वृक्ष मध्ये कदम्बकम्' गुहा कदम्बिनी मुक्तिर्देवता पञ्चधा गता १९२ अनादिविमला शुद्धा‍ सा च एकारसंज्ञया । १९७ । ।। ३९ ।। १९९ शृङ्गाटाग्रे९५ च संजाता उत्तीणी हिमवद्गिरौ” ।। ४० ।। सर्वज्ञा गिरिमध्यस्था उ — ऊकारविघट्टिनी २०१ २०० कूर्मसंकेतके देव जाता सा जालरूपता २०३ २०४ २०२ २०५ । आमूला योगदेवी च परदेहाश्रयासना । ।। ४१ ।। पूर्णोत्तरविलीनत्वाद् विमला योगदेवता ॥ ४२ ॥ २०८ सिद्धलिङ्गाक्षराकाशे ८ शृङ्गाटाक्षरभैरवी । । शवरी सिद्धलिङ्गानां ब्रह्मग्रन्थिः १० परे ११ पदे १२ ।। ४३ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 265 Udyāna The bliss of Kula which is (both) Kula and Kaula24 is Kulamāta‰ga Bhairava. It is the ocean of all existing things (bhūta). Pervasive, it is the Great Garden (of the Li‰ga).25 (36) The self (existing) Tree26 that is there is divided into five branches. The group of five energies has arisen by the application of Sound and the Point.27 (37) (This is) the Tradition (anvaya), the primordial knowledge and sign of attainment (pratyaya) that has become fivefold and abides with five modalities (prakāra).28 Once known, the Command (is transferred) in an instant. (38) In the middle of the beginningless Stone is the Tree.29 In the middle is the Kadamba (Tree). The Kadambinī Cave is liberation, the deity who has become fivefold. (39) Pure and free from stain from the beginningless (past) (anādivimalā), (the deity) is called the letter E. Born at the front (agre) of the Triangle, she has descended onto the Himalayan mountain.30 (40) Jālandhara Omniscient (sarvajñā), she is in the centre of the mountain31 and bursts apart the letters U and Ū.32 O god, she is born in the Convention of the Tortoise in the form of Jāla.33 (41) PūrSagiri Rooted in Ā, she is the goddess of Yoga, whose seat (āsana) rests on the supreme body. She is merged into the northern (seat) and so she is the full one (pūrSā) as Vimalā, the deity of Yoga. (42) The Bhairavī of the letter of the Triangle is in the Void of the letters of the Siddha Li‰gas.34 She is Śavarī of the Siddha Li‰gas and the Knot of Brahmā on the supreme plane (of existence).35 (43)

sanskrit: 266 २१५ कुमारिकाखण्ड: २१६ शमने”३ यत् परानन्दं” विकासे चिञ्चिणीपदम् । २१८ जायते चम्पका देवी १७ ॐकारस्था प्रसिद्धये ॥ ४४ ॥ २१९ पञ्चक्षेत्रक्रमे देवी”” पञ्चपीठविशोधनात् । शिवानन्देन मनसा तदा विमलपञ्चकम् ।। ४५ ।। सर्वस्था” किङ्किणीमुद्रा ?” करवीराक्षरो भवेत् । अनेकाकारवर्णैस्तु४ त्रिकमेकारसंज्ञया५ ।। ४६ । च१९ खशिर २२६ च खकार २२७ च हशिरं १२८ च ९ हकारकम् २३३ २३४ २३० । रशिरं च २३१ हकाराद्यं जशिरं च जकारकम् ।। ४७ ।। व्यापक२३५ अशिरानन्दं३६ पञ्चसंकेतपञ्चकम् २३८ २४० । पञ्चकं च पुरा ज्ञात्वा विमल जायते क्षणात् ।। ४८ ।। शिलैका २४९ कामरूपस्य ४२ शिला पञ्चाक्षरा शिवा २४४ २४५ २४६ अक्षराणि पदाः पञ्च पदा: पञ्चशिलायुताः २४३ २४७ जन्मनी जन्ममध्यस्था ४८ शिला शक्तिर्विभेदकी ४९ । २५० २५१ । ॥ ४९ ॥ एकारकरणा कान्ति: सा शिला ब्रह्मवर्चसा ।। ५० ।। जन्मोत्पत्तिस्तदा२५२ जाता २५३ जन्मशृङ्गाटकाक्षरे २५४ । पश्चिमस्य तु पीठस्य शिला जन्मशिला भवेत् ५५ ।। ५१ ।। २५७ सप्तजन्मक्षये प्राप्ते सा शिला लभ्यते भव । २५९ यत्रस्था २५८ पञ्चधा शक्ति: सानन्दो मातृमण्डले ।। ५२ ।। ज्ञान२६० ज्ञेयमशेषस्य २१ मन्त्रमञ्जूषकस्य`२ च । २६४ शिला सा२६३ प्रथमा प्रोक्ता देवतेयं च ४ योगिनी ।। ५३ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 267 The supreme bliss in tranquil (śamana) (state) is the plane of Ciñcinī when the expansion (of energy take place). The goddess Campakā arises established in the letter O¤ in order to accomplish (all things).36 (44) By the purification of (these) five sacred seats, the goddess (resides) in the sequence of the five fields as Śiva's bliss37 and the mind (manas). Then the Pure Pentad (is fully formed). (45) The Pure Pentad — the Five Conventions The Gesture of Ki‰kiSī, which is within all things, is the letter of Karavīra along with the letters of many forms (as) the Triad called the letter E. (46) The head of Kha, the letter Kha, the head (of the letter) Ha and the letter Ha, the head of Ra, (the letter) at the beginning of Ha, the head (of the letter) Ja and the letter Ja, the pervasive bliss of the head of A - (this is) the Pentad of the five conventions. Having first learnt the pentad, the Pure One arises in a moment.38 (47-48) The one Stone of Kāmarūpa is Śivā, the Stone consisting of five syllables, there are five syllables and the parts (of the Vidyā) are five conjoined with the five Stones. (49) Janmanī, who is in the middle of (the centre of) Birth is the Stone which is the energy that divides up (the letters). Beauty (kānti), which is the instrument (of mantra) of the letter E, is the Stone (along) with the radiant energy (varcas) of Brahmā.39 (50) Then generation of birth takes place in the syllable of the Triangle of Birth. The Stone of the western sacred seat is the Stone of Birth. (51) O Bhava, that Stone is attained (only) after seven lifetimes (of spiritual endevour) have elapsed (and one attains liberation).40 Wherever power resides fivefold it is bliss in the Circle of the Mothers. (52) One should have the knowledge of all the treasure chest of mantras.41 She is said to be the first Stone and this deity is the Yoginī. (53)

sanskrit: 268 कुमारिकाखण्ड: जन्मब्रह्मशिला२६५ ह्येका २६ वृक्षषट्कसमन्विता । २६७ कृत्वा मथनकर्म तु पञ्चावस्था २८ प्रजायते ॥ ५४ ॥ २७० महेन्द्रस्य हरेन्द्रस्य २६९ खगेन्द्रस्य वल्लीं लभेत् । स चैव त्रिविधोपायः २७२ त्रिकभेदः २३ पुनर्भवेत् ।। ५५ ।। २७६ अशेषं २४ चित्कलाजाल १७५ षोडशस्वरमण्डलम् २७७ २७८ । तत्रस्थाश्च त्रयो वर्णास्त्रिकस्येदं तु निर्णयम् ।। ५६ ।। अकारमध्य आकार २८० • २८१ इकार गुणवासरम् । सुरतात्मानियोगेन अकारं परमार्णवम् २८२ २८४ ॥ ५७ ॥ सकारमध्य८५ ईकारं१६ उकारं ईकार २८६ उकार २८७ त्रीणि रश्मयः २९२ २८९ । मध्यम” पदविन्यास” सकार? शक्तिगोचरम् ॥ ५८ ॥ •२९४ २९५ कुकारं मध्य ऊकार त्रिगुणीकृतवाग्भवम् । अव्यक्तं तं परं९६ लिङ्गं अशिरं व्याप्तिगोचरम् ।। ५९ ।। -२९९ त्रिदशैर्भेदितं“ चक्रं तं चक्र ९ बिन्दुनिर्णयम् । संपूर्णकलया युक्त वीरराशित्रिराशिकम् ।। ६० ॥ ३०२ त्रिकण्टकाक्षरास्त्रीणि २ त्रिकण्टाकण्टकानि च । ३०४ ३०३ ३०६ कटर रकटाटश्च ठरयुश्च त्रिकण्टकम् ।। ६१ ।। त्रिकसंकेतकाख्यातं समुद्रादपि“ चोद्धृतम् । •३१० उद्धृतं वाममार्गेण” चकार त्रिगुणी भवेत् ।। ६२ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 269 She is the one Birth-stone of Brahmā and is endowed with the Hexad of the Tree. The state of the five (seed-syllables) comes about after (that energy) has been (contemplated in this way and thus) churned. (54) The Triad42 (Then) one attains the series (valli) of Mahendra, Harendra and Khagendra.43 And that is the threefold means; then the triple (trika) division comes again. (55) The entire circle of the sixteen vowels is the net of the energy of consciousness and the three letters are located there.44 This is the teaching of the triad (trika). (56) 1) The letter Ā in the middle of 2) the letter A, and 3) the letter I, which is the abode of the qualities, along with the application of 4) (the letter) whose nature is Passion (surata) (is followed by) 5) the letter A, which is the supreme Ocean. (57) (Then come) 6) the letter Ī, which is in the middle of 7) the letter S, and 8) the letter U, which are the three rays. The middle one is the deposition of the parts (pada) and the letter S, which is in the sphere of power. (58) 9) The syllable KU, (then) in the middle (comes) 10) the letter Ū, (followed) by 11-13) Vāgbhava (AI¤), which is tripled. That is the unmanifest, the supreme Li‰ga with A on its head and its sphere is pervasion. (59) The Wheel is (thus) divided up by the thirteen and that Wheel is the teaching of the Point. Endowed with completely full energy, it consists of three groups of Heroes of the Assembly of Heroes (vīrarāśi). (60) The three syllables of the Three Thorns and the thorns of the Three Thorns. The triple thorn is KAµAMRA, RAKAµĀTA and µHARAYU. (61) It is called the convention of the triad which has also been extracted from the Ocean (of the Yoni full of letters). Extracted by the path of the left, the letter Ca is tripled.45 (62)

sanskrit: 270 ३१४ कुमारिकाखण्ड: चकारस्य”” तु एकार”” एकारान्ते द्वितीयकम्५ । ३१७ द्विदीर्घकलितानन्द तदा सिद्धिस्त्रिके भवेत् ॥ ६३ ॥ ।। ।। एकोऽपि त्रिगुणीकृत्वा”” त्रैगुण्यैककुल तदा सा” भैरवीमूर्तिः” अद्वैतकरणादपि यदा । ॥ ६४ ॥ अद्वैतं ४ च शिलानाथं साक्षाद् डामरभैरवम् । स बीजं३२६ प्राणिनां २७ सर्व २८ देहमेक ९ ह्यनन्तकम् ३३२ अनन्तं” स्थिरबीजस्य निष्कल चित्तचेतनम् ' ३३६ ३३४ ३३० । ॥ ६५ ॥ निरंशो५ सिंहको व्यापी सिंहबिम्ब परापरम् ।। ६६ ।। परापरस्य बीजस्य विरजस्य प्रभास्वता ३४० ३३७ । आनन्दप्रसरौघ तु कुमारं तत् परापरम् ॥ ६७ ॥ ३४३ ३४४ परस्य ३४१ अपरस्येच्छा ४२ इच्छाबीजं परापरम् । त्रिभिभीवगतो३४५ योगी विन्दते च त्रिकण्टकम् ।। ६८ ।। ३४८ पुनरेव शिलानाथ यत् प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मणः पदम् । ३४९ ३५१ ॥ ६९ ॥ तत् च प्रकृतिभूतस्थ५° ब्रह्माक्षरमशेषतः सुदूरस्थ यथा३ तोयं कर्षेच्छक्तिमृनालकम् “४ । •३५६ ।। ३५९ लसत्विद्युल्लताकार५५ लाकुल विष्णुदेवता ॥ ७० ॥ वह्निर्मध्यगतो विष्णुर्बीजाख्य नभभास्करम् । भानुमध्यगतं सूक्ष्मं तदा रुद्रो ६२ दिगम्बरः •३६१ आडम्बरपरित्यागात्४ मध्यस्थस्त्रिविधात्मनि •३६७ •३६८ ३६३ ३६५ । ।। ७१ ।। त्रिकयोग : ३६६ क्रमाचार पश्चिमं वामरूपतः ।। ७२ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 271 The letter E of the letter Ca and the second one is at the end of the letter E. Then, (by adding) the double long (vowel) and differentiated bliss, there is success in the triad. (63) Then, although one, having tripled, if the oneness of (the reality consisting of) the three qualities is the one Kula, then Bhairavī's form (mūrti) (is generated) from the instrument of (the state of) non-duality.46 (64) And (that state of) non-duality (advaita) is the Lord of the Stone, Õāmara Bhairava directly visible. He is the seed (syllable) of all living beings, the one, endless, body. (65) The mental consciousness (cittacetana) of (this) stable seed (of mantra) is endless and without parts (ninkala). It is the pervasive (deity the) Lion without parts, the image of the Lion that is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent). (66) The luminosity of (that) radiant seed, which is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent) (parāpara) is the current of the expansion (prasara) of bliss. It is the Youth (kumara) (the destroyer of evil) who is both supreme and inferior. (67) The seed (syllable) of desire, which is both supreme and inferior, is the desire of the supreme (transcendence) and inferior (immanance). The yogi established in Being attains the Triple Thorn (trikaS˜aka) by means of the three.47 (68) Again, the Lord of the Stone, who is said to be the plane of the Brahman, is established in the (goddess) who abides as Nature (prakrtibhūta). That is all the syllable of Brahman (extracted from the transcendent) (AI¤) just as very distant water is drawn by the power of (good water) channels.48 (69-70ab) Lakula, the deity VinSu, has the form of a creeper, like a lightning flash that plays (in a stormy sky). The seed (syllable) called VinSu (ŚRĪ¤) is the Fire in the centre and its form is the Sun in the Sky. Subtle, it is in the centre of the Sun. Then Rudra (HRĪ¤) is clothed with the Void (digambara).49 (70cd-71) By abandoning confusion (āÆambara), the one in the middle is within the threefold Self. The Yoga of the Triad (trikayoga) is the western practice of the Krama (kramācāra) as its form is that of the left.50 (72)

english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 273 The left (vāma) is within the left and the end of the left that has been encapsulated with what is within the left. The path of that which is to be known arises once one has clearly known the two encapsulating halves (pu˜advaya). (73) The sprout of Prajāpati, the Lord of Kula, is a ball of fire. The letter Sa of the word of the syllables of the Ball (is formed) from the tranquil nature. (74) Once the mind has been concentrated, the intellect (becomes) stable and dissolves away. Then the Ocean of the Kaulas, which is the Kaula (reality) of the consciousness of Kula, (becomes manifest). (75) 51The Immortal and Lord of the Immortals that (has come) from the world of immortal knowledge and the light of all living beings is 1) the one living being (bhūta) who has become threefold. (76) 2) The triple weapon accomplished by 3) the three energies (kalā) and the accomplished power (siddhaśakti) should be threefold. 4) The deities of the Siddhas are three and 5) the Command of the triple division with the triple name (is also threefold). (77) Again, 6) there is the Cave located on (the Triangle of) the three Preaks and 7) the three corners (of the Triangle). Her form is that of the bliss of 8) the three syllables, the Axis of Meru, and the lineage (santati) of 9) the three Yoginīs. (78) The lineage (of the series of energies) is perpetual bliss and the lineage is uninterrupted. The power that has become free of fluctuations (nistara‰gā) is the deity whose syllable is the letter Ku.52 (79) The goddess called Kumudā is within (Bhairava called the) Youth (kumara)53 and within the Wind (of the vital breath). She is the young (yuvā) goddess of the winds (of the vital breaths). She is the goddess in this way in accord with Śiva's will. (80) By (this) will she was first fashioned as Ghorā and as Aghorā from the ocean of knowledge. Her limbs are the waves of the waves of the ocean (and so she is) TaraSgā (the Wave)54 who resides in the Śiva principle. (81)

sanskrit: 274 ४२२ ४२३ कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४२४ ४२५ ४२६ तत्त्वशक्ति: परा इच्छा या च ज्ञानी च चिन्मया । निरोधस्य ४७ वियोगस्य ४२ परा कीर्तिर्जिगीष्यते ४२९ ॥। ८२ ।। ४३४ कीर्तिः४३० कात्यायनी४३१ नाम४३२ कलानां ४३३ चैकदेवता । ४३५ ४३६ ४३७ विपर्ययकुले रक्ता कुजा नामेन ४८ देवता ।। ८३ ॥ ४४१ देवता च इय९ देवी बुद्धिस्था बुद्धिनामिका । गमागमकुले शक्तिर्विज्ञानादपि ४२ भिद्यते ।। ८४ ॥ भेदानां नायकी४४३ शक्तिरनामा च परा मता । ४४८ ४४४ ४४९ सा पुराकृतकर्मस्य निष्कलात्माविशोधनी६ ।। ८५ ॥ शोधनी सर्वसिद्धानां कुनामाचाक्षरस्य च । अक्षरस्य च वामस्य ५° प्रकटा ? मातृभैरवी ॥ ८६ ॥ •४५२ ४५० ४५१ भैरवाक्षरमूर्तिनां तद्ध्यानगतचेतसाम् ३ । । आवर्तेन५४ गुणाकारा तदा सा कुब्जिकार्णवे ४५५ ।। ८७ ।। प्रकटा५६ शिवतत्त्वानां शूराणां कर्दमे स्थिता । लिङ्गाकाशत्रिमुद्रा या मूर्तिलिङ्गं त्रिसिद्धये ॥। ८८ ॥ ४५९ मूर्तयेका शिवमूर्तस्य मूर्तीमूर्ती २ तथावुभौ ३ । अमूर्त:४४ कौलिको भेदस्तदा लिङ्ग प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ ८९ ॥ ४६८ प्रकाशः सर्वसत्त्वानां ६९ निरोध: स्वाधिकारकम् । ४७० ४७२ ।। कलाकरणकर्तृत्वे कायं लिङ्ग मनो ध्रुवम् ।। ९० ॥ •४७४ ४७६ एवं तच्छाभव योग शक्तिमध्यान्तरालयम् ४७९ । अमृतमृतसंयोगात् ँ ँ योगोद्भव परापरम् ।। ९१ ।। ४७३
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 275 The power of the (supreme) principle (tattvaśakti) is the supreme will which is knowledge of the nature of consciousness. (She is) praised as the supreme fame (the energy) that blocks (obstacles) and disconnects (from bondage). (82) Fame is (the goddess) Kātyāyanī,55 the one deity of (all) the energies. (She is) Raktā (raktā) in the Kula of reversal (viparyaya),56 the deity called Kujā. (83) This deity is the goddess. She resides in the intellect and her name is Buddhi (Intellect). (She is) the power within the Kula of the coming and going (of the vital breath). She is split up. By recognizing her, the power who is the leader (nāyakī) of the divisions (of the energies), Anāmā, is considered to be Parā (Supreme). (84-85ab) She is (the goddess Kubjikā) of the imperishable (reality) and is called Ku. (She is) the purifying (power) (śodhanī) of all the Siddhas. She is (the one) undifferentiated (ninkala) (reality) who purifies the one who has previously produced Karma. (85cd-86) She is the Bhairavī of the Mothers of the letter of the left who has become manifest (praka˜ā). Then, by the rotation of the forms (mūrti) of Bhairava’s letters whose minds are absorbed in that meditation,57 she, (the goddess) Kubjikā, whose form (ākāra) are the qualities (of Nature) (guSa), manifests within the Ocean (of the Yoni of letters) and abides in the energy (kardama) of the Heroes who are Śiva principles.58 She who is the triple Gesture of the Void of the Li‰ga is the Li‰ga with (sonic iconic) Form (mūrtili‰ga) (manifest in this way) in order to accomplish the three (energies of the Yoni and all the triads). (87-88) She is the one form (mūrti) of he whose form is Śiva. Both are with form and without form. The Kaula division is without form; then it is called 'Li‰ga'. (89) Its own authority (independent of all others), it is (both) the light of all living beings and what conditions them (nirodha). It is the body as the Li‰ga that is the stable mind within the agency of the instrument of (its) energies. (90) Such is that Śāmbhava Yoga, the abode within the centre of Power (śakti). It is (the reality) which is both supreme (transcendant) and inferior (immanent) born of Yoga by the conjunction of the mortal and the immortal. (91)

sanskrit: 276 कुमारिकाखण्ड: । त्रिकं च त्रिकलावर्तं संवर्तोपरिमण्डलम् । षड्भिर्भेदक्रमाल्लिङ्गं अहिच्छत्रोदितार्णवम् ।। ९२ ॥ ४८३ ४८५ ४८६ या सा शक्ति: ४४ परेच्छा या भगाख्या षडिभेदतः । ४८७ योगिनी बहुरूपेण“ इन्द्राणी ब्रह्मदेवता” ।। ९३ ।। सा च वृक्षक्रमेणैव वृक्षस्यान्ते सुनिश्चला । अन्वयं विपरीतत्वान्मूर्तिर्विज्ञायते क्षणात् ।। ९४ ॥ कामदेवश्च ९४ योगीन्द्रः ४९५ काममध्ये ४६ निसेवनात् । कामेन”“ सुखभोगाना”” भोगाश्च व्योमनिर्णयात् ।। ९५ ।। ५०२ निर्णय सर्वमन्त्राणां रौद्रीमात्रा परे गतिः । ५०४ ५०५ गतेरूध्व ५०३ मनाद्यं च अरूपं पञ्चधा स्मृतम् ।। ९६ ।। ५०८ आज्ञामन्थानकल्पेन कलाषट्क त्रिधागतम् । संकल्पकल्पना भाति विज्ञानं पारमेश्वरम् ।। ९७ ।। •५१२ त्रैलोक्य११ च विपाकोऽय १२ उपोद्घातविचारणात् •५१६ -५१७ ५१३ । आश्रितं परमं मन्त्र मन्त्रातीत परापरम् ॥ ९८ ॥ -५१९ परा गर्भविगर्भस्था अतिथिश्चात्मपञ्जरम् । रमणानन्दकसंज्ञा° कथिता २१ तव ५२२ भैरव २३ ।। ९९ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 277 Again, the Triad is the triple rotation of the energies, the maSÆala on top of the Doomsday Fire. (It is) the Li‰ga that, by the sequence of the divisions of six, is the Ocean arisen from (the Point which is the) Parasol of the Snake (ahicchatra). (92) That power, which is the supreme will and is called the Yoni (bhagākhyā) with six divisions. She is the Yoginī with many forms, IndrāSī, the deity of the Brahman. (93) Again, she is well fixed, immobile within the Tree (of the Point) by means of the Krama of the Tree. As (the stream of energies) reversed (and merged into the Point), the (sonic) form (of the Vidyā) (mūrti) (in the Point), which is the lineage (anvaya) (of the series of energies), is understood in a moment. (94) By practicing (nisevana) in the centre of Passion, the Lord of Yogis is Kāmadeva.59 Wordly pleasures (sukhabhoga) and worldly experiences (bhoga) are due to Passion and (insight into) the teaching of the Void (vyomanirSaya). (95) The formless (reality) (arūpa) is fivefold as 1) insight (nirSaya) into (the nature) of all mantras, 2) Raudrī’s energy (mātrā), 3) the condition (gati) within the supreme, 4) (the state) beyond (that) state along with 5) the mind and the rest (that begins with it).60 (96) The group of six energies has become threefold by the intent (kalpa) to churn the Command. The conception of intent (saˆkalpakalpanā) manifests (as the) consciousness (vijñāna) of the Supreme Lord.61 (97) This is also the maturation (vipāka) of the three worlds (and it takes place) by reflecting on the beginning (upodghāta) (of all things). The supreme mantra, which, both superior (transcendant) and inferior (immanent), is beyond mantra, is based on (the letter) A (āśrita).62 (98) O Bhairava, the supreme (goddess) (Parā) who is both within the source (of all things) and (the reality) without a source (garbhavigarbhasthā), the Timeless (atithi), and the cage of the Self - the term for the bliss of sport, has been declared to you. (99)

sanskrit: 278 ५२४ कुमारिकाखण्ड: ५२५ भूमिकाज्ञाननिर्मुक्तः पण्डितो योऽर्थदूषकः । स्वयंभूज्ञानकतीरो दूषको २७ नरक २८ व्रजेत् ॥ १०० ॥ ५२९ ५३० इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थान भैरवयज्ञे ९ अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आज्ञापीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलभेदोत्तरषट्कनिर्णये कोटिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहिताया अम्बाक्रमभाषिते पञ्चत्रिकभूमिकाधिकारवर्णने' ५३३ क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। ६४ ।। ५३२ •५३१
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FOUR 279 The scholar who, devoid of the knowledge of the commentary (bhūmikā) corrupts the meaning (of this scripture) and the one who makes a commentary (bhūmikā) by himself (without any grounding in the scriptures), that corrupting one, goes to hell. (100) This is the (sixty-fourth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the Plane of the Pentad and the Triad. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the sacred seat of the Command (ājñāpī˜ha) along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Subsequent Six Thousand (verses) of the Pure Division (vimalabhedottarana˜ka) in the division beginning with `KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (ambākrama).

sanskrit: पञ्चषष्टानन्दः श्रीवक्रा उवाच' परागर्भश्च' विमलः' अतिथिश्चात्मपञ्जरम् । रमणानन्दकैलासमाश्रमं पश्चिमं गृहम् ॥ १ ॥ पश्चिमे तु परे जन्मे सप्तजन्म क्षयं गते । प्रकटं ज्ञानमञ्जूर्षं आकाशकुसुमोपमम् ।। २ ।। o कुसुमसदृशी ं माया नाभिरन्ध्रप्रवाहिणी । १३ आहुतमिव चित्तस्य' विज्ञानं चात्मसाधनम् ॥ ३ ॥ अध्वरं शोध्यरूपं तु अध्वर नाम देवता । मेरुमार्गस्य क्षेत्रस्य ं ज्ञात्वा सन्तानमुच्यते ॥ ४ ॥ ७ सन्तान“ मूर्तिकुम्भस्य कुम्भवत् तिष्ठते” स्थिरम् । अनुवृत्तिं” पुरा ज्ञात्वा तदा सन्तानमुच्यते ॥ ५ ॥ २३ २५ पूर्वपश्चिमयोर्भीवैर्वामदक्षिणयोः क्रमात् । । मनो बुद्धिरकामस्य तदा चिन्तामणिद्युतिः ।। ६ ।। 30 तद्युतेरुदयोऽयं तु अस्तं” तस्यान्तिमं पदम् । ज्ञात्वा चोत्पद्यते चर्या ” चर्यावस्थो दिगम्बरः” ॥ ७ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE The Category of the Self. The Realisation of the Self by Means of the Planes of Yoga1 The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: The pure (reality that) contains Parā (parāgarbha), Atithīśa (Bhairava), the Timeless Lord, the cage of the Self, and the Hermitage of Kailāsa, which is the bliss of sport, is the Western House.2 (1) In the last and supreme birth, when seven lives have passed,3 the treasure chest of knowledge,4 which is (miraculous) like a sky flower, manifests. (2) Māyā that flows through the cavity of the navel is like a flower. (It is) the spiritual discipline of the Self and the consciousness of the mind that has as if been offered as an oblation. (3) The Path (adhvara) is the object of purification. The Path is the deity of the field of the Path of Meru (merumārga). Having known (that), (the Path) is said to be the lineage (santāna) (of the series of deities of the Krama). (4) The lineage (santāna) (of the series of deities of the Krama) is that of the jar of the image (of the deity) (mūrtikumbha) (which is the Point) and it abides stable (and fixed) like a jar.5 Having first learnt the due order, it is then said to be the lineage (santāna) (of the Krama deities). (5) Then, by virtue (of the power) of those things that exist in the east and west, north and south, then, (known) in due order, the intellect and mind of one who is free of passion (shines with) the radiance of a wish-granting gem.6 (6) This (world) is the dawning of that radiance and (its) setting is its ultimate plane.7 Having known (that), (the liberated state which is right) conduct (caryā)8 arises and the one who is established in it, (divested of ignorance), is naked (digambara).9 (7)

sanskrit: 282 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३४ अ आकार च इकार ईकारश्चार्धचन्द्रिका । ३७ चक्षुन्मीलनविद्या या ँ विज्ञान चित्तशोधनम् ॥ ८ ॥ ४० षट्त्यागात् सप्तमं प्राप्य अष्टमं पदमव्ययम्” । अनामयमनाद्यं च नादनादान्तगं पदम् ।। ९॥ ४८ पञ्चरोधनिरुद्धस्य” पदरोधः पराज्ञया । मनो—ऊर्मितरङ्गाद्यसागर” परम ं पदम् ।। १० ।। तत्त्वत्रिकार्णवा” शक्तिः सिद्धलिङ्गा त्रिविक्रमा” । मूर्तित्रिकं कुलाम्नाय” उत्तीर्णं पीठभैरवम् ॥ ११ ॥ त्रिकैककरणाद् योगी भूमिकः परिकीर्तितः । कीर्तन सर्वसामान्यं पश्चिमं च कुलार्णवम् ॥ १२ ॥ ६२ षट्पदक्रमबोधेन भेदाना सप्तविंशतिः २ । । ५९ ६४ उद्धृतं भूमिकार्थेन” ज्ञात्वा तत् परमं पदम् ।। १३ ॥ •६७ ६८ योगिनां च निःसंदिग्धं भ्रान्तिनिरासन परम् । ७० ६० भूमिकार्थोपदेश तु अज्ञात्वा नैव” मुच्यति ॥ १४ ॥ ७३ भ्रान्तिच्छेदं तु चास्तीति कौमारस्य क्रमस्य च । मूलान्वयकुलस्येद सारं कौलक्रमागतम् ।। १५ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE 283 A and the letter Ā, the letters I and Ī and the light of the Half-moon (ardhacandrikā).10 (Thus) the Vidyā that opens the eye (of knowledge) is consciousness (vijñāna) and the purification of the mind. (8) Having attained the seventh by abandoning the six, the eighth is the imperishable plane.11 It is flawless, without beginning, the plane present in Sound and the End of Sound.12 (9) The blockage brought about by (the lower) planes (of existence) of one who is blocked by the blockage of the (lower) five (planes) is due to the (power of) the supreme Command. The Ocean that precedes the fluctuations and waves of the mind is the Supreme Plane.13 (10) Power is the ocean of the three principles.14 She is the accomplished Li‰ga and she takes three steps.15 The triad of forms (mūrtitrika) is the (immanent) tradition of Kula (represented by the triangular Yoni). Transcendent, it is the Bhairava of the sacred seat (of the Point). (11) Solely by means of the triad (of the energies of the Yoni) (one becomes) a yogi praised as being on the plane (of Yoga). Praise (kīrtana)16 is common to all, while the Ocean of Kula is the western (tradition). (12) The twenty-seven divisions (of the Krama) (are formed) by the awakened consciousness of the sequence of the six planes (na˜padakramabodha). Extracted by means of the reality of the planes (of Yoga) (bhūmikārtha), having know that (one attains) the Supreme Plane.17 (13) Free of doubt and supreme, it removes the ignorance of yogis. Without having known the teaching concerning the reality of the planes (of Yoga), one is not liberated. (14) Removing error with regard to the sequence of the Youth, this is the essence that has came down through the Kaulakrama of the Kula of the root tradition. (15)

sanskrit: 284 कुमारिकाखण्ड: दुर्विज्ञेय तु योगीना भूमिकार्थं तवोदितम् । शतसूत्रक्रमौघेन” ज्ञात्वा चयीं प्रपद्यते ।। १६ ।। ८३ भूमिकार्थविशुद्धस्य“ पारम्पर्यरतस्य ं च । ८८ भवते परपदप्राप्तिः “ परे शान्ते निरामये ॥ १७ ॥ यद्यप्याज्ञाधरः” कश्चित् स भ्रान्तश्चेन्न मोचक: । आचार्यस्य यदा भ्रान्तिः क्रमे च मण्डलस्य च ॥ १८ ॥ तदा¨ शिष्यो न मुक्तः स्यात् संसारार्णवदुस्तरात्” । तस्माद् भ्रान्ति परित्यज्य कौलज्ञानं समभ्यसेत् ॥ १९ ॥ १०३ व्याख्यादीक्षा प्रकर्तव्या अन्यथा न कदाचन अविज्ञाय संहितार्थं योऽधिकार करोति च •१०६ । करोति च॰५ ।। २० ।। स स्वय द्रोहको देवि च्छिन्नमूलगतिर्भवेत् ँ । प्रथमान्वये कौलस्य पश्चिमस्य गृहस्य च ।। २१ ।। संहितार्थमिदं” ज्ञात्वा मोचयेत्” मुक्तिभाजनः । ११४ ११५ सोऽधिकारी महादेव ३ अन्यथा नामधारकः ।। २२ ।। चिद्व्योम”” चिद्घनानन्द चेतसां यश्चिनोति यत् । तत् पर”” ब्रह्मणो रूपं आत्माचैतन्यमुच्यते ।। २३ ।। अभ्यासाद् योगिनां योग: खेचक्रे जायते सदा । .१२० । तमासाद्य परं ब्रह्म मोक्षमार्गं स गच्छति ॥ २४ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE 285 The Necessity of the Scripture to know the Planes of Yoga and Liberate Others Hard to know, you have uttered this, the (teaching concerning) the reality of the planes yogis (experience). Having known (that) by means of the current of the transmission (kramogha) of the hundred sūtras, 18 (right) conduct (caryā) is achieved. (16) One who has been purified by the reality of the planes (of Yoga) and is devoted to (the teaching) of the lineage (of teachers), attains the supreme plane within the supreme (reality) that is tranquil and flawless.19 (17) Even if someone possesses the Command, he cannot free (others) if he (himself remains) deluded. If the teacher makes mistakes (bhrānti) in the Krama and the maSÆala, (his) disciple is not liberated from the ocean of transmigration that is so hard to traverse. Therefore, abandoning error (bhrānti), one should practice the Kaula teaching (jñāna). (18-19) One should perform the initiation into the explanation (of this scripture) (vyākhyādīknā) (only in this way) and in no other way at any time. O goddess, he who assumes authority without having understood the meaning of (this) scripture damages himself and the course of his existence (gati) is severed at the root. (20-21ab) Having learnt this, the meaning of the scripture of the western Kaula House that belongs to the first (of all) lineages (anvaya), the liberated one should liberate (others). O Great God, he is (truly one who) has authority, otherwise (if he does not know this, he merely) bears the name of (a teacher but is not really one). (21cd-22) The Liberated State The Void of Consciousness and the bliss of dense (uninterrupted) consciousness of sentient beings that discerns (reality) is the supreme form of the Brahman and is said to be the consciousness of the Self. (23) The Yoga (true) yogis (experience) takes place perpetually within the Wheel of the Sky (of consciousness) (khecakra) by the practice (of this teaching). And once that supreme Brahman has been attained, he moves on the path of liberation. (24)

sanskrit: 286 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १२३ व्रजते परमे स्थाने भगाख्ये यत् विपर्ययात् । १२५ ऐश्वर्यस्य समग्रस्य धर्मस्य यशसः श्रियः ।। २५ ।। २७ वैराग्यस्यापि २६ मोक्षस्य षण्णा भग इति स्मृतः । चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधस्य स्थिरीकरणमेव च ।। २६ ।। षड्विधात्मा च योगीन्द्र निश्चयात्मा प्रवर्तते । एष त्रयत्रिदैवत्यं त्रिनाडीमथनादपि ९ ।। २७ ।। महापथगतिं ज्ञात्वा को न मुच्येत बन्धनात् । सोमाकीनलकुण्डस्य त्रिप्रकारस्य तस्य च ।। २८ ॥ भगाख्यं शक्तिबिम्बाख्य” उड्डियाणं च पीठकम् । १३४ १३२ १३३ महामोक्षपथे सिद्धिः परा कला इति स्मृता ।। २९ ।। ५ यासौ३६ ध्वनिनिनादेन अमृताख्या अनामिका” । १४० सा क्षोभाख्या” जगन्माता सुदीप्ता कुलकौलिनी ॥ ३० ॥ महाज्योतिशिखाकारा दक्षिणे जालपीठगा । रौद्ररूपे ४२ रुद्राणी प्रसिद्धा मोक्षविग्रहे ॥ ३१ ॥ वामामृतभरात्” तृप्ता ४५ वामकोणे व्यवस्थिता । ४७ संपूर्णबिम्बजननी४६ पूर्णगिर्ये गिरोदिता ।। ३२ ॥ १४८ १४९ यस्या: पितृजना नित्यं मोक्षहेतोः प्रवर्तकाः' । सिद्धं पूर्णमन:सृष्टिर्भैरवाश्रमपूर्णकम् ।। ३३ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE 287 By the reversal (of the fettered condition), he reaches the supreme abode called the Yoni (bhaga). It is said to be the source (bhaga) of the six - lordship of all, righteousness (dharma), fame, majesty (śrī), dispassion and liberation. (25) It is the means by which the checking of the fluctuations of the mind is made stable. O Lord of Yoga, the sixfold Self20 becomes the very essence of certainty and by churning the three channels, he possesses the triple divinity of the three (worlds).21 Having learnt the way of the Great Path, who is not liberated from bondage? (27-28ab) The Four Sacred Seats UÆÆiyāna The sacred seat of UÆÆiyāna, which is called the Yoni and the Image of Power (śaktibimba) of the triangular (triprakāra) hearth of Moon, Sun and Fire, (now) belongs to him. (28cd-29ab) Accomplishment (siddhi) on the great path of liberation is said to be the Supreme Power (kalā) which, as the resonance of the resonance (of consciousness) (dhvaninināda), is Anāmikā (the goddess Nameless) (who is also) called Nectar. She is the mother of the universe, Kulakaulinī, who intensely brilliant (sudīptā), is called `arousal' (knobha). (29cd-30) Jālandhara On the right, she resides in the sacred seat of Jāla in the form of the flame of the Great Light.22 RudrāSī is well known in (her) fierce (raudra) aspect which is the form of liberation. Filled with the nectar of the left, she is satisfied and resides in the left corner (of the triangular Yoni). (31-32ab) PūrSagiri Born of Speech (Giroditā) is the mother whose form is perfectly complete in (the sacred seat of) PūrSagiri. To her who is constantly impelled by (man's) forefathers in order to achieve liberation, belongs Bhairava's hermitage (called) PūrSaka, which (when) attained, is the full emanation of the mind. (32cd-33)

sanskrit: 288 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १५२ जपध्यानार्चन शून्ये २ तर्पणं शिशिरे स्मृतम् । ९५४ उत्तरे देवतायान^३ पितृयान ४ तु दक्षिणे ॥ ३४ ॥ १५७ ।। मध्ये सेतु: ५५ परा५६ आज्ञा प्रवृत्त्याद्य हि तत् स्मृतम्” । १६३ तदग्रे चैव कामाख्य पीठ सुरवरार्चितम् ॥ ३५ ॥ निग्रहानुग्रहकर ज्ञात्वा भवति योगिनः । पशुमलक्षयकर विश्वव्याप्तिर्जगत्यपि ॥ ३६ ॥ ।। १६८ लयोत्पत्तिस्थितिमन्त्री संसारस्थितिकारणम् । १६९ । विश्वव्याप्तिः ९ परे चक्रे तन्मध्याल्लिङ्गरूपिणी ।। ३७ ।। चन्द्रविकला सा काली परमानन्दनन्दिनी । १७४ ।। कन्दाधारोत्थिता'७” शक्ति: कुण्डलाकारकौलिनी ॥ ३८ ॥ ध्यात्वा ता ं मनसाक्षया समुत्थप्य ४ शनैः ७५ शनैः१७६ । लक्षयेन्मनसा प्राज्ञो बिन्दुनादे परालये ॥ ३९ ॥ खेचक्रे खेचरी खस्था चन्द्रबिम्बस्वरूपिणी । १७९ शिवात्माशक्तिनामेका त्रयाणां समरसं भवेत् ।। ४० ।। स्थितिर्भवति यद्रूपं भूमिकार्थे प्रवर्तते । शिवात्माशक्तिसंचार:१८२ खेचक्रे जायते यदा ।। ४१ ।। तदैकीभवतामेति परमानन्दलक्षणम् ।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE 289 Repetition (of mantra), visualization, and worship in the Void is said to be lustration within the Cavity (of the emptiness of pure consciousness). The way of the gods is in the north, while the way of the ancestors is in the south. In the middle is the bridge said to be the first movement (towards emanation) (pravrttyādya), which is the supreme Command. (34-35ab) Kāmarūpa The sacred seat called Kāma, worshipped by the best of the gods, is located in front of it. Having known it, the yogi can both grace and obscure (others). (35cd-36ab) He destroys the impurity of the fettered and so too (brings about his) universal pervasion within the universe. The cause of the stability of the world of transmigration he, the reciter of mantra, (brings about) creation, persistence and destruction. (36cd-37ab) The Wheel of the Sky of Consciousness (The energy of) universal pervasion (spreads out) within the supreme Wheel and (emerges) from the centre of it in the form of the Li‰ga. She is Kālī, a transformation (vikalā) of the Moon, and she delights in supreme bliss. (37cd-38ab) She is Kaulinī (who is KuSÆalinī) and her form is (circular) like an earring (kuSÆalākāra). She is the power that has arisen from (Void which is) the foundation of (Vāgbhava), the Root (of the energy of the Yoni).23 Having contemplated her with the mind, and gradually lifted her up, the wise man should perceive (her), she who is the imperishable (power), with the mind in the Sound (that emanates from) the Point in the Supreme Abode. In the Wheel of the Sky (of consciousness), she is Khecarī (the Skyfarer); residing in the Sky (of consciousness), she is the Image of the Moon (candrabimba). (38cd-40ab) (She is) one and she is the oneness (samarasa) of the three: Śiva, Śakti and the Self. (She is) the state of persistence, the (universal) nature that operates within the reality of the planes (of Yoga) (bhūmikārtha). (40cd-41ab) (The supreme reality) whose mark is supreme bliss becomes one when the activity (saˆcāra) of Śiva, Śakti and the Self takes place within the Wheel of the Sky (of consciousness). (41cd-42ab)

sanskrit: 290 कुमारिकाखण्डः १८४ अतो या परमा शक्तिः सुखकारणमव्ययम् ।। ४२ ।। बिन्दुनादपथातीतमित्युक्त चोध्वसंस्थितम् । १८७ ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च ईश्वरश्च सदाशिव: ॥ ४३ ॥ पञ्चब्रह्मात्मको ज्ञेयस्तेषां स्थानं वदाम्यहम् । ब्रह्मणो हृदये स्थानं विष्णुः कण्ठे व्यवस्थितः ।। ४४ ।। तालुदेशे स्थितो रुद्रो निरोधिन्यन्त ईश्वर : । १९२ लम्बिका - ऊध्वतो९३ यत्र ऊध्वमार्गे ९४ निरुध्यते ।। ४५ ।। १९७ बिन्दुस्थानं तदेवोक्त नादस्थानं तदूध्वत: । १९८ तत्र स्थितः शिवो देवो गुणातीतः परापरः ।। ४६ ।। २०० नित्यानन्दस्वरूपेण मथनादुपरि स्थिता । २०२ तस्यां भगाख्यमाख्यातं शक्त्यामुपरिपन्थिनी ।। ४७ ।। २०३ अभ्यासेन यदा ज्ञात्वा षट्प्रकार महोदयम् । २०४ इच्छाज्ञानीक्रियारूपा आत्माशक्तिसमन्विता ॥ ४८ ॥ रसपूर्णा स्थिता सा तु उल्लसन्त्यमृतोपमा । भुजाङ्गकुटिलाकारा परमानन्दलक्षणा ।। ४९ ॥ २०७ २०८ स्वरूपा च तया ँ चैतत् षट्प्रकारे विलीयते ९ । २१० क्षयं यान्त्यपरावस्थाः परावस्था च” योगिनाम् ।। ५० ।। यत्र ब्रह्मकपाट”” हि भित्त्वा परपुरं विशेत् ।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE 291 Thus the Supreme Power is the imperishable cause of happines which, situated above (all others), is said to be beyond the path of the Point and Sound.24 (42c-43ab) The Location of the Five Brahmās Brahmā, VinSu, Rudra, Īśvara and Sadāśiva - one should known that (these) are the Five Brahmās. I will tell (you) their location (sthāna). (43cd-44ab) Brahmā's place is in the Heart. VinSu is located in the throat. Rudra abides in the palate. Again, Īśvara is at the end of the Obstructress (nirodhinī). (44cd-45ab) The place of the Point is said to be above the glottis where it is blocked on the upper path. The place of Sound is above that. Śiva abides there.25 He is the god, who beyond the qualities (guSa) (of Nature), is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent).26 (45cd-46) KuSÆalinī and the Attainment of the Supreme State Churned by eternal bliss (nityānandarūpa), (KuSÆalinī) abides (sthitā) above that.27 Within that, power is said to be (the reality) called the Yoni, whose path is upwards. (47) When (the true nature of) the Six Parts (na˜prakāra), which is the Great Arising (mahodaya) (of emanation), has been known by practice, then that (energy) of will, knowledge and action, endowed with the power of the Self which, full of aesthetic delight (rasa), is like nectar, pours out (of herself). (48-49ab) (Her) mark is supreme bliss and (her) form is crooked (like) a snake. She is the essential nature (of all things) and by means of her, it (all) dissolves away into the Six Parts.28 (49cd-50ab) (The yogi), having penetrated the Door of Brahmā, enters the Supreme Abode (pura) where the lower states are destroyed and the supreme state of (liberated) yogis (arises) (50cd-51ab)

sanskrit: 292 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २१५ निर्वाणमार्गमासाद्य ४ विश्वव्यापी सदाशिवः ।। ५१ ।। पदैः संघट्टयल्लीनो १६ जयन्ती कल्मषापहा २१८ २१७ । चञ्चला परमा विद्या गगने ८ बिन्दुमालिनी ।। ५२ ।। -२१९ २२० मुखेन तां”” शशिकला सुधाबिन्दुद्वयं पिबेत् । •२२२ नासापुटाभ्यां एवं तां? मुक्त्यर्थं पुनराहरेत्२४ ॥ ५३ ॥ योगी जयेज्जरामृत्युं सदाभ्यासाल्लयं गतः । २२५ २२७ व्याधिनां २६ शमनमेव विनाशं राजयक्ष्मणः ॥ ५४ ॥ क्षयक्षीणोऽपि लभते २२८ योगीन्द्र : २२९ करणे स्थितः । २३१ २३२ नाभिपद्मे २३० हृत्पद्मे तु मुखपद्मे तृतीयके ॥ ५५ ॥ २३३ नित्यं सा वसते शक्तिर्जीवेन समधिस्थिता । एकत्र भोगसंभावे चिन्मात्रवद्विभूषिते ।। ५६ ।। हृत्पद्मे' तु स्थिरं बध्वा स्वसंभावं विचारयेत् । २३६ हृद्याकाशविलीनत्वात् पद्मसंपुटमध्यगम् ।। ५७ ।। २३७ •२३८ अनान्यचेतसा भाव्यं परं भावमवाप्नुयात् । २४० । अक्षयं परमं स्थानं धारयेत्” हृदये मने ।। ५८ ।। तत्राचलं सदाकाल १४९ शिखादीपे यथाबलम् । २४३ २४२ तत्र प्राणारणीमध्ये मनसा तु पुनः पुनः ।। ५९ ।। तदासौ भ्राजते २४५ देव मेघमुक्तो यथा रविः । २४४
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE 293 (The energy) that removes impurity triumphs once the path of NirvāSa has been attained and Sadāśiva, who pervades the universe, merging with the parts (pada) (of the lower PraSavas),29 dissolves (away). (51cd-52ab) (She is) Cañcalā (The Fickle One), the supreme Vidyā, Bindumālinī (Garlanded with Points), who (resides) in the Sky (of consciousness). (The yogi) should drink with the mouth (of consciousness) the digit of the Moon which is the wine of the Two Points.30 (52cd-53ab) In order to (achieve) liberation, (the yogi) should draw that (energy towards him) again in that way by means of the two nostrils of the nose.31 (Thus) the yogi who through constant practice has merged (into the supreme state) should conquer old age and death. (53cd-54ab) (In this way all) diseases are quelled; (even) leprosy is no more. The lord of yogis who, established in (each PraSava) the instrument (of mantra), is free of the decay (of old age) attains (the goal). (54cd-55ab) The Rise of KuSÆalinī Sustained by the individual soul, that power resides constantly in the lotuses of the navel, the heart, and the face, which is the third. (55cd-56ab) The Lotus of the Heart Once (KuSÆalinī) has been firmly fixed in one place within the lotus of the heart that is generated from worldly experience and is adorned with pure consciousness, one should reflect upon one’s own origination (svasaˆbhāva). (56cd-57ab) Merged in the Space within the heart, (KuSÆalinī) is in the centre of the capsule of the lotus. One should contemplate it with a one-pointed mind and (thus) attain the supreme state of being. (57cd-58ab) (The yogi) should, according to (his) strength, sustain the supreme and imperishable abode (sthāna) in the mind within the heart. (It should be kept) there immobile at all times within the flame of the lamp (of the Self). (58cd-59ab) (It should be churned) there repeatedly between the fire sticks of the breath by the mind. Then, O god, it shines brilliantly, like the sun free of clouds.32 (59cd-60ab)

sanskrit: 294 कुमारिकाखण्ड: या कला परमा दिव्या स्थिता वर्तेषु व्यापिका •२४७ २४८ २४६ ।। ६० ।। तां ज्ञात्वा मुच्यते योगी संसाराद् दुरतिक्रमात् । २४९ तालुरन्ध्रादधोभागे चित्त” योगी निरीक्षयेत् ।। ६१ ।। संरोधिते तदा चित्ते यावदास्ते मुहुर्तकम् । २५२ २५० पिपीलकैर्यथाक्रान्तं५१ तद्वत् स्पर्शे तदा भवेत् ॥ ६२ ॥ लब्धे २५३ संस्पर्शजे भावे पुनश्चित्तं २५४ न चालयेत् । लभते विवरं सूक्ष्मं बालाग्रशतभागिकम् ।। ६३ ॥ तेन रन्ध्रेण २५५ निर्गत्य प्रविशेत् शाश्वते पदे । २५७ शाक्ते सदोदिते स्थाने अंगुलैकादशावधिः““ ।। ६४ ।। •२५९ । २६० तत्रोपरि परं शुद्ध प्रलयानलसन्निभम् । लहरीतरङ्गकल्लोल–ऊर्मिमालासमाकुलम् ।। ६५ ।। पतननं२६९ चिन्तयेन्मन्त्री६२ हृत्पद्मे स्वे सनातनम् २६३ । जायते च ततो योगी जरामृत्युविवर्जितः ।। ६६ । शक्त्यातीतं परं याति व्योमातीतं तु सर्वगम् । २६६ सर्वक्षोभा : ६५ प्रलीयन्ते तदा तत् परमं पदम् ।। ६७ ।। २६७ विज्ञायते च न संदेहो बलं याति पदे पदे । स्वदेहे तत्त्वविज्ञानं इति मे निश्चला मतिः ।। ६८ ।। २६९ भिद्यते च हृदि ग्रन्थि च्छिद्यन्ते सर्वसंशयाः । क्षीयन्ति सर्वपापानि तस्मिन् दृष्टे परापरे ।। ६९ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE 295 Once the yogi has known that supreme divine energy which is established in, and pervades through, the vortexes (of the psychic centres), he is liberated from the world of transmigration which is so hard to cross. (60cd-61ab) The Palate to the Head The yogi should view the mind (citta) located in the lower part below the cavity of the palate. Then, if the mind is checked and sits (fixed in one place) for some hours (muhurta), (a sensation) occurs within the sense of touch like (a host) of ants covering (and crawling over the body). Once the state generated through (this) tactile sensation has been attained, the mind should not be moved again.33 (61cd-63ab) The End of the Twelve (In this way the yogi) reaches the subtle opening (at the top of the head which is as narrow) as a hundredth part of the tip of a hair.34 Once he has quit (the body) through that opening, he should enter into the eternal plane of power, the perpetually active (sadodita) abode, up to a distance of eleven fingers (breadth). (63cd-64) There above (that) is the supreme, pure (reality), (brilliant and powerful) like the fire of (universal) destruction, full of series of waves, ripples, eddies and currents (of energy).35 One who recites mantra should think of it as falling perpetually into the lotus of his own heart. (65-66ab) Then the yogi, free of old age and death, is victorious and he reaches the supreme, omnipresent (reality) beyond power and the Sky (of consciousness). (66cd-67ab) All disturbances cease and that supreme plane (of being) is known (completely) without a doubt. He attains power (bala) at each level (of being) and the knowledge of reality (tattvavijñāna) within his own body. This is my fixed (and certain) opinion. (67cd-68) The knot in the heart is split apart, all doubts cease, and all sins are destroyed when that (reality), which is both supreme (transcendent) and inferior (immanent), has been perceived. (69)

sanskrit: 296 कुमारिकाखण्ड: परानन्दस्वरूपेण शनैः शनैस्तु भेदयेत् । भित्त्वा तु परमं स्थानं बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया ।। ७० ।। आत्माशक्तिचितं सूक्ष्मं निराधार २ विभावयेत् ३ । २७१ २७५ । निराधारे मतिर्येषां ते सुस्था नात्र संशयः ।। ७१ ।। स्वयं २७६ वावस्थिता २७७ देहे स्वयमात्मनि २७८ गोचरे । उदयन्ती…” प्रबुद्धानां अप्रबुद्धे निवर्तते ।। ७२ ॥ २८० . २८१ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विद्यापीठमार्गे विमलभेदोत्तरषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदे आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशत्सहस्रसंहितायां अम्बाक्रमभाषिते आत्मभेदाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ।। ६५ ।। .२८२
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-FIVE 297 (The yogi) should gradually split apart (the subtle body) by means of supreme bliss, and once he has penetrated through the supreme abode with (his) intellect firmly fixed, he should contemplate the subtle and unsustained consciousness of the power of the Self. Those whose intellect (mati) is (fixed) in (that ultimate reality) free of support are, without a doubt, well established. (70-71) Or else, if (that power) is spontaneously established in the body and within the sphere of the Self, she who is the rising (spiritual energy) of those who are awakened, returns back (to its inactive state) in one who is not awake. (72) This is the (sixty-fifth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the Category of the Self. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat along the path of the Seat of Knowledge (vidyāpī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Subsequent Six Thousand (verses) of the Pure Division (vimalabhedottarana˜ka) in the division beginning with `KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (ambākrama).
