sanskrit: षट्षष्टानन्दः श्रीवक्रा उवाच' आधार चक्रनाथस्य कौमारक्रमनायके । ७ आकाशस्थ गतौ पक्षौ समुद्रः प्रकटीकृतः ॥ १ ॥ प्रकटीकृतमशेषस्य´ जगतः षट्प्रभेदतः ं । o मण्डलार्थं विशुद्धस्य आधारस्थं च षड्विधम् ॥ २ ॥ योनिचक्रमशेषस्य समार्थश्चैव भैरवः । चक्रस्थममलो भाति त्रिपक्षश्च २० १७ क्षय गतः ॥ ३ ॥ सदा भूमिक्रमे” योगादाश्रमे” योगचिन्तकः२३ । अनादिनिधनानन्दस्तमोहृत्पद्मबोधकः” ।। ४॥ पूर्णचक्ररवीशश्च कुलवत्मातृभैरवः” । २७ ३० विध्वंसकः समस्तानां वाग्भवो” रिपुमर्दकः ॥ ५ ॥ •३३ आमोदः” परमास्वादो” विज्ञानं सुषिरं हरः ३७ ३४ । प्रकटा ३५ दर्शने कान्तिस्त्यक्तपक्षपरिग्रहः ॥ ६ ॥ आकाशचक्रमन्त्रस्य स नाथश्चैव कौस्तुभः । विभवाप्यायकर्तृत्वे” समो वै सप्तजन्मनि ॥ ७ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX The Octad of Kula according to the Tradition of the (goddess) Vakrā The Self: the Lord of the Wheel and the Goddess The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: 1The foundation of the Lord of the Wheel is within the leader of the Transmission of the Youth. When the two polarities2 are present in the Void (ākāśa), the Ocean (of the Yoni) is made manifest. (1) The real nature of (this), the maSÆala of the entire universe, has been elucidated in (a manner that) accords with (its) six divisions. Sixfold, it is located in the foundation of the (one) pure (reality). (2) (It is) the Wheel of the Yoni of all things, while the empowered one (samārtha) is Bhairava. Free of impurity, he shines (there) established in the Wheel and (the Void in which the) triple polarity (of Sun, Moon and Fire) has ceased.3 (3) He contemplates Yoga constantly in (this cosmic) Hermitage within the sequence of the planes (of existence) (bhūmikrama) by means of the Yoga (that unites them within him). He is bliss with no beginning or end and awakens the lotus of the heart from darkness. (4) (He is) the Bhairava of the Mothers who possesses the Kula (of energies). He is the Lord of the Sun of the Wheel that is full (and complete). The destroyer of all things, he is Vāgbhava (AI¤),4 the slayer of (his) foes. (5) (He is) fragrance, the supreme Taste, consciousness (vijñāna), the Cavity (sunira), and Hara. He is the beauty revealed in the teaching and is free of attachment to the polarities. (He is the wish-granting gem called) Kaustubha, the Lord of the Mantra of the Wheel of the Void (ākāśacakra). He is equal (in exercising his) power to bestow glory and fulfilment to one who is in (his) seventh life.5 (6-7)

sanskrit: 300 कुमारिकाखण्ड: जन्मकायमलस्यास्य” विषस्य अनिलस्य च । •४६ ४७ दाहकस्यास्य निचयं मुक्तपापमनाहतम् ॥ ८ ॥ शुद्धसन्धिकचक्रस्य श्रीनाथश्चार्धचन्द्रकः' ४९ । उन्मीलनप्रयुक्तात्मा ं मुक्तिमार्गजिगीषिणः ।। ९ । ५७ ५८ मुक्तो मोचयते ह्यात्मा आत्मा वै मोचकः स्मृतः अविमुक्त: सदा योगी मोचनात् सिद्ध्यते पदम् ॥ १० ॥ ६३ आज्ञाघूर्माणचक्रस्य' मथनाद् बोधरश्मयः । ६४ कर्मक्षयप्रभावेण मण्डलं प्रकटीकृतम् ॥ ११ ॥ प्रकृत तूष्णिभूतैक कदम्बावलिगोलकम् । हेलानन्देन भेदित्वा प्राप्यते कारणं परम् ।। १२ ।। ७२ ७३ 06 ७१ चतुःषष्टिः स्मृताश्चक्राः बोधरूपा¨ गभस्तयः ८२ ७५ । एतेषां नायिकान्तस्था ं षट्प्रकारा ँ मनोज्झिता ॥ १३ ॥ प्रोद्गता” मध्यमार्गेण ं अक्षरैः षड्भिरावृता । तदा ते कुलनाथस्य साक्षिका विवरोत्थिताः ॥ १४ ॥ विवरैका गुहा नाम कादम्बी बोधचिन्मया । तत्रस्था” षडिचक्राणां परिज्ञानोपजीवदा ॥ १५ ॥ खचक्रं पुनर्भूचक्र विश्वचक्रं चिदालयम् । ९४ ९७ । चक्रत्रयमहाव्याप्तिः सा च व्याप्तिः कुलाज्ञया ।। १६ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 301 He is the Unstruck Sound, free of sin, the mass of fire of the impurity linked to the body of birth (in saˆsāra) which is the Fire (of the Divine Will) and pervasion (vina). He is Śrīnātha the Lord, the Half-moon of the pure Wheel that connects (the breath and with it all things together). He is the Self engaged in unfolding (the energy of KuSÆalinī) of the one who seeks to conquer the path of liberation. (8-9) The Self is free and liberates. Indeed, the Self is said to be the one who liberates. The yogi is never bereft (of this liberated state) and by (his) liberation he attains (the supreme) plane (of existence). (10) The rays of consciousness of the rotating Wheel of (the goddess's) Command (emanate from it) by churning (it). (Thus) the maSÆala is made manifest by the destruction of Karma. (11) Silent and one by nature, it is the bud (golaka) of the lineage (āvali) of the (Krama of the) Kadamba (tree). Having pierced through it by the joy of effortless sport (helā) (of the union of Śiva and Śakti), (the yogi) attains the supreme cause (kāraSa) (of all things). (12) There are said to be sixty-four wheels. They are the rays (of the one Wheel) and their form is consciousness (bodha). Their mistress is within (them). She possesses six aspects and is free of the mind. She has risen up by the middle path, and is enveloped by the six letters (of HSKHPHRE¤). Then these (energies) of the Lord of Kula along with (their) letters emerge out of the Cavity (vivara) (of the Triangle). (13-14) There is (actually only) one Cavity called the Cave of (of the goddess) Kādambī whose nature is awakened consciousness. Established there, she grants the sustenance of the knowledge of the six Wheels. (15) The Wheels of the Void, the Earth and the Directions (There is) 1) the Wheel of the Void (khacakra), then 2) the Wheel of the Earth (bhūcakra) and 3) the Wheel of the Universe (viśvacakra), the abode of consciousness.6 (The pervasion) of (these) three Wheels is the Great Pervasion and this (state of) pervasion comes about by the Command of Kula. (16)

sanskrit: 302 कुमारिकाखण्ड: षट्कोणभुवनस्यान्ते खचक्र खपरादिकम् विहङ्गक्षीणचित्ताना योगज्ञानस्वरूपकम् १०३ । । ॥ १७ ॥ भूचक्र भूचरीणा४ तु भूचरो गर्भभेदकः । चित्तवृत्तिविलीनत्वात् क्षीणवृत्त्युदये स्थितः ॥ १८ ॥ १०९ ११३ चिच्चर चिच्चरीशस्य दिग्देवाना प्रभञ्जकः । परमात्मा स १४ दिक्कालमुपहायते ।। १९ ॥ ११६ •११७ ११९ एवं तु त्रिविधं चक्र मन्त्रनाथ खमण्डले' । १२० शून्यस्थ सर्वमन्त्राणा ” शून्यचक्रमिति त्रिधा ।। २० ।। त्रैगुण्यरहित ३ चक्र रहित २५ षोडशैः १२६ स्वरैः १२७ । अस्वर तद् भवेच्चक्र राशीना चक्रदेवता ।। २१ ।। देवीनां चक्रसिद्धाना ३२ मन्त्राणा ३३ वीर्यसंभवा' १३६ १३४ । नायकः सृष्टिकर्तीर आज्ञाचक्रपुरान्तगः ।। २२ ॥ ३८ १३९ तस्यात्मानन्दबोधेन ँ चन्द्रार्कौ उभयोः क्रमात् । तदोद्द्योत्य तमच्छाया च्छायाया द्योतकारकौ ।। २३ ।। आपूर्य तमसः सर्व५ देहालोकावसायिनाम्४६ । ४७ स्वयंभूज्ञानवेत्ता ँ च आज्ञानलप्रदीपकः ।। २४ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 303 The Wheel of the Void The Wheel of the Void is within the World of the Hexagram7 and is the Supreme Void and the rest. It is the Yoga and knowledge of those whose (unenlightened) minds have been destroyed by (contemplating) the Bird (of the vital breath). (17) The Wheel of the Earth The Wheel of the Earth pertains to the (energies) that move on the earth. The (male counterpart) who moves on the earth splits up the womb (of the letters). He is (well) established when (that state of consciousness) free of (mental) activity arises, brought about by the cessation of the fluctuations of the mind. (18) The Wheel of the Directions8 The movement within consciousness of the Lord who moves within consciousness is the wind of the gods of the directions. He is the Supreme Soul who eliminates time and space. (19) In this way, the threefold Wheel is the Lord of Mantra within the MaSÆala of the Void. The Wheel of the Void of all mantras is established in the Void and so is threefold.9 (20) (That) Wheel is free of the three qualities and devoid of the sixteen vowels. That Wheel is Unstruck Sound (asvara).10 The deity of the Wheel of the hosts of goddesses, Siddhas of the Wheel and mantras is born from the vitality (vīrya) (of consciousness). (21-22ab) The master (of the Wheel) who resides in the abode (pura) of the Wheel of the Command is the agent of emanation. Both the Sun and the Moon (dawn), in due order by the consciousness of his innate bliss. Having illumined them, the Shade of the Darkness (of transcendence manifests)11 and these two give light within the Shade. (22cd-23) Having filled all the darkness of those who attend to the light of the body, he who knows (that) self-born knowledge kindles the Fire of the Command (for them). (24)

sanskrit: 304 कुमारिकाखण्ड: १५१ अनलस्य कला४९ द्वे च द्वे च त्रीणि रवेः कलाः । १५४ ध्रुवयोनिः १५२ परा माता३ यथा योन्यानलस्य च ।। २५ ।। १५७ अनलार्चिर्गतो““ भानुभीन्वन्तरे शशिप्रभा एव५८ ते च ५९ त्रयश्चक्राः ६० खभूदिक्चक्रमातरः । १६१ १६५ । ।। २६ ।। मातरीणा६२ गृहैक६३ तु अनलाज्ञा' १४ निरञ्जना' निरंशे परमे तिष्ठेत् तदा चोत्पद्यते कला ।। २७ ।। द्विस्वभावे९ स्वरूपेण चलनात्माक्रिया भवेत् । क्रियायोग” कुलज्ञान‍ आज्ञात्र मध्यनिश्चला ३ ।। २८ ।। १७३ १७६ निश्चलं यत् पर¨४ चक्रं निरोधात् ज्ञानरूपधृक् । मातॄणा मेलक¨ रात्रौ ” आज्ञाचक्रे परे पदें ।। २९ ।। ३ चक्रं मात्रा च मातॄणां मध्यरात्रे परे गते । रतिप्रीतिर्विवर्धेत रमणं लिङ्गवर्जितम् ।। ३० ।। १८७ खमध्यस्थ खचक्रं तु खपञ्चकविभूषितम् । ध्यानमेतद् वियोगीना तत्रानन्द दिगम्बरम् ।। ३१ ।। संचरीश तदा चक्रं योगिनां हृदयं परम् १९४ १९३ १९० । । १९५ खहृदयं च खचक्र प्लाव्यमानन्दरूपधृक् ।। ३२ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 305 The Fire has two digits of energy, while those of the Sun are two and three. The firmly fixed Yoni is the supreme Mother of the Fire of the Yoni. (25) The Sun is within the flame of Fire and the light of the Moon is within the Sun. Such are these three Wheels, the mothers of the Wheels of the Sky, the Earth and the Directions. (26) The Wheel of the Command12 The one house of (all) the Mothers is the stainless Command of the Fire. One should stand firm within the (one) supreme (reality) without parts: then energy (kalā) is generated. (27) The dynamic activity (calanātmākriyā) that takes place in the (one) dual nature (of Śiva and Śakti) by means of one’s own innate nature is the Yoga of Action;13 it is the knowledge of Kula - here the Command abides immobile (niścala) in the centre.14 (28) By checking (the flucuations of the mind) the supreme Wheel that is immobile (niścala) possesses the essential nature of knowledge (jñānarūpadhrk). (Thus) the gathering (melaka) of the Mothers on the supreme plane (of being) takes place during the Night (of the duality of Māyā) within the Wheel of the Command. (29) Once attained the supreme (state of being) in the middle of the Night, the Wheel becomes the energy (mātrā) of (all) the Mothers. May the loving joy of passion (ratiprīti) increase in this way the play of intercourse (ramaSa) without the Li‰ga. (30) The Wheel of the Void (khacakra) The Wheel of the Void is in the middle of the Void (of consciousness) and is adorned with the Five Voids.15 This is the meditation of (truly) detached (yogis). The bliss there is naked (and free of limitations) (digambara).16 (31) Then the Wheel is the Lord of Motion (saˆcarīśa), the Supreme Heart of (all true) yogis.17 The Heart of the Void (of consciousness) and the Wheel of the Void, which possesses that bliss, should be made to move upwards (plāvya). (32)

sanskrit: 306 कुमारिकाखण्ड: तदा चक्रोदितानन्दमानन्द ख परापरम् । आर्णवाद्य” पुरा शोध्य हृदये परमं कुलम् ।। ३३ ।। २०१ २०२ कुलरत्नस्य भावस्य भावज्ञानस्य तस्य च । २०३ •२०४ मन्त्रोदयमशेषस्य भैरव परमाक्षरम् ॥ ३४ ॥ अक्षर ०५ भैरवो नाम अनामकमहाप्रभुः । २०८ २०९ २१० प्रभवो ७ विभवानन्दः कौलीशो रमते प्रभुः ।। ३५ ।। २११ प्रभाकान्तिद्वयोर्मध्ये सन्तानं मेरुमार्गयोः । २१४ विपरीतक्रमेणोभौ”२ ज्ञात्वाचारगति: १३ स्फुटा ।। ३६ ।। २१७ । स्फुटं कृत्वा स्फुटः सेतुः १५ कूटक९६ चतुरक्षरम्' चतुष्कलापरात्मानं”“ विकास” शून्यावस्थितम् ।। ३७ ।। २२४ तत्रस्थ २२१ देवदेवीनां २२ संघट्टं परमान्तिकम् । २२६ अनाख्य११५ शिवनादाख्यं चक्रेदं शाम्भवीतनु २३० .२२८ ।। ३८ ।। २३२ तत्र देव्या वसेत् कृष्णा शङ्खस्था” शङ्खिनी भवा । •२३४ २३५ ।। ३९ ।। भावास्वादितदेहीनां भावग्राह्यं रसादिकम् उदधे: कर्णिकामूलं विसर्गद्वयभेदतः २३७ । कलानादोभयोश्चक्र३८ घण्टिकायां” विशोधयेत् ।। ४० ।। विशुद्धिः सर्वकार्याणां विपरीतक्रियात्मकम् । •२४१ बिन्दुभेदकवर्णस्थ विश्वरूपविशोधनम् ।। ४१ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 307 Then (one experiences) the bliss that has arisen from the Wheel and (that) bliss is the Void (of ultimate reality that is both) supreme (transcendant) and inferior (immanent).18 Firstly (then), one should purify the supreme Kula, which is the primordial ocean in the Heart. (33) Bhairava’s supreme syllable, is the dawning of the mantra of (KuSÆalinī) the Jewel of Kula which is the Being and knowledge of Being of everything. (34) The syllable is Bhairava, the great Lord Anāmaka (Unnamed). He is Kaulīśa who is power (prabhava) and the bliss of divine glory (vibhavānanda); the Lord (prabhu) who sports (with his energy).19 (35) The lineage (santāna) (of the series of deities) is in the centre between the two paths of Meru, namely, those of Light (prabhā) and Beauty (kānti). Having known both by means of the reverse sequence,20 the state (of the highest) practice (ācāra) (becomes) clearly apparent. (36) Having made it clearly apparent, the Bridge, which is the Peak (syllable) of four letters, becomes clearly manifest. (Thus) the expansion of the Supreme Self, which consists of four digits of energy (catunkalā), abides (unlimited and ineffable) as the Void. (37) The supreme and ultimate union of the gods and goddesses takes place there.21 (Although) it cannot be named (anākhya), this Wheel, which is the body of Śiva's power (śāmbhavītanu), is called the Sound of Śiva (śivanāda). (38) The dark (krnSā) goddess (KuSÆalinī) resides there.22 Situated on the Conch (śa‰kha),23 she is Śa‰khinī (the Goddess of the Conch) who is Bhavā, (Rudra's consort). (She is) the aesthetic savour (rasa) and the rest that can be perceived through the emotive state (bhāva)24 of the embodied souls who have tasted (this fundamental) state being (bhāva). (39) The root of the calyx of the Ocean25 (of the lotus of the Yoni) is conjoined with the two emissions (of the Sun and Moon).26 Within the glottis (ghaS˜ikā) one should purify the Wheel of both the energies (kalā) and Sound (nāda). (40) The purification of all the goals of action is the universal form of purification. It is (that) reversed action (viparītakriyā) within the letters that splits apart the Point. (41)

sanskrit: 308 २४२ कुमारिकाखण्ड: भरणात्मकयुक्तस्य चित्तस्य दमनस्य च २४३ । व्रतस्थदृढभक्तस्य' विशुद्धिर्बिन्दुशोधनम् ४५ ।। ४२ ।। २४६ २४७ २४८ नानागतिसुरीशस्य अमरीशस्य साधनम् । साधनार्थं तु तत्त्वस्य४९ तत्त्वशुद्धिर्विशोधनम् ॥ ४३ ॥ तत्त्वानां पञ्चधा मार्ग५१ अमार्गं च क्रियात्मकम् २५२ भावयेत्५३ चिञ्चिणीनाथ कर्णमूले त्रिकालवित् .२५५ । २५६ ।। ४४ ।। तदा जीवं च२५७ योगीनां ५८ प्रकृत्या २५९ धारयेत् कला । आमूलाद्११ स्रवते६२ बिन्दु : २६३ चक्र २४ सुरगणार्चितम् ६५ ।। ४५ ।। मूलादेक: २६६ परो हंसः २७ भैरवानन्दचिन्मयः २६९ २६८ विश्राम १९ दीपिका शक्ति: चारोच्चारविभागशः •२७१ २७० । ।। ४६ ।। २७५ । कलाशेषं स्मृतं मूल १७२ तच्च२७३ मूल४ कुलात्मकम् कलाशेष: २७६ पुरस्तस्मात् ७७ टङ्किणी २७८ भवदेवता २७९ ।। ४७ ।। २८१ चक्रनायकिदेवेशी वृद्धावस्था कपालधृक् । कपालं पूर्णिमाकार अमा सा२८३ तत्र देवता ऊध्वलीना २८४ ।। ४८ ।। .२८७ । २९१ ।। ४९ ।। कपालस्य श्मशाने २६ करवीरकें करन्धस्य पुरं९ भित्त्वा समना जायते तदा २९०
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 309 The purification of the Point is the purification of the well controlled (damana) mind endowed (with the energy) that fills it (with bliss) of the devotee who is firm (in his devotion and well) established in the (observance of his inner) vow. (42) The means (of attainment) (sādhana) belongs to Amarīśa (the Immortal Lord), the lord of the gods whose dynamic state (gati) is of many kinds. Purification is the purifiction of the principles (of existence) (tattva), which serves to attain the (supreme) reality (tattva). (43) The Root The path of the principles is fivefold. It is the path of (the letter) A (the energy of the New Moon) and its nature is action.27 One who knows the three times should contemplate CiñciSīnātha who is (located) in (the glottis at) the root of the ear. (44) Then the energy (of consciousness) (kalā) should sustain the soul of (all true) yogis with (the power of) Nature. The Point (bindu) is the Wheel (cakra) worshipped by the hosts of gods.28 It oozes (nectar) from the Root (of the glottis). (45) The one supreme Gander who is Bhairava's consciousness and bliss (emerges) from the Root and, divided up according to whether it moves (downwards or) upwards, it is repose and the power that illumines (and inspires). (46) The Root is said to be (the aggregate) of all the energies (kalā) and that Root is Kula.29 The entire (aggregate) of energies is the City and so µa‰kiSī30 is the deity of phenomenal existence. (47) The mistress of the gods who is the mistress of the Wheel is aged and holds a skull. The form of the Skull is the Full Moon. There the deity is the New Moon (48) She is (the energy) of the Skull in the cremation ground of Karavīra merged (in the transcendent) above.31 The Equal One (samanā) arises when the city of the Cavity of the Void (karandhra) has been pierced. (49)

sanskrit: 310 समस्तरूपमात्मानं९९ बुद्धिगम्योपदेशकम् २९४ कुमारिकाखण्ड: २९३ ज्ञात्वानाहतमन्त्रज्ञ : शशिचयी सुगम्यते' २९५ ।। ५० ।। गमागमनिरोधत्वादध—ऊर्ध्वं९६ विघट्टयेत् । मनमेकाग्रतं“ कृत्वा अनाहतपुरे”” सुखम् ३०० ३०३ ।। ५१ ॥ । तदा चोत्पद्यते चक्र०२ वायुराशिर्महोदधिः तदा ४ चोद्भवते. वृक्ष करवीरे मनोहरे ॥ ५२ ॥ ३०७ हरशक्ति: परा“ च्छाया कमलस्य तु कर्णिका ३०९ ३१२ । आदिमा हृदिमार्गस्था नाम्ना विश्रामभूमिका ॥ ५३ ॥ ३१५ भवतेऽनाहते३ चक्रे कुर्याद् निर्वाणदं४ पदम् । आलय.६ सर्वयोगीनां देहिनोऽनाहतं पदम् ॥ ५४ ॥ ३२१ नादरूप”” ककारान्त॰ सकारान्तपुटीकृतम् । •३२२ ३२४ अर्धचन्द्रकलायुक्त त्रिकूट नाम १४ मन्त्रराट् ५ ।। ५५ ।। ३२६ ३२७ मन्त्रानाहतचक्रस्य मन्त्रराजस्य पार्थिव: । ३२८ पार्थिवं करणं”“ कृत्वा करणं पार्थिवालयम् ॥ ५६ ॥ स च षोडशमध्यस्थः” वह्निश्चन्द्रकलाङ्कितः ३३० ।। । सुखदं सर्वयोगीनां कारणं प्रसरोद्भवम् ।। ५७ ।। कमलानन्दचित्तात्मा विज्ञान३३४ तत्त्वभैरवः ३३७ ३३५ । ३३८ अनाहतस्य५ चक्रस्य ज्ञायते वीरवृत्तिभिः ॥ ५८ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 311 The Wheel of Unstruck Sound Having known the Self whose form is the totality (of all things) and is the (object of the) teaching that can be grasped by the intellect, the one who knows the mantra of Unstruck Sound easily understands the behaviour of the Moon (śaśicaryā). (50) Rub together ‘above’ and ‘below’ by differentiating the coming and going (of the breath)32 and, having concentrated the mind, (experience the) bliss in the City of Unstruck Sound.33 (51) Then the Wheel arises that is the great ocean of the aggregate of (the vital) winds. Then the Tree is born in the beautiful (cremation ground of) Karavīra. (52) Hara’s energy, which is the Supreme Shade,34 is the calyx of the lotus. It is the first (of the energies) and, on the path of the Heart, it is called `the Plane of Repose' (viśrāmabhūmikā). (53) Located in the Wheel of Unstruck Sound, one should make of it the plane that bestows NirvāSa.35 The abode of all yogis, it is the plane of Unstruck Sound of the embodied soul. (54) (The series of letters) ending with the letter Ka are the form of Sound. They are encapsulated (by the series of letters) ending with the letter Sa. Conjoined with the digit of energy of the Half-moon, (this is) the emperor of mantras called the Triple Peak.36 (55) (It is Vāgbhava, the syllable) of the (element) Earth of the King of Mantras of the wheel of Unstruck Sound of (all) mantras. Once formed the (mantric) instrument (pertaining) to (the element) Earth, the instrument (of mantra becomes) the abode of the Earth.37 (56) Again, that is Fire in the midst of the sixteen (energies of the vowels) and is marked with the energies of the Moon. Born from the unfolding flow (prasara) (of energies), it is the (mantric) cause that gives all yogis bliss.38 (57) Consciousness (vijñāna) is the mind (citta) which is the bliss of the Lotus. It is the Bhairava of the principle of the Wheel of Unstruck Sound39 which is known by the modalities (of the energies of the letters governed by the) Heroes (vīravrtti).40 (58)

sanskrit: 312 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ३४० ३४१ अहोरात्रगतिं‍ कृत्वा विकासेत् स्वरमण्डलम् । ३४२ ३४३ ३४५ हृदयान्ते गुहावासं ध्यात्वा चिन्मयतां गतम् ॥ ५९ ॥ च” गतिमन्त्र ३४६ गतेज्ञीन ४७ ज्ञात्वा वै४८ च ४९ गतिमागतिम् मणिपुद्गलयोर्मध्ये ५१ पूर्णचन्द्रनिभा घुति: ५२ ।। ६० ।। ३५४ चक्रेद ५३ मणिपूर्णं तु शिवशक्त्युभयात्मकम् अर्कचन्द्रविलीनत्वात्““ तदा वह्निः प्रजायते ३५६ ३५९ । । ३५० । ३५७ ।। ६१ ।। स चाकाशमनन्तश्च”“ प्रकृतिजठराग्निकः शिवशक्तेः पुरं बध्वा मणिपूर्णस्तदा भवेत् ।। ६२ ।। ३६० ३६२ । सा च शक्तिरक्षराणां च लिङ्गानामोघशक्तयः विसर्गोभयकौलस्य३ षण्मुखमयदेवता ।। ६३ ॥ तत्रस्था६५ वामदक्षोभौ ३६६ यदा ३६७ तिष्ठति १८ तन्मया •३७०३७१ ३७२ ३७३ ३६९ । तदाप्यायननाडीनां चन्द्रस्य जायते पदम् ॥ ६४ ॥ पदं नाडिविभेदेन नालैक संप्रगीयते । मनन७५ सर्वभावानां६ बोधमित्यनुभाव्यते ।। ६५ ।। ३७८ स्वरस्य उदयं तत्र संकोच: ३७९ सर्वनाडिकम् ३८० । विकास८१ सर्वलिङ्गानां मणिपूर्ण सुतेजसम् ॥ ६६ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 313 Having generated (krtvā) (the movement of the breath, which is the) dynamic state (gati) of Night and Day, (the yogi) should expand the circle of the (energies of the) vowels having contemplated the abode of the Cave in the Heart which has become pure consciousness.41 (59) The Wheel Filled with Jewels Once one has known the mantra of the movement (of the breath and realised) the consciousness of (that) dynamism, and the coming and going (of the breath),42 the light, which is like that of the Full Moon, (shines) between the Jewel (of KuSÆalinī) and the individual soul.43 (60) This is the Wheel filled with the gems (of the energies of the letters), which is both Śiva and Śakti. Then, because the Sun and Moon have dissolved away, Fire arises.44 (61) Again, that is Space, the Endless One, Nature (prakrti) and the Gastric Fire (jā˜harāgnika). Once the abode (pura) of Śiva's power has been bound, it is then (the Wheel) Filled with Jewels.45 (62) And she is the energy of the letters which is (all) the energies of the current (of the transmissions) of the Li‰gas. (She is the) deity with six faces of the Kaula (union) of both emissions. (63) If the (energy), which is of that nature, abides there in both (the channels) on the right and the left, then the lunar plane arises of (all) the channels that nourish (the subtle body). (64) (Then there is) said to be (only) one channel (nāla) (of the inner breath), which is the plane (of realisation formed) by the (various) divisions of the channels (nāÆī), and one experiences the awareness (manana) of all existing things46 as awakened consciousness (bodha). (65) The arising there of (the energy) of vocalic sound (svara) (corresponds to) the contraction of the (one) universal channel (sarvanāÆika), while the expansion of all the Li‰gas47 (corresponds to) the radiantly powerful (Wheel) Full of Jewels (maSipūrSa). (66)

sanskrit: 314 ३८३ कुमारिकाखण्ड: तेजादुत्पद्यते नादं४ नादाच्छब्दोऽभिजायते ३८५ । दन्तौष्टतालुरसनाभञ्जनादपि नाडिभिः ।। ६७ ।। तदा चोत्पद्यते वर्णं ँ अष्टवर्गाीष्टदैवतम् ३८९ ३८८ ३९० । देवतानां च सर्वेषां आलय पूर्णचन्द्रकम् ॥ ६८ ॥ •३९२ कोंकणं मणिपूरस्थं चक्रं त्रिदशदीपितम् । ३९३ नायकी देवता तत्र किङ्किणी श्यामदेवता ।। ६९ ॥ देवदेवालयाना९४ च दिव्यं देवालय गुहा । •३९८ निवास सर्वमातॄणां चक्रेद पारमेश्वरम् ।। ७० ।। तस्यैवान्तर्विलीनस्थ” योगिनीनां गृहं च यत् ४०३ •४०० •४०१ ४०४ ४०२ ४०८ नाभिराधारयोर्मध्ये तदार्कसोमविक्रमम् ।। ७१ ।। तदा खं॰५ च त्रिमात्राख्य त्रिशक्तिस्थं प्रतिष्ठितम् त्रिवर्गककलायुक्त पञ्चाशल्लिङ्गभेदितम् ।। ७२ ।। •४१० स्वरचक्रेश्वरं चक्र अधिष्ठानं च कोंकणम् ४१२ ४१४ । । स्वाधिकारं तु देवीनां दिव्याधिष्ठानकारकम् ।। ७३ ।। स्वकायशुद्धिविज्ञान तत्रस्थं तत्त्वनिष्ठितम् । चतुःपीठसमायुक्तं वह्नेरेकारचक्रकम् ।। ७४ ।। एवं स्वाधि“ स्मृतं चक्र९ त्रिकोणोभयमध्यगम् अधिष्ठानं ४२१ समाख्यातं योनिचक्र २२ परापरम् ४२३ ४२० । ।। ७५ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 315 From (this) radiant energy (tejas) arises Sound (nāda) and from Sound, Word by means of the channels and the breath (that strikes) the teeth, lips, palate and tongue. (67) Then ‘letter’ (varSa) arises which is the eightfold deity of the eight classes of letters. The abode of all the deities is the Full Moon.48 (68) Again, Ko‰kaSa is located in MaSipūra, the Wheel well enflammed with (all the) deities (of the letters). The mistress (nāyakī) and deity there is KinkiSī who is dark blue. (69) She is the divine abode of the gods, the Cave of (all) the abodes of the God of the gods. This, the Wheel of the Supreme Lord, is the dwelling place of all the Mothers (of the letters) and the House of the Yoginīs is merged within it. (70-71ab) The Wheel of the Self-supported Then the Sun and Moon move (vikrama) in the middle between the navel and the (Wheel of the) Foundation and the Void (kha) called the three measures (of energy) (trimātra), well established, is located in the triple power (triśakti). It possesses the energy of the three kinds (of light of the Sun, the Moon and Fire) and is divided into the fifty Li‰gas (of the letters). (71cd-72) (This) Wheel is the lord of the Wheel of the Vowels; it is Ko‰koSa, which is the support (of the subtle body) (adhin˜hāna).49 It is the innate (divine) authority (svādhikāra) of the goddesses which is (their) divine support (adhin˜hāna).50 (73) The consciousness of purity within one's own body is there (in that Wheel) and is (thus) grounded in (ultimate) reality.51 Endowed with the four sacred seats, it is Fire, the Wheel of the letter E. (74) Thus, located between the two triangles, (this) Wheel is said to be its own support (svādhi). Called the `support', it is the Wheel of the Yoni which is (both) supreme (transcendant) and inferior (immanent).52 (75)

sanskrit: 316 कुमारिकाखण्ड: •४२४ गुडमेढ्रान्तरं चक्र अग्निसोमस्वलंकृतम् ५ । इन्दुबिन्दुसमाक्रान्तं खगेशं परमेश्वरम् ।। ७६ ।। कन्दचक्र२८ स्मृतं रत्नं नाडीनां मर्मभेदकम् । ४३१ एकैका परमा शक्तिर्नादमालिनीसंज्ञया सा तु पञ्चप्रकारेण त्रिप्रकारा” भगाकृतिः मन्त्रचक्रान्तिका५ ह्यग्निसोमसूर्य भगानना •४३७ ४३२ ४३४ ।। ७७ ।। । ह्यग्निसोमसूर्यभगानना ।। ७८ ॥ आश्रम७ सर्वयोगीनां ८ शृङ्गाटाकृतिशेखरम् । •४४० ४४९ चलद्वलयसंकाशं अभेद्यं दुरतिक्रमम् ॥ ७९ ॥ शक्त्या वेगेन¨र वहते वायुरम्बरयोरिव ४४४ ४४३ तत्र षष्ठः स्मृतो योगी स चाद्वैतस्वरूपतः ' ४४७ ४४८ । ४४५ ।। ८० ।। तस्य शक्ति: स्मृता षष्ठा रौद्रीनामेन देवता । तस्या रोधनमात्रेण ४९ भगान्तस्थमशेषतः ४५० ।। ८१ ।। षट्त्यागात् सप्तमे स्थाने खगेशे व्योमविग्रहे । -४५४ निग्रहानुग्रहे ५२ शाक्ते ५३ भवति शक्तिरव्यया ॥। ८२ ।। •४५७ ४५८ ' तदा चोत्पद्यते ह्लादं जीवस्थ मणिपुद्गलम् अधःस्थं जन्मकोणस्य आधार जीवग्रन्थिकम् ॥ ८३ ॥ ४६१ मन – ऊर्मितरङ्गेषु शब्दराश्योपदेशकम् २ । - उद्भवे४६३ तत्र कौलीशं कौलीश ६४ हंसभैरवम् ।। ८४ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 317 The Wheel of the Root — the Yoni (There is a) Wheel between the anus and the genitals, beautifully adorned with the Fire and Moon.53 Pervaded by the lunar Point (indubindu), it is Khageśa, the Supreme Lord. (This is the) Wheel of the Root (kandacakra), which is said to be the Jewel that splits apart the vital centres (marman)54 of the channels (of the vital breath) (nāÆī). (76-77ab) Called Nādamālinī, the supreme power is each single (type). Again, (when) along with the five aspects (prakāra),55 she is threefold56 (her) form is that of the Yoni (bhagākrti). Her face the Yoni, She is the Sun, Moon and Fire within the Wheel of Mantra.57 (77cd-78) The hermitage of all (true) yogis,58 it is the Peak (syllable) (śekhara) the form of which is a water chestnut (śr‰gāta). It looks like a moving circle (valaya) and, indivisable, it is hard to cross beyond it. (79) It is transported by the force of Śakti (with which it is one) like that of the wind and the sky. The yogi there is said to be ±an˜ha as he is nondual by nature. His energy is said to be ±an˜hā, the deity called Raudrī. All things are contained within the Yoni by just blocking her (dissipated, deluding activity). (80-81) By abandoning the six, (the yogi realises) the imperishable energy on the seventh59 empowered plane of grace and punishment (nigrahānugraha) which is (that of) Khageśa (the Lord Who Moves in the Void) whose form is the Void. (82) Then the joy arises which is the Jewel and the individual soul (maSipudgala) located within the living being (jīva).60 Located below, it is the Knot of the Living Being (jīvagranthika), which is the foundation of the Triangle of Birth (janmakoSa). (83) In the midst of the waves and ripples of the mind,61 it imparts the teaching concerning the Assembly of Sounds (śabdarāśi).62 Kaulīśa, who is the Bhairava of the Gander (haˆsabhairava), (is present) in the upsurge (of power) (udbhava) that takes place there. (84)

sanskrit: 318 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ४६५ ४६६ तत् कपालाक्षरान्तस्थं कपालद्वारचक्रगम् ४६८ ४६९ ४७० ४६७ ४७२ ४७३ धरित्री ८ च ९ पुरे चक्रे महालक्ष्मी च नाभसः ॥ ८५ ॥ दशवायुनिरोधेन दशनाडीप्रभेदकम् । ४७८ एवमाधारचक्रं तु सिद्धमन्त्रोदय पुरम् ॥ ८६ ॥ तस्य शक्तिश्च॰९ मौनाख्या मलयस्था ह्यधोमुखी ८२ । ४८४ ४८५ । सिद्धञ्चोध्वमुखं यस्मात् तस्मात् तत् प्रत्ययं“ भवेत् ।। ८७ ।। ४८७ ४८८ प्रत्ययात्मा स्मृतं चक्रं तच्चक्रक्रमणादपिं । विलीनै:४८९ सर्वगैर्भावैरूध्वतो मोक्षमाप्नुयात् ।। ८८ । ४९४ ' एवं च कुलविज्ञान आज्ञाचक्रं च षड्विधम् षड्विधाज्ञाक्रमोद्देश९५ स्वाधिष्ठानकुल महत् ।। ८९ ।। ४९७ ५०० अधिष्ठानं“ कुलं यस्माद्” भूमिकार्थे विशोधनम् । भूमिकार्थस्य श्लोकेन विज्ञानकुलभास्करम् ।। ९० ॥ उदितं मोक्षधामस्थ अज्ञानविजिगीषिणाम् । ५०३ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे ४ मेरुमार्गविनिर्गते लक्षपादाधिके आद्यपीठावतारिते विमलभेदोत्तरषट्कनिर्णये कादिभेदें' ५०७ आज्ञापारमेश्वरे स्वामिनीमते श्रीचतुर्विंशतिसहस्रसंहिताया ५०९ अम्बाक्रमभाषिते“ वक्राम्नायकुलाष्टकाधिकारवर्णने क्रमोदयो नामानन्दः ॥ ६६ ॥ ५१० ५०५
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SIX 319 It is located in (Vāgbhava) the letter of the Skull within the Wheel that serves as the door of the Skull and Mahālaknamī is the sustaining power63 in the Wheel within the abode of the Void.64 (85) The Wheel of the Foundation breaks through the ten channels (nāÆī) by checking the ten (vital) winds. In this way it is the abode of the dawning of accomplished mantras.65 (86) And his power is called Silence (Maunākhyā). Located in the Malaya (Triangle), it faces downwards. And (when that reality) is attained (siddha), (the Triangle of the Foundation) faces upwards and so that (Wheel) is the insight (of realisation) (pratyaya).66 (87) (Indeed) the Wheel is said to be insight (which is achieved) also by the Wheel’s progressive advance (kramaSa). (Throught it, the individual soul) whose pervasive worldly states of being (bhāva) have dissolved away, attains liberation. (88) Such is the consciousness of Kula and (such) the sixfold Wheel of the Command. (This is) the teaching concerning the sixfold sequence of the Command, the great Kula of the (Wheel) of the Self-supported.67 (89) Kula is the support as it is the purification (that takes place) within the reality of the planes (of Yoga) (bhūmikārtha). It is the Sun of the Kula of Consciousness (realised by understanding just one) verse concerning of the reality of the planes (of Yoga) (bhūmikārtha). It is manifest and established in the abode of liberation of those who wish to conquer ignorance.68 (90-91ab) This is the (sixty-sixth) chapter which is the emergence of the transmission (kramodaya) with regards to the description concerning the Octad of Kula according to the Tradition of the (goddess) Vakrā. It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition (anvaya) that consists of seventy million (verses) that has emerged on the Path of Meru and (extends) for more than a hundred thousand quarter (verses). It has been brought (down to earth) into the first sacred seat (ādyapī˜ha). It is the ultimate purport of the Subsequent Six Thousand (verses) of the Pure Division (vimalabhedottarana˜ka) in the division beginning with `KĀ' in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses) (known as) the Svāminīmata of the Supreme Lord's command as uttered within the Tradition of the Mother (ambākrama).

sanskrit: सप्तषष्टानन्दः श्रीनाथ उवाच मुद्रामन्त्रविकासेन' अतः करणमण्डले । क्रमभेदानि चोक्तानि त्वया ह्यकुलकन्दरे ॥ १ ॥ तेषां तत्त्वोदय ै सम्यक् आत्मसञ्चित्तिपूर्वकम्' । तथा तत्त्वाधिकार ै तु योगपीठे क्रमत्रये ।। २ । श्रीवक्रा उवाच १० सृष्टिपीठात् समारभ्य यावत् वक्रतनुर्हयहम् । तावत् तत्त्वोदय चात्र कथयामि समासतः ॥ ३ ॥ कामरूपे भवेदिन्द्रं कामना सृष्टिरुच्यते । आपः ँ पूर्णगिरि: प्रोक्त: तेजो जालन्धरं स्मृतम् ॥ ४ ॥ ॐकारं भवते वायुस्तत्त्वमेकं भवेत् त्रिधा । २३ तत्राकाशो” भवेदिच्छा” स कुमारः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ ५ ॥ तस्य ऊध्वे४ च कामिन्या गन्धतन्मात्रनायकी । रसरूपात्मिका पूर्णा ं तेजस्तन्मात्र ज्वालिनी ।। ६ ॥ २७ शब्दरूपा भवेदोड्रा ँ त्रिविधा सा व्यवस्थिता । ३० स्पर्शतन्मात्रकं” विष्णुः” स च सिंहक्रमे स्थितः ॥ ७ ॥ श्रीकण्ठो” वाग्विधानेन करात्मको महामति: ३३ ३६ ईश्वरात्मा च पादयोः पायुगो नन्दिरुद्रकः ॥ ८ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SEVEN The Sūtra Concerning the Sequence of Principles. The First Presentation of the Principles Śrīnātha said: So you have talked about the divisions of the Krama in the Root of Akula (akulakandara) and in the circle of the instruments (of mantra) (karaSamaSÆala) (brought about) by the expansion of mantra and Mudrā.1 (1) (Now tell me about) the correct manner of the arising of the principles pertaining to them which is preceded by the awareness (saˆcitti) of the Self. (Tell me) also about the (extent of) the authority of the principles in the sacred seat of Yoga (yogapī˜ha)2 within the three Kramas. (2) The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: I will tell (you) briefly about the emergence of the principles (that takes place) here starting from the sacred seat of emanation up to myself whose body is crooked. (3) Indra (who governs Earth) resides in Kāmarūpa. It is said that desire (kāmanā) is emanation.3 Water is said to be PūrSagiri, while Fire (tejas) is said to be Jālandhara. (The sacred seat of) the letter O¤ is Air. (Thus) the one principle is threefold (as the the first three elements). There (in that case), Space is the will (icchā) and he (who governs it) is said to be Kumāra. (4-5) Above him is Kāminyā who is the mistress of the subtle element of smell. PūrSā (the Full One) is the nature of taste (rasa). The subtle element of fire is Jvālinī. (6) OÆrā is sound (śabda) and she is threefold (as the previous three). VinSu, who is in the Transmission of the Lion, is the subtle element of touch. (7) ŚrīkaS˜ha (abides) as the prescription of speech, Mahāmati is the hands. Īśvara is within the nature of the two feet and Rudra Nandi is in the genital organ (pāyu). (8)

sanskrit: 322 कुमारिकाखण्ड: उपस्थं भैरवाकारं सद्योजातात्मक भवेत् । ४० अनाहतात्मनः” श्रोत्रं” त्वचात्मा मणिपूरकम् ॥ ९ ॥ ४२ चक्षुराज्ञा” विभुः श्वासो” जिह्वा इन्द्रियमण्डले । विशुद्धं नासिका ज्ञेया आधारो मन उच्यते ॥ १० ॥ बुद्धिमीतङ्गिनीतत्त्व अहंकार पुलिन्दिका । ४७ प्रकृतिः शवरी नाम ँ पुरुषों विजयोच्यते ॥ ११ ॥ स ब्रह्मा स च अद्वैतः सृष्टिकती जगत्त्रये । ५३ | तस्य कला`` तु सकल सपिण्डस्थानगोचरम् ।। १२ ।। लिङ्गस्यांशाङ्गसहित्य करोति विकरोति च । बाह्यात्मा चान्तरङ्गश्च जंगमः परिरूप्यते ॥ १३ ॥ उपभेदैश्च भेदेषु नियत्या” कालचोदितः” । ६४ उदिता सा शिवस्यापि ४ शक्तिर्विमलरूपिणी ॥ १४ ॥ समना सा स्वरूपेण उन्मना महन्तारिका । स्वानन्दानन्दमाना तु सृजते सा जगत्त्रयम् ॥ १५ ॥ शिवस्याज्ञास्वरूपा ँ तु कुब्जिकाहं नपुंसका । जितेन्द्रियवशेनापि अधिकारे च तापसे ॥ १६ ॥ संपुटेन हि विद्या च भकारादिविभागशः” । ७७ ७८ ७५ न स्त्री न पुरुषोऽह ँ वा इच्छाशक्तिवरास्मि सा पुरुषो बीजवन्मात्रः क्षेत्रज्ञः स च¨ उच्यते । शुभाशुभात्मकः कर्ता कर्मसङ्गेन बध्यते ।। १८ ॥ ।। १७ ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SEVEN 323 The anus is in the form of Bhairava and it is Sadyojāta by nature. The ear belongs to the nature (of the Wheel of) Unstruck Sound, while (the Wheel) Full of Gems is the skin. (9) (The Wheel of the) Command is the eye, while the pervasive breath is the tongue in the circle of the senses. One should know that the nose is (the Wheel of) Purity, while the (Wheel of the) Foundation is said to be the mind. (10) The intellect is the principle MātaSginī, while the ego is Pulindikā. Nature is Śavarī, while the Person is said to be Vijayā.4 (11) (Puruna) is Brahmā and, one without a second (advaita), is the creator (srn˜ikartr) in the three worlds.5 His energy (kalā) is everything (sakala) including the field of the location of (his) body (piSÆasthāna). (12) He brings about and terminates conjunction with the parts and limbs of the body (li‰ga). He is the external Self and the inner (antara‰ga) and is described as mobile (jangama). (He is) impelled by Time along with Natural Law (niyati) in (his main) varieties together with the secondary ones. (13-14ab) Again, the energy of Śiva is active (uditā) and without stain. She is ‘with mind’ (samanā), who in her essential nature is Mahantārikā,6 the Transmental (unmanā). Blissful with her own innate bliss, she emanates the three worlds. (14cd-15ab) I am Kubjikā the Female Neuter (napuˆsakā), Śiva's (divine) Command. By virtue of control (I have over) the senses (I have conquered) (I am) also (present) in the authority (that governs all things) within austerity. (I am) the Vidyā along with (its) encapsulation and the letters starting with Bha, part by part.7 (15cd-17ab) I am neither male (puruna) nor female (strī),8 I am that most excellent power of the will. The Person is just the bearer of seed (bījavatmātra)9 and is said to be the `knower of the field'. He is the agent who is both auspicious and inauspicious and is bound by (his) association with action (karman). (17cd-18)

sanskrit: 324 कुमारिकाखण्ड: ८० न कर्ताहं शिवो मन्ये” पुरुषत्वात् “ करिष्यति । धरित्र्यादिशिवान्तं च” तत्त्वपिण्डं स उच्यते ॥ १९ ॥ चतुर्विधे भूतसर्गे स एव हि पशुर्भवेत् । ३ ८७ ८८ ८९ अष्टमे“ मानसे” जन्म अष्टमं याति“ चाश्रमम् ।। २० ।। कामरूपादिमारभ्य ं यावस्था सालयं भवेत् । यावन्न कर्मकोटिभिः९३ शिवाह४ नैव चार्चिता ।। २१ ।। तावत् प्राप्तिः कथं मत्यै: श्रीक्रमे गुणवत्तरे । येन यष्टेन संशुद्धिर्मलस्य त्रिविधस्य च ।। २२ ।। तत्त्वानि व्युत्क्रम यान्ति” सप्ताविंशत्पदानि च । तेषां विनाशनार्थाय क्रममार्ग ३ निदर्शितम् ।। २३ ॥ मण्डलेन ०४ यजनं जाप शिवविद्यामहाव्रतम् । सर्वोव भवते सम्यक् वाग्भवस्य यथा स्थिति:' १०९ तत्त्वानां च विभागं तु तव वक्ष्याम्यहं पुनः । ११० १०७ ।। २४ ।। कामरूपं भवेत् पृथ्वी आप: पूर्णगिरिः स्मृतः ।। २५ ।। जालन्धरं महातेजो वायुरोंकारमण्डलम्” । आकाशं तिस्रपीठ”? तु श्रीमच्चन्द्रपुरं गृहम् ।। २६ ।। ११३ महाभूता: स्मृताः पञ्च तेषा तन्मात्रपञ्चकम् ' ११८ ११५ गन्धस्तु पार्थिवे तत्त्वे आपस्तत्त्वे रस १९ भवेत् ।। २७ ।। तेजस्य भवते रूपं वायुः स्पर्शे त्वतो भवेत् । १२१
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SEVEN 325 (In the liberated state he reflects): “I am not the agent. I believe that Śiva will do (all things) because he is (in reality) the Person (puruna).” Again, he is said to be the aggregate of the principles (tattvapiSÆa) from the Earth up to Śiva. Moreover, he himself is the fettered soul, (imprisoned) within the fourfold creation (bhūtasarga).10 (And it is he who) in the eighth mental birth attains (liberation which is) the eighth place of rest.11 (19-20) That state which (encompasses all creation) beginning with Kāmarūpa as the first is the abode (of all things). Unless I, who am Śivā, am not worshipped with countless millions of actions, how can mortals attain (the ultimate goal) in the most excellent Śrīkrama. It is by him (who has) worshipped (in this way) that the triple impurity is cleaned away. (21-22) The principles (of existence) become disordered as do the twenty-seven12 planes (that correspond to them). The Krama Path (consisting of) the sacrificial rite with the maSÆala, repetition of mantra, and Śiva's Great Vow of Knowledge, has been revealed in order to destroy (these impurities). It is above all (else) and is correct (in all respects) as is the condition (sthiti) of (the seed-syllable), Vāgbhava (AI¤). (23-24) The Second Presentation of the Principles Now I will tell (you) again about the division of the principles (of existence). (25ab) Kāmarūpa is Earth, while Water is said to be PūrSagiri. Jālandhara is the Great Fire (mahātejas), while Wind is the circle of (the sacred seat of) O¤, Space is the sacred seat Tisra. The venerable City of the Moon is (Tisra’s) abode (grha). (25cd-26) (These) five are said to be the Great Elements. The group of five subtle elements are (associated with) them. (The subtle element of) smell is in the Earth principle. Taste (rasa) is in the Water principle. (The subtle element of) form belongs to Fire and, next, Wind is in touch. Space is the Great Sound.* (27-28abc)

sanskrit: 326 आकाशं तु महाशब्दः कुमारिकाखण्ड: १२३ इन्द्रियकर्मपञ्चकम् ।। २८ ।। गन्धतत्त्वे स्मृता वाचा स्पर्शतत्त्वे ५ करद्वयम् । शब्दमध्ये २७ तथा पाद२८ पायोस्तेजसि २९ संभव:' १३१ १३२ उपस्थो जायते स्वादें तन्मात्रकर्मपञ्चकम् । १३६ १३० ।। २९ ।। अथ बुद्धेन्द्रियाण्याहुस्तथा कर्मेन्द्रियेषु च ।। ३० ॥ उपस्थस्थमिद श्रोत्रं तथा पाणिगतं त्वचम् ' पायुतत्त्व महाचक्षु' रसना पादमण्डले ।। ३१ । । वाक्तत्त्वे च” स्मृता नासा पृथिव्याद्या भवन्ति ते । १४३ तेषा मूर्ध्नि” स्थितो ह्यसौ་२ अनादिशिवमव्ययः ।। ३२ ।। बुद्धिः कर्मानुसारेण कामरूपे उपस्थिता । । मनो बुद्धिबलेनैव पीठे जालन्धरे स्थितम् ॥ ३३ ॥ मनोवेगेन १४६ हंकार४७ ज्ञात्वव्य तु पुराश्रमे । प्रकृतिर्वाममार्गे तु पूर्णगिर्ये व्यवस्थिता ।। ३४ ॥ पुरुषों बीजवन्मात्रः स्थितश्चन्द्रपुरालये । तस्याश्रम'५२ भवेन्नाद'५३ अन्तरात्मानिशाकरम् ५४ ।। ३५ ।। एवं भागवतो लिङ्गं भगाकारं प्रतिष्ठितम् । क्रियाशक्तिर्महापिण्ड“ प्रत्ययात्मा तदुच्यते ।। ३६ ।। साहं देव परित्राता५९ मन्त्रमार्गे प्रतिष्ठिता । १६१ शिवस्य सा तु या मात्रा काचिद् भेदगुणान्विता ।। ३७ ।। तिस्रस्रोतोद्भवानन्दा ६३ आनन्दो भवमालिनी १४ । १६५ । सा माता सर्वजन्तूनां धरित्र्यादिविभागशः ।। ३८ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SEVEN 327 (Next I will tell you about) the five organs of action. Speech is said (to reside) in the principle of smell and the two hands in the principle of touch. Similarly, the foot (which is the organ of locomotion) is within (the subtle element of) sound and genital organ is generated within light (tejas) (which is sight). The anus arises within taste. (This is) the group of the five (organs of) action and the subtle elements. (28d-30ab) Now, they say that the organs of sense are in the same way within the organs of action. This ear is located in the anus and the skin is within the hands. The principle of the genitals is the great eye, while the tongue is in the sphere of the feet. (30cd-31) The nose is said to be in the principle of speech. They are (equivalent) to the Earth and the other (gross elements). He, the beginningless and imperishable Śiva, is at the head of them (all). (32) The intellect is present in Kāmarūpa in accord with (its) function. By the power of the intellect, the mind is present in the sacred seat of Jālandhara. (33) One should know that, by the force of the mind, the ego is within (OÆÆiyāna) the Hermitage of the City (of the maSÆala). Nature is located on the left path within PūrSagiri. (34) The Person, who is just the bearer of seed (bījavanmātra),13 resides in the abode of the City of the Moon. His hermitage is Sound, the Moon of the inner Self.14 (35) In this way, the lord's Li‰ga is established in the form of the Yoni (bhagākāra). The great body (of mantra) (mahāpiSÆa), it is the power of action and it said to be the essential nature of (every) sign of attainment (pratyaya). (36) O god, established on the Path of Mantra,15 I am she who saves. (I am) she, that certain (inscrutable) measure (of power) (mātrā), endowed with the qualities of duality, that belongs to Śiva. (37) (I am) the bliss generated from the current of (the sacred seat) Tisra. Bliss is (indeed myself) Bhavamālinī. She is the mother of all living beings (and existing things) starting with the Earth onwards, part by part. (38)

sanskrit: 328 कुमारिकाखण्ड: मध्य अनादिनिधनलयोत्पत्तिविवर्जितम् । खं किञ्चित् सुसूक्ष्मस्यापि शतांशस्य सहस्रकम् ।। ३९ ।। १७० भावनामात्र तच्छून्य चैतन्यं शिवमुच्यते । एवं तत्त्वस्वरूपेण शाक्तं लिङ्गं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ ४० ॥ तदेव २ चिञ्चिणीवृक्ष७३ कीर्तिदेवो नभस्तले । १७२ श्रीमच्चन्द्रपुरे जातं तत्त्वं पिण्डीकृत च यत् ॥ ४१ ॥ स एव प्राकृतिस्वामी भुवनानां महालयम् । १७६ १७८ अनन्तादिशिवान्त लीनं सर्वमिदं जगत् ॥। ४२ ।। स्थित्युत्पत्तिर्विपत्तिश्च चतुर्द्वीरोऽपि वर्तते । १८३ प्रधानत्वे स्थित पाश मायार्णवकोर्मिजम्¨ ॥। ४३ ।। एवं मार्गे“ तु सकल प्रवृत्तं रमणादिषु । ९८६ १८७ १८८ निवृत्तिश्चोपचार तु उपदेशेन गीयते ।। ४४ ।। पिण्डं तस्या अधिष्ठान सा चाह परिकीर्तिता' १९२ । पाशजाले यथा” बद्धो विहङ्गो मुग्धचेतसः मुग्धचेतसः “ ।। ४५ ॥ पश्चात् स' भवते त्यक्त उत्पतेत् गगनान्तरे । तद्वदात्मा” च° पिण्डस्थः तिष्ठते मुग्धचेतसः २०४ २०५ २०१ पिण्डस्थोऽयं पदं मन्त्रः रूपलक्षणमादिकम् रूपातीतं सर्वगतं सर्वेषामुपरिस्थितम् २०९ पिण्डस्थ॰८ च पदस्थ च रूपस्थ •२१० तत्त्वपञ्चाशिका सम्यक्”” तवाख्याता २१२ २०६ । ।। ४७ ।। रूपवर्जितम् । २०३ ।। ४६ ।। मया प्रभो ॥ ४८ ॥
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SEVEN 329 In the middle, without beginning or end, devoid of arising and falling away there is a certain (undefinable) Void, a thousandth part of a hundred of what is very subtle. A state of pure contemplation, that Void is the consciousness said to be Śiva. (39-40ab) Such is said to be the empowered (śākta) Li‰ga as the essential nature of (all) the principles (tattvasvarūpeSa). That is the Tamarind (ciñciSī) Tree, the Lord of Fame (Kīrtideva) who resides in the sky (of pure consciousness). (40cd-41ab) Arisen in the venerable City of the Moon, it is (the one) reality (tattva) in which (all the principles) have been gathered together (piSÆīkrta).16 He indeed is the Lord of Nature, the great abode of (all) the worlds. (41cd-42ab) All this, beginning with Ananta up to Śiva, is merged (there within it). Creation, persistence and destruction (take place there) and the fourth door (beyond these three) is also (there within it) (42cd43ab) (It is also) Fundamental Nature (pradhāna) and, as such, bondage (pāśa), born from the waves of the ocean of Māyā, is (there) within it. In this way everything is on the path (of bondage), engaged in sexual pleasures and the other (illusory enjoyments of the world). (43cd-44ab) Service (of the deity) and cessation (from worldly involvement) is extolled as the teaching. Her body (piSÆa) is the support (of all things) and she is praised as me. (44cd-45ab) Just as an innocent bird caught in a net of snares flies up (into the air) as soon as it is freed, similarly the innocent Self resides within the body (piSÆa) (waiting to be freed). (45cd-46) This part (of mantra), mantra (itself), form, sign and the rest is (all) in the body (piSÆastha). Beyond Form (rūpātīta), it is omnipresent and stands above all things. Established in the Body, Established in the Word, Established in Form and Devoid of Form17 - (thus) O Lord, I have rightly told you the fifty (verses) concerning the principles (tattvapañcāśikā). (47-48)

sanskrit: 330 कुमारिकाखण्ड: २१४ पीठपिण्डसमाचार”३ तत्त्वपञ्चाशिकाक्रमम् । आख्यातं तव १५ देवेश सूत्राकारेण सूत्रतः ॥ ४९ ॥ २१६ इत्याद्यावतारे महामन्थानभैरवयज्ञे ६ अन्वये सप्तकोटिप्रमाणे श्रीमच्चतुर्विंशतिसाहस्रे २१८ तत्त्वक्रमाधिकारसूत्रम् ॥ ६७ ॥ २१७
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-SEVEN 331 The transmission of the fifty (verses) concerning the principles (teaches) the co-ordination (samācāra) of the sacred seats with the body. O Lord of the gods, (this) has been told to you, expounded succinctly (sūtritaƒ) in the form of a sūtra. (49) (This) is the Sūtra concerning the Sequence of Principles (tattvakrama). It belongs to the primordial descent into the great sacrifice of the Churning Bhairava in the tradition that consists of seventy million (verses) in the venerable scripture of twenty-four thousand (verses).

english: CHAPTER SIXTY-EIGHT The Sūtra of the Compendium concerning Liberation. A Visualization of the Goddess Kubjikā1 The venerable (goddess) Vakrā said: (One should think of the goddess as) having six aspects, with an immense body and of the form of light, she is clothed in Yoga. (She is) everything without exception and (their) latent traces. The greatest of all, (she is) every state of being. (1) (She is) CiñciSī (the goddess of the Tamarind Tree), supremely horrific as she burns dark blue, red and scarlet.2 (She is) the Sweeper (Māta‰ginī) of the Kula, Raudrī, the goddess Kujā with six faces. (2) She shines with (her) eighteen eyes, greedy for the pleasures of wine. Her face is the Yoni (bhānanā), her form is the Yoni (bhagākāra) and she possesses six Yonis.3 (3) She is in the middle of the Yoni (bhaga)4 (of the syllable AI¤) and, terrible, she has been encapsulated within the Yoni. A treasury of the thirty-two syllables, she is Kubjikā, the mistress of Kula.5 She pervades the circle of the sky with the eighty-four depositions (of mantras). Indeed, she is the goddess Khageśvarī (the Skyfarer). Immortal, (she is) the pure (form of) Kālikā. (4-5) She is the goddess TrikhaSÆā6 Bhairavī, she is the most excellent (goddess) Tripurā.7 Established on the path of the Mālinī Kula, she is (the goddess) Kujā who is in the lotus of the heart. (6) She is the light of the lamp of the Śrīkula, Barbarā (the tribal woman) of many forms.8 (She is) the mother of Rudra, the mother of the Siddhas and the mother of the great Bhairava. (7) She is the mother of the heroes, the mother of yogis and the mother of the sacred seats who has given birth to the universe. Endowed with the six parts, she is terrible. In her eighteen hands (she holds) a trident, dagger, sword, an arrow, (she makes a) frightening (gesture), (holds) a noose, small double-headed drum, a club and Kaula sacrificial pap (carukaulika). These nine (attributes) are on the right. In the same way there are nine (attributes) on the left.9 (8-9ab)

sanskrit: 334 कुमारिकाखण्ड: पाश डमरुक चैव खेटक चरुकौलिकम् ॥ ९ ॥ नवैते दक्षिणे मार्गे वाममार्गे तथा नव । ५६ ५७ कपाल“ चैव खट्वाङ्ग रत्नमाला च कार्मुकम् ॥ १० ॥ अंकुश पीठमुद्रा च खेटक पुस्तकासनम् । देव्याष्टादशमुद्रास्तु चिन्तयेत् सपरिग्रहाम् ॥। ११ ॥ ६८ ७० ७२ । पदैः“ पञ्चभिः” संयुक्ता अपटा नग्नवाससा बिम्बाक्षिणी अधोवस्त्रा व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनी ॥ १२ ॥ जिह्वाजैरुपवीतैवी मुद्रापञ्चकभूषिता । ७७ ७४ भुजाष्टादशसंयुक्ता ँ मुद्रापीठोद्गिरावहा ।। १३ ॥ स्वरमालाशिरोबद्धा” वर्णाहारावलम्बिनी । ८३ भूषिता दिव्यव्योमेन कोटिद्वादशडामरैः ॥ १४ ॥ रत्नमाला¨ गले बद्धा दिव्यरत्नविभूषिता“ । महाकुसुमजातीभि: ँ शोभिता परमेश्वरी ।। १५ ॥ o चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरैरलिनामोदनन्दिता । सुगन्धगन्धदिग्वासा” सुधूपामोदवाससा ।। १६ । दिव्यै रत्नैर्महावस्त्रैः” संवृता¨ परमेश्वरी । कलातीता सर्वगता सर्वेषामुपरिस्थिता ।। १७ ।। ९७ ९६ षट्प्रकारा कुजा देवी परमाक्षरविग्रहा“ । ईदृग्रूपधरा आज्ञा द्वाचत्वारिंशदक्षरा ।। १८ ।। स्वभावेन कुब्जाकारा विद्याभेदे कुजाम्बिका । ०७ चन्द्रद्वीपे४ महाकुब्जा स्थिता श्रीकण्ठानुग्रहे ॥ १९ ॥ त्रिविधेन तु मार्गेण कुजालक्ष तु भेदयेत् । ध्यानमेवं पुरा ज्ञात्वा स्वशरीरे” समभ्यसेत्” ।। २० ।।
english: CHAPTER SIXTY-EIGHT 335 (She also holds) a skull bowl, an ascetic's staff, a rosary of gems, a bow, an elephant gaud, casket (pī˜ha), seal (mudrā), a club and a book rest (pustakāsana). (These are) the goddess’s eighteen divine positions. One should think (of her) as having (this) form.10 (9cd-11) She possesses the has five parts (pada) (of mantra)11 and, without clothes, she is clothed in nakedness.12 (Her) eyes (are red like) the Bimba (fruit), her face is turned downwards and she wears a snake as (her) sacred thread. (12) Or (imagine her as wearing) sacred threads made of (human) tongues and that she is adorned with the Five Ensignias. Endowed with eighteen arms, she transports (the teaching) uttered (udgira) in the Sacred Seat of Gesture (mudrāpī˜ha).13 (13) (To her) head is fastened a rosary of vowels and she wears a necklace of letters. She is adorned with the divine sky (of consciousness) and twelve hundred million warlocks. (14) A jewelled necklace clasps (her) neck and she is adorned with divine gems. (She is) the Supreme Goddess, beautiful with great flowers and jasmines. (15) She is delighted with the fragrance of liquor along with (that of) sandalwood, musk and camphor. The sweet smelling directions are (her) apparel and her clothes are fragrant with fine incense. (16) (She is) the Supreme Goddess swathed in clothes of great (value) and (adorned with) divine gems. Beyond (the sphere of) energies and omnipresent, she is above all (others). (17) The goddess Kujā has six aspects (na˜prakārā) and her form is the supreme syllable. (She who) is the forty-two syllable (Vidyā) is the (divine) Command which bears this kind of form. (18) By nature her form is that of a hunchbacked woman (kubjā) and, within the various forms of the Vidyā, she is mother Kujā. She is the great (goddess) Kubjā who resides on the Island of the Moon and abides in ŚrīkaS˜ha's grace. (19) One should break through Kujā, the target, by means of the threefold path.14 Having first known (this) visualization in this way, one should practice it within one's own body. (20)
